title: Modern Pack for CustomNPC+
description: A JAPPA Style pack for CustomNPC+ and CustomNPCs!
body:
In CustomNPC+ 1.9 new textures were designed for all the existing items to be more JAPPA-styled. These were all automatically added to the mod update. But, upon request, those who use later versions of Custom Npcs on 1.8 through 1.16 want access to these textures via a texture pack. Here they are! All the updated textures for you to use, please enjoy and give all credit to the Artist PopsicleNate for redoing all these textures.


Currently not updated are the Armors and Blocks. They will come in a later update so stay tuned! Thank you all for the support.

[![Showcase](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KAMKEEL/CustomNPC-Plus/dev/images/showcase.gif)]()

title: It's Raining Dogs!
description: Adds three new adorable wolf variations to your world! Requires the corresponding Data Pack.
body:
# It's Raining Dogs!
This wolves adds the textures for three new adorable wolf variants. It's the resource pack companion to the [It's Raining Dogs datapack](https://modrinth.com/project/raining-dogs-dp). 

![Three dogs sitting on top of a stone floor with logs and leaves behind them. The first dog has a golden coat, behind it are cherry leaves and logs. The second dog is black, brown and white, behind it are dark oak leaves and logs. The last dog has a merle coat pattern, behind it are birch leaves and logs.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/86b6b3eb7709ecdb0302ea66262baecca05059c2.png)

**This resource pack does nothing on it's own!** You will need the respective datapack for the wolves to spawn!

## More Information
Please check the [corresponding datapack](https://modrinth.com/project/raining-dogs-dp) for additional information, as well as an important note on worldgen compatability.

title: Chroma Realms
description: Immerse yourself in the challenging challenge of researching measurements, mines and mob behavior in the Chroma Realms mod!
body:
# Chroma Realms
There are 4 worlds in the mod, many strong mobs and bosses, as well as tools and blocks! The mod is updated, and the bugs are fixed. Stay tuned for new updates!

## Mobs
Now in this mod you can spawn and see 8 mobs:
- Chroma Cow
- Chroma Pig
- Boss Zombie
- Boss Cow
- Boss Spider
- Boss Chicken
- Best dog ever
- Demon Villager

## Worlds
Now in this mod you can activate 4 portals:
- Chroma World
- Chroma Realm
- Metaverse
- Purgatory

## Ores, ingots
Now in this mod you can find 5 ores
- Andrezite ore - Andrezite Ingot
- Mytherite ore - Mytherite Ingot
- Realmize ore - Realmize Ingot
- Chroma ore - Chroma Dust - Chroma Ingot
- Mikolite ore - Mikolite Ingot

## Tools
Now in this mod you can craft 9 tools
- Andrezite pickaxe
- Mytherite pickaxe
- Realmize pickaxe
- Chroma pickaxe (3x3 mining)
- Chroma World Portal Igniter
- Chroma Realm Portal Igniter
- Meta Verse Portal Igniter
- Brokened Igniter
- Disc Launcher

## Food
Now in this mod you can eat 6 food
- Boss meat
- Baked boss meat
- Bloody eye
- Poop
- Rib
- Brain

title: The FFK Project
description: Kitchen-Sink modpack with mods from magic to tech and exploration. A wide variety of mods to choose from and enjoy!

Using performance enhancing mods, you can play this modpack on low end computers as well without issue! Have customization through the Essentials' paid and free cosmetics as well as Cosmetica's completely free cosmetics. title: TerralizationCompat
description: This is a modcore for the terralization modpack
body:
This is a modcore for the terralization modpack, others are free to use this as long as you are following the license.

TerralizationCompat is compatible with minetweaker/crafttweaker and oredict edits made there will apply to TerralizationCompat recipes.

### As of version 1.0.2 this adds
+ oredict recipe for dustQuartz to be enriched(mekanism) to quartz
+ oredict recipe for gemDiamond to be enriched(mekanism) to compresseddiamonds

title: AntiGhost Continued
description: A mod that fixes ghost blocks in the minecraft. A continuation of anti ghost mod that made by Giselbaer.
body:
# 👻 AntiGhost Continued

Tired of **"ghost blocks"** ruining your game experience? This is the updated and maintained version of the classic AntiGhost mod!

***

## ❓ What is a Ghost Block?

Ghost blocks occur when the Minecraft client thinks a block is there, but the server knows it’s gone (or vice versa). This often happens during fast mining, fast placing, explosions, or high-latency gameplay, leading to players getting stuck or falling through "invisible" floors.

## ✨ Key Features

### ⚡ Instant Desync Fix

Quickly synchronizes blocks in a specific radius around the player to ensure what you see is actually there.

### 🧤 Simple Use

Just type `/antighost` or press  `G`  (default keybind) to refresh nearby blocks and reveal the truth!

### ⌨️ Customization

Take advantage of custom keybinds to enhance your ghost block-free **experience**.

### 🚀 Updated Support

Specifically maintained and optimized for the latest Minecraft versions (including **1.21.1**).

***

## 🛠 How to Use

*   **Command:** Enter `/antighost` in the chat.
*   **Keybind:** The default keybind for the mod is `G`. You can change this in your Minecraft controls settings.
*   **Downloading:** You need [fabric api](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) to use this mod

***

## 📜 Licensing & Credits

*   **Original Creator:** This mod is a continuation of the original **AntiGhost** mod. Huge thanks to the original author **Giselbaer** for the initial concept.
*   **License:** This version is distributed under a **Custom License**. Please refer to the [LICENSE](https://github.com/enflkyls/AntiGhost-Continued/blob/main/LICENSE) file in our repository for terms of use regarding modifications and redistribution.

title: Immortal Armor
description: adds a ore that can be crafted into the most op tools in the game
body:
Adds a powerful ore, **Nectrurm**, mineable with a diamond pickaxe, letting you craft tools and armor that grant near-creative mode abilities. Wearing the full Nectrurm armor set enables true invincibility and lets you toggle flight by pressing **J (now it is just automatic like if you were in creative.)** — soar through the world effortlessly while wielding ultra-OP tools and weapons that break blocks instantly and one-shot mobs. This mod is pure overkill for players craving god-tier power in Minecraft.

**V4.0.0** — adds an item duper where you press **G** to open it.

**V7.0.0** — added the ability to create explosions. By default the keybinding is not bound; it is under the **Miscellaneous** section.

Any version with **x.1.x** is a nerfed version.

**V10.x.x** adds QoL improvements such as:

- redesigned GUIs
- an item picker for the most common items
- a separated settings GUI

**V12.x.x+** adds the ability to bind a key to the keybind **"Phase Through Blocks"** in **Misc** to swap between Survival and Spectator.

**V13.x.x+** adds the following features (a lot):

- 2 new dimensions — the **Cave World** (accessible by breaking bedrock in the Overworld, instantly teleporting you) and the **Skyland** (accessible by going to **Y=400**)
- the ability to perform an **Orbital Strike** by going into the Hacks GUI (default **G**) and clicking the button **"Other Actions"**
- the ability to teleport to any location in the same GUI as before
- fixed flying in Spectator so you can scroll to change speed
- fixed flying checks so if you are not wearing the armor set and enter Spectator, you won't fall through the world
- made the ore harder to find; upgrading the mod keeps the ore in existing chunks with the new texture since the ore is now found only in the End and is mineable only with a diamond pickaxe
- replaced tool textures with default Netherite tool textures
- made diamonds super common in the Cave World

(1 Heart = 2 HP) starting-hearts: 10 # The maximum number of hearts a player can achieve. # Players cannot use heart items if they reach this limit. max-hearts: 20 # The minimum number of hearts a player can drop to. # Players cannot withdraw hearts if it would put them below this limit. min-hearts: 1 # What action should be taken when a player loses all their hearts (or reaches the min limit)? ban-duration-minutes: 60 # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Crafting System (Dynamic) # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- recipe: # Enable or disable the crafting recipe for Heart Capsules. enabled: true # The crafting shape (3 lines). # Use characters to represent items defined in the 'ingredients' section below. # Space " " counts as an empty slot. shape: - "DGD" - "GTG" - "DGD" # Define what item each character represents. # Use valid Bukkit Material names (e.g., DIAMOND_BLOCK, TOTEM_OF_UNDYING, NETHERITE_INGOT). ingredients: T: TOTEM_OF_UNDYING D: DIAMOND_BLOCK G: GOLD_BLOCK # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Gameplay Mechanics # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- gameplay: # If true, players will lose a heart from environmental deaths (lava, fall damage, drowning). # If false, players only lose hearts when killed by another player (PvP). environment-heart-loss: false # If true, players drop their inventory when they die (Vanilla style). # If false, keep-inventory is enabled for deaths. drop-items-on-death: true # Security measure to prevent players from killing the same player repeatedly to farm hearts. prevent-farming: true # The cooldown time (in seconds) before a player can gain a heart from the same victim again. farm-cooldown-seconds: 300 # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Item Customization # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- item: # The display name of the heart item. Supports color codes (&). heart-item-name: "&c&lHeart Capsule" # The material of the heart item. title: ServerLimitGauge
description: ⚡ Stop Guessing, Start Measuring! The Ultimate High-Precision Server Benchmark. Detect Bottlenecks & Calculate Player Capacity with Real-World Stress Tests. [1.20+]
body:
# 📢 Overview
**Stop guessing your server's capacity. Measure it.**

**ServerLimitGauge** is a professional benchmarking tool designed specifically for Minecraft servers (Spigot, Paper, Purpur, Folia). Unlike generic hardware benchmarks (like Geekbench), this plugin measures **"actual Minecraft performance"**.

It stresses the server with real-world scenarios—Chunk Generation, Entity AI processing, and Math physics—to calculate a reliable **"Recommended Player Count"** and **"Server Rank"** (SSS to C).

**Why use this?**
*   "I bought an i9 server, but it lags." 👉 **Identify if it's a Disk I/O or RAM bottleneck.**
*   "How many players can I host?" 👉 **Get a calculated estimate, not a guess.**
*   "Is my server host scamming me?" 👉 **Visualize the true performance.**

# ✨ Key Features
*   **📊 Real-World Metrics:** Measures **MSPT (Milliseconds Per Tick)** impact from Entities, Chunk I/O, and CPU math separately.
*   **🛡️ Safety Circuit Breaker:** Features a built-in safety limit. If the server lags too much (TPS drops), the benchmark **aborts immediately** to prevent crashes.
*   **🧠 Intelligent Diagnosis:** Automatically identifies bottlenecks. It tells you: *"CPU is great, but your RAM speed is limiting performance."*
*   **🎯 High Precision:** Uses **Trimmed Averaging** logic to ignore lag spikes and warm-up jitters, ensuring consistent results on both high-end and budget CPUs.
*   **📂 Log Reports:** Saves detailed benchmark reports with hardware specs (CPU Model, RAM) to `plugins/ServerLimitGauge/logs/`.

# 🎮 How to Use
1.  **Prepare:** Ensure your server is idle (no players online is recommended for best accuracy).
2.  **Command:** Run `/benchmark start`.
3.  **Wait:** The plugin will perform a **Warm-up** followed by **5 loops** of stress tests:
    *   *Prime Number Calculation (CPU Single-thread)*
    *   *Physics Explosion (Math)*
    *   *HashMap/RAM Access (Memory Latency)*
    *   *Chunk Generation & I/O (Disk Speed)*
    *   *Entity Processing (Mob AI)*
4.  **Result:** Check the chat or console for the **Server Rank** and **Recommended Player Count**.

> **Note:** The benchmark creates temporary entities and loads chunks, but cleans them up immediately.

# 📜 Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **/benchmark start** | Starts the performance benchmark. | `slg.admin` |
| **/benchmark reload** | Reloads the configuration file. | `slg.admin` |

*(By default, `slg.admin` is granted to OPs)*

# ⚙️ Configuration
You can customize the stress load and safety limits.

```yaml
# ==========================================
# ServerLimitGauge Configuration
# ==========================================

# Save benchmark results to a text file in /logs folder.
save-logs: true

# Safety Settings
safety:
  # If true, the benchmark will abort if MSPT exceeds 250ms (TPS < 4) to prevent crashing.
  # Set to false if you want to test low-spec machines to their absolute limit.
  enable-mspt-limit: true
```

# 📸 Gallery
![11900kf](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3ffb20eb58b9b98e24300ccc3ba815fdac9b49d6.png)

High-End Environment (i9-11900KF): Shows SSS Rank and high player capacity.

```text
=============== [Result Report] ===============
OS: Windows 11 (amd64)
CPU Model: 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-11900KF @ 3.50GHz
CPU Cores: 16 threads
Allocated RAM: 10240 MB
Overall Score: 30700
Server Rank: SSS (Extreme)

Recommended Player Count: 245 Players
Max Capacity (Limit): 307 Players

[Detailed Metrics]
- CPU Integer/Math: 28.04 ns
- RAM Latency: 74.99 ns
- Disk/Chunk I/O: 20.96 ms
- Entity Processing: 26.05 ns/entity

[Bottleneck Diagnosis]
⚠ Memory Capacity (10240 MB) is the primary bottleneck.
   Your CPU could handle 426 players,
   but memory constraints limit this to 307 players.
   -> Allocating more RAM will drastically improve your Server Rank.
✔ CPU single-thread performance is legendary (Monster Class).
✔ Disk I/O & Terrain generation speeds are healthy.
============================================
```

Bottleneck Detection: Shows warnings when RAM is insufficient or Disk I/O is slow.

# **Chickoin: The Ultimate In-Game Economy Mod!**

Tired of simple bartering? Dive into a **fully functional economic system** that brings sophisticated banking, secure storage, and even a bit of risk to your Minecraft world! **Chickoin** is more than just a currency—it's the complete infrastructure you need to build and manage your wealth. Get ready to trade, save, and secure your funds!

## 💰 **Core Economic Features**

**The Chickoin Currency**: Our visually refreshed currency is the new standard for wealth! Use Chickoins for all **player-to-player trading and payments**.

**The Wallet**: A safe and portable inventory slot for carrying your hard-earned Chickoins anywhere you go.

**The Secure Safe**: Protect your valuables! This high-security storage unit is secured with a **personal password**, ensuring only you can access your savings. The safe features a **robust, secure design**.

**The Classic ATM**: We've designed a reliable **MinecraftCard-ATM system** from the ground up. Use your **MinecraftCard** to seamlessly **deposit or withdraw** your Chickoins.

## 🛍️ **Brand New: Vendor Stalls! (Creative Only!)**
Bring organized commerce to your world with our new market blocks, **only available in Creative Mode**:

**Flexible Trading**: Stall prices are **fully customizable after placement**, and payments can be made using both the **MinecraftCard** or physical **Chickoins**!

## ⚠️ **High-Risk Specialty Banking (Creative Only!)**

For map creators and adventurous players, we offer powerful, modified ATMs with built-in risks. These machines are **only available in Creative Mode** for balancing purposes.

**The Hacked ATM (**👤**)**: Beware! This sneaky machine will **steal all the money** from your MinecraftCard if you aren't quick enough.

**We hope you enjoy building your economic empire!**

title: Companion-Friend
description: Your new companion is built to be reliable, customizable, and fun—enhancing exploration, combat, and survival with a genuinely useful in-game partner.
body:
# 🏹 Companion Mod

Version: 1.0.0 | Minecraft: 1.21.1 | Loader: Fabric

A feature-rich companion mod that introduces a fully interactive, customizable archer ally designed to support you throughout your Minecraft adventures. Your companion provides reliable combat assistance, campfire cooking, dialogue-driven immersion, and practical utility—bringing personality and usefulness together in one cohesive system.

# ✨ Key Features
## ⚔️ Advanced Combat & AI

- Adaptive Weapon Handling: Automatically switches between Netherite Sword (melee) and Bow (ranged) depending on the threat.
- Intelligent Targeting: Responds to enemies that attack you or targets you engage.
- Companion Durability: Completely invulnerable and immune to all friendly fire.
- Battle Personality: Occasionally charges into combat with an iconic “Leroy Jenkins!” shout.

  
## 🍖 Campfire Cooking System

- Hands-Free Cooking: Provide raw food and place a Campfire—your companion will cook it automatically.
- Task Priority: Cooking temporarily overrides the follow behavior, allowing you to relax at camp.
- Smart Retrieval: Collects cooked items autonomously.

## 💬 Immersive Dialogue HUD

- Dedicated HUD Display: Companion speech appears in a clean, custom bottom-screen HUD box instead of the chat window.
- Unique Voice Lines: Includes over 15 contextual phrases for hunting, combat, and general interaction.
- Status Notifications: Clear on-screen updates when toggling between Follow and Sit states.

## 🎯 Target Practice Mode

- Idle Activity: In “Sit” mode, your companion places a Target Block and practices archery.~~~~
- Real Arrows: Watch them fire actual projectiles as they train.

# 🎒 Utility & Customization

- Inventory Support: Offers a full 27-slot (9×3) storage system for carrying your gear.
- Skin Variants: Select from multiple appearance options through the dedicated skin GUI.
- Reliable Teleportation: If separated by more than 25 blocks, your companion automatically warps to your location.

# 📥 Installation
## Client Installation

- Install Fabric Loader
-  (v0.16.14+).
- Download Fabric API
-  for Minecraft 1.21.1.
- Download the Companion Mod JAR.
- Place all required JAR files into your .minecraft/mods directory.
- Launch Minecraft and enjoy.

Server Installation

For server-specific instructions, see SERVER_SETUP.md.

# 🎮 Usage & Controls
Action	Control	Description
- Sit / Follow Toggle
  - Right-Click (with item)	
  - Switches between staying put and following the player.
- Open Inventory	
  - Shift + Right-Click	
  - Opens the 27-slot companion inventory.
- Open Skin Selector	
  - Right-Click (empty hand)	
  - Access the appearance customization menu.
  
Getting Started
- Summon: Use the Companion Summoner item or /summon companion:companion.
- Command: Right-click with a sword or tool to enable follow mode.
- Equip: Use Shift + Right-click to supply arrows, food, or items.

# 🛠️ Configuration

- The mod includes optimized default settings:
- HUD Message Duration: 10 seconds
- Follow Teleport Range: 25 blocks

# ❤️ Final Notes

Your new companion is built to be reliable, customizable, and fun—enhancing exploration, combat, and survival with a genuinely useful in-game partner.

Enjoy your journey with your loyal archer companion!

title: itemsauce
description:
Adds rarity to item tooltips... that's it.

Includes configurable colors.
body:
# itemsauce
Adds flavor to your items by giving them purely cosmetic rarity labels.

Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.1

Generates a configuration file upon first launch.

```toml
#Use minecraft's default rarity as a fallback
useBakedInRarity = true

[legendary]
color = "LIGHT_PURPLE"
items = ["nether_star", "enchanted_golden_apple", "silence"]

[epic]
color = "GOLD"
items = ["netherite", "elytra", "ancient_debris"]

[rare]
color = "RED"
items = ["emerald", "diamond", "amethyst", "breeze", "golden_apple"]

[uncommon]
color = "DARK_GREEN"
items = ["gold", "ender", "blaze", "trim", "potion"]

[common]
color = "GRAY"
items = ["put_item_names_here"]
```

Colors should follow the name of the color code in the [wiki](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Formatting_codes#Color_codes). (JE Edition codes only)  
Item names put in the items tab should follow their minecraft id. You can see an item's id in-game by using F3+H.  
Items are simply checked to see if they contain the keyword. E.g. if you put 'oak' in legendary, all items with 'oak' in their minecraft id will be legendary.

body:
**This set of resources replaces the standard totem of Immortality in Minecraft with a charming model of Mini Tails, a favorite character from the Sonic the Hedgehog series.**

---

**In addition to the visual changes, the default activation sound is also being replaced with Tails' voice, taken from the official Sonic Adventure 2 game. Now that you're avoiding death in battle, Tails himself will cheer you on, giving you hope and strength to keep fighting!**

title: BarrierVariant
description: A Minecraft Mod that adds Stairs, Slabs, Iron Bars & Fences in a Barrier Block model. Its easy to use.
body:
# Barrier Variant

## Expand your building projects with invisible blocks

This mod adds various barrier variants that are perfect for hidden mechanics, invisible bridges, and creative builds.

## Features

### Four new barrier variants:
- **Barrier Slabs** - Half barriers for fine details
- **Barrier Stairs** - Invisible stairs 
- **Barrier Iron Bars** - Invisible bars that connect to each other
- **Barrier Fence** - Invisible fences with connection system

### Three visibility modes:
- **Visible** - Blocks are always visible (default)
- **Invisible** - Only visible when holding barrier items
- **Creative** - Only visible in creative mode

## Commands

All commands require operator permissions:

### Get blocks
```
/barrier slab [count]      - Gives barrier slabs (1-64)
/barrier stairs [count]    - Gives barrier stairs (1-64)  
/barrier bars [count]      - Gives barrier iron bars (1-64)
/barrier fence [count]     - Gives barrier fence (1-64)
```

### Change visibility mode
```
/barrier mode visible    - Blocks are always visible
/barrier mode invisible  - Only visible with barrier items
/barrier mode creative   - Only visible in creative mode
```

### Help
```
/barrier - Shows all available commands
```

#### Examples:
- `/barrier slab 16` - Gives 16 barrier slabs
- `/barrier mode invisible` - Switches to invisible mode
- `/barrier fence` - Gives 1 barrier fence

## Installation

### Singleplayer / Client
1. Install Fabric Loader for your Minecraft version
2. Download Barrier Variant mod and place in mods folder
3. Start Minecraft and enjoy

### Multiplayer Server
1. Set up Fabric Server for your Minecraft version
2. Place Barrier Variant mod in server mods folder  
3. Restart server
4. **Clients also need the mod** for correct rendering

## Technical Details

- **Mod Loader:** Fabric
- **Supported Minecraft Versions:** 1.21.1
- **Requires:** Fabric API
- **Client-Side:** Required for rendering
- **Server-Side:** Required for commands and logic

## Use Cases

- **Hidden passages** with invisible stairs
- **Parkour maps** with invisible steps
- **Redstone builds** with hidden barriers
- **Adventure maps** with secret paths
- **PvP arenas** with invisible obstacles
- **Build servers** for temporary structures

## Support

Found a bug or have an idea? Dm @.t4bzzz on Discord.

## Changelog

### Version 1.0.0
- Initial release
- Added 4 barrier variants
- Implemented 3 visibility modes
- Created command system
- Full multiplayer support

---

**Happy building with invisible blocks!**

**AutoFeedBreed** is a server-side Fabric mod that lets animals feed and breed on their own using nearby fully grown crops.

- Animals eat nearby fully grown crops
- Crops are automatically replanted after eating
- Animals breed on their own
- Baby animals are prevented from eating crops until they grow up
- The cycle repeats automatically

- **Server-side only**

- **Configurable via `autofeedbreed.json`**

  - Customize breed cooldowns
- **Safe for existing worlds**

body:
**Have you ever wanted to explore a new Minecraft experience, without just starting in the Overworld again?**
AnAether is Ibex's first (published) modpack, about surviving exclusively in the infemous sky dimension

- **Start in the Aether, with no way to leave** and only a parachute and Lore book to guide you
- **5 Dungeons to conquer** to save the cloud realm's sunlight.  And... something about a Whale...?
- **a Multitude of biomes, gear and Aethers unique accessories system** with per-player Loot chests (as of 1.1.0)
- **a custom Bundle recipe** for any semblance of inventory management
- **a ton of other stuff** idk about, especially Ancient Aether that things got no documentation but like 10 armor trims and a giant flower...
- **VoiceChat and Vivecraft support** for those that like that sort of thing
- **AnAether Resourcepack** that adds a funny death message or 2.  Maybe turn it on, see what happens...

Hope you enjoy!  This is technically just a smaller modpack to see how Publishing and running an SMP goes, but i think you'll have fun with it nonetheless.

<details>
<summary>For Developers/Server Owners</summary>

To ensure the Modpack works as intended on a server, the "defaultconfigs", "config", and "script" folders and their contents must be added to your server directory, otherwise youll spawn in the Overworld, (among other gamebreaking issues).

It's also recommended to remove Embeddium from the serverside mods, as that will probably just crash it.

keepInventory is enabled by default, as itl be awhile before you unlock a spawnpoint.  This can, however, be configured through Global Gamerules.

The Bundle recipe (as well as some other Jei recipes and tweaks) is handled through the .zs files in the scripts folder, which can be easily viewed and configured with Notpad++ or a similar program.

Chunky mod is present, for those that would like to preload chunks.  You'll just have to specify you're loading chunks in "aether:the_aether".  More info can be found [here](https://modrinth.com/plugin/chunky)

The base-Aether's server, client and common configs have a few extra options that arent implemented in the outdated 1.4.2 version, which this pack uses.  This is because Ancient Aether currently has crash issues with 1.5 Aether, but if/when they are resolved, these extra configs being present will ensure the Modpack can update existing instances without issue.  See Aether 1.5 and 1.5.1's changelog for more info.

If you're wondering why Sinytra Connector is in this pack, it was originally going to be used for some other Aether compatible mods, but now it just runs ModpackUtils and a zoom mod i like lol (I am aware MUtils has a forge version, but there were some bugs and a crash issue that the fabric version didn't)
</details>

## 🦑 About:

The **Amethyst SkyBlock** DataPack provides an ability to play the most complex and hardcore modification of everyone’s favorite skyblock minigame. Here you have to survive on a block of budding amethyst... You won't need anything else. Here you are alone with emptiness, boredom and monotonous repetition of the same actions. Test your strength, endurance and knowledge in the field of crafts, mobs and drops with this datapack.

## 🎮 Gameplay:

You start with one block below you and empty inventory. Get some amethyst shard and place your first block... Expand your platform, build a mob farm and obtain new and new types of resources, exploring the innovations of this DataPack! **Amethyst SkyBlock** provides the opportunity to go through all stages of the game up to going to the Nether, getting blaze rods and defeating the ender dragon in the End.

## 🌺 Multiplayer:

**Amethyst SkyBlock** allows you to play on the same map with friends. You all can start the game together, or some players can join the game even after you started. The choice is yours!

## 📜 How to play:

You only need to create a new superflat world with "The Void" preset and add this DataPack into it... Thats all! If you couldn’t do it yourself, read the [**Amethyst SkyBlock Installation guide**](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1seVshTsOhoCcbvGqgUr9E7IurhMomV2-T-2kiYGvJwk/edit?usp=sharing) (ENG/RUS).

## 🎫 FAQ:

Here you will find a collection of possible questions about the **Amethyst SkyBlock** DataPack:

<details>
<summary>Amethyst SkyBlock compatibility</summary>

**Amethyst SkyBlock** is compatible with most client-side mods. But we cannot guarantee that during the survival with this DataPack, you will be able to get all the resources from the mods or that everything will work correctly.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Content about Amethyst SkyBlock</summary>

You can freely write posts, post screenshots or upload videos about this DataPack on a variety of platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube and any others. If possible, write somewhere an authorship or a link to the original page on [**Modrinth**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/amethyst-skyblock) or [**GitHub**](https://github.com/Ko3leta/Amethyst-SkyBlock).

</details>

## 🧭 Future of Amethyst SkyBlock:

The future of this DataPack remains unclear, since the topic is unpopular... Your feedback will help us decide whether to develop it further or not. In any case, we're planning the following innovations in the future:

- More options
- Some easter eggs
- Gameplay customisation
- More unique crafts and loots
- Special creatures and monsters
- It's hiding in the emptiness, don't look back...

![Something is hiding here](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/586e30558ac5def2492a6c9d5cd3b38bb79f2087_0.webp)

## 💖 Special thanks:

Many thanks to [**Specis**](https://www.youtube.com/@specis7524) for giving a permission to use the idea of the **Amethyst SkyBlock**.

Many thanks to [**HappyTimosha**](https://discord.com/users/842623861254127637) for testing and bugfixing the **Amethyst SkyBlock** DataPack.

title: Awake
description: The world has gained consciousness through AI! Embark on an adventure and breathe life where you see fit in Minecraft!
body:
# Awake

**Awake** is an immersive Minecraft mod that brings a new level of interaction and adventure to your gameplay. With advanced AI capabilities, Awake allows you to communicate with mobs, embark on unique quests, and explore the world in innovative ways.

## Features

### Mobs
- **Speak with Mobs**: Engage in conversations with mobs. They keep track of various stats such as health, biome, weather changes, time of day, inventory items, and more.
- **Mob Commands**: 
  - Make mobs follow you.
  - Command mobs to attack other mobs or defend you.
  - Organize mobs into attack/defense groups.
- **Friendship Mechanics**: Befriend hostile mobs or make friendly mobs hostile again.
- **Home Commands**: Instruct mobs to return home or wait for you.
- **Pet Hunting**: Ask your pets to hunt food for you (currently supports land animals only).
- **Structure Finder**: Ask mobs to locate nearby structures, such as pyramids, specific villages, monuments etc...

### Quests
- **AI-Generated Quests**: Receive dynamically created quests.
- **Progressive Difficulty**: Quests become harder and more rewarding as you complete previous ones.
- **Unique Player Experience**: Each player gets different quests, making your adventure unique (Note: running this on a server is currently not supported as the game will crash, however once resolved, the Quest Table will enable player specific quests).
- **Repeatable and One-Time Quests**: Some quests can be repeated, while others are one-time challenges.
- **Quest Table Reset**: Reset your quest table at any time using an in-game command.

### World Interaction
- **Image Capture**: Take pictures and store them as images.
- **Share Adventures**: Share your captured images with mobs, showing off your adventures.

## Installation

1. Download the mod's JAR file.
2. Install the mod using the 1.19.4 Fabric modloader.
3. Start your Minecraft world and enjoy the new features!


## Feedback

Your feedback is crucial to me. Please share your experiences, report bugs, and suggest new features. Let's make Awake the best it can be together!

---

Join me on this exciting journey and awaken a new world of possibilities in Minecraft with **Awake**!

title: Sky Royal
description:
Welcome to Sky Royal, An Ultimate Battle Royal Experience!

Have you ever wanted to play a royal with your friends? Well, this datapack allows you to!
body:
## Welcome to Sky Royal, An Ultimate Battle Royal Experience!

Have you ever wanted to play a royal with your friends? Well, this datapack allows you to!
This datapack has custom crafts, world generation, loot tables, and more!

Frozen Horizon update has been released!

Type /function rfi:startroyal to play a sky royal with your friends!

Features:

- There is a world border that will be closing in slowly for a better pvp experience!
- There are loot creates that drop from the sky at 0 0 every 10 minutes, the timer is displayed on the bottom part of your screen.
- Shield crafts have been disabled for a better sword pvp experience!
- PVP starts instantly
- Ancient cities are more common
- Fishing loot tables have been improved, fishing treasure is more common, and you can now get diamonds, golden apples, and other good stuff!
- Village loot tables are also improved, they give you diamonds, more emeralds, and other items
- Custom traders that spawn randomly around the world and accept gold for items like diamonds
- Always day time, and the weather is always clear
- Custom items
- Custom world gen
- And even more features!

Crafts:

- [Planet Minecraft Link](https://www.planetminecraft.com/data-pack/sky-royal/)

License:

- You may not redistribute this project
- You may not change files or code in this project
- You may use in YouTube videos as long as you use some form of credit
- You may not use in public servers

Credits:
- Sharingan for the idea of the potion of levitation
- Aeris2004 for being a game tester

Discord:

Join the discord for notifications of updates, and for help with any issues in the datapack. [Discord Link](https://discord.gg/HhrTBNp9K2)

How long can you survive?

If you find any bugs, please tell me in then the Discord above, for a better experience in Sky Royal.
Let me know of any of your ideas, for a chance of them being added!

title: Madoku Craft: Items
description: Madoku Craft: Items is a configurable Item system. It allows users to customize Items to their specific needs. Which allows you to adjust Tool stats, stacking limit, Fuel Items, etc.
body:
## Overview:

Madoku Craft: Items is a configurable Item system. It allows users to customize Items to their specific needs. This system splits Items into different Categories. You can add and remove Items from the system. Most of these features are customizable in the CONFIG files.
 
## Dependencies:
 
- Fabric API
- Madoku Craft API
 
## Features:

**Material Tiers:**

- By default, Golden variant tools were enhanced to have better stats than Iron variants.
- All Tools had their stats increased across all Material variants.

**Fuel Items:**

- Magma Blocks were added as a new Fuel Item.
- You can add, remove and modify Fuel Items in the CONFIG files.

**Item Customization:**

- The custom Item system allows you to modify whether an Item can stack or not.
- The Item system also allows you to add certain properties to an Item based on their Category.
- You can change what Categories an Item has.
- For example, you can adjust an Axe to have the Spear's attack range.

**Stacking Limit:**

- Item stacking limit is adjustable.
- By default, stacking limit was increased to 128 from 64 Items per stack.
- Stacking limit can be increased up to 999 Million Items per stack.

![Stack Limit](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/67c13bbc2d68cd998301a9ef664c60da1dde8051_0.webp)

**Item Rarity:**

- The Rarity system increases an Item's stats based on the Item's Rarity.
- The Rarity system only applies to Items in the Tools Category.
- Rarity applies to Items crafted, generated in Loot, or spawned via Command.

![Item Rarity](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d81f6fbb1b60d223efe5a53f58d57b6ff28c51d4.gif)

title: liminalness
description: infinite procedurally generated liminal dimension(s)
body:
**You find yourself in a barren world straight out of the deepest depths of your mind. There is familiarity, yet nothing substantial to warrant staying. It's not a matter of surviving, its a matter of finding an exit. Don't get lost!**

![basic corridors](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/be07e508ca6e79fa665d99aa76fe754ccc0881d2_0.webp)

---
## Builders can directly contribute!
This mod is currently in beta as of May 8, 2026, predominantly due to a particular aesthetic that I want to achieve, but am not very good at translating into the game, so building will take some time. This mod will stay in beta until I am happy with the rooms that either I make myself, or the ideas that others may share. If you wish to contribute directly to the mod, refer to this [documentation](https://github.com/denialpan/liminalness/wiki) to learn more.

### Features:
- Infinitely procedurally generated backrooms dimension.
- Datapack support for custom dimension and rooms with extensive [documentation](https://github.com/denialpan/liminalness/wiki).
- Procedurally generated chest loot, including mods, with possible illegal enchantments (planned configurable).
- No new blocks or entities, compatible on vanilla servers and clients.
- Your mind.
- Vanilla mechanics to enter and leave the backrooms.

<details>
  <summary>
    How to get to the backrooms
  </summary>
  The designed method of entering the dimension is meant to be discovered accidentally through reasonable vanilla gameplay at any point in the game. However, if you want to get to it immediately:
  
  <details>
    <summary>
      SPOILER
    </summary>
    right click a bed in an area that has no light, including sunlight. 
  </details>
</details>
  
<details>
  <summary>
    How to leave the backrooms
  </summary>
  Find a room that has a block(s) emitting black/purple particles and walk through it. You will end back at your bed's location. There is no /locate command for this, once you're in the backrooms, you are in! Rooms that contain these portals are generated completely randomly through exploration. Alternatively, dying will obviously spawn you back at your bed.
</details>



### How does it work?
This mod does a unique take on dungeon/room generation, where there is a defined pool of schematics "rooms" created with markers indicating connections to other rooms. Generation is slightly slower, since it is entirely different than seeded vanilla Minecraft structure generation. In return for a slower generation, an infinite dungeon to explore is possible.

Adding more rooms and more points of interest is extremely trivial with the system I've created, and future release updates will likely consist of that.

### Roadmap
- Optimization, optimization, optimization as much as I can.
- Custom terrain math functions (difficult)

### Inspirations
- [Infinite Dimensions](https://modrinth.com/mod/infinite-dimensions) - more random than anything imagined
- [ze_samosbor](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3558923245)
- [Portal 2](https://store.steampowered.com/app/620/Portal_2/)
- [Dimensional Doors](https://modrinth.com/mod/dimensionaldoors) - atmosphere and schematic based storage of structures

title: All Items
description: Collect All Items In The Game
body:
Are YOU looking for a plugin that can easily and conveniently track your progression for any or ALL items in the game? Well you've come to the right place!

This plugin allows a server to collect any set of items or kill any set of mobs. The default list, and the main intent of this plugin is to allow players to collect every obtainable item/mob in Minecraft, but there is also customizability to allow for more creative ways to use this plugin. The main functionalities are the ability to send the items that you collect, and the ability to list your progress. You can use this plugin for everyone with the main list, or have personal lists for every player on the server (or both!).

Versions: (1.17 - 1.21.11)
(Tested More on Current Versions)

A full tutorial on how to use this plugin, as well as community provided item/mob lists are available at this discord: https://discord.gg/zHzFgWX8KW

# **PlaceholderAPI Supported (but not required):** 
You can record information about global or personal lists such as the progress, players score, and check if an item has been found or not! For info on the placeholders scroll to the 'Placeholders' section of this description or look in the discord (link right above).

[PlaceholderAPI Link](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/)

# **Extensive Config File:** 
You are able to change everything about this plugin. Feel free to toggle off commands, global/personal lists, and even the mob/item sections of the plugin. The oportunities are endless.

Some common uses of the config file is to enable auto collect, so players don't need to run a command to submit an item. Also subtraction mode so that the items disappear once submitted.

# **Lang File Support:** 
Don't want the plugin in english? No problem! Use the lang file to customize every text output on your server

# **Commands:** 
Plugin commands are "/aitem", "/amob", "/atimer", "/areset", and "/ahelp". The item command can execute all of the item related sub-commands. The mob command can execute all of the mob related sub-commands. The timer command can execute all of the timer related sub-commands. The reset command resets the data of the plugin (like turning it off and on again). The help command will display a help message for the plugin overall.

Here is a brief description of all of the commands in the plugin:

- list: Lists the items obtained
- self: Lists your personal item list
  
- send: Sends the item in your hand
  
- prog: Displays the total item progress
- player: Displays the item score of the player listed
- check: Displays whether or not the item listed was found or not
  
- help: Displays the item help message
- settings: Lists the item settings of the plugin

(ADMIN)

- reset: Resets the itemdata
  
- submit: Submits the item listed as the player listed
- unsubmit: Unsubmits the item listed
  
- placeholders: Help menu for placeholder setup

Timer also has sub-commands, like start, stop, help, etc.

# Placeholder Info

The '<>' are NOT needed for PLAYERS, if your name is 'B0WSER', input 'B0WSER' in place of <player> not '<B0WSER>'

The '{}' ARE needed for ITEMS/MOBS

### Progress
- %allitems_itemprog% - Fetches the global item progress
- %allitems_mobprog% - Fetches the global mob progress
  
- %allitems_itemprogpersonal\_<player>% - Fetches the progress of a players personal item list
- %allitems_mobprogpersonal\_<player>% - Fetches the progress of a players personal mob list
  
- %allitems_itemprogself% - Fetches the item progress of the player running the command
- %allitems_mobprogself% - Fetches the mob progress of the player running the command
  
### Score
- %allitems_itemscore\_<player>% - Fetches the score of a player in the global item list
- %allitems_mobscore\_<player>% - Fetches the score of a player in the global mob list
  
- %allitems_itemscoreself% - Fetches the item score of the player running the command
- %allitems_mobprogself% - Fetches the mob score of the player running the command
  
### Check
- %allitems_itemcheck\_{item}% - Fetches whether or not a specific item has been found on the global item list
- %allitems_mobcheck\_{mob}% - Fetches whether or not a specific mob has been killed on the global mob list

- %allitems_itemcheckpersonal\_{item}\_<player>% - Fetches whether or not a specific item has been found on the personal item list
- %allitems_mobcheckpersonal\_{mob}\_<player>% - Fetches whether or not a specific mob has been killed on the personal mob list

- %allitems_itemcheckself\_{item}% - Fetches whether or not a specific item has been found on the player running the command's item list
- %allitems_mobcheckself\_{mob}% - Fetches whether or not a specific item has been found on the player running the command's mob list

### Completed
- %allitems_itemcompleted% - Fetches whether or not the main item list has been completed
- %allitems_mobcompleted% - Fetches whether or not the main mob list has been completed
  
- %allitems_itemcompletedpersonal\_<player>% - Fetches whether or not the personal item list has been completed
- %allitems_mobcompletedpersonal\_<player>% - Fetches whether or not the personal mob list has been completed
  
- %allitems_itemcompletedself% - Fetches whether or not the player running the command's item list has been completed
- %allitems_mobcompletedself% - Fetches whether or not the player running the command's mob list has been completed

### Leaderboard
- %allitems_itemleaderboardplayer\_<place>% - Fetches the player at the specified place for the main item leaderboard
- %allitems_mobleaderboardplayer\_<place>% - Fetches the player at the specified place for the main mob leaderboard
  
- %allitems_itemleaderboardscore\_<place>% - Fetches the score of the player at the specified place for the main item leaderboard
- %allitems_mobleaderboardscore\_<place>% - Fetches the score of the player at the specified place for the main mob leaderboard
  
- %allitems_itemleaderboardplayerpersonal\_<place>% - Fetches the player at the specified place for the personal item leaderboard
- %allitems_mobleaderboardplayerpersonal\_<place>% - Fetches the player at the specified place for the personal mob leaderboard
  
- %allitems_itemleaderboardscorepersonal\_<place>% - Fetches the score of the player at the specified place for the personal item leaderboard
- %allitems_mobleaderboardscorepersonal\_<place>% - Fetches the score of the player at the specified place for the personal mob leaderboard

### Timer
- %allitems_timertime% - Fetches the time of the timer
- %allitems_timeracctive% - Fetches the activity of the timer

# Lite Verions
All Items/Mobs lite versions are available for a better out of the box experience.

[All Items Lite](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/all-items-lite.118585/)

[All Mobs Lite](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/all-mobs-lite.130871/)

[All Items Random](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/all-items-random.130872/)

# **Enjoy!**

title: ModernShowcase
description: Advanced glass showcase, display anything with custom angles and extreme lightweight performance.
body:
![Modernshowcase showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/tGohPDy6/images/06db1f3b2b33dafdd2d7ad8a3ce2a5937b8a3297.gif)
> ModernShowcase offers a glass showcase similar to an item frame, but with customizable scale size, rotation, and auto-rotation features. It leverages "Display Item" to showcase items efficiently and utilizes "PersistentDataContainer" to save showcase data to the chunk of the World.

## Features
To acquire a Glass Showcase, assemble 8 glass blocks (any type is acceptable) and 1 item frame.
Once placed, right-click to preview the items in the showcase.
Shift + Right-click to access the showcase settings.
![Crafting a Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/tGohPDy6/images/5f399276de4f9e21f6637a83a42ffd01b4a4039a.gif)
### Current settings options:
- Scale Size: 1~10 (default 7)
- Toggle Fixed Display: Whether the display item always faces the player.
- Toggle Glass Display: The visibility of the glass case.
- Set Display Items: Change the items in the showcase.
- Position Offest: Change the offest of items in the showcase.
- Yaw/Pitch Direction: Specifies the direction of the displayed item.
- Auto Rotation Speed: -02 ~ 25(default 0).

## Permissions
- modernshowcase.craft - whether player can craft item showcase.
- modernshowcase.place - whether player can place item showcase.
- modernshowcase.edit  - whether place can edit item showcase.

body:
![A train decorated with anime-style illustrations](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/X4qZJCqH/images/44a996fb33c7b860feb42c6eafe337aae2d2422c.png)

# Create: Canvas Contraptions
🇯🇵日本語の説明は英語の下にあります！

**Version:** 0.1.2  
**Minecraft Version:** Forge 1.20.1 / NeoForge 1.21.1  
**Create Version:** 6.0.6-6.0.8 / 6.0.6-6.0.10

---

## Overview
**Create: Canvas Contraptions** is a Minecraft mod that brings dynamic image display to your world. Import images from your system as maps and place them on blocks. Because it is fully integrated with the Create mod, these images can be placed on moving Contraptions and Trains.

* Also works with Create Aeronautics!

---

## Features

### Items
* **Blank Drafting Paper**: The starting point for your art. Right-click this item to import an image from your system. Once imported, it becomes a *Filled Drafting Paper*.
* **Filled Drafting Paper**: Allows you to select image tiles and place them onto blocks.
    * *Note*: This item is consumed upon use.
* **Drafting Tablet**: The ultimate tool for artists. It retains all the functionality of the Drafting Papers but features a built-in library that can store up to 16 images. It does not break upon use.
* **Painted Block**: The visual output block that displays your image. This is a system-generated block and is not available as a standard craftable item.

### Mechanics
* **Image Placement**: When placing an image using a *Filled Drafting Paper* or *Drafting Tablet*, the process consumes **Cyan, Magenta, Yellow, and Black dyes** from your inventory (one of each per placement).
* **Create Compatibility**: Images placed using this mod remain intact and visible when moved by Create Contraptions or Trains.

* TIP: You can rotate the image using a wrench.

---

## ⚠️ Important Recommendations
* **Duplicate your papers!** Since the *Filled Drafting Paper* is consumed when you place an image, it is highly recommended to duplicate your filled papers in a crafting grid before using them.
* **Work in Progress**: This mod was originally developed for a private server. Please be aware that **debugging and optimization are currently incomplete**. You may encounter minor issues or performance quirks.

---

## Requirements
* **Minecraft**: 1.20.1 / 1.21.1
* **Loader**: Forge (1.20.1) / NeoForge (1.21.1)
* **Create Mod**: 6.0.6-6.0.8 / 6.0.6-6.0.10

![Image Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/LDWQotJr/images/eed9c1785341ba7578681ca61df865f2863c3d4b.png)

## Mod Description

This mod is an addon for the create mod that adds some random features, with 7 blocks related to kinetics currently added. Some of them can generate kinetic power, while other is related to noteblocks.

**Noteblock Encased Shaft**

- Transfers rotational power in a straight line along its axis.

**Noteblock Encased Cogwheel**

- Transfers rotational power and allows for perpendicular kinetic connections and gear ratio changes.

**Brass Noteblock Encased Shaft**

- Automatically plays musical notes, with the pitch dynamically determined by the input rotation speed.

- Allows players to adjust the audio volume using a scrollable UI box on the outer casing faces.

- Displays detailed block data (Kinetic Stress/Speed, Musical Note, Frequency, and Volume percentage) when viewed with Engineer's Goggles.

- Wirelessly transmits rotational power to another identical Brass Noteblock up to 4 blocks away along the same axis.

- Dynamically calculates the gear ratio of the wireless kinetic connection based on the difference in volume settings between the sending and receiving blocks.

**Kinetic Sculk Sensor**

- Detects vibrations while remaining completely safe to move on dynamic Create contraptions (like moving trains or spinning bearings).

- Dynamically emits light when actively detecting a vibration.

## 模组介绍

**音符盒封装传动轴 (Noteblock Encased Cogwheel)**

- 沿着其轴线呈直线传输转动效能。

**音符盒封装齿轮 (Noteblock Encased Cogwheel)**

- 传输转动效能，并允许进行垂直的动力连接和传动比更改。

**黄铜音符盒封装轴 (Brass Noteblock Encased Shaft)**

- 自动播放音符，其音高由输入的转动速度动态决定。
- 允许玩家通过外壳面上的滚动 UI 框来调节音频音量。
- 当佩戴工程师护目镜观察时，显示详细的方块数据（动力应力/转速、音符、频率以及音量百分比）。
- 在同一轴线上，可将转动效能无线传输到最远 4 格外的另一个相同黄铜音符盒。
- 根据发送端和接收端方块之间的音量设置差异，动态计算无线动力连接的传动比。

**动力幽匿感测体 (Kinetic Sculk Sensor)**

- 探测振动，同时在机械动力 (Create) 移动组件（如移动的火车或旋转的轴承）上保持绝对安全。
- 在积极探测到振动时动态发出光亮。

title: Xray CE
description: Server-reliant xray utility for Better Than Wolves CE providing seamless ore visibility, fullbright, and gloom neutralization
body:
# Xray CE

A high-performance, optimized Xray utility specifically designed for **Better Than Wolves CE (3.0.0+)**.

## Features

- **🚀 Ultra-Fast Rendering**: Uses O(1) block filtering. Unlike other Xray mods that lag the game, Xray CE has zero impact on your FPS.
- **💎 See Everything**: Automatically disables backface culling for ores. You can see buried ores from any angle, even if they aren't exposed to air.
- **☀️ Built-in Fullbright**: Forget torches. Light levels are maximized while Xray is active.
- **🌑 Gloom Immunity**: Bypasses the BTW "Gloom" mechanic, preventing insanity effects and visual darkness.
- **⌨️ Easy Toggle**: Press `X` to instantly toggle your vision.

## Installation

1. Ensure you have **Better Than Wolves CE 3.0.0+** installed.
2. Drop the `xray-ce-1.0.0.jar` into your `mods` folder.
3. This mod is **Server-Enforced**. It must be installed on the server to function.

## Technical Details

Xray CE uses **SpongePowered Mixins** to hook directly into the Minecraft rendering engine:
- `RenderBlocks`: Intercepts block drawing calls.
- `Block`: Bypasses occlusion culling.
- `EntityPlayer`: Neutralizes gloom levels.
- `EntityRenderer`: Overrides lightmap calculations.

## Author
- **chronicboy31**

# **Stonecutter Damage Fix**

The "Stonecutter Damage" bugfix.

This mod fixes a long-standing vanilla bug: the stonecutter block does not deal any damage, even though it visually has a rotating blade. When a player or any mob stands on a stonecutter, they receive damage, exactly as it should have worked from the start.

_What this mod does:_
- Restores the missing stonecutter damage in vanilla Minecraft.
- Works on players and all mob types (passive, hostile, etc.).
- No extra features, no bloat – only the fix.
---
### New in version 2.0.0 - Improved placement

**Now the stonecutter can be placed on walls and on the ceiling!    
Like in mods for additional block placement (like Additional Placements), but only for the stonecutter.**

**At the same time:**
- **all and ceiling stonecutter fully retains damage.**
- **The mechanic only works on all versions Fabric and NeoForge-1.21.11**
- **It's still as simple as ever - no settings, just place the block wherever you want.**

title: EventTime!
description: Lightweight plugin for simple events: players join with /event join, teleport to a set location, and compete until one wins.
body:
# EventTime! - Events for players
**EventTime** is a versatile and easy-to-use Minecraft server plugin designed to manage player events with teleportation, countdowns, and seamless player participation control. It allows server administrators to set up special event locations, control player joins with cooldowns, and automatically start events with countdown timers, ensuring a smooth and fair event experience for all participants.

Don’t believe it? **TRY THE LATEST RELEASE NOW!**

**⚠️ NOTE** Java 21 or higher is required!

### Features
- Full Configuration
- Comprehensive Announcement System
- Flexible Management
- Event Countdown
- Ready-to-Play
- Player Restrictions
- Join Cooldown
- Teleportation Delay
- Inventory Restrictions
- Easy Player Control
- And more!

### Commands
- /event join - Join the event.
- /event leave - leave the event.
- /event admin set - Sets the teleportation location.
- /event admin reload - Refreshes the configuration file.
- /event admin start - starts an event with players.
- /event admin lobby - Toggles the ability to join the event.
- /event admin break - toggle players ability to destroy blocks.
- /event admin build - toggle players ability to build.
- /event admin pvp - toggle players ability to PvP.
- /event admin tpall - teleports all players to your position.
- /event admin stop - stop the event immediately
- /event admin name <text> - Give the event a name (the name will be displayed in the lobby)
- /event admin announcement <text> - announce something (will be displayed on the bossbar and chat.)
- /event admin giveitem <percent> <item> <amount> - give a given percentage of players an item.
- /event admin alivelist - List of alive players.
- /event admin deadlist - List of dead players.

### Permissions
- eventtime.admin - access to everything
- eventtime.use - access to join an event (default)

## How to use


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

1. Place the .jar file in the server's plugins folder.

2. Restart the server and check the console for: [EventTime] Loaded saves!

3. Before allowing players to join the event, set the event name using /event admin name <text>.

4. Set the teleport location for /event join with /event admin set.

5. Adjust the event rules as needed — for example, enabling or disabling block breaking with /event admin break. You can also configure other settings like PvP or building. (Note: These are toggle commands — just type the command to switch the state; do not add "on/off".)

6. Use /event admin lobby to make the lobby available. Once multiple players are gathered, start the event using /event admin start.

7. A countdown will begin (the countdown duration can be changed in the config).

8. The event has started! Players are free to compete — remember, only one player must remain for the event to end!

9. During the event, you have access to special admin commands: /event admin tpall, /event admin pvp, /event admin build, /event admin break, and /event admin announcement.

</details>



## Easy configuration

configuration from version **1.1 BETA**!

**Riptide Fix** eliminates the high drag experienced when using Riptide with Depth Strider ([MC-136249](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC/issues/MC-136249)).

title: Cinematic Cherry Panorama
description: This resource pack edits the Minecraft panorama to have shaders!
body:
[![Cherry Panorama](https://i.imgur.com/A7jBYg8.png)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cinematic-cherry-panorama/gallery)
## Information
- **Shaderpack**: [Rethinking Voxels](https://modrinth.com/shader/rethinking-voxels/version/r0.1-beta9) & [Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris/version/1.9.6+1.21.10-fabric)
- **World Seed**: -7323051237561229001
- **Coordinates**: 40 ~ 1181
- **Version**: 1.21.9

# Installation
Click the [download](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cinematic-cherry-panorama#download) button and choose the correct Minecraft version
Launch your Minecraft instance and go to **Options**, then click the **Resource Packs** option. Click the button reading **Open Pack Folder**. 
Grab the downloaded file and put it in your `\minecraft\resourcepacks\` folder. Select the pack in-game and hit **Done**. Ta-da! You're done!

# How can I make one myself?
To make a custom panorama pack for yourself, you will probably first want a template pack. You can download mine and edit the contents to your liking.

## Setting up the Pack
<details>
<summary>If using a template pack</summary>

- Extract the `.zip` file into a new folder. I recommend you put it into a folder as the extracted files can easily be lost.
- Open `\assets\minecraft\textures\gui\title\background\` and you will see all 6 images labeled `panorama_0.png`, `panorama_1.png`, `panorama_2.png`, `panorama_3.png`, `panorama_4.png`, and `panorama_5.png`.
- Delete all 6 of these `.png` files.

</details>

<details>
<summary>If not using a template pack</summary>

- Create a new folder named `assets`, and 5 more folders that will go inside. The final folder's file directory should look like this:
```
assets/
   └─ minecraft/
      └─ textures/
         └─ gui/
            └─ title/
               └─ background
```
- Create a `pack.mcmeta` file that will go in the final `.zip` alongside `assets`
- This `pack.mcmeta`'s contents should consist of:
```
{
    "pack": {
        "description": "Custom Panorama",
        "pack_format": 34
    }
}
```
`"pack_format": 34` <- This value depends on your Minecraft version. You can check the proper `pack_format` for your version on the [Minecraft wiki](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Pack_format).
```
├─ pack.mcmeta
└─ assets/
   └─ minecraft/
      └─ textures/
         └─ gui/
            └─ title/
               └─ background/
                  ├─ panorama_0.png
                  ├─ panorama_1.png
                  ├─ panorama_2.png
                  ├─ panorama_3.png
                  ├─ panorama_4.png
                  └─ panorama_5.png
```
(You can add a `pack.png` that will be the pack's in-game icon. Make sure the aspect ratio is 1:1)
</details>


## Getting the Images
- Create a **fresh** Minecraft instance on Minecraft (Java) version **1.21.9**+ (I do not recommend doing this on an existing instance as it uses debug features added in 1.21.9 that are experimental.)

- Add these Java arguments to your launcher:
```
-DMC_DEBUG_ENABLED -DMC_DEBUG_PANORAMA_SCREENSHOT
```
- In the official Minecraft Launcher, go to Installations -> [Your Version] -> Edit -> More Options, and paste the arguments into the JVM Arguments field, **before** any existing text. If you're using [MultiMC](https://multimc.org/) or [Prism Launcher](https://prismlauncher.org/), edit the instance settings and add them under Java -> JVM Arguments.

- Launch your instance, and open the world you would like to use.
- **Click `Ctrl + F2`**. If you are in the air, I recommend you hold `Space` as well to prevent moving downwards.
- After pressing Ctrl + F2, Minecraft will display a chat message like "Saved screenshot as ...". Click the underlined text to open the screenshots folder inside your Minecraft instance directory. You should find six images named panorama_0.png through panorama_5.png. Drag and drop these into the `background/` folder you created earlier.
> If you don’t see all six images, make sure the JVM arguments were added properly and that you pressed `Ctrl + F2`. You might need to relaunch the world and try again.

## Finishing your Pack
- Right-click and compress your `pack.mcmeta`, `assets`, and your (optional) `pack.png` files into a `.zip` file with any name you desire. You can use this pack for personal use, or share it with others!
> Make sure you zip the contents (not the folder containing them) so that pack.mcmeta is at the root of the .zip, not inside another subfolder.

---

<small>The pack itself took me ~30 minutes to make. On the other hand, making the description took me around 1 ½ hours 😭</small>

title: Industrium Mod
description: Industrium is the all new mod for revamping your minecraft with a fresh set of items and blocks!
body:
# 🏭 Industrium

**Fabric | Minecraft 1.21.0 – 1.21.1**

**Industrium** is the next-gen industrial mod for Minecraft — a bold evolution inspired by the **Create mod**, but reimagined for **Fabric**. Whether you’re into mining, building, automating, or experimenting with a bit of chaos, **Industrium** gives you the tools to reshape your world.

---

## ⚙️ Key Features

### 🛠️ Tool Revolution

* **Hammer**: Break entire **3x3 areas** at once — mine faster, smarter.
* **Chisel**: Transform blocks into **new forms and decorative styles** instantly.
* **Tiered Toolsets** from brand-new ores with custom stats and progression.

### ⛏️ Ores & Materials

* Unique **new ores** to find, mine, and process.
* Used for tools, machines, blocks, and automation systems.

### 🧱 Modular Blocks

* Craft and build with:

  * **Fences**, **Doors**, **Walls**, **Buttons**
  * **Industrial-style blocks** and **decorative variants**
* Designed to support automation and redstone integration.

### 💧 Fluids & Piping

* Full **fluid system support**
* **Pipes** for transporting fluids between containers, machines, and magic devices.
* Future-ready for automation and mod integration.

### 🎲 Magic Block – The Gamble Cube

* Introduces **randomized rewards** and risk-taking to mining.
* Drop an item in... and maybe get rare ores — or nothing at all.
* Balances **luck, strategy, and surprise**.

---

## 🌐 Why Choose *Industrium*?

> "If Create gave you motion, Industrium gives you momentum."

* Built natively for **Fabric**
* Compatible with **Minecraft 1.21.0 – 1.21.1**
* Lightweight, modular, and **designed to work alongside other tech & magic mods**

Whether you're digging deep, building big, or automating everything, **Industrium** is your new go-to for industrial-scale Minecraft.

---

## 📥 Installation

1. Requires **Fabric Loader** and **Fabric API**
2. Drop `Industrium` into your `/mods` folder
3. Launch and enjoy!

---

## 🧪 Work in Progress

This is an early release with **many more features planned**, including:

* Machines
* Energy systems
* Advanced automation
* Mod compatibility extensions

---

**Industrium**
*Build smarter. Mine deeper. Automate everything.*

body:
# LoreAnvil

A bukkit plugin for changing name or lore of an item stack with anvil.  
Supports style code starts with `&`, and hex colors starts with `&#` above 1.16.

## Versions

- Paper API is needed.
- ProtocolLib is recommended.

Developing Minecraft Version: **1.21.3**

## Usage

- Modify item name
    - Left: Item
    - Middle: Empty
- Append item lore
    - Left: Item
    - Middle: Paper
- Remove the last item lore
    - Left: Empty
    - Middle: Item

## Permission

**All player have these permissions by default.**

- `loreanvil.rename` —— Rename.
- `loreanvil.lore.add` —— Append item lore.
- `loreanvil.lore.remove` —— Remove item lore.
- `loreanvil.no_too_expensive` —— Remove the too expensive limit.

## Bug report

Submit it on the issues page.

description: Allows you to store coins in your bank and upgrade your bank account unlocking many perks and more!
body:
**Mortis Bank**
Mortis Bank allows you to store coins in your bank and upgrade your bank account unlocking many perks and more.

![features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2a945da647aba5a89645342afab87afc0ad84675.png)

● Bank Depositing / Withdrawing System. Store your coins in the bank by Depositing it with a bank limit and Take out your coins from the bank by Withdrawing it.

● Bank Upgrades with customizable requirements and perks. You can use permissions, items and money as requirements in order to purchase a bank upgrade and upgrade your bank limit.

● All Menus are configurable. You can configure the menu items and can use the provided placeholders in the menu items.

● Multiple Data Storage Systems. Supports H2, SQL, MYSQL, MARIADB, POSTGRESQL

![commands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/61dca6975bb27bc76c33c050e1bc2b5c7787158f.png)

/bank
Opens the bank for the player.
Requires "bank.main" permission.

/bank help
Shows all the commands.
Requires "bank.help" permission.

/bank open <player_name>
Opens the bank for the target.
Requires "bank.open" permission.

/bank admin
Shows all the admin commands
Requires "bank.admin" permission.

Full List of Commands in the [Wiki](https://mortis-development.gitbook.io/mortis-development)

![placeholders](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/01307b8bec864cf712422c18dd9a03b7c8e1d7c6.png)

_raw Use this at the end of a placeholder to get its raw value. For Example %mortisbank_balance_raw%
_formatted Use this at the end of a placeholder to format its value. For Example %mortisbank_balance_formatted%
%mortisbank_balance% Shows the bank balance
%mortisbank_max_balance% Shows the bank limit
%mortisbank_account% Shows the player's account name
%mortisbank_account_priority% Shows the player's account priority
%mortisbank_deposit_whole% Shows the deposit-able amount
%mortisbank_deposit_half% Shows the deposit-able amount
%mortisbank_withdraw_everything% Shows the withdraw-able amount
%mortisbank_withdraw_half% Shows the withdraw-able amount
%mortisbank_withdraw_twenty% Shows the withdraw-able amount
%mortisbank_has_transactions% Shows "true" if the player has transactions else "false".
%mortisbank_transaction_<position>% Shows the transactions. Example %mortisbank_transaction_3%
%mortisbank_transaction_list_<size>% Shows the transactions
in a list
Example %mortisbank_transaction_list_10%
%mortisbank_leaderboard_<position>% Shows the leaderboard. Example %mortisbank_leaderboard_1%

![dependencies](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/23fab467e3faf70524418aad3e8a56defd31dcd1.png)

title: Scrolls of Mending
description: Repair your gear instantly at the cost of XP!
body:
![Scrolls of Mending](https://github.com/Joshcraft2002/joshs-scrolls-of-mending/blob/main/media/coverartsinglescroll.png?raw=true) # Introduction Scrolls of Mending adds scrolls which repair your armor at the cost of experience. There are different ranks of scrolls that repair different percentages of durability, and the experience cost changes dynamically depending on how much total durability your gear has. # Crafting You first need to craft a blank parchment. This can be done by arranging paper on a crafting table depending on which equipment you want repaired. ![Parchment Types](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qazcgSo2/images/229496f7da03e5f17a5d0b873a0c51934ce1b17a.png) Then, depending on the rank of scroll, you need to create a scroll seal. Surround one of the below materials in 8 gold nuggets at a crafting table: - **Iron Nugget:** Lesser Scroll Seal - **Lapis Lazuli:** Scroll Seal - **Diamond:** Greater Scroll Seal Then, toss a blank parchment, a seal, and an Enchanted Book with mending on the ground to craft a scroll. ![Creating a Scroll](https://github.com/Joshcraft2002/joshs-scrolls-of-mending/blob/main/media/groundcrafting.gif?raw=true) # Usage Right clicking the scroll in either your offhand or mainhand repairs your equipment and consumes the scroll. The amount repaired and experience cost depends on the scroll type: ![Scroll Types](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qazcgSo2/images/7609e10e34ba993c1a943ccbed40dcec8558b1f2.png)
(undamaged equipment is ignored in the cost calculation) If you don't have enough experience levels, a message will appear: ![Not Enough Experience](https://github.com/Joshcraft2002/joshs-scrolls-of-mending/blob/main/media/notenoughexperience.png?raw=true) # Installing Download the resource pack and place it in your resourcepacks folder, and download the data pack and place it in your world or server's datapacks folder. (pretty simple) If you plan to use multiple datapacks and resourcepacks together, you can use [weld](https://weld.smithed.dev/) to easily merge them together to place in your world. (some packs may not be compatible with others, but Josh's More Foods follows smithed's conventions for better compatibility with other packs) To uninstall the datapack, run this command: `/function jmsm:uninstall` Afterwards, you can safely disable then remove the datapack. ## Configuration To open the config menu, run this command: `/function jmsm:config`
Config Options - scroll use cooldown (in seconds, with actual cooldown up to 1 second early) - cost calculation type - `default` bases cost on total durability, in line with the repair always being a % of full durability - `legacy` is the old system, basing only on damage - experience cost of scrolls (in %, and based on cost calculation type)
# Credits Sprites are made by [Bonii](https://twitter.com/ChalkDev) ## Contributing
Translations If you want to help with translations, submit a pull request, message me on PlanetMinecraft, or hit me up on discord: joshmats

You can base off of the US English file here

title: Vanillaplus Ultimate
description: improves vanilla minecraft to perfection
body:
**# FABRIC API REQUIRED**

### This is a mod that aims to add onto the vanilla experience and make it more enjoyable and complete, the aim of this mod is to add features that overhaul vanilla minecraft while having the same feel.

# Features:

## sculk:
### 1. new sculk dimension with 2 biomes the sculk forest and wasteland
### 2. 3 new mobs:
  - The sentry which drops sculk veins and a reinforced deepslate shards
  - The sculk zombie which drops rotten flesh and sculk veins
  - The deep crawler which drops sculk veins and sculk blocks
### 3. new sculk effect which slows you down a lot and stops you from jumping
### 4. 2 new structures, the sculk fortress and the sculk stronghold for you to explore!
### 5. A new wardens heart which is dropped by the warden and is required to make warden armor (along with a new warden upgrade template)
### 6. A new wardens skin which allows you to craft warden skin armor
### 7. reinforced deepslate shards can be found all over sculk themed chests and are combined with deepslate to craft reinforced deepslate which can be turned into reinforced deepslate bricks.
### 8. A new dark slayer boss that drops a dark core used to craft a warden sword
### 9. New set of sculk wood found in the sculk dimension
### 10. added new key which when combined with wardens heart makes and activated key which then you can light the ancient city portal (make sure to remove all sculk vein on portal before use)

## building:
### 1. added andesite, diorite and granite bricks and their variants
### 2. added concrete stairs, slabs and walls
### 3. added the nether brick fence gate

## overworld:
### 1. added palm trees and wood group
### 2. added naturally generating quicksand pools in the desert (prevent falling with leather boots)
### 3. added smaller desert pyramid (more on the way later)
### 4. added fallen logs (EXTREMLY buggy)
### 5. added silver ore (more on that on the materials section)

## materials and tools:
### 1. added silver and copper armor and tools (both like iron but with stat debuffs and boosts, choose one wisly as they are opposites!) armor effects apply with full armor

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
copper is associated with speed while silver is slower but heavier (aka more protection)

</details>


### 2. added amethyst armor and tools (like diamond but slightly different)
### 3. added warden armor and sword (more on that in the top section)
### 4. added new metal detector when right clicked detects for any metals (iron, gold, silver or copper) under the block

## villages:
### 1. added builder, miner and beekeeper huts and villagers
### 2. added new mining bench (workstation for miner villager)

## miscellaneous:
### 1. added soul jack o lanterns
### 2. added cherries which fall from cherry trees
### 3. added the coconut (currently unobtainable in survival but left for future use)
### 4. added quicksand bucket

## technical:
### 1. added new usable_beehive replacing the normal one for villager use

## keep in mind this mod is still in the alpha phase and there is more to come so stay tuned!

- Strength Essence
- Boost Essence
- Wealth Essence
- Ocean Essence
- Heart Essence
- Air Essence
- Cave Essence

title: Custom Book Author
description: Change the author and name of written books
body:
Discord: The Quin Studios community hub, and semi-regular news
Instagram: Texture-by-texture progress for my resource pack, Immersion, and general Quin Studios news
Patreon: In-depth update and development progress posts for large projects

If you like my work, please consider supporting me on Patreon

About

This datapack allows you to customize and change the author and title of a written book. Supports Minecraft versions 1.18+.

To change the author name of a book, just follow these steps:


     1. Take a Book and Quill, and rename it to "Author" with an anvil.

     2. On the first page, write the author name, however you want it to display.

     3. Put the named book and quill in your offhand, and open a written book that you want to change the author of.

     4. And voila, you're done! The new author name should now display properly.


You can change book titles with this same method, only using a book and quill named "Title" instead of "Author". This method can be used to overcome the vanilla character limit for book titles, allowing you to now make books with titles potentially stretching even beyond the edges of your screen.

Installation

New World:


     1. Select Data Packs in the world creation menu (in 1.19.4+, select the More tab at the top of the screen first)

     2. Drag and drop the download into the Minecraft window, then select Yes to add the pack

     3. Click the arrow on the pack icon to load the pack, and then select Done

     4. Load and play your world


Existing World:


     1. Navigate to your world folder. You can open it from the worlds menu by selecting your world, Edit,
         and then Open World Folder

     2. Go into the datapacks folder, and move the download there

     3. Load your world

     4. Type /reload


Note that if you are installing the datapack into a pre-existing world, you will need to temporarily enable cheats in order to reload the datapack. Cheats do not need to be enabled after reloading, and are not necessary for new worlds.
