title: Spells & Sorcery
description: Datapack that adds Spellbooks, Alchemy, New Items, New Mobs, and even a New Boss!
body:
# Spells & Sorcery

This Datapack adds a 24 new items to the game! 12 of which are new _Spellbooks_! It also adds 3 new Custom Mobs, a new _Alchemy_ system, and even a new boss: _The Necromancer_!

## Alchemy:

This datapack adds a whole new way of crafting... the _Alchemy Pot_!

<details>
<summary>Alchemy Pot</summary>



**Alchemy** is used to brew all of your spells. You can make an _Alchemy Pot_ by placing a soul campfire underneath a water-filled cauldron, then tossing an Amethyst Shard inside. Your finished _Alchemy Pot_ should look like this:

![Alchemy Pot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1aaa9650b806c73deee4189f90b72d1b270350a1.png)

When brewing, you must wait five seconds after throwing in all of the correct ingredients. Most spells require a _Spell Tome_, which is found in Dungeons, Abandoned Mineshafts, and Stronghold Libraries. The _Spell Tome_ acts as a blank spell, which you infuse spells into!
</details>

## Spells:

**Spellbooks** are brewed in the _Alchemy Pot_, and require a _Spell Tome_. Spells use-up _Mana_, which regenerates over time. The default Mana maximum is 10, but can be increased with the _Mana Charm_.

<details>
<summary>Amethyst Bolt</summary>

![Amethyst Bolt](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c5bf7c724d0ac4d752f1c80a93b4141362d8f0e9.png)

- Made with 1 _Spell Tome_ and 1 Amethyst Shard.

This is a simple and cheap spell which shoots forward a burst of purple amethyst, which will damage enemies.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Arcane Dash</summary>

![Arcane Dash](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/84d643a58adf0449354f22bb5e54aadd7157b53e.png)

- Made with 1 _Spell Tome_, 1 Rabbit Foot, and 1 Block of Emerald.

This spells sends you dashing forward, damaging any enemies in your path.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Inferno</summary>

![Inferno](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6429134d08e6e38f39b4276ba7296e7b26464d01.png)

- Made with 1 _Spell Tome_, 1 Gunpowder, 1 Blaze Powder, and 1 _Scorched Obsidian_.
- _Scorched Obsidian_ can be obtained by trading with Piglins.

This fiery spell casts a wave of fire whichever way the player is looking.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Ascendio</summary>

![Ascendio](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b470cf73e71abe8ea5dc77e6e754fc5554b5c942.png)

- Made with 1 _Spell Tome_, 1 Feather, and 1 _Pixie Dust_.
- _Pixie_ dust is a drop from the new mob: _Pixies_.

**When not sneaking:** This spell sends the player upwards, and provides slow fall.

**When sneaking:** This spell casts out a bolt which will send enemies upward when hit.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Electra</summary>

![Electra](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ed1dd48a4705fe3124607539f496cce069ce8951.png)

- Made with 1 _Spell Tome_, 1 Feather, and 1 Nether Star.

This spell creates a field which conducts lightning after a short period.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Hellfire</summary>

![Hellfire](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ff7bf30c61bd26ec64aafc976d3d0c890f44a3c6.png)

- Made with 1 _Spell Tome_, 1 Ancient Debris, 1 Blaze Powder, and 1 _Scorched Obsidian_.
- _Scorched Obsidian_ can be obtained by trading with Piglins.

This spell causes fireballs to rain down on the marked area.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Shadowstep</summary>

![Shadowstep](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b71ebfa4e1922b40af6ce6107dbc2f9959a0c735.png)

- Made with 1 _Spell Tome_ and 1 _Shadow_.
- A _Shadow_ can be obtained by killing _Wraiths_.

This spell creates a shadowy platform under your feet, allowing you to parkour off of it in thin air.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Enlargio</summary>

![Enlargio](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7154e543d5d385510ea9052da195ec4b88a2ebd0.png)

- Made with 1 _Spell Tome_, 1 Blue Candle, and 1 Pufferfish.

**When not sneaking:** Casts a bolt which will make the entity it hits grow in size.

**When sneaking:** Makes yourself grow in size.

* Effects on players only last 30 seconds, however effects on mobs are permanant UNTIL hit with the _Reducio_ spell.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Reducio</summary>

![Reducio](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/984ea66530096ff3f0b558d12c582dc3bea25560.png)

- Made with 1 _Spell Tome_, 1 Orange Candle, and 1 Pufferfish.

**When not sneaking:** Casts a bolt which will make the entity it hits shrink in size.

**When sneaking:** Makes yourself shrink in size.

* Effects on players only last 30 seconds, however effects on mobs are permanant UNTIL hit with the _Enlargio_ spell.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Glacious</summary>

![Glacious](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8ea299b924d0dfd121e6bc3720dbe6e015a2357e.png)

- Made with 1 _Spell Tome_, 1 Snow Block, 1 Ice Block, and 1 _Yeti Tooth_.
- A _Yeti Tooth_ is a drop from a _Yeti_.

This spell casts a icy bolt which will cause the area it hits to be a blizzard for a short time, slowing down any entities inside.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Health Spell</summary>

![Health Spell](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34a8d6017d8242d25617c187c40a867c53e7b00c.png)

- Made with 1 _Spell Tome_ and 1 Ghast Tear.

This spell generates a temporary field which will give anything inside regeneration and resistance.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Timekeeper</summary>

![Timekeeper](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/274f50f6f185dff1008dc834dd14b324677a0324.png)

- Made with 1 _Spell Tome_, 1 Netherite Ingot, and 1 Clock.

This spell creates a location in time wherever you are, and teleports you back to that spot after 5 seconds.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Mana Bottle</summary>

- Made with 1 Bottle and 1 Amethyst Shard.

This brews a smiple Mana Bottle, which will instantly regenerate your mana.

</details>

## Custom Mobs:

This Datapack adds 3 new custom mobs, each with their own unique drops and mechanics!

<details>
<summary>Pixie</summary>

![Pixie](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/56820592c0b5066b6cb3c07e81900bc32ea8aba7.gif)

_Pixies_ can be found in Birch and Dark Oak Forests. Pixies have a 50% chance to drop _Pixie Dust_, which is used to brew the spell _Ascendio_.

_Pixies_ have two varieties. One is a light yellow color, and the other is a light blue color.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Wraith</summary>

![Wraith](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a9b80365c3995c0c2cd38a8c1eacf597327d3ac6.png)

_Wraiths_ can be found corrupting Zombies in the dripstone caves. When spawned, they have white eyes and are invincible to your attacks. You must make them walk through a circle of lit candles, like the one shown above, the make them vulnerable. When weakened, their eyes turn red and they become much faster.

Uppon death, _Wraiths_ can drop their _Shadow_, which is used to make the spellbook _Shadowstep_.

</details>



<details>
<summary>Yeti</summary>

![Yeti](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/59347331b833f635187c70ae5a5e107eb365b73e.png)

_Yetis_ are found spawning at night in snowy biomes. A yeti packs a powerful punch, and is very heavy and knockback resistant. Be sure to keep your distance!

If killed, _Yetis_ have a chance to drop a _Yeti Tooth_, which is an ingredient used to brew the spellbook _Glacious_.

</details>

## Items:

- **Pixie Dust:** dropped by _Pixies_.
- **Scorched Obsidian:** traded by Piglins.
- **Shadow:** dropped by _Wraiths_.
- **Spell Tome:** found in dungeons, mineshafts, and libraries.
- **Yeti Tooth:** dropped by _Yetis_.
- **Mana Bottle:** brewed in the _Alchemy Pot_.
- **Cursed Book:** found in ancient cities, also a rare drop from witches.
- **Mana Charm:** dropped by _Necromancer_. When in offhand, doubles max Mana.

- **Wraith Spawn Egg:** operator only item.
- **Pixie Spawn Egg:** operator only item.
- **Yeti Spawn Egg:** operator only item.
- **Necromancer Spawn Egg:** operator only item.

## Necromancer:

The _Necromancer_ is a new boss which will drop the _Mana Charm_, an item which when put in offhand will **double** your max mana level!



<details>
<summary>Summoning</summary>

The _Necromancer_ is summoned using a ritual. You will need three things: 12 Purple Candles, 1 Amethyst Block, and 1 _Cursed Book_.

- The _Cursed Book_ can be found in ancient cities, or is a rare drop from witches.

Place the candles in a circle around the amethyst block, then throw the _Cursed Book_ ontop of the Amethyst. After you then light the candles, the _Necromancer_ will spawn!

Here is how to place the blocks:

![Necromancer Spawn](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3ed73cfb81fec16df9f7f586bb9cd84ca6bedb2f.png)

</details>


<details>
<summary>Attacks</summary>

The _Necromancer_ has 2 modes, attack mode, and vulnerable mode. When he is purple, he is in attack mode. You can not harm him in this phase; you must evade his attacks until he turns red.

When he is red, he is vulnerable, meaning this is the time to damage him. Be warned, when he hits half health he gets much faster!

### Attacks:

_Necromancer_ has 3 attacks.

One of them is the _Amethyst Spiral_, where he will unleash a bunch of _Amethyst Bolt_ spells in a spiral. This attack is indicated by purple particles around him before he casts it.

Another is the _Electra Attack_. In this attack, he will summon _Electra_ spell fields att your feet. It is crucial to stay on the move while he casts this. It is signaled by blue particles around him before he casts it.

Finally, he can cast the _Ascendio_ spell in a spoiral around him, similare to the _Amethyst Spiral_. This attack is signaled by yellow particles before he casts it.

</details>

## Final Notes:

Thank you so much for downloading my datapack! If you enjoyed, please let me know! If you have any more Spellbook suggestions, I would love to hear them and I am open to updating this pack with more books if I get some good ideas!

I have a discord server where you can reach out to me, [here](https://discord.gg/vdfdNqPuQw).

Have a great day :)

title: Craftable Mini-Blocks
description: Lets you create mini versions of many blocks with a Stonecutter!
body:
![Mini-blocks used to label each barrel's content in a storage system ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/aTTjGqmo/images/473f4c6a2570290391cda70e04fb3c483f7643e3.png)

Lets you create mini versions of many blocks with a Stonecutter!

This Data Pack takes advantage of the new custom recipes introduced in 1.20.5 to create a more immersive than ever experience on using Mini-Blocks! No Knowledge Books, no Wandering Traders, all is just in your local Stonecutter! You could even fool me this was Vanilla!

Currently, pretty much all full blocks in the Building Blocks and Natural Blocks have a mini-block version, plus a lot of Colored and Utility ones!

Just be aware that once you cut your block into pieces, there's no way to get the original block back! So think carefully before building with mini Netherite Blocks or mini Beacons!

All the Mini-Blocks also come with Note Block sounds! Most use their regular placing/breaking sounds, but some may add more unique possibilities for your next Note Block creation!

title: TitansBattle
description: Hight customizable battle plugin for Minecraft servers
body:
## Titansbattle

TitansBattle is a plugin that allows you to create all sorts of battle events: server-wide, 1v1, team vs team; anything is possible!

Free for all games and challenges have 3 phases:
- Lobby: Players can join the game or accept the challenge
- Preparation: Players are teleported to the arena, receive kits (if enabled) and have some seconds to prepare (organizing items, picking a position) for the battle
- Battle: PvP is finally enabled and players fight each other until one group/player is remaining.

Elimination tournaments work in a similar manner, except in the preparation time only 2 players/groups are teleported at a time, until the winners are decided (1st, 2nd and 3rd).

Checkout the [Getting started](https://github.com/RoinujNosde/TitansBattle/wiki#getting-started) guide to know how to set it up! Or if you are a Developer, [click here](https://github.com/RoinujNosde/TitansBattle/wiki#developers).

### Features
- Server wide battles
- Challenges between 2 groups/players
- PlaceholderAPI support
- Highly customizable games
- Unlimited game/challenge files
- Title and action bar messages
- Sounds
- Stats (kills, deaths, victories)
- Compatible with SimpleClans and Factions (MassiveCraft or FactionsUUID)
- Different messages per game
- Scheduler
- MySQL and SQLite
- 9 API events
- Kits
- World Border
- Prizes
- Free for all and tournament modes
- Prefix for winners and killer (player with most kills)
- Join/leave messages for winners/killer

### Screenshots

Soon

### Commands

**Admin commands:**\
/tb start - starts a game manually\
/tb cancel - cancels the current game\
/tb setwinner <player> - sets a player as winner of the current game\
/tb kick <player> - kicks a player from the game\
/tb setdestination GENERAL_EXIT - sets the general exit (used for teleporting players who disconnected)\
/tb game|challenge create <name - creates a game or challenge\
/tb game|challenge setkit <name - sets your inventory as the kit\
/tb game|challenge setprize <name <prize LEADERS|MEMBERS - sets your inventory as the prize\
/tb game|challenge edit prize <name <field <value - edits some* fields from the game|challenge prize\
/tb game|challenge edit config <name <field <value - edits some* fields from the config\
/tb game|challenge setdestination <name <destination - sets the destination\*\*\
/tb game|challenge setdestination <name ARENA_ENTRANCE 1|2 - sets the arena entrance***\
/tb reload - reloads the plugin, this will cancel the current game

\* use a text editor to edit all settings\
\*\* you need to set all of them for the game|challenge to work\
\*\*\* entrance 1 is required

**Player commands:**\
/tb join - joins the current game\
/tb challenge player|group <target <arena - challenges a player|group to a duel\
/tb accept [challenger] - accepts a challenge (if the challenger name is not supplied, it will accept the last request)\
/tb leave - leaves from the game|challenge\
/tb watch - teleports to the watch room\
/tb watch <arena - teleports to the watch room of the specified arena\
/tb help - shows the command list\
/tb ranking groups|players - shows a ranking\
/tb winners <game [date] - shows the winners from the specified game\

### Permissions

- titansbattle.admin - Gives access to administrator commands
- titansbattle.player - Gives access to player commands
- titansbattle.challenge.accept - Can accept challenges
- titansbattle.challenge.player - Can challenge other players
- titansbattle.challenge.group - Can challenge other groups
- titansbattle.join - Can join a game
- titansbattle.exit - Can exit games or challenges
- titansbattle.watchroom - Can teleport to watchrooms
- titansbattle.help - Can use the help command
- titansbattle.create - Can create games or challenges
- titansbattle.reload - Can reload the plugin
- titansbattle.cancel - Can cancel a game
- titansbattle.start - Can start a game
- titansbattle.kick - Can kick players from a game
- titansbattle.setdestination - Can set the destinations for games/challenges
- titansbattle.command-bypass - Bypasses command restrictions in games/challenges
- titansbattle.winners - Can use the winners command
- titansbattle.setinventory - Can set kits or prizes for games/challenges
- titansbattle.ranking - Can use the ranking command
- titansbattle.setwinner - Can set the winner of a game

### Links

Crowdin (translations): https://crowdin.com/project/titansbattle\
Metrics: https://bstats.org/plugin/bukkit/TitansBattle/14875\
Builds: https://ci.roinujnosde.me/job/TitansBattle/

title: Preston
description: Compressed block mod.
body:
Preston is a "compressed block" mod - that is, it provides means of compressing sets of 9 identical blocks into 1 "compressed block" recursively, as well as decompressing them back.

Where it differs from previous approaches, however, is in a few key areas:

* Preston allows you to compress any full-cuboid block in the game, not just a selection of them.
* Preston lets you set the amount of compression levels available. By default, there are sixteen (single, double, triple, ..., sexdecuple), but you can set them all the way from just one (single) to one thousand (..., undemilluple, milluple)!
* Preston allows you to balance block compression by providing an RF/FE-powered machine, the Compressor, to faciliate this. The amount of RF/FE necessary scales with the compression level. (Optionally, you can configure it to allow crafting-based compression.)

Preston also includes mod compatibility with:

* Just Enough Items (0.2.0+)
* HWYLA (0.3.0+) - for properly supporting the Compressor's energy storage
* BuildCraft (0.3.0+) - Minecraft Joules support
* CraftTweaker (0.3.1+) - mods.preston.Compressor.addRecipe(<output>, energy_cost, <input>), mods.preston.CompressedBlocks.createStack(<block>, <amount>), mods.preston.CompressedBlocks.getMaximumCompressionLevel()
* BuildCraft (0.3.3+) - "Has Work" gate support

In addition, Preston includes an API for developers to be able to query, compress and decompress Compressed Blocks in their own machines, as well as define custom recipes for the Compressor.

title: GoodMC: Old Combat & Blockhitting
description: Restores the old combat system from Minecraft 1.8 and the animations from 1.7.10. Fully configurable
body:
GoodMC: Legacy Combat Restoration

GoodMC is a lightweight combat mod which overhauls the combat system in Minecraft to what it was prior to the Combat Update (1.9). 😲
Comes with a built-in config. No need to mess with files outside the game.

###  **Now compatible with multiplayer!** ### 

In addition, it brings back the old animations of blockhitting, swing, itemheld and more from Minecraft 1.7.10.

**The mod is completely configurable in-game!**

If you like the mod, please consider donating on my Ko-fi page. Your support is really appreciated:
https://ko-fi.com/buvtack

Core Features:

- Legacy attack speed: globally removes attack cooldown from the game
- Sweep attacks: disables sweep attacks unless the used tool has Sweeping Edge
- Classic Blockhitting: Re-enables the ability to block swords by right clicking with them. It        
  looks and functions exactly as it did in Minecraft 1.7.10
- Damage of axes nerfed back to the way it was up until Minecraft 1.8, though they are still 
  useful for disabling shields

Technical compatibility:

Minecraft 1.12.2 (versions for this mod for the latest Minecraft versions coming soon)
No dependencies required

Perfect mod for private servers and singleplayer survival worlds for players who want to play the latest versions with all the modern features and mods but without the combat from Minecraft 1.9

Server compatibility: Must be installed both on the client and the server

⚠️ IMPORTANT ⚠️
GoodMC modifies core combat mechanics (attack cooldown, blockhitting, etc.)
Using this mod on public servers may result in an automatic ban by anticheat systems. Use at your own risk on public networks

You can freely include this mod in any modpack you want, public or private, provided it links back to this page. You may not modify and redistribute the mod's .jar file without my explicit permission


View gallery in order to take a better look at the added/modified features of the mod.


🔥 Features in detail:

- Globally removes attack cooldown from the game
- Restores sword blocking by right clicking with a sword to deflect 50% of incoming damage
- Restores the old damage values for axes (nerfing them back to what they were prior to 1.9)                though they are still useful for disabling shields
- Rebuffs Sharpness and Strength
- Rebuffs the effects given by the Enchanted Golden Apple (used to give Regeneration V and                       Resistance II and was nerfed to Regeneration II and Resistance I)
- Allows removal of the Armor Toughness mechanic, rebuffing armor to be stronger, as it was prior to Minecraft 1.9

- Brings back the Enchanted Golden Apple recipe using an apple and 8 gold blocks
- Reverts the amount of knockback applied on hits to the amount it was in 1.7
- Removes the miss penalty introduced in 1.8. As soon as your crosshair is on target and you strike, the hit will register.
- Restores the visuals from 1.7: Blockhitting, Itemheld in first person & third person, old tooltips, old  swing, eating animation and so on.
- Brings back the ability to break blocks while using an item (breaking blocks while blocking a sword, eating food, drawing a bow and so on)
- Restores the old fishing rod mechanics (fishing rods deal knockback again)
- Removes Enderpearl and Eye of Ender cooldown when throwing them
- Restores the classic 2D animations of dropped items and skulls from prior to Minecraft 1.8, and 2D beds from prior to Minecraft 1.12, all toggleable in-game and no restart needed


I am currently working on updating this mod to the latest Minecraft version. Update coming soon! 🔥🔥🔥

description: Enchantment Tooltip Cleaner can remove enchantment lines and/or the gray description text beneath them.
body:
Enchantment Tooltip Cleaner can remove enchantment lines and/or the gray description text beneath them, perfectly resolving the conflict between **_[Apotheosis](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/apotheosis)_** and **_[Tooltips Reforged](https://modrinth.com/mod/tooltips-reforged)_** and keeping your tooltips clean and tidy. Now, it's not just for enchantments; it's a complete, **Zero-Overhead** toolkit for tidying your tooltips!

**Features:**
- **Simple Toggles**: Easily remove common clutter like enchantments, descriptions, item attributes, and potion effects with a single click.
- **Advanced Filtering**: 5 powerful custom filter lists to remove absolutely any line you intuitively don't want to see:
  - Text (Contains / Exact Match)
  - Translation Key (Contains / Exact Match)
  - **Regex (Advanced Pattern Matching)**: Now fully independent and highly reliable. Filter out complex dynamic texts flawlessly!
- **Zero-Overhead Performance**: Newly reinvented rendering logic using global caching mechanisms and native format strippers. Even with massive filter configs during intense 144Hz tooltip rendering, it costs basically 0 CPU/Memory overhead.
- **Debug Mode**: A powerful debug tool (Hold `[Ctrl]` to copy info) makes it incredibly easy to find the exact text or key you need to filter.
- **Fully Configurable**: All features are configurable via the in-game Mod Menu or the `.toml` config file.

**Compatibility:**
- Now fully modernized and ported to **NeoForge 1.21.1**.
- Recommended for use: **_[Tooltips Reforged](https://modrinth.com/mod/tooltips-reforged)_** + **_[Enchantment Descriptions](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchantment-descriptions)_**

----------------------------------------中文说明----------------------------------------

此 MOD 可以移除附魔行和/或其下方的灰色说明文字，完美解决 **_[Apotheosis](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/apotheosis)_** 与 **_[Tooltips Reforged](https://modrinth.com/mod/tooltips-reforged)_** 的冲突，让你的提示框清爽干净。现在它不只针对附魔，它是一个完整且**零性能损耗**的提示框清理终极工具！

**功能特色：**
- **简单开关**： 通过简单的选项，一键隐藏附魔、灰色说明、物品属性和药水效果。
- **高级过滤**： 拥有5个强大的自定义过滤列表，让你能精准移除不想看到的任何特定行：
  - 文本 (包含 / 精准)
  - 翻译键 (包含 / 精准)

title: Tab Friends
description: Never lose track of your friends on busy servers - Tab Friends brings them to the top of the player list with eye-catching visual highlights and customizable colors!
body:
# Tab Friends

A client-side mod for Minecraft that allows you to add players to a friends list. Friends are displayed first in the server player list.

## Features

- Adding players to friends list via command
- Automatic sorting of player list: friends are always displayed first
- **Visual highlighting of friends:**
  - Colored background in player list
  - Customizable color and transparency through GUI
- Saving friends list between sessions
- Simple friends list management
- **Integration with Mod Menu** for convenient configuration through the game interface

## Commands

All commands start with `/tabfriend`:

- `/tabfriend add <player>` - add a player to the friends list
- `/tabfriend remove <player>` - remove a player from the friends list
- `/tabfriend list` - show the list of all added friends
- `/tabfriend clear` - clear the entire friends list
- `/tabfriend` - show command help

## Visual Display Configuration

The background color for friends can be configured through **Mod Menu**:

1. Install the [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) mod (optional but recommended)
2. In the game main menu, open "Mods"
3. Find "Tab Friends" in the list and click the settings icon
4. Available settings:
   - **Red, Green, Blue** - color components (0-255)
   - **Transparency** - background transparency level (0 = fully transparent, 255 = fully opaque)
   - **Color Preview** - ARGB color palette for quick selection

Default: dark green color with 50% transparency (`0x80008800`)

Settings are automatically saved to the `config/tab-friends-config.json` file

title: TrueEssentials
description: A feature-rich alternative to the popular yet junk-filled EssentialsX
body:
Ever grown tired of the junk that EssentialsX provides that overrides vanilla Minecraft commands? With TrueEssentials, that problem is no longer there.

# Why choose TrueEssentials over Essentials?
Compared to EssentialsX, TrueEssentials is:

✅ More compact and optimized than EssentialsX (150kb vs ~4.5mb)

✅ Packed with most of the core features EssentialsX provides, removing most of the junk
 
✅ Easily configurable via a simple YAML configuration file

# Features
### ✅ PlaceholderAPI support (or simple built-in placeholders)
### ✅ Legacy chat color + Mini message support
### ✅ Classic EssentialsX commands (gamemode shortcuts, flight, etc)
### ✅ Command hider/spoofer extension
### ✅ Spawn extension
### ✅ Customizable splash screen on join (title/subtitle customization)
### ✅ Custom join, new join and quit messages
### ✅ Custom chat format
### ✅ Homes extension
### ✅ Customizable & easy-to-use moderation tools
### ...with MORE coming soon!


# What is TrueEssentials?
These days EssentialsX is filled with various "utility" commands which are mostly never used and override vanilla ones. Using this plugin, you only get the basics and you can toggle more features to your liking! This allows you to have the perfect core plugin, to your liking, without missing out on features **YOU** might consider important.

Essentially (pun intended), TrueEssentials is a core utility plugin for your server, packed with useful commands such as gamemode shortcuts (gmc, gms, etc), basic moderation utilities such as /invsee (more coming soon!), and other useful features your server might need.

# Bug reports
Click [here](https://github.com/Nebulations/TrueEssentials/issues) to create a bug report (issue)
Feel free to join the discord server (on the right!) for more extensive support.

# Placeholder support
This plugin has simple built-in placeholders, but using PlaceholderAPI is strongly recommended for the full experience.

# Message formatting
For all messages, [Mini Message formatting](https://docs.advntr.dev/minimessage/format) and [Legacy Color Codes](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Formatting_codes) are supported.

# Metrics & data collections
Starting with version 1.1, TrueEssentials will collect anonymous statistics including the number of servers running TrueEssentials, the number of players, etc. using bStats, an open-source statistics service for Minecraft software. You can opt out in /plugins/bStats/config.yml. You can check out bStats' website [here](https://bstats.org/).

![Servers using TrueEssentials & players online](https://bstats.org/signatures/bukkit/TrueEssentials.svg)

# What is planned in the future?
1. ~~Moderation utilities extension (bans, warns, etc)~~ Added in 1.1
2. Economy extension
3. Discord X Minecraft chat extension
4. Item editing extension
5. Chat filter extension

title: OptiFoundry
description: Optimize chunks, entities, and ticks
body:
# OptiFoundry

**Smart server optimization with powerful control tools.**  
Reduce lag, clean entities, and take full control over game ticks.

---

## ✅ Compatibility

- **Platforms:** Spigot / Paper / Purpur  
- **Minecraft:** 1.12 → 1.21.6  
- **Server-side only:** no client mods required

---

## ✨ Features

| Feature                        | Description                                                                 |
|--------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 🚀 Performance                 | Optimized handling of entities, items, and chunks.                         |
| ⏱ Tick control                 | Freeze, unfreeze, step, sprint/boost, set tick rate, live TPS query.       |
| 🧹 Entity cleanup              | `/opti kill` filters (items, mobs, armor stands, TNT, boats, carts, players, all). |
| 🗺 Chunk sweeping               | Unload idle chunks safely (spawn and forceload aware).                      |
| 📊 Status helpers              | Quick stats for entities, chunks, and TPS.                                 |
| 🧩 Wide version support        | Works from 1.12 up to 1.21+.                                               |

---

## 🖥 Commands

```
/opti help
/opti status
/opti reload
/opti chunksweep              # unload idle chunks
/opti itemsweep               # sweep dropped items
/opti toggle <chunk|items> <on|off>

# Entity cleanup
/opti kill <type> [radius <r>]
# types: items, mobs, animals, villagers, golems, armorstands, tnt, boats, minecarts, bosses, players, entities, all, or <EntityType>

/optick query                 # show tick info (TPS, rate, frozen)
/optick rate <1-10000>        # set target tick rate (default 20)
/optick freeze | unfreeze
/optick step <ticks> | step stop
/optick sprint <seconds> | sprint stop

```
⚠ **Note:**  
Since Minecraft **1.20.3**, vanilla already adds `/tick`.  
OptiFoundry therefore uses **`/optick`** as a safe alias.

---

## 🔐 Permissions

| Permission           | Default | Description                       |
|----------------------|:-------:|-----------------------------------|
| `optifoundry.use`    |   op    | Access to `/opti` commands        |
| `optifoundry.kill`   |   op    | Allows `/opti kill ...`           |
| `optifoundry.tick`   |   op    | Allows `/optick ...` tick control |

---

## 🛠 Installation

1. Download the latest **OptiFoundry** JAR.  
2. Place it into your server’s `plugins/` folder.  
3. Start (or restart) the server.  
4. *(Optional)* Edit `plugins/OptiFoundry/config.yml` and run `/opti reload`.

---

## ⚙️ Default config (excerpt)

```yaml
chunk-guardian:
  enabled: true
  scan-interval-ticks: 60
  player-buffer-chunks: 1
  respect-forceload: true

item-flow:
  enabled: true
  merge-radius: 2.5
  max-stack: 64
  ttl-seconds: 180
  blacklist-materials: []

# Multiplayer Isolation

title: Advanced Teleporters
description: Adds vanilla progression friendly teleporting systems to the game.
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf98a76450d8061a7872cded9fe06f1acd770f89.png)


**Whats new ?**

Now players can craft and place teleporters to teleport and save their coordinations. There are 4+1 teleporters and a remote device that players can use. It's a mod I made with the hope that it will give the player a sense of progress that will not bore them throughout the general progression of the game with useful and easy to understand mechanics.

 ![img](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7de64c5d48b2f212f96f0121297ceaf9c581f01e.png) 

**How does teleporters work ? - Main teleporters**

Main teleporters are expensive machines, of which there are 4: copper, gold, diamond and netherite. The player can connect to the teleporter system by clicking on any of the main machines.Player opens the teleporter UI according to the tier of the machine they last interacted with; these levels are important because with each increasing level, you gain +3 save & teleport slots. Forexample diamond teleporter has 9 teleport slots and netherite teleporter has 12.

 

 

**How does teleporters work ? - Side teleporters**

Side teleporters are machines that are cheaper than the main teleporters but do not have any level value. Which means after connecting to a main&host teleporter player can place down these cheaper teleporters to teleport around. Players who doesnt have a main connection will going to have "There is no host connection." message after interacting with it.

 

 

**How does teleporters work ? - Teleporter remote control**

This handheld device works similarly to side teleporters, which means again it doesn't have its own level value so if player didn't interacted with a main teleporter before they will going to have "Teleporter remote control is offline." message after interacting with it. However unlike main&side teleporters,handheld devices cannot save coordinates in order to teleport back to the same place and they consume 1x dimension pearl per teleportation. Dimension pearls can be crafted with 4x ender pearls and 1x lapis luzili in the crafting table.

**Quick Note:** After crafting Teleporter remote control it will be on its "offline" stage which you need to click to a main teleporter with it in order to use. 

**JEI and Netherite Portal Frame Craft bug**

title: DragonHelper
description: DragonHelper is a QOL mod for any sort of Dragon Simulator server out there! It includes the ability to track certain event such as dragon spawning and mob kills, and additionally supports some features such as auto-sell and message filtering!
body:
# DragonHelper
DragonHelper is a QOL mod for any sort of Dragon Simulator server out there, designed to make your play experience better!

The mod is designed to be compatible with any sort of dragon simulator server with any sort of features, so it uses a configuration system to define attributes that cause the below features to work.

Current features:
- Rare dragon and golem notifications
- The ability to disable summoning eye placement, other player loot, and loot number texts
- Multiple UI elements designed to track kills and slayer quest progress
- Auto-sell


If you are interested in tracking data on another server that is not specified by default in this mod, you'll need to follow the steps below.
  1. Open your `mods` folder, navigate to the root game instance directory, and find the `config` folder.
  2. Find and open the `servers.json` file within the `dragonhelper` folder, located inside of the `config` folder that you opened in step 1.
  3. Add a new server to the list in JSON format. The server name MUST be lowercased.
  4. Add configuration keys to your new server. Change the values associated with each configuration key to the associated lowercase text/command present on the new server. For example, if I wanted to add a new server where I can auto-sell, and the server's sell command is `/sellallitems`, I would add the following to my server's json: `"auto-sell-normal": "sellallitems"`

Example server.json file:
```
{
  "examplenewserver": {
    "auto-sell-normal": "sellallitems"
  },
  "dragfights": {
    "eye-place-contains-text": "placed a summoning eye",
    "dragon-drop-contains-text": " has obtained ",
    "dragon-spawn-contains-text": "has spawned",
    "auto-sell-normal": "sellall",
    "kill-tracking-command": "debugkill",
    "kill-contains-text": "you killed",
    "pvp-protection-message-contains": "you can\u0027t pvp here"
  },
  "dragnet": {
    "dragon-drop-contains-text": " has obtained ",
    "rng-meter-update-starts-text": "rng meter -",
    "pvp-protection-message-contains": "you can\u0027t pvp here",
    "dragon-spawn-contains-text": "has spawned",
    "eye-place-contains-text": "placed a summoning eye",
    "protector-name-contains-text": "protector",
    "auto-sell-normal": "sell",
    "rng-meter-load-contains-text": "rng meter experience",
    "lootnum-contains-text": "lootnum",
    "slayer-exp-load-contains-text": "slayer xp experience",
    "kill-contains-text": "you killed",
    "slayer-exp-update-contains-text": "\u003e total xp",
    "has-infernal-dragons": true,
    "rng-meter-tracking-command": "debugmeter",
    "auto-sell-eyes": "eyes",
    "experiments-npc-name": "CIT-e98c26597f30",
    "slayer-exp-tracking-command": "debugslayerxp",
    "auto-sell-special": "specialsell",
    "renew-experiments-command": "renewexperiments",
    "kill-tracking-command": "debugkill"
  }
}
```

title: Actually Vanilla
description: A modpack that improves Performance, Audio, Utility, and Visuals without losing the vanilla experience by only using client-side mods.
body:
Have you ever thought that vanilla Minecraft feels too outdated and laggy? But then when you try those vanilla+ Modpacks they change too much of the game that it doesn't even feel vanilla anymore? Well this Modpack is probably what's right for you. This Modpack improves your gameplay without altering the vanilla style by only adding client-side mods. Adds Performance, Audio, Utility, and Visuals with high configurability.

- 🔧[Infinite Music](https://modrinth.com/mod/infinite-music) - Allows changing the delay between Minecraft music playing. 
- [Presence Footsteps](https://modrinth.com/mod/presence-footsteps) - Adds a more varied and rich footsteps SFX.
- [Sound Physics Remastered](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-physics-remastered) - Provides realistic sound attenuation, reverberation, and absorption through blocks.

Packs marked with ⚙️ impact your performance. If you prefer better performance then you should remove it.

title: BeaconEnhancer
description: "Beacon Enhancer" is a mod that boosts the functionality of beacons in Minecraft by allowing players to increase the beacon's effect radius using Nether stars.
body:
When using a Nether star by right-clicking on the beacon, the mod automatically calculates the new radius of the beacon based on the number of Nether stars used and applies it instantly. This expanded functionality provides players with greater flexibility and control over the range of beneficial effects provided by beacons, allowing them to further customize their gameplay experience and optimize the efficiency of their projects in the Minecraft world. With smart mathematical formulas and seamless integration into the game, "Beacon Enhancer" offers a significant improvement in gameplay for exploration and construction enthusiasts in Minecraft.

The mathematical formula used by the "Beacon Enhancer" mod to calculate the new radius of the beacon is as follows:

​
![NewRadius formula](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2d45f5f3f6188cd24acfc4defc9e15f38c72fbf4.png)

Where:

- customRadius: customRadius is the new radius of the beacon.
- baseRadius: baseRadius is the base radius of a beacon without any enhancements.
- netherStarCounter: netherStarCounter is the number of Nether stars used to enhance the beacon.
- additionalArea: additionalArea is the extra area added to the beacon's radius for each Nether star.
- π:  is a mathematical constant representing the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter.

This formula calculates the new radius of the beacon taking into account both the base radius and the number of Nether stars used to enhance the beacon. The more Nether stars used, the larger the resulting beacon radius.

body: # Magical Gems: A mod for armor and potions. --- Magical Gems is a Minecraft 1.16 mod that lets you define the effects of potions on armor pieces. ### Gems Gems are items that add effects to armor. To add these effects, simply place your piece of armor and the gem in an anvil. ### Alchemy table The alchemy table is used to create gems. First, place a normal gem in the "Gem slot". Next, place the potion corresponding to the gem's effect or "essence". Finally, you'll need to put in enhanced fire powder as fuel. ### Distillery The distillery allows you to create potions that don't exist in the vanilla game, such as the haste potion. First, place an empty vial in the exit slot. Next, place the potion and the required item in the corresponding slots. Lastly, you'll need to use improved fire powder as fuel. --- Please credit me if you use my mod in some videos by adding the download link in the description. Please respect the license. title: Coffee+
description: Coffee+ adds coffee to Minecraft, the way coffee should be done.
body:
![Beta title banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nR1chlv0/images/58981ae36796dc757b54257a19713479709ab755.png)
# **Coffee+ adds coffee to Minecraft, the way coffee should be done.**

<iframe src="https://github.com/sponsors/linussewell/button" title="Sponsor linussewell" height="32" width="114" style="border: 0; border-radius: 6px;"></iframe>

## **Plants**

**Coffee Tree**

Right-clicking the ground while holding raw coffee beans will plant a coffee tree. Over time it will grow, and right-clicking a fully-grown tree will give you between 1-3 raw coffee beans.

Coffee trees can spawn in any mountain or mutated extreme hill biome - but remember that you can only gather coffee by right-clicking a grown plant, destroying it won't drop anything.

 
## **Blocks**

**Coffee Machine**

Coffee can be brewed by placing ground coffee within the top slot of a Coffee Machine, an empty mug within the bottom one, and pressing the "Brew" button. This will create a 'Full coffee mug', which can be crafted to create different coffee varieties, as listed below.

![Coffee Machine crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nR1chlv0/images/9cef51948da06050a5c07d17a2cbf7afb9801ed6.png)

**Coffee Grinder**

One of the ways that coffee beans can be ground is with a coffee grinder. The coffee grinder must be placed down and does not use up durability over time. To use the coffee grinder, place roasted coffee beans into the grinder and click 'Grind'.

![Coffee Grinder crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nR1chlv0/images/4a3451373a5a4609f2bd10129791a2c0a26bf956.png)
 
## **Items**

### **Coffee varieties:**

After drinking any variety of coffee, an empty mug will be returned to you. Drinking coffee also applies some potion effects for a short amount of time. The potions and amounts of time vary depending on which coffee variant is drunk. These effects slowly wear off over time, e.g., giving you speed two before slowing it to speed one as the caffeine wears off. The insomnia effect is also applied, which will prevent sleeping after drinking coffee.

**Full coffee mug**

The Full coffee mug is obtained after using the coffee machine, details of how to do so are listed above.

**Sugary Coffee**

![Sugary Coffee crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nR1chlv0/images/a668868236f6633afd460b0eb3e69bdeeba259fc.png)

**Milky coffee**

![Milky coffee crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nR1chlv0/images/4ee0bdf5290e01641d0ce94ffebb68ac070f18f8.png)

**Sugary milky coffee**

![Sugary milky coffee crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nR1chlv0/images/1aa93674e2e545af280aec425bd0e72d63f79474.png)
 
### **Coffee beans:**

**Raw coffee beans**

These are the raw coffee beans that you harvest from a coffee tree. Details of how to collect them are listed above, under the 'Coffee Tree' plant.

**Roasted coffee beans**

Raw coffee beans can be roasted in a furnace or a smoker, to obtain Roasted coffee beans. These can then be ground down using any variety of coffee grinders, for use in a Coffee machine.

![Roasted coffee beans crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nR1chlv0/images/23118f5b5176f75189cd153b9701e474a2eb89b3.png)

**Ground coffee**

This can be crafted within a crafting grid using the hand grinder (as shown below), or by utilising the coffee grinder block (as shown above)

![Ground coffee crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nR1chlv0/images/3890f5a298375efbb870200d926789a7ae0db94b.png)
 
### **Mugs:**

**Clay mug**

The coffee mug is obtained by gathering 7 clay and crafting a clay mug.

![Clay mug crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nR1chlv0/images/9676acbb7b5b8be8208b7063504ebd307d3264c1.png)

**Empty coffee mug**

The clay mug must be smelted in a furnace to 'harden' the clay, creating a coffee mug - the item used to hold coffee.

![Empty coffee mug crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nR1chlv0/images/a4b231025efea48618bb992a33fa6829b6affc16.png)

 

### **Other:**

**Hand grinder**

Coffee beans can also be ground with a hand grinder. The hand grinder can be kept in your inventory and loses durability as you use it. To use the hand grinder, place the hand grinder and roasted coffee beans into any shape in a crafting grid. This will use up 1 durability, with a total of 16 uses.

![Hand grinder crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nR1chlv0/images/b2d2db793a00ed522d1d905d1e26efb23527c10c.png)

# Compound V

Compound V is a Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 superhero mod inspired by *The Boys*.

Find rare laboratory keycards, raid secret underground labs, synthesize Compound V, and inject yourself to receive one random permanent power set. Powers are strong, risky, and built around energy, cooldowns, ultimates, and multiplayer synchronization.

> This is a fan-made mod. It is not official and does not include official assets from The Boys.

## Features

- Compound V serum with random permanent hero powers
- Temp V syringe with temporary Butcher powers
- Secret laboratory generation
- V-Injector machine
- Rare keycards from Ancient Cities, End Cities, and Woodland Mansions
- Custom rare ingredients
- Energy, cooldown, ultimate, mutation, and failure systems
- Modern superhero-style HUD
- Multiplayer sync for hero selection, energy, cooldowns, active effects, and appearance overlay
- Admin/testing commands
- Custom item textures and models for mod items

## Heroes

Current heroes include:

- Homelander
- Starlight
- Soldier Boy
- Stormfront
- A-Train
- Queen Maeve
- Black Noir
- The Deep
- Kimiko
- Translucent
- Butcher with Temp V
- Firecracker
- Sister Sage
- Tek Knight
- Lamplighter
- Shockwave

Each hero has multiple abilities, with stronger heroes like Homelander, Starlight, Soldier Boy, and Stormfront having higher power levels.

## Controls

- R
- G
- V
- B
- N
- H
- J
- U

/compoundv give

/compoundv remove

- **Acacia**: Knocks back nearby monsters
- **Dark Oak**: Grants XP orbs in dark areas
- **Cherry**: Strikes nearby monsters with lightning

title: Simple Block Replacer
description: A simple mod to replace blocks with other blocks.
body: ## Due to a lack of time, I am no longer updating this mod **Block Replacer** is a mod that lets you replace blocks in the world (upon chunk generation) with another block. The main intention of this mod is block deduplication. Imagine you have Biomes O' Plenty and Regions Unexplored at the same time. Well, you'd have 2 different sets of multiple wood types which is inconvenient, with this mod, you can only keep one set by replacing the other. All info on how to replace a block is located in the `blockreplacer.json5` config. **NOTE:** This mod has no retroactive capibilities, it will only replace newly placed/generated blocks since it's install. ## **Performance** I tested a config that replaces all stone blocks in the world with blocks of diamond and the performance hit was negligable. This is partially due to the fact that the mod intercepts the methods that sets the blocks during chunk generation and do the replacement directly there so it's almost as if nothing changed. ## **Modpack Usage** You may include this mod into your own modpacks as long as it is distributed through CurseForge, Modrinth, or any other recognized mainstream modding platforms that may exist in the future. ## **Is this not just [Block Swap](https://modrinth.com/mod/block-swap)?** Not quite. This mod is significantly simpler in implementation as all it does is replace blocks. It doesn't have a state swapper, or an ID remapper. Currently, Block Swap is getting a revamp for 1.21.1 but since the Author is busy and the scope of the mod has increased, it will be quite a while before that happens. I would like to state that this is **not a port of blockswap nor is it a good alterative for it.** I only made this mod because I needed a block replacer.

title: Unnamed Common Library (UCL)
description: A very simple, easy to use configuration library that fits right in your mod!
body:
English

❔ Tell me more about it

Unnamed Common Library (UCL) is my attempt at making a simple, useful, (yet to be) powerful configuration library. Its goal is to be general purpose so that no matter the mod you build or your preferences, you can always use it. This library is obviously not meant to be used on its own,if you do so it will at most serve as an example and a test for its capabilities.

🤩 Why you should like it

  • Very easy to implement and use
  • Optional configuration screen integrations
  • JSON, TOML, and YAML support

🧑‍💻 For developers

Installation

Add the repository to your build.gradle(.kts):

repositories {
    maven {
        url = "https://maven.pkg.github.com/aurorarissime/unnamed-common-library"
    }
}

And in your buildscript, add the dependency (modImplementation for Fabric, implementation for NeoForge):

dependencies {
    (mod)Implementation("from.discorde:ucl:${ucl_version}+${minecraft_version}-fabric")
}
Usage

1. Create your configuration model

MyModConfig.java

import from.discorde.ucl.common.config.annotations.*;

@Configuration(
    name = "mymod"
)
public class MyModConfig {
    @Comment("Enable the awesome feature")
    public boolean awesomeFeature = true;

    @Comment("Maximum power level (0-100)")
    public int maxPower = 50;

    @Comment("Welcome message displayed to players")
    public String welcomeMessage = "Hello!";
}

2. Load the configuration in your mod initialiser

MyMod.java

public class MyMod implements ModInitializer {
    // The wrapper class is auto-generated at compile time
    public static final MyModConfigWrapper CONFIG = MyModConfigWrapper.createAndLoad();

    @Override
    public void onInitialize() {
        if (CONFIG.awesomeFeature) {
            System.out.println("Awesome feature is enabled!");
        }
    }
}
References

Annotations

@Configuration

Add this annotation right above your config class

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description | |------------|-------------------------|----------------|-----------------------------| | `name` | `String` | *required* | Config file or folder name | | `location` | `ConfigurationLocation` | `SUBDIRECTORY` | Where to save the config | | `format` | `ConfigurationFormat` | `JSON5` | File format to use | | `screen` | `boolean` | `true` | Generate YACL config screen |

@Comment

Add this annotation above any field to include a comment in the config file

@Comment("This comment will appear above the field in the config file")
public boolean myOption = true;

Enums

ConfigurationLocation

| Value | Description | |----------------|------------------------------------------------------| | `ROOT` | Save directly in the config folder as `{name}.{ext}` | | `SUBDIRECTORY` | Save in a subfolder as `{name}/configuration.{ext}` |

ConfigurationFormat

| Value | Extension | Description | |---------|-----------|--------------------------------------------------------| | `JSON5` | `.json5` | JSON with comments, trailing commas, and unquoted keys | | `TOML` | `.toml` | Tom's Obvious Minimal Language | | `YAML` | `.yaml` | YAML Ain't Markup Language |
Configuration screens integration

If screen = true (default) in your @Configuration annotation and YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL) is installed, a configuration screen will be auto-generated and accessible through Mod Menu.
To disable the config screen, just set the screen parameter to false in the @Configuration annotation.

Enjoy 🙂

title: SharedLife
description: SharedLife links players health bars together for an ultimate cooperative challenge. This plugin features strict synchronization: damage taken by one player is immediately reflected on everyone else.
body:
**SharedLife** links players health bars together for an ultimate cooperative challenge. This plugin features strict synchronization: **damage taken by one player is immediately reflected on everyone else.**

## ✨ Key Features

❤️ Strict Health Sync: Instant 1:1 health mirroring.

💛 Absorption Support: Eating a Golden Apple or Notch Apple applies the Absorption effect and yellow hearts to the ENTIRE group.

🍖 Hardcore Regen Rule: Natural regeneration only activates if EVERY group member has a full food bar. If one player is hungry, nobody heals!

💀 Shared Death: If one player dies, everyone dies.

🔗 Easy Linking: Simple commands to link and unlink players.

## 🛠️ Commands

/sharedlife on - Enable the plugin.

/sharedlife off - Disable the plugin.

/sharedlife link <player> - Create a group and link to a player.

/sharedlife unlink - Leave or disband your group.

## 📥 Installation

1.  Download the `.jar` file.
2.  Open your Server `plugins` folder.
3.  Place the file into the `plugins` folder.
4.  Restart your server.
5.  **Enjoy!**

title: StartupCommands
description: Allows you to set commands that run on server startup.
body:
This mod allows you to create commands that run on server startup.

There are 3 ingame commands you can use, /startupcommands, /addstartupcommand, and /removestartupcommad. All 3 have different uses.

/startupcommands allows you to see the current startup commands on your server as a list.

/addstartupcommand allows you to add a startup command to your command list, the command must be inside double quotes and not include a slash, (ex: "time set day").

/removestartupcommand allows you to remove a startup command based on number in the list. So, you can do /startupcommands which will tell you the number associated with your commands, then do /removestartupcommand (number of command to remove).

NOTE:
Commands execute 1 second apart from each other to make it sequential, this is so it is guranteed one takes place after another.

title: CraftDisable
description: A simple yet powerful plugin that gives administrators full control over what items can be crafted on their server.
body:
**CraftDisable** is a lightweight, powerful, and easy-to-use plugin designed for server administrators who want precise control over their server's economy and gameplay balance. Whether you want to disable overpowered items, create unique challenges, or guide players toward a specific progression path, CraftDisable provides the essential tools to do so with ease.

---

## ✨ Features

-   **⚙️ Intuitive In-Hand Commands:** Quickly disable or re-enable the craft for any item you are holding. No need to look up item IDs!
-   **📁 Centralized Config Management:** Manage a clean, simple list of all disabled items directly in `config.yml`. Perfect for managing dozens of items.
-   **🛡️ Bypass Permission:** Grant trusted players or ranks the `craftdisable.bypass` permission to allow them to craft anything, ignoring all restrictions.
-   **💬 Customizable Player Messages:** Every message, from the plugin's prefix to the craft denial notice, is fully translatable and customizable in the config.
-   **🤫 Silent Mode:** Choose whether players receive a notification when they attempt to craft a disabled item. Perfect for creating a seamless experience where some items just seem "uncraftable".
-   **⚡ Admin-Friendly Tools:** Includes a `/craftdisable reload` command to apply config changes instantly and a `/craftdisable list` command to see all disabled items in-game.
-   **💡 Tab-Completion:** All commands feature intuitive tab-completion to make management fast and error-free.

---

## 💻 Commands & Permissions

The main command is `/craftdisable`, with aliases `/cd` and `/craftd`.
All management commands require the permission `craftdisable.admin`.

| Command             | Description                                           | Permission             |
| ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------- |
| `/cd disable`       | Disables the craft of the item in your main hand.     | `craftdisable.admin`   |
| `/cd enable`        | Re-enables the craft of the item in your main hand.   | `craftdisable.admin`   |
| `/cd list`          | Shows a list of all currently disabled items.         | `craftdisable.admin`   |
| `/cd reload`        | Reloads the plugin's configuration file.              | `craftdisable.admin`   |

**Bypass Permission:**
-   `craftdisable.bypass` - Allows a player to craft items that are on the disabled list.

---

## 🔧 Configuration

The configuration is designed to be straightforward and easy to understand. You can quickly add items to the `disabled-items` list and toggle player notifications.

**Example `config.yml`:**
```yaml
# General plugin settings
settings:
  # Set to true to send a message to the player when they try to craft a disabled item.
  # Set to false for a "silent" block.
  send-craft-denied-message: true

# A list of items that are disabled from crafting.
# Use Bukkit Material names.
disabled-items:
  - "TNT"
  - "ENCHANTED_GOLDEN_APPLE"

title: Item Frame Controller
description: This plugin will allow you to completely customize the interaction with frames in a specific world!
body:
![Background](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2nQ7yAHS/images/02f29fd273ff8328d58c7cd2a9aeba102f25ef82.png)

# ItemFrameController

**ItemFrameController** is a Minecraft plugin for Spigot/Paper 1.16.x - 1.21.1 that provides precise control over player interaction with item frames in specified worlds. It’s ideal for protecting custom builds, museum areas, adventure maps, or simply enhancing server security.

## 🎯 Features

- 🚫 Prevent players from rotating item frames while sneaking.
- 🚫 Block placing items into item frames unless in Creative mode.
- 🛡️ Stop players or entities from breaking item frames.
- 🛠️ Restrict item frame placement.
- 🌍 Limit functionality to specific worlds.
- 💬 Customizable messages for each blocked action.

## ⚙️ Configuration

The plugin uses a YAML configuration file with the following structure:

```yaml
restricted-worlds:
  - world
  - custom_world

prevent-rotation: true
prevent-placing-items: true
prevent-knocking-by-player: true
prevent-knocking-by-entity: true
prevent-placing-frames: true

messages:
  rotation: "§cYou cannot rotate item frames in this world!"
  placing-items: "§cYou cannot place items into item frames here!"
  knocking-by-player: "§cYou cannot break item frames here!"
  knocking-by-entity: "§cEntities cannot destroy item frames here!"
  placing-frames: "§cYou cannot place item frames in this world!"

body:
This mod's only purpose is to play the boowomp sound effect whenever you break a block with the wrong tool and do not get the drop from it. It is NOT required on the server and will work if it installed on only the client; however, installing the mod on the server is recommended as it will play the sound in the world at the position of the broken block, allowing other nearby players to hear that a player has made a poor life choice.

The sound file can be replaced via resourcepack! This is the file path to put the sound at if you wish to do so:

```
assets/boowomp/sounds/failed_block_harvest.ogg
```

The mod also has a registered subtitle for the sound event, which defaults to "Boowomp". Should you wish to change this, the path is as follows:

```
assets/boowomp/lang/en_us.json
```

with the entry:

```
{
  "boowomp.subtitle.failed_block_harvest": "Boowomp"
}
```

title: [Template] Simplified WorldGen
description:
Brings back the simple world generation method with as few lines o code as possible instead of the tens of thousands present in 1.18-19.
Easily editable template.
body:
# Introduction:

I've been playing Minecraft since the first release but I only realized that there were in fact data packs. I immediately fell in love with world generation data packs and that how one minor change in the game's code can make the game feel wholly different. A simple replace of a block makes the world golden or makes it that there are PIGS in the place of every single leaves block in the game for every single tree that there is! I learnt, studied and made several world generation data packs for me, my friends and for the public while playing and toying around the Minecraft worldgen code that slicedlime released. But everything has changed with the cave update. Mojang completely rewrote the world generation system and it felt like all my previous studies went down the drain like nothing and I had to start re-learning how world generation works with each new release of Minecraft. They changed so much I could barely stand my ground with the new world generation settings. Back in 1.16 if I wanted jungle trees in a savanna biome I just added as few as 5 lines of code into the savanna biome and poof there now were extra jungle trees in the savanna biome. If you wanted end cities to generate or mansions in the nether? Just as easily as the previous method was. It was simple, easy, with very few limitations. Even someone like me who has absolutely terrible affinity for coding could enjoy himself. With 1.18 the removed this. If you want to add blue orchids to a biome? Forget it. The game will crash. You'd like nether biomes to exist in the overworld? Nope. Crash. You'd like to add some color to cold oceans and you'd want some coral to generate? Nah. As soon as you tell the game that there are corals in cold ocean biomes it'll crash. I really despise this new, overcomplicated, highly limited worldgen that Mojang has implemented with the 1.18 cave update. It made my work much much less enjoyable and much more frustrating with very little sense of achievement.


# What does the data pack do?

Honestly? Not much. You won't notice pretty much anything if you're a layman. Well... except for the new underground biomes that now can generate above ground. Yeah, sorry about that. That wasn't intentional. For some reason they now do generate above ground just as any other biome does. That was an accident. But the main goal of this data pack was to bring back the old kind of world generation. Not in the sense of gameplay but mechanics. Before 1.18 the game used as few as a few hundred, maybe even fewer lines of code to tell the world how and what sort of biomes should it generate. However, all that changed with the cave update. Now the game generates the very same biomes with the few new ones with as much as 200.000 lines of code! That's absurd. Can't even get my head around that. I can't work with that! I cannot easily modify that or change any of that! That's way too much! This data pack tries to make the world generate pretty much the same way as before but with as few lines of code as possible so me and maybe a few other inexpert, clumsy ones can get a sense of what is exactly going on in the data pack, then modify it t other imagination. Now the game generate mostly the same biomes, mostly the same way but with 1423 lines of code instead of the default 205030.

title: Immersive Navigation
description: Adds multiple navigation tools to avoid F3 screen.
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7eb35d7ca0efd8477cb6798378ae72d796e93e1f.png)
# Immersive Navigation

Immersive Navigation is a utility and quality-of-life mod for Minecraft that enhances exploration and immersion by providing a variety of tools to help navigate and understand the world, without relying on debug screens (F3). These tools simulate semi-realistic navigation and surveying experiences while maintaining gameplay immersion.
## Features

    Depth Meter: Displays the player's current Y-level (height).
    Cartesian Tool: Shows the player's X and Z coordinates or chunk information.
    Digital Clock: Shows the time in modern language. (12-Hour)
    Metal Detector: Detects nearby ores.
    Moist Sensor: Determines if the player is standing in a slime chunk **(My Favorite)**.
    Hollow Scanner: Identifies open areas (2-block tall) beneath the player.
    Terrain Analyzer: Detects if valuable materials exist under the player, summarizes the richness.
   ** Omni-Gauge**: All-in-one tool with switchable modes for multiple functionalities like time display, coordinate checking, and terrain analysis.

## Crafting
    Battery: Crafted using lapis lazuli and iron ingots.
    Solar Panel: Renewable energy component crafted using glass, iron ingots, and sunlight sensor.

### Not-so-near Plans

    Config for ore detection, compatibility with other mods.

### How to Use

    All tools: Right-click to for functionality.
    Omni-Gauge: Shift + Right-click to change mode.

### Installation

    If not from modrinth client:
    Download and install Fabric and Fabric API.
    Place the mod .jar file into your mods folder located in .minecraft.

title: Simple Display Items

body:
# Simple Display Items
A simple datapack that allows you to disable interaction with an item, make it float, and make it immune to fire.

## Showcase
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/QJ9RBMGaqn0" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen></iframe>

*(Watch on YouTube for better quality)*

## Usage
First run the following command:
```
/function sdi:craft/craft_papers
```
This will give you two papers, one called "Display On" and one called "Display Off". 

To put an item in "display mode", throw the item on the block you want, then throw the "Display On" paper on top. If you see green particles, then it worked.

To take an item out of display mode, simply throw the "Display Off" paper at the item, and you can immediately pick it up.

### ❗WARNING❗
Items are *not* immune to explosions for now. This may change in the near future.

## ⚙️ Optional Crafting Recipe
There is a built in crafting recipe that is disabled by default. To enable it, unzip the datapack and navigate to:
```
data/sdi/recipes/papers.json.disabled
```
Rename the file to just "papers.json". (If you are on windows, you may need to enable file extensions. You can learn how to do so [here](https://www.howtogeek.com/205086/beginner-how-to-make-windows-show-file-extensions/))

Once you finish this and reload with "/reload", the papers can be crafted by all players with the following recipe:\
![Crafting Recipe](https://file.garden/YK55Rqs3-AHC5Tk9/simple_display_items_recipe.png)

You can also replace the recipe with any recipe you want, as long as the file is still called "papers.json".

title: Frostbyte's Item Model Modifier
description: Adds the /model command, allowing any item to be given any model
body:
[![Frostbyte's Item Model Modifier](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/692713b2-8f4d-453a-b929-ac620778a534)]()

[![CurseForge](https://cf.way2muchnoise.eu/short_1298999_downloads.svg)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/frostbytes-item-model-modifier)
[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/8C9whm1d?color=00AF5C&label=downloads&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/mod/frostbytes-item-model-modifier)
[![Requires Fabric API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Requires-Fabric%20API-dbd0b4?logo=data%3Aimage%2Fpng%3Bbase64%2CiVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAfQAAAH0BAMAAAA5%2BMK5AAAAGFBMVEUAAADb0LTGvKW8spyuppSakn6Aem04NCogwuCRAAAAAXRSTlMAQObYZgAAAo1JREFUeNrt2zFOw0AQhlF3rg0FNbkBSpEakSMQcQPqBITm%2BnRIM4VHVkDG8L56m7ftvztIkiRJkiRJkiRJkrTJxsid0dHR0dHR0dHR0dHR0dHR0dHR0dHR0dHR0dHR0dHR0Ychcpcpdxc5dHR0dHR0dHR0dHR0dHR0dHR0dHR0dHR0dHR0dHT0r952ufspF7kzOjo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ovpfpo%2BRa%2Fb0932uOY6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6OvmF6P6BPpca2zz1MuSiho6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6P%2FUnqUGlvzX73WvDyI%%2BHfry%2Bb1exVOxdlR0dHR0dHR0dHR0dHR0dHR0dHR0dHR0dHR0dHR09Ja%2B4WL%2BKl4ih46Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6O%2Fi%2FptZhvKKGjo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojo6Ojt3RJkiRJkiRJkiRJkjbRJ0KLYiuU9T5SAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC)](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)

**Overview:**

This mod adds a ```/model``` command, allowing any item to be given any model. ```/model``` can be called with one of four arguments, as long as the player's main hand is not empty:
- ```/model get```: Returns the identifier of the model that is currently applied to the item
- ```/model set <identifier>```: Sets the item's model to the model defined by ```<identifier>```
- ```/model reset```: Resets the item to its vanilla model
- ```/model gui```: Opens a GUI which can be used to visually browse through every currently loaded item model

Items modified via the ```/model``` command remain 100% vanilla, so the custom model will render even for players who don't have [Frostbyte's Item Model Modifier](https://github.com/FrostbyteGames1/Frostbytes-Item-Model-Modifier) installed (as long as the model is vanilla or part of a texture pack that is shared by all players involved). Additionally, if the item being modified is a helmet, the new model will be rendered instead of the helmet texture.

**Using the GUI:**

When running the ```/model gui``` command while holding any item in the player's mainhand, a new Remodel screen will be opened. The two item slots at the top of the screen will display the current held item (left) and a preview of that item with the currently slected model applied (right).

Below these item slots are a search bar and a stonecutter-style scrollable list of every currently loaded item model, listed in alphabetical order by identifier.

The GUI also contains three buttons:
- A blue circular arrow (left): resets the held item to its vanilla model
- A green check mark (center): applies the currently selected model
- A red X (right): exits the GUI

![The /model GUI for an unmodified Diamond Helmet](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b3bcdda5-6f3a-4573-a684-e9239cee66fc)

If any of the models in the list are clicked, the preview item slot (right) will update to reflect the current selection. The button with the green check mark (center) will then become active, signifying that it can be clicked to apply the current selection and exit the GUI.

![The /model GUI for an unmodified Diamond Helmet with the Flowering Azalea Sapling model selected](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/584f1183-77d9-4140-9bda-32bf26c663be)

If ```/model gui``` is run with an already modified item in the player's mainhand, the button with the blue circular arrow (left) will be active, signifying that it can be clicked to reset the current item to its vanilla model and exit the GUI.

![The /model GUI for an Diamond Helmet remodeled to look like a Flowering Azalea Sapling](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/78f99b5b-2e34-4980-acda-5daca29d4382)

Once an item has been remodeled:
- No mod-dependent data will have been applied, meaning custom model will remain even if [Frostbyte's Item Model Modifier](https://github.com/FrostbyteGames1/Frostbytes-Item-Model-Modifier) is uninstalled 
- If the item is stackable, it will now only stack with other items with the same NBT data
- If the item can be equipped to the head slot, its new model will be rendered instead of the armor texture

![The survival inventory of a player with the Ari default skin, wearing a Diamond Helmet remodeled to look like a Flowering Azalea Sapling](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f3e8cae3-f5d9-49be-8f60-c589163921af)

**FAQs:**

- *Will this be updated to [Insert Version]?* - Yes! I plan on updating this mod for as long as I can. Expect to wait a few weeks after major Minecraft updates for an updated version of this mod. There may be longer pauses between minor versions depending on how busy I am.
- *Will you make a Forge version?* - No. I don't make Forge mods, but feel free to make your own (unofficial) port as long as you credit me for any code borrowed from this mod.
- *Can I use this in my mod pack?* - Yes! I made this mod for people to use!

**Download:**

Modrinth - https://modrinth.com/mod/frostbytes-item-model-modifier

Curseforge - https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/frostbytes-item-model-modifier

title: CustomTree
description: Replaces vanilla world-generation trees with custom NBT structures
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/09a3b41261c91245577410cf81e5010676c7f53a.png)



# CustomTree

CustomTree is a modern world-generation mod for Minecraft that replaces vanilla trees with custom-made and carefully designed NBT structures. The mod enhances forests and natural environments with more detailed tree generation while trying to maintain compatibility with other mods as well as world generation performance.

## Features
- Replaces vanilla trees with custom NBT-based variants
- Unique tree generation across all supported biomes
- Full compatibility with Tectonic
- Server-side support with no client installation required
- Lightweight and optimized for modpacks and multiplayer servers, coming in at only 1 MB total
  

## Compatibility

While I try to maintain compatibility with different mods, I cannot promise that every mod will work. Especially mods that modify tree generation or add their own trees will probably not be compatible with this mod.

**Compatible Mods**

- Tectonic
- C2ME

## Updating to Other Versions

The goal of this mod is to support nearly every modern Minecraft version. However, please keep in mind that updating and porting a mod to newer Minecraft versions takes time, especially as Mojang frequently changes internal game code and world generation systems.

At the moment, I am primarily focused on supporting newer Minecraft releases and do not currently plan to backport the mod to significantly older versions in the near future.

If you would like to use the mod on an unsupported older version, you are free to decompile and port the mod yourself in accordance with the project's license.

title: Augmented Weaponry
description: A free weapons plugin consisting of six Custom Weapons, each with unique abilities.
body:
# Augmented Weaponry



The Ultimate Custom Weapons Plugin!

**Augmented Weaponry** adds 6 Custom Weapons to your game, each with a unique Main Ability and Passive Ability.


Perfect for Survival, SMP, PvP, Network hubs, and competitive servers.






## Features



**✔ 6 Custom Weapons**

Each with a unique Passive and Active ability, with matching themes to one of the Structures/Biomes in Vanilla Minecraft.



**✔ Lightweight & Optimized**

Built for performance; no unnecessary overhead.



**✔ Easy Configuration**

Simple YAML config with clear formatting options.






## Weapon Lore and Info



**Reaper Scythe:**


The strongest of all weapons, the Reaper Scythe was forged in the depths of the Nether realm alongside the Soul Reaver. Cursed with dark energy, it strips away life from all living beings that are unfortunate enough to feel its warmth.



**Active Ability (Death Curse):** Upon hitting an enemy, they are inflicted with the Death Curse, which makes them perish regardless of their Armor or Potion effects. The only way to negate the Death Curse is to consume an Enchanted Golden Apple.



**Cooldown:** 1 Day





**Soul Reaver:**



The only weapon strong enough to withstand the dark energy of the Reaper Scythe being forged alongside it, the Soul Reaver is a prison of eternal torment for damned souls. It is capable of converting slain souls back to health and experience for the wielder, a frightening yet functional ability.



**Passive Ability (Dark Harvest):** When an entity is slain, their soul is converted and sent back in the form of +3 health and +5 xp levels for the wielder, up to a maximum of 50 xp levels.



**Passive Ability (Explosive Demise):** If an entity dies within 10 seconds of being hit by the Soul Reaver, its soul collapses hastily, unleashing an AOE explosion that effects nearby enemies in a large radius.



**Cooldown: Passive**





**StormBringer:**


Channeling a fraction of the power of Poseidon, this weapon was one of the gifts to Atlanteans. Originally far weaker, it was lost and forgotten by the receiving warriors, enraging Poseidon and causing him to curse it with his raw fury to unleash its full might.



**Active Ability (Sky Fury):** When unleashed, it summons lightning bolts on all enemies around the Wielder, forcing them back and displaying the eternal curse of the weapon.



**Passive Ability (Shield of Atlantis):** The weapon protects its Wielder by giving them permanent Resistance II, as long as their hands clasp it.



**Cooldown:** 1 minute





**Gravity Shifter:**

One of Dr. Geros most destructive creations, the Gravity Shifter is a weapon straight out of science fiction. The force of this weapon is enough to anchor an enemy in place, removing their ability to jump and run for a fixed amount of time.



**Active Ability (Mighty Anchor):** Upon striking, the enemy loses the ability to jump and is slowed for a specified time period.



**Cooldown:** 1 minute





**Blink Blade:**

Forged by the last Ender Queen, the Blink Blade captures the elusive power of the Endermen, turning its Wielder into a shadow of the void. It was far stronger than the Reaper Scythe a long time ago, but after the collapse of the Ender kingdom, it lost most of its power to the invading faction.



**Active Ability (Enderport):** Upon striking, the wielder has a 30% chance to teleport behind the enemy, catching them off guard and giving the wielder the upper hand.



**Passive Ability (Void Dash):** The wielder's speed is greatly boosted while holding this weapon, as they obtain the Speed II effect.



**Cooldown:** Passive





**Cursed Dagger:**

The weapon of endless curses, stained with the blood of the last Aztec Emperor. Forged deep inside the Jungles of Regenhaim, it has seen the darkest mysteries unfold infront of it.



**Active Ability (Cursed Strike):** A hit delivers the poison effect to the victim, bathing them in the venom of Dàkuit, along with a chance to blind the enemy for 5 seconds.



**Cooldown:** 1 minute




## Commands


**Main command and Alias:**

/augmentedweaponry

/ag



**Sub-commands:**

/ag:giveweapon <weaponname> - Give yourself a weapon

/ag:reload - Reload the Plugin

/ag:weaponinfo <weaponname> - View info about a Weapon

/ag:weaponrecipe <weaponname> - View crafting recipe for a Weapon

/ag:weapons - List of all Weapons






## Why Augmented Weaponry?


Augmented Weaponry aims to keep the simplistic style of Vanilla Minecraft while still adding a custom twist to Weapons! Most (or all) abilities are Vanilla oriented - meaning they use Vanilla features to customize weaponry.


It also provides optimizations for maximum Server performance!

Paper
Purpur


(Works on most modern forks)
