title: Improved Wolf AI
description: Wolves in vanilla are kind of useless. They attack stuff, sure, but then they just stand there while the loot despawns. This mod fixes that.
body:
# Improved Wolf AI

Wolves in vanilla are kind of useless. They attack stuff, sure, but then they just stand there while the loot despawns. This mod fixes that.

---

## Features

**Smart Hunting** - Wolves stop attacking once the target is dead. No more watching your wolf lunge at a corpse.

**Meat Collection** - After a kill, your wolf grabs the meat and brings it back to you.

**Hostile Detection** - Your wolf growls when hostile mobs are nearby. Works as an early warning system in caves or at night.

**Item Fetching** - Crouch and your wolf will fetch nearby item drops and bring them to you. Useful for cleaning up after a fight.

---

## How It Works

- Wolves still fight normally, they just stop when the job is done
- Crouch to signal your wolf to fetch items, stand up to cancel
- Growling doesn't interrupt combat or other behaviors
- Items are visually shown in the wolf's mouth while carrying

---

## Config

Everything can be toggled or adjusted in the config file:

- Enable/disable any feature
- Adjust detection ranges
- Change fetch behavior (crouch-only or always active)
- Tweak timing for growls and fetching

---

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Forge 47.0.0+

---

## Notes

- Only affects tamed wolves
- Sitting wolves won't fetch, growl, or hunt
- Should work fine with other mods unless they completely overwrite wolf AI

---

Report bugs on the issue tracker. Suggestions welcome.

title: Infinite Villager Structures
description: A datapack that turns overworld into densely generated villager structures!
body:
![Thumbnail](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/22c3b4b21ba6c102c24990195c859fd7a6073c79.png)

# 🏘️Infinitely Generated Overworld Village
If you are looking to challenge yourself in a completely random minecraft world I introduce you. . .
A Minecraft datapack that turns your overworld into a pile of villages infinitely!

This datapack currently supports 1.21.8+ only and may support older versions soon, including upcoming more cursed datapack as well!

# 📥Installation
**Recommended method**  
1. Create a new world in Minecraft
2. Click **More** → **Datapacks** → **Open Pack Folder**
3. Drop the datapack `.zip` file of this datapack into folder
4. Back to Minecraft and select and add it → **Done** → Generate the world

**Other method**
1. Drop the datapack `.zip` file into existing world folder and restart (leave and join) the world
2. Datapack should be enabled automatically (You can check by `/datapack list`)
- If it doesn't listed in active datapack, run `/datapack enable "file/Infinitely-generated-village-datapack-X.XX.X_vX.X.zip"` and restart the world

# 🔧Recommended Configuration
Currently the datapack can only be configured by editing its files only.

**⚠️Always makesure to make changes by unzip the datapack first before editing for safety⚠️**

**Configurable file:**

```
Infinitely-generated-village-datapack-X.XX.X_vX.X-vx\data\minecraft\worldgen\structure_set\villages.json
```
This file controls how villages generate across the overworld, open it with **Notepad** or any text editor.

**Key settings:**

`"spacing": 2,` Default: 2 - Tell how far structures generate, in chunks currently 2 chunks. (Lower values = denser villages.)

`"separation": 0,` Default: 0 - Minimum amount of chunks that must be empty between structures. (Lower values = structures can overlap)

**For v1.1+**
`"spacing"` and `"separation"` can be configurated in `vx\data\minecraft\worldgen\structure_set`, can be configured **Both** `(villages_ocean.json, villages.json)`

# ⚠️ Performance Notice
This datapack causes villager structures to generate extremely densely and infinitely each chunks. 
Expect performance impacts, especially during world generation. 
It is **highly recommended** to use high-end PC or optimization mods such as [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium), [C2ME](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-fabric), [Noisium](https://modrinth.com/mod/noisium) or [any](https://modrinth.com/mods?f=categories:optimization&v=1.21.8)

## Notes
- In existing worlds villages will not generate in new chunks immediately, you have to locate any vanilla Minecraft village first.

🎉 Shared-Lives 🎉

Small plugin for Minecraft that makes players damage shared between them.
What is Shared-Lives?

Ever wanted your Minecraft team to truly share everything—including their pain? With Shared-Lives, whenever one player takes damage, everyone in the group feels it! Want to make things even more chaotic? This plugin is for you!
Features

    🩸 Shared Damage: All pain is mutual!
    🛠️ Easy to set up—just drop it in your plugins folder.
    👫 Play with friends and test your teamwork (or suffer together).

Installation

    Download the plugin.
    Drop it into your server's plugins folder.
    Restart your server.
    Configure below!

Configuration

All settings are in plugins/Shared-Lives/config.yml.
YAML

share-heal: false

🔧 Options

    share-heal:
        true: Healing one player heals everyone!
        false: Only damage is shared, healing is not.

    Default: false

Example

Want everyone to heal together?
Set share-heal: true
YAML

share-heal: true

How Does It Work?

    Take damage? The whole squad takes damage!
    Eat some food? If share-heal is enabled, everyone gets a boost.

Why Use Shared-Lives?

    Make your adventures thrilling, challenging, and hilarious.
    Perfect for custom game modes, streamers, or anyone who loves chaos.

description: Early-Weapons allows new recipes and new functions for vanilla items and new weapons crafted from simple early-game materials.
body:
Early Weapons, where the goal is to enhance the early-game experience of Minecraft by introducing a range of new weapons that are immediately accessible but carefully balanced to ensure they do not overshadow the natural progression of the game. These weapons are designed to be crafted from common vanilla materials—such as wood, stone, leather, iron, gold (both finished and raw), sticks, and even flint—that players typically gather within their first few in-game days. Rather than hoarding or discarding these materials once stronger resources like diamonds and netherite are acquired, Early Weapons gives them renewed importance and practical value during the early stages of survival.

This mod is especially useful for players who find themselves in a time crunch—whether in hardcore mode, speedrunning, or just seeking more exciting combat options without needing to grind for rare ores. It empowers players with more weapon variety and utility right from the start, without breaking game balance. The weapons introduced are not overpowered or game-breaking, but instead provide niche uses, diverse combat styles, and tactical advantages suited for specific scenarios. For example, some may be faster but weaker, others slower with knockback effects, or crafted from raw materials and flimsy haha,

Early Weapons breathes new life into Minecraft’s early game by offering accessible, balanced tools of combat that respect vanilla mechanics while expanding player choice. Whether you're fending off your first night of zombies, exploring a newly generated world, or preparing for a PvP challenge, this mod helps you get battle-ready faster—without skipping the essential survival experience Minecraft is built on.

Yes, to be able to play in older versions, you have to unlink the modpack at the very bottom of the modpack options. Yes, this modpack is Cross-Platform.

- **Can I use this modpack with a server running [MedieCraft - Server](https://modrinth.com/modpack/mediecraft-server) ?** 

No, you are missing many mods that are mandatory to join a [MedieCraft - Server](https://modrinth.com/modpack/mediecraft-server). See [MedieCraft - Lite](https://modrinth.com/modpack/mediecraft-lite).

**More of Items+**: [_Items Plus Series_](https://modrinth.com/collection/HR0F6Sea)
# Description
This mod currently adds the 'Creeped' effect and a Musket rifle.

See what I'll add in the full version under _**Future Additions**_.

## Added Content
Below is all the content the latest version adds.

### Creep Positions
Brewing the Creep Potions and how they work in the MCreator version

![Brewing a Splash Potion of Creep](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/7rkrVI0s/images/e203d566458d0a803a7606461caa515a472fcdd5.png)

- **Potion of Creep**: At the moment you can only use a Splash or Lingering potion to brew it since you need Gunpowder. Once you use it on an entity (or yourself, for whatever reason) it will explode with a power of 2 after the effect duration ends (30 seconds) or if they are caught on fire. Milk does work.
- **Potion of Creep +**: Use Redstone on a Potion of Creep. This will increase the potion's duration to 3 minutes (have fun finding a use for this!).
- **Potion of Creep II**: Use Glowstone Dust on a Potion of Creep. This will increase the explosion's power from 2 to 4 while also increasing the duration to 40 seconds.

### Rifles and Pistols
Crafting the Rifles and Pistols and how they work in the MCreator version.\
All of these will be different in the full release.

![Crafting a Musket Rifle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/7rkrVI0s/images/9e64a1880875db6eeddb0d32add2b54538826092.png)

- **Musket Rifle**: At a crafting table use a Gold Ingot and 2 Iron Ingots in a line, then any wood slab in the center below and any wooden plank in the bottom left.\
To fire, you need 2-3 Gunpowder (20% chance that you need 3) and an Iron Nugget. Keep clicking to load the Gunpowder until you hear a click indicating that it's now loaded and then click again to fire. It will deal 11 damage on any entity hit. Has a durability of 183.

![Crafting a Snaphaunce Pistol](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/7rkrVI0s/images/fbe807caaec73dd21c54d3cec81ef88145bb18ec.png)

- **Snaphaunce Pistol**: At a crafting table use an Iron Nugget and an Iron Ingot to the right of it, then any wooden slab in the bottom left.\
In the full release it's meant to be weaker than the Musket (with lower power and less damage) but will be much cheaper and have a special ability no other ranged weapon has in the base game (including the Musket itself). Currently, it's not well balanced and I only added a recipe so you can try it out in survival.

- - -

## Future Additions
These aren't in the Alpha because of either MCreator's limitations or because I just decided to wait for the beta / full release.\
_*May not add or will be vastly different after balancing_.

**Powder Flask**: A flask that can hold powder by placing it inside a crafting table and surrounding it with the powder. When any of the flasks run out of powder they will be replaced with the Powder Flask.

**Gunpowder Flask (_Powder Flask filled with Gunpowder_)**\
The Powder Flask filled with Gunpowder (the flask in the center surrounded by 8 gunpowder), each Gunpowder will become three uses on the Gunpowder Flask (24 total uses). This is undecided, but it might also take .65s instead of .75s when loading a Musket or Snaphaunce. It can also place the gunpowder onto the ground (takes three uses of the flask).

**Placeable Gunpowder** [_as Add-On_]
It acts similarly to Redstone Dust, except for an infinite distance and a 5-tick delay between each piece of Gunpowder activating. Each Gunpowder will be destroyed after being activated and can only be activated by Flint & Steel (I may add an option for Redstone activation in the config). It can be placed to branch into multiple directions and will activate any Redstone machinery.

***Cannon + Cannonball**\
This is very unlikely to be added, but I may have some ideas for a legitimate cannon that have unique functionality... I just can't think of any right now :|

  location: 1 meter in front of player
  lines: "&cRAHH!", "&7Get jumpscared!"
```
- You can also hide the hologram! `hide hologram "ghost" from player`

More Examples can be viewed directly inside the source code, and labeled.


## Requires [Skript](https://github.com/SkriptLang/Skript) 2.7.0 or higher to function.

Please suggest syntax ideas in the [Github](https://github.com/keishispl/skologram)! It would help a lot.

For suggestions, you can also suggest them in Github as well!

This plugin was made because I am done with console filling with "This line has been set!", I can barely see the important stuff!

title: CreepyCogs
description: Modpack made for the creepycogs server
body:
# 🎃 Minecraft Modpack: Creepy Cogs 🎃


Are you ready to embark on a spine-tingling adventure in the world of Minecraft like never before? Dive into the eerie and electrifying world of Creepy cogs, a unique modpack that fuses Halloween spookiness, thrilling exploration, cutting-edge technology, and challenging gameplay. Brace yourself for a terrifyingly fun experience as you journey through a world where the nights are darker, filled with new terrors, and the only way to see is by clutching a torch.


## 🌙 Haunting Nights

The night has taken on a malevolent twist, with darkness deeper than ever before. Without a light source, you'll be plunged into an abyss of inky blackness. The moonlight barely penetrates the inky void, and you'll find yourself relying on torches to uncover the hidden secrets of the night. Survival becomes a nail-biting challenge as you fend off new, nightmarish monsters lurking in the shadows.


## 🏰 Mysterious Structures and Secrets

Explore a world filled with creepy and enigmatic structures. Abandoned haunted mansions, ancient crypts, and spooky graveyards are just a few of the bone-chilling sights you'll encounter. As you venture deeper into these sinister structures, unravel their secrets to reveal hidden treasures and ancient artifacts. Some of these secrets may even grant you the power to conquer the menacing creatures of the night.


## 👻 Conquer the Bosses

Prepare to face off against a new breed of bosses that make the Overworld a far more treacherous place. These otherworldly creatures possess powers and abilities that will push your skills to their limits. Conquer them, and you'll unlock valuable resources and technologies necessary to survive in this haunted realm.

## 🔧 Harness the Power of Technology

In the midst of this supernatural adventure, technology plays a pivotal role. The Create Mod takes center stage, allowing you to engineer machines and contraptions to aid in your quest. Craft powerful tools and gadgets, automate your resource gathering, and forge innovative defenses to keep the darkness at bay. Master the art of invention as you delve into this fascinating aspect of the modpack.


## 🎃 Spine-Chilling Atmosphere

The ambiance of Creepy Cogs is unparalleled. Creepy sounds, spectral effects, and ominous music combine to create an immersive and chilling experience. Every moment spent in this modpack is a journey through the unknown, a journey filled with both terror and excitement.

Are you ready to face the darkness, unveil the mysteries, defeat monstrous bosses, and conquer technology in a world that's been transformed into a Halloween nightmare? If you have the courage, embark on the adventure of a lifetime and download the Creepy Cogs modpack today. But remember, the night is dark and filled with terrors, and you must hold a torch to see what lies ahead!

### A simple client-side mod for toggling the /teammsg command.
### Usage:
- **Use /toggleteammsg or /ttm to toggle whether your chat messages should be sent to the team chat or not**
- **When enabled, type in chat as normal and your messages will be sent into the team chat instead.**
- **If Team messages are enabled, use /allchat <msg> or /ac <msg> to send a message in the regular chat**
- **You can use /r <msg> or /reply <msg> to send a message to the person you last messaged**

### Notes:
- **This mod may not work on servers using custom teams through other plugins/mods**

title: Aurora pvp
description: A Minecraft PvP mod that's half done, sorry idk how to code it, will get better hopefully over the weeks to come. It works tho... only for 1.21.11 for now.
body:
# **Aurora PvP**
Built for cleaner fights and better control

_Fabric 1.21.11 • Client-side PvP utility mod_

# For server owners
If you would like to opt out of people having this client on your server, please check the versions for the Fabric server mod and Paper plugin for server opt-out. Thank you.

## UPDATED 1.7.4
_Hope you like it :3_

## **What is Aurora PvP?**

Aurora PvP is a modular PvP-focused client that improves how combat feels and plays without overcomplicating Minecraft.

The goal isn’t to overload the game with features, but to refine the parts that actually matter in PvP:

- visibility
- awareness
- control

Everything is designed to feel smooth, useful, and consistent with vanilla gameplay.

## Combat Features

Aurora PvP includes several features that help you better understand and react during fights:

- Player Outline (PvP)
- Highlights players so they’re easier to track in combat
- Target Health (Crosshair)
- Displays enemy health directly in your crosshair for faster decisions
- Damage Tracker
- Shows how much damage you’re dealing in real time
- Hit Particles
- Adds clear visual feedback when landing hits

These features give you better awareness without getting in the way of gameplay.

## Visual Improvements

The mod reduces unnecessary visual clutter and improves clarity:

- NoRender
- Removes distracting or unimportant visuals and can improve performance
- Makes it easier to see key elements during fights
- Block Overlay
- Improves block interaction visibility for building and PvP
- Movement and Control

Movement-related features are designed to make gameplay more comfortable and consistent:

- Toggle Sprint
- Toggle Sneak
- Free Look (hold key)
- Zoom (hold + scroll)

These changes don’t alter core mechanics but make movement easier to manage during fights.

## HUD and Information

Aurora PvP adds useful on-screen information without cluttering the display:

- Cyber Vitality HUD (in progress)
- Hand / Tool Durability
- Potion Effects Display
- World Time
- Facing / Degrees

All HUD elements are designed to be simple and readable.

## Customisation

All modules can be toggled through an in-game GUI.
You can choose exactly which features you want to use and configure the mod to match your playstyle.

## Visual Style

Based on the in-game experience and gallery, the mod focuses on:

- clean outlines
- minimal HUD elements
- clear particle effects
- reduced visual clutter
  
The result is a more focused and readable PvP experience.

## Development Status

Aurora PvP is still being developed.

Some features may not work perfectly yet, and improvements to stability, visuals, and UI are ongoing. More updates and features are planned.

Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader

### Final Notes

Aurora PvP is built around making combat clearer and more controlled without changing the core feel of the game.

_**If you want a cleaner PvP experience with better feedback and visibility, this mod is designed for that.**_

title: MiguelCrates
description: Inject excitement into MiguelEconomy with fully customizable, animated loot crates! creating a unique reward system for your server
body:
# MiguelCrates

MiguelCrates turns simple item giving into an event. It adds fully animated, exciting lootboxes to your world that hook into your economy and keep players coming back for "just one more spin."

---

## How to Create Your Own Custom Crate

User the online Crate Builder : https://miguel-economy-builder.vercel.app/crate-builder

OR


1.  **Find the Folder:** Go to your server’s config folder (`config/migueleconomy/crates`).
2.  **Copy & Paste:** Take an existing file (like `common.json`) and copy it. Rename it to something like `vip_crate.json`.
3.  **Edit the Details:** Open it with any text editor (like Notepad).
    * Change the **Name** to "VIP Crate".
    * Pick a **Texture** (color) for how it looks.
    * **List your Rewards:** Simply type in the items you want (e.g., `"minecraft:diamond"`), how many to give, and how rare they should be.
    * *Tip: You can even make it run commands (with custom icons!) or give money.*
4.  **Restart:** Restart your server, and your new crate is ready to be placed!


<details>
<summary>Comple Crate Guide</summary>

# Creating and Editing Crates

MiguelCrates uses JSON configuration files to define crates. This allows you to easily create new crates or modify existing ones without changing the mod code.

## Location

Crate configuration files are located in the `config/migueleconomy/crates/` directory of your Minecraft instance.

- **Server/Client**: `config/migueleconomy/crates/`

Each crate is a separate `.json` file. The file name determines the unique ID of the crate (e.g., `common.json` -> `common`).

## Crate Structure

The basic structure of a crate JSON file is as follows:

```json
{
  "display_name": "My Custom Crate",
  "description": "A description of what's inside.",
  "icon": "minecraft:chest",
  "texture": "miguelcrates:block/common_crate",
  "rewards": [
    ...
  ],
  "obtain": {
    "sources": [
      ...
    ]
  }
}
```

### Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `display_name` | String | The name shown in GUIs and items. |
| `description` | String | Description text shown in tooltips. |
| `icon` | String | The Item ID used to represent the crate (e.g., `minecraft:chest`). |
| `texture` | String | Path to the texture for the custom renderer (usually `miguelcrates:block/<name>`). |
| `rewards` | List | A list of possible rewards (see below). |
| `obtain` | Object | (Optional) Defines how players can get this crate (see below). |

### Simplified Enchantments (Recommended)
Instead of using complex NBT strings, you can use the `enchantments` block to add enchantments to an item. This works for both books and tools.

```json
{
    "item": "minecraft:enchanted_book",
    "quantity": 1,
    "enchantments": {
        "minecraft:sharpness": 5,
        "minecraft:unbreaking": 3
    },
    "weight": 10
}
```

### Advanced NBT
For more complex data (attributes, names, etc.), you can still use the `nbt` field.
```json
{
    "item": "minecraft:diamond_sword",
    "nbt": "{display:{Name:'{\"text\":\"Excalibur\"}'}}",
    "weight": 5
}
```

## Rewards

The `rewards` list contains objects defining what players can win.

```json
"rewards": [
  {
    "item": "minecraft:diamond",
    "quantity": 2,
    "weight": 10
  },
  {
    "command": "give @p minecraft:stone 64",
    "weight": 50
  },
  {
    "item": "minecraft:experience_bottle",
    "command": "xp add @p 5 levels",
    "weight": 10
  },
  {
    "item": "migueleconomy:money",
    "nbt": "{MoneyValue:100L}",
    "weight": 20
  }
]
```

- **`item`**: Resource location of the item (e.g., `minecraft:iron_sword`). If used with `command`, it acts as the icon.
- **`command`**: Command to execute. Use `@p` for the player opening the crate.
- **`name`**: (Optional) Custom display name for the reward (e.g. "5 Levels of XP").
- **`quantity`**: (Optional, default 1) Number of items to give.
- **`nbt`**: (Optional) NBT data string for the item.
- **`weight`**: The chance weight. Higher weight = higher chance.
  - Probability = `weight / total_weight_of_all_rewards`

## Obtain Methods

The `obtain` section defines how crates are generated in the world. It contains a list of `sources`.

### 1. Crafting (`craft`)

Allows players to craft the crate in a crafting table.

```json
{
  "type": "craft",
  "recipe": {
    "type": "minecraft:crafting_shaped",
    "category": "misc",
    "pattern": [
      "AAA",
      "ABA",
      "AAA"
    ],
    "key": {
      "A": { "item": "minecraft:planks" },
      "B": { "item": "minecraft:chest" }
    },
    "result": {
      "id": "miguelcrates:crate",
      "count": 1,
      "components": {
        "minecraft:custom_data": { "CrateId": "your_crate_id" }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### 2. Mob Drops (`kill`)

Drops when a specific entity is killed.

```json
{
  "type": "kill",
  "entity": "minecraft:zombie",
  "chance": 0.05
}
```

- **`entity`**: Entity ID (e.g., `minecraft:creeper`, `minecraft:ender_dragon`).
- **`chance`**: Probability from 0.0 to 1.0 (0.05 = 5%).

### 3. Loot Tables (`loot_table`)

Injects the crate into vanilla loot tables (chests).

```json
{
  "type": "loot_table",
  "id": "minecraft:chests/simple_dungeon",
  "chance": 0.1
}
```

- **`id`**: The Loot Table ID to inject into.
- **`chance`**: Probability the crate will appear in the chest.

## Example File (`example.json`)

```json
{
  "display_name": "Example Crate",
  "description": "An example configuration.",
  "icon": "minecraft:barrel",
  "texture": "miguelcrates:block/common_crate",
  "rewards": [
    {
      "item": "minecraft:apple",
      "quantity": 5,
      "weight": 50
    },
    {
      "item": "minecraft:golden_apple",
      "weight": 10
    }
  ],
  "obtain": {
    "sources": [
      {
        "type": "kill",
        "entity": "minecraft:skeleton",
        "chance": 0.02
      }
    ]
  }
}
```


</details>



---

## In-Game Commands (Admin)

Use these commands to manage crates.

### Give a Crate
` /miguelcrates give <player> <crate_id> [amount]`

* **Example 1 (Give yourself a Rare Crate):**
    `/miguelcrates give @p rare`
* **Example 2 (Give a player 5 Common Crates):**
    `/miguelcrates give PlayerName common 5`

### Restore Default Crates
`/miguelcrates default <name|all>`
* **Restores missing or deleted default crates.**
* Example: `/miguelcrates default all` (Restores all 20+ themed crates)
* Example: `/miguelcrates default miner` (Restores just the Miner crate)

### Reload Config
`/miguelcrates reload`
* Refreshes the mod if you edited the JSON files while the server was running.

### Open Menu (Shortcuts)
`/crates`, `/crate`, or `/box`

title: Magnetizing
description: Adds items and blocks based around magnets
body:
![magnetizing_title](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Command17/Magnetizing/main/assets/magnetizing_title_1k.png)

[![available_fabric](https://github.com/intergrav/devins-badges/raw/refs/heads/v3/assets/compact/supported/fabric_vector.svg)](https://fabricmc.net/)
[![available_neoforge](https://github.com/intergrav/devins-badges/raw/refs/heads/v3/assets/compact/supported/neoforge_vector.svg)](https://neoforged.net/)

[![requires_architectury](https://github.com/intergrav/devins-badges/raw/refs/heads/v3/assets/compact/requires/architectury-api_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/architectury-api)

***Fabric also requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) and [Forge Config API Port](https://modrinth.com/mod/forge-config-api-port)!***

---

## About 📖

This mod adds blocks and items related to magnets. These can be used to make
farming easier, create new redstone contraptions or simply to annoy your friends!

Magnets are made by a new ore:

![magnetite_ore](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Command17/Magnetizing/main/assets/magnetite_ore.png)

**Magnetite!**

Magnetite ore generates similarly to iron ore. It's the one of the key materials needed to make magnets.
However, you can't just use magnetite ingots to make magnets, as they are not
magnetic **...for now!**

If you add some **lapis lazuli** or **redstone** to a **magnetite ingot** you get:

![blue_and_red_magnetite](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Command17/Magnetizing/main/assets/blue_and_red_magnetite.png)

**Blue** and **red magnetite** ...now they're magnetic!

**Blue magnetite** has a **negative pole**, which means it'll repel entities.
**Red magnetite** has a **positive pole**. It attracts entities!

![blue_magnetite_gif](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Command17/Magnetizing/main/assets/blue_magnetite_gif.gif)
![red_magnetite_gif](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Command17/Magnetizing/main/assets/red_magnetite_gif.gif)

## Showcase 🖼️

### Block Magnets

![block_magnet_showcase](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Command17/Magnetizing/main/assets/block_magnets_sc.png)

They attract/repel entities in a square up to 5 blocks in each direction. 
The range can be changed by right-clicking the block.

### Directional Block Magnets

![directional_block_magnet_showcase](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Command17/Magnetizing/main/assets/directional_block_magnet_sc.gif)

These magnets attract/repel entities in a line up to 10 blocks long in only one direction.
You can, yet again, change the range by right-clicking the block.

### Item Magnets

![blue_item_magnet_showcase](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Command17/Magnetizing/main/assets/blue_item_magnet_sc.gif)
![red_item_magnet_showcase](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Command17/Magnetizing/main/assets/red_item_magnet_sc.gif)

Item magnets fit in your inventory and are perfect for picking up many items on the ground or pushing them away.
They work similar to block magnets, but only attract/repel items from the ground.

The range can be changed by sneaking and right-clicking with the item.

## Other 📚

This mod is configurable! You can install [Configured](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/configured) to change the config in-game.

Found an issue or do you have feedback? Make an issue on the [issue tracker](https://github.com/Command17/Magnetizing/issues)!

title: Bladebound
description: Bladebound adds named swords with unique effects, lore, and world-generated shrines designed for natural survival progression.
body: # ⚔️ **Bladebound** [![Minecraft 1.21.11](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.11-brightgreen)](https://www.minecraft.net/) [![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mod%20Loader-Fabric-blue)](https://fabricmc.net/) [![Fabric API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Requires-Fabric%20API-orange)](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) [![Modrinth Version](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/v/bladebound?logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/mod/bladebound) [![CurseForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/CurseForge-Bladebound-orange?logo=curseforge)](https://legacy.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/bladebound) Bladebound is a Fabric mod focused on **named legendary weapons**, **world-based discovery**, and **light progression mechanics** that integrate naturally into survival Minecraft. Powerful items are earned through exploration rather than shortcuts, encouraging players to uncover ancient structures and hidden knowledge. --- ## 🗡️ **Featured Weapons & Artifacts** **_Sandai Kitetsu_** — Uncommon A cursed blade from a dangerous lineage. This sword **does not generate in the world** and must be crafted using a Nether-obtained cursed component. **_Wado Ichimonji_** — Rare A disciplined blade that grows stronger through mastery and consistent use. _Found inside the Wado Ichimonji Dojo_ **_Excalibur_** — Legendary A legendary holy sword that deals **bonus damage to undead** enemies. _Spawns in the Excalibur Church_ **_Murasame_** — Legendary A cursed blade that inflicts the deadly **Murasame Curse** on hit. Without proper protection, this curse will kill both enemies and the wielder. _Spawns in the Murasame Shrine_ **_Frieren’s Staff_** — Legendary The staff of one of the greatest mages to ever live, enabling spellcasting and magical progression. _Spawns in Frieren’s Tower_ --- ## 🌍 **World Generation & Exploration** Most rare and legendary items in Bladebound are obtained through **exploration**, not crafting. Ancient structures are scattered throughout the world, each tied to specific weapons or magical progression paths. _Sandai Kitetsu_ is excluded from world generation and must always be crafted. --- ## 🧪 **Artifacts & Magical Components** **Cursed Kitetsu Shard** A cursed crafting material used to forge **Sandai Kitetsu**. - Dropped by **Wither Skeletons** - Rarely obtainable through **Piglin bartering** **Murasame Gauntlets** Protective gauntlets designed to shield the wielder from powerful curses. - Required to safely wield **Murasame** - Crafted rather than found **Cooldown Bracelet** A magical bracelet that alters how spells are cast. - Influences spellcasting behavior when worn - Obtained through exploration or villager trades --- ## 🪄 **Magic & Progression** Bladebound introduces a light magic system centered around staves, mana, and spell discovery. Spells are learned through exploration and ancient knowledge rather than crafting tables, keeping progression immersive and deliberate. --- ## 📘 **Bladebound Codex** Bladebound includes an in-game **Codex** that documents weapons, magic, and progression rules. It serves as a natural reference for learning how items work and where they can be obtained. --- ## ⚙️ **Requirements** - Minecraft **1.21.1** - **Fabric Loader** - **Fabric API** --- ## 🔖 **Credits** Made by Owen / Bladebound Minecraft is © Mojang AB

body:
🔷 Lapis Lazuli Armor and Tools – Full Description
Step into the world of magic and mining with Lapis Lazuli Armor and Tools — a custom gear set that transforms one of Minecraft’s most enchanting materials into powerful equipment. Now, Lapis isn’t just for enchanting tables — it’s your new go-to for stylish protection and reliable tools.

🛡️ Armor
Craft a full set of armor — Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, and Boots — using Lapis Lazuli.

Color: Deep, glowing lapis blue

Durability: Similar to Iron, but with better enchantability

Protection: Balanced between Iron and Gold

Bonus Effects (optional):

Increases experience gain

Boosts enchantment strength when worn


🛠️ Tools
Mine, fight, and build with the full Lapis tool set: Sword, Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, and Hoe.

Efficiency: Comparable to Iron tools

Enchantability: High, like Gold

Special Traits (optional):

Extra drops from ores

Emits particles or light when used

Increased luck or Fortune chance

🔨 Crafting
Use regular crafting recipes, replacing Iron or Diamond with Lapis Lazuli.
Example:

3 Lapis + 2 Sticks = Lapis Pickaxe

8 Lapis = Lapis Chestplate

✨ Why Use Lapis Gear?
A fresh visual style with glowing blue armor

Balanced power for mid-game use

High enchant potential for magical builds and combat

A great use for all that extra Lapis!

title: Moar Spears
description: 16 new spear types with unique, powerful, wacky, and OP abilities, all while fitting nicely into vanilla survival.
body:
Moar Spears

Spears are pretty sweet, with cool animations and loads of unique ways to use them. But I wanted MOAR! So, I decided to make Moar Spears, adding 16 new spears to the game all with unique powers and abilities. These range from simple ones like the Slime or Piston spears that deal some knockback, or the TNT spear that causes explosions on hit, to more complex spears like the Dripstone or Prismarine spears that shoot deadly projectiles. I threw in a couple silly ones too. Game balance wasn’t super in focus, so these may end up being somewhat overpowered, however they should in theory fit fairly well into the vanilla game.

You can craft them in a vanilla Crafting Table. All recipes can all be found HERE, or in-game in the Recipe Guide.

The datapack REQUIRES this Library, as well as this Resource Pack.

Learn more from this video:

So, what do the spears do?

  • Disaspear:
    • While ramming you are invisible, but mobs hit also become invisible.

  • Drill Spear:
    • Mines blocks in front of you.

  • Dripstone Spear:
    • Launches pointed dripstones.

  • Fishing Spear:
    • Makes fish drop more loot.

  • Goat Spear:
    • Summons charging mobs.

  • Grabbing Spear:
    • Lets you pick up mobs. Note: This doesn’t work on players.

  • Lance:
    • Very strong on a mount, but useless everywhere else.

  • Magma Spear:
    • Shoots fireballs.

  • Piston Spear:
    • Knocks mobs up and away from you.

  • Piston Sword:
    • It can send mobs flying. Essentially just a weak sword with knockback III.

  • Prismarine Spear:
    • Turns you into a guardian. Ramming makes thorns appear around you. Left-click shoots a rainbow laser.

  • Slime Spear:
    • Launches you and your target backwards.

  • Spear Blossom:
    • Leaves a trail of exploding spores that cause withering.

  • Spearmint:
    • Drinking this throws spears around you.

  • Spear Tire:
    • Makes mobs you hit “tired”. While tired, mobs cannot move.

  • TNT Spear:
    • Leaves a trail of TNT behind you.

  • Wind Spear:
    • Float Like a Butterfly, Sting Like a Breeze.





    To install, follow the instructions contained in the “instructions.txt” file included in the download. If you are still having issues installing or want help knowing how to do something with the pack, ask for help on our discord. Fully Multiplayer compatible!

title: The Upside Down
description: A deadly dimension full of mobs and darkness, double mob drops and unique loot. Inspired by Darkhax and the Hunting Dimension from the good ole days!
body:
A new dark dimension, inspired by the Hunting Dimension by Darkhax.

Build a 14 block portal, light it with the Blood Stone or by sacrificing a chicken in the portal frame.


Mobs in the Upside Down are double health, stable footed (no knockback) and spawn everywhere.

They are armored and can have enchanted weapons but they drop double loot (vanilla drops only)

 

By default, Simple Burnout Torch is a required dependency and is configured so torches placed in The Upside Down will burnout over time, this adds a level of complication along with the eternal darkness and tougher mobs.

 

If you use Reliquary, you can disable mob drops in the Reliquary config and they will be injected into the loot tables of mobs that spawn in The Upside Down.

The point of this is to give pack makers a reason to send players to The Upside Down.  Reliquary drops can be very powerful when incorporated into crafting recipes.

title: Giants of the Cretaceous
description: This project adds unique dinosaur ecosystem, as well as some equipment and vehicles crafted with dinosaur materials.
body:
![All dinosaur models](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/155b2f9ec7b101458c0d3e3ac5fe6abfc0933038_0.webp)

The modification adds dinosaurs to minecraft. However, they are not bloodthirsty monsters or fossils that you need to revive. Predators attack their prey only when they are hungry, herbivores fight back, dinosaur nests and bones can be found all over the world. Each creature has unique custom model, texture and animations. Moreover, there is plenty of equipment, and some weapons have their custom models. 

For now, the mod has no in-game documentation, so let me introduce some key features and mechanics. Also I recommend to install JEI, since there are lot of recipes, and some of them are not that obvious :)

## Dinosaurs

You can meet them always everywhere. For now, there are 11 species (not all of them are dinosaurus, however). Some of them are herbivores, which means they won't attack anyone until someone attacks them. Others are carnivores. Each minute a carnivore creature becomes hungry and kills one prey. After that, the creature's hunger is satisfied for a minute, and it becomes neutral. 

Moreover, most of the creatures has unique abilities to use when attacked. Each ability has a cooldown of 15 seconds. Finally, all the creatures are tameable and breedable. When bred, they lay eggs, except the aquatic ones. Now I'd like to present you these creatures in alphabetical order.

**When riding a creature, you can use its ability (if it has one) by pressing R. You can also attack nearby enemies by pressing B.**

### Amargasaurus

![Amargasaurus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8910e287121c260d102fdd66d5295169f45afb6f.png)

A huge herbivorous sauropod with beautiful crests. Spawns in forests and meadows. Rideable.

**Tame food:** Herbivorous Treat

**Ability:** Stomp. Breaks nearest blocks and deals a lot of damage to nearby enemies

**Drop:** Amargasaurus Spike, Dinosaur Hide & Meat

**Connected Weapon:** Amargasaurus Trident (hits all enemies in 2x2 area)

### Archelon

![Archelon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/820d6736af58c0852fad9c83f365a63b30345a48_0.webp)

A giant carnivorous aquaitc turtle. Rideable.

**Tame food:** Tropical Fish

**Ability:** no ability

**Drop:** Archelon Shell, Giant Lungs (use underwater to replenish oxygen; it slowly repairs on air)

**Connected Weapon:**: no weapon

### Deinocheirus

![Deinocheirus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f1090a4d1bfd9ff4124c77ae088fd3f003b05df1_0.webp)

Though peaceful-looking, this giant theropod is predator. Spawns in forests and meadows. Rideable.

**Tame food:** Honey Block

**Ability:** Overpower. Deals 3 rapid attacks using its giant hands

**Drop:** Deinocheirus Hand, Dinosaur Fur & Meat

**Connected Weapon:** Deinocheirus Saw (can be used both for combat and cutting trees)

### Mosasaurus

![Mosasaurus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3c3afe8b745e4d6026ab40bf4bb04f009cd4649e_0.webp)

The ultimate oceanic predator which even archelons are afraid of. Rideable.

**Tame food:** Carnivorous Treat

**Ability:** no ability

**Drop:** Mosasaurus Fin, Giant Lungs

**Connected Weapon:** no weapon

### Nanuqsaurus

![Nanuqsaurus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eb982a97e832ac5b07470aacaf3fc97a46ed2683.png)

Carnivorous theropod which lives in cold snowy biomes. Its attacks applies Polar Touch effect which slows down entities attack speed and prohibits health regeneration. Rideable.

**Tame food:** Carnivorous Treat

**Ability:** passively applies Polar Touch when attacks

**Drop:** Nanuqsaurus Claw, Dinosaur Fur & Meat

**Connected Weapon:** Nanuqsaurus Blade (applies Polar Touch on hit)

### Pachyrinosaurus

![Pachyrinosaurus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/98be785084ab7891d53ed89d2f2abc558273b389.png)

Herbivorous ceratopsian living in cold biomes. When defending, it knocks back the enemies. Rideable.

**Tame food:** Herbivorous Treat

**Ability:** passively knock backs the enemies

**Drop:** Pachyrinosaurus Wart, Horn & Collar, Dinosaur Hide & Meat

**Connected Weapon:** Pachyrinosaurus Shield (when blocking, applies Thyreophora Grace; deals damage to enemies who attack the owner), Pachyrinosaurus Maul (mines 3x3 and has extra knockback)

### Protoceratops

![Protoceratops](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd1a9542ed7fd6ab0aa983a71806b9792d7587c0.png)

Smalll herbivorous ceratopsian living in arid biomes.

**Tame food:** Herbivorous Treat

**Ability:** no ability

**Drop:** Protoceratops Collar, Dinosaur Hide & Meat

**Connected Weapon:** Protoceratops Shield (when blocking, applies Thyreophora Grace)

### Quetzalcoatlus

![Quetzalcoatlus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d661d1d72a1b60304ed4130ae573a53284d7107_0.webp)

Giant pterosaurus living in coastal areas. Carnivorous. Well, it flies, and you can take advantage of it. Rideable.

**Tame food:** Carnivorous Treat

**Ability:** Flight (hold SPACE to fly up)

**Drop:** Quetzalcoatlus Crest, Membrane & Finger

**Connected Weapon:** Quetzalcoatlus Halberd (use it to give temporary Slow Falling effect)

### Saurolophus

![Saurolophus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/25836b60f763b674228b64bcd67039bbdbbeeb85.png)

Herbivorous dinosaurus. Spawns in plains and savannas. Rideable.

**Tame food:** Herbivorous Treat

**Ability:** Trumpet. Applies Stun to nearby enemies (this effects prohibits to move and attack)

**Drop:** Saurolophus Horn (right click to use Trumpet by yourself), Dinosaur Hide & Meat

**Connected Weapon:** no weapon

### Tarbosaurus

![Tarbosaurus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2324e4f5ccf8af5a04de72578628b0db54b74977.png)

That's why you are here, right? As cool as TRex, this carnivorous theropod lives in plains and savannas. Rideable.

**Tame food:** Carnivorous Treat

**Ability:** Roar. Applies Fear to nearby enemies (this effects prohibits to move and attack)

**Drop:** Tarbosaurus Tooth, Dinosaur Hide & Meat

**Connected Weapon:** Tarbosaurus Saber (restores you 1 HP when you attack)

### Velociraptor

![Velociraptor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/242ea7376e5ae75c3cd51b27388a6006120c6d23.png)

Little predator living in arid biomes. Thet attack only in groups. They will follow their owner if it has Pack Leader effect on him.

**Tame food:** Insect Abdomen (drops from Silverfish and Bee)

**Ability:** no ability

**Drop:** Feather, Velociraptor Claw

**Connected Weapon:** Velociraptor Dagger (both melee and range weapon)

## Materials

All the dinosaur materials are mentioned above. However, let me also show the recipes of dinosaur treats which are used to tame most of them.

![Treat Recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/589867ec177b2df7ad49f34377616e8c81698f09.png)

## Weapons

Basically, I have already mentioned all the combat stuff, so let me just provide all the recipes here. Tooltips and in-game documentation will be released in the nearest future!

![Weapon Recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/05d2efec48112d019bf2577d996c8047e628e829_0.webp)

## Armor

You can craft Feather Armor using feathers and then upgrade it to Fur Armor, or you can upgrade Leather Armor to Hide Armor and then to Shell Armor. Each armor has its unique buff which is activated when you press V. To purge the buff, press V again. Read more about buffs in the next section. Let me also show the recipes.)

![Armor Recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b458a70fd86e7b8b8ce0257221d845c24e3ca91a_0.webp)

## Effects

As you might have guessed, there are some custom buffs and debuffs in the mod:

* Pack Leader. Applied when you eat Insect Abdomen or use the ability of Feather Armor. Increases you movespeed & jump height and make all your tamed velociraptors follow and protect you.
* Fear & Stun. Applied by Tarbosaurus, Saurolophus and by using Saurolophus Horn. They basically are the same and just have different icons. They prohibit you to move and attack.
* Polar Touch. Applied by Nanuqsaurus and Nanuqsaurus Blade. Decreases target entity's attack speed and doesn't allow to regenerate health even if you hunger is full.
* Thyreophora Grace. Applied when you block damage with Protoceratops or Pachyrinosaurus Shield. Gives you extra attack knockback.
* Cretaceous Grace. Applied when you use the ability of Hide & Shell Armor. Increases your maximum health, armor and attack damage, but decreases your movement and attack speed.
* Winter Grace. Applied when you use the ability of Fur Armor. Gives you extra movement & mining speed when you are in a cold biome.
* Underwater Grace. Applied when you use the ability of Shell Armor. Increases your swimming speed and gives you infinite oxygen.

## Vehicles

There are two vehicles in the mod:

* Shell Submarine. Well, it swims fast and looks good.

![Submarine](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1bbb655107319412352518b9352cbda140369f2.png)

* Quetzalcoatlus Airship. When you ride it, press SPACE to speed up and move towards your eyes direction.

![Airship](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4daea054491fd5e9cf7892c6cd9cbcfffd4a121a.png)

Crafts of these vehicles are presented below.

![Vehicle recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d9c12962cbb16992d93d6eaa9a09571c60701d02.png)

## Outlook

I am planning both minor and major updates for the mod. 

Minors:
* in-game documentation;
* different dinosaur textures.

Majors:
* new dinosaur species;
* new villager profession and related structure (a lab or something like that);
* an option to make dinosaur hybrids (probably, hybrid dragons, but I can't tell exactly for now).

Hope you will enjoy the mod!

title: Admin Abuse
description: small Paper/Spigot plugin that lets admins send loud, colorful global announcements and meme-style “ADMIN ABUSE” alerts with both chat messages and titles. It supports legacy & color codes and hex colors, includes a countdown command to hype events, and is
body:
# This plugin will not recieve anymore updates for a longwhile. Due to me being very busy in real life and having a job.
Admin-Abuse is a lightweight Paper/Spigot broadcast plugin focused on flashy “admin abuse” style announcements with full color support.​

Features
Simple commands for global announcements, including a dedicated “Admin Abuse” countdown that hypes up events before they start.​

Supports legacy color codes (&a, &b, &l, etc.) and modern hex colors (like #ff00ff) in both chat and titles for highly customized messages.​​
-# it should also support minimessage format (i think)

Sends synchronized chat broadcasts and on-screen titles to all online players, making sure no one misses important messages.​

Commands

`/broadcast <message>` – Sends a formatted global announcement with full color support.​

`/adminabuse <message>` – Instantly blasts an “ADMIN ABUSE” style alert to everyone.​

`/adminabusestart <message>` – Starts a short countdown (3…2…1…) and then triggers an “ADMIN ABUSE” broadcast.

`/chunkban <player>` Bans someone from the chunk.

`/chunkunban <player>` Unbans someone from the chunk.​​

Permissions
`eee.broadcast` – Allows use of `/broadcast`.​

`eee.adminabuse` – Allows use of `/adminabuse` and `/adminabusestart`.

`eee.chunkban` - Alows use of `/chunkban`.

`eee.chunkunban` - Alows use of `/chunkun~~~~ban`.​

Compatibility
Server: Spigot / Paper

Minecraft: 1.21+ (built and tested on modern Paper/Spigot APIs).​

Ideal for SMPs, event servers, and admin meme moments where you want announcements to look loud, colorful, and impossible to ignore.​

title: [World Generator/Challenge] Start In The Nether!
description: Reverse the gameplay! Spice it up by starting in the nether!
body:
# Introduction:
I'm sure many of you have thought about it: What if we started in the Nether? What if we had to escape to the real world to get resources and survive? Swap the nether with the overworld! Would it be possible? The answer is: yes. Many of us thought about this idea and some of us pulled this through. Some with considerably better results than other but yeah, most of them didn’t really succeed without the usage of either light or heavy mods. Data packs are delicate things. They all depend on the game itself, on the current version of Minecraft. In contrast to mods, either fabric or forge data packs cannot actually add new blocks, items or content to the game because they’re limited to use vanilla assets only… BUT that doesn’t mean a creative mind cannot create something new! Minecraft is HUGE, yes. That is not a question. If you use your mind well enough and the devs AND the game wishes you to succeed you can create new things with data packs for sure. So far this is the only working data pack for 1.18 that I found to be working and does what it is supposed to do. Swap the nether with the overworld safely, thus the player will start in the nether.

# Features:
Nothing much. Really. The nether and overworld dimensions are swapped.
You need to survive. Starting in the nether without any resources to help you survive is a hard job. VERY hard. I’ve done it countless times so I do know that… Good luck!

# Addendum:
There are quite a few data packs for 1.18 that should do the same as this pack. Only that they're outdated and falsely marked to work with 1.18. Most of these wasn't even updated for half a year, deprecated and neglected or was released while 1.18 wasn't released. I've tested the following data packs those do not work at all or are very buggy:

- StuleBackery's Start In The Nether Pack
- Cosmoguy's Nether Escape - Minigame/challenge (It's different kind of data pack but it does work in fact. Just installation is different.)
- paczek654321's nether start
- Yoyousss' Minecraft, But The Dimensions Are Switched...﻿

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/2VIHJRJ1iFY" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

**This data pack is designed for the Origins mod. For the best experience, it is highly recommended to also use Pehkui and Mob Origins, though the data pack should still somewhat function without them.**

[This Origin was suggested by **Nerro** on Discord aka **Lord_Nerro** on Minecraft. If you would like to suggest your own data pack, you can do so over on my Discord server as well.](https://discord.gg/b8jJUQ29Wg)

**Pantoslime:** A rare and unsettling mutation of the common slime, the Pantoslime is a creature of deception. Its oozing form bends with unnatural precision, twisting into familiar shapes to ensnare the unwary. Where its lesser kin mindlessly absorb what they touch, the Pantoslime lures prey into false security, wearing the guise of chests, barrels, and furnaces with chilling accuracy.

**Impact:** 🔴🔴🔴

**🟩 Corrosive Lance [Primary + Guiseless]:** Your body lurches forward, launching a razor-sharp lance of hardened slime. It pierces flesh with a sickening squelch, dealing 3 full hearts of damage and leaving behind a festering wound that melts armor and flesh.

**🟩 Oozing Mimicry [Secondary]:** Fix your gaze upon an interactable object and feel your form ripple, stretch, and collapse into perfect replication. A chest? A furnace? No. A trap. Each stolen guise grants its own slimy advantage. Shift again, and the disguise dissolves back into slime.

**🟩 Cloak in Stillness [Sneak]:** When wearing a stolen shape, you may still yourself entirely, sinking into the world’s grid like a shadow slipping between cracks. Only the keenest eyes will sense the wrongness in your stillness.

**🟢 Bouncy Biology:** Impact holds no terror for you. You descend from great heights only to rebound, your gelatinous form laughing at the earth’s pull. The ground may shatter, but you will not.

**🟢 Tool Engulfment:** Your acidic essence seeps into whatever you hold, dripping with venom. Swords poison, pickaxes corrode stone faster, and every strike leaves behind a lingering rot.

**🟡 Carnivorous Sludge:** Only flesh sustains you. Rotten or fresh, it matters not, for your stomach devours all toxins, leaving you immune to the sicknesses that plague lesser beings.

**🟡 Caustic Presence:** Your very touch is decay. Tools and armor degrade faster in your grasp, eaten away by your corrosive slime. But those who strike you suffer the same fate, their blades dull, their shields crack, all things crumbling in the face of your corrosive essence.

**🟡 Compact Ooze:** You are but a single block in stature; a small, squirming thing. Yet within that frame lies a predator’s patience.

**🟡 Gelid Congregation:** Your kindred call to you. When near lesser slimes, your wounds slowly knit shut with quiet squelches. When another Pantoslime lingers close, the healing is swift, their fellowship mending your gooey flesh.

**🟡 Viscous Movement:** The ground clings to you like tar, dragging at your every step. But leap, and you are free, bounding with unnatural speed.

**🔴 Fractured Guise:** Pain unravels you. When brought below four hearts, your disguise collapses, leaving only a quivering, vulnerable mass of slime.

**🔴 Gelid Flesh:** Your body, though having incredible properties, is fragile. Two hearts fewer than the average mortal possesses, a price for your malleable deceit.

**🔴 Unwelcome Deceit:** No villager will barter with a creature that wears lies like skin. To them, you are not a customer, you are a predator hiding in plain sight.

**🔴 Viscous Fatigue:** Your form strains under repeated manipulation. The use of abilities temporarily liquefies parts of your mass. These compromised sections remain inert, unable to be reshaped, until they slowly ooze back into cohesion.

**🟪 Hide Block Displays [Secondary + Sneak]:** An out of lore ability for the player's benefit. Toggles the rendering of all block displays. Useful in hiding some block displays that cover the screen. Other players will still see the block displays. The Pantoslime itself is unaware of any of this.

<details>
<summary>Stolen Guises</summary>

# Artisan's Guise
**Mimicked Blocks:** Cartography Table, Crafting Table, Fletching Table, Loom, and Stonecutter.

**🟩 Internal Workshop [Primary]:** Your gelatinous body swirls and churns, forming a perfect crafting table grid within your translucent core.

**🟢 Mender’s Respite:** Every foe felled mends your tools and armor as if their fading essence weaves itself into your gear, stitching fractures and smoothing dents.

**🔴 Creator’s Burden:** This guise lacks the focused force for efficient demolition. Every block resists your efforts, breaking apart 25% slower than normal.

# Gulper Guise
**Mimicked Blocks:** Barrel, Chest, Ender Chest, Shulker Box, and Trapped Chest.

**🟩 False Maw [Primary]:** Your gelatinous body splits open, revealing a yawning cavity ready to snatch and store. Items placed inside remain in your viscous form when you shift shapes, but only by resuming this hollow guise can you retrieve them.

**🟢 Voracious Pull:** Your slime trembles with unnatural hunger, exerting a faint gravitational pull on loose objects. Trinkets and treasures alike slide helplessly toward your form.

**🔴 Burdened Ooze:** Your expanded carrying capacity weighs down your gelatinous form, reducing mobility by 25%. You ooze forward with visible effort.

# Ironhide Guise
**Mimicked Blocks:** Anvil, Chipped Anvil, Damaged Anvil, Grindstone, and Smithing Table.

**🟩 Gelid Fortification [Primary]:** Your gelatinous body hardens into a dense, rubbery mass. No attack can pierce you, but you cannot move or strike back until the effect passes.

**🟢 Reinforced Ooze:** Your slimy hide grows unnaturally dense, adding 6 points of armor. Weapons struggle to penetrate your reinforced goo.

**🟡 Seismic Splat:** Every landing from a jump sends ripples into the earth, dealing minor damage to nearby creatures as your heavy body slams down with crushing force.

**🔴 Leaden Sludge:** Your gelatinous form sags with unnatural density. You ooze forward at a crawl, all mobility reduced by 25% under your weight.

# Jester's Guise
**Mimicked Blocks:** Jukebox and Note Block.

**🟩 Center Stage [Primary]:** You burst into a dazzling performance, commanding all eyes upon you. Nearby creatures freeze, utterly mesmerized, caught in the spotlight of your spectacle.

**🟢 Jester’s Grace:** Your movements become a blur of practiced elegance, dashing 50% faster and leaping 50% higher as if the very air cheers your every step.

**🔴 Marked Fool:** Villagers see through your act. Their whispers turn to shouts, and before you can bow, iron golems already march toward you, fists raised against the trickster in their midst.

# Scorching Guise
**Mimicked Blocks:** Blast Furnace, Campfire, Furnace, Smoker, and Soul Campfire.

**🟩 Pyroclastic Surge [Primary]:** Your core flares with intense heat, emitting a blistering heatwave. Nearby creatures burst into flames as superheated slime spatter scalds them for 3 full hearts of damage.

**🟢 Molten Core:** This guise renders you completely unaffected by extreme heat. Flames lick harmlessly across your surface, and lava flows around you like warm syrup.

**🔴 Hydrolysis:** Water triggers a dangerous chemical reaction in your heated form. Rain sizzles painfully on contact, and immersion deals continuous damage as your unstable structure begins dissolving.

# Verdant Guise
**Mimicked Blocks:** Beehive, Bee Nest, and Composter.

**🟩 Verdant Surge [Primary]:** Your gelatinous form pulses with energy, causing nearby plants to shudder and rapidly grow.

**🟢 Photosynthetic Ooze:** Bathed in sunlight, your translucent body thrums with vitality. Your wounds seal as chloroplasts within your goo convert light into regenerative energy.

**🔴 Light-Starved Sludge:** While out of the sun’s reach, your movement speed is reduced by 50%, as your plant-infused slime congeals into sluggish, inert goo.

# Voltaic Guise
**Mimicked Blocks:** Dispenser, Dropper, and Hopper.

**🟩 Energy Discharge [Primary]:** Your core crackles with unstable power before releasing a concentrated bolt of raw energy towards your target, dealing 4 hearts of damage and leaving victims twitching.

**🟢 Overcharged:** Energy courses through your form, supercharging your movements. You zip across terrain 50% faster and launch yourself 50% higher with each jump.

**🔴 Storm Magnet:** During thunderstorms, ominous rumbles precede inevitable lightning strikes that seek out your conductive form with terrifying accuracy.

# Warlock's Guise
**Mimicked Blocks:** Beacon, Brewing Stand, Cauldron, Chiseled Bookshelf, Enchanting Table, and Lectern.

**🟩 Viscous Hex [Primary]:** You secrete a tar-like curse onto your target. Their limbs grow heavy as your malignant slime infiltrates their being, slowing their movements to a crawl while your acidic magic eats away at them from within.

**🟢 Arcane Ooze:** Magical energies supercharge you, movements become 25% quicker, your jumps 25% higher, and your attacks 25% deadlier as magic thrums through you.

**🔴 Arcane Fragility:** Your magic-infused guise reacts violently to spells. Every arcane strike burns through your gelatinous body with 50% greater effect, as if your own attunement betrays you.

</details>

[If you have any questions, concerns, or bugs you would like to report, my Discord server is a great place for doing so.](https://discord.gg/b8jJUQ29Wg)

# Dormant Sigil
**Dormant Sigil** is a lightweight add-on that introduces a revival mechanic for Hardcore multiplayer worlds. Using a special item: the **Dormant Sigil**, players can resurrect fallen allies and bring them back from permanent death.

## Features
- Adds a custom item, the **Dormant Sigil**, which;
- Revives other dead players in Hardcore mode
- Has a fair recipe which introduces new uses to existing vanilla items
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b89b8ee57c789ef5e1e934d55b3f2ff2cdb753b0.png)

## Ideal For
- Hardcore SMPs that want a touch of forgiveness
- Servers where permadeath feels a little too permanent

## Installation
- Data Pack
  - Drop the datapack in your world’s `datapacks` folder
- Fabric / Quilt / Forge / NeoForge
  - Drop the .jar file in the `%appdata%/.minecraft/mods` folder

## Not Compatible With
- Datapacks or modifications that unlock recipes in any way

title: OFF: All Of Era
description: A fully progression-based modpack that spans every era — from primitive survival and ancient magic to medieval kingdoms, industrial technology, and futuristic space exploration. Build, evolve, conquer, and shape history through the ages.
body:
![newbanner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5079fa4bca2e26be6c06b0a80628db98c874c0ec.png)

## **⛰️ The Primordial Shatter and the Cycle of Ages**

In the beginning, there was only the Void—no stars, no stone, no fire, no soul. From its silent depths emerged three primordial beings: Mother Earth, the Fire-Breather, and the Time Weaver. Together, they shaped the world. Mother Earth molded the first mountains and valleys, the Fire-Breather exhaled the sun and molten rivers, and the Time Weaver forged the first hourglass to guide the flow of eras.

## **The Age of Stone – The Awakening**

In the first era, the world was young and untamed. Towering cliffs and boundless forests ruled the land. The first humans and the first monsters walked side by side. Fire was newly discovered, and tools were carved from rough stone. In those days, spirits spoke in whispers and guided the living.

## **Rise of the Ancients**

As the sands of the hourglass fell into the second age, humans began shaping knowledge rather than stone. They built monumental structures and carved runes into the earth. Golem-kin, descendants of Mother Earth’s power, and ancient deep-dwelling creatures awakened. The first secrets of fire and magic were uncovered.

## **The Age of Iron and Blades**

The third era was an age of kingdoms and conquest. Iron spoke louder than words. Empires rose; armies marched. Dragons ruled the skies, and sorcerers guarded forgotten truths. Cities were fortified with high walls, and the mountains were pierced by mines. The Fire-Breather’s breath could still be felt in the heavens.

## **Steam, Gears, and Smoke**

As time advanced, magic and metal intertwined, heralding the fourth age. Steam-powered machines, early automatons, and mechanical citadels were forged. An uneasy alliance formed between mages and craftsmen. The whispers of nature slowly drowned beneath the clatter of gears.

## **Between Shadow and Steel**

In the fifth era, the sky dimmed under towering cities. Humanity reached upward with steel and knowledge. Science sought to replace sorcery, yet the old spirits never fully slept. The descendants of the golems merged with machines, and ancient ruins slumbered beneath the earth, waiting.

## **The Starsong Era**

In the final age, the world was no longer enough. The last grains fell from the Time Weaver's hourglass, opening pathways among the stars. Dimensional gates, astral vessels, and cosmic entities emerged. Yet the voice of Mother Earth still echoed:
“When the world ends, the ages begin anew.”

## **The Cycle Closes, Then Starts Again**

Legend says every age rises from the ashes of the last. Some civilizations reach the stars; others fall back to stone and flame. But whoever shatters the cycle or forges a new one is named The Fatecarver, etched into the Time Weaver's eternal tome.

**_Perhaps that one… is you._**

title: Looper
description: A simple plugin to loop commands
body:
# Looper
This is a simple plugin that does simple things. It allows you to loop commands using a command.

To get started, make sure you have the `looper.use` permission. From there, run the command `/loop <iterations> <period> <command>`.
 An example might look like `/loop 10 20 say Hi! I sent this message 10 times with a 20 tick delay between them!`
 To cancel a loop use the `/cancelloop [player]` command! Note: If you supply a player's name, you need to have the `looper.cancel` permission. Players can cancel their own loops without it. It is assumed to cancel one's own loops if no player name is specified.

 To cancel every loop, use the `cancelallloops` command. (It requires the `looper.cancel.all` permission)

I got inspiration from [this](https://youtu.be/y1vtO4q4rtE) Minikloon Video.

title: NoHeartShaking
description: Stop your hearts from shaking at low HP!
body:
# NoHeartShaking

> **Stop your hearts from shaking at low HP!**

A minimalistic client-side mod that disables the heart "shaking" animation when the player's health is **2 hearts or less**.
Perfect for **custom maps**, **modpacks**, or **challenge runs** like a 1-heart survival where that constant jitter becomes more annoying than helpful.

![Hearts before installing the mod](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RaydanOMGr/NoHeartShaking/refs/heads/screenshots/Before-NoHeartShake.webp)
![Hearts after installing the mod](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RaydanOMGr/NoHeartShaking/refs/heads/screenshots/After-NoHeartShake.webp)

## Why does this mod exist?

The vanilla heart shaking effect is meant to indicate low health, but in curated experiences, like challenge maps or minimal UIs it can be distracting or even immersion-breaking. This mod stops that animation completely, making it ideal for:

* Hardcore challenge modpacks
* Minimal HUD setups
* Custom maps with persistent low-health scenarios

## Requirements

* **Minecraft:** 1.21.5 (tested), may work on other versions, try it out!
* **Loader:** [Fabric](https://fabricmc.net/use/) or [Quilt](https://quiltmc.org/)
* **Java:** 21 or newer

## Need Support?

If you have questions, ideas, or bugs to report, come hang out in the [Discord server](https://discord.com/invite/3vfnvBFRKv).

## Source & License

* [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/RaydanOMGr/NoHeartShaking)
* License: **[MIT](https://opensource.org/license/mit/)**

title: Bedrock Redux
description: A minecraft mod that ports some features from Bedrock edition to Java edition.
body:
Do you envy the features of Bedrock Edition? Do you feel like playing Java Edition with those features? Try this mod!

If you haven't played Minecraft Bedrock Edition, let me introduce those features:

## Generations of Water Creatures

Fishes, squids and other water creatures can now spawn in bubble column blocks and flowing water blocks, and the Y-axis coordinate is not limited below 64.

## Bartering

When breaking a block guarded by piglins (such as gold block, nether gold ore), piglins admiring gold ingot will immediately toss the result item and finish the barter, which makes it possible for players to make bartering farm and gain a lot loots in a short period of time from piglins.

## Trident Killer

In Bedrock Edition, thrown tridents will cause damage when they are pushed by pistons, while they won't in Java Edition. But now this feature is ported to Java Edition, so you can make a trident killer with this mod.

title: Hitboxes+
description: added improved hitboxes
body:
This is Hitboxes+

It is ment to improve how hitboxes work and affect gameplay.

Note: These hitboxes **WILL NOT** show using F3+B

There are 4 types of hitboxes:

- Kinetic Hitbox: These hitboxes are hitboxes that only fireworks can toggle & collide with.

- Projectile Hitbox: Only projectiles can trigger this hitbox

- Explosion Hitbox: Only explosions toggle this hitbox

- Bounding Box: This the regular vanilla hitbox

Bad Mod is a testament to how not to design a Minecraft mod. It brings a variety of unwelcome changes that make the game almost unplayable:

Excessive Mobs: The mod randomly increases the spawn rates of hostile mobs to ridiculous levels, making survival nearly impossible. Players find themselves constantly overwhelmed by hordes of alexas, Greeds and greets.
Unbalanced Mechanics: Bad Mod introduces new mechanics that are poorly thought out and unbalanced. For instance, it adds overpowered weapons and armor that break the game’s progression, while also introducing pointless and detrimental items that clutter the inventory.
Performance Issues: Due to the excessive number of entities and poorly optimized code, the mod causes significant lag and performance issues, making the game stutter and freeze frequently.
Numerous Bugs: Bad Mod is riddled with bugs, including frequent crashes. These bugs make the game frustrating and often unplayable.
Lack of Coherent Theme: The mod seems to lack any coherent theme or vision. It randomly adds various elements without any consideration for balance, cohesion, or the overall player experience.
Annoying Features: The mod includes features that are more annoying than fun, such as random explosions, constant rain, and items that troll the player by exploding when picked up.
Overall, Bad Mod is a prime example of a mod that detracts from the core enjoyment of Minecraft, turning it into a chaotic and frustrating experience without offering any meaningful enhancements or fun features. 💀️

# C&C: Sculk ## Sculk Sensors and more!

##### This mod is a concept and doesn't have any crafting recipes or block drops. It cannot be used in vanilla survival. All blocks are available in the vanilla item tabs. ### Features: #### - HIGHLIGHT FEATURE: Sculk Sensors! Sculk sensors are blocks from the 1.17 update, shown at Minecraft Live 2020, that can detect vibrations and movement. They can sense footsteps, block placing, and projectiles!

According to the Minecraft Developers, sculk sensors don't react to *sounds*, they react to predetermined vibration "triggers". That is the way they work in this mod.

Currently, sculk sensors don't react to every kind of vibration. If they aren't sensing something you think they should be sensing, leave an issue on GitHub!

#### - Sculk Blocks! This mod introduces 3 types of sculk themed blocks shown during Minecraft Live 2020. They include Sculk Growths, Sculk Growth Blocks, and Sculk Sources.

Sculk sources will *very* slowly spread sculk growth blocks around them onto stone. #### - Slate! Slate's name has not been confirmed, and it may not even be likely it will generate in the Deep Dark with sculk blocks in 1.17. However, it was shown in the demo of the Warden (which is not included in this mod) along with the sculk blocks and candles, so it has been included in this mod. #### - Candles! Candles are customizable light sources that come in all dye colors, and they can be placed in different amounts to give off different light levels. Their placement works like sea pickles or turtle eggs.

- 💔 **Divorce system**

  - All messages configurable via config files.

- `/marry <player>` – send a marriage proposal.
- `/marry accept <player>` – accept a proposal.
- `/marry deny <player>` – deny a proposal.
- `/marry divorce` – request divorce confirmation.
- `/marry divorce confirm` – confirm divorce.
- `/marry info` – show all available commands.

description: Automatically places torches in dark areas to prevent mob spawning. Preview scan, survival inventory support, and grid-based placement for efficiency.
body:
# LightUp

  Automatically places torches in dark areas within a radius around the player to prevent mob spawning. Uses an efficient grid-based placement system.

  ## Commands

  | Command | Description |
  |---------|-------------|
  | `/lightup` | Preview with default radius (64 blocks) |
  | `/lightup <radius>` | Preview with custom radius (8-128 blocks) |
  | `/lightup stop` | Stop the current task |
  | `/lightup help` | Show all commands |

  ## Features

  ### Preview System
  Before placing any torches, the mod scans the area and shows:
  - **Torches needed** with stack breakdown (e.g., "3840 (60 stacks)")
  - **Inventory comparison** (survival mode)
  - **Crafting materials** if you're short on torches
  - Click **[START]** to begin or do nothing to cancel

  ### Game Modes

  | Mode | Who | Behavior |
  |------|-----|----------|
  | **OP Mode** | Players with permission level 2+ | Unlimited torches |
  | **Survival Mode** | Regular players | Uses torches from inventory |

  ### How It Works
  1. Creates a grid of positions every 12 blocks apart (torch light reaches 14 blocks, ensuring overlap)
  2. Places ONE torch per tick to avoid server lag (~10 torches/second)
  3. After grid completion, does a cleanup scan for any missed dark spots
  4. Progress updates every 50 torches

  ### Torch Placement Validation
  A position is valid if:
  - Position is air
  - Block above is air (prevents underwater placement)
  - Block below is solid
  - Block light level is 0 (actually dark)

  ## Technical Details
  - **Minecraft:** 1.21.11
  - **Mod Loader:** Fabric
  - **Dependencies:** Fabric API
  - **Source:** [GitHub](https://github.com/manchesterjm/Area_Light_Up_Minecraft_mod)

title: CheckYourMods
description: Security tool for NeoForge 1.21.1. Smart Xray resource pack detection via metadata. Client mod verification against server whitelist.
body:
# CheckYourMods 🛡️

**CheckYourMods** is an advanced security and transparency tool for **Minecraft 1.21.1 (NeoForge)** designed for server administrators. Specifically designed for friends' servers to ensure that no one is downloading suspicious mods that aren't necessary to play or cheating. It ensures a fair play environment by monitoring client-side modifications and resource packs.

## ✨ Key Features

* **Smart Mod Verification**: Automatically compares player mods against the server's mod list and ignores matches.
* **Intelligent Resource Pack Scan**: Detects suspicious keywords like "xray", "vision", or "transparent" within the pack's internal metadata (`pack.mcmeta`).
* **SHA-256 Fingerprinting**: Allows manual tracking of specific resource packs using their unique digital hash.
* **Transparency for Players**: Includes public commands so players can verify what is being monitored, ensuring the staff is not hiding anything.
* **Persistent Logging**: All connection data, detected mods, and suspicious packs are recorded in `logs/checkyourmods-log.txt`.

## 🛠️ Configuration

The mod generates a configuration file in `serverconfig/checkyourmods-server.toml` with intuitive instructions:

1.  **`allowed_mod_ids`**: Add IDs for client-side utility mods (e.g., `optifine`, `sodium`, `voicechat`) so they are not announced as extra mods.
2.  **`manual_xray_hashes`**: Add specific SHA-256 hashes for malicious packs that might bypass the keyword scanner.

## 💻 Commands

* `/modcheck list`: Shows the list of allowed mod IDs to all players.
* `/modcheck packs`: Shows the list of manually watched resource pack hashes.

The Hardcore plus is built to provide the most stable, consistent, and reliable foundation for Hardcore play — without artificially increasing difficulty or altering core survival mechanics. Instead of making the game harder, the goal is to make every Hardcore world as smooth, fair, and technically robust as possible.

This pack focuses on performance, world consistency, bug reduction, and gameplay clarity. By combining well-researched technical, optimization, and stability-oriented mods, it ensures that every Hardcore run is defined by your decisions — not by lag spikes, world hiccups, or unpredictable technical issues.

Hardcore plus is intentionally minimalistic. There are no gameplay overhauls, no difficulty boosters, and no intrusive features that alter the vanilla balance. You’re free to add whatever quality-of-life, visual, or personal mods you prefer — the pack exists purely as a clean, reliable backbone for long-term Hardcore survival.

Its lightweight structure makes updates fast and easy. Performance improvements, stability patches, and compatibility fixes can be applied rapidly, ensuring the pack stays relevant across new Minecraft versions with minimal delay.

Derivative Packs

title: Mines
description: Automatically regenerate mining zones with teleport safety.
body:
[![AshCraft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a75887d69106ed9eb2dd595176121f279523f184_0.webp)](https://www.ashcraft.cz/)

Mines is a utility plugin designed for servers that use regenerating mining areas. It allows administrators to define rectangular zones in any world that automatically refill with a specific block type on a timer. Players inside these zones during regeneration are safely teleported to a predefined location, preventing suffocation or block-trapping issues.

Zones are fully customizable in config.yml and can include:

World and coordinates of two opposite corners to define the zone.

Block type the zone should regenerate with (e.g., DIAMOND_ORE, NETHERRACK, etc.).

Teleport location where players are sent when the mine resets.

By default, all defined zones regenerate every 15 minutes, but this interval can be adjusted in the code if needed.

Additional features:

Multiple zones support – configure as many as you need.

Automatic regeneration without server restarts.

Safe player teleportation out of the mine before blocks reset.

/reloadMines command (with permission minesplugin.reload) to reload configuration without restarting the server.

Integrated metrics and donation message.

Perfect for prison servers, resource worlds, or survival servers that want to maintain renewable mining areas without manual resets.

Illusioners adds functionality to the Illusioner, the unused Illager mob!

You can download the plugin version for PaperMC servers [here](https://modrinth.com/plugin/illusioners), which is only required on the server.

To find and kill the real illusioner, you must first attack one of its illusions. Upon destroying an illusion, a trail of particles appears leading towards the invisible, real illusioner. Attack in the area the particles lead to, to kill the illusioner.
