When popping an illusion, popping all illusions and hitting an illusioner without popping any illusions, you get custom advancements!

title: Magic Wands
description: A mod that adds magic wands and spells that allow unique and destructive combinations!
body:
# Magic Wands

This mod adds magic wands and spells! The spells can be put in sequences to create unique combinations and powerful wands. There are destructive and utility spells and wands can be used for many purposes

## Features

### Blocks
- **Wand Editor**: Allows adding a spell to a wand.
  - Make sure the wand has enough capacity and the spell tier is not higher than the wand tier!
  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fa64ff35-83ad-4e55-8133-448bd83a1671)
  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cd36ce45-a684-4c0c-afd0-f936b8b82f2a)

- **Magic Nullifier**: Magic is forbidden!
  - Attempting to cast a wand near it will strike the player with a lightning bolt and force the wand to be dropped.
  - Any nearby wand with spells will be struck by lightning and the spells will be removed and dropped to the ground
    
   ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a122d51b-e622-4c24-93dd-3ecfbfbf5aed)

- **Magic Ore**: Some magic dust is hidden in this ore, ready to be used! Find it between y=32 and y=-64


### Items
- **Magic Wand**: The main item!
  - There are 3 tiers: Basic, Powerful, Ultimate
  - Each tier has lower base cooldown, recharge time and more spell capacity than the previous
    
   ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0a54493b-a46d-47b6-bcff-29b2cc60b401)
   ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8452b6a4-5015-41ad-9a25-cec13c3f90d4)
   ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/08851803-ccb9-4d9a-a590-fc304c70d51c)
  
- **Magic Dust**: Dust infused with magical properties! Used to craft spells, wands and more
- **Concentrated Magic Dust**: Dust with higher magical potential! Used to craft high-tier spells and wands
  
  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6c565cac-ba55-4d53-8960-235e4e7be9e1)
- **Magic Essence**: Pure magic that is ready to be used to harness all magic! Used to craft an ultimate magic wand
  
  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bb8f0b3f-902a-474f-becf-323eff96a9c7)


### Cast Mechanics
- When a wand is used it casts the next spell (which is highlighted with purple in the inventory tooltip)
- Then, it cools down for a base delay (of the wand) plus the cast delay of the spell
- After casting all spells it will recharge for the maximum of the wand recharge time and the cooldown
- Some spells may alter the casting order and these rules

### Spells
- **Fireball Spell** (Tier 1): Creates a fireball than explodes and sets blocks on fire. Power scales with wand tier
  
  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cb00ada3-9d0d-428f-bd7e-d35f6436c754)
- **Exploding Arrow Spell** (Tier 1): Shoots an arrow that explodes on impact. Power scales with wand tier
  
  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ab376466-fcbc-4565-b3ab-96175b0500fc)
- **Reduce Recharge Spell** (Tier 1): Reduces the recharge time by 7 ticks. Can stack

  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0c9f444b-217c-4b22-8c72-b0b9778807eb)
- **Random Potion Spell** (Tier 1): Throws a random splash potion

  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f8abf159-11b8-4292-b943-0d1124d370a7)
- **Continue Spell** (Tier 1): After the previous spell is cast, the next spell is cast immediately. The total cooldown is the sum of the spell cooldowns

  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/582d7a70-0ea1-4a83-ad1a-1d19cc07243c)
- **Teleport Spell** (Tier 2): Teleports the player to block pointed by the mouse if it is within 5 times the interaction range. Otherwise, it teleports the player 5 blocks ahead

  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/49b01d24-69cc-4bd7-9fb4-5f9a66e9af4e)
- **Cast All Spell** (Tier 2): Casts all spells in wand, waiting for the cooldown between them. If a continue spell is found, casting stops after it finishes

  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/329a9f7e-4f33-4ba2-b6da-2a7b49df7344)
- **No Cooldown Spell** (Tier 3): Removes all cooldown for the remaining spells. Recharge time is unaffected

  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/30aba32b-89c2-4b1a-88d9-50cce22dc71d)
- **Lightning Bolt Spell** (Tier 3): Casts a lightning bolt at the block pointed by the mouse if it is within 15 times the interaction range. Otherwise, it casts it 5 blocks from the player

  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fec5c88d-55a0-4ec7-879d-f02d4aa9b054)

title: Toggleable Keep Inventory
description: A simple Minecraft plugin that allows for users to toggle their own keepInventory preferences.
body:
# Toggleable Keep Inventory 

A simple Minecraft plugin that allows for users to toggle their own keepInventory preferences.

More specifically, this plugin allows users to use `/keepinv` to decide if they want to keep their inventory on death or not.

## Features
- Small and lightweight
- Doesn't store any files
- No configuration required
- Integrates with permission systems
- Uses `/gamerule keepInventory` for the world as a default if user does not use `/keepinv`

## Notes
- This supports Bukkit/Spigot/Paper 1.18.2+. Support for other servers types is unlikely.
- The one permission this mod has is `togglekeepinv.command`.

# Highway Robbery | v1.0.0
Minecraft's version 1.21 experimental data pack enables players to craft copper doors and trapdoors, but at an absurdly
expensive price. This data pack modifies those recipes to mirror the cost of crafting iron doors and trapdoors. It still
allows copper blocks in the various oxidized states to be used to make their respective versions of the doors, but the
output has been increased to match the new recipes.

This pack must be loaded after the Update 1.21 data pack or else the recipes will not be properly replaced. This is also
true for players using Misode's [Update 1.21 without trial chambers](https://modrinth.com/datapack/no-trial-chambers) pack. You can do this by moving it above those
packs when creating a new world. If you want to use a data pack loader mod, I recommend [Paxi](https://modrinth.com/mod/paxi), as it allows you to
specify the order in which packs should load using a config.

title: Potato's Potater Bombs
description: A new take on Minecraft's throwable explosives featuring a vegetable.
body:
# Potato's Potater Bombs
Potato's Potater Bombs is a Datapack with a new take on the so often used throwable bombs in mods. Potater Bombs goal is to be as user friendly as possible for the average player, well still providing depth for players who wish to make use of the more advanced features.

![Potater Example Image](https://cdn-raw.modrinth.com/data/B4mMG9LU/images/ecdda2dc748ad9d0e724aa57d87b43e7572f4327.gif)

*This Datapack has no resource pack!*
## Potater Basics
Potater Bombs are easy to make with a few simple steps

- First make a **Potater Station** by throwing a potato on an empty barrel anywhere in the world.
- Then open the **Potater Station**, you should see something that looks like this:
![Potater GUI](https://cdn-raw.modrinth.com/data/B4mMG9LU/images/7b146f6cf4e01f5604d192ebcdf7b6468fa1e164.png)
- In order to make your first Potater you are going to need gunpowder and normal potatoes. Then put them above their indicated slots.
- Once that is complete you should see the grayscale Potater then gain color, you can take that out and claim your Potater Bomb.

### Using Potaters

Using a Potater Bomb is as simple as holding it and left clicking! Notice it loses durability in it's description whenever it gets used.

> **Potater Bombs do not destroy blocks, TNT still needs to have a purpose and this makes sure it does.**

## Modifying

During the Potater creation process you can modify the end result by using certain items or increasing the quantity of the base ingredients.

Increasing the quantity of the basic ingredients gives your Potater more durability! Potatoes increase the durability of a Potater at a rate of 1x, while Gunpowder increases it at a rate of 1.5x! Up to a max of 182 durability to a Potater!
![Gunpowder Durability Increase](https://cdn-raw.modrinth.com/data/B4mMG9LU/images/3c7e4fffe5c2018767199a651ac70ae1ff68496a.png)

### Modifier Slots
This is the main thing that sets this throwable bombs idea apart from others. You can modify the Potaters you make using these. Sometimes completely changing the functionality.

To add modifiers to the Potater head over to your Potater station and insert any of the allowed items the modifier slot says. Currently these items are:

- Baked Potatoes
- Poisonous Potatoes
- Redstone Dust

*Modifiers can be taken out by just clicking the modifier slot again.*

![All Potaters](https://cdn-raw.modrinth.com/data/B4mMG9LU/images/769be656c54772f30eed10a401e57d382cd0299e.png)

***Experiment to see what combinations do!***

title: TradeShop
description: A simple, no-nonsense item trade chest shop plugin.
body:
# Tradeshop!
_A simple, no-nonsense trade chest shop plugin._

# Usage
Place any storage block like a chest, barrel, or shulker.
Then put a sign on the side of the block with the following format.
```
[Shop]
X ItemName (or "[Hand]")
for
Y ItemName (or "[Hand]")
```
ItemName must be the name of the [Bukkit Material](https://jd.papermc.io/paper/1.21.1/org/bukkit/Material.html) (case/space doesn't matter)  
Use `[Hand]` as a temporary placeholder; then right click the sign with the item.

If it works, the sign will reformat itself.

### Example
```
[Shop]
1 Iron Ingot
for
64 Wheat Seeds
```

# Note
This plugin is very new! Please report any bugs or recommend any features on GitHub issues or my Discord.

# Rant
I have a strong distaste for plugins with AI-Generated icons. I will NOT download your plugin if the icon is an AI-Generated image. I made the icon for this plugin in 5 minutes using free software.

These magical horses are more than just your ordinary Minecraft mobs. They come with extra behaviors (just try to tame that pegasus without thinking, and see where it gets you), they have extra equipment and inventory slots, they can fight with or without their rider, and they can have children! 

And this isn't just your simple Minecraft horse breeding - these magical horses have DNA, and can pass on all or some of their traits to their children! Want a flying horse with a unicorn horn? Breed a pegasus and a unicorn! Want a huge horse with flaming hooves? Breed a destrier and a nightmare! Want a horse with ALL the traits?! Well, you can get that too! Just keep breeding... but you might want a DNA tester to make your job easier.


And if you're a master breeder, maybe you can find some of the secret mutant magical horse breeds... otherwise known as Ultimate Unicorns.

Lastly, you can create your own custom unicorn (a new colored magical horse skin with optional magic powers) that all your friends can see! Click here for more info (http://www.hackshop.com/unicorn).

title: Better Amethyst
description: adds new features to amethyst
body:
# Better Amethyst — Complete Feature List

## Items

### Amethyst Dust
- **What it is:** Crafted from amethyst shards via Smithing. Stackable.
- **Behavior:** Edible — eat it for Speed II (30s), Strength II (25s), Glowing (30s).
- **Recipe:** Smithing template (amethyst shard) + 1 amethyst shard base + 1 amethyst shard addition → 3 amethyst dust.

### Amethyst Carrot
- **What it is:** Edible food item.
- **Behavior:** Hunger 6, saturation 0.8 (slightly better than a steak).
- **Recipe:** Shaped 3×3 — center is a vanilla carrot, surrounded by 8 amethyst dust → 9 amethyst carrots.

### Refined Amethyst Crystal
- **What it is:** Single-stack tool item.
- **Behavior:** Right-click to dash **5 blocks forward** in your look direction. Blends prior velocity with the dash so it feels natural during sprinting/falling. Up-look adds extra lift. 3-second cooldown. Plays ender-teleport sound.
- **Recipe:** Shaped pattern of gold ingots and amethyst dust.

### Vibration Detector
- **What it is:** Single-stack tool item.
- **Behavior:** While **holding + sneaking**, applies Glowing to every living entity in a 25-block radius.
- **Recipe:** Shaped with echo shards + amethyst dust.

### Amethyst Mirror
- **What it is:** Single-stack tool item with NBT-backed entity link.
- **Behavior:**
  - **Right-click while looking at a mob:** Links to that mob.
  - **Right-click while linked:** Swaps positions with the linked entity (up to 50 blocks apart).
  - **Shift+right-click while linked:** Toggles **spectate-through-eyes mode** — your camera switches to the linked entity's view. You stay frozen in place at your saved spot. Shift+right-click again to return.
 
- **Recipe:** Shaped with diamonds, iron ingots, and amethyst dust.

### Crystalline Anchor
- **What it is:** Single-stack tool item, shatters when used.
- **Behavior:** Two-stage save/restore.
  - **First right-click (Set):** Saves your position, yaw/pitch, HP, hunger, saturation, and active status effects into NBT.
  - **Second right-click (Restore):** Teleports you back to the saved position, restores HP/hunger/saturation, re-applies all saved status effects. 
- **Consumes anchor on use.**
- **Recipe:** Shaped with amethyst dust, ender pearls, amethyst shard.

### Amethyst Lantern (formerly "Soul Harvester")
- **What it is:** Single-stack tool item with NBT-stored captured mob data.
- **Behavior:**
  - **Right-click in air:** Harvests every mob in a 10-block radius of the same entity type as the first one captured. Stores full mob NBT (so when released, the mob keeps its name, HP, effects, custom data). Caps at **10 souls**.
  - **Players caught in the harvest zone:** Applied **Soulless** status effect for 60 seconds (instead of being captured).
  - **Mobs with > 150 HP**: The lantern shatters (you're guaranteed to survive at ≥ 2 HP).
  - **Right-click block:** Release one captured soul at the block face.
  - **Sneak + right-click block:** Release all souls at once.
- **Recipe:** Shaped — netherite block surrounding amethyst dust.

### Amethyst Gauntlet (formerly "Sonic Gauntlet")
- **What it is:** Single-stack combat item.
- **Behavior:** Right-click fires a 40-block beam.
  - Hits the first valid entity in the beam path for **15~ sonic-boom damage** (armor-bypassing) + 1.5-strength knockback.
  - **3.5-second cooldown.**
- **Recipe:** Shaped 3×3 — vibration detectors + music disc 5 + amethyst dust + gold ingots + netherite scrap.

---

## Enchantments


### Resonance (weapon, max level III)
- **Effect:** On hit, releases a shockwave around the target.
- **Source:** Simple Dungeon chests (35%) and the enchanting table.

### Crystallize (weapon, max level III)
- **Effect:** On hit, applies Slowness `(level - 1)` and Mining Fatigue `(level - 1)` for `3 × level` seconds.
- **Source:** Simple Dungeon chests (35%) and the enchanting table.

### Echo Strike (weapon, max level II)
- **Effect:** Hits echo half a second later.
- **Source:** Ancient City chests (40%) and the enchanting table.

### Amethyst Ward (chestplate, max level I)
- **Effect:** When a hit would kill you, instead set HP to 1 and trigger a knockback-only explosion around you. **The chestplate breaks** (decremented to 0). One-shot save. Doesn't trigger from void or `/kill`.
- **Source:** Stronghold Library chests (30%) and the enchanting table.

### Vibration Cloak (leggings, max level I)
- **Effect:** Masks every vibration you produce — sculk sensors, calibrated sculk sensors, and the Warden's hearing all ignore you. Works at all times (not just sneaking).
- **Source:** Ancient City chests (40%) and the enchanting table.

### Reflective Shell (chestplate, max level III)
- **Effect:** `15% × level` chance to reflect incoming projectiles back at their owner.
- **Source:** Stronghold Library chests (30%) and the enchanting table.


---

## Status Effects

### Echo (beneficial)
- **Effect:** Your attacks echo — every hit deals an extra delayed strike 1 second later.
- **Source:** Echo Potion.

### Shatter (harmful)
- **Effect:** When you take damage, every armor piece on you takes **5× normal durability damage**.
- **Source:** Shatter Potion.

### Soulless (harmful)
- **Effect:** Reduces max HP by 10 (5 hearts) and slows movement by 30%. Visible in the HUD effects panel. Lasts 60 seconds.
- **Source:** Standing in the Amethyst Lantern's harvest zone when activated (cant be caused to self).

---

## Potions 

### Potion of Echo
- **Effect:** 45 seconds of Echo.
- **Brewing:** Awkward Potion + Echo Shard → Potion of Echo. 

### Potion of Shatter
- **Effect:** 20 seconds of Shatter.
- **Brewing:** Awkward Potion + Iron Ingot → Potion of Shatter. 

---

##  Loot Table

|---|---|---|
| Simple Dungeon | Resonance | 35% |
| Simple Dungeon | Crystallize | 35% |
| Ancient City | Echo Strike | 40% |
| Ancient City | Vibration Cloak | 40% |
| Stronghold Library | Amethyst Ward | 30% |
| Stronghold Library | Reflective Shell | 30% |

title: Area Hints
description: A mod that displays the domain name which could be written by players when you enters an area
body:
---

# 🏷️ Areas Hint Mod

**Add immersive area name popups to your Minecraft world!**
When entering custom regions, elegant area titles appear at the top of your screen. Supports multi-level nesting, dimension default names, and easy creation tools—making exploration feel truly meaningful.

---

## 📖 Overview

Areas Hint allows players to define regions (called “domains”) using polygons and display custom names upon entry. All calculations are handled client-side with multithreaded optimization, placing almost zero load on the server. Say goodbye to complex commands and use intuitive tools to mark your world with ease.

---

## ✨ Features

* **Player Customization**: Freely name regions, define boundaries and height.
* **High Performance**: Zero server load, with client-side optimization and multithreading.
* **Automatic Area Titles**: Enter places like “Elven Forest” or “Dark Castle” and see smooth title animations appear on screen.
* **Multi-level Regions**: Supports nested regions (e.g., “Kingdom” → “Throne Room”) with elegant transitions or combined displays.
* **Dimension Default Names**: Displays the dimension name (e.g., “Wilderness Continent”) when outside all regions.
* **Easy Creation Tool**: Use `/areahint easyadd` for an interactive setup—just walk and click to create areas.
* **Fully Customizable**: Modify names, colors, heights, split or merge regions anytime.
* **Beautiful & Smooth UI**: RPG-style title display (inspired by Genshin Impact), with adjustable styles and smooth animations.
* **No Claim Restrictions**: Mark any place freely—explore without limits.

---

## 🎯 Why Choose Areas Hint?

* **Player-Friendly**: No admin permissions required for creating area markers.
* **Optimized Performance**: Client-side processing keeps multiplayer smooth.
* **Plug and Play**: Install and start marking areas with simple commands.
* **Highly Compatible**: Works seamlessly with minimaps, shaders, and optimization mods.

---

## 🛠️ Features Overview

* Polygon-based region definition with multi-level domains (top-level / subdomains).
* Ray-casting detection to determine player position.
* Multiple rendering methods (CPU, OpenGL, Vulkan).
* Rich subtitle style customization.
* Full command system for configuration and management.
* Interactive domain creation tool **EasyAdd**, designed for ease of use.

---

## 📋 Command System

### Basic Commands

| Command            | Description                    | Permission |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------ | ---------- |
| `/areahint help`   | Show all commands and usage    | Everyone   |
| `/areahint reload` | Reload config and domain files | Admin      |

### View & Manage Domains

| Command            | Description                    | Permission                  |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------ | --------------------------- |
| `/areahint check`  | Show all combined domain lists | Everyone                    |
| `/areahint delete` | Interactive domain deletion    | Everyone (own domains only) |

### Create & Edit Domains

| Command                | Description                       | Permission |
| ---------------------- | --------------------------------- | ---------- |
| `/areahint easyadd`    | Start interactive domain creation | Everyone   |
| `/areahint rename`     | Start interactive rename          | Everyone   |
| `/areahint expandarea` | Expand domain interactively       | Everyone   |
| `/areahint shrinkarea` | Shrink domain interactively       | Everyone   |
| `/areahint dividearea` | Split domain interactively        | Everyone   |

### Vertex Editing

| Command                | Description                   | Permission |
| ---------------------- | ----------------------------- | ---------- |
| `/areahint addhint`    | Add vertices interactively    | Everyone   |
| `/areahint deletehint` | Delete vertices interactively | Everyone   |

### Style & Display Settings

| Command                    | Description                              | Permission |
| -------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ---------- |
| `/areahint recolor`        | Recolor domains                          | Everyone   |
| `/areahint sethigh`        | Set domain height                        | Everyone   |
| `/areahint subtitlerender` | View/set render mode (cpu/opengl/vulkan) | Everyone   |
| `/areahint subtitlestyle`  | Choose subtitle style interactively      | Everyone   |
| `/areahint subtitlesize`   | Choose subtitle size interactively       | Everyone   |

### Dimension Domain Management

| Command                         | Description                          | Permission |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | ---------- |
| `/areahint dimensionalityname`  | Manage dimension names               | Everyone   |
| `/areahint dimensionalitycolor` | Manage dimension colors              | Everyone   |
| `/areahint firstdimname <name>` | Set name on first entry to dimension | Everyone   |
| `/areahint firstdimname_skip`   | Skip first-time naming               | Everyone   |

### Other Features

| Command                           | Description                        | Permission                   |
| --------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| `/areahint replacebutton`         | Interactive keybinding replacement | Everyone                     |
| `/areahint boundviz`              | Toggle boundary visualization      | Everyone                     |
| `/areahint language`              | Choose language interactively      | Everyone                     |
| `/areahint debug`                 | Toggle debug mode                  | Admin                        |
| `/areahint frequency <1-60>`      | Set detection frequency            | Everyone                     |
| `/areahint serverlanguage <code>` | Set server log language            | Console (permission level 4) |

---

## 🏰 Use Cases

* **RPG Servers**: Name towns, dungeons, and wilderness areas to enhance immersion.
* **Adventure Maps**: Add story-driven area titles or hidden location names.
* **Building Servers**: Label large builds with names or authors.
* **Singleplayer Worlds**: Mark your base, farms, mines—create your own journey log.

---

## ✅ Compatibility

Areas Hint is fully compatible with the following mods (tested):

*(Keep your original compatibility list as-is, since mod names remain unchanged.)*

---

## 🌟 Final Words

Areas Hint is more than just a mod—it’s the “place naming system” of your Minecraft world. It makes every journey feel meaningful and immersive. Whether you're building an epic RPG server or documenting your personal creations, it adds a whole new layer of experience.

**Try it now and give your world its own identity!**

# Tw's Decoration Extension

![background](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2FGjgUh1/images/f2072922792ae0fa018f824514b78e7d27346e96_350.webp)

**Tw's Decoration Extension** adds a variety of decorative blocks and entities to enrich your Minecraft builds, along with a few small gameplay tweaks. 

It requires the **[TW's Decorative Food](https://modrinth.com/mod/tws-decorative-food)** mod as a dependency.

---

## Features

### Picnic Baskets
- 16 dyeable variants (matching all wool colors) and a plain one.
- Right-click to open/close the lid (sneak + click to toggle without interaction).
- Store **one type of food/item** inside (max stack size varies per item).
- Place or take out items when the basket is open.
- **Sneak + click** on a colored basket to remove the dyed carpet and revert to a plain basket.

### Chairs
- Craftable chairs in all wood types: oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, cherry, and bamboo.

### Hanging Hooks (Rack Hooks)
- Two variants: iron and copper.
- Hang items on **four separate slots** per block.
- Some items (like salmon) require **two blocks of vertical space** – the hook checks below for air.

### Simple Hooks
- A smaller hook that hangs from a chain.
- Holds **one item** from a predefined list (raw/cooked meats, fish).
- Place a chain above, then attach the hook to the bottom of the chain.

### Chicken Egg Placement
- Chickens no longer just drop eggs – they **place eggs as decorative food blocks** (provided by TW's Decorative Food)!
- Eggs will stack onto existing egg blocks nearby, up to the block's max stack size.
- If no egg block is nearby, the chicken attempts to place a new egg block on a suitable surface.

---

## Dependencies
- **[TW's Decorative Food](https://modrinth.com/mod/tws-decorative-food)** (required)

---

## 💬 Feedback & Suggestions
If you encounter any issues or have ideas for improvement, please report them on our [GitHub Issues page](https://github.com/666daji/Decoration-Extension/issues).

body:
# ⚙️ PolyTech

🖥️ Server-side tech + automation • Fabric API • Polymer • Minecraft 1.21.11  
⚡ Adds energy networks, industrial machines, quarry systems, villager processing, and large-scale automation.

---

## ✨ Key Features

⚡ **Energy System**
- Uses **Power Units (PU)** over a ➕ 6-way connectable **Cable** grid
- Upgradeable tiers: **LV → MV → HV → EV**
- 📡 Dimension-wide **wireless power** with 🎨 **16 color channels**
- 🔋 **Battery Boxes** for energy storage and distribution
- ☀️ **Solar Panels** for renewable power generation

🏭 **Industrial Machines**
- 🔥 **Generator**: burns furnace fuels to produce power
- 🪨 **Macerator**: grinds items into dust
- 🧱 **Compressor**: makes plates and compressed materials
- 🔥 **Electric Furnace**
- 👥 **Villager Grinder**: processes villagers into **Villager Souls**
- 🧬 **Villager Combiner**: combines villagers for trait optimization

⛏️ **Quarry Automation**
- ⛏️ **Quarry Block** with moving drill head for frame-based mining
- 🧨 **Chunk Destroyer** for large-scale chunk-by-chunk excavation
- 🧱 **Quarry Frames** to define and visualize mining areas
- 📦 **Digital Chest compatibility** for direct mined-item deposit

🤖 **Automation**
- 🧠 **Digital Crafter (endgame)** connects to a 🎨 Digital Chest color channel
- 📋 Scans and executes crafting recipes automatically
- 🎛️ Machine-specific GUIs for control and monitoring
- 🔀 All machines support per-face I/O: ⬅️ Input • ➡️ Output • ➖ Normal • 🚫 Disabled

📦 **Materials & Progression**
- 🪙 New processed resources including **Iron Dust**, **Gold Dust**, and **Copper Dust**
- 🧱 New compressed materials including **Iron Plates**, **Gold Plates**, and **Copper Plates**
- 👻 **Villager Soul** as a specialized advanced resource
- 📘 **PolyTech Handbook** for in-game documentation and progression help

🪄 **Dynamic Visuals & GUIs**
- ✨ Floating holographic text shows status, progress, and power warnings
- 🧪 Runtime-generated resource pack with custom models and GUIs
- 🖱️ Drag-and-drop slot UI
- 🧰 Expanded machine interfaces for more advanced systems

🔗 **Integrations**
- 📦 **Digital Chest** support for automation and quarry output
- 🚰 **Polymer Pipes** support for item and fluid transport
- 📚 **Polydex integration** for recipe browsing with custom categories

---

## 🛠️ Summary

PolyTech is growing into a much larger automation mod focused on **energy**, **industrial processing**, **quarry mining**, **villager-based progression**, and **cross-mod infrastructure** — all with **server-side Polymer compatibility** for vanilla-friendly multiplayer play.

title: Botany Pots - More Crop Compatibility
description: Adds new crops from other farmers delight mods and cobblemon to botany pots + few minor changes.
body:
# Overview 

This datapack improves compatibility between Botany Pots and several popular farming mods by adding missing crops and fixing multi-block crop behaviour



# What this datapack does
##  🌾 Adds missing crops to Botany Pots

Enables the following crops to grow in Botany Pots

### Cultural Delights

🌽 Corn (uses upper block)

🥒 Cucumber

🍆 Eggplant

~~🥑 Avocado~~ (V1.1) - Support moved to my [Botany Tree pack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/botany-trees-x-farmers-delight-expanded-compatibility), adds axe compatibility.

🌽🌿 Wild Corn

🥒🌿 Wild Cucumbers

🍆🌿 Wild Eggplants

### Cobblemon

🍇 Eggant Berry

🌾 Hearty Grains 

🌰 Galarica Nuts (V1.1)

### Vegan Delight

🫘 Soybeans

🫘🌿 Wild Soybeans

### Pineapple Delight (V1.1)

🍍 Pineapples

🍍🌿 Wild Pineapple Crops

⚠️ Note: As this is simply a datapack, you do not require all of these mods to be present, it will work fine with just the ones you have. If you are concerned, simply delete their recipe folders from the ZIP

## 🌱 Multi-block crop fixes

Some crops (such as corn and rice) are multi-block plants where the harvestable logic lives on the upper block.

This datapack updates Botany Pots recipes to:

Target the upper / harvestable block where appropriate (Currently limited to Rice and Corn, I can't seem to get Hearty grains to support this behaviour, but as Hearty Grains upper block only drops 2 hearty grains instead of 1, and has no other interaction recipes, I figure it's fine to leave out until a future update).

Preserve tool-gated drops and loot conditions (Corn drops corn cobs instead of kernels, and Rice drops Rice Panicles instead of Rice)

Display the correct mature crop visuals inside the pot (Rice displays Rice Panicles block instead of Rice Crops block)


## 🍍 V1.1 Pineapple Delight Support

### Pineapple features

This datapack does a lot to make Pineapple Delight consistent with other delight mods and crops in this datapack, namely

- Wild Pineapple Crops can now be obtained with Silk Touch or Shears (why you'd want to grow these, I don't know, but now you can!)
- Pineapples can be grown on dirt or sand in botany pots
- Added knife harvesting support for fully grown pineapple crops
 - Pineapples harvested with knives drop two pineapple sides and one pineapple crop (as well as a fortune roll for additional pineapple crop drops).

### Why remove Avocado Support?

Simply put, I felt I could better support its compatibility if I kept it with my Botany Tree datapack. Any changes I make to Botany Tree support will be reflected in its inclusion there (like axe stripping support to get stripped jungle logs). If you really want Avocado's but don't want to use botany trees, just pull the recipe from either V1.0 or the Botany Tree pack and merge it with the zip.

## 🔪 Notes on knife usage & straw harvesting

Corn and rice can drop straw when harvested with a knife using this datapack, but Botany Pots does not allow knives in the tool slot by default.

To enable straw drops in Botany Pots, I recommend also installing my companion pack:

[Botany Pots x Farmer's Delight Compatibility Pack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/botanypots-farmers-delight-rich-soil-compatibility) (also adds rich soil support).

Using a knife to harvest Rice will also drop Rice instead of Rice Panicles alongside Straw, and will auto-cut pineapples into pineapple sides using these datapacks together!

# Technical
### Compatibility

Requires [Botany Pots](https://modrinth.com/mod/botany-pots) - (Fabric version tested)


🧩 **Compatible with:**

[Farmer's Delight Refabricated](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated)

[Botany Pots Tiers](https://modrinth.com/mod/botany-pots-tiers)

[Botany Trees](https://modrinth.com/mod/botany-trees)

[Cultural Delights](https://modrinth.com/mod/cultural-delights)

[Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon)

[Vegan Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/vegan-delight)

## 📦 Works well with my other data pack

[BotanyPots × Farmer’s Delight – Improved Compatibility](https://modrinth.com/datapack/botanypots-farmers-delight-rich-soil-compatibility) for proper rich soil support (also adds knives!)


Safe to add or remove from existing worlds.

### Instructions

📥 **Installation**

Download the datapack

Place the ZIP file into:

```
<world folder>/datapacks/
```
Run /reload or restart the world

**Versions**

Im sure this probably works in more versions than just 1.21.1 but thats all I tested it for at the moment! Feel free to test it if you wish.

Features an "Abyss" system for item recovery via `/abyss`. | | **RedstoneLimiter** | 🟡 Medium | Detects and suppresses rapid-pulsing redstone clocks that cause TPS drops. | | **VehicleMotionReducer** | 🟡 Medium | Optimizes boat and minecart collisions, movement logic, and removes mineshaft clutter. | | **AbilityLimiter** | 🟡 Medium | Limits rapid Trident/Elytra usage to prevent excessive chunk loading. | | **HopperOptimizer** | 🟡 Medium | Reduces hopper tick rates and optimizes item transfer logic to minimize lag. | | **InstantLeafDecay** | 🔵 Low | Makes leaves decay instantly when trees are cut, reducing entity processing. | | **ConsoleFilter** | 🔵 Visual | Regex-based filtering to keep your server console clean and readable. | --- ## 🛠 Commands All commands use the `/syncboost` (or alias `/sb`) prefix. | Command | Description | | :--- | :--- | | `/syncboost` | Open the main configuration GUI. | | `/syncboost menu` | Open the main configuration GUI. | | `/syncboost help` | Display the full list of available commands. | | `/syncboost monitor` | View real-time server statistics (TPS, MSPT, RAM, CPU). | | `/syncboost map` | Get a map item that displays a live performance graph. | | `/syncboost benchmark` | Run a CPU/RAM stress test to measure server hardware performance. | | `/syncboost chunks [world]` | Analyze chunks for performance issues. What Java version does SyncBoost require?

SyncBoost requires minimum Java 17 and recommends Java 21 for optimal performance. Java 21 offers significant performance improvements for modern servers.

Which Minecraft versions are supported?

SyncBoost supports Minecraft 1.17.1 - 1.21.4+. Legacy versions (1.17.1 - 1.20.4) are fully supported, and 1.16.5 is available via manual build configuration.

Is SyncBoost compatible with Folia?

SyncBoost works with Spigot, Paper, Purpur, Pufferfish, Folia, and any compatible fork. Paper or higher is recommended for best performance.

SyncBoost is designed to work alongside other plugins. It integrates seamlessly with Spark for profiling and stacker plugins like WildStacker, RoseStacker, and UltimateStacker.

How do I recover accidentally cleared items?

Use the Abyss feature! Items cleared by WorldCleaner are temporarily stored and can be recovered using /abyss command within a configurable time window.

# OXG Modpack - The Definitive Vanilla+ Experience

Welcome to the OXG Modpack, the definitive Vanilla+ experience, now available in two tailored editions: **Essential** and **Pro**. Both are designed to enrich every aspect of Minecraft for the perfect SMP adventure.

This is a comprehensive modpack for both the **Client and Server**, engineered to work together to provide a stable and cohesive experience for all players.

## Which Version Should You Choose?

This project has two separate downloads. Choose the one that best fits your playstyle and PC hardware.

#### Download `Essential` if...
- You want the core Vanilla+ gameplay with **maximum performance and stability**.
- You have an older PC, a laptop, or simply prioritize high FPS above all else.
- You want a lightweight, fast, and reliable experience.

#### Download `Pro` if...
- You want the ultimate visual and immersive experience with **shader support, enhanced animations, and realistic sound physics**.
- You have a mid-to-high-end gaming PC that can handle graphical enhancements.
- You want every bell and whistle for the most breathtaking adventure possible.

---

## The Essential Experience (The Foundation for Both Packs)

Every player gets to enjoy a Minecraft that is fundamentally better, no matter which version you choose.

### ⛰️ Renewed Exploration and Adventure
The world is vast and full of surprises. Say goodbye to repetitive landscapes!

-   **Epic New Biomes:** Explore hundreds of new biomes across the Overworld, Nether, and End with mods like **Biomes O' Plenty**, **Incendium**, and **Nullscape**.
-   **Reimagined Structures:** Discover completely redesigned and challenging dungeons, temples, villages, and strongholds with the full suite of **YUNG's Better...** mods and **Dungeons and Taverns**.
-   **Threatening Dimensions:** Venture into a new realm of darkness with **Deeper and Darker**.
-   **Explorer's Tools:** Never get lost again with the help of **Nature's Compass** and **Explorer's Compass**.

### ⚔️ Dynamic and Challenging Combat
Minecraft's combat has been completely modernized to be more agile and strategic.

-   **Modern Combat System:** Swing in any direction, dual-wield effectively, and feel the impact of every hit with **Better Combat**.
-   **New Abilities:** Roll to dodge attacks, use class-based skills with the **RPG Series (Archers, Paladins)**, and discover new weapons and enchantments.
-   **Invasions and Events:** Defend your base from periodic Illager invasions and prepare to encounter new types of monsters with **Friends&Foes**.

### 💎 Top-Tier Performance and Stability
Play on a server that just works. Optimized with the best performance mods to ensure a stable TPS and high FPS.

-   **Optimized Engine:** Powered by **Sodium**, **Lithium**, **FerriteCore**, and **C2ME** to guarantee the best possible performance on both the client and the server.
-   **Less Lag, More Gameplay:** Drastically reduces lag spikes caused by world generation and entities.

### 🏡 Quality of Life and Building
Small tweaks that make a huge difference in your day-to-day gameplay.

-   **Teleportation Network:** Create your own fast-travel network with **Waystones**.
-   **Less Punishing Death:** Recover your items safely with the **Universal Graves** system.
-   **Decoration and Customization:** Use hundreds of new decorative blocks with **Chipped** and **Handcrafted**.
-   **Enhanced Mechanics:** Pick up small animals and chests with **Carry On**, enjoy a deeper sleeping mechanic with **Sleep Tight**, and organize your loot with **Lootr**.

---

## ✨ The Pro Upgrade: What's Added on Top?

By choosing the **Pro** edition, you get all of the above, plus a suite of high-end client-side mods for an unparalleled sensory experience.

-   **Breathtaking Visuals & Shaders:** The Pro pack is powered by **Iris Shaders**, allowing you to use your favorite shader packs. It also includes **Sodium Extra** and **Reese's Sodium Options** for fine-tuned graphical control, plus visual mods like **Visuality**, **Better Animations Collection**, and **Falling Leaves** for a more dynamic world.
-   **Unparalleled Immersion:** Feel the world around you with **Sound Physics Remastered** for realistic audio reverb and muffling, and hear every step with **Presence Footsteps**.
-   **Deep Customization & Enhanced UI:** Show off your style with **3D Skin Layers** and the flowing motion of **WaveyCapes**. Enjoy a redesigned advancement screen with **Better Advancements** and track your progress with **Advancement Plaques**.

---
## ⚙️ Installation
1. Choose and download the `.mrpack` file for either the **Essential** or **Pro** edition from the "Files" tab.
2. Use a modern launcher that supports Modrinth modpacks, such as [ATLauncher](https://atlauncher.com/downloads) or [Prism Launcher](https://prismlauncher.org/download/).
3. In your launcher, select "Import" or "Add Instance from Zip" and select the `.mrpack` file you downloaded. The launcher will handle the rest!

---
### ✨ Credits and Gratitude
This modpack wouldn't be possible without the incredible work of the modding community. A special thank you to the creators of the key mods that define this experience:

-   **Performance:** [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium), [C2ME](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-fabric), [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core), [ModernFix](https://modrinth.com/mod/modernfix)
-   **Visuals & Shaders (Pro):** [Iris](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) by the IrisShaders Team
-   **World Generation:** [YUNG's API](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-api) & Suite, [Biomes O' Plenty](https://modrinth.com/mod/biomes-o-plenty), [Stardust Labs'](https://modrinth.com/user/Stardust_Labs) Suite (Incendium, Nullscape)
-   **Combat & RPG:** [Daedelus' Library](https://modrinth.com/user/Daedelus) (Better Combat, RPG Series)
-   **Quality of Life:** [BlayTheNinth's](https://modrinth.com/user/BlayTheNinth) Mods (Waystones), [Patbox'](https://modrinth.com/user/Patbox) Mods (Universal Graves)
-   **And many more!** This pack contains hundreds of amazing mods. Please support their creators.

title: TimberPlus
description: Advanced tree cutting plugin with mini-game mechanics
body:
# TimberPlus Plugin

![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ba1f4136d2ae38d7556aa869267139c2e7c5f941_0.webp)


![detay](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7eef6339bc5224210aa403489b46651561975aa9.png)


TimberPlus is an advanced tree cutting plugin for Minecraft servers (Paper/Folia) that introduces mini-game mechanics to make wood chopping more engaging. Players can activate the cutting mode with `/tmp`, and upon breaking a log, they are presented with an action bar mini-game.

## 📋 Features

### 🎮 Mini-Game System
- Visual mini-game on the Action Bar
- Moving arrow and target zone mechanics
- 3 successful hits required to cut the whole tree
- Cooldown system for failures

### 🌳 Tree Detection
- Realistic tree detection using BFS algorithm
- Support for all Minecraft tree types (Oak, Birch, Spruce, Jungle, Acacia, Dark Oak, Mangrove, Cherry, Bamboo, Crimson, Warped)
- Leaf checking and size limits
- Permission-based access control per tree type

### 🛠️ Axe System
- Support for all axe types
- Durability calculation system
- Unbreaking enchantment support
- Low durability warnings

### 📊 Statistics
- SQLite database for player stats
- Tracking logs broken, successful games, success rate
- Leaderboard system

### 🔧 Management
- Detailed configuration file
- Permission-based access control
- World-based activation
- PlaceholderAPI support
- Folia server support

## 📁 Installation

1.  **Requirements:**
    *   Paper/Folia 1.20+ server
    *   Java 17+
    *   PlaceholderAPI (optional)

## 🎯 Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/tmp` | Toggle tree cutting mode | `timberplus.use` |
| `/tmp help` | Help menu | - |
| `/tmp stats [player]` | View statistics | `timberplus.command.stats` |
| `/tmp top` | View leaderboard | `timberplus.command.leaderboard` |
| `/tmp reload` | Reload plugin | `timberplus.admin` |
| `/tmp reset <player>` | Reset player stats | `timberplus.admin` |
| `/tmp debug` | Debug info | `timberplus.admin` |

## 🔐 Permissions

### Basic Permissions
- `timberplus.use` - Use the plugin
- `timberplus.unlimited` - Access all tree types
- `timberplus.bypass.cooldown` - Bypass cooldowns
- `timberplus.bypass.durability` - Bypass durability

### Command Permissions
- `timberplus.command.stats` - Stats command
- `timberplus.command.leaderboard` - Leaderboard command

### Admin Permissions
- `timberplus.admin` - All admin commands

### Tree Type Permissions
- `timberplus.tree.oak` - Oak
- `timberplus.tree.birch` - Birch
- `timberplus.tree.spruce` - Spruce
- `timberplus.tree.jungle` - Jungle
- `timberplus.tree.acacia` - Acacia
- `timberplus.tree.dark_oak` - Dark Oak
- `timberplus.tree.mangrove` - Mangrove
- `timberplus.tree.cherry` - Cherry
- `timberplus.tree.bamboo` - Bamboo
- `timberplus.tree.crimson` - Crimson
- `timberplus.tree.warped` - Warped

## 📈 PlaceholderAPI

| Placeholder | Description |
|---|---|
| `%timberplus_logs_broken%` | Total logs broken |
| `%timberplus_rank%` | Player rank |
| `%timberplus_success_rate%` | Success rate |
| `%timberplus_total_games%` | Total games |
| `%timberplus_successful_games%` | Successful games |

body:
# 🎉 FirstJoinRewards – Reward Players for Welcoming Newcomers!

**FirstJoinRewards** is a lightweight, fully configurable Minecraft plugin that rewards players for welcoming newcomers. Now with **Top Welcomers GUI**, **PlaceholderAPI support**, and **admin controls**!

Supports both **Java and Bedrock** players thanks to Geyser + Floodgate integration!

---

## ✨ Features

### 👋 Welcome System
- Detects when a player joins for the first time
- The first player to say the correct welcome message (e.g. `hej Steve`) receives a reward
- Works with Bedrock player names like `*Steve_`, `._Alex`, etc.
- Configurable timeout (default: 30 seconds)

### 🎁 Rewards
- **Command rewards** (e.g. give money, permissions)
- **Item rewards** (e.g. diamonds, XP bottles)
- **Combo rewards** for milestones (50, 100, 150, 200+ welcomes)

### 🏆 Top Welcomers System (NEW!)
- Beautiful GUI with player heads podium
- Top 3 welcomers displayed with gold/silver/bronze styling
- Your personal stats button
- Fully configurable in `gui.yml`

### 🔌 PlaceholderAPI Integration (NEW!)
Use these placeholders in other plugins:
- `%fjr_welcomes%` - Player's total welcomes
- `%fjr_rank%` - Player's rank
- `%fjr_top_1_name%` / `%fjr_top_1_count%` - Top 1 player
- `%fjr_top_2_name%` / `%fjr_top_2_count%` - Top 2 player
- `%fjr_top_3_name%` / `%fjr_top_3_count%` - Top 3 player
- ... up to `%fjr_top_10%`
- `%fjr_total_welcomes%` - Total server welcomes
- `%fjr_total_players%` - Total welcomed players

**Bonus:** Use placeholders from OTHER plugins in FJR messages!

### 🛠️ Admin Commands (NEW!)
- `/fjr admin reset <player>` - Reset player's welcomes
- `/fjr admin set <player> <count>` - Set welcome count

title: Golden Days+
description: Relive the nostalgia of old Minecraft with Golden Days+, a faithful throwback modpack.
body:
**Golden Days+ – Relive the Classics**

Golden Days+ is a carefully crafted nostalgia-driven modpack designed for players who long for the classic charm of Minecraft’s earliest days but still want the smooth, stable experience of the modern game. Instead of bombarding you with heavy shaders or ultra-modern changes, this pack focuses on capturing the feeling of Minecraft Alpha and Beta — when every tree chopped, every cave explored, and every mob encountered felt new and exciting.

This modpack is built around the idea that less is more. You won’t find overwhelming menus, complicated tech trees, or futuristic content that takes away from the original Minecraft soul. Instead, Golden Days+ enhances the core gameplay loop of survival, building, and exploration by carefully adding lightweight mods and resource tweaks that bring you back to the roots of the game. The textures, sounds, and atmosphere feel old-school, while the quality-of-life improvements make it comfortable to play on modern versions.

One of the biggest appeals of this pack is its faithful simplicity. Unlike many nostalgia-themed projects that drown in unnecessary extras, Golden Days+ gives you a streamlined experience. The pack replaces the modern, polished textures with carefully chosen retro-style visuals that echo Minecraft’s early charm without being clunky or broken. The mobs, items, and blocks look closer to their original designs, creating an immediate wave of familiarity the moment you load up a new world.

Golden Days+ is also multiplayer-friendly. You can start a small survival world with friends and enjoy the throwback atmosphere together without worrying about lag or overcomplication. Thanks to lightweight optimizations (not shaders), the pack runs well even on low-end systems, making it accessible to everyone — just like the original game was back in the day.

Whether you’re a veteran player who started during Alpha or Beta, or a newcomer curious about what Minecraft used to feel like, this modpack bridges the gap between the golden past and the stable present. You’ll notice how the skies look simpler, the grass feels warmer, the caves have an old echo of danger, and the villages carry a rustic charm. All of this combines into an experience where every block feels more meaningful and every structure tells a story of when Minecraft was young.

Golden Days+ is not about overwhelming you with endless content, but about taking you back to the essence of Minecraft — a world of survival, creativity, and endless adventure, wrapped in nostalgia yet stable for modern play.

**⚒️ Perfect for players who want:**

A retro-inspired survival experience

Nostalgic textures and sounds (without shaders)

Multiplayer-friendly and lightweight performance

A return to the simplicity of old-school Minecraft

title: TCon Tank Nerf
description: Nerfs Seared Tanks to be able to only hold liquids with temperatures less than or equal to 1000C
body:
# What.

This mod is intended for "expert" packs to gate blazing blood (or any other add-on equivalents) to the foundry/alloyer (access to Tier 4 materials) by restricting higher temperature fuels (>1000C) to scorched tanks and preventing them from being using in seared tanks.

# Why?

The goal is to make the late game of Tinkers harder and encourage experimenting with lower tiers for longer.

Blazing blood is fairly easy to obtain and is pretty much the only road block to end game Tinker's materials. Aside from making the raw materials themselves harder to obtain, its not really possible to tweak to challenge of tier 4 materials without having to use other mods to make it more difficult or also nerfing access to the smeltery (access Tier 3 materials) too much.

title: Tinker's Knives
description: Reskins Tinkers' Construct Daggers in the style of Farmer's Delight Knives, with compatibility for Tinkers' Integrations and Tweaks
body:
# Requirements
### [Tinkers' Construct](https://modrinth.com/mod/tinkers-construct) (Required)
Since this Resourcepack reskins Tinkers' Construct Daggers, Tinkers' Construct is obviously required, otherwise this resourcepack doesn't do anything.
### [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight) (Optional)
This Resourcepack was made with Farmer's delight in mind, though Farmer's Delight and Tinkers' Construct do not have base compatibility with each other, you will need a datapack to add Tinkers' Construct Daggers under the "forge:tools/knives" tag, or get this next mod
### [Tinkers Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/tinkers-construct-delight) (Optional)
Tinkers Delight adds compatibility between Farmer's Delight and Tinkers' Construct, as well as adding new recipes and foods.

If you like compatibility with Farmer's Delight, you should check out their other stuff, sadly most of their Farmer's Delight compats aren't on Modrinth, so you'll have to look up their Curseforge profile.

Incase you do not want to get Tinkers Delight, I'd reccomend adding compatibility with Farmer's Delight through a datapack as I explained above, that is if you're going to be using Farmer's Delight with Tinkers.
### [Tinkers' Integrations and Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/tcintegrations) (Optional)
A great Tinkers' Construct addon with an eye for balanced integration, this resourcepack also adds reskins for their additions such as Neptunium (from Aquaculture) and Brass (from Create).

Check out their other mods too, their same eye for balance is present in all their other mods, making their mods worth considering for any well-balanced modpack.

# Description
After testing NocubeYT's Tinkers Delight addon in a modpack, I noticed it would be pretty easy to reskin the Tinkers' Construct daggers into knives as they only utilized 2 parts.

At first, This was just supposed to be for personal use in a modpack I'm making for friends, but I decided to contribute to modrinth since I support the idea of an open-source modding platform.

Moreover, I feel many see Tinkers' Construct as a fossil of a mod and I hope to help make it feel just a little more up-to-date by throwing my hat into the ring and making some visual integration between 2 of my most favorite mods.

# Versions
Though this resourcepack was made for 1.19.2, it should work for all versions except those before 1.16.5, and it should even work on any new versions of tinkers unless they completely rework the tools again (which I assume they won't) if it shows a warning about the resourcepack being made for a newer or older version, just ignore it.

If you have any issues or suggestions simply contact me in DMs on my discord (since modrinth doesn't do comments) my username and icon are the same ones that I have here and my DMs are open to the public

A crate can hold several stacks, 32 by default, of a single item. When broken, the crate retains its content so you can
move it easily.

You can interact directly with the front of the crate (the face showing the item and its count):

* Left-click (attack) to extract a stack of the contained item,
* Shift-left-click (sneak-attack) to extract one item,
* Right-click (use) with an item in hand to insert it into the crate, if possible,
* Shift-right-click (sneak-use) with an empty hand to insert all matching items from your inventory in the crate.

Crate can be improved by inserting up to 5 upgrades. Right-click (use) any face but the front to open its GUI. At the
bottom of the screen, just over the player inventory, there are 5 slots available for upgrades. Each slot can contain
one item, and you can insert several upgrade of the same type (e.g. 5 iron ingots).

Possible upgrades are:

* An iron ingot to increase the maximum capacity by 8 stacks.
* A diamond to increase the maximum capacity by 16 stacks.
* A netherite ingot to increase the maximum capacity by 32 stacks.
* A cobweb to lock the crate to the contained item, i.e. if the crate is emptied, it remembers the item and will not
  accept other items.
* A bucket of lava to have the crate accepts more items than its maximum capacity but destroy overflow items.

Beware: if you remove a capacity increase and the resulting capacity is lower than the current amount of items, the
crate gets jammed and cannot be used until you increase the capacity again.

Crates can also be accessed by hoppers and any mod that supports the Fabric Transfer API.

### Controller

The controller should be placed next to existing crates and allows to interact with all connected crates. The possible
interactions (with the front side) are:

* Left-click (attack) with an item in hand to extract a stack of said item,
* Shift-left-click (sneak-attack) with an empty hand to restock all items in your inventory,
* Right-click (use) with an item in hand to insert it into a crate that accepts it,
* Shift-right-click (sneak-use) with an empty hand to insert all matching items from your inventory into the crates.

The controller does not interact with unlocked, empty crates, so you cannot insert new items this way. When several
crates contain/accept the same item, the controller will prioritize them depending on the operation:

* when inserting, it starts with the non-full crate with the highest number of items.
* when extracting, it starts with the crate with the lowest number of items.

The controller can also be accessed by hoppers and any mod that supports the Fabric Transfer API.

title: Secure Trade
description: Player Trade from anywhere: exchange items and XP across distance and dimensions with a custom GUI and configurable server-side limits.
body:
# Secure Trade

Secure Trade is a player trade mod for multiplayer worlds, co-op servers, and modpacks.

Trade items and experience with another player from anywhere: across a base, across the map, or even across dimensions. No more running back home just to hand over ores, tools, drops, or XP.

## Why Use It?

Minecraft multiplayer often splits players across different jobs and locations. One player may be mining, another crafting at base, and someone else exploring the Nether or a modded dimension.

Secure Trade keeps that flow intact: send a trade request, confirm the exchange, and keep playing.

By default, trades are not limited by distance or dimension. Server owners can keep that freedom or configure stricter rules for local-only trading, dimension restrictions, item blacklists, cooldowns, logging, and trade history.

## How It Works

1. Run `/trade <player>`.
2. The other player accepts the request from chat.
3. Both players get a shared trade screen.
4. Each side adds items and/or XP.
5. Both players confirm.
6. A short countdown starts, then the exchange completes.

If either player changes their offer after confirming, the ready state is reset so both sides can review the updated trade.

## Features

- Player trading from anywhere by default
- Cross-dimension trading between the Overworld, Nether, End, and modded dimensions
- Item and XP exchange in the same trade session
- Shared trade GUI with 27 offer slots per player
- Clickable chat requests with accept and deny actions
- Clear confirmation states and countdown before completion
- Custom trade sounds for requests, countdown, blocked items, cancellation, and successful trades
- Automatic readiness reset when items or XP change
- Optional distance limit for servers that want local-only trading
- Optional dimension allowlist or blocklist
- Optional item blacklist, including protected items inside supported containers
- In-GUI warning when an item is blocked by the server blacklist
- One active trade or pending request per player
- Request cooldowns to reduce spam
- Trade history command with grouped items, XP, and item hover tooltips
- Optional async transaction logging to `logs/securetrade.log`
- Disconnect-safe item return or drop handling
- Localization for 23 languages
- Fabric, Forge, and NeoForge support across supported Minecraft versions

## Supported Versions

| Minecraft | Loaders |
| --- | --- |
| 26.2 | Fabric, NeoForge |
| 26.1.x | Fabric, NeoForge |
| 1.21.1 | Fabric, NeoForge |
| 1.20.1 | Fabric, Forge |
| 1.19.2 | Fabric, Forge |
| 1.18.2 | Fabric, Forge |
| 1.16.5 | Fabric, Forge |

Use the file that matches your Minecraft version and mod loader.

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `/trade <player>` | Sends a trade request. If both players request each other, the trade opens immediately. |
| `/trade accept` | Accepts the current pending trade request. |
| `/trade deny` | Denies the current pending trade request. |
| `/trade history` | Shows recent trades for the player, including items and XP. |

## Configuration

The server configuration file is created at:

title: HolaAlerts
description: HolaAlerts is a Velocity plugin that filters chat, blocks swears/ads, and helps keep servers safe with real-time alerts.
body:
# **

HolaAlerts

**
## What is HolaAlerts? **HolaAlerts** is a robust chat monitoring plugin designed for Velocity-powered Minecraft servers. It provides advanced chat filtering and alert functionalities to maintain a safe and professional server environment. With HolaAlerts, server administrators can effectively monitor and moderate player chat, ensuring compliance with community standards by detecting and censoring inappropriate language and advertisements. ## **Features** - 🛡️ **Chat Filtering**: Automatically censors predefined swear words and advertisement patterns in player chat, with customizable replacement characters. - ✅ **Advertisement Whitelisting**: Allows specific domains or patterns (e.g., example.com) to bypass advertisement filtering, ensuring flexibility for server promotion. - ⏲️ **Real-Time Alerts**: Sends in-game and console alerts to staff with configurable permissions (holaalerts.notify) when inappropriate content is detected, with distinct formatting for swear words and advertisements. - 📘 **Discord Webhook Integration**: Delivers detailed alerts to a Discord server via customizable webhooks, including options for titles, colors, field names, footers, and timestamps for both bad word and advertisement alerts. - ❓ **Permission-Based Controls**: Supports bypass permissions (holaalerts.bypass) for exempting certain players from chat filtering and reload permissions (holaalerts.reload) for configuration management. - ⚒️ **Reloadable Configuration**: Easily reload the plugin’s configuration using /holaalerts reload or /ha reload commands, enabling dynamic updates without server restarts. - ⛏️ **Customizable Alerts**: Offers highly configurable alert formats with MiniMessage support, allowing for rich text formatting, hover events, and click-to-copy functionality for player names. ## 🫙 Requirements - Velocity 3.3.0+ - Java 17+ ## ⚙️ Configuration HolaAlerts provides a comprehensive `config.yml` for full customization. **Word Filtering:**
Words configuration ``` filters: # List of words that will be censored in chat # You can add/remove words as needed swear-words: - example - test - badword # List of advertisement patterns to censor # These patterns will trigger advertisement alerts unless whitelisted ads: - .com - .net - example.org # List of advertisement patterns to exclude from censorship # Messages containing these patterns will not be censored for advertisements # Example: Add allowed domains like 'myserver.com' to prevent censorship ads-whitelist: - exmaple.com - example.net ```
**Discord webhook settings:**
Discord webhook configuration ``` discord: # Discord webhook URL for sending alerts # Obtain this from your Discord server: Server Settings > Integrations > Create Webhook webhook-url: "" # Enable or disable Discord webhook notifications enabled: false # Title for bad word alerts in Discord embeds bad-word-title: "⚠️ BAD WORD ALERT ⚠️" # Title for advertisement alerts in Discord embeds advertise-title: "🛡️ ADVERTISEMENT ALERT 🛡️" # Color for bad word alerts in Discord embeds (hex or decimal, e.g., "FF0000" or "16711680" for red) bad-word-color: "FF0000" # Color for advertisement alerts in Discord embeds (hex or decimal, e.g., "AA00FF" or "11141120" for purple) advertise-color: "FFF700" # Field name for the player in Discord embeds player-field-name: "Player" # Field name for the message in Discord embeds message-field-name: "Message" # Footer text for Discord embeds (e.g., server name or branding) footer: "" # Show timestamp in Discord embeds show-timestamp: true ```
## 📝 Commands **/holaalerts** or **/ha**: Displays the plugin information. **/holaalerts reload** or **/ha reload**: Reloads the configuration (requires holaalerts.reload permission). ## 🔐 Permissions **holaalerts.notify**: Receive in-game alerts for detected content. **holaalerts.bypass**: Bypass chat filtering. **holaalerts.reload**: Reload the plugin configuration. ## 🌟 Why Choose HolaAlerts? HolaAlerts is ideal for server administrators seeking a lightweight yet powerful solution for chat moderation. Its seamless integration with Discord, flexible configuration, and robust permission system make it suitable for servers of all sizes, from small communities to large networks. _**Developed by [M0_kii](https://github.com/M0-ki), HolaAlerts combines functionality with a polished user experience, ensuring your server remains a welcoming and controlled environment.**_

title: DevAuth Neo
description: Authenticate Minecraft accounts in development environments
body:
Authenticate Minecraft accounts in development environments. This is a "reincarnation" of [DevAuth](https://github.com/DJtheRedstoner/DevAuth) but improved, updated and available directly as a Fabric mod. ## Usage ### Adding the mod
via Maven Central (default) Add the following to ``build.gradle``: ```groovy dependencies { localRuntime 'net.litetex.mcm:dev-auth-neo:' // Further documentation: https://wiki.fabricmc.net/documentation:fabric_loom } ```
via Modrinth Add the following to ``build.gradle``: ```groovy repositories { // https://support.modrinth.com/en/articles/8801191-modrinth-maven exclusiveContent { forRepository { maven { name = "Modrinth" url = "https://api.modrinth.com/maven" } } filter { includeGroup 'maven.modrinth' } } } dependencies { localRuntime 'maven.modrinth:dev-auth-neo:' // Further documentation: https://wiki.fabricmc.net/documentation:fabric_loom } ```
### Quickstart IMPORTANT: **DevAuth is disabled by default**, in order to be unobtrusive.
The simplest way to enable it is by setting the corresponding system property: ``-Ddevauth.enabled=1`` * When launching for the first time you will be prompted to enter your credentials * You will also get hints on what to do in the console/logs when required * After the authentication was successful the generated tokens will be stored in `microsoft_accounts.json` * Future logins will try to reuse these tokens * The tokens are then delegated to the game and it starts as usual ### Configuration
The configuration is dynamically loaded from (sorted by highest priority) * Environment variables * prefixed with ``DEVAUTH_`` * all properties are in UPPERCASE and use `_` instead of `.` or `-` * System properties * prefixed with ``devauth.`` * A configuration file located in ``~/.dev-auth-neo/config.json``
Full list of configuration options #### General | Property | Type | Default | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `enabled` | `bool` | `false` | | | `account` | `String` | - | If not set:
Will be prompted via the console | | `account-type` | `String` | `microsoft` | Currently only Microsoft is supported | | `force-handle-all-tokens-as-expired` | `bool` | `false` | Handles all existing tokens as if they have expired and refreshes them | | `state-dir` | `String` | Automatically determined
`~/.dev-auth-neo`) | The directory where the login information of the provider will be saved | | `cache-profile-info-minutes` | `int` | `360`
6h | How long should fetched profile information(uuid and name) be cached? | #### Microsoft Grant-Flow options _NOTE: All grant-flow options are additionally prefixed with `microsoft.oauth2.`
For example `predefined-provider` must therefore be defined as `devauth.microsoft.oauth2.predefined-provider`_ | Property | Type | Default | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `grant-flow` | `String` | `auth-code-embedded` | See bellow for available flows | | `client-id` | `String` | automatically determined | Designed as general purpose override for e.g. a custom provider | | `scopes` | `List` | automatically determined | | #### `auth-code-embedded` Auth Code flow using an embedded browser * This login mechanism is identical to the one used by Minecraft's launcher * Therefore selected by default * This workflow downloads and installs a Chromium browser using CEF (Chromium Embedded Framework) * The download is around 150MB * It's installed by default into `~/.dev-auth-neo/jcef` | Property | Type | Default | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `use-temporary-cache-dir` | `bool` | `true` | Creates and uses a temporary directory for the browser cache.
If this is set to `false` all browser information (cookies, cache) and also possible logins will be persisted! | | `redirect-uri` | `String` | automatically determined | Designed as general purpose override for e.g. a custom provider | #### `auth-code-external` Auth Code flow using an external browser * Same as `auth-code-embedded` however this can be done with the system browser * Starts an integrated webserver to get the tokens at the end of the flow * ⚠ This flow depends on 3rd party clients / launchers * These clients are totally dependent on Mojangs [explicit approval](https://aka.ms/mce-reviewappid) and can - although unlikely to happen - be blocked at any time for any reason by them * The 3rd party can change or delete their client without warning * The 3rd party might be able to see your login activity * Available 3rd parties: * [DevAuth](https://github.com/DJtheRedstoner/DevAuth) (default) | Property | Type | Default | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `predefined-provider` | `String` | `devauth` | | | `open-system-browser` | `bool` | `true` | Should the system browser be automatically opened with the sign in page? | | `redirect-port` | `int` | automatically determined | Port used for the integrated webserver | | `redirect-uri` | `String` | automatically determined | Designed as general purpose override for e.g. a custom provider | #### `device-code` Device Code flow * This flow generates a short code that needs to be verified online with the an account * ⚠ This flow depends on 3rd party clients / launchers * These clients are totally dependent on Mojangs [explicit approval](https://aka.ms/mce-reviewappid) and can - although unlikely to happen - be blocked at any time for any reason by them * The 3rd party can change or delete their client without warning * The 3rd party might be able to see your login activity * Available 3rd parties: * [MultiMC](https://github.com/MultiMC/Launcher) (default) * [DevLogin](https://github.com/covers1624/DevLogin) * [Prism](https://github.com/PrismLauncher/PrismLauncher) | Property | Type | Default | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `predefined-provider` | `String` | `multimc` | |
## FAQ ### How do I delete the login information? Delete `%USERPROFILE%\.dev-auth-neo` (Windows) or `~/.dev-auth-neo` (Linux) ### I want to switch to another account _What's the easiest way to do this?_ Set ``-Ddevauth.account=otherAccountName`` ### Security? The tokens are stored in a file on the disk in above specified folder. As with all data on your PC, you as a user are responsible for keeping them secure. You can revoke tokens in the [Microsoft account settings](https://account.live.com/consent/Manage).

title: PlayerLocate
description: Client-side command to locate nearby players.
body:
This mod adds a `/playerlocate` command that allows you to locate players present in the world by retrieving their coordinates in real time.

## Usage:

``/playerlocate``  Displays the list of all nearby players, sorted from closest to farthest, with their exact coordinates (X, Y, Z) and their distance in meters.

``/playerlocate <player>``  Displays the coordinates of a specific player. Tab autocompletion is available.

``/playerlocate --npc``  Same as the base command, but also includes NPCs present on the server (excluded by default).

## Distance indicator:

🔴 Red — less than 50 meters

🟡 Yellow — between 50 and 150 meters

🟢 Green — more than 150 meters

This mod is client-side only, no server-side installation is required. It is compatible with all server types (Vanilla, Spigot, Paper, etc.) as long as Fabric and Fabric API are installed on the client.

title: Enchantments Rebalanced
description: Improves the broader enchanting process in multiple ways.
body:
[!["Minecraft Rebalanced" Collection by RainlessSky](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft%20Rebalanced-2A2B2F?style=flat-square&logo=modrinth&label=part%20of&labelColor=222329)](https://modrinth.com/collection/rWTOiG2z)
![Minecraft Rebalanced sees survival as a survival game, and less of a free sandbox.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/jPZFRfGa/images/7ebd705feba2a30b4017405ac475012e475fdcd5.png)
The goal of Enchantments Rebalanced is to improve unbalanced enchantments and to change how some enchantments are obtained, from an experienced player's perspective.

**This datapack needs plenty of constructive feedback, whether it's positive, mixed, or negative. Please join the Discord server and share your thoughts or suggestions!**
****

### A note about the design of Enchantments Rebalanced
Enchantments Rebalanced is created from the standpoint that some enchantments are imbalanced, and that most enchantments can be obtained too easily. While I understand that some may agree with these opinions, many likely don't.

**Don't *expect* your personal opinion to be validated and your own playstyle to be strengthened by Enchantments Rebalanced.**

****

### Changes
- Mending and Unbreaking are now mutually exclusive
  - This change introduces a tradeoff between two choices:
    - Equipment with infinite lifespan, at the expense of needing to go and repair more often, or;
    - Equipment that lasts longer, but will eventually need to be replaced
- All anvil costs for enchantments have been adjusted
  - This, for the most part, makes lower tier enchantments add 1-2 levels, medium tier add 3-4, and high tier add 4-8 levels.
- Anvils are now 8 iron ingots cheaper (31 -> 23)
- Librarian villagers can no longer sell Mending

title: Redmium
description: A mod pack made for low-end devices
body:
**As of version 1.2.0 Redmium also supports shaders, im too lazy to edit the whole description.** 

# **About Redmium**

Redmium is an ultra lightweight modpack specifically crafted for low-end devices such as laptops, office computers and even phones using java launchers to massively increase FPS and lower RAM usage, it has excellent compatibility with other mods and old devices. It uses only the essential mods and focuses on pure performance.

It is recommended to use **Java 25** with Redmium for optimal performace.

## **Performace**

> This version of Redmium is made just for increasing FPS, so it doesn't support shaders or has any additional mods.


## **Features**

> Redmium only adds Sodium Extra and Reese's Sodium Options, any other mod is for optimisation. **Shader support is here since 1.2.0**

## **Why use Redmium**

> Redmium has the lowest RAM usage and highest performance than any other optimisation modpack.

> Redmium will always be compatible with almost all mods and also the oldest devices.

> Redmium will work with only about 0.9GB of RAM, which is something no other modpack has done in the latest version of Minecraft.

>Redmium will have frequent updates, and update to latest versions of Minecraft fast with beta versions of the modpack.

> It has the highest performance compared to any modpack available on the internet, and **no one will ever do it better than Redmium!** (maybe)


# **Installation (Prism launcher)**

1. **Download and install** the Prism launcher app.
2. **Login** with  your account
3. **Click** add instance
4. **Click** on modrinth then search for Redmium
5. **Install** the Redmium modpack (should be the first search result)

# **Versions**


```
v[version]-[stage] version -> [major.minor.patch]
```
This kind of versioning is called **Semantic versioning**
I use it because it's the most widely used and easy to understand.


Convert the .mrpack to a .zip [here](https://mrpacktozip.playdown.in/) (this isn't an advertisment for the website)

# **FAQ**

Q:Is this a client side modpack?
A:Yes, it's client side and allowed on all servers.

A:Probably not.
