title: Zettai RPG
description: RPG mod adding 4 stats : Vitality, Strenght, Agility, Intelligence, and more to bring you more RPG experience!
body:
![Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/RDRDu7ji/images/c8bc3bc2d4627dcc260f65b82e6f64e23670dd24.png)
### This simple mod introduces four main stats: **Vitality**, **Strength**, **Agility** and **Intelligence**.
### And, one additional - **Mining skill**.
### 
You can upgrade them accordingly: **Vitality** by _taking damage_, **Strength** by _dealing physical damage_, **Agility** by _running_, **Intelligence** by _dealing magic damage_.
And, **Mining**, well... by... **MINING** xD

![Stats ... ehh Status?](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/RDRDu7ji/images/066e42a46fc378748a2c6495f3a0851f689eae28.png)
- **Vitality** increases your _maximal health_.
- **Strength** increases your _physical damage_.
- **Agility** increases your _jump strength_ and _running/swimming_ capabilities.
- **Intelligence** increases your _magical damage_.
- **Mining skill** increases your _mining speed_.
To see your progress press **P** (can be changed in control settings).

No annoying pop-ups, simple stats progression.
Simple mod.
Maybe in future will add chat notifications about your progress.

Mod can be configured in config file.
It also has two commands:

```
/setStat
```
 and 
```
/addStat
```


Capability system is taken and changed from [Electroblob's Wizardry](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/electroblobs-wizardry) mod.

title: Eldritch Awakening
description: A mod filled with overpowered loot and eldritch nightmares
body: Embark on a journey into the unknown with a mod that transforms your world, introducing eldritch horrors lurking in the shadows, mysterious new dimensions waiting to be explored, and powerful entities that will test your strength. Venture into the Eclipsed Dimension, a realm shrouded in darkness and secrets, where the mighty Malachar, the Fallen Seraph, awaits those brave enough to challenge him. # SUPREME HOMES 2.0

## ALERT
If you want to use the Economy system please install the [Vault API](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/)
 
## About the Supreme Homes 2.0 plugin

The Supreme Homes 2.0 is a little more code-optimzated the you ancestor, and with the admin-tools that let you see the players that have a home in your server and the homes of this players in a GUI where the red beds are for private homes (only the creator has access) and green beds are public homes (all players can access, it's useful for players shop or something like that ;)

This plugin is for player teleports, with this the player can set a home in a world, and after, if need back to this location, write /home <homename> in chat and he has teleport back for the location, the messages in lang/<LANG>.yml (Replace <LANG> with EN_US or PT_BR).

The plugin has too a system for vips, it needs activate the limit.isActive in config.yml, after this you can set your own vip tiers in the permissions.yml file

this plugin use public sethome too, a different set home very useful for player shops, with a public set home, anyone can teleport to a player home with the command /home public <playername> <homename>

Possibility to set a price to sethome or delhome or home teleport enabling the "active_economy" option in config.yml and customizing the prices in the Economy.yml (negative numbers add money to player, positive numbers remove money from the player and the price "0" unable the economy system for the command)

Possibility to set the delay for teleport in config.yml, if not enabled the teleport will be instant

Change the command sound in sounds.yml

## Main Features
- Sethome and homes for teleport
- Sethome and home for public use in the server
- Possibility to custom the messages in lang file
- Permissions
- VIPS tier (limited home with the vips in the server) controlled by server owner
- Custom CD in config.yml
- Sounds on use commands
- Economy system to set the command's price
- Titles on command
 
Admin Tools

Permission:

     suphomes.admin : General permission
     suphomes.show : Allow to use the /show command

Commands:

- /show [player name] - shows all the players that have a home, when clicked show the homes of this player, on click in the bed home you will be teleported; Optional: [player name] show all homes of this player


- Infinite tiers

For infinite tiers you can set it in permissions.yml file, you can create each tier in this with the structure:

```yaml
viptierN:

 limithomes: 10 # the limit of the homes in this tier
 message: a string list with the message that you will show when player reach the limit
   - 'Message that will showed'
   - 'You can make something beautiful with lists'
```
Commands
permission: suphomes.player
- /sethome <homename> //sets a new home
- /home <homename> //teleports to home
- /homes // show all player's home
- /delhome <homename> //delete a home

Public homes commands
permission: suphomes.public

- /setpublic<homename> //sets a public home
- /unsetpublic<playername> <homename> //teleports to a public home of a player

  Permissions

- suphomes.sethome - (set home command) command: /sethome <homename>
- suphomes.home - (home teleport command) command: /home <homename>
- suphomes.homes - (home list command) command: /homes
- suphomes.delhome - (Delete home command) command: /delhome <homename>
- suphomes.public.set - (Set home as public for other players) command: /setpublic <homename>
- suphomes.public.unset - (Set home as private only access for owner) command: /unsetpublic <homename>
- suphomes.player - (Allow to use all default home commands, this permission is allowed for default)
- suphomes.public - (Allow to use all public homes commands, this permission is not allowed for default)
- suphomes.admin : General permission for admin tools
- suphomes.show : Allow to use the /show command (admin tool)

## BStats metrics
It's a option in config.yml to send some statistics to [bstats](https://bstats.org/plugin/bukkit/Supreme%20Homes/10590)

title: ItemLocator
description: ItemLocator helps players track and locate items in Minecraft chests by marking their locations with glowing beacons, making organization and retrieval easier.
body:
# ItemLocator
ItemLocator is a useful Minecraft plugin designed for server administrators and players, providing an intuitive way to track and locate items in containers like chests, barrels, shulker boxes, and more. With advanced item tracking, players can easily find and organize their items with minimal effort, utilizing glowing beacons to mark item locations.

### Key Features:
- Track Item Locations: Automatically track the locations of items placed in chests or other containers.
- Glowing Beacons: Visualize item locations with glowing beams that can be seen through blocks, making it easy to find your stored items.
- Player-Specific Views: Each player can view their own tracked items in containers, ensuring that no one else can see your chest's contents.
- GUI-Based Searching: Players can open a custom GUI that displays all tracked items, allowing for quick navigation and retrieval.
- Command-Based Search: Players can search for specific items using a simple command and view their locations instantly.
- Customizable Permissions: Server administrators can configure who has access to item tracking and searching features, maintaining control over player actions.
### Commands:
- /itemlocator gui – Opens a GUI displaying all tracked items for the player.
- /itemlocator locate <material> – Searches for a specific item by name and displays its locations.
### Support and Contributions:
If you encounter any issues or would like to contribute to the development of this plugin, feel free to visit the GitHub repository and follow the contributing guidelines.

title: Printer Datapack
description: This datapack adds a way to shrink down any build to a single block!
body:
## About
This Datapack adds a way to shrink down any build to a single block! Requires you to have OP commands.

## New
This is a short list of all the new features. For more information, expand the tabs bellow.
- Printing Selection (x16, x32 and x64)
- Printing Location
- Print Remover

<details>

<summary> Printing Selection </summary>

Before you print, select whatever area you want. There are three sizes when selecting: **16x16x16, 32x32x32 and 64x64x64**. To select an area, place down the selection spawn eggs. They can be obtained using **/function give:print_X** with X being 16, 32 or 64. When placing the spawn egg you will grab the lowest x,y,z coordinates of your selection. Additionally, there will be a preview to see the area you selected.
### ![SelEggs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2VwwWx2r/images/7e387efd2340dedac8f682bfdea4a40929dad509.png)
![https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2VwwWx2r/images/15a7256849674e7decaee7696910db75e4aea7c4.png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2VwwWx2r/images/15a7256849674e7decaee7696910db75e4aea7c4.png)

</details>


<details>
<summary> Printing Location </summary>

Can be obtained using **/function give:print_location**.
Place down to select the spot where you would like to have your print. There will be a preview to see the area the print will be made. Left-Click the printing location to remove the location and to remove the selection. Right-Click the printing location to start printing. 
### ![https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2VwwWx2r/images/ca0f05de83a81d8674e1ae98551e28aa78e4aab6.png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2VwwWx2r/images/ca0f05de83a81d8674e1ae98551e28aa78e4aab6.png)
![https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2VwwWx2r/images/676b141ee5c75eed9eb30f4ce5bb862aab1c43d3.png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2VwwWx2r/images/676b141ee5c75eed9eb30f4ce5bb862aab1c43d3.png)

</details>


<details>

<summary> Print Remover </summary>

Can be obtained using **/function give:print_remover**.
Place down to remove any print made on that block.
![https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2VwwWx2r/images/3b38158cd9f7cada4249f59179e0ab34d6878d7b.png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2VwwWx2r/images/3b38158cd9f7cada4249f59179e0ab34d6878d7b.png)

</details>

The prints are made out of **block displays**, which are entities. With small prints, such as 16x16x16, this won't produce any lag. However, large prints using the 64x64x64 printer may result in lag, and may take hours to complete.

## ⚠️  Bugs
If you notice any bugs report them in the **[bugs]** text channel in [my discord server](https://discord.gg/eZEHeNbzUE)

## Download
To download the datapack, you have two options to add it to your world:
- **Creating a new world:**
  1. Download the **Printer_Datapack.zip file**
  2. Click **Create new world** in minecraft
  3. Click **Data Packs**
  4. Drag the **Printer_Datapack.zip file** into there, and make sure you put it on the 'selected' side (right side)

- **Add to existing world:**
  1. Download the **Printer_Datapack.zip file**
  2. Select your world in the single player menu
  3. Click **Edit** at the bottom of the screen
  4. Click **Open World Folder**
  5. Click on the **datapacks** folder
  6. Drag the **Printer_Datapack.zip file** into there

title: MobSteer | Ride Mobs & WASD Control
description: Ride mobs and control any mob that can move using WASD movement!
body:
# MobSteer
### Take full control over practically any mob in Minecraft!

> ✅ **Versions:** **1.21.x** – **26.2**

> ⚠️ **Required:** **Paper** / **Purpur** or other Paper-based forks

> 🚫 **Not supported:** **Folia** / **Spigot**

## Description
**MobSteer** is a **Rideable mobs** plugin that allows you to ride and control almost any mob in the game. Do you want to fly with a bee, swim with a dolphin, or just walk around with a chicken? This plugin lets you do just that! You can control almost all mobs using the WASD keys.

## Features
* **Right-Click & Ride:** No commands needed, simply right-click any mob and start controlling it instantly.
* **Full Control:** Take charge of almost any mob using WASD (fly, swim, walk).
* **Compatibility:** Works with most monsters and animals, optimized for Purpur and Paper.
* **Customization:** Fully configurable dismount style, speeds, and taming rules.
* **Ender Dragon:** Can be ridden, but beware it may break blocks!

## Gameplay
![Gameplay GIF](https://i.imgur.com/MGNpJEO.gif)

## Commands
Use `/steer` to mount a mob, and `/msr` for configuration.

* `/steer` - Use this command to mount and control a mob.
* `/msr reload` - Reloads the configuration file.
* `/msr blacklist [add|remove] <mob>` - Manages the mob blacklist.
* `/msr ride [all|user] <true|false>` - Allows riding and /steer for everyone or a specific player.
* `/msr hover <true|false>` - Toggle hover mode.
* `/msr autostep <true|false>` - Toggle auto step.
* `/msr falldamage <true|false>` - Toggle fall damage
* `/msr invulnerable <true|false>` - Toggle ridden mob invulnerability
* `/msr merchants <true|false>` - Allow riding trading merchants

## Notes
* Horses and similar mobs have a custom vanilla like taming system provided by this plugin by default.

## Configuration
* **Custom Dismount:** Choose between vanilla dismounting or requiring a triple shift to get off.
* **Speed Control:** Override speed for all mobs or set specific speeds for Ender Dragons, Withers, etc.
* **Blacklist:** Easily restrict certain mobs from being ridden.
* **Taming System:** Control if players can ride their own pets or pets belonging to others.
* **Invulnerability:** Make the mob invulnerable while being ridden.
* **Messages & ActionBar:** Fully customize all plugin messages (supports MiniMessage and legacy colors).
* **Hooks:** Integration with WorldGuard, LuckPerms (group-based restrictions) and GadgetsMenu pets.

## Permissions
* `mobsteer.use` - Allows riding mobs.
* `mobsteer.steer` - Allows using the `/steer` command. (requires mobsteer.use to work)
* `mobsteer.admin` - Access to administrative commands (`/msr`) and bypasses all mount restrictions.
* `mobsteer.*` - Full access to the plugin.

## Statistics
[![bStats](https://bstats.org/signatures/bukkit/MobSteer.svg)](https://bstats.org/plugin/bukkit/MobSteer/29842)

title: Trident Killers 4 Java
description: Bedrock-style trident killers for Java Edition — no carpets, no gimmicks. Throw a trident, aim a piston at it, farm. Server-side only.
body:
# Trident Killers 4 Java

**Bedrock-style trident killers for Minecraft: Java Edition.** Server-side.

Bedrock players have enjoyed trident killers for years: throw a trident, point a piston at it, and
the moving trident kills mobs with full player credit — the heart of countless XP and drop farms.
Java never natively had it. Now it does through a Fabric Mod, and the Java version is better than the original.

## Why this mod beats other solutions

**No carpets. No gimmicks.** Datapack-based attempts at Java trident killers can't touch the game's
collision rules, so they resort to making the trident ride a piston-pushed carpet — fragile setups
where the trident falls off, lands somewhere useless, and goes dead. This mod works at the game
level: stick a trident anywhere, aim a piston at it, done. The contraption is exactly as simple as
Bedrock's — simpler, because the trident can't escape.

**The trident is rock-solid.** Once a piston has touched it, the trident is locked in place: it
never drifts, never sinks, can't be shoved around by mobs crowding it, and **never despawns** —
it stays until a player picks it up. Build the farm once; it runs forever.

**Water-friendly.** Run water straight through the kill chamber to move mobs or items -- waterlog stairs to thread a flow at any height -- and the locked trident still won't budge. Other trident killers drift the instant water touches them; this one holds its spot in a current.

**Player-safe by design.** The killer damages mobs and *only* mobs. Players are never harmed —
even standing directly inside the kill zone with the pistons running, you take zero damage
(tested). No item destruction, no XP-orb destruction, no PvP griefing vector. Bedrock can't say
the same.

**Kill credit done right.** Kills count as player kills for the thrower: XP drops, Looting
multiplies drops, and player-only drops work. And it keeps working **while you're offline** —
loot keeps flowing into your hoppers, while XP is automatically suppressed so orbs don't pile up
and lag the server while nobody's there to collect them.

**Enchantments behave exactly as they should.**

Impaling: Full bonus damage — melts aquatic mobs
Looting: Multiplies drops, verified
Channeling: Ignored — no surprise lightning in your farm
Riptide: Ignored (can't be thrown anyway)
Loyalty: Vanilla behavior (returns after a hit — use a non-Loyalty trident for farms)
Unbreaking / Mending | The trident takes no durability from killer hits

**Bedrock-style pickup.** Any player can pick up a killer trident, not just its owner — just like
Bedrock.

**Everything else stays vanilla.** A trident that has never been moved by a piston is completely
untouched: it despawns on the vanilla timer, other mods can manage it freely. This mod governs
only tridents you've deliberately put to work.

**Server-side only.** Drop one jar in the server's `mods` folder. Every client can connect —
vanilla or modded, nothing to install client-side. Works in singleplayer too.

## How to build one

1. Throw a trident where you want the killer.
2. Aim a piston at it and put the piston on a clock.
3. Funnel mobs into the trident. That's it — no carpet, no entity tricks.

Damage lands on each piston extension: vanilla trident damage (8) plus enchantments, hitting every
mob in the trident's hitbox at once. Standard hurt immunity paces it at roughly one hit per piston
cycle, just like Bedrock.

## Requirements

- Minecraft: Java Edition 26.1.2
- Fabric Loader 0.15+
- No other dependencies

## Development & licensing

This mod is an original, independent implementation — it contains no Mojang/Microsoft code and no
code from any other mod or datapack. Development practice and design records: see `CLEANROOM.md`
and `FUNCTIONAL_SPEC.md` in this repository.

All rights reserved. © Kishku7

title: MCA Reborn x Easy Villagers Compat
description: MCA x EV Compat is a compatibility addon created to improve integration between Easy Villagers and MCA Reborn.
body:
# MCA Reborn x Easy Villagers Compat

**MCA Reborn x Easy Villagers Compat** is an unofficial compatibility addon for **Minecraft Comes Alive Reborn** and **Easy Villagers**.

It allows MCA Reborn villagers to work with Easy Villagers while preserving their identity, appearance, profession, family data and relationships.

## Short Description

Makes Easy Villagers work with MCA Reborn villagers while preserving MCA identity, appearance, profession, family data and relationships.

## Features

- Pick up MCA Reborn villagers using Easy Villagers.
- Restore the original MCA villager instead of converting it into a vanilla villager.
- Preserve MCA data such as appearance, name, gender, personality, genetics, family, relationships and profession.
- Prevent villager duplication during pickup and restoration.
- Show the real MCA villager name on stored villager items.
- Render MCA villagers in the inventory, hotbar, GUI and supported Easy Villagers blocks.
- Supports Trader, Breeder, Farmer, Converter, Incubator and Iron Farm blocks.
- Generate MCA babies in the Breeder when both parents are MCA villagers.
- Preserve MCA babies in the Incubator and advance their MCA age data safely.
- Run a safe MCA Converter path that correctly applies the cure reputation result.
- Prevent MCA villagers from opening the vanilla merchant screen when picked up.
- Configure stored MCA villager sounds to use MCA voices, Easy Villagers default sounds or muted sounds.
- Configure sound behavior by action, including pickup, inventory, block insertion, block removal and block processing.
- Configure sound behavior by block, including Trader, Breeder, Farmer, Iron Farm, Converter and Incubator.
- Use simplified common and client configs.
- Keep compatibility, rendering and debug options available for troubleshooting and modpack use.

## Dependencies

Required:

- Minecraft Comes Alive Reborn for Forge 1.20.1
- Easy Villagers for Forge 1.20.1

## Notes

This mod does not include or redistribute Minecraft Comes Alive Reborn or Easy Villagers. Both mods are required separately.

This is an unofficial compatibility addon.

Back up your world before installing or updating mods, especially if you already have villagers stored inside Easy Villagers blocks.

## Feedback and Suggestions

If you have any questions, issues or run into any problems, please feel free to leave your feedback.

Ideas for new mods, improvements or future features are always welcome.

title: Gamingecke Create 2026

body:
Gamingecke Create 2026 is a comprehensive tech and building modpack centered around the Create mod. It combines complex automation, immersive engineering, and breathtaking world generation with essential performance and quality-of-life tweaks for a smooth, highly engaging Minecraft experience.

### Features
- **Engineering and Automation:** The heart of the pack. With Create and its many addons, you'll construct sprawling machinery, design complex train networks using Steam 'n' Rails and Railways Navigator, generate power via Diesel Generators and Crafts & Additions, extract resources with Ore Excavation, and automate everything from food processing (Central Kitchen, Slice & Dice, Confectionery, Bitterballen) to experience management through the Enchantment Industry.
- **Technology and Logic:** Keep your factories running precisely with advanced redstone circuits via Project Red Transmission and fully programmable computers thanks to CC: Tweaked.
- **Building and Decoration:** Give your industrial empire a personality. Create Deco, Interiors, Copycats+, Vibrant Vaults, and Bells & Whistles offer a wealth of architectural options to make every build your own.
- **World Generation:** Tectonic delivers breathtaking, completely overhauled landscapes, while the YUNG's Better series breathes fresh life into familiar vanilla structures.
- **Performance:** Even the most complex contraptions run smoothly, thanks to Sodium, Lithium, ImmediatelyFast, FerriteCore, and Dynamic FPS keeping framerates stable and servers healthy.
- **Immersive Atmosphere:** Shaders give the world a stunning visual overhaul, while Sound Physics Remastered and Create: Sound of Steam add realistic acoustics and authentic mechanical audio to round out the experience.
- **Navigation and Mapping:** Xaero's Maps makes exploration effortless, and Distant Horizons pushes your view distance far enough to take in your factories and Tectonic's landscapes in their full scale.
- **Information and Claiming:** JEI keeps even the most complex recipes manageable, Jade provides detailed block and entity information at a glance, Lighty highlights mob-spawnable areas, and Open Parties and Claims keeps your hard-built factories safe from unwanted visitors.
- **Quality of Life:** Sophisticated Backpacks, Inventory Essentials, and Mouse Tweaks make managing your inventory a breeze. Carry On lets you relocate functional blocks with ease, Zoomify gives you precise zoom control, and Not Enough Animations adds a layer of polish to character movement.
- **Communication and Social Features:** Simple Voice Chat enables direct in-game voice communication, Chat Heads makes it easier to identify who's talking in chat, and Sit lets players kick back and relax between build sessions.
- **Utilities:** Auto Reconnect Reforged automatically reconnects you to the server after a disconnection, so you can get back to building without the hassle of logging in again.

### Notes

- Created for [Gamingecke.space](https://discord.gamingecke.space/) but available to anyone seeking a expanded Create experience.

title: Pixelmon Ranger Gigaremo
description:
A mod adding Gigaremo units to the Pixelmon Reforged mod.
Also adds custom field moves, NPCs, equipment, and an economic system.
body:
**For MC 1.21.1, NeoForge**

Having a passion for the Ranger series of games, I've created a side mod for the Pixelmon Reforged mod.

This mod adds Gigaremo units to the game, a custom Flood Move Skill, multiple new NPC Presets, multiple new armours, and an entire new economic system for your reputation with the Rangers.

When activated, Gigaremo units run a silent command that detects any Pixelmon entering within a 24 block radius, and sets them to have maximum aggression. This means that any Pixelmon that have been in range of a Gigaremo's effect will actively hunt down survival mode players to engage in combat. Config settings are also available to change the effect range to as small as 10 blocks, or as large as 60, and Pixelmon can also be set to emit particles when affected (off by default)

Gigaremo units come in four different colours, and can all be crafted with their corresponding Concrete and Elemental Evolution Stone.

When placed by players, the Gigaremo will be in an inactive state. Gigaremo can be activated by using Black Tumblestone on them, and when activated will feature an animated model.

Before they are activated, Gigaremo can be broken with a pickaxe to drop themselves. However, once activated, Gigaremo will no longer drop themselves and will instead drop a Broken Gigaremo when broken with a pickaxe. Additionally, Activated Gigaremo take a long time to break with a pickaxe, as the intention is that they be broken by Move Skills (which break them instantly).

- Blue Gigaremo can be broken using the Lightning Bolt Move Skill.
- Green Gigaremo can be broken by the Ignite Move Skill.
- Yellow Gigaremo can be broken by the Rock Smash Move Skill.
- Red Gigaremo can be broken by the Flood Move Skill, introduced in this mod.

The Flood Move Skill is usable by any Pixelmon knowing any appropriate water attack (hydro pump, water gun, water sport, etc). This move creates a water source block at the target location, and can waterlog blocks and fill cauldrons. In the Nether, this move skill produces unique results.

Players will gain (or lose!) reputation with the Ranger Union based on actions interacting with this mod, tracked through Ranger Points. Activating Gigaremo hurts a players reputation, while destroying them, fighting DimSun members, and calming enraged Pixelmon will help their reputation. The Ranger Union has quartermaster NPC's that will supply players with items based on their reputation - players with better reputations will have access to more items, while players with particularly bad reputations will be seen as criminals themselves.

Players can trade Ranger Points for new custom armours, the best of which even have special inherent effects.

NPCs spawn in relevant structures - Rangers will spawn in Ranger Stations found in Plains Villages, while villain teams have their own structures in the wilderness (needs to be enabled in config).

This mod requires the Pixelmon Reforged mod for full functionality, however if you do not have Pixelmon this mod will still load (although commands, NPCs, some structure elements, block state changes, and the custom Move Skill will not work).

**Known Issues**

- Destruction of Gigaremo through methods other than Move Skills award points to the nearest player, not necessarily the player who caused the destruction.
- The icon for the Flood move skill is a placeholder.
- NPC battle teams and rewards aren't necessarily properly balanced.
- All container loot tables are placeholders.
- The new plains village road piece doesn't convert to oak planks in water.
- I know the models are a little ugly, I am focusing on functionality.


**Future Plans**

- More World Gen!

title: ZyrenAuth
description:
ZyrenAuth is a secure and modern authentication plugin/mod for Minecraft 1.21.1+ servers.
It focuses on account security, player privacy, and a smooth login experience.
Supports both Paper and Fabric servers.
body:
ZyrenAuth

A modern, high-performance, and privacy-focused server-side authentication platform for Paper.

--- ### **Overview** **ZyrenAuth** is a robust account security and cryptographic authentication lifecycle utility engineered explicitly for Paper and Spigot-compatible server environments. It intercepts player network connections to execute mandatory validation challenges, establishing a strict data barrier that protects player states, inventories, and profile configurations until verification parameters are successfully met. --- ### **Key Features** * **Reverse Word Captcha Verification** — Enforces a randomized reverse-string algorithmic challenge instantly upon connection, preventing automated credential stuffing and bot injection vectors. * **Graphical 2FA Initialization** — Features an in-game GUI pipeline (`/za 2fa setup`) that generates and projects local 2FA secret key states and QR code URIs directly to authenticator applications. * **Isolated Space Teleportation** — Seamlessly forces unauthenticated connections onto a locked, safe void coordinate context (`0.5, 0.0, 0.5`), completely suppressing network world interactions and movement events until verification succeeds. * **Persistent State Persistence** — Automatically serializes and caches complete player data matrices—including inventories, vector positions, active status effects, food boundaries, and experience blocks—restoring them seamlessly upon successful lifecycle completion. * **Intelligent Network Profiling** — Dual-mode operation handling: * *Online-Mode Pipelines:* Seamlessly authenticates valid Mojang verification hashes while managing dynamic username updates. * *Offline-Mode Fallbacks:* Automates session persistence for pre-registered users while enforcing strict registration protocols for unrecognized profiles. * **Asynchronous Release Auditing** — Connects non-blockingly to Modrinth asset channels on startup to evaluate, verify, and notify console administrators of available optimization payloads. * **Enterprise Storage Ingestion** — Supports relational MySQL and MariaDB database storage engines for multi-server synchronization, complete with a structured, encrypted file-based archive fallback. --- ### **Quick Start & Deployment** 1. **Deployment:** Drop the compiled `ZyrenAuth` binary archive directly into the active server `plugins/` directory. 2. **Initialization:** Run the server lifecycle to instantiate the primary configuration schema at `plugins/config/zyrenauth/`. 3. **Configuration Extraction:** Utilize the [Online Configuration Generator](https://zyrenauth.wuaze.com/) to easily compile and modify variables within the local `config.json` payload. --- ### **Command Framework Syntax** #### **User Interaction Group** * `/register ` — Establishes a new cryptographically hashed profile record. * `/login ` — Initiates a BCrypt validation challenge to unlock player interaction parameters. * `/captcha ` — Supplies the response payload to the active reverse-string challenge. * `/addemail ` — Connects an SMTP-reachable tracking address to the profile context. * `/emailconfirm ` — Validates email ownership tokens. * `/resetpassword` & `/resetconfirm` — Handles remote recovery routines. #### **Administrative Controls (OP Only)** * `/za help` — Maps the entire executable subcommand tree. * `/za status` — Evaluates localized storage engine metrics and performance health states. * `/za reload` — flushes and hot-reloads configuration matrix parameters directly from disk memory. * `/za migrate ` — Manages data profile migrations across active infrastructure contexts. * `/za delete [confirm]` — Completely purges targeted user authentication blocks. ---

Available exclusively for the Paper and Spigot Server ecosystem.

title: Rainbow Wood
description: Adds tintable wooden blocks which you can color with dyes
body:
# Rainbow Wood [![discord-singular](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/social/discord-singular_vector.svg)](https://discord.offsetmonkey538.top/) [![modrinth](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/modrinth_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/rainbow-wood) [![Requires Fabric API](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/requires/fabric-api_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) **Adds new tintable variants for all vanilla wooden items.** In case the 11 wood types from vanilla aren't enough, now you can have ~16.5 million different ones!¹ ###### ¹ One for each possible RGB color, but most of them look the same and thus are pointless haha
Full list of new tintable items - Log - Stripped Log - Wood - Stripped Wood - Planks - Stairs - Slab - Fence Gate - Fence Gate - Door - Trapdoor - Pressure Plate - Button - Sign - Hanging Sign - Hanging Sign - Boat - Chest Boat
## Acquiring In creative mode, just open the creative menu and there are 76 different colors available in the "Rainbow Wood" tab. When playing survival, you first have to get *uncolored* items before coloring them. To do that, you can drop any normal wooden item into a cauldron filled with water. You can also craft colored items from other colored items (i.e. stairs from planks, fences from planks and sticks), just make sure that the inputs all have the same color.
Colors can be applied in two ways: ### Averaging This is the default way. It gets the average color of the input items, and then applied it to the output. The inputs can contain other tinted items of the same type (i.e. you can't combine stairs with a slab) or dyes. Examples:
Red Dye + Blue Dye + Uncolored Planks

Coloring planks with a Red Dye (RGB of 255, 0, 0) and Blue Dye (RGB of 0, 0, 255) results in colored planks with the color of (127, 0, 127) as that is the average.

Red Dye + Uncolored Planks

Coloring planks with a Red Dye (RGB of 255, 0, 0) results in colored planks with the color of (255, 0, 0) aka red.

Blue Dye + Uncolored Planks

Coloring planks with a Blue Dye (RGB of 0, 0, 255) results in colored planks with the color of (0, 0, 255) aka blue.

Red Planks + Blue Planks

Combining red planks (RGB of 255, 0, 0) with blue planks (RGB of 0, 0, 255) results in 2 colored planks with the color of (127, 0, 127) as that is the average.

Purple Planks + Uncolored Planks

It is also possible to combine uncolored items with colored items, which will result in duplication of the colored items. Combining purple planks (RGB of 127, 0, 127) with uncolored planks results in 2 colored planks with the color of (127, 0, 127).

### Adding To add the RGB values of the inputs, you need to put an **Iron Ingot** into the recipe as a *modifier*. Examples:
Red Dye + Blue Dye + Uncolored Planks

Coloring planks with a Red Dye (RGB of 255, 0, 0) and Blue Dye (RGB of 0, 0, 255) results in colored planks with the color of (255, 0, 255).

Red Planks + Blue Planks

Combining red planks (RGB of 255, 0, 0) with blue planks (RGB of 0, 0, 255) results in 2 colored planks with the color of (255, 0, 255).

title: Souls Forge
description: Use the souls of your enemies to create new Weapons and Armour.
body:
This datapack introduces a whole new style of magic to your Minecraft worlds, with access to Soul Shards, a unique system that enhances gameplay through experience-based mechanics and combat.

# What To Expect:
### Soul Shards
Collect experience points inside an Amethyst Shard. This converts your XP into Soul Shards, which can then be used for crafting new materials and weapons.

### Soul Shard Blocks
A unique feature of the datapack, Soul Shard Blocks shatter when a player falls from a height of more than 4 blocks, scattering a random amount of Soul Shards.

### Soul Silver Ingots
Soul Silver is created by combining Soul Shards, Echo Shards and Iron Ingots. Use it to craft the new weapons and armour.

### Silver Armour
Crafted from Soul Silver, this armour provides strong protection (slightly weaker than Netherite without knockback resistance) and gives the unique ability to make nearby Illagers neutral. It can be repaired with Soul Silver.

### Soul Totem
This item is craftable from Soul Shards and Soul Silver Ingots an will save you from death! When used it will break, losing its lush and colour. You can recharge it by crafting it with a single soul shard to breathe new life into it, and yourself!

## Soul Weapons
This pack adds a range of weapons made from Soul Shards and Soul Silver. These weapons come with unique abilities and are repairable using Soul Silver:

**Soul Spear:** A long-range melee weapon with moderate attack power.

**Soul Sword:** A generic, straightforward soul weapon.

**Soul Axe:** A powerful weapon that can also chop down trees.

**Soul Hammer:** The strongest of the soul weapons, capable of dealing AoE damage and breaking fragile blocks.

### Soul Enchantments
Absorb XP with your Soul Weapon to fill a Soul Bar. When the bar is full, the weapon receives a random Soul Enchantment that enhances its stats or grants special abilities.

# FAQ's
Any questions asked in other channels will appear here. (Feel free to join the discord to ask a question! The discord also comes with Wiki pages for all new packs.)

description: Unveil the secrets of the End with Nihilite, a rare end-game ore that unlocks new tools, armor, and a dynamic rune system, alongside a unique progression system to level up your Nihilite tools as you explore the mysteries of the Void!
body:
**_Check the gallery for more  recipes and pictures of the mod!_**

**Nihilite** introduces exciting new features and mechanics centered around a **powerful new End-exclusive ore, Nihilite**. This mod enriches the End exploration experience with challenging gameplay, unique tools, and rewarding progression systems.

![Nihilite armor and sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8fcee018df2b33e3a69731338b171092924e2ebc_0.webp)
![Nihilite Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aeed55858822476202ff78ac86a6375f66acc7ae.webp)

## New Features

![Nihilite Ores](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/10edca3cf34ce74ff0b72810f4797ce157f742dd_0.webp)
### Nihilite Ore:
Found exclusively in the End dimension.

**Challenging to mine:**
Drains your hunger based on how much Raw Nihilite you carry.
Spawns Endermites that attack you when mined.

**Purpose:** Collect Nihilite to craft powerful tools, armor, runes and engage with its unique progression systems.

### Nihilite Armor:
Grants immunity to lightning strikes, making it essential for players who face stormy challenges or wield the Nihilite Sword.

### Nihilite Tools:

**Infinite Durability:** Never worry about repairing or replacing these tools.

**Nihilite Sword:**
Chance to summon a lightning strike on enemies when attacking.

**Level-Up System:** Improves with monster kills, enhancing damage and lightning power over time.

**Nihilite Pickaxe:**

**Ore Detection:** Highlights nearby ores outside of your field of vision while mining.

**Level-Up System:** Improves mining speed as you gather ores.

**New End Structures:**
Scattered across the End, these ruins contain rare End-themed loot, including Nihilite resources, tools, and treasures.

## Rune System Features

![Awakening Runes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5a77fb66855e73a2b447c3ccf86fb65287267fa6.png)

**Sleeping Runes:**
Extremely Rare Loot: Dropped by any mob with a 0.1% chance.
Unusable in their base form: Must be awakened to unlock their potential.

**Awakening Runes:**
Combine a Sleeping Rune with 8 Nihilite Blocks to create an Awakened Rune.
Costly but powerful upgrade: Awakening requires significant End exploration and mining effort.

**Awakened Runes:**
When held in the off-hand slot, each Awakened Rune provides a strong bonus:
For example, Rune of Swiftness: Grants Speed II for faster movement.
Additional rune types can grant bonuses like Strength, Regeneration, or Resistance.
            
This mod enhances End gameplay with unique challenges, progression mechanics, and rewarding exploration for seasoned adventurers. Venture into the Void and uncover the power of Nihilite!


**_Check the gallery for more  recipes and pictures of the mod!_**

title: Custom Creations
description: A plugin which lets you create custom abilities for items without writing a single line of code!
body:
# MCCustomCreation
A minecraft plugin for creating custom items abilities without touching even 1 line of code!

Have you ever thought about an item, an ability which does not exist yet. Which should be created and will be so fun to use, yet, holded back because you couldnt create it? If that is the case, this plugin is just for you! It will let you create any ability you have ever thought of without touching a single line of code!

The plugin uses GUIs and components named "Nodes" that the player can combine together to make his own custom abilities to sepcific events. The sum of all abilities in a single item are called a "Creation".

![Custom Events!](https://github.com/ODINN555/MCCustomCreation/raw/main/PageImages/Events.jpg)
![Custom Events!](https://github.com/ODINN555/MCCustomCreation/raw/main/PageImages/actions_preview.jpg)


# Setup
Download the plugin and put it in the server's plugins folder. This plugin requires ProtocolLib, so download it and put it in the server's plugins folder as well.

# Commands
- /CustomCreation Help - shows the list of commands and their detailed description.
- /CustomCreation Create - creates a new Creation.
- /CustomCreation Remove - deletes a Creation.
- /CustomCreation Duplicate - creates a new creation with the abilities of the duplicated creation.
- /CustomCreation test - for tests purpuses (BETA), not in use in general.
# Settings
The settings listed in the config:
- FileManagerType - The file manager which saves the creations. YAML by default. (Do not change this unless - there is another FileManager of a different type).
- MessageLogging - If error messages to players should be logged in console. By default - true.
- NodeBlacklist - The list of blacklisted nodes which won't be registered by the plugin. By default- empty list.(NOTE: To list a node, you will need it's key name. By default, most of the keys are the node's name but with caps, for example, TELEPORT_ENTITY. For further information, see the guide on the github page)
# Guide
See the "Aspect of The Creation" guide on the [GitHub Page](https://github.com/ODINN555/MCCustomCreation#walkthrough---aspect-of-the-creation).

# Contact
If you need help, or you wanna leave a suggestion, bug report, an idea, a review or just a good note. Feel free to DM me on discord (send a message request, do not friend me), username: odinn555, or write it on the github page.

title: [SimplePetsAddon] WorldRestriction Addon
description: This addon simply restricts certain tasks from happening in certain worlds
body:
## ***What is this addon?***

This is a simple [SimplePets](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simplepets) Addon that allows server owners/admins restrict what can happen in certain worlds, such as pet mounting and making them a hat

## ***Plugin/Resource Links:***
* [SimplePets](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simplepets) ***(REQUIRED)***

## ***How to install:***

The addon can be installed a few different ways it can be done via the install command, via the GUI installer, or manually

### ***Install via Command:*** (Easiest)
* Simply type the *`/pet addon install WorldRestriction`* command
    It will also attempt to load and enable it

### ***Install via GUI Installer:***


* Run the *`/pet addon`* command
* Click the *`Install Addons`* item that is in the bottom row of the GUI
* Locate the *`WorldRestriction`* item in the GUI
* Once found simply click it

***NOTE:*** If it gets stuck saying "Installing..." then check your console for any errors, If there are none then try one of the other methods.

### ***Install Manually:***


* Open the SimplePets plugin folder
* Open the *`Addons`* folder
    (If the folder is not there then simply create one)
* Download the addon from one of the download locations
* Drop the addons jar file into the *`Addons`* folder
* Restart your server (This is to actually get the addon loaded into the plugin)



## ***Default Config:***
```yaml
world-restrictions:
  pet-riding:
    # Should this restriction be enabled?
    enabled: false
    
    # List the worlds that pet riding should not be allowed in here.
    list:
    - world_nether
    
    # This message gets sent to the player when they try to ride a pet in a blocked world
    reason: '&cPet riding is disabled in this world'
    
  pet-hat:
    # Should this restriction be enabled?
    enabled: false
    
    # List the worlds that pet hats should not be allowed in here.
    list:
    - world_nether
    
    # This message gets sent to the player when they try to put their pet on their head in a blocked world
    reason: '&cPutting your pet on your head is disabled in this world'
```

title: Minecraft, But It Rains Random Blocks..
description: Random blocks begin falling from the sky, turning the world into a chaotic and ever-changing survival challenge. Adapt quickly, dodge the falling blocks, and use the unpredictable terrain to your advantage!
body:
# Minecraft, But It Rains Random Blocks..


## How to Change Rain Speed?

```
/trigger rbr_speed_up
/trigger rbr_speed_down
/trigger rbr_speed_status
```

**Minecraft, But It Rains Random Blocks** transforms the weather system into a chaotic survival challenge where hundreds of different blocks can fall from the sky at any moment. From simple stone and dirt to rare ores, decorative blocks, and even dangerous materials, every rainstorm reshapes the world around you.

What begins as a normal survival world can quickly turn into a constantly evolving landscape. Mountains can appear out of nowhere, caves can become sealed shut, and valuable resources may literally fall from the sky. Every playthrough is unique as the environment changes naturally over time.

Whether you're trying to survive the chaos, build automated farms around the falling blocks, or simply watch your world transform into a massive collection of random structures, this datapack adds an entirely new challenge to Minecraft survival.

## Features

* Random blocks continuously fall from the sky.
* Hundreds of different block types can appear.
* The landscape evolves naturally as blocks accumulate.
* Valuable resources can become obtainable through rainfall.
* Compatible with singleplayer and multiplayer worlds.
* Creates unique survival scenarios every time you play.
* Lightweight and optimized for long-term survival worlds.
* Works alongside most vanilla-friendly datapacks.

## Gameplay Ideas

* Start a new survival world and adapt to the changing terrain.
* Challenge yourself to survive only using resources provided by block rain.
* Compete with friends to survive the longest.

## Installation Guide

### Singleplayer Installation

1. Download the datapack.
2. Open Minecraft and create a new world, or select an existing world.
3. Click **Edit** on the world you want to use.
4. Click **Open World Folder**.
5. Open the **datapacks** folder.
6. Place the downloaded datapack ZIP file inside the folder.
7. Launch the world.
8. If installing into an existing world, run:

`/reload`

9. The datapack should now be active.

### Multiplayer Server Installation

1. Stop your server.
2. Open your server files.
3. Navigate to:

`world/datapacks`

4. Upload the datapack ZIP file into the datapacks folder.
5. Start the server.
6. Run:

`/reload`

or restart the server if necessary.

### Verify Installation

Run:

`/datapack list`

If the datapack appears in the enabled list, the installation was successful.

## Support

If you encounter bugs, have suggestions, or want to report compatibility issues, feel free to leave a comment. Feedback helps improve future updates.

Enjoy watching your world transform as random blocks rain from the sky!

MoreCulling + Noisium Backport

MoreCulling + Noisium Backport brings rendering and world-generation optimizations inspired by MoreCulling and Noisium to Minecraft 1.16.5 Fabric.

This project combines optimizations targeting both client-side rendering performance and server/world-generation performance into a single backport for older Minecraft versions.

Included Optimizations
MoreCulling-inspired optimizations

MoreCulling focuses on reducing the amount of unnecessary geometry Minecraft renders.

This backport includes optimizations such as:

Improved block face culling
Reduced rendering of hidden block faces
Better handling of leaves and transparent blocks
Reduced overdraw in dense environments
Rendering optimizations designed to improve FPS in large builds and forests
Noisium-inspired optimizations

Noisium focuses on improving world-generation performance and reducing overhead during terrain generation.

This backport includes optimizations targeting:

Noise generation performance
Chunk generation efficiency
Reduced CPU overhead during terrain generation
Improved scalability during world creation and exploration
Why combine two mods?

MoreCulling and Noisium improve different parts of Minecraft performance, making them good candidates for a combined backport project.

Instead of requiring multiple separate backports, this project bundles related rendering and world-generation optimizations into a single mod for easier installation and maintenance on 1.16.5.

About the Backport

This project adapts optimization concepts from modern Minecraft versions for use on Minecraft 1.16.5 Fabric.

Because older versions use different rendering and world-generation internals, some implementations have been rewritten or adjusted specifically for the 1.16.5 engine and Fabric ecosystem.

Not every feature from the original mods may be included, but the goal is to preserve as many useful optimizations as possible while maintaining stability and compatibility.

Why?

Many players still enjoy older Minecraft versions, especially 1.16.5, but optimization support for those versions has slowed down significantly over time.

This project exists to help bring modern optimization improvements back to older versions so players and modpacks can continue benefiting from newer performance work.

title: SlashString
description: Give your players an easy way to get string.
body: ![Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0c3ed27fbe31c052e899a810bf37234ab4461b4c.png) ## Recent **Minecraft Java** updates have closed several **string** and **tripwire** duplication tricks that farms and players used for years. If your world just lost that supply, **SlashString** is a fair replacement: one command, and **you** set how much string they get and how often, with no exploits involved. --- ### What does it do? - Players type **`/string`** and receive a stack of string (the item used for bows, wool, tripwires, and lots of crafts). - You choose **how many** they get and how long they must **wait** before using the command again. - If their inventory is full, you can choose whether **extra string falls on the ground** or **is thrown away**. There is **no permission plugin** setup: everyone who can use commands on your server can use `/string`, unless you block the command yourself in your host’s files. --- ### Installation 1. Download the plugin **.jar** from this project’s files page. 2. Put the jar in your server’s **`plugins`** folder. 3. **Restart** the server (or load the plugin the way you usually do). You need a **Paper** (or Paper-style) Minecraft server. The plugin is built for recent **1.21** releases; if your server version does not match, ask your host or check the project’s version tags before installing. --- ### Commands | Command | Who can use it? | |---------|------------------| | **`/string`** | Players in the world. They get string according to your settings. | | **`/string reload`** | The **server console** always works. **Players** must be a **server operator** (opped) to reload. | Reloading applies changes from your config and message files **without** restarting the whole server. --- ### Settings (`config.yml`) After the first start, open: **`plugins/SlashString/config.yml`** | Setting | What it means | |---------|----------------| | **amount** | How many string items one use of `/string` gives (at least 1). | | **cooldown-seconds** | How many seconds a player must wait before `/string` works again. Use **0** for no cooldown. | | **drop-if-full** | **true**: if the inventory is full, extra string **drops at their feet**. **false**: extra string **does not drop** (it is removed). | Edit the file, then run **`/string reload`** from the console (or in-game if you are opped). --- ### Messages (`messages.yml`) Text the plugin sends (cooldown warnings, “you received string”, reload success, and so on) lives in: **`plugins/SlashString/messages.yml`** You can change the wording and colors. Colors use the usual **`&` codes** (for example **`&a`** green, **`&c`** red, **`&e`** yellow, **`&7`** gray). Placeholders like **`{amount}`** are filled in automatically. Keep those spelled exactly as in the default file. After editing, use **`/string reload`** so players see the new text right away. --- ## License - 🚫 You may not claim this plugin as your own. - 🚫 You may not resell or redistribute this plugin. - ✅ You may modify this plugin for personal use only; redistribution is not permitted. ## Bstats ![stats](https://bstats.org/signatures/bukkit/slashstring.svg)

title: Simple Cables
description: This minecraft mod adds cables for transmitting energy in FabricMC
body:
# Simple Cables (English)
This minecraft mod adds cables for transmitting energy in FabricMC.

## Libraries
- Fabric API
- MCPitanLib
- Fabric Language Kotlin

## Blocks
- Energy Cable - A cable that transmits energy, only obtainable in creative mode (512 E/t)
- Copper Cable - A cable that transmits energy (256 E/t)
- Iron Cable - A cable that transmits energy (512 E/t)
- Gold Cable - A cable that transmits energy (1024 E/t)

Right-clicking on the cable without holding any block items will allow you to check the amount of energy stored in that cable.

## Configurations
`config/simplecables76.json` contains the following configuration options

- `rebornEnergyConversionRate` - Energy conversion rate (default: 1.0)
- `energy.transferRate.energyCable` - Transfer rate for Energy Cable (default: 512)
- `energy.transferRate.copperCable` - Transfer rate for Copper Cable (default: 256)
- `energy.transferRate.ironCable` - Transfer rate for Iron Cable (default: 512)
- `energy.transferRate.goldCable` - Transfer rate for Gold Cable (default: 1024)

The transfer rate values represent the amount of energy transferred per tick.

# Simple Cables (日本語)
エネルギー伝送ケーブル単品を追加するFabricMC用のマイクラModです。

## 前提Mod
- Fabric API
- MCPitanLib
- Fabric Language Kotlin

## ブロック
- エネルギーケーブル - エネルギーを伝送する、クリエイティブモードでのみ入手可能なケーブル (512 E/t)
- 銅ケーブル - エネルギーを伝送する (256 E/t)
- 鉄ケーブル - エネルギーを伝送する (512 E/t)
- 金ケーブル - エネルギーを伝送する (1024 E/t)

ブロック系アイテムを所持せずに右クリックすると、そのケーブルに入っているエネルギーを確認できます。

## 設定
`config/simplecables76.json`にて、下記の設定項目を変更できます。

- `rebornEnergyConversionRate` - エネルギー変換レート (デフォルト: 1.0)
- `energy.transferRate.energyCable` - エネルギーケーブルの転送速度 (デフォルト: 512)
- `energy.transferRate.copperCable` - 銅ケーブルの転送速度 (デフォルト: 256)
- `energy.transferRate.ironCable` - 鉄ケーブルの転送速度 (デフォルト: 512)
- `energy.transferRate.goldCable` - 金ケーブルの転送速度 (デフォルト: 1024)

転送速度の数値は、1ティックあたりのエネルギー量を表しています。

title: Deltarune Tools
description: Adds common items from game DELTARUNE.
body:
This mod adds common items from game DELTARUNE, like healing items (food), swords, axes, scarves, rings, and TP system (spell system), and music discs.

Rarer food items can give effects.

Most swords can improve damage output at the early stage of game. The better the sword, the harder its recipe.
You can gain TP by standing near hostile mobs, attacking and killing any mobs.
If you hold any Axe, you can cast Rude Buster spell by the cost of 50 TP. It fires a projectile that deals damage on impact.
If you hold any Scarf, you can cast Heal Prayer spell by the cost of 32 TP. It heals player based on used Scarf.

If you hold Snow/Freeze Ring, you can cast Ice Shock by the cost of 16 TP. It fires a projectile that deals a little damage, and slows the entity it hits (Freeze Ring locks them in place for several seconds)
If you hold Thorn Ring, you can cast Snowgrave by the cost of 100 TP. It fires a projectile that locks entity in place, and creates a 3x3x3 ice cube around them, dealing large amount of damage.

Some items like Kromer and card suits cannot be obtained through crafting. Kromer can be bought from Wandering Trader, and card suits spawn in new structure.

title: NookOST
description: A reactive music resource pack featuring the hourly soundtrack from Animal Crossing: New Leaf, dynamically played in Minecraft depending on time, location, and events.
body:
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/723f955644671e5443f1231d45d6bd53d3cfeed9.jpeg)


**NookOST** is a reactive music resource pack that replaces Minecraft’s default soundtrack with the iconic hourly music from Animal Crossing: New Leaf.

Using the Reactive Music Mod, the soundtrack dynamically adapts to your gameplay and environment, bringing the cozy atmosphere of Animal Crossing directly into Minecraft.

Music changes automatically depending on:

- Time of day (24 hourly tracks)
- Weather conditions
- Biomes
- Dimensions
- Special gameplay events

The goal of this pack is to recreate the relaxing and immersive feeling of living in a peaceful village, similar to the original Animal Crossing experience.

### 🌿 Dynamic Music System

The music changes based on different situations in the game:

### 🕒 Time of Day

All 24 hourly tracks from Animal Crossing New Leaf are included.

Each hour of the day triggers the corresponding track, just like in the original game.

### 🌍 Locations

Different tracks can play depending on where you are:

- Overworld exploration
- Villages
- Caves
- Structures

### 🔥 Dimensions

Custom music also plays in special dimensions:

- Nether exploration music
- End dimension ambience
- Ender Dragon battle music

### 🎮 Other situations

The pack also includes music for:

- Main menu
- Credits screen



## 📦 Requirements

This resource pack requires:

[Reactive Music](https://modrinth.com/mod/reactive-music)

Without the mod, the pack will not work correctly.

## 📥 Installation

1. 1️⃣ Download the Reactive Music Mod
1. 2️⃣ Download NookOST
1. 3️⃣ Drag the downloaded .zip file into your resourcepacks folder

```
.minecraft/resourcepacks
```

1. 4️⃣ Launch Minecraft
1. 5️⃣ Open the Reactive Music settings

You can access it by:

Using Mod Menu

Typing the command:


```
/reactivemusic
```


6️⃣ Select NookOST from the available music packs list.

Once enabled, the music will dynamically adapt to your world.


### 🎶 Soundtrack

This pack includes music from:

Animal Crossing: New Leaf
Composed by the Nintendo Sound Team.

The soundtrack is synchronized with:

- 24 hour cycle
- weather
- gameplay situations

to recreate the original relaxing atmosphere of the game.

title: Origins: XE-13 Phobos
description: Origin Addon that adds the Phobos origin, inspired by the Exo Mechs from Terraria's Calamity Mod.
body:
## 🔧 XE-13 Phobos
### Impact 3

**The crown jewel of it's creators achievements. This origin is retrofitted with the most advanced technology possible, but is not without it's flaws.**


This origin, although introducing many new gameplay mechanics, can still easily turn the tides of battle, being able to deal extreme damage and regenerate almost instantly, although having to manage fuel and avoid close quarters pvp.

Can be downloaded as either a Mod or Datapack, the Resource Pack is only required if using the datapack.

### Dependencies: (Required for both the Mod and Datapack)
- Origins
- Apugli
- Eggolib
- Appli
- Origins: Math
- Pehkui
- Extra Origins

## Origin Abilities
### Some complex abilities have been simplified, more info on them can be viewed ingame.

<details>
<summary>ExoFuel</summary>
The hunger system is replaced with a fuel system, with each fuel cannister granting 100 fuel and a total of 10 cannisters. Natural regeneration, eating, and starvation are also disabled, as fuel is regained almost instantly after not using any abilities for 10s. (1000 fuel total, most abilities drain fuel)
</details>
<details>
<summary>Draedon's Arsenal</summary>
When clicking your primary, draw your arsenal, a set of 4 weapons that can be used with right click and cycled with left click. These weapons are extremely powerful, but consume fuel upon use.
</details>
<details>
<summary>Draedon's Heart</summary>
This ability (activated with secondary) converts fuel cannisters to health, with each cannister consumed granting 1 heart, this is your only way to regenerate health.
</details>
<details>
<summary>Triple-Jump</summary>
By clicking your sneak key while in midair, gain up to 2 additional jumps.
</details>
<details>
<summary>Lightweight</summary>
Due to being built from light materials, you are able to land gracefully and with ease. (Fall damage immunity up to 10 blocks)
</details>
<details>
<summary>Unprocessable Liquids</summary>
As you are complete machine, you are incapable of processsing and harnessing most effects.
</details>
<details>
<summary>Unwieldy</summary>
You have grown reliant on your abilities, causing you to struggle to perform well in close quarters combat. (You are unable to make critical hits)
</details>
<details>
<summary>Not-So Fireproof</summary>
Your fuel canisters melt in hot temperatures, causing you to lose fuel passively when on fire in addition to taking +50% fire damage. (This effect can be allievated with fire resistance.)
</details>
<details>
<summary>Mental Lag</summary>
Your reaction time is slowed, causing you to attack considerably slower (-30% Attack Speed).</details>

## Known Bugs
- Upon selecting the origin, some projectiles rarely may not shoot, this can be fixed by relogging or reselecting the origin. This is an apugli bug and as such cannot be fixed by me.

## Credits
All credits for the origin textures and sounds go to the Terraria Calamity Mod developers!

title: Seasons [BTW Addon]

# Seasons Addon

![A Forest In Fall](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ZnPGVYHm/images/74f02eebd27518e22197f4e6523536f81f1c7841.gif)

Features include:
- Experience the full season cycle of a year - and not just 4 seasons, all 12 Months!
- Seasons are not global. Seen a jungle in the winter before? Nope, seasons are specific to the biomes 👀
    - Some have more seasons, others have less. Varying climate distributions throughout the year 〰️
- Biomes are still intended to keep their identities - everything a season changes still relies on the biome's vanilla values
    - E. g. Taiga will not get too hot, and there will be no snow or rain in the desert!
- Each month looks different, foliage will change color throughout the year
    - Expect the plains to be lush in spring - knowing well that the heat of summer is just around the corner!
    - Autumn-y forests obviously included - if it happens to be fall!
- If a biome gets too hot/dry in a season - no more rain possible. Keep an eye on your crop layout, just as in deserts!
- If it gets too cold though - water will freeze and it might begin to snow. Might need to go ice-fishing after all!
- More in-depth crop system! Certain crops like it more warm, others might prefer a more humid atmosphere 🍈
    - Taiga too cold in the spring? Plains too hot in the summer?  Be sure to exploit different biomes for best yield!

title: Dimitri's Smithing
description: A datapack that rebalances crafting, keeping, upgrading, and repairing your gear.
body:
_Heavily inspired by [Tinkerer's Smithing](https://modrinth.com/mod/tinkerers-smithing)._

This datapack modifies smithing recipes and item components such that:

- All tools can be repaired in an anvil using appropriate materials, including tools that can normally only be repaired through anvil combining.

- All gear can be upgraded to a higher tier by combining them in a smithing table with a sacrificial higher-tier item of the same type, meaning all the extra equipment you find lying around can be made useful.

- The anvil's "prior work" penalty is capped to be at most 15 levels, to make repairing tools long-term without mending more achievable.

- Any named gear will turn into a "broken" version upon running out of durability, and cannot be used again until it's been repaired on an anvil or with mending.

The intention of this datapack is to make it so that you can carry a single set of tools and armor through your entire journey, steadily upgrading it as you go, without needing to rely on using Mending and carefully watching your gear's durability.

---

Known issues:
- There is no good way to know what tool specifically broke. So if you break a tool with a delta of -3 (for example, pulling an item with a fishing rod or firing a firework rocket from a crossbow), if you're holding another tool in your other hand with at most 3 durability it will also break.
- For some reason the tool breaking script does not work on fishing rods, so named fishing rods will still break when running out of durability. :(
---

![A grid of crafting results showing tools not normally be repairable in an anvil, demonstrating e.g. repairing a bow using string.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8566723481d132d816b6329f35c7db759d70aa2c.png)

![A diamond pickaxe named "Rosebud" with 0 durability and a purple name, indicating it is broken.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e96af383684c1f5fc4c6275da6c83d597baec241.png)

![A diamond pickaxe bring upgraded to a netherite pickaxe via sacrifice, keeping its name and enchantments.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/621ae2f8969b03e91a24af22d6c33e8088268a72.png)

title: Studded Armor: Lost Tier & Chainmail Rework
description: A Forge mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that resurrects the forgotten Studded armor set and finally gives Chainmail the recipes it deserved.
body:
[![License: LGPL v3 or later](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-LGPL%20v3%2B-blue.svg)](https://github.com/Hand-Lock/studded-armor/blob/master/LICENSE)
# Studded Armor: Lost Tier & Chainmail Rework  
*A Forge mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that resurrects the forgotten **Studded** armor set and finally gives Chainmail the recipes it deserved.*

## ⚔️ Why This Exists

Between **December 31 2009** and **February 6 2010** the Indev branch of Minecraft contained a fourth armor set—**Studded**—whose sprites were lifted wholesale from *The Legend of the Chambered 2*. Every new world spawned a full set in the player’s inventory, yet the items offered no protection and could not be equipped. When real armor mechanics arrived a few weeks later, both the items and their textures were deleted, leaving a “missing tier”.
This mod restores that tier with balanced stats, authentic recipes, and progression.

---

## 📜 Historical Timeline

| Java Edition build                   | Date (UTC)              | Event                                                                        |
| ------------------------------------ | ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Indev 0.31 20091231-2**            | 2009-12-31 22:57        | Studded textures added to *items.png* and granted in the starting inventory. |
| **Indev 0.31 20100204-1 → 20100206** | 2010-02-04 → 2010-02-06 | Studded items removed in preparation for armor mechanics.                    |
| **Indev 20100206-2034**              | 2010-02-06              | Studded textures stripped from *items.png*—the set disappears entirely.      |

**Quick facts**

* **Availability (Indev):** Spawned in the starting inventory only; could not be crafted or found.
* **Functionality:** Purely cosmetic inventory items—could be moved but not worn.
* **Sprite origin:** Directly copied from *The Legend of the Chambered 2* where they were named *studded helmet/shirt/pants/boots*.
---

## 🛠️ Crafting & Progression

### 1 ️⃣ Studded Armor (Smithing Table)
Combine **any Chainmail piece** with a **Studded Upgrade Smithing Template** and a **Stud**:

![Studded Upgrade Smithing Template + Chainmail Armor Piece + Stud = Studded Armor Piece](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/03c160c0cde18a0b1402cbb6006c9c491ba66007.png)

---

#### 🔧 Crafting a Stud

![asd](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/227c978354a81feeec780b82f6dce0db982d6db1.png)

```

[N] [N] [N]
[N] [L] [N]
[N] [N] [N]

```
* **L** = Leather Strip  
* **N** = Iron Nugget  

---

#### 🔧 Crafting a Leather Strip

![asd](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/331bf4ba6d039bfca99e242943512ab84bbab20b.png)

```

[ ] [ ] [ ]
[L] [L] [L]
[ ] [ ] [ ]

```
* **L** = Leather  

---

#### 📜 Studded Upgrade Smithing Template
Found while **brushing suspicious sand or gravel** (Archaeology). Gives archaeology real purpose, beyond pottery shards...

Clone it like any vanilla template, using a **Leather Strip** as the central material:

![asd](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/70ac929f1e61cf2bbf36c6853689dec3df8bca71.png)

```

[D] [S] [D]
[D] [L] [D]
[D] [D] [D]

```
* **S** = Studded Upgrade Smithing Template
* **L** = Leather Strip
* **D** = Diamond

---

#### 🛡️ Stat Overview
| Set | Armor (points) | Toughness / piece | Durability (chestplate) |
|-----|---------------|------------------|--------------------|
| Iron | 15 | — | 240 |
| **Studded** | **17** | **+1** | **384** |
| Diamond | 20 | +2 | 528 |

*(Values respect the vanilla ratios between individual pieces.)*

---

### 2 ️⃣ Chainmail Rework
Chainmail is now obtainable **through crafting**:

#### 🔧 Chains

![asd](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/caff5a957b71f2351cacc24a12571883de793384.png)

```

[ ] [N] [ ]
[ ] [N] [ ]
[ ] [N] [ ]

```
* **N** = Iron Nugget → **1 × Chain**

---

#### 🔧 Chainlinks

![asd](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7fdeeec99f385c0262a01049f860506be5a754f3.png)

```

[ ] [C] [ ]
[C] [ ] [C]
[ ] [C] [ ]

```
* **C** = Chain → **2 × Chainlinks**

---

#### 🔧 Chainmail Armor Pieces  
Use **Chainlinks** in the standard vanilla armor shapes.

<details>
<summary>Show patterns</summary>

##### Helmet
```

[CL] [CL] [CL]
[CL] [  ] [CL]
[  ] [  ] [  ]

```

##### Chestplate
```

[CL] [  ] [CL]
[CL] [CL] [CL]
[CL] [CL] [CL]

```

##### Leggings
```

[CL] [CL] [CL]
[CL] [  ] [CL]
[CL] [  ] [CL]

```

##### Boots
```

[  ] [  ] [  ]
[CL] [  ] [CL]
[CL] [  ] [CL]

```
* **CL** = Chainlinks  
</details>

---

## 🧩 Modpack-Friendly by Design
* **No-Enchant Packs:** This mod was primarily made for modpacks that disable enchanting and assign intrinsic enchants per tier.

* **Designed for Weight Systems** – Studded armor intentionally finishes the **Light Armor** branch (Leather → Chainmail → Studded) so it can keep pace with the **Heavy Armor** branch (Golden/Copper → Iron → Diamond). 
  In setups like my upcoming [CAVEGAME.EXE](https://discord.gg/NhWG6YdSq7) modpack:
    * Studded = final **Light** tier  
    * Diamond = final **Heavy** tier  
    * Netherite = sole **Medium** end-game tier

* **Old-Beta Animal Logic** – gives leather an end-game use and value when breeding is disabled.

> ⚠️ *In a straight-vanilla playthrough—without intrinsic-enchant perks or an armor-weight system—the extra Studded tier may feel like “bloat”; yet it remains a nostalgic gem for legacy-feature aficionados.*

title: Carbonised
description: Copper: Reworked
body:
# Carbonised
Vanilla copper is a bit... weird. You basically _have_ to spread it out at least 5 blocks or else it will barely oxidise at all. This, frankly, doesn't make any sense. So I changed it!

## Brief
- Copper will now oxidise at the same* speed, even when surrounded by other copper blocks.
- Batches of copper blocks will try to balance their oxidisation levels **without cancelling any oxidisation attempts.**
  - Added a new gamerule `oxidisationRadius` (default: 4), which controls the radius in which copper blocks attempt to preserve balance. (Note that larger collections of copper will still age at roughly the same rate regardless) Setting this value to 0 disables balancing.
- *Copper blocks oxidise slower the more full blocks surround them
- Copper blocks will oxidise faster when underwater

## Details for Nerds
### What happened previously?
Previously, whenever a copper block tries to oxidise, it will search for any block less oxidised in a 9x9x9 area. If it finds one, it doesn't oxidise. I can only guess that this was an attempt to make copper oxidise evenly, but it ends up making groups of copper almost never oxidise.

### So what happens now?
When a copper block attempts to oxidise, it searches for a less oxidized block within a 4 block distance (or higher depending on `oxidisationRadius`) that has a physical connection to it. If it finds one, it oxidises that block instead. This leads to higher synchronicity on connected surfaces and makes those oxidise at roughly the same speed as normal spread out copper blocks.

However! The fewer sides of a copper block are exposed to air or water, the fewer [random ticks](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Tick#Random_tick) will be turned into oxidisation attempts. Blocks that are completely surrounded will not attempt to oxidise, but can still become oxidised through other copper blocks.

For every side of a copper block that is surrounded by water, its probability of oxidising will increase (equivalently to the decrease noted above). That means if a copper block is surrounded by other blocks on four sides but has two sides touching water, its oxidisation chance will multiply by `((6 - 4 + 2)/6) = (4/6)`. Note that due to a technical limitation the final oxidisation chance cannot exceed 1. In the end, a single copper block submerged in water behaves exactly the same as one floating in the air.


## Translation Note
I have added names for the new gamerule in German and British and American English. Since I don't know any languages besides that the gamerule will appear by its command name in those languages. Feel free to open issues on the issue tracker with a suggested translation for your own language, should you miss it.
