title: Crallusion Critter Collector
description: A mod that adds several fantasy creatures to the game that you can collect and train!
body:
Have any suggestion? Want to report a bug? We have a Discord server! You can join and ask anything you want!

Crallusion is a mod inspired by Pokémon and Digimon while still being its own thing. This is a creature collector mod where you can hatch, train, and collect your creatures, while learning about them! You can craft items that you can use on them, give them food, explore the world and find new special creatures!

 

Click here to inform yourself about the creatures added in this mod

 

Getting started

When joining into the world, you're gonna obtain several items. These items are only given to you at the very start of the world, you won't receive this starting pack again in a world that was already created.

Creature Egg: This is how you will obtain most creatures. You need to give this egg Hatching Sigils for making it hatch into a baby creature. Baby creatures will then be able to grow up and evolve depending on the elemental sigil you give it! Creature eggs are also obtained rarely when killing wild creatures.

 

Hatching Dream: This is how you obtain Hatching Sigils! These sigils are used for making Creature Eggs hatch into babies! Hatching Dreams are also obtained from killing wild creatures.

 

Dreamy Meat: This is a basic healing item that you can give to your creatures. It doesn't recover much HP, but it's useful for the start! You can also obtain this item from killing wild creatures.

 

Exquisite Dreamy Meat: This is the healing item that heals the most HP of the entire mod. It's dropped very rarely by wild creatures. There are more reliable sources of food, though.

 

Battling

Creatures can be used to battle other creatures or even vanilla mobs and other players, each creature have their own magic skill that they can use on their own while battling. There is an elemental system and a typing chart, the elements are: Elementless, Fire, Water, Grass, Ice, Earth, Wind, Electric, Light & Shadow. Here's an image showing what the typing chart looks like:

 

The only thing that exists for this mechanic is ''strong against''! This means that there are no elemental resistances or immunities, only strong against!

 

Creature drops

When killing wild creatures, you can obtain several different kinds of items from them. The most important item that you need to remember are the elemental sigils. Elemental sigils are used for making your own baby creatures evolve into the element you give it. Use the following image as an example:

 

 

The egg will have a 10% chance of hatching into a specific baby if you give it the specific baby's hatching sigil. This baby will then have a 20% chance of evolving into Nyarice if you give it ice sigils. Nyarice will then have a 10% chance of evolving into Kitrick if you keep giving it ice sigils, and so on.

''What is that strange item at the very end of the image?'' - You may ask. That is a Leviester. The Leviester is like the "soul" of the creatures. All creatures have a Leviester inside of them, and in some cases, their Leviester can resonate within them and let them get upgraded in some way. Not every creature is capable of resonating with their own Leviester, but those that do can get to experience something truly magical

 

List of Leviester forms

Type change: Changes the typing of the creature to another and its magic skill changes to one that matches that of the type it converts into.

 

HIT!: +8 ATK to the creature.

 

CHUB!: +15 HP to the creature.

 

Holy: The creature becomes Light type and adds +5HP & +5ATK to the creature.

 

Fallen: The creature becomes Shadow type and adds +5HP & +5ATK to the creature.

 

Armor: Adds +20HP & +7ATK to the creature and the magic skill becomes Armor Point.

 

 

Spawning

Each element is attatched to Minecraft biomes. You can edit with datapacks what elements belong to what biomes, as they work purely with tags. Here's a chart showing all the spawning biomes that come from default:

Other information

How are creatures obtained?

Creatures can be obtained in two ways: hatching them from creature eggs, or catching them with a dreamcatcher.

Creature eggs are the main method of obtaining creatures. They are obtained rarely whenever killing wild creatures, and can also be obtained through breeding Adult stage creatures. Once you have a creature egg, you need to give it hatching sigils to hatch it into the baby creature you want. These baby creatures will then need elemental sigils in order to evolve into the Baby II stage creature of the element you want it to evolve into. Sigils are obtained from killing wild creatures.

 

About the dreamcatcher...

It is a rare item to get, and it only has a 4% chance of successfully catching wild creatures. Its obtaining method is through crafting. This is meant to be just a secondary way of obtaining creatures, not a main one. The main way for obtaining creatures is meant to be through creature eggs.

 

What is that weird looking pink item next to the evolution trees?

That is an item called Leviester! It's a special gimmick item obtained rarely when killing wild creatures. A Leviester makes Adult creatures transform into special variants of themselves! For example, Trichat becomes a FireTrichat when exposed to a Leviester. The change is not only typing, it comes in multiple more variants, they're listed above!

 

What happens when my creature dies?

When your creature dies, it will become a creature egg! You don't forever lose your creature, it will just go back into being an egg, so you'd have to raise it from the start again.

 

Is there anywhere I can inform myself about the creatures this mod adds?

Yes! By clicking here, you can get to a document that tells you about the creatures in this mod!

title: CustomCoords
description: Customise your coordinates so they mean something to you!
body:
Coordinates are an essential part of the multiplayer experience. There's no other way to efficiently communicate the location of something to someone who doesn't share your knowledge. This information, being so essential, does not belong in the debug screen, along with information that is either useless or potentially oppositional to a positive user experience. As such, we the community have created a vast number of mods to display your coordinates through other means over the years. This mod's niche in this sea of coord mods is that of customisability, hence its namesake.

Originally being a backend function, coords struggle to hold meaning, especially after the introduction of -64 < y < 0. You can now be in control of that meaning. For example, you can change Y 0 to be sea level, so your Y-coord can communicate where you are regards to it. Importantly, this is only visual, so it doesn't effect how the game operates in the background.

/cc share and automatic chat coord interpretation allows you to communicate with others who don't share the same customisations as you, without any unwarranted confusion.

This mod also comes with integration with [Xaero's minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap), the custom coords are shown in the info display.

This mod is still in development. Please be aware that it may not work as intended. Post any bugs, queries, or gripes to the [Issue page](https://github.com/Hxrlio/CustomCoords/issues).

title: Danny Pack: Letalis: Vista
description: A client-side pack which adds a variety of new features to the game while still maintaining performance
body:
# Letalis: Vista is closed

Letalis: Vista (the server this pack was made for) has shut down 

# Danny Pack: Letalis: Vista
*For Quilt 1.20.1*

This pack is a Quilt-based that with the sole purpose of enhancing the user experience in a multitude of ways.

### Content

Danny Pack: Letalis Vista adds a substantial amount content to the game to give every type of player something they'd enjoy. For adventurers you have the option of using [Xaero's mapping mods](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map) or [JourneyMap](https://modrinth.com/mod/journeymap) (disabled by default) to map your adventure and keep track of the places you find. For those who wish to better express themselves there is [Wildfire's Female Gender Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/female-gender)* . For those who just can't keep track of item recipes there is [Just Enough Items](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei). For those who love the immersion of proximity chat there is [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat)* . For those who just love stylizing there is [Cosmetica](https://modrinth.com/mod/cosmetica). For those who just want to do funny dances there is [Emotecraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/emotecraft)* . And for those who love creating cinematics of their world there is [ReplayMod](https://modrinth.com/mod/replaymod).

**Note: Wildfire's Female Gender Mod, Simple Voice Chat, and Emotecraft all require server side mods or plugins for others to be able to see your emotes, breasts, or speak through voice chat.*


### Performance

Despite the large amount of content mods and enhancements that this pack includes it still preforms excellently compared to vanilla. This increased performance is in large part due to mods like [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium), [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling), and many others which are provided in the list below.


### OptiFine Parity

This pack supports a majority of OptiFine features. [Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris), [zoom](https://modrinth.com/mod/zoomify), [dynamic lighting](https://modrinth.com/mod/lambdynamiclights), [custom items textures](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn), and many more.


### Enhancements

To get around pesky server-side render distances this pack includes [Bobby](https://modrinth.com/mod/bobby). Bobby saves chunks as you go through them, this means that you can view unupdated versions of these chunks even when they are not within server render distance.

[Fabrishot](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabrishot) adds an option to take 4K screenshots simply by pressing F9. This is especiallt useful when taking screenshots with shaders.

Have you ever been annoyed by how small Minecart's default chat history is? With the [MoreChatHistory](https://modrinth.com/mod/morechathistory) mod you won't need to worry about this problem again. 

Ever find that Minecraft just doesn't have enough unique animations? Well the developers at [Not Enough Animations](https://modrinth.com/mod/not-enough-animations) seem to agree with you, which is why they added a whole batch of fresh animations to Minecraft.

### Why this pack?

While this pack will never be as performant as packs like [Fabulously Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized), this pack has a draw which make it the best for me and hopefully others. This draw is that it maintains high FPS while having loads of extra content that benefit the user experience. This content makes it pretty much ready and easy to be used for my use case which is private survival servers with friends.

Notice: **Some mods in this pack my violate the rules of servers (for example Xareo's Minimap or some aspects of MouseWheelie). Please ensure to review the rules of servers you will be playing on with this pack.** (All mods within  this pack are allowed on Letalis: Vista)

title: Better Weapons
description: Adds new weapons, artifacts and structure to our cubic world.
body:
# **Introduction**


We present to your attention a new modification from **GCM Studio (GuildCraftsMen)** under the guidance of player **RusmayXD**, which adds various artifacts, weapons and structures. Let's talk about everything in order!



# **Structures**


In total, there are only **10 structures** in the mod: 9 of them appear in the normal world, and another 1 in the land of ender. Inside each structure there is a chest containing a unique artifact or weapon for your player character, more on these later.

Some structures will be safe, however, there will also be those where you will have to show strength and ingenuity. For example, there is an air structure in the form of a cloud (it consists of a cloud block that was added with this modification), if the player stands on this cloud, it will fall to the ground, also the blocks will cause the air block to “break”, be careful!

We will not go into details of each structure, since we will lose interest in studying the modification, but we can show examples of these dungeons.



# **Weapons**


In this mod, weapons are divided into two types: ordinary and magical, for each type you will receive certain achievements. Let's look at each one.

• **Macuahutl** is a legendary weapon of the Aztecs. Has 6 damage and 0.7 attack speed. It will need to be crafted from four stones and three boards.

• **Khopesh** is a strengthened version of the iron sword. 9 damage and 1 attack speed, has a craft of two iron swords and one ingot of the same material.

• **Idol of the Dead Dux** is the very first weapon that was added to this mod. This is a short range spear that deals 10 damage with an attack speed of 0.7. It cannot be created, it can be found in special structures. If you press RMB while holding the idol, you will gain the ability to run intensely for a certain time. Please note that such weapons can gradually break with each active ability, use wisely.

• **Scythe of Justice** - a weapon of the upper world, coming straight from the abyss, look for a certain structure. Deals only 4 damage per attack, but has a speed of 3 units. RMB to activate stealth mode.

• **The Phoenix Sword** is one of the most powerful weapons in this mod. Deals 10 damage and has an attack speed of 0.8, cannot be created, can only be found. RMB to accept the Phoenix's gift! When you activate this ability, you receive a large number of buffs, including regeneration and maximum fire resistance. The effects are accompanied by new sounds.

• **The Storm Axe** is the most powerful and interesting weapon of this project. Has 10 damage and 07 attack speed. When you activate the ability, you enter spatial movement mode and gain flight for two seconds. Sounds too good? Truly! However, to get this weapon, you will need to find a floating structure in the ender world.

• **Sarkabans** are the only ranged weapon from this mod. They are long tubes for hunting with darts (regular and poisonous). All types of sarcabans and darts can be created and also found while traveling around the world.




# **Artifacts**


In this mod there are only 6 artifacts that can be found in structures. They are divided into two types: **passive and active**:

**Passive artifacts** simply need to be kept in your inventory for them to work (for example, the Anemo artifact, which gives a smooth fall as long as it is in your inventory).

**Active artifacts** must be held in your hand, for example, Athena’s shield, it protects against some negative effects.




# **Other things**


In fashion, we haven't covered **bags and backpacks** yet. There is nothing surprising here: the bags are made from leather and thread. Backpacks are the same, but now with the addition of craft bags. Used for storing and carrying things.

**Cloud is a block** that is only available in the creative menu. It will form an air structure in the ordinary world. If you break it in survival, you can get a bottle of experience.

**The Pipe** is another craftable mod item that can be lit using the right mouse button. When smoking, you get the effect of strength, nausea and a little speed.

title: AzSpoof
description: A legacy Forge mod to make it look like you're on the AZ Launcher
body:
# AzSpoof
A simple 1.9.4 Forge mod to make Funcraft & other servers think you're on the AZ Launcher.

# EOL
Funcraft has officially been shutdown as of 26/08/2023 (22h UTC+1, french time), rendering this mod useless.

Even tho this server really was kind of a shithole sometimes (bad infra, staff not super great, kinda abandonned), I've really enjoyed playing it for the last ~8 (not sure exactly how much, probably a bit more?) years, and it's been a reference for me and a bunch of other people.

From pvping to the freecube to doing the funny hacker god back to playing Skywars (the best Skywars btw) with a bunch of friends, I've done basically everything you can do on a minigames server.

Unlike other Funcraft players I don't plan to stop playing the game itself.
However, after 11 years and about 4/5 years of it being almost abandonned, it's finally time to let the best French server go. 

Thanks to every other Funcraft player for all of those amazing years.

![image](https://github.com/Nixuge/AzSpoof/assets/33488576/09c1b0e8-e02d-4c9d-9c97-4d415df037b9)

# What are Funcraft and the AZ Launcher
Funcraft is a (1.9.4) French server, and the AZ Launcher is their dedicated launcher. It's not needed to play on Funcraft, and indeed 1.9.0->1.11.2 clients work just about fine, but it's greatly pushed and can improve the gameplay experience a bit.

# What can you do with the AZ Launcher
For most parts, it's just a normal Minecraft launcher like Lunar or Badlion, but this time in 1.9.4.

There are however some games (Rush 1vs1, Octogone) that can ONLY be played with that launcher for no apparent reason, apart from to push it unreasonably.

# Why not play on it then?
- Limited set of mods, and like in some other launchers you can't add any more, so if you have a specific need you basically can't do much except playing on another launcher.
- Sometimes buggy, not that buggy but has some quite annoying glitches while PVPing, which is basically the main point of using the launcher.
- (my personal reason) Horrendous input issues on 1.9.4 (especially on Linux), which make the launcher basically unusable for anything against an even mid-good player.

# Why release that mod now ?
Had it for quite a while but basically just forgot about it, now that Funcraft is closing in a month (28 august 2023) might as well release it

# Usage
The mod is really primitive, it doesn't save any config or anything.

Use /azspoof to toggle on/off the mod (by default disabled when launching mc).

This mod is basically useless if not playing "Octogone" or "Rush 1vs1"

title: Truss
description: A single block to replace signs in technical builds
body: In Vanilla Minecraft, sign blocks and open fence gates have the useful properties of being "solid" blocks, while having no hitbox, which makes them invaluable in certain builds for purposes like interacting with falling blocks or fluids.  However, both of these blocks have downsides that make them annoying to use - signs require support, fence gates react to redstone and clicking, and both of them are tedious to place in large quantities, for different reasons.  This mod adds a single block, the Wood Truss, that has the same useful properties - it is solid but has no hitbox - without the downsides of signs or fence gates that come up when using them for this purpose.

title: AdminCraft
description: AdminCraft is a powerful moderation toolkit designed for server admins and moderators who want more control, smoother management, and better oversight of their community.
body:
AdminCraft is a powerful moderation toolkit designed for server admins and moderators who want more control, smoother management, and better oversight of their community. Whether you're running a small survival server or managing a bustling SMP, AdminCraft equips your staff team with everything they need to keep the game fair and fun.

# ✨ Features 
- __(Everything is configurable!)__
- **Tempban system** - Prevent rulebreakers joining the server for a specified amount of time, easilly
- **Spawn Protection** - Keep your server's spawn area safe from griefing and chaos.
- **Mute Mode** - Silence disruptive players without needing them to log out.
- **Freeze Mode** - Prevent suspicious players moving and interacting with the world during your investigations
- **Alt Account Detection** - Identify suspicious players who may be using alternate accounts.
- **Configurable sanction** - Configure sanctions that can be applied quicly with a simple command, depending on the reason and the past sanctions.
- **Discord-based appeal system** - Allow players to appeal their sanction, while still keeping the hand on your sanctions
- **Centralised sanction database** - Store every sanction to easily find a player history
- **Inventory and Enderchest management** - View and edit your players' inventory and enderchest, even when they are offline!
- **Offline management features** - Teleport to offline players, teleport offline players and edit their tags!

## Planned features
- **Staff mode** - Keep your player inventory separated from your admin's one, to switch quickly between moderation and game.
- **World Logging** - Track and review player activity to catch griefers and rule-breakers. (Planned for next version)
- **Word Blacklist** - Prevent players sending inappropriate messages, to keep the chat clean.
- **Staff Prefix** - Help your staff demarcating from other player with a configurable prefix and name/chat color.
- And **much more!**

# 🚀 Why AdminCraft?
Running a server is hard enough —moderation shouldn't be. AdminCraft gives you the tools to:
- Quickly respond to griefing or cheating.
- Detect and deal with alt accounts.
- Protect your spawn with case.
- Manage disruptive behavior on the spot.

This is just the beginning-more features and improvements are on the way to make AdminCraft the ultimate staff
companion mod.

**Discord:** https://discord.gg/uKpPsaYmgk

<details>
<summary>Spoiler: Commands</summary>

**Sanctions**
- `/mute <player> <(reason)>` -> prevents a player from sending messages in chat or placing signs
- `/tempmute <player> <duration> <(reason)>` -> same as above, but temporarily 
- `/unmute <player>` removes a player mute
- `/warn <player> <(reason)>` -> warns a player with a chat message
- `/tempban <player> <duration> <(reason)>` -> temporarily bans a player
-> `/sanction <player> [configuredReason1|configuredReason2|…]` -> applies a configured sanction template on a player (debug in progress)

**Tools**
- `/alts <player>` -> List every players who logged in with the same ip address than the player
- `/freeze <player>` -> Toggles the freeze mode for a player (preventing him moving and interacting with the world, the mode is cleared after each server restart)
- `/history <player>` -> Lists a player’s received sanctions, and reports
- `/reports <player>` -> Lists the reports accusing the player
- `/otp <target> <(destination/player)>` -> Teleports a player to a destination or another player, even offline
- `/otag <target> [add|list|remove] <tag>` -> Edit player tags even offline
- `/editappeal <id> [delay|status] <delay/status>` -> Edit a player's appeal
- `/editduration <id> <duration>` -> Edits a sanction duration
- `/playerinfo <player>` -> Gives some usefull informations on a player (location, active sanctions)

**Player commands**
- `/report <player> <reason>` -> Reports a player to the server staff

**Legend**
- `<argument>` -> mandatory argument
- `<(argument)>` -> facultative argument 
- `[arg1|arg2|…|argN]` -> (mandatory) choose one argument between the list

**Duration argument**
The /temp\* commands follow the following regex:
`^(?:(\d+)d)?(?:(\d+)h)?(?:(\d+)m)?(?:(\d+)s)?$`
Which means that all the temp* commands syntax for duration is `<days>d<hours>h<minutes>m<seconds>s` (without spaces), but if you remove one field it will still works.
Exemples:
- `1d`-> 1 day
- `29d4h` -> 29 days and 4 hours
- `4h35m`-> 4 hours and 35 minutes
- `4h5s`-> 4 hours dans 5 seconds

</details>


<details>
<summary>Spoiler: Special Thanks</summary>

Thank you to everyone who helped me make this mod!

### Code

- bl4ckscor3 (ports to new versions)
- CYB3RCA4T (Gradle troobleshootings)

</details>

title: Trade & Transport
description: Trade & Transport is a modular Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that improves villager trading and transportation mechanics. Every feature can be individually toggled in-game to fit your preferred playstyle.
body:
Trade & Transport is a modular Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that improves villager trading and transportation mechanics. Every feature can be individually toggled in-game to fit your preferred playstyle.

### **Features**

* **Villager Buckets:** Pick up and transport villagers using a standard bucket. The bucket safely retains the villager's trades, level, and custom name.  
* **Stackable Curing:** Reverts the 1.20.2 curing nerf. Zombie villager curing discounts can once again stack up to 5 times for maximum trade discounts.  
* **Trade Cycling:** Adds a dedicated cycle button to the merchant screen. This allows you to easily reroll the trades of a Level 1 villager with zero experience without needing to repeatedly break and place their workstation.  
* **Guaranteed Zombie Conversion:** Villagers killed by zombies will always convert into zombie villagers, regardless of your world's difficulty setting.

### **Configuration**

All features are enabled by default. You can toggle each of these four mechanics on or off at any time using the in-game configuration menu.

### **Dependencies**

To run this mod and access the settings screen, you must install the following dependencies:

* Fabric API (Required)  
* YetAnotherConfigLib / YACL (Required)  
* Mod Menu (Optional)

title: Graal
description: High performance JavaScript runtime, tweaked for Minecraft usage
body:
## Graal
is a customized version of GraalJS, a high performance JavaScript implementation. It is ECMAScript-compliant, provides interoperability with Java and other Graal languages.

On top of regular GraalJS features, Graal made these improvements:
- MemberRemapper support, allowing developers to customize the JavaScript side name of a Java member, like Method and Field
- Trimmed bundled libraries, making the total mod size ~50% smaller than regular GraalJS

GraalJS Documentation: https://www.graalvm.org/reference-manual/js/

## Attention

1. This is NOT GraalJS or GraalVM. If you encounter issues that are not related to JavaScript itself, send issues to GraalMC GitHub repo before contacting GraalJS or GraalVM
2. (Fixed in 25.0.2.0) If you are running the game with GraalVM, the game will crash early

title: HeadSmith
description: 3300+ survival-friendly decorative and functional heads with crafting recipes
body:
# HeadSmith

3300+ survival-friendly decorative and functional heads with crafting recipes

Head Catalog: [def9a2a4.github.io/HeadSmith](https://def9a2a4.github.io/HeadSmith/)

![header image with lots of example heads](https://def9a2a4.github.io/HeadSmith/assets/header.png)


## Features

- **Head Catalog** - Browse hundreds of custom textured heads through an in-game menu: `/headsmith show`
- **Search** - Find heads by name or tags `/headsmith search <query>` or [def9a2a4.github.io/HeadSmith](https://def9a2a4.github.io/HeadSmith/)
- **Crafting** - Depending on the head, craft using shaped/shapeless recipes or stonecutter recipes.
- **Drops** - Control what drops when heads are broken (silk touch support). For example, a [bottle of redstone]() when broken will just drop redstone dust unless broken with silk touch.
- **Special Properties**:
  - Lightable [candles](https://def9a2a4.github.io/HeadSmith/?q=candle) with particle effects
  - [Glowing pumpkins, glowstone, and other blocks](https://def9a2a4.github.io/HeadSmith/?prop=glowing)
  - Functional blocks that open [crafting tables](https://def9a2a4.github.io/HeadSmith/?prop=workbench), [anvils](https://def9a2a4.github.io/HeadSmith/?prop=anvil), enchanting tables, looms, and more

| Description                                                                                            | Preview                                          |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------ |
| Browse the catalogue of heads via `/headsmith show`                                                    | ![catalogue](https://def9a2a4.github.io/HeadSmith/assets/show-tags.png)                   |
| Head catalog showing how to craft a stack of books                                                     | ![catalogue - stack of books](https://def9a2a4.github.io/HeadSmith/assets/hs-show-stack-of-books.png)      |
| Mini block heads collection                                                                            | ![mini blocks](https://def9a2a4.github.io/HeadSmith/assets/mini-blocks.png)                 |
| Most blocks can be crafted into mini blocks (and sometimes other decorative items) via the stonecutter | ![gold block in a stoencutter](https://def9a2a4.github.io/HeadSmith/assets/stonecutter-gold.png)            |
| Put a mini block in a stonecutter to craft mini blocks with symbols                                    | ![mini oak planks in a stonecutter](https://def9a2a4.github.io/HeadSmith/assets/stonecutter-mini-oak-planks.png) |


## Commands

| Command                                       | Description                               | Permission          |
| --------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- | ------------------- |
| `/headsmith show`                             | Open the head catalog menu                | `headsmith.catalog` |
| `/headsmith search <query>`                   | Search for heads by name or tag           | `headsmith.catalog` |
| `/headsmith reload`                           | Reload configuration and head definitions | `headsmith.admin`   |
| `/headsmith give <head_id> [player] [amount]` | Give a head to a player                   | `headsmith.admin`   |

## Configuration

Heads are defined in YAML files and loaded via `config.yml`. Each head can have:

- Custom texture (base64 encoded skin data)
- Display name and lore
- Tags for organization and searching
- Special properties (lightable, glowing, workbench, etc.)
- Crafting recipes (shaped/shapeless)
- Stonecutter recipes
- Drop rules with silk touch conditions

title: Common's Content
description: Adds missing recipes and uses for vanilla materials, as well as extra progression tiers, weapons, and utilities.
body:
This mod adds content in a few different areas of the game, and providing uses for existing materials that I felt were missing from the game, as well as silly extras to have some fun with.

Suggestions, bug reports, and other questions can be taken to the Discord. We'd love to have you over!

Two new tool path types exist alongside vanilla's tools; Durability-Focused sets, and Efficiency-Focused sets.

**Durability**:
- Carbon Steel; Tier between iron and diamond. Boasts increased durability and damage.
- Titanium; Tier between diamond and netherite. Very durable, sharp, and protective. Can be used to upgrade to netherite as well without the need for diamond gear.

**Efficiency**:
- Silver; Gold tools rebalanced for the iron tool tier. 64 Durability, diamond-mining capabilities, and a tad bit sharper than gold.
- Amethyst; Put all the extra geode material to good use. Has similar durability to iron, but is capable of mining ancient debris, and fairly quickly as well. Not the worst for combat, but there's better options.

Basic medical supplies exist as well, giving more common resources more of a use.
- Bandages; Simple, made of string and oxeye daises. Restores some HP over time.
- Medkit; Uses bandages, copper, and some dye. Restores a lot more HP over a longer time period.

The mod also adds miscellaneous uses for vanilla materials in the form of new recipes, plus some end-game weapons and gadgets with complex crafting recipes, if you find yourself with some spare time.

I intend to add more content over time, but life has a way of thwarting my plans. Curses!
Forge 1.20.1 and NeoForge 1.21.1 are the only versions currently supported for this mod.

# Refined Patchwork ![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c489b72ac1ddae75d17760db6c795392026166b0.png) This datapack adds and tweaks many vanilla recipes and behaviors. It aims to enhance the Minecraft experience without breaking the game's balance. --- ## 🛠️ Features
Edited Vanilla Crafts ### ▶️Grindstone can be crafted with stone, sandstone, or red sandstone slabs.

### ▶️Carrot on a Stick and Warped Fungus on a Stick are shapeless.

### ▶️Stonecutter can be crafted with stone, deepslate, granite, diorite, or andesite.

### ▶️All Redstone items that use cobblestone in their crafting recipe can also be crafted with cobblestone, cobbled deepslate, or blackstone *(e.g., Piston, Observer...)*.

### ▶️All Redstone items that use stone in their crafting recipe can also be crafted with stone, deepslate, granite, diorite, or andesite *(e.g., Comparator, Repeater...)*.

### ▶️Daylight Detector can now be crafted with any type of glass (except tinted glass).

### ▶️Crafting wood from logs gives **4** wood *(instead of 3 in vanilla)*, and this works with any wood variant.

### ▶️Crafting a quartz block gives **4** quartz blocks.

### ▶️Crafting a trapdoor gives 6 trapdoors *(exept for bamboo)*.

### ▶️Blast Furnaces can be crafted with smooth stone, smooth sandstone, or smooth red sandstone.

### ▶️Leads no longer require slimeballs *(like newer Minecraft versions)*.

New Crafting Recipes ### ▶️Podzol can be crafted using dirt and any type of leaves.

### ▶️1 wool gives 4 string

### ▶️Melon blocks gives 9 slices.

### ▶️All utility tables *(cartography, smithing, fletching, loom)* can be crafted using a crafting table + specific item.

### ▶️Anvils can be crafted with iron blocks and chipped anvils *(chipped anvils can be crafted the same way, but using damaged anvils)*.

- Leaves can be converted into any other type using a sapling. - You can craft and convert torches and soul torches. - Craft light blocks with levels 1, 7, 10, and 15. - Craft invisible and glowing item frames. - Add many new ways to obtain dyes. - `[1.21.10+]` You can craft a Copper Torch by combining a regular Torch with one Copper Nugget. - `[1.21.10+]` You can craft a Copper Lantern by combining a regular Lantern with one Copper Nugget.
New Uncrafting Recipes - Honeycomb blocks can be uncrafted into 4 honeycombs. - You can uncraft a chest boat to retrieve both the boat and the chest. - You can uncraft a minecart chest to retrieve both the minecart and the chest. - You can uncraft a minecart furnace to retrieve both the minecart and the furnace. - You can uncraft a minecart hopper to retrieve both the minecart and the hopper. - You can uncraft a minecart TNT to retrieve both the minecart and the TNT.
Duplication - You can duplicate cobbled deepslate by combining 1 cobblestone with 1 deepslate. - Banner patterns can be duplicated using paper - Sherds can be duplicated using 4 bricks
Stonecutter - All wood types, including bamboo, can be used in the stonecutter. - Deepslate provides all deepslate variants in the stonecutter. - Light blocks can be converted to any light level - Paintings can be placed in a stonecutter to select the desired variant. - You can choose different armor stand variants by placing them in the stonecutter.
Smithing Table ###

🔴`[1.21.11+]`

▶️Lets you upgrade Nautilus Armor using Nautilus Shells, the current armor piece, and the materials of the next tier. **You must upgrade step by step** — for example, you can’t go directly from iron to diamond; you have to go through the golden tier first.

Furnace - Smelting copper, iron, or gold raw blocks gives copper, iron, or gold blocks. - Ancient debris cannot be smelted in a standard furnace but only in a blast furnace *(with a longer cooking time)*.
Miscellaneous - Eating a melon slice gives one melon seed. - `[1.21+]` Trial spawners will give more food when they drop it. - Frogspawn can be obtain with silktouch - Many new ways to obtain dyes - Combine colored wool to create new colors *(not all combinations are supported)*. For example, `red + white = pink`. - Throwing wet sponge into the Nether dries it - Holding a clock shows the time **(customizable format**). Use `/trigger rfpw.clock.toggle.display` to toggle the display, and `/trigger rfpw.clock.toggle.format` to change the time format. - Holding a compass shows your coordinates. Use `/trigger rfpw.compass.toggle.display` to toggle the display. - Holding a recovery compass shows your death location. Use `/trigger rfpw.recovery_compass.toggle.display` to toggle the display. - `[1.21+]` Having a Heavy Core in your inventory gives Slowness II - Normal potions and banner patterns stack up to 16 - Splashing a water potion on lava transforms it into cobblestone. - `[1.21.2+]` Throw a plant named `Placeable` to place it on any full block - Wet sponge can also dry on a campfire - Climbing speed on climbable blocks *(ladders, vines, weeping vines, twisting vines, and scaffolding)* is enhanced by sneaking, jumping, and looking *(up = climb, down = descend)*. For versions `1.21` and `1.21.1`, the effect is the same but jumping is not required - Falling into the End void while holding a totem teleports you back - `[1.21.6+]` Change the H.Ghast base ‘flying_speed’ attribute from 0.05 to 0.085 when it is being ridden and the player is holding a snowball in both the main and off-hand - `[1.21.10+]` The more a Copper Golem is oxidized, the slower it moves.
Entity Interactions - Taking llama spit damage while holding a piston in your main or off-hand transforms it into a sticky piston. - Hitting a squid while holding white wool turns the wool into black wool, and hitting a glow squid turns it into cyan wool. - Hitting a squid or glow squid causes 2 seconds of blindness.
Cauldron Interactions - Dropping magma cream into a water-filled cauldron produces a slimeball. - Dropping concrete powder into a water-filled cauldron turns it into concrete. - Dropping dirt into a water-filled cauldron turns it into mud. - Dropping any colored wool into a water-filled cauldron turns it white. - Dropping any colored carpet into a water-filled cauldron turns it white. - Dropping any colored bed into a water-filled cauldron turns it white. - Dropping any colored banner into a water-filled cauldron turns it white. - Dropping any colored glass or glass pane into a water-filled cauldron removes its color.

title: AH BackPack
description: A simple, strong Backpack Plugin for minecraft. Create shared Backpacks, easily!
body:
![icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1854168202b30f0d9dcf42c733265e07b7c65ba7_0.webp)
## AH BackPack is the perfect Backpack Plugin, for creating shareable Backpacks!

Perfect for Minecraft Challenges or private Projects!

Simply create a shared Backpack using 
```
/ahpack assign [player1][player2]
```
(the Players who share the Backpack) and it's ready! 
just run: 
```
/bp
```
 or 
```
/ahpack
```
 to access it

If you don't have one you can enter /bp or /ahpack to access a not shared Backpack

You can also easily assign Backpacks to other Players using the config.yml or the command


You can also change the Size of Backpack in the config files!

You can also enable to drop the content of the Backpacks when the Player dies, with Team Backpacks, the content only drops if both Players are death (default = false)

### Permissions:

- backpack.use (allows using the /bp or /backpack command - default true)
- backpack.assign (allows the Player to assign Backpacks to other Players or unassign them - default op)
- badckpack.admin (allow the Player to acces command to reload the config or clear all data - default op)

title: Knights and Fire
description: Immersive medieval-fantasy survival and warfare
body:
You shipwreck on an unknown coast, and find yourself lost deep within a hostile world. It will require all of your determination and skill to build a shelter and to find and preserve food before the winter. _But, wait... what was that glimmer through the trees?_ 

You cautiously move to the edge of the woods, and just a stone throw's away there lies... _A DRAGON!_

This modpack brings together the fantasy from Ice and Fire: Dragons with the hardcore survival elements of TerraFirmaCraft. With the addition of mods such as Epic Fight, Epic Knights, and When Dungeons Arrise, all of this culminates in creating a challenging and immersive Medieval Fantasy world.

Note that this modpack is in alpha currently, so it is far from well polished. I also plan on switching to Ice and Fire II when it comes out.

title: Mobmanity
description: A minecraft datapack that makes mobs behave like different types of players. Mobs can use and spawn in with whole variation of vanilla items that they use in unique ways to attack you. Mobs can also spawn with behavior making every fight fully different!
body:
# Mobmanity
_Mobmanity is a Minecraft datapack that makes mobs behave more like players.
They can spawn with a wide variety of vanilla items—and they know how to use them. From pickaxes and blocks to ender pearls and elytras, every mob encounter becomes unpredictable and intense.
On top of that, mobs can gain one of six unique behavior patterns, making each fight feel dynamic and challenging._

### All items mobs can spawn with:

- Wind Charge (if version allows) – Thrown at player
- Fire Charge – Thrown at player
- Cobweb – Placed near/on player
- TNT – Placed near/on player
- Iron Pickaxe – Used to mine toward the player
- Iron Axe – Used for melee attacks
- Flint and Steel – Sets player on fire
- Ender Pearl – Thrown away from or toward player
- Splash Potion – Thrown at player or self
- Goat Horn – Rallies nearby mobs to target the player
- Lava Bucket – Placed near/on player
- Water Bucket – Placed near/on player
- Totem of Undying – Prevents death
- Golden Apple – Consumed when health is low
- Firework Rockets – Shot from crossbows
- Cobblestone – Used to build up to the player
- Elytra – Used to glide toward the player
- Turtle Helmet – Just for fun :D

### What mobs can ride on:

- Horse
- Zombie horse
- Skeleton horse

### Mob behavior types:

- Athletic: The mob will be faster, run up cliffs easy (if version allows it), do less damage and jump over deep cliffs to get to the player.
- Aggressor: The mob will do more damage, be a bit slower and jump at players that are near him.
- Stalker: The mob will be a bit faster, be fully silent and do more damage on a backstab to players.
- Leader: The mob will make mobs around him stronger depending on how many mobs are around him.
- Tank: The mob will be slower, have a lot of armor and get less damage from far away (far bow shots, far trident shots, ...)
- Frightened: The mob will run away from the player to regenerate health when on low health.

## 简体中文
这个数据包能让玩家拥有体力。

### 目前功能：

过劳时体力恢复更慢，当体力恢复到50%时解除过劳状态；
- 以及一些适用于开发者（整合包作者、服主、地图作者和本数据包作者）的命令。

### 命令：
- `/function printernet:stamina/extra/set_inf_stamina` 设置命令执行者有无限体力
- `/function printernet:stamina/extra/unset_inf_stamina` 命令执行者取消设置无限体力
- `/function printernet:stamina/extra/set_no_re_stamina` 使命令执行者体力无法恢复
- `/function printernet:stamina/extra/unset_no_re_stamina` 让命令执行者体力可以恢复
- `/function printernet:stamina/extra/set_max_stamina` 将命令执行者的体力回满
- `/function printernet:stamina/extra/set_to_rest` 将命令执行者的体力清零以让其处于过劳状态

## English
This data pack grants players stamina.

### Current Features:
- Actions that drain stamina: sprinting, jumping, swimming, climbing, attacking, taking damage, and blocking attacks with a shield;
- Stealth increases stamina regeneration;
- When stamina drops below 50%, the hunger debuff is applied, slightly slowing movement speed, mining speed, and attack speed;
- When stamina falls below 25%, the hunger debuff level increases, further slowing movement speed, mining speed, and attack speed, and attack damage is reduced;
- When stamina hits 0%, exhaustion occurs, with the hunger debuff level increasing even higher, making movement, mining, and attacking impossible;
- During exhaustion, stamina recovery slows down, and exhaustion ends when stamina regenerates to 50%;
- Displays stamina icons and percentage in the action bar (in red when exhausted, white otherwise);
- Includes some commands for developers (modpack authors, server owners, map creators, and the author of this data pack).

### Commands:
- `/function printernet:stamina/extra/set_inf_stamina` Set infinite stamina for the command runner
- `/function printernet:stamina/extra/unset_inf_stamina` Cancel infinite stamina for the command runner
- `/function printernet:stamina/extra/set_no_re_stamina` Prevent the command runner's stamina from recovering
- `/function printernet:stamina/extra/unset_no_re_stamina` Allow the command runner's stamina to recover
- `/function printernet:stamina/extra/set_max_stamina` Fully restore the command runner's stamina
- `/function printernet:stamina/extra/set_to_rest` Deplete the command runner's stamina to trigger exhaustion

# Labyrythm

**A Minecraft Mod for Neoforge 1.21.1**

Labyrythm is a challenging content mod. The name of the mod combines "Labyrinth" and "Rhythm," reflecting the mod's core features: a dangerous maze and sound-based boss mechanics.

## Description

Prepare to delve into the darkness! Labyrythm introduces the **Minotaur's Labyrinth**, a vast, procedurally generated dungeon. This structure draws heavy inspiration from Minecraft's Deep Dark and Ancient Cities, featuring winding corridors covered in sculk.

Within the heart of this maze lurks the **Minotaur**, a fearsome new boss. Be warned: the Minotaur is blind and hunts using sound, similar to the Warden. Every step you take, every block you place, could alert it to your presence. Stealth and careful planning are key to survival – hence the "Rhythm" in the mod's name.

Those brave enough to explore the labyrinth and confront the Minotaur can discover powerful new items, including the formidable **Minotaur's Axe**, found in chests and as drops from the boss itself.

## Key Features

* **Minotaur's Labyrinth:** A new, procedurally generated underground structure themed after the Deep Dark and Ancient Cities.
* **The Minotaur:** A challenging new boss that is blind and reacts to sounds made by the player.
* **Sound-Based Gameplay:** Navigate the sculk-infested labyrinth carefully to avoid attracting the Minotaur.
* **New Loot:** Discover powerful items, including the Minotaur's Axe, within the labyrinth's chests and as a reward for defeating the boss.

title: XDeathsBans
description: Configurable death-based ban system for Minecraft servers. Set death limits, enable temp bans, and manage bans easily.
body:
# XDeathsBan

**XDeathsBan** is a mod designed for Minecraft servers that introduces a ban system based on the number of times a player dies. With this mod, server administrators can set a maximum death limit before a player is banned, configure whether only PvP deaths count, and customize the ban duration.

This mod is perfect for **hardcore** or **advanced survival** servers where death has real consequences, forcing players to be more strategic to avoid getting banned.

---

## 🛠️ Key Features
✅ **Automatic Bans**: Players will be banned upon reaching the configured death limit.  
✅ **PvP Mode**: Allows you to configure whether only PvP deaths count towards the ban.  
✅ **Temporary Bans**: Option to enable bans with a custom duration in ticks.  
✅ **Ban Management**: Commands to unban individual or all players.  
✅ **Configurable Settings**: Adjust ban settings in-game without restarting the server.  

---

## 🎮 Commands and Usage

### 📋 Mod Configuration
Administrators can modify the mod settings in real time using the following commands:

📌 **Check the current settings:**  
```plaintext
/xdeathsban settings status
```
💬 Displays the allowed death count, whether bans are temporary, ban duration, and if only PvP deaths count.

📌 **Set the maximum number of deaths before a ban:**  
```plaintext
/xdeathsban settings maxdeaths <number>
```
💬 Defines how many times a player can die before being banned.

📌 **Enable or disable PvP-only death counting:**  
```plaintext
/xdeathsban settings onlypvp <true|false>
```
💬 If enabled (`true`), only PvP deaths will count towards banning a player.

---

### 🚫 Ban Configuration
📌 **Enable or disable temporary bans:**  
```plaintext
/xdeathsban ban bantemp <true|false>
```
💬 Activates or deactivates temporary bans. If set to `false`, bans will be permanent.

📌 **Set the temporary ban duration:**  
```plaintext
/xdeathsban ban bantime <ticks>
```
💬 Defines how long a player will remain banned before they can rejoin.

_(1 second = 20 ticks, 1 minute = 1200 ticks)_

---

### 🔓 Ban Management
📌 **Unban a specific player:**  
```plaintext
/xdeathsban unban <player>
```
💬 Removes the ban for a specific player.

📌 **Unban all players:**  
```plaintext
/xdeathsban unban all
```
💬 Lifts the ban for all currently banned players.

📌 **List all banned players:**  
```plaintext
/xdeathsban util listbans
```
💬 Displays a list of all currently banned players.

📌 **Reload the mod configuration:**  
```plaintext
/xdeathsban util reload
```
💬 Reloads the settings from the JSON file without restarting the server.

---

## 🎯 Ideal Server Types
✔ **Hardcore and Semi-Hardcore**: Where death should have serious consequences.  
✔ **Competitive Survival**: Encouraging strategy and caution.  
✔ **PvP and War Servers**: To enforce bans on players who lose too many battles.  
✔ **Survival Events**: Eliminating players from an event after a set number of deaths.  

---

title: We Like Those Ores
description: This mod adds new ores with a vanilla+ feel, enhancing the game without breaking its balance.
body:
![We Like That Ores Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/986462ad97cd736c895cf2e95cd5c9e4697ccdef.png)

Why does this mod exist? Aren't there already thousands of ore mods out there? Yes, they exist. But most end up adding elements that unbalance the game and ruin the vanilla Minecraft experience, or have a completely different look than vanilla.

We Like Those Ores is another "expansion", as it aims to enrich the vanilla experience without exaggeration. Each ore or resource is designed to be balanced while staying true to the style of the original game.

Vanilla Minecraft only has a few minerals, and mining is one of the things we do most in the game, this mod fixes that, you mine and then make blocks, armor and tools similar to what you already have in the game.

This mod is also specific to the Forge 1.20.1 version, and another reason is because I like creating mods and I will dedicate myself to bringing something good to the community, just like so many other mods out there.

I recommend using this mod with other very well made mods that modify the terrain and or add ores such as Terralith, Biomes o Plenty, Quark, SimpleOres.

![wulfenite-block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dad94faad5ab9ae320b8268cb7bb4f6d0558189f.png) **ATTENTION! Make sure to always download the latest version of the mod to avoid bugs as much as possible.**

This is the beginning of the mod, more ores will be added soon!

![Lushite Update 0.6](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/85241793bb97198731048004e327891f38c83388.png)

New version 0.6 of We Like Those Ores, brings a new ore "Lushite", new items, decorative blocks, a new armor and of course, bugs fixed.

Lushite is a rare ore that can only be found in lush cave biomes, this ore is a type of powder that can be combined with niobium to form an alloy called lushiobium, used to upgrade niobium armor and make decorative blocks. image

![lushite recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4be5930cae69740d173c451492f4aa64e7d2973a.gif)

I'll be honest, I wanted to make the upgrade work like the diamond to netherite upgrade in the game, where you can only find the upgrade form in a certain location, in this case it would be in abandoned mines, but after more than 1 hour trying to make it work in MCreator it didn't work. ![lushite upgrade](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/937fce11cf7fc8e7632164a5e1ae5ccd9b3c9165.png)

I got it due to bugs, but at least I did something very similar. Mix niobium ingots and lushite powder on the workbench and make the item to upgrade your niobium armor to lushiobium, place the upgrade on a smithing table along with the armor piece and another lushite powder and that's it, you now have a armor similar to netherite. ![lushite dust](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e1d4c67e9e00e2438b1d960e88ec31ab9665840d.png)

![niobium grid](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/31596e446d7c2acb7f566e87a2cebaf211f8fcce_0.webp) ![lushite grid](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d15362f4f743633c1dc3fa900f6e99a99c1a83bb_0.webp) And also, I bring new decorative grid blocks inspired by the new Minecraft 1.21 update, which I recommend using This Mod to port the update to our 1.20.1 version.

![niobium](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34dbf2f338d9ea234214abf388ba01e58d8341c8.png)

Niobium is an ore that has better enchantment and efficiency than diamond and netherite, but has lower damage and durability.

![niobium recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9e706d7d5a01d27377d76a544c92a331de0255c4.gif)

Niobium is rare and can be found in basically the same layers as diamond, and its distribution is also similar to that of diamond. Its whitish-gray appearance is very similar to iron. To find it, look between -60 and 20.

![ignisium](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ee9f48e8bc1716f0936dccf9280ad74b50da1e55.png)

Ignisium is a mineral present in the Nether that stands out for its durability, however it does not have much efficiency, damage and enchantability.

![ignisium recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/07f27488b4f09bd2cfa2b924590642726f4e9772.gif)

It's not that difficult to find. Its black-orange appearance is very reminiscent of a volcano. Find between layers 0 and 64.

![wulfenite ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/68e939ee184340d913d3750504176ad49c937a93.png)

title: Block Chat
description: A simple plugin that disables chat. Easy to use.
body:
**ChatBlocker** is a lightweight and easy-to-use chat control plugin for Spigot and Paper servers. It lets you quickly enable or disable the server chat, making it perfect for staff announcements, events, or keeping things calm during busy moments.

**Features**
- **Instant toggle.** Turn the chat on or off instantly with a simple command.
- **Custom message.** Set a personalized message that players see when chat is disabled.
- **Saves your settings.** Remembers chat state and message across restarts.
- **Lightweight and efficient.** No dependencies, minimal performance impact.

**Commands:**
- ```/blockchat``` — Toggle the chat on or off.
- ```/blockchat message <text>``` — Change the message displayed when chat is disabled.

**Example:**
```
/blockchat
> Chat has been disabled!

/blockchat message Chat is currently off for maintenance!
> Disabled message has been updated!
```

body:
# Simple UUID Converter

## Disclaimer
**This pack was originally written by [gibbsly](https://github.com/gibbsly) and ported to MC-Build by [SnaveSutit](https://github.com/SnaveSutit). I simply cleaned up the code a bit, created a logo, and
uploaded the project to modrinth for convenience. This does not violate
copyright, as the original data pack is licensed under [The Unlicense lincense](https://unlicense.org). I'm also aware that this library has [already been uploaded to modrinth](https://modrinth.com/datapack/get-uuid), but the site does not seem to be maintained anymore.**

## About

This is a basic library to just generate the hex UUID of an entity

## Use

- `gu:generate` - writes the UUID of the current entity to storage `gu:main out`

- `gu:convert` - converts the UUID you input as the function argument `{UUID:[I;0,1,2,3]}` and writes it to storage `gu:main out`

## Credits

- Original author: [gibbsly](https://github.com/gibbsly)
- Original MCB rewrite: [SnaveSutit](https://github.com/SnaveSutit)

title: KarpInfo
description: Client-Side QoL mod for the server KobbledKarp. Offers HUDs, reminders, a stats tracker and more.
body:
# KarpInfo

Client-side quality-of-life mod specifically for the server KobbledKarp.

This mod reads information (like timers) from server chat and keeps track of them by displaying them in HUDs or by scheduling reminders. 

Timers include those for legendary spawns, Battle Tower, STS, and more. You won’t miss important information anymore, even if you don’t constantly read chat, and you no longer need to track multiple timers yourself.

For the mod to detect a timer, it must first appear in chat. So use `/legendinfo` once for the legendary timer, or for activities like the Battle Tower, complete them once to start tracking them.

Many features can be configured with `/karpinfo config`.

**Disclaimer:**
This is an unofficial mod made by me. The server admins allowed me to upload it, but they are not affiliated with it, so please contact me for support instead of the server staff.
This mod does not automate gameplay, give information that are not visible to the palyer, or send any packets to the server.

## Features

**Various HUDs** – most are only shown when needed or when the "HUD Details Key" (default: Alt) is pressed:
- `Main HUD`: Shows timers for the next legendary spawn, STS, and daycare, as well as Vote Party progress and the current time.
- `Tasks Cooldown HUD`: Shows when daily/weekly tasks like the Battle Tower, Kits, or Distortion Gyms are ready.
- `Server Timer HUD`: Shows item clear, server restart, and raid join timers.
- `Raid HUD`: Shows real-time raid rankings.
- `Legend Info HUD`: Shows current conditions for legendary spawns and conditions for the next legendary spawn.

**Notifications and Reminders** with optional sounds:
- Reminders 1 and 3 minutes before legendary spawns
- Notifications when a Vote Party is about to complete
- STS reminder (more precise than the existing one)
- Raid start notification and reminder
- Breeding notification sounds

**Stats Tracking** – displays custom KobbledKarp stats `/karpinfo stats`
- Number of legendary spawns witnessed and obtained
- Number of scam parties witnessed
- Money made and spent with `/shops`, `/pay`, `/sts`
- Money made with chest shops and `/gts` while online (can’t track while offline)
- Total GTS tax paid
- Number of raids participated in, times placed in the top 3, and average position
- Vote/Raid crates opened and Leg/Tex keys won
- Eggs bred and hatched
- Pokemon caught

And detailed breakdowns:
- Chest Shop tracking for all transaction types and what products made/cost how much
- Balance tracking when doing `\balance`, graph that shows your balance over time

**Legendary spawn helper**
Commands that tell you which Legendary Pokémon can spawn for you:
- `/checklegend now` tells you all legendaries that could spawn for you right now
- `/checklegend next` same, but uses the time of the next legendary spawn instead
- `/checklegendfilter` allows you to check for other times, biomes, and weather

**Dex helper** helps with completing the Pokedex
- Notifications when a wild pokemon that is not in your Pokedex is nearby.
- Also makes pokemon not in your dex glow (no esp they only glow when you can see them)
- A custom Pokedex UI `\dexhelper` where you can filter by uncaught pokemon
  - Clicking on a pokemon wil open its Bulbapedia page.
  - You can copy a list of your missing pokemon to share with others for touch trades

**Card Collection Tracking**
needs you to open each card page once for it to know what cards you already have
- Adds a green marker to collected cards and a red marker to cards you are still missing
- In the binder pages shows card school icon and a "+" icon tho cards that can be added
- Command `/karpinfo missingcards` copies all cards you are missing to sahre for trading

**Local friends tracking**
Allows you to add friends with `/friend add <name>`, which provides some useful features:
- When joining the server, a list of all online friends will be displayed
- `/friend online` shows which friends are online and their AFK status
- `/friend list` shows all your friends and when you last saw them online
- Optional notification sounds when friends join or leave
- `/friend remove <name>` removes a friend

**Lots of config options** use `/karpinfo config` or the ModMenu mod:
- Disable HUDs, notifications, or sounds
- Adjust HUD positions, backgrounds, and scale
- Disable the "Shiny Boost" Boss Bar for less HUD clutter
- Show an icon for plushies in GTS to distinguish them from Pokemon
- Hide plushies on the Minimap
- Configure when HUDs or specific entries are shown

title: Flamy Flames
description: Improves the look of flame particles by removing animated scaling, limiting rotation and adding animated textures.
body:
# Flamy Flames

A small mod that improves the look of flame particles by removing the scaling animation, changing their rotation mode and adding animated textures based on age.

Affects all vanilla and modded blocks that use flame particles, like **Torches**, **Candles** and lit **Furnaces**.

## Does this work with resource packs?

The animated textures can be overridden by resource packs. This will probably look fine with packs that add their own animated textures, but will look less than ideal with packs that just change the vanilla flame texture.
Because of this, the textures of this mod are provided as a built-in resource pack to allow reordering if needed.

## Mod Compatibility

Animated textures are included for the flame types added by:
* **[Buzzier Bees](https://modrinth.com/mod/buzzier-bees)** (Soul Candle flame)
* **[Caverns and Chasms](https://modrinth.com/mod/caverns-and-chasms)** (Cupric flame)
* **[Copper Age Backport](https://modrinth.com/mod/backport-copper-age)** (Copper flame)

New flame particles added by other mods will still get the the rotation and removed scaling, but won't have animated textures.

title: Lib99j
description: Another useful library mod for server-side development.
body:
## About
This is a mod used as a base for all my mods. Feel free to use it if you wish.

### Library Features
- VFX including locking camera, overlays, and more
- Server-side gui textures
- Server-side particles
- Hide bossbars
- Custom effects
- Pondering
- Easy config creation
- And more...

## Usage
**On mod initialization, please run Lib99j.ensureLoaded(). This forces the library to load before yours, which allows all the features to work correctly**

### build.gradle (Version number from modrinth)
```
repositories {
	maven { url = 'https://dj.ucc.asn.au/maven/' }
}

dependencies {
  implementation include("com.daniel99j:djutil:1.1")
  implementation include("com.daniel99j:lib99j:VERSION")
}
```



### Ponder (Server-side)
This is a re-creation of Create Mod's ponder system, now server-side. See [https://modrinth.com/mod/ponderplus](https://modrinth.com/mod/ponderplus) for an example.

Features:
- No client mods
- Skip, rewind, and pause
- If installed alongside Polydex or Booklet, click once to open a ponder
- Fast
- Does not change the player - neither the server or client know you are pondering, everything happens at the network level
- Fully self-contained
- No real-world changes
- Works with Polymer and server-side mods (and client ones too!)

Controls (in-game hud shows these):
- F: Identify - fly around and it will show what you are looking at
- SPACE: Pause/play
- Q: Exit
- L: Open menu
- S: Restart scene
- D: Next scene (if possible)
- A: Previous scene (if possible)
- SCROLL: Select step to skip to
- W: Skip to selected step

Commands:
```
/ponder all <id>
/ponder item <item>
/ponder item <item> scene <id>
/ponder item hand
/ponder item hand <id>
/ponder scene pause
/ponder scene unpause
/ponder scene exit
```


Dev commands:

```
/ponder dev ui_creator -> Opens the UI creator.
/ponder dev ui_creator_from <ponder command> -> Opens the UI creator after running the specified ponder command
/ponder dev toggle_free_movement -> Toggle free movement in a ponder scene
/ponder dev get_edits -> Lists all interactions made with the world in free move mode
```


UI creator:
- Stained glass shows safe area
- Open menu [L] to start editing
- If on the client hold shift in the menu to see what ponder ui coordinate the cursor is over, CTRL-C to copy

Demo video:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/AFEpMs1cQRs" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

### Game properties
- enableHideableBossbar() makes yellow bossbars white, and using BossBarVisibility you can make any bossbar invisible
- enableCustomEffectBadLuck() makes the unluck effect show as "Custom Effect (/polymer effects)" and have a custom sprite
- enablePonder() enables ponder (see above)
- enableAddingAssetTranslationsToServer() makes all lang files in the assets folder be treated as a server translation in Nucleoid Server Translations API

### Configs
- Lib99j also provides an easy to use config api
- Per-world, common, client only, and server only configuration options
- Optional client syncing
- Uses cloth config for screen
- In-game server side dialog re-creation of cloth config (/lib99j config {modid})
- Mod menu support
- JSON serialization through GSON
- Supports primitives, identifiers, vec2, vec3, colours automatically in all config screens and config files
- Use ConfigManager.addConfig(modid, modconfig) to add configs. Each ModConfig contains a nullable ConfigHolder for each context. Just supply a config class and you're done
- Use ServerConfigCopy.getConfigOption(modid, serializedName, optionClass, fallback) to get a synced option from the server (option must be annotated with sync = true)

Example config class:
```
public class ExampleConfig {
    @ConfigEntry
    public boolean testBool = true;

    @ConfigEntry(sync = true)
    @SerializedName("wavy_ui")
    public boolean wavyUi = false;

    //Object primitives work too!
    @ConfigEntry(min = 0, max = 10000)
    public Integer explosionDamage = 10;

    @ConfigEntry(displayType = ConfigDisplayType.SLIDER, max = 50, min = 0)
    public int explosionSize = 10;

    @ConfigEntry(displayType = ConfigDisplayType.COLOUR_PICKER)
    public int worldTint = 0xff00ff;

    @ConfigEntry(displayType = ConfigDisplayType.COLOUR_PICKER_ALPHA)
    public int overlayColour = 0xff0000ff;

    @ConfigEntry
    public Identifier packId = Identifier.withDefaultNamespace("test");

    @ConfigEntry
    public Vec2 spawnRotation = Vec2.ZERO;

    @ConfigEntry
    public Vec3 spawnPos = Vec3.ZERO;

    //ChatFormatting is an Enum
    @ConfigEntry
    public ChatFormatting formatType = ChatFormatting.RED;
}
```

### Mod install status
- Use ModInstallManager.syncInstalledStatus(modid) to mark your mod to have its install status synced, then use ModInstallManager.isInstalled(modid, player) to check if the mod is installed on the client

### Gui Utils
- By default, Lib99j generates a font space range of -256 to 256 (Note, when using eg, space=270, it uses a combo of 256 and 14!). Use GuiUtils.getSpace() and related functions
- GuiUtils.nextPage(), GuiUtils.previousPage(), and GuiUtils.head() create player heads for use in guis
- GuiUtils.doesPlayerHaveMods() allows you to see what mods are installed, read the documentation for more info
- GuiUtils.toast() displays an advancement popup with a custom item and text
- **Now for the meat of it!**
- GuiUtils.generateTexture() and GuiUtils.generateColourableTexture() creates a GuiElementBuilder that has an auto generated item model and definition. Texture format: "examplemod", "ui/test/image". Note that other base paths are accepted, but it is recommended to use /ui/ as other functions use this solely
- GuiUtils.generateBarTexture() creates a vertical bottom to top filling bar with a base, fill, and overlay.
- BackgroundTextures are a basic inventory-based font background generator, eg: new BackgroundTexture(Identifier.fromNamespaceAndPath(MagmaNetworkMod.MOD_ID, "test/test_ui"), 176). Uses /ui/ for texture references.
- 

### VFX
- VfxUtils.shake() causes a camerashake effect similar to bedrock edition
- VfxUtils.addGenericScreenEffect() adds many other client-side effect such as:
- RED_TINT - Red worldborder tint
- SNOW - Powder snow overlay
- FIRE - Self-explanatory
- NAUSEA - You get it.
- BLACK_HEARTS - Withered hearts
- GREEN_HEARTS - Poisoned hearts
- GREEN_HUNGER - Green hunger haunches
- BLINDNESS - The blindness effect
- NIGHT_VISION - The night vision effect
- CONDUIT_POWER - The conduit power effect
- DARKNESS - Warden darkness effect
- LOCK_CAMERA_AND_POS - More complicated, explained next.
- 
- **Camera Locking**
- To lock the player's camera and movement, add the LOCK_CAMERA_AND_POS effect
- setCameraInterpolation, setCameraPos, setCameraPitch, and setCameraYaw control varius aspects of the locked camera
- Due to technical reasons, the player is unable to see the hotbar, and the game looks like it is in spectator mode
- registerCameraLockHandler registers a camera lock handler for a source id, which supplies camera rotation and player
- 
- **MISC**
- VfxUtils.clientSideExplode() causes a client-side explosion destroying blocks (ONLY ON THE CLIENT). Use only for cinematics, as ghost blocks are buggy
- VfxUtils.fireworkExplode() creates a firework explosion as if a firework actually spawned
- VfxUtils.sendFakeEntity() sends a client side entity. Note it will never be removed normally, so it is only recommended to use this with lightning bolts or other entities that will be auto-removed
- 

### Particles
WORK IN PROGRESS FEATURE, may experience heavy server lag.
Rework will happen soon when I have time.
### Misc
- PlayPacketUtils contains a list of all PLAY packets
- ConfigUtils has some basic configuration functions
- GameProperties has some toggles and information about the game



This project has no affiliation with Create Mod, Ponder, or any similar mods.

With this data pack, you can count dropped items in 2 ways:

### 1

You can name an armor stand 'itemcount<radius>', where radius is the radius around the armor stand where the data pack will try to find items (for example: itemcount12). Clear indicators will be given to signify a recognised item counter.

### 2

Doing '/trigger global_item_counter' and then clicking 'On' will make the data pack ignore the item counters and count all loaded items.

Bundles, shulker boxes and other items containing items have their contends extracted after counting them. '/trigger item_count_sidebar' can be used to view the counted items in the world. '/trigger reset_count' to reset the counted items. This goes without saying: Items that have been counted aren't counted again. title: Original Swamp
description: Origins themed modpack with optimizations and first person enhancing features
body:
# 🌳🐸 Original Swamp 🐍🌿

Original Swamp is a really cool modpack for Minecraft that combines the Origins mod with some fancy optimization to make the game run smoother and look better.

### 🚀 Is it like Optifine?

Nah, it's not Optifine. Instead, it uses SODIUM and some other mods that make the game crazy fast and smooth, with almost no frame drops.

### 💥 Lots of Awesome New Mods

And that's not all! Original Swamp also has a bunch of totally awesome new mods that add all kinds of cool stuff to the game, like minimaps (with claims and parties), new foods, and revamped structures. So if you're looking for some new adventures in Minecraft, you gotta check it out and see what you can discover!

### 🐮 Origins

In this mod, there are also ORIGINS, which are similar to classes. Each one provides unique perks and debuffs.

### 🪶 Lightweight

With only 60–70 mods, this modpack is light as a feather. It can run on most hardware and even on 1.18.2.

title: Isolate
description: Isolation. A mod that adds a new dimension, a few blocks, and items.
body:
**A simple mod adding a new dimension (mainly for lore/isolation,) some new blocks, and 2 new items.**

# The Items.
**Charm of Isolation.** Right click to transport oneself to Isolation. Off-hand + Right Click to return to overworld. Attack another player with this item to send them there.

**Tainted Knife.** Returns the target player to the overworld if stabbed in Isolation. 9 attack damage, 1.6 attack speed. Used only for lore.

# The Blocks.
**Pillar** (+ Horizontal Variants.) (+ Isolated variant.)

**Package** (Mainly deco, but neat anyway.)

# The Dimension.
**Isolation.** An empty black & white space, completely quiet and freezing. Water is black and will freeze. Foliage + Grass are white. 

# Recipes.
The blocks are stonecutter recipes. To get pillars, you must put a Quartz Pillar in the stonecutter. To get the Package (3), you must put a piece of Stripped Oak Wood in the stonecutter.

**Side note, this mod is intended as BCSMP lore, and as such, is not entirely balanced for this reason.**

### silly extra side note

Knife tooltip:

*"Stained by divine blood. Pierces the target, returning them to the Overworld."*

title: Hopper Filters
description: Add item filtering mechanism to Hopper. No need complicated Redstone
body:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9b628bd9-f92e-4d21-bf58-3f8039309d89)

## HopperFilter Plugin

**Enhance your Minecraft server with HopperFilter** — a lightweight, powerful and highly customizable plugin that lets players create advanced hopper filters through an intuitive GUI system!

HopperFilter gives players full control over which items hoppers can pick up or transfer.  
With per-player limits, permission-based customization, world-specific toggles, and nice visual + sound effects — it brings both functionality and style to item management.

Perfect for **Survival**, **Factions**, **Skyblock**, or any server that values precise and beautiful item sorting!

## Features
- **Hopper Filters**  
  Right-click a hopper while sneaking → open a beautiful, customizable GUI to choose exactly which items the hopper will accept.

- **Per-Player Limits**  
  Set a default maximum number of filters per player, with the ability to override via permissions for VIPs/donors/admins.

- **Custom Filter GUI Size**  
  Adjust the filter menu size (27, 54 slots…) individually per player through permissions — more space for serious sorters!

- **World Blacklist**  
  Easily disable hopper filters in certain worlds via config (great for minigames, spawn, etc.).

- **Lightweight & Performant**  
  Designed from the ground up to be efficient — minimal lag even on large servers with thousands of hoppers.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/pEcgI8JQsnQ" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/31b13b0c-d8e2-4634-813e-280ae6d081d7)

## Commands
- `/hopperfilter reload`  
  Reloads the configuration file (admin only)

## Permissions
- `hopperfilter.admin`  
  Access to admin commands (reload)

- `hopperfilter.use`  
  Allows players to create and manage their own hopper filters

- `hopperfilter.bypass`  
  Allows using filters even in worlds where they are disabled

- `hopperfilter.limit.<number>`  
  Sets custom hopper filter limit for the player  
  Example: `hopperfilter.limit.20` → max 20 filters

- `hopperfilter.limit.*`  
  Unlimited hopper filters

- `hopperfilter.menu.<size>`  
  Sets custom GUI size for the player's filter menu  
  Example: `hopperfilter.menu.54` → 54-slot menu  
  (Default: 27 slots if no permission is set)

title: Panda's Brilliant Journey
description: PBJ is a 1.21.5 vanilla+ pack focused on enhancing exploration through new world generation, structures and mobs.
body:
![Panda's Brilliant Journey](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dcf9e4ca470494d18b21cf6491983eb39166d397_0.webp)

![The Goal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/14360d0c5ce1b97d6e8b4093caaf2d7246f125a3.png)

This pack was created primarily to host a small group of friends who love vanilla Minecraft but wanted a little bit more. Subject to frequent (and sometimes stretches of dormancy) content and balance adjustments to suit our taste. You are welcome to use it as is or make a fork if you like what it has at its core.


![Key Mods](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0600ac6ba87e41037a6317d894140f7dfa396db1.png)

**[Tectonic](https://modrinth.com/datapack/tectonic):** Creates more realistic feeling terrain while adding a touch of the fantastic. Adjustments have been made, increasing mountain height to around 360 blocks high. This adds scale without tanking chunk loading. The build height has also been doubled. 

**[William Wythers' Overhauled Overworld](https://modrinth.com/datapack/terralith):** Hundreds of new biomes that use vanilla blocks. Some biomes have been removed, but this can be adjusted to preference with the Biome Replacer config.

**[Terralith](https://modrinth.com/datapack/william-wythers-overhauled-overworld-(datapack)):** Overhauls vanilla biomes without adding any new blocks to increase their diversity and scale dramatically.

**[Wilder Wild](https://modrinth.com/mod/wilder-wild):** Adds several vanilla-style biomes, mobs and terrain tweaks that blend well with WWOO.

**[Enderscape](https://modrinth.com/mod/enderscape):** New End Biomes and overhauled generation.

**[Incendium](https://modrinth.com/datapack/incendium):** Ampifies Nether generation while adding some more Biomes.

**[Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons):** Greatly increases view distance without a large impact on performance by introducing a LOD system _(honestly, how is this not a vanilla feature?)_

**[Living Things](https://modrinth.com/mod/living-things):** Adds several real-world animals and has been manually configured to work with Terralith.

**[Dungeons and Taverns Series](https://modrinth.com/user/NovaWostra):** Most of the DnT structure mods have been included.

**[Towns and Towers](https://modrinth.com/mod/towns-and-towers):** Adds much improved variety to villages and pillager outposts.

**A collection of animal and mob additions:** From animals like bears and deer to a more diverse cast of enemy mobs!

**And more!**
