## A Minecraft Server
This is my server's modpack, put together for me and my friends to use. It includes quality-of-life and vanilla-feeling additions to give a more convenient experience without losing the original game.

There is technically no need to use this modpack if you do not have access to my server. However, there is nothing stopping you from using it if you enjoy the mods.

## Why did I make this modpack?

I enjoy playing minecraft, especially with friends, but I often become uninterested or bored after a length of time. I put together this modpack as a way for my friends and myself to feel motivated to play the game again by adding little things that make the game feel less difficult to keep playing.

## Installation
To install the modpack simply open the page on the Modrinth app and click the Install button.

### Please read if you have access to the server.
Old versions of this modpack are not compatible with the mods currently on the server. Please play using the latest version to be able to join the server.

title: EZWireless
description: A simple, lightweight wireless redstone mod.
body:
# EZWireless
## A simple, lightweight wireless redstone mod.

EZWireless is a simple, lightweight wireless redstone mod. The mod adds two blocks, the Transmitter and the Receiver. You can right click on each of these to set which channel they're on, and all Receivers on a certain channel will output a power level of 15 if at least one Transmitter is powered. Comparators reading a Receiver will output the power level of the Transmitter on the channel with the highest power. The mod also adds an item called the Wireless Linker, which just simply sets a Transmitter and Receiver pair to a random channel. This is not required to set channels, it's just a convenience tool.

title: Pug's Cobblemon
description: Pug's Cobblemon combines the best mods for new biomes, structures, combat, and Pokémon! Explore diverse landscapes, decorate with unique furniture, and catch and train Pokémon with Cobblemon for an epic adventure.
body:
Welcome to Pug's Cobblemon, a carefully curated compilation of some of the best Cobblemon mods out there, designed to offer a whole new way to experience the game! This modpack is all about combining amazing biomes, structures, new gameplay mechanics, and exciting combat features to create a rich, immersive world full of adventures. Please note: I did not create any of these mods myself, I’ve simply compiled them so you can enjoy them together in one seamless experience!

Biomes & Structures:
With this modpack, you can explore a stunning variety of landscapes and structures, thanks to Terralith and Tectonic. These mods transform the world’s biomes into breathtaking terrains with new geological formations and vibrant ecosystems. The pack also includes Dungeons and Taverns Modline, adding exciting dungeons to discover, taverns to visit, and loads of loot to find. Structory offers even more custom structures to fill your world, while Better End and Better Nether upgrade the End and Nether with new villages and pillages, offering more opportunities for exploration and engagement. There’s always something new to uncover around every corner!

Combat:
Prepare for epic battles with Better Combat Mod, which overhauls the combat system, adding new mechanics for a more immersive and strategic fighting experience. With combat reworked, you’ll also need to check out new weapons, armor, and powerful mobs from the new structures and dungeons.

Decoration & QOL Mods:
Decorating your world has never been so fun! With mods like Handcrafted, Clutter, Supplementaries, and Amendments, you can fill your homes with realistic, cozy furniture, tiny details, and all sorts of cute and functional decorations. Looking for something a bit more Pokémon-related? Pokeblocks and Plushables add delightful plush toys and blocks related to the Pokémon universe. Additionally, Paladins Furniture adds even more styles to your interiors.

To make life easier in Minecraft, this pack also includes Quality of Life mods like Decaying Leaves, 3D Skin Layers, and Better Animations. These tweaks improve the overall game experience, from visual polish to small gameplay improvements that enhance immersion.

Pokémon:
For all the Pokémon fans out there, get ready for an unforgettable adventure! Cobblemon adds a massive roster of Megas, Legendaries, and more Pokémon to catch, train, and battle. You can now ride your Pokémon, hatch eggs, collect badges, explore Pokémon-themed structures, and engage in battles with TMs and HMs. And with the addition of Pokémon-related décor, your world will truly feel like a Pokémon Trainer’s dream!

body:
<center>
  
  ![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Fapi.modrinth.com%2Fv2%2Fproject%2Fsl9k&query=downloads&suffix=%20&style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&logoColor=10DD10&logoSize=auto&label=Modrinth%20Downloads&labelColor=101010&color=242424)

  ![Requires Polymer](https://img.shields.io/badge/suggests_polymer-black?style=for-the-badge&logo=data%3Aimage%2Fsvg%2Bxml%3Bbase64%2CPHN2ZyB4bWxucz0iaHR0cDovL3d3dy53My5vcmcvMjAwMC9zdmciIHdpZHRoPSIzMiIgaGVpZ2h0PSIzMiI%2BPHBhdGggZD0iTTAgMGgzMnYzMkgwWiIgZmlsbD0iI0Y2RTBBNiIvPjxwYXRoIGQ9Ik0xMSAzaDEwdjJoNnY2aDJ2MTBoLTJ2MmgtMnYtMmgtMnYtOGgtMnYyaC0ydjJoLTJ2MmgtMnYyaC0ydjJoLTJ2Mkg5djJIN3YySDN2LTRoMnYtMmgydi0yaDJ2LTJoMnYtMmgydi0yaDJ2LTJoMnYtMmgyVjloLThaIiBmaWxsPSIjOTA5REEyIi8%%3D%3D&labelColor=%23f6e0a6&color=%23f6e0a6&link=modrinth.com%2Fmod%2Fpolymer)

  ## SpawnerLoader9000 (SL9K)

  Loads your spawner even when you're far away.

</center>

# Why?
This is specifically useful for spawner farms when you want to move them far away from the spawner!

I got the motivation to create this mod because the mod [Scarecrows' Territory](https://modrinth.com/mod/scarecrows-territory), isn't Vanilla compatible.

# How do I use it?
## First, you need to craft the block.

<details>
<summary>Crafting Recipe</summary>
  <center>
    
![Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c08e1ccc9392948942199f67a21d12993c56c2b.png)
  
  </center>

(you can make a suggestion in Github if you think that the recipe is very expensive!)
</details>

## Then, what?
Just place the block on top of a mob spawner and watch the magic happen!

<details>
<summary>Extras!</summary>
<hr>
The block can also load a 3x3 chunk area around itself so the spawned entities dont unload immediately.
<hr>
• This feature only works if the block itself is above a spawner and theres no presence of itself in a 5x5 chunk radius.
<hr>
<details>
<summary>Note!</summary>
Remember that this feature is automatically turned off but, you can enable it by right clicking the block and clicking the item in the middle. (Don't forget to click apply in the bottom right corner of the GUI!) (takes a while to actually load the 3x3 chunk area)
</details>
<hr>
</details>

# Compatibility
This mod should be compatible with all mods (atleast I think it is), feel free to make a [Github Issue](https://github.com/ThatMG393/SpawnerLoader9000/issues) if there's any mod incompatibility issue.

## Vanilla client compatibility
This mod supports Vanilla clients if you install the optional server-side mod, [Polymer](https://modrinth.com/mod/polymer)! (HUGE THANKS TO PATBOX AND ITS CONTRIBUTORS‼️‼️)

<details>
<summary>Tutorial! (all of this is on the server-side)</summary>
  
  1. Download Polymer and install it in your server 'mods' folder.

  2. Run the Minecraft Server to generate Polymer configs.

  3. Go to `config/polymer`

  4. Open `auto-host.json`

  5. And change the value of `"enabled"` and `"required"` (<- this one is optional) to `true`.

  The config file should now look like this:
  ![Output](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7dd2020ad8dc0087049e84f5a4ecc8a7375840dc_0.webp)

### Lastly, save the config and restart your server!
</details>

You can also install Polymer in the client-side for an overall better experience!

title: AdventuresHorizons
description: Time for an adventure! - This is my personal, low-res trailer modpack inspired by the Lowresbone Modpack! It aims to recreate the stunning visuals of Minecraft trailers within the vanilla game.
body:
![Description Header :)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/db5ddcc38cf5c0129af5e3fb1b0e556981c68b90.png)
# AdventuresHorizons - Time for an Adventure!
A modpack inspired by **Lowresbones - Low Res Trailer Recreation Modpack**, my pack adds a variety of visual, gameplay, and performance mods while keeping the vanilla gameplay and iconic style of the official low-res Minecraft trailers!

_**If you love the look of the official Minecraft trailers as much as I do, this is the modpack for you!**_

## Future and goals!
My goal is to create a modpack that makes me enjoy the game again, so I thought I'd share this journey with you through this modpack. I will keep updating it from time to time to fix any mistakes and fine-tune settings until it's perfect!

This is a **BETA** version still.

title: Budding Amethyst Border

## ✅ Pack Features

- Adds intensity and a border to budding amethyst, making it much easier to distinguish from regular amethyst!

## ℹ️ Frequently Asked Questions

**Q:** What Minecraft versions is this resource pack compatible with?

**A:** This resource pack should be compatible with Java Minecraft versions 1.17 and up, and does **NOT** require Optifine. If you are playing in a version below 1.21, you can safely ignore the "made for a new version of Minecraft" warning (unless you're playing on a version below 1.17 of course).

**Q:** What is your backstory behind making this resource pack?

**A:** When excavating amethyst geodes, I've always struggled with distingushing regular amethyst from budding amethyst, often resulting budding amethyst accidentally being broken. Thus, I made this pack to help myself and many others to help distinguish budding amethyst from regular amethyst, while still keeping the vanilla feel of budding amethyst without completely ruining the texture :)

title: A Little More Survival
description: Heavily opinionated changes to survival.
body:
What it says on the tin.

Rebalancing survival to do a few things:

1. Damage taken hurts
  
   Regeneration is not _disabled_ per se, it is instead extremely slow. At the same time, it still drains hunger/thirst. Fights end quickly, since immediate, fast regeneration is hard to obtain without multiple caveats.
2. Doing something new should be rewarded
  
   Full protection netherite gear is now only one way to set yourself up, no longer the only _viable_ way. More protective armor slows you down more, at the same time, each piece of armor grants a different bonus to some attribute, allowing for mixing and matching to strengthen a playstyle. The way armor reduces damage has been changed, too, meaning that little armor is still better than no armor, and that high defense does not turn fights into 20 minute slap fights.
3. Survival is tough, but not unfair
  
   There's no random events or sudden attacks that can kill you out of nowhere. Dealing with hunger and body temperature is challenging but predictable, and can be handled with a bit of work.

Things to know:
- There's 5 choices of weapon: swords, knives, axes, spears, and machetes. Each grant a different attribute increase, except for spears, instead having very long range and able to be thrown.
- To make a crafting table, you'll need iron and copper. To make a brick furnace, place a block of bricks and right-click it with a pickaxe.
- Throw down 1 log and 3 sticks, then light it with a fire starter. This makes a campfire.
- Standing around a campfire (soul or regular) gives regeneration.
- Brewing stands are disabled. You can make potions at a campfire or cauldron. The type of campfire matters. Check recipes in JEI using bottles to see available potions.
- Enchanting tables are disabled. Currently, enchanting is only done through books. Pay attention to an item's enchantment points, as it will determine the level and type of enchantments you can attach to it.
- The day cycle is 20% slower, giving you about 12 minutes of day and night each.
- You'll need to find some way to mitigate the extreme temperatures of the nether before progressing. The end is similarly cold.

This modpack was tested entirely in solo play and up to 4 player co-op. It works in multiplayer, but I can't say it's balanced for large group play.

title: Zephyr
description: Minecraft Modpack based on exploration and immersion.
body:
Summary

Created for the Zephyr Minecraft server, This modpack is themed around exploration and immersion, with special world generation and new structures keeping things interesting. This modpack also includes difficult magic for the player to master, custom tool assembly, enhanced cooking, wine-making, sailing, origins, and more.

Exploration

Zephyr features winding underground rivers and sweeping landscapes from Tectonic, as well as a world divided into multiple different continents with the Continents mod. Travel between distant locations is made easy with sailboats and skyships, and there are lots of new structures to discover.

Magic

Zephyr has two magic mods, Mage Hand and Hex Casting. In hex casting, you discover amethyst geodes underground and use them to fuel your own custom designed spells, and the mage hand mod lets you craft magic floating hands to automate things like farming.

Travel

Zephyr features three travel mods, Small Ships, which adds 3 types of sailboats, Immersive Aircraft, which adds 4 rustic aircraft to the game and upgrades for them, and Automobility, which adds customizable automobiles.

Food

Zephyr includes Farmer’s Delight, Culinary Construct, and Vinery to ensure the player never runs out of interesting food items.

title: Reverscore
description: Reverscore is a mod for the Revers Modpacks which adds various items and bosses.
body:
Reverscore is a mod which adds items, armors sets, tools, boss fights and other assets for the Revers: Reverse Collapse and Revers: Continuum Turbulence modpacks.

It will not work properly outside of it.

Nearly everything in Reverscore has no recipe of its own since the items are supposed to be obtained by using other mods, in a modpack.

Reverscore currently adds seven armor sets, four items that grant various buffs while in the inventory or offhand, several bosses and miscellaneous items.

**Armor Effects**
Deluge: Absorption IV, Luck, Speed, Strength, Haste, Fire Resistance, Saturation II
Archaeologist: Absorption III, Resistance II, Regeneration II, Saturation, Weakness, Slowness II
Soleipse: Speed, Strength III, Fire Resistance II
Lunepse: Speed III, Strength I, Haste II

**Pocket Items Effects**
Pocket Elisa: +100 Damage, Speed II and Resistance II
Double Tap Root Beer: +20 Damage
Ashes of Divine Winter: Permanent Fire Aspect and inflicting Slowness
Wheel-Dice of Fate: Grants random effects when hurting mobs
Ars Automatica: Grants various items when killing mobs with potion effects.

**Bosses**
Avar - an evil manifestation of greed, will summon his mercenaries against you and run away.
Kintoru - an evil manifestation of control who has mimicked a small ghast, will summon her puppets and accursed minions against you.
Netamo - an evil manifestation of rage who has mimicked a giant wolf, will rush towards you and fight you.
Gorge - an evil manifestation of gluttony. He will lifesteal off your damage.

## CHATBEAUTIFIER
### Beautify your chat.



# BUILD
Execute `gradlew shadowJar` in project directory, output file will be located on `build/libs` folder as `ChatBeautifier-VERSION-all.jar`.



# DONATE
This is a free & open source project, so I don't earn revenue from this resource. However, you can donate me through my PayPal by clicking [here](https://paypal.me/foudrestudios).



# SUPPORT
Join my [Discord](https://discord.gg/bQNd3ZWwzq) to get support. However, it's not guaranteed that you will get support from directly me or our support team. We are volunteers.



# COMMANDS
- **/chatbeautifier**: Main command. Contains "send", "toggle" and "reload" args. Example usage: **/chatbeautifier send Deliable custom_fonts mycoolfont My very cool text**, **/chatbeautifier send Deliable small_caps My very cool text**



# PERMISSIONS
- **chatbeautifier.command.main**: Permission to use the main command.
- **chatbeautifier.command.<arg>**: Permission to use the /chatbeautifier <arg> command.

title: Slowcraft
description: Library for modpack, datapack and mod authors to create low-tech Progressive Crafting items, inspired by Better Than Wolves and Create.
body:
# Slowcraft

**Slowcraft is a library mod for modpack, datapack and mod authors to create progressive crafting items called SlowTools.**

Inspired by the [Knitting](https://wiki.btwce.com/view/Knitting) system in [Better Than Wolves](https://wiki.btwce.com/view/Main_Page) and the [Polishing](https://create.fandom.com/wiki/Sand_Paper) system in [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create/).

![An example SlowTool](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dde960135a26d11b97b1a0314503532468b461d3.png)

## SlowTools

SlowTools are intermediary crafting items, intended to be time-consuming crafts. The player holds right-click to work on it while its durability bar shows the current progress.

Progress is saved when the player stops, so a long craft can be completed a little at a time. Once the bar finishes, the SlowTool is consumed and its outputs are given to the player.

_A real life example could include things like knitting, weaving, or whittling._

![A SlowTool being completed over time](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/lK5knzE0/images/3c5946f8424aec74266ebe6264dd4ac74678c8f9.gif)

## Requirements

- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- (Optional) [JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei)

Slowcraft is a library mod. Installing it by itself does not add anything; mods, modpacks, and datapacks use it to create their own SlowTools.

## Documentation

- [Slowcraft Wiki](https://github.com/nibbyy/Slowcraft/wiki)
- [Making SlowTools](https://github.com/nibbyy/Slowcraft/wiki/Making-SlowTools)
- [Commands and Integrations](https://github.com/nibbyy/Slowcraft/wiki/Commands-and-Integrations)
- [Example Datapack](https://github.com/nibbyy/Slowcraft/releases/tag/Datapack)

## Made for Modpacks, Datapacks and Mods

Slowcraft supports two ways to create SlowTools:

- **Data-driven:** SlowTools can be added through datapack JSON files without any Java.
- **Java-driven**: SlowTools can be registered as items for mod developers who want custom sounds, assets, or additional behavior.

SlowTools can be configured with a crafting time, up to four item outputs, and more!

## Integration

When [JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei) is installed, Slowcraft adds a **Progressive Crafting** recipe category showing each SlowTool's outputs and crafting time.

SlowTools have an Information page, and SlowTools are added to JEI automatically.

![Slowcraft's Progressive Crafting category in JEI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5987d333a2cbc34c5fc8dbb741850ab0bf498f89.png)

**JEI is optional and is not required to use Slowcraft.**

Planned Integration:
- EMI / REI / etc.
- KubeJS

## Credits

- **FlowerChild** and the **BTW CE 3.0 Community** for the inspiration and art assets
- [Ivangeevo](https://modrinth.com/user/ivangeevo) for assistance with item logic

_Slowcraft was originally created for a modpack of my own, but anyone is welcome to use it in their mods or modpacks._

## Check Out

I've released a mod with this Library which adds the Wool Processing line from BTW: [BetterThanWools](https://modrinth.com/mod/betterthanwools)

title: Infinite Use
description: Toggle any held item to be infinite — totems revive forever, blocks place endlessly, tools have no durability loss. One command, one tag, every item.
body: # InfiniteUse Make any item infinite with one command. Totems become unlimited. Blocks place forever. Tools never break. ## Features A single command turns the item in your main hand into an **infinite** item: - **Stack count never decreases** — eat food, place blocks, throw splash potions, shoot arrows, fire ender pearls, drink potions, use buckets... the stack never goes down. - **Durability never decreases** — swords, pickaxes, shears, bows, fishing rods, crossbows, elytra... the bar stays full. - **Totems of Undying** — survive death as many times as you want from a single totem. - **End Crystals**, **Boats**, **Eggs**, **Snowballs**, **Splash Potions**, **all subclass items** — covered via a unified `ItemStack` dispatch hook. The marker is stored as an NBT tag (1.16.5–1.20.4) or as a custom `DataComponent` (1.20.5+), so it persists across save/load and works on dedicated servers. ### Move duplication is fixed Earlier naive implementations duplicate items when you shift-click them in inventories (the source stack doesn't decrement, but the destination still receives the items). InfiniteUse uses a **thread-local consume context**: cancellation only triggers when the stack is actually being *consumed* (use / place / eat / totem trigger), not during inventory transfers. Move freely without duplication. ## Commands Requires OP permissions (level 2). | Command | Description | |--------|-------------| | `/infiniteuse` or `/iu` | Toggle InfiniteUse on the held item | | `/iu on` | Mark the held item as infinite | | `/iu off` | Remove the mark | | `/iu toggle` | Same as no argument | | `/iu status` | Show current state of the held item | ## Requirements - Fabric Loader - Fabric API Each jar targets one Minecraft version. **Use the jar that exactly matches your Minecraft version.** ### Jar / Minecraft compatibility table | Jar file | Compatible Minecraft version | |---|---| | `infiniteuse-mc1.16.5-1.0.0.jar` | 1.16.5 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.17.1-1.0.0.jar` | 1.17.1 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.18.2-1.0.0.jar` | 1.18.2 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.19.4-1.0.0.jar` | 1.19.4 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.20.1-1.0.0.jar` | 1.20.1 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.20.4-1.0.0.jar` | 1.20.2 / 1.20.3 / 1.20.4 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.20.6-1.0.0.jar` | 1.20.5 / 1.20.6 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.21.1-1.0.0.jar` | 1.21 / 1.21.1 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.21.2-1.0.0.jar` | 1.21.2 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.21.3-1.0.0.jar` | 1.21.3 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.21.4-1.0.0.jar` | 1.21.4 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.21.5-1.0.0.jar` | 1.21.5 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.21.6-1.0.0.jar` | 1.21.6 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.21.7-1.0.0.jar` | 1.21.7 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.21.8-1.0.0.jar` | 1.21.8 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.21.9-1.0.0.jar` | 1.21.9 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.21.10-1.0.0.jar` | 1.21.10 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.21.11-1.0.0.jar` | 1.21.11 | Versions not listed (1.16.0-1.16.4, 1.17.0, 1.18.0/1.18.1, 1.19.0-1.19.3, 1.20.0, etc.) are **not supported** — Minecraft's APIs differ enough between point releases that a mismatched jar will fail to load or crash. ## How it works A Mixin on `ItemStack#decrement` and `ItemStack#setDamage` cancels the operation only when: 1. The stack carries the InfiniteUse marker, AND 2. We are inside a "consume" path (`Item#use`, `useOnBlock`, `finishUsing`, `onStoppedUsing`, or `LivingEntity#tryUseDeathProtector` / `tryUseTotem`). Inventory operations (drag, shift-click, hopper transfer, drop) take place outside this context, so counts decrement normally — no duplication. ## Links **YouTube:** [MC clip](https://youtube.com/channel/UCGrw0wd3fF-l-m3wfCLbFKw) Subscribe for updates and tutorials! --- # 日本語 コマンド一発でメインハンドのアイテムを **無限化** するFabric MOD。 ## 特徴 - **スタック数が減らない** — 食べる・置く・スプラッシュポーション投擲・矢発射・エンダーパール・ポーション飲み・バケツ使用…全部減りません - **耐久値が減らない** — 剣・ピッケル・ハサミ・弓・釣竿・クロスボウ・エリトラ…バーは常に満タン - **トーテム・オブ・アンダイング無限** — 1個のトーテムで何度でも蘇生 - **エンドクリスタル / ボート / 卵 / 雪玉 / スプラッシュポーション / その他サブクラス系アイテム** — `ItemStack` の統一エントリで全部カバー マーカーは NBT タグ（1.16.5〜1.20.4）または カスタム DataComponent（1.20.5以降）で保存。セーブ&ロードを跨いでも維持され、専用サーバでも動作します。 ### アイテム移動時の複製を解決済み 素朴な実装だとシフトクリック移動時に「移動先には入る・移動元は減らない」で複製になります。本MODは **スレッドローカルの消費コンテキスト** を使い、実際にアイテムを *消費* する経路（使用/設置/食べる/トーテム発動）でのみキャンセルが発動します。インベントリ移動・ホッパー輸送・ドロップは通常通りに進むので複製しません。 ## コマンド OP権限（レベル2）が必要。 | コマンド | 動作 | |---|---| | `/infiniteuse` または `/iu` | メインハンドのアイテムを無限化トグル | | `/iu on` | 無限化をON | | `/iu off` | 無限化をOFF | | `/iu toggle` | 引数なしと同じ | | `/iu status` | 現在の状態を表示 | ## 対応バージョン 各 jar は **1 つの Minecraft バージョン専用** です。お使いの Minecraft バージョンに合った jar を選んでください。 ### jar と対応 Minecraft バージョン対応表 | jar ファイル | 対応 Minecraft バージョン | |---|---| | `infiniteuse-mc1.16.5-1.0.0.jar` | 1.16.5 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.17.1-1.0.0.jar` | 1.17.1 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.18.2-1.0.0.jar` | 1.18.2 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.19.4-1.0.0.jar` | 1.19.4 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.20.1-1.0.0.jar` | 1.20.1 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.20.4-1.0.0.jar` | 1.20.2 / 1.20.3 / 1.20.4 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.20.6-1.0.0.jar` | 1.20.5 / 1.20.6 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.21.1-1.0.0.jar` | 1.21 / 1.21.1 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.21.2-1.0.0.jar` | 1.21.2 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.21.3-1.0.0.jar` | 1.21.3 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.21.4-1.0.0.jar` | 1.21.4 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.21.5-1.0.0.jar` | 1.21.5 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.21.6-1.0.0.jar` | 1.21.6 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.21.7-1.0.0.jar` | 1.21.7 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.21.8-1.0.0.jar` | 1.21.8 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.21.9-1.0.0.jar` | 1.21.9 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.21.10-1.0.0.jar` | 1.21.10 | | `infiniteuse-mc1.21.11-1.0.0.jar` | 1.21.11 | 上記に載っていないバージョン（1.16.0〜1.16.4、1.17.0、1.18.0/1.18.1、1.19.0〜1.19.3、1.20.0 など）は **非対応** です。Minecraft の API がポイントリリース間で十分に変化するため、合わない jar はロードに失敗するかクラッシュします。 ## 仕組み `ItemStack#decrement` と `ItemStack#setDamage` をMixinで横取りし、以下の条件を**両方**満たす場合にだけキャンセルします： 1. 対象スタックに InfiniteUse マーカーが付いている 2. 「消費パス」内（`Item#use` / `useOnBlock` / `finishUsing` / `onStoppedUsing` / `LivingEntity#tryUseDeathProtector` ・ `tryUseTotem`） インベントリ操作（ドラッグ・シフトクリック・ホッパー輸送・ドロップ）はこの条件外なので普通にスタックが減り、複製しません。 ## YouTube **チャンネル:** [MCクリップ](https://youtube.com/channel/UCGrw0wd3fF-l-m3wfCLbFKw) チャンネル登録よろしく！

title: Leader Banner
description: Give leader zombies a cool banner!
body:
A small datapack that just adds banner to a zombie's head when they spawn IF they have the leader zombie attribute modifier.

A _vanilla-friendly_ attempt to indicate which zombies have had their maximum health increased, inspired by Pillagers and their ominous banners. This banner can be obtained by killing the zombie carrying it, with a **25%** chance of dropping.

title: ZenoDuels
description: Duels Plugin for your SMP!
body:
## ⚔️ ZenoDuels - Clean Duel System

A straightforward duel plugin that actually works well. Challenge players, fight in dedicated arenas, and let the plugin handle the rest.

## 🎮 What it does

Players can challenge each other with `/duel <player> <gamemode>`. The challenged player gets clickable accept/deny buttons in chat. Once accepted, both players teleport to the arena, fight until someone dies, and the winner gets configurable time to collect items before everyone returns to their original spots.

The arena automatically resets after each duel, so you don't have to worry about cleanup.

## ✨ Key features

- 💬 Simple `/duel` command system
- 🖱️ Clickable chat responses (no typing commands)
- 🎯 Custom gamemode support (nodebuff, crystal, sumo, etc.)
- 🔄 Automatic arena restoration
- ⏰ Configurable winner collection time
- 🎨 Fully customizable messages
- ⚙️ Easy admin setup

## 🤔 Why use this?

Most duel plugins are either overcomplicated or missing basic features. This one focuses on doing duels right - clean interface, reliable teleportation, and automatic cleanup. Perfect for PvP servers that want organized 1v1s without the hassle.

Set your arena points, create some gamemodes, and you're done. No complex configuration needed. 🚀

## 🎯 Perfect For

PvP servers, practice servers, tournament hosting, and community servers wanting organized, fair dueling with automatic arena cleanup.

## 🎮 DISCORD
Join our discord if you have any questions or problems related the plugin: [__Join Our Discord__](https://discord.gg/pVbSPXg3uG) here you can make friends, talk and watch for updates. Maybe you can win some giveways or some packs of mine.

title: THE HOLE
description: THE HOLE is an experimental Minecraft mod that introduces coordinate-based black holes. Place black holes in your world that will attract nearby entities, items, and ultimately blocks, creating destructive zones.
body:
THE HOLE is an experimental Minecraft mod that introduces coordinate-based black holes. Place black holes in your world that will attract nearby entities, items, and ultimately blocks, creating destructive zones.

FEATURES:
Coordinate system
Growth system
Automatic removal
Player notification
Toggle command
World protection

COMMANDS:
/thehole create [x] [y] [z]: Create a black hole at the specified coordinates
/thehole create: Create a black hole at your current location
/thehole remove: Remove the nearest black hole
/thehole savemode: Enable/disable safe mode

!IMPORTANT WARNINGS!
-Performance reduction
-High computational load: Black holes continuously scan large areas for entities and blocks
-Resource intensive: Large black holes (radius > 30) can significantly impact frame rate
-CPU load: Complex physics calculations are performed for each active black hole.
-Irreversible destruction: Absorbed blocks are permanently removed from the world
-Large-scale damage: Black holes can destroy entire structures and landscapes
-Potential damage: Extremely large black holes may cause chunk loading issues

SAFE MODE
Safe mode prevents black holes from growing beyond a radius of 80

KNOWN ISSUES
-Very large black holes may cause significant lag spikes during growth phases
-The speed of object absorption varies depending on server performance

NOTE: This mod is intended for experimental gameplay. Use it responsibly and consider the impact on your system's performance. The author is not responsible for equipment damage or world damage resulting from unsafe use.

title: Krieger Combat System
description: A PvP mod with a life system. Lose hearts when you die in PvP — at 0 hearts you get permanently banned. Includes a duel system and a rescue item for extra excitement!
body:
KriegerMod – Life and Combat System

By MaveHD & Nxton

Security information: The server IP address is recorded and sent to a Discord Webhook to prevent misuse. This data is used solely for license enforcement and is not publicly shared or stored beyond the necessary period.

📜 Description  

This mod adds a life system where players lose one life each time they die in combat. When a player reaches 0 lives, they get kicked from the server! Additionally, it features a combat system that marks players for PvP for a certain duration, along with duels and special items like the Lifesaver, which protects a life.

✨ Features  

✔ Life System – Every player starts with 3 hearts. You lose one heart each time you die in combat.  
✔ Combat Mode – PvP activates a countdown timer (30–320 seconds). Logging out during this time still costs you a life!  
✔ Duels – Challenge other players with /duel and fight without losing lives.  
✔ Lifesaver Item – Protects you from losing a life (wearable as a Curio).  
✔ Dynamic Combat Duration – The lower your health, the longer the combat mode lasts.  
✔ Broadcast Messages – Epic death announcements visible to all players.  
✔ Persistent Data – Player lives are saved in playerLives.json.  

⚙️ Commands  

/playerlives check/set – Displays the remaining lives of all players and allows setting those values.  
/restoreplayer [player] – Restores a player back to the server if they were kicked due to losing all lives (OP only).  
/duel [player] – Starts a fair duel with another player.  

⏰ Future Updates  

Dummys (A Dummy for the player spawns for 30 seconds when a player logs out so he cant escape a fight) [50% Done | Comes in about 2 Updates]


If you have any Questions join my [Discord](https://dsc.gg/mavehd)

This mod was developed independently by us, but is based in many aspects on the well-known Minecraft Helden mod. Despite the obvious parallels, this is not a copy, but rather our own project with our own implementation, our own ideas, and extensions. Our goal was to create a similar gaming experience, while setting our own priorities and further developing the system according to our own ideas.

title: TarminaRX's Lucky Clover
description: Find rare four-leaf clovers, stack up your luck, and watch your loot tables smile back. Boost fishing and chest rewards, trade with master clerics, and tune every multiplier to make fortune favor your adventures.
body:
# TarminaRX's Lucky Clover

Discover the magic of luck with four-leaf clovers! This mod brings a touch of fortune to your Minecraft adventures by introducing lucky four-leaf clovers that enhance your luck attribute and improve your loot-finding experience.

## Features

### 🍀 Four-Leaf Clover Item

Find these rare lucky charms in loot chests throughout your world! Each clover you carry increases your luck, making your adventures more rewarding.

### 🎲 Dynamic Luck System

- **Inventory-Based Luck**: The more clovers you carry, the luckier you get!
- **Configurable Multipliers**: Customize how much luck each clover provides
- **Affects All Luck Mechanics**: Fishing, mob drops, and loot chest contents all benefit from your increased luck

![Lucky Clover Effect Inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bdc01b24989efe19aeefb70e8f1d9937df787e68.png)

### 📦 Loot Table Integration

Four-leaf clovers naturally spawn in various loot containers:
- Village chests
- Barrels
- Dungeon loot
- And more!

The more clovers you already have, the better your chances of finding more (luck multiplier applies to clover spawns too)!

![Lucky Clover Chest Loot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c3f301304738ae253b988be1f7d72f194ebd1027.png)

### 🤝 Villager Trading

Master Clerics have discovered the secret of four-leaf clovers and are willing to trade them for emeralds (or any configured item).

![Lucky Clover Villager Trade](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/67c8f9736c89b567511f478e055620da65daf913.png)

## ⚙️ Configuration

TarminaRX's Lucky Clover is highly configurable! After your first launch, find the config file at `config/trxluckyclover-common.toml`.

### Trade Configuration
```toml
enableCloverTrade = true           # Enable/disable cleric trades
tradeItem = "minecraft:emerald"    # Item required for trade
tradeItemCount = 50                # Number of items needed
```

### Luck Settings
```toml
luckMultiplier = 1.0              # Luck bonus per clover (general effects)
lootLuckMultiplier = 0.01         # Luck bonus for finding more clovers
```

### Loot Settings
```toml
enableLootTableDrops = true       # Enable clovers in loot chests
cloverLootChance = 0.1            # Base spawn chance (0.0 to 1.0)
maxCloverInLoot = 1               # Max clovers per chest
```

## 🐛 Bug Reports & Suggestions

Found a bug or have a feature suggestion? Please report it on the [issue tracker](https://github.com/TarminaRX/luck-clover-mod/issues).


## 🏆 Credits

- [KazekiPixels](https://mcmodels.net/vendors/195/kazekipixels) - For the four-leaf clover texture.
- [JrDemiurge](https://modrinth.com/user/JrDemiurge) - for the original mod idea.

---

**May the luck of the four-leaf clover be with you!** 🍀

title: tpHome-Plugin
description: A stupidly simple teleport home plugin for Paper Servers.
body:
The tpHome plugin add a **/tphome** command to [Paper](https://papermc.io/) servers.  The player is sent to their respawn location.

The tphome command is injected into Minecraft's native command system so it can be used in Command Blocks and DataPacks.

Server Operators with the `minecraft.command.selector` permission (as well as Command Blocks and Functions) can supply an optional single player selector.

The command can be restricted by updating the plugin's config.yml file and restarting your server.


**IMPORTANT:** This plugin will only work with servers supporting Paper's plugin loader.


**Permissions:**

`tphome.home` - Allow user to run command when restricted.


**Data Collected**

This plugin utilizes [bStats](https://bstats.org/plugin/bukkit/tpHome) to collect usage statistics, including anonymized data about your server.
If you wish to have your server excluded from this data collection, please edit the `bStats/config.yml` file and set `enabled` to `false`.

The D3K Legacy Modpack offers a range of enhancements that significantly improve both the performance and gameplay experience in Minecraft. title: BackPack Plugin
description:
It's a Minecraft Plugin that adds Backpacks to the game.
It works with all 1.21 versions, Tested on 1.21.5 and 1.21.8. Fully customizable.
You can get them by Crafting, or with a command.
body:
# BackPack Plugin:
# 
Overview

The Backpack plugin allows players to have personal portable storage in Minecraft that can be opened like a chest but is persistent across server restarts. Each backpack is unique and linked to its owner, with features to prevent nesting backpacks inside each other and control inventory access. It's fully customizable. 


The plugin also provides commands for giving, viewing, and managing backpacks, as well as full configuration support for customization.

Features
1. Backpack Items

Players can receive backpacks via command (/backpack give) or (optionally) through crafting.

Each backpack is linked to a UUID and the player's name.

The item lore shows:

Owner name

Backpack number

Contents count (filled slots / total slots)

Instruction: "Right click to open"

2. Commands
/backpack give <player> [rows] [item]

Gives a backpack to a player.
!["Backpack give" Command](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9820105d20aa5779efbe66f60c45d84a7d6802be.png)

Optional:

rows: Size of the backpack (e.g., 2x9, 3x9)

item: The type of item to represent the backpack (e.g., CHEST, SHULKER_BOX)

/backpack seeinside <player> <number>

Allows a player to view a specific backpack of another player by his number.
!["Backpack seeinside" Command](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8faffc2e8b61af9cbd5e351b66eca4a6454dc77f.png)

/backpack reload or /bp reload

Reloads the plugin configuration (items, crafting recipes, language settings, etc.) without restarting the server.
!["Backpack reload" Command](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd58ffd4a2cc2c0ebf79583535ac7340203e5ceb.png)

3. Crafting

A default backpack recipe exists (configurable).

Can be fully customized in the config: shape, ingredients, and result item.

Crafting can produce real functional backpacks or dummy items depending on the settings.

4. Inventory Behavior

When a backpack is opened:

Players can move all items except the backpack itself.

Other backpacks can be moved but cannot be placed inside the open backpack.

Inventory contents update dynamically in the item's lore.

5. Persistence

All backpacks are saved to backpacks.yml:

Contents

Size

Owner

Display name

Data is loaded automatically on plugin enable.

6. Configuration Options

Backpack Item: Set which item represents a backpack.

Default Rows & Max Rows: Control size limits of backpacks.

Crafting Recipe: Fully configurable, including shape and ingredients.

Language Settings: Support for English and German messages.

Comments: All config settings include English comments for clarity.

7. Plugin Compatibility

Compatible with Paper/Spigot 1.21+

Java 17+ recommended

Works with UUID-based persistence for multi-server and offline player support

8. Development Notes

Uses PersistentDataContainer for linking items to inventories.

Uses a custom BackpackInventoryHolder to track which inventory belongs to which backpack item.

Designed to prevent server errors from nested backpacks or accidental item loss.

Commands and crafting are fully dynamic via the configuration.

title: AutoCompressor
description: Automatically compress items based on custom recipes.
body:
## Features:
- Creating custom autocompressor recipes linked to an activator item
- All players can enable and disable AutoCompressors that they have unlocked for themself
- Admins can give activator items and revoke autocompresors from players
- **Easy setup with no writing in files required!**
##
### Commands:
- **/auc** (or /auc help) - Show all commands
- **/auc create <autocompressor id>** - Create an autocompressor hold the item in your hand that you want to use as the activator item and set the custom autocompressor id for the autocompressor
- **/auc createrecipe <recipe id> [input item amount] [output item amount]** - Create a recipe that can be added to a autocompressor later hold the input item in your main hand and the output item in your offhand the input item amount is how many input items it takes to get the resulting output item amount (defaults to 64 -> 1)
- **/auc asignrecipe <autocompressor id> <recipe id>** - Asign a created recipe to an autocompressor
- **/auc activator <autocompressor id> <player>** - Give yourself or another player an activator item
- **/auc type <AutoCompressor Id> <Permenant/Inventory/Offhand>** - Choose the type of AutoCompressor an AutoCompressor is, **Permenant** (default) - Right click activator item to claim it permenatly player's can toggle it on and off with the /toggle command, **Inventory** - Works only when the activator item is in the players inventory cannot claim the activator item, **Offhand** - Works the same way as the inventory type except the activator item only works when its in the players inventory
- **/auc list** - Lists all the autocompressor id's that you have add to the server
- **/auc listrecipes <autocompressor id>** - Lists all the recipes for a specific autocompressor
- **/auc remove <autocompressor id>** - Delete a specific autocompressor
- **/auc removerecipe <autocompressor id> <recipe id>** - Delete a specific recipe from an autocompressor using the recipe id
- **/auc deleterecipe <recipe id>** - Compltely delte a recipe id and remove it from all autocompressors
- **/auc revoke <autocompressor id> <player>** - Revoke an autocompressor from a player that has already unlocked an autocompressor
- **/auc toggle <autocompressor id> <player>** - Enable or disable an autocompressor that you have already unlocked admins can enable and disable other players unlocked autocompressors

- **/auc listtoggled** - List the autocompressors that you have unlocked and enabled or disabled
##
### Permissions:
- **autocompressor.*** - Get all permissions for the AutoCompressor plugin
- **autocompressor.create** - /auc create command
- **autocompressor.createrecipe** - /auc createrecipe command
- **autocompressor.removerecipe** - /auc removerecipe command
- **autocompressor.remove** - /auc remove command
- **autocompressor.activator** - /auc activator command
- **autocompressor.setactivator** - /auc setactivator command
- **autocompressor.listrecipes** - /auc listrecipes command
- **autocompressor.list** - /auc list command
- **autocompressor.revoke** - /auc revoke command
- **autocompressor.type** - /auc type command
- **autocompressor.deleterecipe** - /auc deleterecipe command
- **autocompressor.toggle** - /auc toggle command (enabled to all by default)
- **autocompressor.listtoggled** - /auc listtoggled command (enabled to all by default)
- **autocompressor.adminhelp** - See the admin help menu when you get sent the help menu
- **autocompressor.help** - /auc help command (enabled to all by default)

![Resource Roost](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/761be84bb23d1310cc917585f1a3e318a1f45a0d_0.webp)

Roost
The Roost is used to transform a normal Armadillo into a Resource Armadillo. If you want to create a Diamond Armadillo, you will need:

1 diamond
1 iron scute
Furnace fuel
A regular Armadillo
Once you have all the materials, the Roost will transform the Armadillo into its resource variant. You can view all recipes in JEI or EMI.

 

Armadillo Hive
The Armadillo Hive is used to breed Resource Armadillos of the same type. For example:

Two Diamond Armadillos → Baby Diamond Armadillo
Special recipes like the Netherite Armadillo: A Gold Armadillo and an Obsidian Armadillo will produce a Baby Netherite Armadillo.
However, breeding will only occur if the hive contains at least two Armadillo food items like Spider Eyes.

 

Nest
The Nest acts as a storage unit for Armadillos and has the following features:

It picks up Armadillos just like other containers.
If the Nest contains a brush (of any kind), it will automatically brush the Armadillos and collect their scutes if they have any left.
 

Centrifuge
The Centrifuge is used to convert scutes into essence. It works in two ways:

Manually inserting an item will add one to all slots.
Using a hopper will fill an entire stack in one slot (up to 64 items).

title: P.O.S.E. Datapack - Player-Origin Statue Engine
description: Create Player Statues with ease
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cff84301c3f76161d9d6d7972330ab435bdeae40.png)

P.O.S.E. (Player-Origin Statue Engine) is an exciting addition to Minecraft Java Edition, allowing you to create dynamic and customizable statues. Bring your creations to life with unique models, player skins, and a wide selection of pre-designed poses. It even supports all vanilla capes, adding a personal touch to your designs. For an even smoother experience, pair it with Axiom to easily place statues and craft custom poses.

This project is made up of two parts: the resource pack and the data pack. While the data pack isn’t strictly necessary to run P.O.S.E., it adds a lot of helpful functionality. Mine resources for time, die if you run out!
body:
## TimedLife Datapack The **TimedLife** datapack adds an exciting element to your Minecraft gameplay by introducing a time-based challenge. Each player begins with a limited amount of time, and as the clock ticks down, they must strategically gather rare blocks to extend their lifespans. Once a player's remaining time reaches zero, they face the ultimate consequence – death. ## How to Play 1. **Start**: Your time begins ticking down as soon as you move. 2. **Gain Time**: Place rare blocks, stand on them, and sneak to consume them, adding precious minutes to your remaining time. 3. **Survive**: Strategize and extend your lifespan by wisely using rare blocks. 4. **Consequence**: When your remaining time hits zero, you will face unavoidable death. ## Rare Block List - **Beacon** | 30 Minutes - **Block of Netherite** | 30 Minutes - **Block of Diamond** | 15 Minutes - **Block of Emerald** | 5 Minutes - **Block of Gold** | 3 Minutes - **Block of Iron** | 2 Minutes - **Block of Lapis Lazuli** | 1 Minute 30 Seconds - **Block of Coal** | 1 Minute - **Block of Redstone** | 1 Minute - **Block of Copper** | 45 Seconds - **Block of Quartz** | 30 Seconds ## Notes This datapack is inspired by a video I saw a few years ago, unfortunately I can't find it or I would credit it for the idea.
Supports Multiplayer *Your time is precious – use it wisely!*

title: creative-faces
description: A creative plugin that allows Minecraft servers to show the face of players in the chat, scoreboard, tab, signs, items and everywhere you can write text!
body:
# Creative Faces

A creative plugin that allows Minecraft servers to show the face of players in the chat, scoreboard, tab, signs, items and everywhere you can write text!

`creative-faces` uses [creative-central](https://modrinth.com/plugin/central), *the plugin that unifies
resource-packs*, and a placeholder system like [MiniPlaceholders](https://modrinth.com/plugin/miniplaceholders)
or [PlaceholderAPI](https://spigotmc.org/resources/6245/)

![Screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ghzB8Af7/images/2e8ac856ec4b13ec9c29703e8a075e45f26edac9.png)

## Features
- Add faces to the chat, signs, anvils, items, guis, everywhere!
- Uses creative-central so you have all its features:
- - Automatically generates the server's resource-pack
- - Automatically upload the resource-pack to a server or host it locally
- - Automatically send the resource-pack to everyone
- Easy to use
- If you use PlaceholderAPI, just use `%faces_face%` to show the player's head
- If you use MiniPlaceholders, just use `<faces_face>`
- Developers API

Check the [plugin's documentation](https://unnamed.team/docs/creative-faces) for more

title: Cheaper Anvil — 1-Level Cost
description: Anvil work is insanely expensive. Cheaper Anvil makes using an anvil more comfortable without breaking the XP system.
body:
# Cheaper Anvil

Anvil work is insanely expensive. Cheaper Anvil makes using an anvil more comfortable without breaking the XP system.

- No more "Too Expensive!" — removes the accumulated prior work penalty from items.
- Every successful anvil action costs 1 XP level (rename, repair, combine, apply enchanted books, etc.)

**Note:** You still need to have enough XP levels to perform the operation (usually a few levels).
However, the net cost will still be 1 level.

Works in singleplayer and multiplayer (no client install needed).

## Installation

### Singleplayer
1. Open your world folder: `.minecraft/saves/<your_world>/`
2. Put `CheaperAnvil_1.x.x.zip` into `datapacks/`
3. If the world is already loaded, reload it or run `/reload`

### Server
1. Put the zip into: `<server>/world/datapacks/`
2. Restart the server (or run `/reload`).

title: Flashback Recording Indicator
description: Small REC / PAUSED HUD overlay when Flashback is capturing.
body:
# Flashback Recording Indicator

A tiny client-side HUD overlay that tells you whether [Flashback](https://modrinth.com/mod/flashback) is actively recording or paused.

## What it does

When Flashback has a recorder active, a small status badge appears in the top-left corner of your screen:

- 🔴 **Red dot + REC** - Flashback is recording
- 🟡 **Amber dot + PAUSED** - Flashback is paused

If no recorder is active, nothing is shown.

## Why

Flashback doesn't have a built-in recording indicator. If you lose track of whether you've paused or are still capturing, you can end up with missing footage or a recording you forgot to stop. This mod makes the state visible at a glance.

## Details

- Client-side only, does not need to be installed on the server
- HUD element is rendered after the boss bar layer
- Semi-transparent background for readability against any scene
- Zero config, install and forget

# SulfiDish Radio 🎵

**SulfiDish Radio** — A fan-made **Minecraft** mod dedicated to the beloved [Gensokyo Radio](https://gensokyoradio.net/), the finest Touhou **music** station.

This mod brings the magic of [Gensokyo Radio](https://gensokyoradio.net/) directly into your **Minecraft** experience with a beautiful **anime**-**styled** **HUD** overlay that dances to the rhythm of Touhou **music**.
And they **dynamically** change their interface to match the album cover.

![SulfiDish Radio](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a325763b903d54a2fbf679e4bafbbe67933f420d.png)
![SulfiDish Radio](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ff448266f5a73bf831d37d7e5ec83dc05f0b14f0.png)![SulfiDish Radio](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a005cf28da675397b14810dca6e65d7577fa210.png)![SulfiDish Radio](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b7a27bb3110b8c7864f0a9e2da7a3ca9517fb59.png)
## **Features**:

- **Real-time track info** — song title, artist, album, circle, and year displayed live

- **Adaptive album art** — cover art is fetched and rendered with smooth levitation animation, and the entire **HUD** color scheme **dynamically** adapts to the album's palette

- **Audio visualizer** — a colorful bar visualizer that pulses with the music, themed to match the current album art

- **Smooth jelly**-like notifications — track changes, connection events, **pause**/**resume** — all delivered with gentle floating and soft blink **animations**
**Pause** & **resume** **controls** — stop and start the radio stream at any time with instant feedback

- **Progress bar** — see how far into the current song you are, with elapsed/remaining time

- **Listener count** — see how many others are tuned in

- **Customizable layout** — 4 position options (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right)

- **Toggleable elements** — album art, progress bar, listeners count, and rating can each be turned **on**/**off**


**Bilingual interface** — full **Russian** and **English** support, switchable in-game 💗

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/01214ddee37d25a4e709152551d2408b9985ad3f.png)![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab028f6e6b804647a0a41288a4983219e61f3e01.png)

This is an unofficial fan project and is not affiliated with [Gensokyo Radio](https://gensokyoradio.net/).

title: Jobs Cobb
description: Jobs for Cobblemon Mod in Minecraft
body:
# Jobs Cobb

Jobs Cobb adds a configurable profession system for Cobblemon servers, with job progression, economy costs, rewards, objectives, deposits, player storage, and in-game menus.

Players can join jobs such as Miner, Farmer, Fisher, Breeder, Builder, Hunter, Apothecary, Artisan, or Ranger, then progress by playing naturally: mining, farming, fishing, catching Pokemon, breeding, crafting, placing blocks, depositing resources, and completing server objectives.

The mod was originally made for a French Cobblemon server, but it can be configured for any multiplayer setup.

---

## Main Features

- `/jobs` menu with a full custom client interface
- Vanilla chest menu fallback when the player does not have the client-side mod
- Player commands: `/jobs` and `/job`
- Admin command: `/jobsadmin`
- Job XP, levels, tiers, grades, objectives, and rewards
- Automatic tracking for many Minecraft and Cobblemon actions
- Deposit objectives for resources and items
- Cobblemon Economy support for join costs, leave costs, and rewards
- JSON player storage by default
- Optional SQLite storage
- Configurable jobs, objectives, rewards, costs, storage, and anti-abuse rules
- Built-in admin documentation generated with the config files
- Automatic client language support for English, French, Spanish, and German

---

## Automatic Objectives

Jobs Cobb can automatically track actions such as:

- Mining blocks and ores
- Harvesting crops, berries, and Apricorns
- Replanting crops
- Using fertilizer
- Fishing
- Catching Pokemon, shiny Pokemon, aquatic Pokemon, rare Pokemon, and legendary Pokemon
- Winning Cobblemon battles
- Collecting and hatching eggs
- Detecting IV, hidden ability, and competitive Pokemon objectives
- Reviving fossils
- Healing Pokemon
- Placing blocks and decorative blocks
- Crafting supported items, medicine, Poke Balls, bottles, glass, and decor
- Reaching Pokedex completion milestones

The default config focuses on objectives that are automated or completed through deposits.

---

## Dependencies

Required:

- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Cobblemon
- Cobblemon Economy
- Another Furniture
- Arts & Crafts

Optional support is included for Beautify decorative blocks when present.

---

## French Minecraft Server

Jobs Cobb was originally created for a French Minecraft Cobblemon server.

Join the community and play Cobblemon with French-speaking players:

https://discord.com/invite/TeQXbhFNMu

title: HyperGrave
description: An extremely sophisticated and customizable grave data pack
body:
HyperGrave is a very high-quality grave data pack / mod.
It is super customizable, has a lot of cool features, supports multiplayer and yet it's simple to use.

HyperGrave supports Minecraft versions 1.21.5 to 26.2.

## Resource pack
You don't *need* a resource pack to use HyperGrave. However, if you don't like the default look of graves in HyperGrave, you might want to use [Sul4ur's Global Resource Pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/sul4ur-global-respack)

## Quick Tutorial
When a player dies, HyperGrave generates a grave for that player. The grave takes the player's items and XP and stores it. This is what a grave looks like:

![A glowing, floating and rotating player head with a text display on top, the first line displaying "Sul4ur #1009" and the second line displaying the grave's despawn time ](https://i.postimg.cc/FFBsBzw2/hypergrave-grave2.gif)

The number after '#' represents the GID (grave ID) of the grave, which is unique amongst all other graves. You need this GID to be able to run commands on this grave.

Right-click on the grave to retrieve the items and XP in the appropriate slots:

![The player right-clicking on the grave. The grave gives all of its items to the player, placing each in its appropriate slot, and filling the player's XP bar with the stored XP.](https://i.postimg.cc/yY3Y4BHK/hypergrave-unpack.gif)

or left-click on the grave to drop all of the items and XP:

![The player left-clicking on the grave. The grave drops all of its items and XP for the player to collect.](https://i.postimg.cc/hPQPWgB4/hypergrave-pop.gif)

By default, graves despawn in 90 minutes.

That's all you need to know! To learn about some of HyperGrave's useful commands (you will need to know those too), use this command:

```
/trigger hygrave.help
```

And whatever you do, don't execute commands that begin with `/function hygrave:internal/`!

## Features
### Customizable!

![HyperGrave's customizability is indescribable in a thousand words, let alone an image.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eebae4d0b555901fb472e7c10cf1d5368f0029eb_0.webp)

HyperGrave is super customizable! In fact, that image just shows like 15% of HyperGrave's customizabiliy!

You will also see a bunch of other cool features of HyperGrave. If you didn't like any of these features or the way they work, don't worry! You can most likely change that!

### Grave Info Display!
You can view the information of any grave (even the ones that were already broken). You can see the items and amount of XP stored in the grave, when the grave was generated, the owner of the grave, the status of the grave, etc.

![A dialog-like text showing the owner of the grave, location of the grave, experience of the player before death, experience stored in the grave, the despawn time and creation time of the grave, the items of the grave as a table-like structure of filled-in or hollow squares, each showing the presence of an item, and the status of the grave, with buttons for navigation through GIDs of all graves and a button for remotely looting the grave](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a90f4813480da5b6b266f247cfddc44bde6b86b6.png)

In the Items field, you can hover over any square and get its info:

![Hovering over a square in the Items field shows the information of that item in that slot.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/502b131c26b06be14254c64f10875cfa4a5a6466.png)

Pretty cool, right? Hold on, you haven't seen anything yet...

### ICD!
ICD (Item Cycle Display) is a really cool feature. Here is how it works:

When you sneak near a grave, the grave's ICD "activates"; in other words, the player head changes to show the items stored in the grave and the text display changes to show the info of the item. It cycles through the items one by one each second, a lot like how items are cycled in a trials chamber vault.

![The player sneaks near the grave. After doing so, the player head and the text display change to show an item stored in the grave, cycling through them one by one. The player right-clicks and receives one of the items of the grave.](https://i.postimg.cc/vHxHFMdJ/hypergrave-icd(1).gif)

While an item is being displayed, you can even take that single item out of the grave.

ICD is really useful to take a quick peek at the items in the grave and to take a single item out of grave.

### Remotely looting graves!
Tired of walking all the way to the destination of your grave just to get your items back? Don't worry, because HyperGrave also allows* you to loot a grave from anywhere. 

About that image of grave info display, look at the bottom part of the image. Do you see a button that says 'loot'? You can use the button to loot and break the grave from anywhere in the world!

**NOTE:** Don't get too excited! <u>This feature is disabled by default</u> and it's up to the admin to enable this feature if they want to.

### Item backups!
A second layer of protection to your items! Along with a grave, an item backup (simply called 'backup' in-game) is also generated when you die. A backup is always guaranteed to generate no matter what (the one and only exception is when you don't have items).

![The info of the backup, showing the owner, creation time and items of the backup and the GID of the grave relevant to the backup](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d2a5a2abd46d5a5c53d306c8fdcd76bf1ae242b4.png)

Just like graves, each backup has a unique BID (Backup ID) that can be used to get the information of the backup and retrieve an item or the items of the backup.

Note that only admins can see the information of a backup and retrieve its items.

### Multiplayer support!
![Two graves with different player heads and different owners](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/07297d7662986887177ab15e948257945cd0a598.png)

HyperGrave supports and is designed to be compatible with multiplayer. All of its configs and the whole implementation is designed to work well with more than 1 player on the server. And yes, it has been tested on multiplayer.

(Notch is just used as an example here. Don't take anything too seriously!)

### Free and open-source! (Technical)
For those computer nerds out there:

HyperGrave is FOSS (Free and Open-Source Software). The source code is available at [Github](https://github.com/sul4urx/hypergrave). HyperGrave has really awesome documentation that nicely explains everything in detail as comments in the .mcfunction files.

**Absolutely no** AI has been used in HyperGrave's development in any way. It's AI-free!

## Commands
### Trigger commands
These commands begin with `/trigger hygrave.`. They can be executed by any player (admins and non-admins). Here is a list of the trigger commands and what they do: (There are some other trigger commands, but you don't need to know those)

#### `/trigger hygrave.info`
Shows the info menu, a lot like the 'about' section you see in other platforms. It shows the name of HyperGrave, the version, the author(s), some links to the projects homepage and doc and etc and some buttons that do in-game action.

#### `/trigger hygrave.help`
Use this if you have any questions about HyperGrave. It will tell you what you need to do and some FAQs.

#### `/trigger hygrave.show_grave_info set 1021`
Shows information about grave #1021 (grave with GID of 1021).

#### `/trigger hygrave.show_grave_info`
Shows information about the last grave generated.

### Function commands
These commands begin with `/function hygrave:run/`. They can be executed by any player (admins and non-admins).

**IMPORTANT:** Do NOT execute commands that begin with `/function hygrave:internal/`. These commands are used by HyperGrave and if ran by a player, it could break HyperGrave.

Here is a list of the function commands and what they do: (There are some other function commands, but you don't need to know those)

#### `/function hygrave:run/config`
Opens the config menu.

#### `/function hygrave:run/grave/generate`
Generates a grave for you, as if you have died there.

**TIP:** You might want to combine this with the `/execute as ... at @s run` command, like this: `/execute as Sul4ur at @s run function hygrave:run/grave/generate` (Generates a grave for Sul4ur)

**NOTE:** There is also this command: `/function hygrave:run/grave/admin/generate`, which forcefully generates a grave, bypassing the requirements set in the configs

#### `/function hygrave:run/grave/admin/show_grave_info {gid: 1034}`
Like `/trigger hygrave.show_grave_info set 1034`, but bypasses all restrictions set in the configs.

#### `/function hygrave:run/grave/admin/show_backup_info {bid: 2041}`
Shows information about backup #2041 (backup with BID of 2041).

Also allows you to retrieve a single item or all items from the backup.

#### `/function hygrave:run/grave/admin/show_last_backup_info`
Shows information about the last backup generated.

Also allows you to retrieve a single item or all items from the backup.

#### `/function hygrave:run/uninstall` and `/function hygrave:run/reinstall`
Uninstalls or reinstalls Hypergrave.

title: Safe Drop
description: Never accidentally drop your best sword into lava again! This minimalist Mod requires a quick double-tap to drop enchanted or custom-named items.
body:
# ⚛️ Atomic SafeDrop

![Demo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/atomic-mods/safedrop/443ff303e988ba31bc211f58ad59b2139245f75a/media/Safedrop%20Demonstration.png)

**Never lose your best gear to a misclick again.**

We’ve all been there: you’re bridging over a lava lake in the Nether or dodging attacks in the End, and a sudden slip of the finger makes you yeet your fully enchanted Netherite sword into the abyss. 

**Atomic SafeDrop** is a lightweight, strictly focused mod that elegantly solves this exact pain point without cluttering your game with unnecessary menus or bloated code.

### ✨ How It Works

SafeDrop acts as a smart safety net for your most precious items:
* **Valuables are Protected:** If the item you are holding is **enchanted** or has a **custom name**, the single drop key input is completely ignored. 
* **Intentional Dropping:** To actually drop a valuable item, you simply **double-tap the drop key** within a 500ms window.
* **Normal Behavior for Junk:** Standard items like dirt, cobblestone, or basic tools drop normally with a single press, ensuring your inventory management speed isn't slowed down.

title: BanMenu
description: BanMenu is a powerful Minecraft moderation plugin featuring a GUI, ticket system, Discord integration, and comprehensive punishment management for Spigot and Paper
body:
![# BanMenu – The Ultimate Minecraft Moderation Plugin](https://www.endcrystal.eu/uploads/post_images/1-1766948684.png)

# BanMenu – The Ultimate Minecraft Moderation Plugin

**BanMenu** is a powerful, modular moderation plugin for **Spigot, Paper and Bukkit** and fully supports **Geyser / Bedrock cross-platform servers**.

It provides a **complete all-in-one moderation solution** including punishments, tickets, Discord integration, role synchronization, security systems and detailed logging — all configurable and scalable.

**Current Version:** **1.4.2**

---

## 🎯 Main Features

### ![✅ Moderation System](https://www.endcrystal.eu/uploads/post_images/1-1766941875.png)
- Ban, Mute & Kick (temporary & permanent)
- Flexible **ID-based punishment system**
- Automatic expiration for temporary punishments
- Undo actions (Unban / Unmute)
- Admin & bypass permissions

### ![🎨 GUI Menu](https://www.endcrystal.eu/uploads/post_images/1-1766941867.png)
- Modern, user-friendly moderation GUI
- Visual player overview
- Fast moderation without command spam

### ![🎫 Ticket System](https://www.endcrystal.eu/uploads/post_images/1-1766941943.png)
- GUI-based ticket creation & management
- Cooldown system to prevent abuse
- Ticket states: Open, Closed, Reopened
- Discord notifications for staff

---

![## 🤖 Discord Integration](https://www.endcrystal.eu/uploads/post_images/1-1766941923.png) (Extended in 1.4.0)

### ![📜 Discord Rules Bot](https://www.endcrystal.eu/uploads/post_images/1-1766941844.png)
- Quiz runs **directly in the Rules channel** (no DMs)
- Ephemeral questions & final summary only
- Verified users skip the quiz automatically
- Multilingual messages (DE / EN)
- Fully configurable via `discord_rules_bot.yml`

### ![🏷️ Discord Role Management](https://www.endcrystal.eu/uploads/post_images/1-1766941838.png)
- Role management via **Discord Slash Commands**
- Admin / Moderator permission groups
- Configurable role permissions
- New config: `discord_role-permissions.yml`
- Slash Commands:
  - `/role give`
  - `/role remove`
- Minecraft command:
  - `/discord-role`

### ![🔄 Role Synchronization](https://www.endcrystal.eu/uploads/post_images/1-1766941850.png)
- **Bidirectional sync**: Minecraft ↔ Discord
- Priority modes: `minecraft`, `discord`, `both`
- Manual sync command:
  - `/dc-sync`
  - `/dc-sync <player>`
- Fully configurable sync messages

### 📝 Discord Slash Commands
- All Rules Bot commands available as Slash Commands
- Channel-restricted execution
- Commands registered even if modules are disabled
- Multi-line embedded help messages

---

## ![🛡️ Security Features](https://www.endcrystal.eu/uploads/post_images/1-1766941892.png)
- IP tracking (alt account detection)
- Optional automatic IP bans
- Optional VPN detection
- Chat filter with blacklist & regex
- Chat delay / anti-spam system

---

## 📊 History & Statistics
- Full punishment history per player
- Detailed stats (bans, mutes, kicks, tickets)
- Deletable history with reasons
- Complete logging of moderation actions

---

## ![🔧 Technical Features](https://www.endcrystal.eu/uploads/post_images/1-1766941897.png)
- **MySQL & SQLite** support
- Full proxy support (BungeeCord / Velocity)  **(Comming Soon)**
- **Geyser / Bedrock compatible**
- PlaceholderAPI integration
- LuckPerms & GroupManager support
- Multi-language (EN / DE)
- Modular system (disable unused features)
- YAML-based configuration
- Hot-reload without restart

---

## ![📋 Commands](https://www.endcrystal.eu/uploads/post_images/1-1766941827.png)

| Command | Description |
|-------|------------|
| `/banmenu` | Main command (reload, update, stats) |
| `/ban <player> <ID>` | Ban a player |
| `/unban <player>` | Unban a player |
| `/mute <player> <ID>` | Mute a player |
| `/unmute <player>` | Unmute a player |
| `/kick <player> [reason]` | Kick a player |
| `/check <player>` | Player information |
| `/history <player>` | Punishment history |
| `/gui` | Open GUI |
| `/ticket` | Ticket system |
| `/dc-verify <code>` | Link Discord account |
| `/dc-unverify` | Remove Discord link |
| `/dc-sync` | Sync own roles |
| `/dc-sync <player>` | Sync other players |
| `/discord-role` | Manage Discord roles |
| `/maintenance on` | Start Maintenance Mode Fix |
| `/maintenance on <time>` | Start Maintenance Mode with Timer |
| `/maintenance off` | Stop Maintenance Mode |

---

## ![🔐 Permissions](https://www.endcrystal.eu/uploads/post_images/1-1766941881.png)

<details>

### Main Permissions

title: Vermilion
description: A vanilla+ mod adding Warhammers, Daggers, Mini-Bosses, Ruby Ore, Swamp/snow additions, Illusioners, Sieves and more.
body:
![Night](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9413f979bb01ec5ce40d55d6c1a35e5a339e6401.png)
# Overview
Vermilion is a vanilla-friendly mod that adds Warhammers, Daggers, new mini bosses in the swamp and snow, Rubies with armor and tools, a jigsaw structure underground, New crops and mob variants.

# Features

## Daggers
![Dagger Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1d5c31a80ee7e805b554c9ef26d86bef75b1bde.png)

Daggers come in all material tiers and are a fast but weak weapon, with sneaking giving bonus damage.
### Dagger Dash
![Dashing with a Dagger](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6555da2de8f5517c3853c1be417ed6420618ad2d.png)
When right clicking, the dagger can dash the player forward in the direction they are facing, however it takes up a lot of durability. The dash strength does not change with dagger tier. Zombies and its variants can also spawn with iron daggers and can use its dash to get to the player.
### Enchantments
![All Dagger Enchantments](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f2f3da4e09bf507c752c441ba828c7483256ace3.png)

The dagger has 2 enchantments, the first being Fleet which has 3 levels and increases the strength of the dash, however it can only be gotten in structure chests. The second is Sneak Strike which also has 3 levels and increases the damage of the sneak attack.

## Ruby
![Mining Ruby in a Cave](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ade046788b1e9270a75868ee73eec81a97bc4c90.png)
Ruby Ore can be found uncommonly in any biome starting from Y25 but it does have increased spawn rates in deserts. It can also spawn in basalt deltas.

### Ruby Gear Upgrading
![Upgrading Iron armor to Ruby Armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/192aa4aba4399e25409270c689760b158b825728.png)
To obtain Ruby armor/tools you must find a Ruby Smithing Template located in a few select structures. You can then apply the template alongside a ruby to any iron equipment and get the resulting ruby equivalent.

### Ruby Armor and Tools
![Wearing a full set of Ruby armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/782f6297d62596b873d0e46b6820b5ecfb198557.png)
Ruby is in between iron and diamond alongside having higher enchantability. When wearing a full set of ruby armor the player can occasionally get instant health, and the effects of the ruby jewel and ruby lamp are amplified as well. However when the ruby armor grants health it uses hunger. All skeleton and zombie variants (including wither skeletons) can spawn with ruby armor and tools.
### Ruby Item Gallery
![A gallery of all ruby items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6e78a67c133da7585fb03ecf6c966a68a576cefa.png)
All current ruby items.

## Yew Tree and Woodset
![Image of a Yew house in a plains](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/76f41bbdc0f2b5d84d9daf71753e828ad2ed4f9b.png)
Yew trees can be found in a few humid biomes, and behave similar to other woodsets.
## Structures

### Snow Labyrinth
![Inside a Snow Labyrinth](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dc1e4f189d6adf92ca1f35bcc37a40e343dd6707.png)
Cartographers can now sell new explorer maps one of which leads here. The snow labyrinth is a large underground structure comprised of hallways and rooms, some of which with mobs, others with puzzles. With it being randomized.

### Swamp Villa
![Looking at a Swamp Villa in a swamp](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef4fd20c9105c57098bfcec20375dc82903c8607.png)
The Swamp Villa too has an explorer map and is found in either normal or mangrove swamps. On the bottom floor are witches, alongside a few chests. But these aren't the main reason you'd come here.
![Inside a Swamp Villa](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/176321662879d3c9cf1d958802e4d6fa9ab16ea2.png)

### Woodland Estate
![Looking up at a Woodland Estate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d5514baf48a5346c359c74d1a8e336b53ab30b3.png)
The Woodland estate is a large spruce structure similar to woodland mansions found in mega taigas, inside are vindicators alongside randomized rooms. On the top floor, the illusioner can spawn, with it having a new drop.

## Mini-Bosses

### The Thawed
![Fighting a Thawed in a snow biome](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2f12e8d29d3f2f0d18c6ecc0ad1dea115bcbe195.png)
The Thawed can be summoned similarly to how iron golems/the wither are summoned and it has a rage system, the higher the rage the stronger attacks it will use. Things like attacking it, touching it, it missing its projectiles ect will increase its Rage. Once killed it will drop the Frost Shard.

### The Plague Witch
![Fighting a Plague Witch on the top floor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5ab7d339223a489d3b87ee4662fb22721db1c7d1.png)
The plague witch spawns on the top floor in the swamp villa, once it sees the player it will start throwing potions, the lower the plague witches health gets the stronger potions it will throw. It also will spawn mobs such as witches, zombies, skeletons, silverfish and spiders. Once killed it will drop the heart of the swamp.

## Boss Rewards

### Warhammer
![Hitting a mob with a Warhammer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cca499435657578622f70c11736169d954fd4087.png)
The Warhammer is crafted with a frost shard and 2 coffer, it deals aoe damage when the player crits a mob to all enemies around the critted mob.

**Enchantments**

![All Enchantments for the Warhammer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/03384bc3f5f38a2a1d8e93e02a115cbc6a73e971.png)

The Warhammer has 2 main enchantments. The first being Rampage, this has 3 levels and will increase the damage of the Warhammer aoe for each consecutive correctly timed hit and this has no cap. The second is Shackle, this also has 3 levels and will give slowness to all entities in the aoe radius.

### Famine Totem
![A Famine Totem Growing Crops](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12c4ea4459be054df3c8d53785e37bb5f0b1034f.png)
The Famine Totem is crafted with the heart of the swamp and on its own it wont do anything, but if powered by emerald or ruby it will grow crops adjacent to it over time. 

## Utilities
### Pouches
![A display of pouches](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6afce9876761d6b5b9576f395584b25ebd976d8d.png)
Pouches are small portable storage. Regular Pouches have 5 slots and Bejewelled Pouches have 12. All 3 can also be dyed.

### Soul Hook
![Using Soul Hook](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8bf14933c581980c96e40043032c5a5184cf1e75.png)
The Soul Hook is a weapon that when right-clicked will pull any nearby mobs to the player.

## Miscellaneous Additions

### Frostbit
![A Frostbit at Night](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b064c4783aba683a29253e6ad997c9b76a46af4.png)
The Frostbit is a zombie variant that spawns in cold biomes similar to strays upon being hit by it the player gets inflicted with weakness. When a zombie is in powder snow it converts to a Frostbit

## Mushroom Fields Changes
![An Updated Mushroom Fields](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2229236f0018f6c0c6f35ac04cd25bd198b2660e.png)
Mycelium Sprouts can be found on the ground alongside tall brown and red mushrooms.

## Small Additions
- Algae and Cattails in swamps
- Tallow dropped from pigs when killed
- Water Sieve block
- Small additions to the swamp biome
- Candy item
- Creepshroom Mob
- Dynamite/New Explosives
- Witches Hat Item
- New Potions
- Item Stand Block

title: fzPaint
description: A creative painting mod for Minecraft Fabric that allows you to paint blocks with custom colors and create pixel art using the Paint Brush tool.
body:
# fzPaint

[![Minecraft Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.1-brightgreen.svg)](https://www.minecraft.net/)
[![Fabric API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Fabric%20API-Required-orange.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-GPL%203.0%20only-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

A creative painting mod for Minecraft Fabric that allows you to paint blocks with custom colors and create pixel art using the Paint Brush tool.

## Features

- Paint Brush Tool: A special tool to paint blocks with custom colors
- Pixel Art Support: Create detailed 16x16 pixel art on block faces
- Color Customization: Choose from millions of colors to paint your blocks
- Persistent Painting: Your paintings are saved and persist across game sessions
- Easy to Use: Simple and intuitive painting interface

## Installation

1. Download and install Fabric Loader
2. Download Fabric API
3. Download fzPaint from Modrinth
4. Place both Fabric API and fzPaint JAR files in your .minecraft/mods folder
5. Launch Minecraft with the Fabric profile

## How to Use

1. Get the Paint Brush from the Creative Inventory (Tools tab)
2. Right-click on any block face to open the painting interface
3. Choose your color or create pixel art
4. Save your masterpiece!

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- Fabric Loader 0.17.3 or higher
- Fabric API 0.116.7 or higher
- Java 21 or higher

## Contributing

Contributions are welcome! Feel free to open issues or submit pull requests.

## Contact

- **Modrinth**: [fzPaint on Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/fzpaint)
