title: Always at night
description: Experience an endless night where peace and peril come in waves — survive through shifting phases of safety and danger.
body:
## 🌙 Always at Night

**Always at Night** is a simple Minecraft mod that keeps the world permanently in darkness — the sun never rises.

The mod introduces a unique survival rhythm with **two alternating phases**:

*  **Calm Phase:** No hostile mobs spawn for a while, allowing players to explore, build, or gather resources safely.
*  **Danger Phase:** Hostile mobs begin to spawn again, challenging players to survive through the endless night.

### 🧭 Why download this mod?

* Adds tension and atmosphere to the game without altering core mechanics.
* Perfect for **hardcore survival**, **adventure maps**, or **story-driven gameplay**.
* Lightweight and compatible with most modpacks.

### ⚙️ How it works

The world remains in a **permanent night cycle**, and a timer system alternates between safe and dangerous phases. You don’t need to do anything — the mod handles it automatically once installed.

### 🧩 Compatibility

* Works on both client and server sides.
* Designed for **Fabric** / **Quilt** (can be adapted for others if needed).
* Requires **Fabric API** (and optionally **Indium** for optimization).

body:
# 👻 Soulbound: Afterlife Awakened

> _In death, you were chosen._

**Soulbound: Afterlife Awakened** thrusts you into a world where dying is not the end — it’s just the beginning of your second life. Death leads to spiritual awakening. You return as a wandering spirit, free from flesh, bound to the unseen.

---

## ☠️ Key Features

- **Spirit after death**: Death is inevitable. Respawn as a ghostly soul and roam the world in spirit form.
- **Haunting the Living**: As a spirit, you can **possess mobs**, control them, and use their powers — from zombies to skeletons and more.
- **Rich, Atmospheric World**: Graveyards, cursed biomes, and ambient terror await — enhanced by mods like *The Graveyard*.
- **Proximity Voice Chat**: Whisper to other souls... or scream across realms.
- **Play with Friends**: Host your own world, invite friends, and explore the afterlife together — whether as allies or rival spirits.

---

## 🍎 How to Return to Life

Even in death, there is hope.

To become **mortal again**, use a classic ritual — just like with zombie villagers:

1. Drink a **Potion of Weakness**
2. Eat a **Golden Apple**
3. Wait… and rise once more, reborn in flesh.

Other players can also revive you with this method — cooperation or betrayal is in your hands.

---

## 🧿 Recommended For

- Players who love dark fantasy, undead mechanics, and twisted survival experiences
- Roleplay lovers looking for a deep, death-aware world
- Multiplayer servers or friends playing together on LAN / Hosted World

---

**You are bound to the spirit realm...  
But will you break free, or rule from the shadows?**

title: Expected
description: Expected is a modification for Minecraft focused on the selective reworking of various game mechanics.
body:
### About

**Expected** is a modification for Minecraft focused on the selective reworking of various game mechanics. The goal is to improve balance, increase difficulty, and update forgotten or overly powerful features. The mod carefully preserves the vanilla atmosphere while introducing systematic and logical changes—especially regarding elytra usage, mending, anvils, and brewing.

### [Give me a dollar (ko-fi)](https://ko-fi.com/swproducts)

### Changes to Elytra Mechanics

#### Disabling Mending Enchantment on Elytra
[Video clip](https://youtube.com/clip/Ugkxw-lwWD1mf5ugfZTDetbeLBI7tWd-teS4?si=Y_oUAvC-fWnTtCEQ)

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/35384f5aa6efc1f513da5234f0a39588c25af27f.png)

Elytra can no longer be enchanted with Mending. This prevents their unlimited use and reinforces the value of the resource.  

#### Cooldown for Firework Use During Flight  
[Video clip](https://youtube.com/clip/UgkxkRhE7lCgeTjDInCF-_teGIXU9vP5Ay7N?si=Saql7Rg4xsxWGk-d)

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9bf917b02f9b7221250954e28af7fa2374bd34d.png)

When using a firework while flying with elytra, the player must wait before using it again. This limitation encourages more deliberate and mindful movement.  

#### Reduced Elytra Durability
[Video clip](https://youtube.com/clip/UgkxmuE4jcPZ7jCpP6_e_DCg23G_cfBOGCqx?si=Nm116V2vbcbmm9xV)

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19d6bf17425cad5240de67857723941ed36b0cf1.png)

The base durability of elytra has been decreased from 432 to 312 points, prompting users to be more cautious and strategic in their use.  

#### New Enchantment for Elytra  
[Video clip](https://youtube.com/clip/UgkxAkuS4_CWXNI-LMSTp7p3s611DF4-SCj9?si=qL8zpDmsd4GLPxUl)

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/261e77168f912d05ac406c65c80f2a6236a15cac.png)

A unique enchantment has been added that reduces the cooldown between firework uses. This enchantment is exclusive and can only be found in End structures—specifically in End Cities.  

### Changes to Mending Mechanics  

#### Durability Loss During Mending via Anvil  
[Video clip](https://youtube.com/clip/Ugkx9WLsUm-BMYNZUKmVNi6QKmAa5Xm8pqTU?si=vVnD6Lubc-dMzSyh)

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a3b547cac0b58ca53eaab31712a4ef0e76fcc7a2.png)

When using an anvil to apply the Mending enchantment, the item loses 50% of its maximum durability. This change makes the decision to repair more significant and diminishes the previously overpowered effect of this enchantment.  

#### Modified Anvil Repair Principle  
[Video clip](https://youtube.com/clip/UgkxQgS2TU5ujOxmAH6RXs-cgpi7opjS2iq0?si=FqQwU1Kle2w87Qw5)

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c3ec2f1d0a785ab8d00d33fe6102c5052658a3bc.png)

The maximum repair cost for any item via the anvil is now capped at 25 levels.  

### New Potions  

#### Gravity Potion  
[Video clip](https://youtube.com/clip/Ugkxpb0AsbOkwY-hYwFO07seNx_cyAlHinng?si=CZ4Hiq5zv2earb9c)

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a163ba592a218eef8890ed8353f982fba6277cf0.png)

Brewed by adding a Wither Skeleton’s bone to a Potion of Leaping in a brewing stand—effectively inverting its effect.  
**Effect:** Complete immunity to knockback and suppression of the Levitation effect.  

#### Levitation Potion  
[Video clip](https://youtube.com/clip/UgkxpI98BFQnyfBIeTVRCBVW79D8hOCbtY84?si=3GCBCz_SOKfZU971)

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f0a61b2f29b8ddfa54856528b66a1814fde5f78e.png)

Created through the standard brewing system using a Shulker Shell fragment.  
**Effect:** Grants the player levitation, allowing them to overcome obstacles, take flight, and cross deep chasms. Its combination with the Gravity Potion is especially useful when traveling in the End.  

#### Chorus Potion  
[Video clip](https://youtube.com/clip/UgkxwAXj1gtL2w8S_Yc5222M8zRrRTEMfvlY?si=GHD2h2a5UW_yMQKj)

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2777f2ab4e57a3f1c7d4ffee1a2d547ad13c724b.png)

Prepared from roasted chorus.  
**Effect:** When the player takes damage, they are teleported a short distance, mimicking the effect of a Chorus Fruit. This potion can be lifesaving in dangerous situations or help in avoiding encirclement.

title: Mansioneer
description: Adds biome-specific variants for Woodland Mansions; easily expandable with data packs!
body:
# Mansioneer

Have you ever wondered why Woodland Mansions were only built in Dark Oak Forests? Have you ever wanted a vanilla-flavored incentive to go exploring? With Mansioneer, Woodland Mansions will generate in many biomes scattered around your world! Each mansion seamlessly blends into its environment, making exploration more rewarding and interesting. 

## Where do Woodland Mansions generate? 

Mansioneer currently expands Woodland Mansions to generate in swamp, savanna, taiga, jungle, desert, forest, birch forest, icy, snowy, plains, and mountain slope biomes, along with variants thereof. It also allows them to generate in Cherry Grove and Pale Garden biomes. Each biome type will have its own block palette and theme! 

## What do Woodland Mansions look like?

Take a look at the [gallery](https://modrinth.com/project/mansioneer/gallery)! It features a selection of the many variants that Mansioneer adds. 

## Can I move into a Woodland Mansion? 

Yes, as long as you can evict the Pillagers! Some variants of Woodland Mansions may require some renovations, while others - like the vanilla one - only need some more torches to be added. Alternatively, you can tear them down for a plentiful source of materials and build your own mansion!

## How does this work?

Mansioneer modifies the default logic for Woodland Mansions. When Minecraft places one, Mansioneer will swap out the block palette using a datapack-defined "block transformer". This means that it should be instantly compatible with mods or datapacks that change the look of Woodland Mansions. 

## Why are the chests still giving Dark Oak Saplings?

Mansioneer doesn't change chest loot - the "block transformer" system isn't currently fine-grained enough to change the loot tables of chests. Instead, it directly swaps out one block for another. 

## I'm making a modpack; how does this work with other mods? 

Mansioneer should play nicely with other mods that edit the vanilla Woodland Mansion by default! If you want to add specific variants for modded biomes - or variants that use modded materials - take a look at the data files in `/data/___/mansioneer`. You can create new block transformer palettes, new biome-to-block-transformer mappings, or both!

title: No more keybinds
description: One menu instead of thousands keybindings
body:
**No more keybinds** is a unique solution for managing numerous keybinds in Minecraft, especially useful for large modpacks. This mod allows users to open and interact with a convenient menu of all available keybinds without needing to assign separate keys.

#### Main Features:
- **Keybind Menu**: Press `Alt` to open an automatically generated menu with all available keybinds in the game.
- **Menu Control**: Hold the middle mouse button to move the menu to a convenient spot on your screen.
- **Interactive Control**: You can trigger keybinds directly through the menu, even if no specific key is assigned to them, simplifying interaction with a large number of keybinds.
- **Mod Support**: The entire interface can display keybinds from other mods. This mod is specifically designed for modpacks with many mods where the number of keybinds can grow quickly.

#### Future Plans:
- **Interface Editor**: In future updates, users will be able to customize the appearance of the menu to suit their needs.
- **Full Keypress Emulation**: There will be an option to fully simulate keypresses through the menu, further expanding the mod's functionality.

#### What Makes This Mod Unique?
**Keybind Menu Mod** is the first and only solution that allows you to manage keybinds efficiently through an intuitive menu without manually assigning them to individual keyboard buttons. This makes it indispensable for modpacks with many mods and keybinds.

The mod is in active development, and more customization and usability improvements will be added in the future.

title: Basic Server Mod Lists
description: Simple Fabric mod that allows for servers to require mods to join
body:
# Basic Server Mod Lists

I wanted something for my private Fabric server that allowed for mod compatibility checking, similar to Forge's mod list handshake on server join.  It would also notify players in a decently friendly matter, instead of Client crashes or registry remapping errors that are often caused by differing Client/Server mod versions.  This is a simple Fabric mod that aims to achieve this, by allowing for Fabric servers to require certain mods for Clients to have before joining.

## Requirements

This mod requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) and is required on both Client and Servers

## Getting Started

For players, simply drag and drop the latest supported version in your `mods` folder.  No further setup is required as it's configured on a per-server basis

For servers, drag and drop the latest supported version in its `mods` folder and start it up to generate a configuration file.  Configure the required mods as desired and finally connect with a Client that has this mod and the configured required mods installed

Velocity proxy server setups are also supported and require for the latest version to be installed in its `plugins` folder.  It is also required for the server-side mod to be installed in all desired sub-servers

## Server Configuration

Required client mods on a server have to be listed in its generated 'required-mods.txt' file, otherwise it will default to require every installed server mod

The current 'required-mods.txt' format requires mods to be listed in the format of their mod id and version separated by an underscore on separate lines.  An asterisk can be used for prefix/suffix wildcards, otherwise explicit matching is used

Example config:
```
cobblemon_1.3.1+1.19.2
twilightforest_*
create_*
```

## Issues or Requests

If there are any issues or requests, please report it in the Issues tab on [Github](https://github.com/KyujuuAlpha/Basic-Server-Mod-Lists)

title: Bow Tie
description: Use Hjson, YAML, XML and more instead of JSON.
body:
# Bow Tie

*Did you ever get annoyed by not being able to write comments in your Minecraft JSON files?*

*Do you want whitespace to decide on your data nesting?*

*Did you ever want to write your recipes as lovely XML compared to JSON?*

Then I got the right thing for you :)

---

This Minecraft Fabric mod uses the data API of [Tweed 4](https://github.com/Siphalor/tweed-api).

You can use all data formats that Tweed supports to replace your JSON mess.
Supported are:

- [Hjson](https://hjson.github.io/)
- [JSON5](https://json5.org/)
- [YAML](https://yaml.org/)
- XML

## Examples

Example files formulated in alternate data formats can be found [in the testmod](https://github.com/Siphalor/bow-tie/tree/1.16/src/testmod/resources).

## How does it work?

*Bow Tie* tries to intercept all data loading and checks for supported files with the same name.
It then loads these files with the respective serializers and uses Tweed's API to convert them to JSON files.
These are then handed back to the game.

title: Stealth and Alert
description: A Minecraft mod bringing a stealth and alert system just like what in other games.
body:
# <center>Stealth & Alert</center>
**The mod is new. There maybe many bugs and feel free to report them. More mechanics are under development.**

**Stealth & Alert** introduces a tactical stealth system to Minecraft, inspired by the perception mechanics of some games like Assassin's Creed.

![Walking in the woods, displaying Alert, Visibility and Sound Wave HUDS.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/85f9214d62e0470d1c579d240446afdf09d63103_0.webp)

## 🎯 Key Features
- **Circular HUD:** A dynamic indicator around the crosshair tracking enemy positions and alert levels (White/Yellow/Red).
- **Perception AI:** Mobs with the added entity tag now possess realistic FOV and transition through **_Idle_**, **_Suspicious_**, **_Searching_**, and **_Fighting_** states.
- **In-world Alert Symbol:** There will be spesific symbols and animations to indicate their alert state and to indicate if they've seen a player.
- **Target Tracking States:** The mod distinguishes between the mob's overall alertness and its specific observation status of each player, ensuring a deep and logical detection flow.
- **Visibility System:** Light, environment and player's action can affect player's Visibility to make an influence on enemies' awareness towards player. When Visibility is lower than a threshold, player will be invisible; but getting too close to enemies will still make enemies spot you. It is showned by an HUD.
- **Environment Stealth:** When standing in an area full of tall grass, or crawling in an area full of short grass, or staying in a place dark enough, and so on, will make you invisible, which means a player can sneak taking advantage of environments to be not seen by enemies.
- **Sound System:** What players do will make sounds, reacted to by enemies - but you can also make use of that feature, using Pebbles or other throwables to attract them away.
- **LKP (Last Known Position):** Mobs investigate the spot where they last saw the player, rather than using "god-mode" tracking.

## 🚀 The Vision

- This mod aims to build a comprehensive stealth ecosystem. Upcoming updates will keep improving the mechanics introduced, and introduce **Assassinations**, and **Corpse Discovery**.

###                                       **ABOUT THIS MOD**
![Lost the way](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c2bce443f74b28cbf82a8e24e7c85c860b38f343_0.webp)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   The barren plain stretched onward, vast beyond reckoning, unto the very edge of the horizon 
an illomened monument standing sentinel over the extinguished glory of some antediluvian age, where only the ruins of the "Empire" yet loomed, terrible in their magnitude.


   The earth below lay black as the void between the stars, stained with the blood of untold centuries, and veiled beneath a shroud of ceaseless ash that fell without end a pallid, unnatural snow that smothered the sun and left the land in perpetual gloom. This was no mere wasteland, but the residue of history itself: a scripture inscribed in treachery and the wreckage of some war fought in an age before ages. Here, vengeance, anguish beyond comprehension, and the last deranged fragments of hope had fused together and burned, until all that remained were blackened stumps pitiful, charred remnants of what once had been.
   

   Among the living and the dead alike, every soul in that place had been reduced to the same wretched communion: the Eyeless. Their sockets gaped, hollow as bottomless abysses, dark wounds without end. Some had had their eyes seared away by the apocalyptic fires of ages past; others had taken the blade to their own sight, unable to bear witness any longer to the horror of shattered expectation laid bare before them.

   They wandered without purpose amid the ruin, like specters bound by some curse to a cycle from which there was no release.

Some were filled with a hope so deluded, so hollow, that it betrayed nothing but the feeble wit of fools.
Some dreamed, in their sin, that they were purifiers of some sacred order.
Others believed themselves saviors of the lost, liberators of trapped souls.

And from these twisted spirits, given form and voice, was born a belief most aberrant turning, ever turning, in a wheel that knows no end.

title: CHC | Custom Hit Command
description: Executes a configurable command when hitting an other player with a configurable item group or a single item!
body:
# **Custom Hit Command: Unleash Dynamic Actions on Impact!**
![Curseforge Downloads](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/dt/1308743?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge&color=D02F2F&link=https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/bukkit-plugins/chc&link=https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/bukkit-plugins/chc) ![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/eXM4AQg2?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&color=D02F2F&link=https%3A%2F%2Fmodrinth.com%2Fplugin%2Fchc&link=https%3A%2F%2Fmodrinth.com%2Fplugin%2Fchc)  ![Spiget Downloads](https://img.shields.io/spiget/downloads/127038?style=for-the-badge&logo=spigotmc&color=D02F2F&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.spigotmc.org%2Fresources%2Fchc-custom-hit-command.127038%2F&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.spigotmc.org%2Fresources%2Fchc-custom-hit-command.127038%2F) ![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/866268252245590016?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&color=D02F2F&link=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2FZ3rrqYSpUE&link=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2FZ3rrqYSpUE)


## **❓ What is CHC?**
**Custom Hit Command** let's you trigger specific commands every time you **hit another player** with a **chosen item group** and/or **single item(s)** you marked before with `/chc sethititem`! This **lightweight** and **highly customizable** plugin is built for Paper 26.1, ensuring **fast performance** and **seamless integration**.

## **🌟 Key Features:**

🔧 **Configurable Hit Item**: Define which item group, single item, or external NBT tag triggers the action (e.g., all Iron Swords, marked Blaze Rods, or even plugins like DeluxeHub items via key=value)

🎯 **Dynamic Command Execution**: Set any server command to run upon a successful hit. You can choose whether the command is executed by the attacking player or the console. Use the **`%hitted_player%`** placeholder to automatically insert the name of the player you hit (e.g., `/duel %hitted_player%`)

✨ **Visual Hit Particles**: Configure particle effects to appear at the location of the hitted player, adding a visually dynamic element to your commands

💬 **Customizable Messages**: Tailor nearly all plugin messages to match your server's style

🔎 **Enhanced Logging**: An optional, enhanced logging system can be enabled to provide detailed debug information for troubleshooting

🔔 **Update Notifications**: An automatic update checker can be configured to notify you in the console or directly in-game (or both) when a new version is available. It can be easily toggled on/off in the configuration

**So what are you waiting for? Get Custom Hit Command now and bring a new layer of excitement to your server!**

## ️**🛡️ Commands & Permissions:**
`/chc reload` | `customhitcommand.reload`

`/chc sethititem` | `customhitcommand.sethititem`

`customhitcommand.update` (for in-game update notifications)

`customhitcommand.use` (allows the use of the hit item (default true))

`customhitcommand.admin` (parent permission for all permissions)


## **📆 Planned features:**
- config updater
- minimessage support
- multiple commands
- command delay
- multiple hit item groups
- set for every item group a different command executor and command 
- sound option to play at a successful hit
- folia support


## **❓ Q&A:**
**Why is the compiled plugin (JAR file) larger than the source code on GitHub?**

Our plugin includes dependencies like **bStats** to gather anonymous usage statistics. When the plugin is compiled into a single JAR file, the bStats library (along with all its own dependencies) is packaged directly into the final plugin file. This process, called 'shading', makes the plugin self-contained which naturally increases the overall file size compared to just the raw source code.

## **🆘 Need Help?**
If you encounter any problems, bugs, or have questions about the plugin, please don't hesitate to contact me directly. I'll be happy to take a look and provide support! Your positive experience is our priority.

body:
# Quacky's Better Keybinds

> Rebind any action to anything — multiple keys, mouse buttons, and combos.
> **Client-side only.** Works on Lunar, Modrinth App, Feather, and vanilla Fabric.

---

## Features

- **Bind anything** — every action in the Controls menu, vanilla *and* modded, is bindable.
- **Multiple binds per action** — give one action as many key combos as you want.
- **Combos** — chain keys and mouse buttons together (`Shift + Left Click`, `Ctrl + Alt + P`).
- **Order-sensitive option** — per bind, require the exact press order, or allow any order.
- **Smart conflict resolution** — the most specific combo always wins.
- **Multi-key capture** — press your whole combo; it auto-finalizes after 3 seconds idle.
- **Mouse support** — all 8 mouse buttons, including side buttons.
- **Live bind list** — see every bind in one panel, remove any with one click.
- **ModMenu config** — everything lives in a clean in-game GUI.

## Install

1. Install **Fabric Loader ≥ 0.19.2** for MC **1.21.11**.
2. Drop into `mods/`:
   - **Fabric API** `0.141.4+1.21.11` or newer
   - **Mod Menu** `17.0.0` or newer
   - `quackys-better-keybinds-1.0.0.jar`

Client-only — no server-side install needed.

## Usage

1. Open **Mod Menu → Quacky's Better Keybinds**.
2. **Search** for the action you want in the search bar.
3. **Click** the action to select it.
4. Click **Set Keys**, then press your combo (one key or many). It locks in after 3s.
5. Toggle **Order** to choose whether press order matters for that combo.
6. Click **Save Bind** — it appears under *Your keybinds* and saves instantly.
7. Remove any bind with the red **X**. Close the screen to persist.

## Compatibility

| | |
|---|---|
| **Minecraft** | 1.21.11 only (API drift means cross-version isn't a single jar) |
| **Loaders** | Fabric. Lunar / Modrinth / Feather work as long as they ship 1.21.11 |
| **Conflicts** | None known — binds drive the game's real KeyMappings, so modded actions work too |

## Known limitations

- Binds never fire while a screen or menu is open, so they can't operate GUIs.
- Actions are read from the game's keybind list — an action with no registered KeyMapping can't be bound.

## License

**MIT.** Quack responsibly.

---

### Other Mods

Make sure to check out my organisation to find other mods! Helps a lot and lets me make more mods — and maybe a common library in the future :)

Description

Limits special mob spawns
Automatically disables during daytime
Goal

Create a simple but effective horror experience that makes every night feel unpredictable and dangerous, without impacting server performance.

title: AdminToolbox
description: Effective Minecraft moderation tools designed to prevent cheating.
body:
Effective Minecraft moderation tools designed to prevent cheating, maintaining staff integrity and community trust.

**AdminToolbox supports [Folia][folia].**

## Features & Commands

### Spectate

`/spectate`, `/admin`, `/target`

Enter admin mode, which creates a separate temporary inventory that is deleted when exiting. The player is placed in
Spectator Mode until they reveal or exit admin mode.

While spectating, the player can use the command again to exit admin mode. The player will be teleported back to their
original location, placed back into survival mode, and their original inventory will be restored.

#### Target Locations

- `/target` - Enter admin mode at current location
- `/target <player>` - Enter admin mode at a specified player's location
- `/target <x> <y> <z> [world]` - Enter admin mode at specific coordinates
- `/target <x> <z> [world]` - Enter admin mode at specific coordinates (uses the highest Y-level block at that location)

#### Targeting Spawn

`/spawn`, `/targetspawn`

- `/spawn` - Enter admin mode at the current world's spawn point
- `/spawn <world>` - Enter admin mode at the provided world's spawn point

#### Navigation

- `/back` - Move to previous location in teleport history
- `/forward` - Move to next location in teleport history

### Reveal

`/reveal`, `/show`

While spectating in admin mode, running this command places the player into survival mode at their current location.
This makes the admin visible to players during confrontations while maintaining:

- Temporary inventory
- Immunity to damage
- No mob targeting

#### Fullbright

`/fullbright`, `/nightvision`

- `/fullbright` - Toggle fullbright for the current admin session
- `/fullbright <on|off>` - Enable or disable fullbright for the current admin session

### Yell

`/yell <player> <message>`

Forcibly displays a large red title on the targeted player's screen.
Use the pipe character (`|`) to separate title and subtitle: `title | subtitle`.

Legacy ampersand [color codes] are supported. (i.e. `No stealing! | Did you read the &e/rules&r?`)

![A large red title displays within Minecraft: "No stealing!" A smaller subtitle below it reads "Did you read the /rules?", and "/rules" is highlighted in yellow.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ModernBetaNetwork/AdminToolbox/refs/heads/main/.assets/demo-yell.jpg)

### Freeze

`/freeze <player>`

Stops the target player from moving until released.

Frozen players:

- can look around freely
- can fall downward
- can use containers
- cannot place or break blocks
- cannot take any damage
- cannot hurt other entities (including players)
- cannot be targeted by mobs

To release a frozen player, use `/unfreeze <player>`

### Streamer Mode

**Requires LuckPerms.**

`/streamermode <duration>`, `/pausealerts <duration>`

Allows players to temporarily disable certain permissions (i.e. those that give them staff-only alerts), intended for
use when screen sharing or live-streaming gameplay.

#### Placeholder

When PlaceholderAPI is available, a placeholder is made available to display when a player has streamer mode active.

- ``%rel_streamermode_tag%``: Displays a `⬤` tag in red when streamer mode is active.
- ``%rel_streamermode_prefix%``: Displays the tag followed by a space when streamer mode is active.
- ``%rel_streamermode_suffix%``: Displays the tag preceded by a space when streamer mode is active.

## Permissions

| Permission                                   | Description                                                                                       |
|----------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `admintoolbox.target`                        | Use `/target` at current location                                            |
| `admintoolbox.target.player`                 | Use `/target <player>`                                                       |
| `admintoolbox.target.location`               | Use `/target <x> [y] <z> [world]`                                            |
| `admintoolbox.reveal`                        | Use `/reveal`                                                                          |
| `admintoolbox.yell`                          | Use `/yell`                                                                              |
| `admintoolbox.freeze`                        | Use `/freeze` and `/unfreeze`                                                          |
| `admintoolbox.spawn`                         | Use `/spawn` in current world                                                 |
| `admintoolbox.spawn.all`                     | Use `/spawn [world]`                                                          |
| `admintoolbox.fullbright`                    | Use `/fullbright` while in admin mode                                              |
| `admintoolbox.broadcast.receive`             | Receive alerts about others' targets actions. |
| `admintoolbox.broadcast.exempt`              | Do not send alerts to players with `admintoolbox.broadcast.receive`                               |
| `admintoolbox.streamermode`                  | Use streamer mode                                                               |
| `admintoolbox.streamermode.unlimited`        | Bypass maximum streamer mode duration. (Set in config.yml)                                        |
| `admintoolbox.streamermode.placeholder.wear` | Wear the streamer mode status placeholder.                                                        |
| `admintoolbox.streamermode.placeholder.view` | View other players' streamer mode status placeholders.                                            |

## Integrations

- **[LuckPerms](https://luckperms.net/)**
    - Required for streamer mode.
    - **New in version 1.4.0:** Custom context for conditionally applying permissions based on admin state.
        - **`admintoolbox:state`** can be any of `spectating`, `revealed`, or `normal` (not in admin mode).
- **[BlueMap](https://bluemap.bluecolored.de)**
    - The plugin will hide admins who are revealed from the map.
- **[PlaceholderAPI](https://modrinth.com/plugin/placeholderapi)**
    - The plugin provides a placeholder for players' streamer mode status.
    - Players must have the appropriate permissions to wear and view the placeholder.

## Analytics

**Added in version 1.4.0.**

For us to better understand how many servers are using AdminToolbox, by default we collect anonymized analytics via
bStats. Server administrators can disable this functionality on their servers by setting `enabled: false` in
`plugins/bStats/config.yml`.

The anonymized collected data is viewable publicly at https://bstats.org/plugin/bukkit/AdminToolbox/26406.

[folia]: https://papermc.io/software/folia

[color codes]: https://minecraft.wiki/w/Formatting_codes

title: Create: Copyfoxes
description: Create: Copycat Extension, adding copycat blocks that allow even smaller cube placement
body:
# CopyFoxies

`CopyFoxies` is an expansion mod for the **Create 0.5.1 + Copycats 2.2.1** ecosystem, focused on providing more flexible, engineering-friendly copycat geometry blocks.

## Highlights

- Adds multiple variable-geometry Copycat blocks with step-by-step right-click parameter editing.
- Complex blocks support staged placement preview (point -> line -> side) to reduce misplacement.
- Built for architectural and mechanical detailing: slopes, edge cuts, layered shapes, and centered/symmetric pieces.

## Main Block Families

- `Edge Cut Prism` / `Edge Cut Centered Prism`
  - Adjustable `U/V` cut-line positions and thickness.
  - Supports positive/negative half switching for chamfers, corner fills, and irregular transitions.
- `Horizontal Variable Slope` / `Horizontal Variable Centered Slope`
  - Adjustable top width, bottom width, and thickness for continuous slopes and directional mechanical detail.
- `Dual Half Layer` / `Dual Half Column` / `Centered Half Panel`
  - Practical base geometry for fast blockout and layered detailing.
- `Quarter Panel` / `Three Band Panel`
  - Finer panel segmentation and layered profile control.
- `Center Variable Cube` / `Corner Variable Cube`
  - Ideal for centered/corner volume tuning and structural transitions.

## Interaction Design

- Key variable-geometry blocks provide visual placement previews.
- Parameters can be increased/decreased directly on the same block, minimizing break-and-replace loops.
- Designed for intuitive click-based shape editing instead of memorizing complex workflows.

## Compatibility & Dependencies

- Minecraft: `1.20.1`
- Forge: `47.3.x`
- Create: `0.5.1.j-55`
- Copycats: `2.2.1`

> The versions above are recommended for full feature compatibility and best stability.

## Who Is This For

- Players who build high-detail structures with Copycats
- Players who need smooth geometric transitions in Create contraptions
- Pack/mod authors extending variable copycat geometry on the legacy Create stack

## Future Plans

- Expand the library of editable geometry families
- Keep improving placement previews and interaction consistency
- Control state complexity and performance cost without sacrificing usability
- Port to Create 6.0+ in approprite timing

# ✴️ About this datapack 

FossilsPlus normally allows its special fossils (Shiny, HA, IV, Perfect) to generate any Pokémon species present in the game, including stage 1 and 2 Pokémon.

Fossils Minus restricts those modifiers so they only work when combined with valid fossil ingredients for thematic consistency. All supported recipes give stage 0 Pokémon.

## ⚠️ Hidden Ability Notes

Some Pokémon do not have hidden abilities defined.

The following species currently, by default, do not have hidden abilities:

- Archen
- Genesect
- Type:Null

Hidden Ability recipes are still included for these Pokémon via:

- fp_ha_archen.json
- addon_ha_genesect.json
- addon_ha_typenull.json

These recipes exist to support custom server-side hidden ability additions and modded ability expansions.

If your server does not use custom hidden abilities, these files can be safely removed.

Removing them will prevent the Hidden Ability Fossil from being used to revive those Pokémon, so that nobody wastes a Hidden Ability Fossil unnecessarily.

# ⚙️ Technical details

This release is structured as modular packs:

## 🗃️ Required

- Core Datapack

- Core Fetus Resource Pack

## 🚥 Optional Addons

- Complete Galar Fossilmon

- ATM x MSD (Vanilla version)

- ATM x MSD (LegendaryMonuments version)

- Lost Lore

You can enable only the integrations you use. Using addon packs that add recipes for Pokémon not present in your game may crash the game

### 🏯 Legendary Monuments Support

An alternate ATM x MSD pack is included, where Mewtwo's resurrection requires:

- Nether Star

- Tuft of Mew Hair (LegendaryMonuments)

This overrides the Psychic Gem recipe when enabled for both the default recipe, and any fossils plus recipes. This feature was present in previous LM versions of ATM x MSD but has since been removed.

# 🖥️ Installation

Extract the main download.

Place desired datapack zip(s) into:

world/datapacks/


Place the desired resource pack zip(s) into:

client resourcepacks folder
or

host as server resource pack

Run:

/reload


⚠️ Do not unzip the inner zip files.

## 🔧 Advanced: Combining Packs Into One

If you prefer a single unified datapack and/or resource pack instead of modular zips, you can merge them manually.

### Combining Datapacks

If you wish to combine these packs into one for cleaner organisation;

Unzip the datapacks you want to combine.

Merge their data/ folders together.

Keep only one pack.mcmeta at the root.

Re-zip the folder (do not nest folders).

Final structure should look like:

```
UnifiedPack.zip

├── pack.mcmeta

└── data/

    └── cobblemon/

        └── fossils/ 
```


⚠️ Important:

If combining ATM x MSD variants, choose EITHER the Vanilla or LegendaryMonuments version — not both.

### Combining Resource Packs

Unzip the resource packs you want to merge.

Merge their assets/ folders together.

Keep only one pack.mcmeta.

Re-zip the folder.

Final structure:

```
UnifiedResourcePack.zip

├── pack.mcmeta

└── assets/

    └── cobblemon/

        └── bedrock/
```

## 🌐 Compatibility

Minecraft 1.21.1

[Cobblemon 1.7.3+](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon)

[Cobblemon FossilsPlus](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon-fossils-plus)

Optional: [ATM x MSD](https://modrinth.com/datapack/allthemons-x-mega-showdown-legacy)

Optional: [LegendaryMonuments](https://modrinth.com/mod/legendary-monuments)

Optional: [Lost Lore](https://modrinth.com/datapack/poketwo) 2.0/1.8

# 🤞 Future Plans
1. Dracodacentro support
2. Shiny fetus textures
3. Pre - Combined asset packs
4. Custom special fossil assets (if not supported by Fossils Plus already)
5. More recipe support (reach out on Cobblemon's Discord)

A feature-rich Minecraft progress tracking and management mod that helps you record every achievement in your game!

### 🎯 Multiple Progress Types  
- **Kill Progress** - Track specific mob kills  
- **Obtain Progress** - Track item collection    
- **Explore Progress** - Track dimension exploration  
- **Build Progress** - Track block placements  

### 📊 Smart Progress Management  
- **Real-time Progress Display** - HUD shows active progress  
- **Tree Chart Statistics** - View completion rates and hierarchical progress  
- **Estimated Time** - Smart estimation of remaining completion time  
- **Auto Save** - Progress data automatically saved, no loss on restart  

### 🌳 Sub-Progress System  
- Create hierarchical progress structures

- Manage complex achievement chains

### Installation

- **Kill Progress** - Use mob IDs like `minecraft:zombie`

- ✅ Killing mobs automatically updates kill progress  
- ✅ Obtaining items automatically updates obtain progress    
- ✅ Entering dimensions automatically completes explore progress  
- ✅ Placing blocks automatically updates build progress  
- ✅ Progress completion shows chat and HUD notifications

### Interface Settings  
Find Simple Progress in the Mods list, click Config button:

### Data Management  
- 🔒 Progress data automatically saved to world folder

title: FFA Streaks
description: A simple plugin to automate FFA healing, kits, teleporting and streaks.
body:
# FFAStreaks

A comprehensive Free-For-All (FFA) plugin for Paper/Spigot servers that adds killstreak tracking, healing on kill, kit management, and teleport systems.

## Features

### Core Features
- **Killstreak Tracking**: Tracks player killstreaks and resets on death
- **Highest Streak**: Records each player's best killstreak ever
- **Heal on Kill**: Automatically heals and feeds players when they get a kill
- **Streak Rewards**: Configurable rewards (broadcasts, potion effects) at specific streak milestones
- **Anti-Farm Protection**: Prevents players from farming the same victim repeatedly
- **No Drops**: Prevents inventory and XP drops on death
- **World Whitelist**: Enable/disable the plugin in specific worlds

### Kit System
- Create, delete, and manage kits
- Simple `/kit <name>` command for players
- Full inventory, armor, and offhand support
- Admin kit management commands

### Teleport System
- Set teleport points for FFA arenas
- Link kits to teleport points (auto-given on teleport)
- Full heal and feed on teleport
- Simple `/ffago go <type>` command

### PlaceholderAPI Integration
- `%ffastreaks_streak%` - Current killstreak
- `%ffastreaks_highest_streak%` - Best killstreak ever
- `%ffastreaks_kills%` - Total kills
- `%ffastreaks_enabled%` - Whether FFA is enabled in current world

## Requirements

- Paper 1.21.x or compatible
- Java 21
- PlaceholderAPI (optional, for placeholders)

## Installation

1. Download the latest JAR from the releases page
2. Place `FFAStreaks-1.0.0.jar` in your server's `plugins/` folder
3. Start or restart your server
4. Configure `plugins/FFAStreaks/config.yml` to your preferences
5. Reload with `/ffastreaks reload` or restart the server

## Configuration

### config.yml

```yaml
enabled_worlds:
  enabled: true
  worlds:
    - world
    - arena

heal_on_kill:
  enabled: true
  amount: 6.0  # 1.0 = half-heart, 20.0 = 10 hearts

anti_farm:
  enabled: true
  same_victim_cooldown_seconds: 20

messages:
  prefix: "&d[FFA]&f "
  disabled_world: "&cFFAStreaks is disabled in this world."
  streak_self: "&aYour current streak: &e%streak%"
  streak_other: "&a%player%'s streak: &e%streak%"
  top_header: "&6Top killstreaks:"

rewards:
  "3":
    broadcast: "&e%killer% &fhas a &a3&f kill streak!"
    effects:
      - "SPEED 10 0"
  "5":
    broadcast: "&e%killer% &fhas a &a5&f kill streak!"
    effects:
      - "STRENGTH 8 0"
  "10":
    broadcast: "&e%killer% &fis on a &c10&f kill streak!"
    effects:
      - "RESISTANCE 10 0"
      - "REGENERATION 4 1"
```

### Configuration Options

**enabled_worlds**
- `enabled`: Enable world whitelist (false = all worlds)
- `worlds`: List of world names where FFA features are active

**heal_on_kill**
- `enabled`: Enable healing and feeding on kill
- `amount`: Health amount to restore (1.0 = half heart)

**anti_farm**
- `enabled`: Enable anti-farm protection
- `same_victim_cooldown_seconds`: Cooldown before same victim can be farmed again

**rewards**
- Configure rewards at specific streak milestones
- Format: `"streak_number": { broadcast: "message", effects: ["EFFECT seconds amplifier"] }`
- Effects format: `"EFFECT_NAME seconds amplifier"` (e.g., "SPEED 10 0")

## Commands

### Player Commands

**/streak [top|player]**
- View your current killstreak
- `/streak top` - View top 10 killstreaks
- `/streak <player>` - View another player's streak

**/kit <name>**
- Get a kit by name
- Example: `/kit warrior`

**/ffakits list**
- List all available kits

**/ffakits give <name>**
- Get a kit for yourself
- Example: `/ffakits give warrior`

**/ffago go <type>**
- Teleport to a teleport point
- Automatically gives linked kit if configured
- Fully heals and feeds player
- Example: `/ffago go spawn`

**/ffago list**
- List all available teleport points

### Admin Commands

**/ffastreaks reload**
- Reload the plugin configuration
- Permission: `ffastreaks.admin`

**/ffakits create <name>**
- Create a kit from your current inventory
- Permission: `ffastreaks.admin`

**/ffakits delete <name>**
- Delete a kit
- Permission: `ffastreaks.admin`

**/ffakits give <name> [player]**
- Give a kit to yourself or another player
- Permission: `ffastreaks.admin` (to give to others)

**/ffago set <type>**
- Set a teleport point at your current location
- Permission: `ffastreaks.admin`

**/ffago link <type> <kit>**
- Link a kit to a teleport point
- Permission: `ffastreaks.admin`

## Permissions

**ffastreaks.kit**
- Allows players to get kits using `/kit` or `/ffakits give`
- Default: `true` (all players)

**ffastreaks.go**
- Allows players to use `/ffago go` and `/ffago list`
- Default: `true` (all players)

**ffastreaks.admin**
- Full admin access to all FFA commands
- Default: `op` (operators only)

## Usage Examples

### Setting Up an FFA Arena

1. Create a kit:
   ```
   /ffakits create warrior
   ```

2. Set a spawn point:
   ```
   /ffago set spawn
   ```

3. Link the kit to spawn:
   ```
   /ffago link spawn warrior
   ```

4. Players can now use:
   ```
   /ffago go spawn
   ```
   This will teleport them, give them the warrior kit, and fully heal/feed them.

### Creating Streak Rewards

Edit `config.yml` to add rewards at specific streaks:

```yaml
rewards:
  "5":
    broadcast: "&e%killer% &fhas a &a5&f kill streak!"
    effects:
      - "STRENGTH 8 0"
      - "SPEED 10 0"
```

The `%killer%` placeholder is automatically replaced with the player's name.

## PlaceholderAPI

If PlaceholderAPI is installed, the following placeholders are available:

- `%ffastreaks_streak%` - Current killstreak
- `%ffastreaks_highest_streak%` - Highest killstreak ever achieved
- `%ffastreaks_kills%` - Total kills
- `%ffastreaks_enabled%` - Whether FFA is enabled in current world (true/false)

### Example Usage in Scoreboards

```
&eKill Streak: &f%ffastreaks_streak%
&eBest Streak: &f%ffastreaks_highest_streak%
&eTotal Kills: &f%ffastreaks_kills%
```

## How It Works

### On Player Death
- Inventory is kept (no drops)
- XP level is kept (no XP drops)
- Killstreak is reset to 0
- If killed by a player:
  - Killer's streak increments
  - Killer is healed and fed (if enabled)
  - Streak rewards are applied (if configured)
  - Anti-farm protection is checked

### On Kill
- Health restored by configured amount
- Food level set to 20
- Saturation set to 20.0
- Exhaustion reset to 0
- Kill count increments
- Streak increments
- Highest streak updated if new record

### Anti-Farm System
- Tracks last kill time for each killer-victim pair
- Prevents rewards if same victim is killed within cooldown period
- Configurable cooldown in seconds

## File Structure

```
plugins/FFAStreaks/
├── config.yml          # Main configuration
└── kits.yml            # Kit and teleport storage (auto-generated)
```

## Troubleshooting

**Plugin not working in a world:**
- Check `enabled_worlds` in config.yml
- Ensure world name matches exactly (case-sensitive)

**Kits not saving:**
- Check file permissions in `plugins/FFAStreaks/`
- Ensure server has write access

**Placeholders not working:**
- Install PlaceholderAPI plugin
- Use `/papi reload` after installing FFAStreaks
- Check placeholder syntax: `%ffastreaks_streak%`

**Commands not working:**
- Check permissions with `/lp user <player> permission info`
- Default permissions should be `true` for players
- Admin commands require `ffastreaks.admin` permission

## API

### Public Methods

```java
// Get current streak
int getStreak(UUID uuid)

// Get total kills
int getKills(UUID uuid)

// Get highest streak ever
int getHighestStreak(UUID uuid)

// Check if enabled in world
boolean isEnabledInWorld(World world)
```

## Version

Current Version: 1.0.0

## Support

For issues, feature requests, or questions, please open an issue on the project repository.

## License

This plugin is provided as-is for use on Minecraft servers.

## Credits

Developed for Paper 1.21.x servers with support for PlaceholderAPI integration.

title: Smelting Metal - Realistic Metal and Gem Processing
description: A Minecraft mod that enhances metal and gem processing by requiring players to smelt ores into molten metal, mold it, and cool it in water to create ingots.
body:
# Description
**SmeltingMetal** is a Minecraft mod that enhances the metal and gem processing by introducing new system for creating and recycling certain items. Instead of directly smelting raw ores into ingots, player smelt any metal item to create a molten metal, which then can be collected by molds and cooled in water to produce usable ingots. Gem items can be turned into gem dust by using grindstone or crushing wheels from create mod. Tools require single metal/gem unit from an item mold and bigger items, like armor need block mold and 9 gem dust or 1 bucket of molten metal.

Recipes have been added for all metal items to smelt them into molten blocks or items. Including modded items, as long as metal name is in the name of the item. The same applies to grinding gem items.

Added Create support to add crushing recipes for all metal items and support Depot interactions.

Removed smelting recipes for items that are covered by new metal processing. Additionally, metal nuggets create raw ore or crushed metal instead of an ingot, making molds the only way to create ingots. Added option to turn crafting ingot recipes like netherite ingot into a mixing recipe from create.

This mod is designed for Minecraft 1.20.1 and integrates seamlessly with technical mods like Create, encouraging players to build complex automation systems for metal processing. It adds depth to gameplay by making metal production more engaging and rewarding.
 

# New items
## Metal Item Processing
### Molten Metal

![molten metal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3f7a456a13d46e6b7ddfeb396058e3008e2974f0.png)

Obtained by smelting a metal item. It can be any item with expected metal in name, excluding blacklisted items.

It cannot be stacked or held in inventory. On collecting from container, if no Hardened mold is present in inventory, it damages the Player and is thrown on the ground. On the ground, it damages player if they attempt to collect it. After couple of seconds, its being turned back into raw metal. Alternatively, when put in water, its cooled immediately.

 

### Clay Mold
![clay mold](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0dd2ebb81809ec3e133e8844dcb49fb711ecbebe_0.webp)

Crafted by using 5 clay balls. 

You can print a shape of a tool or  an ingot to change what kind of result do you want. Supported shapes: ingot, sword, axe, pickaxe, shovel, hoe.

Can be baked into Hardened Mold, by cooking in the furnace or made into Netherite Mold by combiting with netherite scrap. Mold retains its shape after this process.

 

### Hardened Mold / Netherite Mold
![hardened mold](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e08744d4d9a50760f59c830346ebf9aad760bf30.png)![hardened mold filled](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/31e78341d910bd19d1187453c3fd89dc2a26778c.png)![netherite mold](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b71ae107747218294f47f83ececa542bac96d158_0.webp)![netherite mold filled](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c92427607d90f8c3e9e783e46713359289ca0ac1.png)

Necessary for ingot making. When in inventory, Molten Metal can be collected. Both items dissapear and one Filled Mold is added with appropriate metal type. To be turned into a tool or ingot, it needs to be cooled by water or simply dropping it on the ground and waiting for it to cool. If Netherite Mold was used, it drops alongside the ingot. Hardened Mold breaks.

 

## Metal Block Processing
### Molten Metal Block
![molten block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e8bec3cd2cae2d3744f95ed882e926de57308113.png)
Obtained by smelting a metal block (as defined in config).

It cannot be stacked or directly put in inventory. On collecting from container, if no empty bucket is present in inventory, it damages the Player and is thrown on the ground. On the ground, it damages player if they attempt to collect it. After couple of seconds, its being turned back into raw metal block. Alternatively, when put in water, its cooled immediately.

If modded version of molten metal fluid is detected, that version is instead deployed on ground.

 

### Molten Metal Bucket
![metal bucket](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c2485a9f1568f079c29947109fc6d118a2cce82.png)
     
When bucket is in inventory, Molten Metal Block can be collected, turning it into Molten Metal Bucket. It can be poured into a netherite / hardened block mold by right clicking the block with it.

If modded version of molten metal bucket is detected, that version is used instead.

 

### Clay Block Mold
![clay top](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7e6520fddaa8c8472a31fd91f5aa8096de14be03_0.webp)

Crafted by using 8 clay balls.

You can print a shape of a piece of armor or  a metal block to change what kind of result do you want. Supported shapes: block, helmet, boots, pants, armor. (along with their synonyms defined in config)

Can be baked into Hardened Block Mold, by cooking in the furnace or crafted into a Netherite Block Mold, by surrounding it with 4 netherite ingots or upgrading it with a smithing template.

 
### Hardened Block Mold/ Netherite Block Mold
![hardened top](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e370b5663cfd9b3a1364d49ce39db464525c4703_0.webp)![netherite top](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/abb93d7f123bb4b029ff7266fe5e1f40d5e90a9e_0.webp)

Necessary for making metal block or armor. Sides of the block reflect the result item.

Molten Metal can be poured inside, case appearance reflecting its state. Filled case can be then cooled with water bucket to turn into a desired item, unless given metal doesnt have a given item. In that case, it defaults to metal block. Netherite Block Mold then drops on ground, Hardened Block Mold is destroyed. 

Molten metal can be collected back by rightclicking filled Block Mold with a bucket.

## Gem Processing
### Gem Dust
![gem dust](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d0a722f9d035c662bf5486789b7157009a8044ca.png)
Obtained by crushing gem items by grindstone or create crushing wheels. Block items provide 9 gem dusts.
Can be collected into molds by right clicking when holding gem dust and item mold in both hands.
Filed gem mold can be made into an item by right clicking it onto a source of lava.

### Filling Block Molds with Gem Dust
![hardened mold gem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7faf056da7324acb20813be3709a1114ffc19761_0.webp)![netherite mold gem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c6e8f136e85d7bad702a0c0c7e16934e3a648d3b_0.webp)
To fill block mold simply right click it while holding 9 or more gem dust. Retrieve it the same way.
Turn filled block mold by right clicking it with lava bucket.

# Configuration
## Metals Section
- **metal_definitions** (def iron, copper, gold, netherite) -  Choose your own metal that should be proccessed into molten metal.
  - Compatible with mod metals, f.e. add "zinc" to be able to smelt Zinc added by Create mod.
  - Currently, metals need metal ingot and metal block to be registered.
  - Metal items like molds, metal bucket, block and item are gonna be tinted by the color set in properties
  - Add your own definition of metal items not following the format. f.e. "andesite,color=B3A294,ingot=andesite_alloy,raw=andesite" 
  - supported keys: color ingot, block, raw, raw_block, nugget, crushed, bucket, molten_fluid
- **gem_definitions** (def. diamond)
  - Like metal definition, compatible with other mods. 
  - main gem item is the only required item
  - supported coloring gem items
  - supported keys: color, gem, block, shar
- **blacklist_keywords** (def nugget, mold, template, scrap) - Choose metal items which should NOT be melted or crushed by providing defining part of their name. Item name that includes one of the blacklist words is not melted.
- **block_keywords** - Keywords that identify block items. Any item containing these, will be treated as a block.
- **block_result_definitions** - add tags to block result categories. f.e. "armor=chestplate,tunic,armor" makes items containing chestplate, tunic, armor to be recognized as a metal armor result type. So you are able to print leather tunic onto a block mold to receive iron chestplate as they are both in armor category.
## Features Section
- **enable_melting_recipe_replacement**- Enable replacement of smelting/blasting recipes with molten metal recipes
- **enable_crushing_recipe_replacement**- Enable replacement of crushing recipes with crushed metal recipes
- **enable_nugget_recipe_replacement**- Enable replacement of nugget->ingot crafting recipes with nugget->raw_metal
- **enable_ingot_crafting_recipe_replacement** - Enable removal of crafting recipes for ingots, f.e. netherite ingot and if create mod is loaded add mixing recipes for them as well

# Compatibility
Mod should be compatible with most of modded metals. They only need to be defined in config and have ingot, block, raw and raw block form

Added specific support for Create with new features

Pairs great with Spelunkery and Create: Metalwork

# Issues
When right clicking Create depot to collect molten metal. Appropriate container item is filled but remains ghost icon of molten metal item that disappears on click… Only visual bug, no gameplay influence.

# Alternatives
There are some mods i was inspired by, that have similar functionalities if you prefer them. those include Hot Iron, Create Weaponry, etc

# What's next?
- RELEASE MOD FOR OTHER VERSIONS OF MINECRAFT
- Consider options how sensible it is to have molds for all gem / metal items not just armor and tools

title: Lightweight
description: Boost your Minecraft experience with enhanced performance, smoother gameplay, and optimized efficiency.
body:
# Lightweight Optimization

Lightweight Optimization is a lightweight, performance-focused Minecraft modpack built to maximize FPS, reduce lag, and deliver a smoother gameplay experience while preserving the vanilla feel of Minecraft.

This modpack combines some of the best optimization mods available for Fabric, making it an excellent choice for both low-end and high-end systems.

## Features

- Significantly improved FPS and overall performance
- Reduced memory usage and faster chunk loading
- Enhanced multiplayer and server performance
- OptiFine-like features without sacrificing performance
- Minimal impact on vanilla gameplay and visuals
- Regular updates for the latest Minecraft versions

## Included Technologies

Lightweight Optimization includes industry-standard performance mods such as:

- Sodium
- Lithium
- FerriteCore
- ImmediatelyFast
- Entity Culling
- More Culling
- Krypton
- ThreadTweak
- Iris Shaders
- Sodium Extra

and many other carefully selected optimization and quality-of-life enhancements.

## OptiFine Features Included

While Lightweight Optimization is built around Sodium, many popular OptiFine features are still available through modern alternatives:

- Shader support via Iris
- Dynamic Lights
- Connected Textures
- Improved graphics customization
- Enhanced performance compared to traditional OptiFine setups

## Built on Fabric

Fabric provides one of the fastest and most lightweight modding platforms available. By leveraging Fabric's extensive optimization ecosystem, Lightweight Optimization delivers exceptional performance without unnecessary bloat.

## Works Everywhere

Lightweight Optimization works seamlessly in:

- Singleplayer worlds
- Multiplayer servers
- Survival gameplay
- Creative building
- PvP environments

No server-side installation is required for most features.

## Performance First

Whether you're exploring vast worlds, building large projects, or using shaders, Lightweight Optimization is designed to provide a smoother and more responsive Minecraft experience.

title: Dimian's Vanilla Plus
description: A list of mods i compiled together that make my ideal way to play minecraft. Aims to enhance the experience by adding quality-of-life and better performance while maintaining the vanilla experience intact. I did not make the mods.
body:
# **Description:**
A list of mods I compiled together that make my ideal way to play minecraft. Aims to enhance the experience by improving the game's performance, adding to the gameplay with quality-of-life changes and new visuals to make the game more digestible and feel more modern while maintaining the vanilla experience mostly intact.

# **Performance:**
These are mods intended to improve the games performance.

- **[Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium):** A modern rendering engine for Minecraft which greatly improves performance.
- **[Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium):** No-compromises game logic/server optimization mod.
- **[Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra):** A Sodium addon that adds features that shouldn't be in Sodium.
- **[Indium](https://modrinth.com/mod/indium):** Sodium addon providing support for the Fabric Rendering API, based on Indigo.
- **[Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling):** Using async path-tracing to hide Block-/Entities that are not visible.
- **[More Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/moreculling):** A mod that changes how multiple types of culling are handled in order to improve performance.
- **[FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core):** Memory usage optimizations.
- **[Memory Leak Fix](https://modrinth.com/mod/memoryleakfix):** A mod that fixes random memory leaks for both the client and server.
- **[ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast):** Speed up immediate mode rendering in Minecraft.
- **[Let Me Despawn](https://modrinth.com/plugin/lmd):** Improves performance by tweaking mob despawn rules. Say bye to pesky unintentional persistent mobs. 

# **Quality-of-Life:**
These are mods that not only add extra information and visual feedback to your actions, but also some gameplay tweaks to make the experience more convenient and feel more modern.

- **[Just Enough Items](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei):** JEI - View Items and Recipes.
- **[Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu):** Adds a mod menu to view the list of mods you have installed.
- **[Mouse Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/mouse-tweaks):** Enhances inventory management by adding various functions to the mouse buttons.
- **[Eating Animation](https://modrinth.com/mod/eating-animation):** A mod that adds sprite animations for edible and drinkable items.
- **[AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin):** Food/hunger-related HUD improvements.
- **[Enchantment Descriptions](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchantment-descriptions):** Provides a way to get enchantment descriptions from enchanted books.
- **[Advancement Plaques](https://modrinth.com/mod/advancement-plaques):** Replace those boring advancement popups with something flashier.
- **[Legendary Tooltips](https://modrinth.com/mod/legendary-tooltips):** Give your rare items a fancier tooltip! Also adds additional tooltip configuration options.
- **[Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations):** Make your game like the trailers! Dynamic animated entities to freshen your Minecraft experience.
- **[Better Advancements](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-advancements):** Better Advancements tries to improve the UI and UX for the advancements system in minecraft 1.12+ in a modded environment.
- **[Dynamic Crosshair](https://modrinth.com/mod/dynamiccrosshair):** A mod that hides or changes the crosshair dependent on context.
- **[Item Highlighter](https://modrinth.com/mod/item-highlighter):** Highlights newly picked-up items. Simple and convenient.
- **[Pick Up Notifier](https://modrinth.com/mod/pick-up-notifier):** Be notified about all the things you've just collected.
- **[Tiny Item Animations](https://modrinth.com/mod/tiny-item-animations):** Adds little animations when you pick up or insert items with your mouse.
- **[Leaves Be Gone](https://modrinth.com/mod/leaves-be-gone):** Quick leaf decay from cutting down trees. Built for fast performance and mod compat!
- **[Traveler's Titles](https://modrinth.com/mod/travelers-titles):** Epic, RPG-like titles when entering biomes & dimensions!
- **[Minecart Turning](https://modrinth.com/mod/minecart-turning):** MC-201 fix; player camera turns with minecart (and other uncontrolled entities).
- **[Sound Physics Remastered](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-physics-remastered):** A Minecraft mod that provides realistic sound attenuation, reverberation, and absorption through blocks.
- **[LambDynamicLights](https://modrinth.com/mod/lambdynamiclights):** A dynamic lights mod for Fabric.

# **Gameplay additions:**
These are mods that change or make additions to gameplay, such as new features and tweaks.

- **[Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap):** Displays a map of the nearby world terrain, players, mobs, entities in the corner of your screen. Lets you create waypoints which help you find the locations you've marked.
- **[Keep Some Inventory](https://modrinth.com/datapack/keep-some-inventory):** Don't lose equipment but drop resources when dying.
- **[Nyf's Spiders 2.0](https://modrinth.com/mod/nyfs-spiders):** Vanilla spiders are not yet creepy enough for you? You wish spiders would actually climb properly?! Spiders 2.0 enables regular spiders and cave spiders to walk along walls and ceilings and it also improves their AI such that they can find their way around almost any obstacle.

# **Visuals:**
Mods that directly change the graphics and visuals of the game.

- **[Bare Bones](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones):** Minecraft with the style of the trailers.
- **[Complementary Shaders - Reimagined](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-reimagined):** Preserving the elements of Minecraft with exceptional quality, detail, and performance.
- **[Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity):** A Fabric mod that allows for efficient connected textures.
- **[Barebones Better Leaves](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/barebones-better-leaves):** Creates holes on leaves in a style that fits the barebones resourcepack.
- **[Colourful containers GUI](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/colourful-containers-gui):** A container GUI replacement mod that hopes to match the menu to every one of Minecraft's colourful interactable blocks.

# **Credits:**
I did not make the mods themselves but simply put them all together in a modpack, all the credits go to the respective creators.
The mod descriptions are taken from the pages of the respective mods.

title: Record
description: Adds two commands that show players that you are either recording or are live
body:
# Record Plugin - PaperMC 1.21+

[![KH Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f69c5ff58ef061c0e6fadee4a7a4a8f00e3fcaf3_0.webp)](https://billing.kinetichosting.net/aff.php?aff=947)

This is a simple Minecraft Plugin that uses the [LuckPerms API](https://luckperms.net/wiki/Developer-API) and [LuckPermsChat Plugin](https://modrinth.com/plugin/lpc-chat) to add and remove the [Rec] And [Live] Prefixes to/from your Username.

[Todo](https://github.com/users/SkyKingPX/projects/5/views/1)

## Features
- /rec or /r to add/remove the [Rec] Status
  
  ![Recording Status](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8f59f47a102d4e0d4ac15be8c5a6638afd90c313.png)
- /live or /l to add/remove the [Live] Status
  
  ![Live Status](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/48b408c27e3ae816a2897ec2a17753d47921bab6.png)
- You can execute either the /rec or the /live command while having a different status and the plugin will automatically change your status to the new one.
- Customizable Prefixes & Prefix Weight
- Translations inside the configuration file
- Message Broadcasting

## Dependencies
- [LuckPerms](https://luckperms.net/download)
- [LPC](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/lpc-chat-formatter-1-7-10-1-20.68965/) / [LPC Minimessage](https://modrinth.com/plugin/lpc-chat)
- [TAB](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/tab-1-5-1-21-4.57806/) (Shows the Status in the Tab bar - **optional**)

## Installation
1. Download the latest release of [LuckPerms](https://luckperms.net/download), [LPC](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/lpc-chat-formatter-1-7-10-1-20.68965/) / [LPC Minimessage](https://modrinth.com/plugin/lpc-chat) and the Record Plugin
2. Put all of the jars into the plugins folder of your Server
3. Done!

The plugin will automatically create the required groups in LuckPerms

## Configuration
This is the default configuration file (last updated: v1.1.0):

```
# If a feedback message should be sent to a player when changing the status
# (Messages are configurable)
enable-private-feedback: true
# If a public Broadcast should be sent (to all players) if a player changes the status
# (Messages are configurable)
enable-public-broadcast: false
# If the command executor should be excluded from the broadcast
# Requires enable-public-broadcast: true
exclude-executor-from-broadcast: false

# Prefixes
rec-prefix: "&5[&r&4Rec&5] &r"
live-prefix: "&5[&r&bLive&5] &r"

# Prefix Weights - Controls the order of the prefixes
# May be useful when having ranks/prefixes in LuckPerms
rec-prefix-weight: 100
live-prefix-weight: 100

# Messages - (Un)Comment the German/English translations to change the language
# INFO: Available Placeholders: {player}, {prefix}, {group}
# > A Placeholder is only available in those messages, that already contain it!
messages:
  console: 
    # Console Messages do not support Color Codes!
    invalid-config: "Invalid configuration file! Did you update it? Please check the config.yml!"
    #invalid-config: "Ungültige Konfigurationsdatei! Hast du sie aktualisiert? Bitte überprüfe die config.yml!"
    rec-group-already-exists: "Group 'rec' already exists, skipping creation"
    #rec-group-already-exists: "Gruppe 'rec' existiert bereits, überspringe Erstellung"
    rec-group-created: "Created group 'rec'"
```

title: Slashbridge
description: serverside utility mod aiming to add in minecraft commands that I think the base game lacks, bridging datapack and mod function.
body:
### Slashbridge

## What does it do?

Slashbridge was started because there are functions that I was like "Really? You can't do that with commands?" In its current state it adds commands, but the plan is to expand it to other serverside features that will be used my own datapacks and data-driven mods, and hopefully yours too!

## Commands

<details>
<summary>/motion</summary>
Entitymotion allows you to smoothly move an entity and edit its current velocity in different ways.
  
Movement subcommands:

> set (vector) - Changes the entity's velocity to a new vector.
> 
> add (vector) - Adds a new vector to the entity's current velocity.
> 
> seek (number) - Moves targets towards an entity (or away from with a negative number).
> 
> mult (number) - Multiplies a target's current velocity by a number.

Vector movement formats:

> world - Movement corresponds to in-game coordinates. <x> <y> <z>
> 
> local - Movement relative to where the target entity is facing. <forward/back> <up/down> <right/left>
> 
> zx - Movement rotates only horizontally but not vertically. Y is always up in the game world and not up relative to where an entity is facing. <forward/back> <y> <right/left>
</details>

 
<details>
<summary>/status</summary>
Entitystatus lets you modify the health, hunger, and absorption values of an entity. 

Subcommands:

> seek lets you transfer any of these stats from one entity to another, such as giving an entity hunger by removing another's health.
> 
> The rest of the subcommands +|-|*|/|= are just math operators. 
</details>


<details>
<summary>/despawn</summary>


  
Despawn lets you despawn entities without technically killing them. They won't drop items or xp or anything. Currently made to ignore players.

Subcommands:

> recursive - Despawns the entity targeted alongside all of its passengers.
>
> single - Despawns only the entity targeted.
</details>

<details>
<summary>/after</summary>

After lets you run a command after a number of ticks. Can be stacked with other commands. For example `/execute at @p run after 100 kill' could be a command. 

</details>

<details>
<summary>/during</summary>

During lets you run a command during day, night, or a specific moon phase. 

</details>

<details>
<summary>/Ignite & /Extinguish</summary>

Set entities on fire or put it out. The ignite command lets you set the number of ticks entities are on fire for.

</details>

## Tags

These will have some degree of command functionality, but they partially use minecraft's command system and can be added & manipulated with the /tag command.

<details>
<summary>Damage Resitance and Vulnerability</summary>
sb.dx.<damageType>+<multiplier>
  
> This adds in damage multipliers for a specific damage type. These are done in camelcase, as that's what's displayed in minecraft. So instead of writing indirect_magic you'd write indirectMagic.
> 
> sb.dx.mob+0.5 would mean you take half melee damage from mobs
> 
> these tags are not intended to stack, and the math will work out weirdly if you try and stack them.
> 
> you can put negative multipliers to heal on damage.

sb.damageheal

> This tag is added when an entity heals instead of taking damage. It does not get removed at the moment, with the assumption that whoever's using the tag for tracking purposes can remove it on their end.
</details>


## Plans for the future

<details>
<summary>Player Animation Command(s)</summary>
  
Idk how plausable this is, but I want to be able to queue up player animations available in vanilla game such as swinging a hand or sitting. Whether or not this would be possible, especially at my current skill level, only time will tell.
</details>

title: ItemGator
description: Prevent players from having/using specific items until they have a certain tag!
body:
Looking for an easy way to prevent players from having *anything* to do with an item until they've made it further through progression? Then look no further! ItemGator allows you to use datapack-style recipes in order to prevent players from being able to have an item until some other process - be it an FTB Quest Reward, a Per-Tick `mcfunction` or some other means - adds a tag to the player.

When the tag isn't present on the player, the item will turn into whatever item is defined as a substitute and all of the data for the original item will be stored on the substitute as NBT.

When the tag *is* present, the mod will use that NBT data on the item to revert it back to its original form, allowing you to push the use of an item to a later time.


## Datapack examples:

### Disallow access to an entire mod until the tag `test123` is given to the player

In this example, the mod Immersive Engineering is being gated from any player that doesn't have the tag `test123`. When a player without that tag obtains *any* Immersive Engineering item, it'll turn into a stick until they are granted that tag.

```json
{
  "type": "itemgator:mod",
  "mod": "immersiveengineering",
  "substitute": { "item": "minecraft:stick" },
  "tag": "test123"
}

```

### Disallow an item or item tag until the tag `test123`is given to the player

In this example, any `minecraft:planks` will be turned into a stick until the player is granted the tag `test123`:

```json
{
  "type": "itemgator:ingredient",
  "input": { "tag": "minecraft:planks" },
  "substitute": { "item": "minecraft:stick" },
  "tag": "test123"
}
```

title: Madoku Craft: Farming
description: Madoku Craft: Farming is a configurable Farming system. This system adjusts Crops to grow based on Time, Season, and Rain. Farmland be Fertilized to increase Crop Yield and growing speeds.
body:
## Overview:

Madoku Craft: Farming is a configurable Farming system. It allows users to customize Farming to their specific needs. This system adjusts Crops to grow based on Time instead of randomly. It also modifies the Yield for Crops. Most of these features are customizable in the CONFIG files.

## Dependencies:

- Fabric API
- Madoku Craft API

## Features:

**Crop Growth:**

- All Crops grow based on in-game Time.
- If Madoku Season is Enabled, some Crops will only grow during certain Seasons.
- Crops grow faster when it Rains.

![Seasonal Crops](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2cf4cffd1a0f407f948737f7bb50e2e3e06d8519.png)

**Fertilizer:**

- Placing Bone-meal on Farmland fertlizes the block.
- Fertilized Farmland allows Crops to grow faster and increases their Yield.

![Fertilizer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0b7e957f69d9596f2c94eb171e0b607472493f5a.gif)

**Adjusted Crops:**

- Pumpkins and Melons no longer grow adjacent to their Stem.
- Since Pumpkins and Melons replace their Stem, their Yield were adjusted accordingly.
- This allows Pumpkins and Melons to grow similar to other Crops.

title: CuffsX
description: CuffsX is a mod adding handcuffs for player control, with two types (hands, legs), timed apply/remove, durability, and leading players with a lead. Includes commands, logs, LuckPerms support, and works on Fabric 0.14+.
body:
# EN
## CuffsX

**CuffsX** is a Minecraft mod that adds an advanced handcuff system for player control and server management.

---

### 🔗 Features

* Two types of cuffs:

  * 🖐 Hand cuffs
  * 🦵 Leg cuffs

* ⏳ Timed application and removal

* 🛠 Durability system

* 🎲 Randomized cooldown between escape attempts

---

### 🧍 Player Control

* Ability to lead restrained players using a **vanilla lead**
* Automatic teleport if distance exceeds **3 blocks**
* Different escape mechanics for hands and legs

---

### ⚙️ Server Features

* Commands for:

  * Removing cuffs
  * Enabling / disabling the system
  * Viewing logs (last **24 hours**, with coordinates)
  * Listing all restrained players with details

---

### 📦 Gameplay Mechanics

* Cuffs:

  * ❌ Do not enter the target’s inventory
  * ✔ Are removed from the user upon use
  * 💀 Drop on death

* Application:

  * Only works if the target is outside **FTB claims**
  * Requires being within range
  * Includes a timer before completion

---

### 🔐 Permissions

* Permissions handled via **LuckPerms**

---

### 🔌 Compatibility

* ✔ Fabric Loader **0.14+**
* ✔ Optional integration with **FTB Chunks**

---

### 🎮 Use Cases

* PvP servers
* Roleplay servers
* War / faction-based scenarios

> Ideal for situations where controlled player interaction is required.

**CuffsX** — это мод для Minecraft, добавляющий продвинутую систему наручников для контроля игроков и управления сервером.

---

### 🔗 Основные возможности

- Два типа наручников:
  - 🖐 Наручники для рук

### 🧍‍♂️ Контроль игроков

- Возможность вести связанного игрока с помощью **обычного поводка (lead)**  
- Автоматическая телепортация, если расстояние превышает **3 блока**  
- Разные механики освобождения для рук и ног

### ⚙️ Серверные функции

- Команды:
  - Удаление наручников
