title: CulPlugin
description: Just a small utility plugin with commands, fake plugins, customize your server in the server list, and other features coming!
body:
![PluginLogo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/32b742d3008ef8264608344ee360c6f4dc7e2b5a.png)
**CulPlugin is a plugin which is created for types of server utilities and control, aswell as lying to the client.**
## What CulPlugin Implements:
### Commands (Any of the commands can be disabled via the config):
**<> <- required argument, [<>] <- optional argument.**
- **_clientstats <Player>_** -> Sends the Client Stats of the selected player (Those include Client Brand, wether Custom Weather is enabled or not, Render Distance, Version, Language). Permission: ```culPlugin.clientstats.use```  
- **_sudo <Player> <Command> [<Arguments>]_** -> Forces the selected player to say or execute a certain command with the selected arguments. Permission: ```culPlugin.sudo.use```  
- **_ec_** -> Opens Your Ender Chest. Permission: ```culPlugin.ec.use```  
- **_(ec/inv)see <Player>_** -> Opens the selected player's Inventory or Ender Chest. Permissions: ```culPlugin.(ec/inv)see.use```  
- **_gm(c/s/a/sp) [<Player>]_** -> Changes the player's gamemode to creative/survival/adventure or spectator, if no player is selected, changes the executor's gamemode to said gamemode. Permissions: ```culPlugin.gm(c/s/a/sp).use```  
- **_fly [<Player>]_** -> Toggles the player's flight mode, if no player is selected, toggles the executor's flight mode. Permissions: ```culPlugin.fly.use``` -> for toggling flight for yourself, ```culPlugin.fly.other.use``` -> for toggling flight for others.  
- **_culplugin <Argument(s)>_** -> Command for the plugin itself, as of the edition of this description, there's one argument: reload. Permission: ```culPlugin.main.use```  
- **_thing <Argument(s)>_** -> As of the edition of the plugin's description, there's 3 arguments, self-explanatory: BlockYouLookAtYouGet, BlockYouLookAtIsGone and BlockYouLookAtYouGetAndIsGone. Permission: ```culPlugin.thing.use```  
- **_shrug_** -> Makes the player send "¯\\\_(ツ)_/¯". Permission: ```culPlugin.shrug.use```  
- **_get <Argument(s)_** -> Gets or executes almost any java expression such as org.bukkit.Bukkit.getServer().shutdown(). Disabled by default. Permission:  ```culPlugin.get.use``` 
**<big>Use at your and the server's risk.</big>**  
- **_reset <Player>_** -> Resets the selected player's effects, inventory, exp, advancements and recipes, depending on which argument is chosen (or 'all' for all of them). Permission: ```culPlugin.reset.use```
- **_deplete <Player> <amount>_** -> Removes the amount of a random item from the player's inventory. Permission: ```culPlugin.deplete.use```  
- **_editplayer <Player> <Argument> <Argument(s)>_** -> Lets you edit a good bit of the player chosen, like the display,tab names & the nametag, flyspeed, the amount of arrows/bee stingers in the player's body, health, deathscore, transfer them to another server, show the win screen, show the elder guardian thingy, and other functions alike. All relevant arguments of the functions are suggested (aswell as the functions themselves), so there should be no confusion. Permission: ```culPlugin.EditPlayer.use```  


### Plugin Faking  
**You can fake plugins from the config. Disabled by default.**  
```yaml
fake-plugins:
  enabled: false
  list:
    LinuxFramework: # some bs lmao, you can also ig js copy real plugins or make your own fake ones :D
      version: "1.0.1" # I recommend you keep the version if you decide to delete everything else, cause without the version... it could break maybe? probably
      description: "Framework which a linux server runs on." # also for formatting use minimessage imo, but you can use whatever you want :D
      website: "https://localhost:25565"
      authors: "Framework Specialists, Cool Peoples" # can also be 'author' for singular
    CoolPeople:
      version: "v3"
      description: "Hi :D"
      authors: "Cool People :D"
```  


### Server List Ping Editing  
**You can edit the information the client recieves on a server list ping. Disabled by default.**  
```yaml
server-info:
  enabled: false
  features:
    motd: "Ello :D"
    max-players: 1
    online-players: 2
    version: "Linux 19.2" # custom version string, use minimessage or wtv you decide :D, use '&' instead of section signs.
    protocolVersion: 775 # protocol version number
    allowLegacy: true # allow legacy clients, clients with a protocol ver below ~4 or lower than 1.7
    hover: # only works for stuff which a real username can have (rn)
      enabled: false
      lines: ["eee", "eee", "lmaoHi"] # hover list lines n stuff
```  


### Prefix deleting thingy  
**Ya can disable/enable the prefixing for commands made by culPlugin or any commad with a colon(:) in it.**  
```yaml
plugin-stuff:
  enabled: true
  features:
    plugin-prefixing: true # removes all commands starting with 'culplugin:' if disabled (true = enabled)
    other-prefixing: true # removes all commands with colons (:) if disabled (true = enabled)
```  
**<ins>All Configuration Values Shown are the Defaults and can be changed on the fly, refreshed with 'culplugin reload'.</ins>**  


Pssst.. Releases are tested on Folia 1.21.11 and Paper 1.21.11, 1.19
Player related commands are tested on myself. Only the features added in the version are tested.

title: LocatorToggle
description: Allow Users to Toggle the New Locator Bar
body:
## 📋 Overview LocatorToggle is a lightweight Spigot plugin that allows players to locally toggle the newly introduced locator bar. When toggled off, the player is also hidden from other players’ locator bars, providing a more private gameplay experience. ❗ **Gamerule 'locatorBar' must be set to 'true'** ## 🎥 Demonstration ## 🛠️ Commands - **/locator** - Toggles the locator bar functionality on/off for the player. - **/locator radius \** - Sets the locator bar radius (1-60,000,000 blocks). - **/locator reload** - Reloads the plugin configuration and language files. ## 🔐 Permissions | Permission node | Description | Default setting | |-----------------|--------------------------------------------------|-----------------| | locator.toggle | Controls usage of the /locator command | Everyone | | locator.radius | Controls usage of the /locator radius subcommand | Everyone | | locator.reload | Controls usage of the /locator reload subcommand | Operators | ## ⚙️ Configuration
Click to view config.yml ```yaml # Whether new users will have their locator disabled by default. locator-disabled-by-default: false # Maximum radius that players can set using /locator radius. locator-max-radius: 60000000 # Default radius when players enable the locator. # This only applies when the player hasn't set a custom radius yet. default-locator-radius: 60000000 ```
## 🔌 PlaceholderAPI Support This plugin provides the following placeholders: - `%locatortoggle_status%` - Returns "enabled" or "disabled" based on the player's preference - `%locatortoggle_radius%` - Returns the player's custom locator bar radius (if set)

title: UnstableCraft
description: A chaotic modpack with every mod imaginable.
body:
# ![text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6725008db401f1de4b8be3ff8324a9a606f9f112.png)

## About

A chaotic modpack with every mod imaginable, inspired by CrazyCraft or InsaneCraft. This is a personal modpack for some friends of mine on a server, but I might as well make some ad revenue money off of it. We wanted the server to be a loser's version of the Unstable SMP, but that didn't work out, but in remembrance of the original idea, it is called UnstableCraft. Contrary to the name, I hope to make the modpack as stable as I can.

## Performance & Stability

I want to make this modpack as stable and performant as possible, but with the large amount of mods I plan to add, I cannot guarantee that it will work well on lower-end pcs. If your pc cannot run this pack I suggsest trying [UnstableCraft Lite](https://modrinth.com/modpack/unstablecraft-lite-cc), a version of the modpack only with performance, minimal utilities, and every server-side mod.

## Content

As of now, this modpack has mostly utility related mods. I plan to update the pack with content related mods in the future. Mods like [Cataclysm](https://modrinth.com/mod/l_enders-cataclysm), [Apotheosis](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/apotheosis), [Twilight Forest](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-twilight-forest), [BetterX Mods](https://modrinth.com/organization/betterx), and [Modern Industrialization](https://modrinth.com/mod/modern-industrialization/versions), are planned.

## Multiplayer

This modpack was made for a private server, but if the pack gets popular I might make a public server for it. But for now, using [Essential](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential) to host your own worlds or making your own server is reccomended. If a public server ever happens, it will be after the modpack gets most of it's content mods. [UnstableCraft Lite](https://modrinth.com/modpack/unstablecraft-lite-cc) will also be compatible like I said before.

title: EssentiaX Chat Addon
description: Clear chat and slowchat addon for EssentiaX
body:
# ChatAddon for EssentiaX

**ChatAddon** is a useful addon for **EssentiaX** that makes your server chat more manageable and organized.  

## Features

- **Slowchat**  
  - Prevents players from sending messages too quickly.  
  - Configurable cooldown in seconds.  
  - Players with the permission `essentiax.slowchat.bypass` can bypass slowchat.

- **ClearChat**  
  - Manually clear the chat with the `/clearchat` command.  
  - Broadcasts a message when the chat has been cleared.  
  - Automatic chat clearing at configurable intervals.  
  - Both the command and auto-clear can be enabled or disabled in the config.  
  - Permissions:  
    - `essentiax.clearchat` for using the command  
    - `essentiax.slowchat.bypass` for bypassing slowchat

## Installation

1. Place the `ChatAddon.jar` file in the following folder:  
plugins/EssentiaX/addons
2. Start or reload the server.  
3. The configuration file will be automatically created at `plugins/EssentiaX/addons/chataddon.yml`.  
4. Adjust slowchat and clearchat settings in the configuration file.

## Configuration

- **Slowchat**  
```yaml
slowchat:
 enabled: true
 cooldown_seconds: 5
 
clearchat:
  enabled: true
  auto:
    enabled: true
    interval: 60 # minutes
```

Notes

- This addon is compatible only with EssentiaX.
- No additional dependencies required.

DISABLE MOB GRIEFING
====================

A lightweight Fabric mod that allows you to selectively disable specific types of mob griefing using custom gamerules.  
Currently, the following mob behaviors can be disabled: **Creeper griefing** and **Enderman block manipulation**.

This mod introduces two new gamerules:

- `/gamerule disableCreeperGriefing true`

- `/gamerule disableEndermanGriefing true`  
  Prevents Endermen from picking up or placing blocks in the world.


## Notes

- The mod is designed primarily for **server-side use**.
- No additional mods are required.

title: Bedframe
description: Translation layer that converts textured/custom server-side Polymer blocks and items to native Bedrock representations.
body:
# Bedframe

Translation layer that converts textured/custom server-side Polymer blocks and items to native Bedrock representations.

> ⚠️ Bedframe is in early development (and may stay that way), so you should *expect* problems. Batteries not included. See store for details.

> ❗ If you are looking for general modding support on Bedrock, see if [Hydraulic](https://github.com/GeyserMC/Hydraulic) works for you. Or, if you are looking for specifically Polymer support and can use Geyser's Custom Item API V2 preview, see if [Rainbow](https://geysermc.org/wiki/other/rainbow/) works for you. Their conversion code is better than mine. Do note that Hydraulic *does not* support Polymer mods at the moment, and I haven't tested if both mods work at the same time.

## Requirements

- [Geyser-Fabric](https://geysermc.org/download)
- [Polymer (or a mod that uses it and its resource pack features)](https://modrinth.com/mod/polymer)

You also probably want Polymer's Auto-Host feature, but Bedframe doesn't require it.

## Compatibility

See the [spreadsheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ru1hisG0D22LlQG8Kkw0XwVGLOjtfU8odAiiZo6nnzQ/edit?usp=sharing).

Polymer mods that use display entities are not supported at the moment. (Geyser simply doesn't support it).

Bedframe does not touch non-textured blocks (so mods like [Server-Side Waystones](https://modrinth.com/mod/sswaystones) will work as expected)

Feel free to [make an issue](https://github.com/sylvxa/bedframe/issues/new) for incompatible mods.

## License

This mod is available under the CC0 license. Feel free to learn from it and incorporate it in your own project

title: Force Normal Font
description: Replaces the unicode font with the normal Minecraft font in places where it may be forced (eg Patchouli books)
body:
Replaces Minecraft's Unicode font with the standard font seen throughout the game. This doesn't do much in vanilla Minecraft, however modded reference textbooks (especially those reliant on Patchouli) have a tendency to use the Unicode font in place of the normal one. This pack replaces that, and also enables custom fonts to be used in these places as well.

Note: In some cases, the change of font may cause text to overflow where it's supposed to show up. This isn't a fault of this pack, the vanilla font is a fair bit wider than the Unicode font and mod authors can't account for the change. See the Gallery for an example.

Functional versions exist for 1.19.2 and 1.20.1. Will probably work on other versions, but make sure to download whichever of those two is closer to your target version.

# Dispenserfarm Mod Introduction

Dispenserfarm is a lightweight yet powerful Minecraft mod that enhances dispensers, turning them into versatile tools for automated farming. This mod allows dispensers to plant a wide variety of crops and items, from wheat, carrots, and potatoes to unique plants like mushrooms, sugar cane, cave vines, and Nether Wart, using their corresponding items.

### Key Features:
- **Automated Planting**: Dispensers can place seeds, saplings, flowers, and other plantable items on suitable surfaces like farmland, soul sand, or nylium.

Dispenserfarm is perfect for players looking to streamline farming automation in Minecraft, saving time and enhancing redstone creativity. Try it now to transform your dispensers into ultimate farming tools!

- A land claim

- Interacting opens a menu to load chunks and players from notepads

- An item to mark players and chunks for you states
- When right-clicked, saves the chunk
- When right-clicked on a player, saves the player
## Stateleporter
- An item to teleport to your state
- Right-click a statemaker to save the position, then shift-right-click to teleport back

body:
Elemental Amulets — a mod that adds amulets, powerful and cool looking necklaces!
Control the elements in your favor!

Escape from enemies with the help of a amulet of speed and jump boost, take a hot shower in the nether with a fire-resistance amulet, travel deep into  and etc! New mechanic - Elemental combination, with which you can mix the elements with anything! The Jeweller and the elemental guide will help you on your journey.

 

Also, with full customization and full JEI support, you can put this mod into any modpack! Change the values using the configuration, view, add and remove recipes!

 

This mod is currently in stable beta! All core features are working, so feel free to use it in modpack!

 

 

List of currently added amulets:

  1. Amulet of Fire-Resistance - protects from fire and on higher levels from lava!
  2. Amulet of Water  - makes you breathe underwater(tier 2+) and swim faster!
  3. Amulet of Air  - makes you fall slow
  4. Amulet of Terra-Protection - creates magical shield around you that protects from damage
  5. Amulet of Jump-Boost - makes you jump higher
  6. Amulet of Invisibility - makes you invisible
  7. Amulet of Speed-Boost - boosts your speed
  8. Amulet of Earth - boosts plants and improves the yield
  9. Pacifying Amulet - passive mobs won't get angry at you(e.g endermans and zombified piglins)
  10. Amulet of Knockback - very straightforward, pushes your attackers.

and many other amulets yet to be added!

 

FAQ:

Q: Why does this mod has a lot of downloads?
A: I’ve created this mod a long time ago, and then abandoned it. After some time I removed all files and started fresh

 

Compatibility with other mods:

This mod should be compatible with most mods, since it’s not changing anything global.
If you found that some mod is not compatible with mine, please report this issue to me and other mod’s creator!

Suggestions:

If you have an idea, feel free to leave comment or create a new pull request on github(only if you want to make it yourself)

All ideas are welcome!

Also please don’t repost this mod! https://stopmodreposts.org

I’m not going to sue you, but please just not.

title: Compound V
description: Superpowers inspired by The Boys, served by the bottle. Drink experimental serums and try to keep your ability alive. -> Compound V Plugin
body:
# 🧪 CompoundV ### *Inject the powers of* The Boys *into Minecraft.*
--- > Most heroes don't get their powers in a lab. > On your server, they will. **One bottle at a time.** CompoundV is a modular ability plugin inspired by *The Boys*. Players drink experimental serums to roll for super powers — from flight and heat vision to a one-shot chest beam that vaporizes anyone in its path. Every ability has real controls, real cooldowns, and real consequences.
🧪 Drink. Pray. Survive. 🧪
--- ## 🧪 The Serums | Serum | Color | What it does | | :-: | :-: | :-- | | **Compound V** | 💙 | The classic. Random ability, permanent until death. Heroes are extremely rare. | | **Temp V** | 💚 | A weaker, time-limited dose. Power fades after a configurable duration. | | **V One** | 🩵 | The refined formula. Only rolls top-tier abilities. | | **Anti V** | ❤️ | The cure. Drink to remove your current ability. | | **V-Null Virus** | 🟣 | A bio-weapon. Infects and strips abilities from any supe it hits. Splash & lingering variants available. | All serums are crafted step-by-step at the **workbench**. Type `/cv tutorial` to receive the full in-game crafting handbook. > **Right-click** a bottle to drink. After a short activation, your power is unlocked. --- ## 🦸 The Abilities
🔴 The Patriot — like Homelander
The face of Vought. Untouchable, arrogant, absolutely lethal. **Compound V's rarest roll** — the **V One variant** is even stronger. - ✈️ **Permanent flight** — automatic, no toggle - 🔥 **Heat Vision** — press **F** to toggle a high-damage eye beam with overheat system - 👁️ **X-Ray** — **Sneak + Right-Click** to reveal nearby entities through walls - 🚀 **Jump Start** — **Sneak**, look up, then **Jump** to launch yourself skyward - 💥 **Sonic Boom Landing** — fall from 30+ blocks for a devastating impact explosion - 💪 Permanent **Strength III**, **Resistance II**, **Regeneration** & **+10 bonus hearts** > 🩸 *V One variant adds Strength IV, Resistance III, fire resistance, faster flight and a stronger Jump Start.*
🟡 The Veteran — like Soldier Boy  ·  V One exclusive
The original supe. Pissed off, off the grid, and packing nuclear-grade firepower in his chest. - 💪 Passive **Strength V** and **Resistance III** - ☢️ **Chest Beam** — **Sneak + Right-Click** to fire a thick yellow energy beam for 3 seconds - Tears through blocks · ignites everything it touches · melts players and mobs - **Strips abilities from any supe it hits** — *yes, even another Patriot* - 💥 **Ground Zero** — releases a massive visual shockwave on cast - ⏳ 45 second cooldown — use it wisely
🌊 The Diver — like The Deep
- 🐬 Extreme underwater speed with Dolphin's Grace and water-only movement boost - 📡 **Sonar** — **Sneak + Right-Click** to reveal nearby entities through terrain - ⚔️ Bonus Strength and Resistance while submerged
🏃 The Runner — like A-Train
- ⚡ Speed stages scaling to top velocity — press **F** to toggle - 💥 High-speed impact damage on collision with entities - 🧊 Special movement bonuses when sprinting over water
👻 The Ghost — like Translucent
- Press **F** — activates Ghost Mode (**Invisibility II** + Resistance + Strength) - 🔥 Passive **Fire Resistance** - 🛡️ Immune to Heat Vision damage while invisible - 🐺 Active mobs drop targeting while Ghost Mode is on - ⏱️ 5 second toggle cooldown
🔥 Heat Vision I / II / III / IV
Four separately rollable tiers. Color indicates tier: blue → green → orange → red. - Press **F** to toggle - **Overheat system** — extended use triggers a cooldown; toggle off early to reset the timer - Cooks raw mob drops on kill · clears vegetation in the beam path
🔵 Sonic Boom — like Bombsight  ·  V One exclusive
- 💪 Passive Strength IV, Resistance IV, **+10 bonus hearts**, projectile immunity - ✈️ Electric flight at 3× speed with a powerful jump start - **Sneak + Left-Click** — fires a **Sonic Beam** (Warden-style, 3s cooldown) - Press **F** — launches a **Sonic Ring** (30s cooldown) with knockback and area damage - 💥 Explosive landing from height (30s cooldown)
⚡ Stormstrike — like Stormfront  ·  V One exclusive
- 💪 Passive Strength, Resistance and extra hearts - ✈️ Electric flight with lightning jump-start particles - Press **F** — toggles a **lightning beam** dealing tick damage in a wide arc - Melee hits trigger **real lightning strikes** on the target - Fall impact summons **4 visible lightning effects**
💛 Heal Angel — like Private Angel  ·  V One exclusive
- 💪 Passive Strength II, Resistance II, Regeneration II, **+5 bonus hearts** - **Sneak + Left-Click** — heals a nearby entity (min 1 heart, 1s cooldown) - Press **F** — **commands** a nearby mob to follow and protect you (they won't attack their owner)
🌊 Submarine — like Submarine  ·  V One exclusive
A supercharged aquatic fighter — The Diver's true evolution. - 💪 Doubled Strength and Resistance bonuses while submerged - **Sneak + Left-Click** — extended **Sonar** pulse revealing entities through terrain - Press **F** — powerful **Riptide Dash** (1s cooldown) for underwater mobility
🦘 Jumper
- 💪 Passive Strength I - Press **F** — **Jump Boost V** + temporary fall damage immunity - ⏱️ 15 second cooldown
💥 Shockwave
- 💪 Passive Strength II, Resistance I - Press **F** — 10-block pressure wave, heavy knockback (3 hearts vs players, 6 vs mobs) - ⚡ Critical hits automatically trigger mini shockwaves - ⏱️ 2 minute cooldown
🪱 The Worm
- ⛏️ Permanent **Haste IV** — mine through anything instantly - Press **F** — toggle **Night Vision** - 💪 Passive Strength I, Resistance I
💡 Flash Light — like Starlight
- 💪 Passive Strength II, Resistance I - Press **F** — **15-block Blindness burst** hitting all nearby entities - **Sneak + Left-Click** — focused **light beam attack**
🔥 FireSonic
- 🔥 Passive Fire Resistance, Strength I, Resistance I - Press **F** — toggles a close-range **fire beam** dealing tick damage - Melee hits apply fire pressure on every hit
☠️ Toxic Cloud
- 🧪 Permanent **Poison Immunity** - Press **F** — releases a **poison gas cloud** around you - **Sneak + Left-Click** — short-range **poison vomit** targeting entities ahead
🔥 The Countess — like Crimson Countess
- 🔥 Passive Fire Resistance, Strength II, Resistance I · flight enabled - Press **F** — launches a **fireball** - Double jump mid-air activates a **fire jump boost** - Melee hits apply burn damage
⚔️ The Warrior — like Queen Maeve
- 💪 Passive Strength III, Resistance II, Regeneration I, **+10 bonus hearts** · flight enabled - Double jump available mid-air - Landing from height triggers a **small shockwave**
💀 The Headpopper — like Victoria Neuman
- 💪 Passive Strength II, Resistance II, Regeneration I - **Sneak + Right-Click** — locks a red mark on the target; hold Sneak to trigger a countdown and deal heavy damage (release Sneak to cancel) - Press **F** — area pulse hitting all nearby entities - 🛡️ Immune to Heat Vision damage
🕷️ SpiderWeaver — like WebWeaver
- 💪 Passive Strength I, Resistance I, Regeneration I - Press **F** — fires a **web projectile** trapping entities in cobwebs - **Sneak + Left-Click** — places a **cobweb trap** at your location - 🧗 **Wall Climbing** — hold Sneak while touching a wall
💣 The Detonator — like Naqib
- 🔥 Passive Fire Resistance, Strength II, Resistance I - **Sneak (hold)** — charges a countdown, then releases a **large self-centered explosion** (self-damage protection active) - Every **3rd melee hit** triggers an **explosive strike** - Melee hits apply fire damage
📏 Size Changer
- **Sneak + Left-Click looking up** → Giant form (+10 hearts, doubled melee, Jump Boost II) - **Sneak + Left-Click looking down** → Tiny form (~3.5× smaller) - Cooldown starts after returning to normal size - **V One upgrade** available with stronger bonuses
🌀 Teleporter
Short-range blink ability. **V One upgrade** available for longer range and reduced cooldown.
✈️ Flight  ·  ⚡ Speedster  ·  💪 Super Strength  ·  ♨️ Fire  ·  👁️ Vision
Classic standalone powers. - **Flight** — Permanent creative-style flight with a basic Jump Start - **Speedster** — Toggle Speed IV · sprint Resistance bonus - **Super Strength** — Passive Strength III + Resistance. No cooldown. You just hit harder. Forever. - **Fire** — Passive ring of fire ignites nearby enemies · Fire Resistance included - **Vision** — **Sneak + Right-Click** to reveal entities through walls with a glowing effect
--- ## 🎮 Abilities Showcase Heat Vision — press F, melt everything The Veteran's Chest Beam — nuclear option, ability-stripping The Patriot's Jump Start — launch yourself skyward --- ## 🎮 Controls Cheat Sheet | Action | Input | | :-- | :-: | | Toggle ability (Heat Vision, Ghost Mode, beams…) | **F** *(swap offhand)* | | Secondary / special attack | **Sneak + Left-Click** | | Special 2 / X-Ray / Chest Beam / charge | **Sneak + Right-Click** | | Jump Start | **Sneak + look up + Jump** | | Double Jump | **Jump** mid-air | | Wall Climb *(SpiderWeaver)* | **Sneak** on a wall | | Drink serum | **Right-Click** bottle | > 📖 Run `/cv tutorial` in-game to receive a full written handbook with every crafting chain and control reference. --- ## 📋 Commands & Permissions
📜 Commands
Main command: `/compoundv` — alias: `/cv` | Command | Description | | :-- | :-- | | `/cv help` | Show the in-game help | | `/cv info [player]` | View your own or another player's active ability | | `/cv tutorial` | Receive the in-game crafting & ability handbook *(aliases: `/cv guide`, `/cv book`)* | | `/cv give bottle ` | Give a serum bottle | | `/cv give [potionType]` | Directly assign an ability | | `/cv remove ` | Strip a player's ability | | `/cv reload` | Reload config and language files |
🔑 Permissions
| Permission | Default | Description | | :-- | :-: | :-- | | `compoundv.use` | `true` | Drink serums and use abilities | | `compoundv.admin` | `op` | Use all `/cv` admin commands |
--- ## 🌍 Languages English, German, Spanish, French, Hindi and Russian ship out of the box. Set `language: en` (or `de`, `es`, `fr`, `hi`, `ru`) in `config.yml`. Drop a custom file into `plugins/CompoundV/lang/` to add more. --- ## ❓ FAQ
💀 What happens when I die with an ability?
By default, you lose it. Same risk Vought's heroes never had — and exactly what makes serums valuable and PvP genuinely tense.
⏱️ How long do Temp V abilities last?
The duration is rolled per drink between `min_duration_minutes` and `max_duration_minutes` (default: 15–120 min). When the timer runs out, the ability fades automatically.
🎲 Why is The Patriot so rare?
By design. Default weight is `1` against a combined pool of 100+. Tweak the weight in `config.yml` if you want him more common.
🔧 Can I disable abilities or change roll chances?
Yes. Set any ability's chance to `0` in `config.yml` to disable it, or adjust the number to influence roll frequency. Run `/cv reload` to apply without restart.
🧪 Can two players have the same ability at the same time?
Yes. Every drink rolls independently — there's no global lock. Two Patriots on one server? That's a tournament.
---

title: Lobby4PvP
description: Enables interactive PvP in your lobby by simply holding a sword — safe, visual, and fully customizable with VIP gear, stats, and PlaceholderAPI support.
body:
# ⚔️ Lobby4PvP — Interactive Lobby PvP System A modern and lightweight PvP system designed for hubs and lobbies. Lobby4PvP lets players enable PvP simply by holding a sword — no commands, no menus, just pure interaction. When the sword is held, players automatically enter PvP mode and receive configurable armor, sounds, and effects. Once released, PvP disables safely after a short delay, returning the player to lobby mode. Everything is handled cleanly, with no duplication issues, plugin conflicts, or item loss. --- ## ✨ Main Features - **Interactive activation:** Enable PvP instantly by holding your sword. - **VIP profiles:** Custom weapons and armor for VIP players. - **Anti-duplication:** Fully protected against exploits and ghost items. - **Visual feedback:** ActionBar, BossBar, and chat notifications perfectly synced. - **Persistent stats:** Kills, deaths, hits, and KDR stored safely in `stats.yml`. - **Config reload:** `/lobby4pvp reload` refreshes all settings live — safely. - **Conflict override:** Works seamlessly with WorldGuard, Essentials, PvPManager, and CombatLogX. - **PlaceholderAPI support:** Full integration for scoreboards and tablists. - **bStats metrics:** Anonymous statistics (ID 27655). --- ## 🔌 PlaceholderAPI Integration Lobby4PvP includes full support for **PlaceholderAPI**, allowing you to display player PvP data anywhere — in scoreboards, holograms, menus, or tablists. All placeholders are automatically registered when the plugin detects PlaceholderAPI at startup. ### Available Placeholders | Placeholder | Description | |--------------|-------------| | `%lobby4pvp_status%` | Shows whether the player currently has PvP mode enabled or disabled. | | `%lobby4pvp_cooldown%` | Displays the remaining cooldown time before PvP can be re-enabled. | | `%lobby4pvp_kills%` | Shows the player’s total kills in the lobby. | | `%lobby4pvp_deaths%` | Shows the player’s total deaths in the lobby. | | `%lobby4pvp_hits%` | Displays how many successful hits the player has landed. | | `%lobby4pvp_kdr%` | Displays the player’s kill/death ratio (KDR). | | `%lobby4pvp_vip%` | Returns `true` or `false` depending on VIP status. | | `%lobby4pvp_version%` | Displays the current Lobby4PvP plugin version. | ### Example usage If your scoreboard or hologram plugin supports PlaceholderAPI (such as TAB, AjLeaderboards, DecentHolograms, etc.), you can directly use these placeholders. --- ## ⚙️ Commands & Permissions | Command | Description | Permission | |----------|--------------|-------------| | `/lobby4pvp` | Display plugin info | `lobby4pvp.info` | | `/lobby4pvp reload` | Reload the configuration | `lobby4pvp.reload` | | *(VIP gear)* | Access VIP sword and armor | `lobby4pvp.vip` | --- ## 💻 Compatibility & Config
config.yml 

# ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║                        Lobby4PvP — v1.8.6                            ║
# ║  Enable PvP in your lobby by holding a sword. Safe, robust, fast.    ║
# ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
#  QUICK HELP:
#  • Reload everything live: /lobby4pvp reload
#  • Text supports both legacy '&' colors and MiniMessage
#  • Hotbar slots are 0..8 (0 = far left, 8 = far right)
#  • Java 17+ plugin build; latest Paper 26.1.x servers require Java 25 at runtime
#  • Invalid sounds, particles, materials, enchantments or out-of-range values warn in console and use safe runtime fallbacks
#  • Empty lore lines like "" are valid and kept as intentional spacing
#
#  REFERENCES:
#  • Materials    → https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/Material.html
#  • Sounds       → https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/Sound.html
#  • Particles    → https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/Particle.html
#  • Enchantments → https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/enchantments/Enchantment.html
#
#  NOTE ABOUT STATS:
#  • Player stats (kills, deaths, hits) are stored persistently in 'stats.yml'.
#  • No configuration is required; the file is created and maintained automatically.
#

# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ Core & Safety                                                       │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
debug: false                        # Extra console logs (useful for diagnosing conflicts)
check-for-updates: true             # Notify in console if a new version is available
keep-inventory-on-death: true       # Prevent drops/exp on death in the lobby (safe duels)

# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ PvP Policy (scope & override)                                       │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
pvp:
  override-others: true             # If true, Lobby4PvP can un-cancel other plugins' PvP blocks
                                    # when BOTH players are in Lobby4PvP mode.
  worlds: ["*"]                     # Where this plugin applies. ["*"] = all worlds.
                                    # Example: ["lobby", "hub1"]
  blocked-message: "&cPvP is blocked here."
                                    # Shown to the attacker when damage is denied by policy.
                                    # Supports legacy '&' colors and MiniMessage.

# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ Timers (seconds)                                                    │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
timers:
  activate-seconds: 5               # Hold the sword for X seconds to enter PvP mode
  deactivate-seconds: 10            # After releasing the sword, PvP disables after X seconds
  cooldown-seconds: 0               # Wait time before enabling again (0 = off)

# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ Display (all channels are consistent)                               │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
display:
  actionbar: true                   # Show progress/status in the action bar
  bossbar: false                    # Show progress/status in a BossBar
  chat: true                        # Also print clean, non-spam chat messages
  bossbar-color: GREEN              # GREEN, BLUE, RED, PURPLE, PINK, WHITE, YELLOW
  bossbar-style: SOLID              # SOLID, SEGMENTED_6, SEGMENTED_10, SEGMENTED_12, SEGMENTED_20

# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ Default Sword (non-VIP profile)                                     │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
sword:
  give-on-join: true                # Give players the lobby sword on join
  slot: 2                           # Desired hotbar slot (0..8)
  material: IRON_SWORD              # Any valid Bukkit material
  display-name: "&aLobby Sword"
  lore:
    - ""
    - "&8-----------------------"
    - "&oHold to enable PvP"
    - "&oFun & safe duels in the lobby!"
    - "&8-----------------------"
  lock: true                        # Prevent moving/dropping plugin items (anti-dup)
  enchantments:
    - SHARPNESS:4
    - UNBREAKING:4

# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ Default Armor (auto-equipped while PvP is ACTIVE)                   │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
armor:
  helmet:
    material: IRON_HELMET
    display-name: "&aLobby Helmet"
    lore: []
    enchantments: ["PROTECTION_ENVIRONMENTAL:3"]
  chestplate:
    material: IRON_CHESTPLATE
    display-name: "&aLobby Chestplate"
    lore: []
    enchantments: ["PROTECTION_ENVIRONMENTAL:3"]
  leggings:
    material: IRON_LEGGINGS
    display-name: "&aLobby Leggings"
    lore: []
    enchantments: ["PROTECTION_ENVIRONMENTAL:3"]
  boots:
    material: IRON_BOOTS
    display-name: "&aLobby Boots"
    lore: []
    enchantments: ["PROTECTION_FALL:4"]

# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ VIP Profile (permission: lobby4pvp.vip)                             │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
vip:
  enabled: true
  permission: lobby4pvp.vip

  sword:
    enabled: true                   # If false, VIPs use the default sword profile
    slot: 2                         # Desired slot for VIP sword (can differ from non-VIP)
    material: DIAMOND_SWORD
    display-name: "&bVIP Lobby Sword"
    lore:
      - ""
      - "&8-----------------------"
      - "&oExclusive VIP sword"
      - "&oHold to enable PvP"
      - "&8-----------------------"
    enchantments:
      - SHARPNESS:5
      - UNBREAKING:3

  armor:
    helmet:
      material: DIAMOND_HELMET
      display-name: "&bVIP Helmet"
      lore: []
      enchantments: ["PROTECTION_ENVIRONMENTAL:4", "UNBREAKING:3"]
    chestplate:
      material: DIAMOND_CHESTPLATE
      display-name: "&bVIP Chestplate"
      lore: []
      enchantments: ["PROTECTION_ENVIRONMENTAL:4"]
    leggings:
      material: DIAMOND_LEGGINGS
      display-name: "&bVIP Leggings"
      lore: []
      enchantments: ["PROTECTION_ENVIRONMENTAL:4"]
    boots:
      material: DIAMOND_BOOTS
      display-name: "&bVIP Boots"
      lore: []
      enchantments: ["PROTECTION_FALL:4", "DEPTH_STRIDER:3"]

# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ Item Flags                                                          │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
items:
  unbreakable: true                 # Make all plugin items unbreakable

# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ Effects                                                             │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
fx:
  sound: ENTITY_PLAYER_LEVELUP      # Played when enabling PvP
  particle: CRIT_MAGIC              # Spawned around the player when enabling PvP
  disable-sound: ENTITY_ITEM_PICKUP # Played when disabling PvP
  disable-particle: CRIT            # Spawned around the player when disabling PvP

# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ Kill Celebration                                                    │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
kill-firework:
  enabled: true
  power: 1                          # 1..4 (higher = higher flight)
# Safe-state recovery applied when PvP is manually disabled
safe-state:
  auto-heal:
    enabled: true
    health: 20.0                    # Clamped to the player's max health
  auto-feed:
    enabled: true
    food-level: 20                  # 0..20
    saturation: 0.0                 # 0.0..20.0

# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ Messages (supports '&' colors and MiniMessage)                      │
# │ {seconds} is dynamically replaced                                   │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
messages:
  prefix: "&aLobby4PvP &8» "
  enable: "&a&lPvP mode enabled.&r &7Prepare for battle."
  disable: "&7PvP mode disabled. You are now safe."
  hold: "&7Hold your sword for &f{seconds}s &7to enable &aPvP mode&7."
  already-active: "&7PvP mode is already active."
  deactivate-progress: "&7PvP mode will disable in &f{seconds}s&7."
  deactivate-cancelled: "&7Deactivation cancelled."
  cooldown: "&7Wait &f{seconds}s &7before enabling &aPvP mode&7 again."
  world-pvp-disabled: "&cWorld PvP is globally disabled here. Lobby4PvP cannot enable combat in this world."

# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ PlaceholderAPI formatting                                           │
# │ Optional visual wrappers for numeric stats (use {value})            │
# │ Supports legacy '&' colors and MiniMessage                          │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
placeholders:
  status:
    enabled: "&aenabled"
    disabled: "&cdisabled"
  vip:
    true: "&btrue"
    false: "&7false"
  stats:
    kills: "&6⚔ {value}"
    deaths: "&c✖ {value}"
    hits: "&e☄ {value}"
    kdr: "&aKDR: {value}"
- **Minecraft:** 1.18 → 26.1+ - **Java:** 17 or higher - **Supported Loaders:** Paper, Spigot, Purpur, Bukkit *(partial)* - **Dependencies:** PlaceholderAPI (necessary), bStats (included) --- ## ❤️ Designed for performance Lobby4PvP was built to deliver a clean, lag-free lobby PvP experience. It runs efficiently on modern Paper servers, automatically detects PvP conflicts, and adapts smoothly to configuration changes. Simple to install, safe to use, and ready for your next network. ⚔️ [![Need Help? Join Discord](https://i.ibb.co/5hrnQqFF/discordsupportbanner-1.png)](https://discord.gg/cyBKzJ78gA)

title: create: nuclear industry
description: a create addon that adds realist fully simulated atom physics for nuclear reactors
body:
# Create: Nuclear Industrys 
is a Create addon that adds nuclear fission to Minecraft. it simulates all radation particals in real time using raytracing for 100% realism, along with 1000% more custimizablity, at least compared to a diffrent create addon that i cant name.

---

  
###  Whats in it?
  
  **Uranium Ore:**  spawns underground. Mine it and process it into Enriched Uranium.
  
  **Uranium Fuel Rods:**  the core of your reactor. Place them together and they start a chain reaction,
  absorbing radiation from each other and building heat. They glow brighter as they get hotter.
  if you let them overheat and they melt down the and explosion scales with how many rods are nearby,
  and it'll cascade into the rest of your reactor.
  
  **Boron Control Rods:**  absorb radiation particles and slow the reaction down.
  Put them next to your fuel rods if you don't want things to go wrong. 
  
  **Heat Pipes:**  move heat from your reactor to everywhere else and geneators and helps stablize the reactor.
  
  **Thermal Generator:**  connects to the heat network and outputs a Create shaft.
  Needs water pumped in via fluid pipes. Converts it to steam after and, if you got no water, you got no power.
  
  **Heat Gauge:**  reads the temperature of the heat network it's placed in.
  it can output a redstone signal proportional to heat (0–15 at 0–1000 c) 
  also works with display link to show the temperature.
  
  ---
  
  Radiation is simulated as actual particles bounce through the world.
  they bounce off walls and get absorbed by different materials, and give you radiation Sickness if they hit you.
  Boron rods absorbs the most. everything else does a little, and Iron does nothing (it reflects everything)

  ---

description: This plug-in can create and delete transmission points through instructions, and has a more convenient gui to display its own transmission points.
body:
## Features

- ✅ **GUI Interface** - Beautiful graphical interface with pagination support
- ✅ **Command System** - Complete command support for creating, deleting, and listing teleport points
- ✅ **Configuration File** - Fully customizable configuration including messages, delays, and GUI settings
- ✅ **Hot Reload** - Reload configuration without server restart
- ✅ **Teleport Delay** - Configurable teleport delay with movement cancellation
- ✅ **Permission System** - Complete permission node support
- ✅ **Clean Code** - Follows Java coding standards with clear structure

## Installation

1. Ensure your server is running Spigot 1.21.5
2. Copy the generated `SetHome-1.0.0.jar` to your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart the server or use `/reload` command
4. Edit `plugins/SetHome/config.yml` to customize settings

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/sethome gui` | Open teleport points GUI | `sethome.use` |
| `/sethome create <name>` | Create teleport point at current location | `sethome.create` |
| `/sethome delete <name>` | Delete specified teleport point | `sethome.delete` |
| `/sethome list` | List all teleport points | `sethome.use` |
| `/sethome reload` | Reload configuration file | `sethome.reload` |

Aliases: `/sh`, `/home`

## Permissions

- `sethome.use` - Use teleport function (default: all players)
- `sethome.create` - Create teleport points (default: all players)
- `sethome.delete` - Delete teleport points (default: all players)
- `sethome.reload` - Reload configuration (default: OP)
- `sethome.admin` - Administrator permission (includes all permissions)

## Configuration

The configuration file is located at `plugins/SetHome/config.yml` and supports customization of:

- Plugin prefix and messages
- Teleport delay time
- Require standing still option
- GUI title and size
- All prompt messages

Use `/sethome reload` after modifying the configuration.

# Spectrum Outline EntzuMC

Upgrade your block highlights with vibrant moving colors and a sleek modern style.

---

## ✨ Features
- 🌈 Animated spectrum outlines  
- 🔄 Flowing color loop around edges  
- 🎨 Custom color mode  
- 📏 Adjustable thickness  
- ⚡ Lightweight & optimized  
- 🧩 Vanilla shader based  

Perfect for PvP, building and cinematic gameplay.

---

## 🖥 Compatibility
✔ Minecraft **1.21.x**  
✔ Vanilla  
✔ Iris  
✔ Sodium  
✔ OptiFine

---

## 📦 Installation
1. Download the pack  
2. Move it to `.minecraft/resourcepacks`  
3. Activate it in game  

---

## ❤️ Credits
Created by **EntzuMC**



# ⚙️ Configuration Guide  
Spectrum Outline EntzuMC

All visual effects can be customized directly inside the shader files.

No extra mods or menus required — just edit a few lines.

---

## 📂 Where to edit
Open the pack and go to:

assets/minecraft/shaders/core/

You will find:

- `rendertype_lines.vsh`
- `rendertype_lines.fsh`

At the top of both files you will see the configuration panel.

---

## 🎮 Changing the Mode

Find this line in **both files**:

#define MODE RAINBOW_LOOP

Replace `RAINBOW_LOOP` with one of these:

- `VANILLA` → Default Minecraft outline  
- `RAINBOW_FADE` → Smooth animated color shift  
- `RAINBOW_LOOP` → Colors travel around the edges  
- `CUSTOM` → Uses your selected color  
![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b597339e28a9d42f745b1988813036d210ea004f.png)

⚠️ The mode must match in both files.

---

## 📏 Changing the Thickness

In `rendertype_lines.vsh`:

#define THICKNESS 2.5

Examples:
- `1.0` → vanilla  
- `2.0` → slightly thicker  
- `3.0` → bold  
- `4.0+` → very thick  

---

## 🎨 Custom Color Mode

If you use:

#define MODE CUSTOM

Change this in `rendertype_lines.fsh`:

#define CUSTOM_COLOR vec4(0.2, 0.8, 1.0, 1.0)

Format:
vec4(R, G, B, A)

Values go from **0.0 to 1.0**.

Examples:

White:
vec4(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0)

Red:
vec4(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0)

Purple:
vec4(0.7, 0.2, 1.0, 1.0)

---

## 🌈 Changing Rainbow Speed

#define SPEED 2000.0

Higher = faster  
Lower = slower  

---

## 🔁 Direction

#define DIRECTION 1.0

- `1.0` → normal  
- `-1.0` → reverse  

---

## 🎚 Smooth Transitions

#define SMOOTH true

- `true` → soft gradient  
- `false` → hard color steps  

---

## 💡 Tips

✔ Restart Minecraft after editing  
✔ Use CUSTOM mode for quick testing  
✔ If nothing changes → make sure both files match  

---

Enjoy your personalized outlines 🔥

title: Sniffer Reimagined
description: Adds new features to make the Sniffer more interesting.
body:
# Description

Sniffer Reimagined is a mod that aims to make the Sniffer more interesting. It does this by adding more items Sniffers can find, including new farming, fishing, and crafting items. Additionally, four Sniffer variants have been added to the game, all obtainable by hatching a Sniffer Egg in specific biomes. Try to collect them all in your world!

# Additional Sniffer Drops

![new diggable items list](https://i.imgur.com/zeFGMrM.png)

Sniffers can now dig up:

- Red & Brown Mushrooms
- Iron Root
- Worm

## Iron Root

The Iron Root is a new item that can be smelted into an Iron Ingot using a furnace or blast furnace. This allows for Sniffers to be used to make simple iron farms.

## Worm

Worms are a new addition that have many uses. They can be fed to certain mobs, including Sniffers, Chickens, Frogs, Turtles, and Axolotls. Worms can also be used in Composters to create bone meal.

### Farming

![enriched farmland](https://i.imgur.com/nXmfOeI.png)

There is a 40% chance that right-clicking a worm on farmland will convert it into Enriched Farmland. Enriched Farmland grows your crops faster than traditional farmland, making your farms more productive.

### Fishing

![applying worm as bait in inventory](https://i.imgur.com/fuKEXIA.png)

You can pick up the worm in your inventory and left-click on a fishing rod to attach it as bait. Doing this makes fishing much faster. By default, worms reduce the time to catch a fish by 15 seconds. This also stacks with enchantments such as [Lure](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Lure).

# Nether Sniffer Drops

![nether sniffer diggable items list](https://i.imgur.com/H9DSR9k.png)

Sniffer Reimagined also introduces two Nether variants to Sniffers. These variants are the Crimson & Warped Sniffer. Sniffers hatched in the Nether can dig up:

- Crimson & Warped Mushrooms
- Nether Wart
- Gold Root
- Ghast Tear
- Blaze Rod
- Skeleton Skull Fragments

## Gold Root

The Gold Root is a new item that can be smelted into a Gold Ingot using a furnace or blast furnace. This allows you to use Nether Sniffers to make simple gold farms.

## Skeleton Skull Fragments

The Skeleton Skull Fragment and Wither Skeleton Skull Fragment are new items found by Sniffers hatched in the Nether. Using nine of these fragments in a crafting grid can craft a skull of its respective type. This offers an alternative to farming skulls and introduces a viable method for peaceful mode players.

# Other Variants

In total, there are 5 Sniffer Variants. These variants are:

- Default
- Cherry
- Cold
- Warped
- Crimson

## Cherry Sniffer

![cherry sniffer](https://i.imgur.com/otFca4r.png)

The Cherry Sniffer can be obtained by hatching a Sniffer Egg in a Cherry Grove.

## Cold Sniffer

![cold sniffer](https://i.imgur.com/xqqPw04.png)

The Cold Sniffer can be obtained by hatching a Sniffer Egg in a snowy or icy biome.

## Warped Sniffer

![warped sniffer](https://i.imgur.com/ZjqWJFW.png)

The Warped Sniffer can be obtained by hatching a Sniffer Egg in a Warped Forest.

## Crimson Sniffer

The Crimson Sniffer can be obtained by hatching a Sniffer Egg anywhere in the Nether (outside of a Warped Forest).

# Additional Tweaks

- Wandering Traders can now sell Sniffer Eggs
- Sniffers no longer have an eight-minute cooldown for sniffing items
- Sniffers now can dig up loot in places they've already searched

# Credits

Much thanks to [Torrezx](https://modrinth.com/user/Torrezx) for permitting the use of textures from the [Biome Sniffers](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/torrezx-biome-sniffers) resource pack!

title: Stay put! [door waxing]
description: A simple mod which adds the ability to wax doors, trapdoors and fence gates to freeze them in their current state.
body:
'Stay put!' is a simple and compatible mod, which adds the ability to wax doors, trapdoors and fence gates, similar to signs.

### What it does:
This mod adds the ability to be 'waxed' to all doors, including trapdoors and fence-doors. Once one of these blocks is waxed it is fixed in its current position, until it gets broken. To wax a door simply right-click on it with a piece of honeycomb, like how you would wax a block of copper.

### Why?
The main reason that I created this mod was because I got annoyed that I kept flicking doors and trapdoors that were placed for decoration. This mod adds a way to prevent this minor annoyance, hopefully making your game a little bit better :-)

### Iron doors?
Once a door is waxed, thats it. It can no longer be opened or closed at all, even by redstone. This allows you to fix things like iron trapdoors in their open position without needing to be powered, allowing for greater flexibility in building and decorating in survival.

### Copper doors?
Copper doors have been given special treatment, as they can already be waxed with honeycomb in vanilla (though with different purpose). As a simple work-around, waxed copper doors may now be 'double-waxed' in order to fix their state.

### Compatibility
The mod should be compatible with almost every mod, so long as they extend the vanilla blocks. If they for some reason do not do that, then special compatibility can be added. :-)


##### No ai was used in the development of this mod!

title: Throw Your Axes
description: This mod allows you to throw your axes.
body:
### Anyone who is still on v1.0.0, please update to v1.0.1 otherwise your anvil isn't gonna work.

# Description
**This mod allows you to throw your axes.**

## Usage
When your attack is _**not** on cooldown_, you can **hold** the **use** button to **charge**, and **release** it to **throw**.

The **longer** you charge, the **faster** it travels, and deals **60%~150%** of the axe's damage.

Each throw consumes **1 durability**. 

You can see the axe's outline within **5 blocks**.

## Attribute
**A new attribute is added for one of the enchantments.**

### Vulnerability
This attribute **increases** all damage taken by the entity.

## Enchantments
**This mod adds 5 new enchantments to enhance the throw. Unless otherwise stated, the enchantments only apply to axes.**

### Bonding (Max Level I)
You can see the axe's **outline** within **40 blocks**, and your movement speed is **increased** by **15%** when you are moving **towards** it.

If you stop moving towards it, the speed boost will gradually **decay** over **1 second**.

***

### Impact (Max Level IV)
After hitting an entity with a **thrown** axe, the entity will suffer from **6/9/12/15%** **slowness** and **12/16/20/24% vulnerability** for **8 seconds**.

If the axe misses and hits an object, entities within **8** blocks from the axe will suffer from **half** of the slowness for **4** seconds.

***

### Well Prepared (Max Level V)
The axe gains **2/3/4/5/6 tokens**. Every time you throw your axe, a **token** will be **consumed** and you will **not** lose your axe.

After **picking up** an axe thrown by this enchantment, the corresponding axe **recovers** a token.

**Incompatible with Mending**

***

### Mastery (Max Level III)
The time required to charge up to the **throwing threshold** and b are both reduced by **0.05/0.1/0.15** seconds.

You can start charging when your **attack cooldown** reaches **80/65/50%**. The **charge slowness penalty** is **reduced** by **20/35/50%**.

Your axe will only lose 1 durability when it's used as a melee weapon.

***

### Sniping (Max Level III)
**Applies to:** Ranged weapons  
**Description:** When you shoot or throw a projectile and hit an entity outside 15 blocks, the longer the distance between the shoot/throw position and the hit position is, the more damage the projectile deals.  

# Dependency
- [Timed Modifiers API (required)](https://modrinth.com/project/UsIu1tnt)
- [DuskyWisp's Library (required)](https://modrinth.com/mod/duskywisps-library)

# MISC
Please report any bugs to **Github** or this **email address**: heinok.chow@gmail.com

The **compatibility** between this mod and other mods are **not** tested.

You can **only** throw axes, sorry, I only feel like doing throwable axes for now. Or maybe swords on a good day, we'll see.

This mod will **not** be backported to **older** versions until I finally figure out how the rendering works. 

This mod is currently for **Fabric** only.

title: XMod Additions XL
description: A collection of additions made to give unloved items more use, bolster lackluster aspects, and use unique quirks as inspiration for new features in this Vanilla expansion! Think of it as sprinkling a little zest and flavor over every aspect of the game :D
body:
![mod overview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c907e9bfff72a541edf57432ced2247bf67ffe35.png)

_Nether brick is the only stone type that has fences... why aren't there any wood types with walls?_
_Why are saddles only ontained through loot tables?_
_Why is there a Hell, but not a Heaven?_
_Why is redstone so extensive, but inventory management so limited?_
_Why is the game bloated with so many items that only have a single use?_

These questions and more are what prompted the creation of this pack!

# Welcome to XMod Additions XL

[GitHub Repo for bug reports, reviews, and more!](https://github.com/revisiony2k-debug/XMod-Additions-XL)

[MMC Reviews](https://mmcreviews.com/all/mods/xmod-additions-xl/)

This mod brings with it a series of improvements, addons, and features to the Vanilla Minecraft experience, including the revival of recipes that used to exist, imaginative new items and blocks to bring some added life and variety to existing areas, and even a whole new dimension!
Think of it as a Vanilla+ expansion, rather than a mod with a core central theme. I've been working on it on and off for a couple of years, and I am rather pleased to finally publish it. I will not be explaining every minute detail, as I feel leaving some mystery is good fun, but I will be doing my best to explain everything that is needed to get a good experience out of this pack, with or without helper mods like JEI. So, without further ado, let's jump right in!

## Blocks
Starting with the basics, let's talk about all the various blocks that have been added to the game. There's a lot to get through so I will try to categorize them into groups for discussion.

### Wood Types
![Wood Types](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/23e8f2af5c5a8a7d9502d6a8497ca0c60eb7fae2.png)
Here are all of the new wood types added to the game. All of them can be found in various new biomes and each has something unique about them. From left to right they are as follows:
- Rosetta. This dark-log pink-plank wood type is the most standard wood type added into the game. It can be found growing in the Cloud Tundra.
- Enlightened Timber. This saturated green wood type is another standard wood type found in the Ethereal Hills.
- Hardwood. This is a very odd wood type that has some unique recipes and block choices. It is found in the Spoopy Forests. Breaking it does not drop logs, but instead drops _Hardwood Chunks_, which can be used to craft the various Hardwood Planks recipes.
- Rotten Wood. This wood type speaks for itself, can only be found in the Deadlands, and is incapable of sustaining plants.

**NOTE that all custom trees you see in this mod cannot be replanted, making the quantities of these new types a distinctly finite resource that must be explored for.**

Hardwood Planks Recipe

![Hardwood Planks Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ac778055ed4a2799eef8f89f22ab04cbc91b37b.png)

Additional Hardwood Recipes

![Hardwood Planks Stonecutter Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a7023e1595b367d9102441c66602c13f24d568ce.png)

Rotten Planks Recipe

![Rotten Planks Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/506a3d08046a91999dd20f4f294bf481b368dfe1.png)

Rotten Wood Fence Recipe

![Rotten Wood Fence Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3bd916b1d48282bfa0d0860f9fe32030b8cef463.png)

Rotten Wood Slab Recipe

![Rotten Planks Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ebf64d63c2dc210dc0e6187afe280fd25f919bde.png)

Rotten Wood Stairs Recipe

![Rotten Wood Stairs Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dddfc9bee76d23ada0fc9075f18d50eda39fad36.png)

Sticks Recipe Using Rotten Planks

![Rotten Wood Sticks Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/40249d2bf1e85b420b46e977d7df55e46fb3baf1.png)

### Terrain Blocks
With multiple new biomes in the mod, there comes with it a lot of new blocks to bring those biomes to life. 99% of these blocks cannot be crafted, barring some specific exceptions. There's a lot to cover, so I'll be brief:

### Function Blocks
Thse blocks that add various useful features and utilities to the world :)

**Recycler**
The Recycler is a useful block that solves the problem of what to do with all of the junk clogging up your system. Normally the solution is to dump it into lava, but then that is quite a waste. Instead, this machine block allows for a very easy way to recycle them into... XP!

![Recycler Powered State](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a10c54308dafccf3535a878b2c572bc9c4a0ee5e.png)

Firstly you want to be sure that the block is enabled, which is done by feeding it a Redstone signal. Then all you need to do is feed into it one of two categories of items via a hopper (or other direct inventory insertion block, depending on what other mods you are using). Those two categories are as follows:
- Stackable items, in a full x64 stack, will be recycled into XP nuggets.
- Non-stackable items will also be recycled into XP nuggets.
**NOTE that there is only a single inventory slot on the machine, so feed items into it with care. Also, items that stack to less than 64 will not be recyclable**

![Recycler In Action](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/72b75cd13e5e5bc07ed12f4385b3b2ede79552e6.png)

## Biomes And Dimensions
In the world of Minecraft, Biomes are the true spice of life. Most of the ones created for this mod were made for the new Dimension, Ethereal, but a couple still ended up in the Overworld as well.

### Overworld

**Deadlands**
This biome is made up of darkened, rough terrain. Filled with coarse dirt, mossy Cobblestone, Dripstone caves, Dungeons, and forests that rot away before your very eyes, it is not a nice place to be. Here is where you will also find the Dying Flower.

![Deadlands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9f48b57167ba84e46d51f185f439b326e8ff4ecb_0.webp)

**Spoopy Forests**
This biome is prety much what it sounds like. Trees made of Hardwood and cobwebs, the ground littereed with Wispyreed and Sticky Grass, eery particles wafting around -- even the sky a perpetual orange. Mycelium coats the landscape, with coarse dirt yet again making it's presence known. Here is where you might get lucky with gold and emerald, or unlucky if you happen across this place at night.

### Ethereal
The penultimate dimension, the Ethereal plane is one of great reward and discovery. Contained within are unique creatures, fantastic treasures, and beautiful vistas. It also provides opportunities for new lovely decoration blocks that you cannot get anywhere else!

![Ethereal Dimension Portal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8b9b3d69e920344942836fd1a2067cbf12fe92da.png)

## Creatures
In this mod there aren't a lot of new additions, and all of them can be found in the Ethereal Dimension. Let's take a look at each one\

**Ethereal Golem**
This is the only hostile mob in the mod. This nasty guardian flies around the world, and sends you flying with a nasty ranged attack if he spots you. It has 100 Health and is equipped with strong armor and weapons. Good luck!

![Ethereal Golem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/28667c26c949472c604f93184eed1000cf6df4e1.png)

**CloudPuff**
The most passive mob added, this cute little goon is a new companion for you. It likes Moon Orbs, which you can also use to breed it, and they will often congregate around Moonflowers. You can ride them, granting you no jump but quite a lot of speed, and you can also tame them. Easily distracted, afraid of conflict, and with only 10 Health, the CloudPuff is a friend best kept safe elsewhere (although do be aware that once tamed, they will follow you around for LIFE).

![CloudPuff](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a13a83b465b2f7d7488141fb01e5c0a71d59c5a.png)

**Ethereal Stray**
A passive mob whose function serves as the closest thing to a sentient life form, a master of strange transmutation abilities. With 250 health they aren't too easily slain, and they also have a passive to regenerate their health, but they won't hurt you. Right-clicking on them with the item you wish to offer in your main hand initiates the transmutation process. The available options are the following:

- Giving a Nether Star transmutates into an End Crystal (100 ticks)
- Giving a Block of Coal transmutates into a Diamond (20 ticks)
- Giving a Heart of the Sea transmutates into a Beacon. (100 ticks)
- Giving a Dragon Egg transmutates into a Mob Spawner Cage (200 ticks)

title: More Mystcraft
description: Additions and improvements to Mystcraft.
body:
This mod has the following non-Modrinth depepdency: [Myst Library](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mystlibrary)

***

**_More Mystcraft_** is a collection of miscellaneous additions to the mod _Mystcraft_. Version 0.8.5 is designed for use with at least _Mystcraft_ 0.13.7.03 and _Forge_ 14.23.5.2803. It will **not** work with previous versions.

***

_More Mystcraft_ currently has several foci:

**Structures**

*   Adds an overworld structure called the Abandoned Study that is meant to provide some resources to players who have not yet traveled to any Ages. It can also spawn in Ages if the corresponding Page is used. There is a config option to disable the Book Binder recipe if you would like these Studies to be the only source of Descriptive Books.
*   Cosmetically upgrades the default libraries and provides an option to disable libraries altogether. If the upgrade is enabled, there is a 10% chance that a library will be upgraded to a larger Great Library.

**Pages**

*   Pyramids: Features like Spheres and Spikes that accept blocks as modifiers.
*   Ocean Monuments: Have ocean monuments spawn in your Ages!
*   Size Pages: Tiny, Small, Medium, Large, and Huge.
*   Tilt Pages: No Tilt (0°), Half Tilt (45°), and Full Tilt (90°).
*   Tinted Sun Page: Make your sun a different color and give it a size and tilt for a truly unique Age!
*   Rings Biome Distribution: A new biome distribution where the biome changes as you move outward from the center of the map.
*   Normal Biome Distribution: Replaces the five "sized" biome distribution from _Mystcraft_ and can be used with the Size pages. The original pages can be disabled and remapped in _moremystcraft.cfg_.
*   East-West and North-South Bands Distribution: Biomes bands expand into infinity.
*   Boxes Biome Distribution: Just like Rings Biome DIstribution, but with right angles.
*   Island Biome Distribution: Accepts one biome page and places it in the middle of an infinite ocean. Use in conjunction with a Standard World page for best results.
*   Gigantic Trees: A semi-replacement for Huge Trees. These ones have thicker trunks but spawn less frequently to cause less generation lag.
*   Cloud Height Pages: Manipulate the cloud height in your Ages.
undefined*   Lacking Ores: Stops ore generation in the ground. (Ores used in structures like obelisks will still spawn.) It should work for any ore (including modded ores) that post to OreGenEvent. Be careful to not use it together with "Dense Ores". They will cancel each other out and you'll get some unwanted side effects.

**Blocks**

*   Traffic cone: Ensure explorers stay within DRC-approved areas!
*   Unstable Book Receptacle: Functions similarly to a regular Book Receptacle. When a Descriptive Book is inserted, it creates a new Age every time you use the portal. When a Linking Book is inserted, it spawns you at a random coordinate within the target Age.

**Items**

*   Maintainer suit: A fully-protective suit you can use to visit ages with unknown dangers. When inside a maintainer suit, your vision and movements are restricted, and you cannot interact with anything outside the suit, but you can still access your inventory, and you are fully protected from any and all dangers. The suit has the added benefit of linking with you when you are inside it, and it also includes a readout of any potion effects an age may inflict due to instability.

***

Be sure to check out these other great _Mystcraft_ add-ons: _[Linking Through the Ages](https://modrinth.com/mod/ltta)_, _Pages_, _Linking Tweaks_, and _Mystcraft Info_.

**Unlock:** Just remove the added line

**Explanation:** This sets two dragon eggs as the required items to enter a dungeon and those are impossible to obtain.

title: Personal Rules
description: Allow player to configure gamerules for themselves! No more server-wide `keepInventory`
body:
Gamerules, but personal! No more server-wide `keepInventory`!

## Usage

The mod is server-side, client installation is __not required__ (unless you want to use it in a singleplayer).

Personal rules can be accessed or modified in the same way as gamerules,
with a little difference of using `/personalrule <rule> [value]`.

By default, all personal rules are disabled and all players are using world gamerules.

To disable a personal rule, use `/personalrule <rule> reset`.

## Configuration (`<world>/personalrules.conf`)

A Carpet-like configuration file with required [permission levels][minecraft-wiki-permission-level] per gamerule.
Allowed values are `ops`, `true` (everyone), `false` (disabled),
and permission level in range `0`-`5` (where `0` = everyone, `5` = disabled).

Permission levels can be queried or modified with `/personalrules permission <rule> [permission_level]`.
Reload from the configuration file with `/personalrule permission reload`.

The permission level of 2 is required to be able to access `/personalrules permission` command.

### Default configuration

```
keepInventory                     ops
doMobLoot                         ops
projectilesCanBreakBlocks         ops
doTileDrops                       ops
doEntityDrops                     ops
naturalRegeneration               ops
reducedDebugInfo                  true
doLimitedCrafting                 ops
disableRaids                      ops
doInsomnia                        true
doImmediateRespawn                true
playersNetherPortalDefaultDelay   true
playersNetherPortalCreativeDelay  true
drowningDamage                    ops
fallDamage                        ops
fireDamage                        ops
freezeDamage                      ops
doPatrolSpawning                  ops
doTraderSpawning                  ops
doWardenSpawning                  ops
forgiveDeadPlayers                true

```

title: CITX (CIT Extension)
description: A mod that allows easy renaming of CIT items with a custom command.
body:
**CITX** is a Minecraft mod that makes renaming Custom Item Textures (CIT) items easy. Use a simple in-game command to quickly rename items, without the need for an anvil.

### **Features:**
- **Easy Item Renaming**: Use the `/citx <extension>` command to quickly append a custom extension to the item in your hand.
- **Command Flexibility**: The mod supports a wide range of custom extensions and includes an easy-to-use reset function (`/citxreset`) to revert item names back to their original state.
- **Optimized Renaming Logic**: Supports multiple renames without affecting the name of the original item and prevents double underscores.

### **How to Use:**
1. **Renaming Items**:
   - Hold the item you wish to rename.
   - Use the `/citx <extension>` command, replacing `<extension>` with your desired suffix (e.g., `_newname`).
   - The item will be renamed with the specified extension, and the new name will be visible.

2. **Resetting Item Names**:
   - If you want to reset the item’s name back to its original state, simply use the `/citxreset` command.
   
3. **Important Reminder**:

title: ColorfulCollars
description: Freely blend colors of your pet's collar
body:
### Description 
This is a simple mod that allows your pet's(cats and dogs) collar to be freely dyed and have colors mixed without being limited by the dye types in Minecraft.
### What this mod does
1.Now, when you use dye on your pets, _**the collar color will be a blend of the original color and the dye color**_ , **instead of Mojang's low-quality system that simply overrides the color.**

2.Based on the 24w35a update: **The collar color now defaults to a valid mixed color of the parents' collar colors, unless the mix does not exist or the parents' collar colors cannot be combined.** However, this blending is not ideal. This mod ensures that _**the collar color is truly a blend of the parents' collar colors**_, unaffected by conditions like "the mix does not exist" or "the parents' collar colors cannot be combined.

---

This modpack aims to squeeze out every ounce of performance from the original mc.enhance modpack by omitting all of the purely visual mods. This leaves the player with a balanced mix of performance and quality of life mods, all of which are client-side and multiplayer friendly.

I believe many of the mods in this pack should be included in the base game due to how useful they are. And although each mod may be small on their own, together they succeed in creating an enhanced vanilla-plus experience! title: PostPlaceholderAPI
description: Get placeholders using get requests
body:
# PostPlaceholderAPI

The **PostPlaceholderAPI** is a powerful Minecraft plugin that enables server administrators to retrieve placeholders using GET requests. With this plugin, you can seamlessly integrate dynamic content into your server, enhancing the player experience. By sending a GET request to the server, you can access various placeholders that provide real-time information about players.

## Features

- Fetch placeholders through GET requests.
- Retrieve player-related data using the provided format: `http://backend.ip:port/<player-uuid>/<placeholder-without-%>`.
- Example request: `http://example.com:8000/d2f0a4b6-260e-480b-a33c-bbe5a5db2d53/player_name` (returns JSON containing "playgamesgo").
- Requires inclusion of a valid **Token** in the request header to authorize access. Failure to do so results in a **401 Unauthorized** response.
- Example responses:
  - `{"status":"401","message":"Unauthorized"}` - Without Authorization Header
  - `{"status":"404","message":"Invalid URI"}` - With the Wrong URL Scheme
  - `{"status": "200", "message":"playgamesgo"}` - Valid Placeholder (`%player_name%`)

## Compatibility

- The PostPlaceholderAPI plugin is compatible with **Minecraft version 1.19 and above**.
- If you require plugin functionality for Minecraft version 1.18 or lower, consider using the [RestPlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/rest-placeholderapi.90266/) plugin.
- Note that the RestPlaceholderAPI plugin is recommended for older versions, as the PostPlaceholderAPI plugin focuses on offering functionality for newer versions of Minecraft.

Enhance your server's capabilities and provide dynamic content effortlessly with the PostPlaceholderAPI plugin. Retrieve placeholders, deliver personalized experiences, and keep your players engaged like never before.

# ⚔️ Explorers
This modpack was originally just built by me and a friend to spice up a survival server we wanted to create. As it expanded in size, I realized that this could become something more expansive than just a cluttered modpack—and it already felt a lot more cohesive than that. I believe this pack is a perfect, fulfilling compilation of mods for anyone who, like me, wants the game to feel a bit more adventurous, thrilling—and actually built for exploring.

# 🔥 Features
This modpack primarily contains mods of four different types (outside of API mods):
* Significant and game-altering (BetterEnd, BetterNether, Terralith, etc.)
* Small additive or decorative mods (Adorn, Campanion, Promenade, etc.)
* Quality of life changes (Axes Are Weapons, Omni-Hoppers, Tax Free Levels, etc.)

title: InvSearch
description: Find items across your inventory and known storage locations with a clean in-game search.
body:
InvSearch is a lightweight Fabric client mod that adds fast item search to
Minecraft. It helps you find what your client has seen in your inventory and
tracked storage, so you can stop opening every chest in the room just to find
one missing stack.

It works as a practical storage memory aid: open containers as you play, then
search later to see known-current item locations and counts. Use it on its own,
or alongside InvSort and InvCatalogue as part of the wider inventory management
suite.

Open the search modal from the in-game Search button on supported screens. Type
an item name or id to filter the known item list, then select an item to see
where it was last seen and how much is available.

![InvSearch search screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/wIOLlhbN/images/6d26fc7acaffd8fdc2c30b99b020c03d962cad4a_350.webp)

InvSearch now also understands category queries. Start a search with `:` to
match practical item groups from the shared sorting vocabulary, such as
`:wood`, `:stone`, `:tools`, `:food`, `:gear`, or `:storage`.

![InvSearch selected result](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/wIOLlhbN/images/5582d33b43d82701a4080f3c0e03bd70c598491f_350.webp)

## Features

- In-game search UI for inventory and known storage
- Live results while you type
- `:category` searches for broad groups such as wood, stone, tools, food, gear,
  storage, and redstone
- Known-current item location tracking
- Per-location item counts for searched stacks
- Held-versus-tracked counts so you can see what is on you and what is stored
  elsewhere
- Tracks standard containers, placed shulkers, ender chests, and storage
  minecarts through the shared inventory tracking system
- Keeps tracking data separated by singleplayer world or multiplayer server
- Works client-side in singleplayer, LAN, Realms, and multiplayer where
  client-side utility mods are allowed

## Good for

- Finding misplaced tools, blocks, and resources
- Large survival bases with too many storage chests
- Hardcore or seasonal worlds where storage changes often
- Players who want item search without server-side changes
- Using alongside InvSort and InvCatalogue for broader inventory management

## Install note

InvSearch does not require a server install. Install Fabric Loader, Fabric API,
and the InvSearch jar for your Minecraft version.

It remembers what your client has seen. If another player moves items while you
are away, reopen that storage so InvSearch can refresh its known location data.
