title: Combatant [BEING REVAMPED]
description: The new age of combat.
body:
im fully reworking the mod (so silly)

# Credits

Before we begin, I want to credit some people. Thanks to PlazmaZX(plazmazx on discord) for giving every amethyst armour and tool texture!


![Combatant](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ayOegD8J/images/6addc9ed8f66386003499a07ebf1a8055f50a8fd.png)

Combatant is a mod that changes combat by adding new enchants, changing weapons, and adding some new interesting weapons which change your playstyle, instead of adding millions of ores and repetitive, boring weapons with unchanging stats. Please refer to the official wiki for more in-depth info!

# New Weapons:
### Aethers' Horn:
The Aethers' Horn is a disruptive weapon, meant for getting away or dealing low damage to groups of enemies. The Horn has two attacks, which can be changed by enchants. The first one registers when you hit a block, and causes a small explosion, which launches your enemies away from you, and launches them in the air. The second registers when you hit an entity, and causes the enemy to be pushed towards you.
### Amethyst Aspect
The Amethyst Aspect is an alternative to the sword and axe, a heavy-hitting sword meant for dealing with heavier targets. It has 10 attack damage, and is quite slow. It can be upgraded.
### The Heartbreaker
The Heartbreaker is the upgraded version of the Amethyst Aspect, dealing 12 attack damage. The Heartbreaker has an additional ability, which deals additional armour-piercing damage if the enemy is freezing. The Heartbreaker can be combined with Frostbite. However, this will apply a 4 second cooldown, using the new cooldown mechanic.

# New Armour:
### Amethyst Armour
Amethyst armour is a new armour set, which is an *alternative* to netherite. It offers a protection level between iron and diamond armour, however, in return, it grants you the ability to shoot dragons breath using your armour ability key(K by default). This has a 10 second cooldown.

# New Smithing Templates:
### Amethyst Upgrade:
There is a new amethyst upgrade template, which can be rarely found in mineshaft chests. It can be combined with diamond tools(only the sword right now) and diamond armour to make a new tool/armour set!

# New Enchants:
### Frostbite
Frostbite is a new heavy-hitting weapon(axe, amethyst aspect, heartbreaker, etc.) enchant, which freezes enemies as if they are in powdered snow depending on the level. Cannot be combined with Smite or Cleaving.
### Cleaving
Cleaving is another new axe enchant, which disables any right-click abilities of your items in your main and off-hand. This applies an effect, and can only be applied if the effect hasn't been yet applied.
### Combustion
Combustion is an enchant which gives the on-block-hit attack a bigger radius, but doesn't push enemies back. Generally, use this if you want to learn how to use the weapon, as the radius is really precise, and all of your shots have to be well-timed to be useful in tricky situations.
### Flames of Hell
This enchant is an enchant for dealing medium damage in a large area, and for somewhat annoying your enemies at times. It applies a new effect, Haephaestus' Flames, which deals damage based on the level of the effect every 5 ticks(half a heart at level 1, 2 hearts at level 4).
### Wind Dash
Wind Dash is probably my favourite enchant so far. It allows you to travel really fast, at the cost of dealing a lot of damage(2 hearts in full protection 4 netherite, but blast protection works better) to the user. If you have to quickly get away, this is your best shot. It allows you to travel by pushing you forward 2 times the amount that the Horn would push your enemies backwards when you hit any block at any distance. This means that if you are careful, you can chain jumps! It also works on your velocity, so jumping up or using potions before the push will increase it's distance.
### Crystallization
Crystallization changes the ability of The Heartbreaker to a passive one, making it slow down enemies instead of helping to deal more damage.

# New Items:
### Coins
Coins are a creative-only item(subject to change), which can be used for maps, quests, etc.

# New Blocks:
### Refined Slate
![Refined Slate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ayOegD8J/images/9286237ee792ea1f95cd602f9f8530e7f3e7b298.png)
Refined Slate is the only group of blocks so far. It's a pale, grey-ish, soft block type, not fit for gradients, but instead for more of japanese-esque builds. They have a cheap recipe, and can be used for the Mystic Table.
### Mystic Table
The Mystic Table is a table made using refined slate, netherite scrap and a gold block. This block allows you to craft the new weapons, currently only being one weapon, aka, the Aethers' Horn.

![Combatant](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ayOegD8J/images/068dce94e7bae9783177e21f71eecdf03293d76c.gif)

Please note this isn't compatitable with optifine, as far as I understand. I will try to track down the source of the issue before the next update.

title: Damage Overhaul
description: A mod that overhauls damage and armor calculations.
body:
# Damage Overhaul

Damage Overhaul is a mod for Minecraft 1.16.2 and higher aiming to add damage typing and change the armor and damage calculation formula. Simply put though, it recalculates armor based on the amount of damage, and how spread out the damage is amongst typing. A larger damage hit will render much more profoundly on an entity than many small typings, and armor will feel less effective on bigger hits. This all feeds into an exponential decay calculation to make armor less effective the more you have of it against a bigger attack. The aim of this is to make it feel like larger attacks feel more profound, while with armor, you can shrug off smaller hits. This mod is extremely customizable, from being able to modify variables in the calculations, to being able to define your own damage types, to being able to modify what damage a tool deals. This all occurs through YAML files in the configuration directory.

***

This mod is Fabric only. I am not considering a Forge port at this time. If you want to port it, it's licensed under GPL-3, so have a go as long as you credit me and license it under GPL as well.

***


It does this through a few targeted Mixins into the LivingEntity and PlayerEntity classes. While these mixins are required in order to make the custom damage calculations, these mixins are slightly invasive, and **THIS WILL RENDER SOME MODS INCOMPATIBLE WITH THIS MOD.** As I find incompatibilities with this mod and others as raised through issues, I will mark them incompatible on my end.
 
 #### Marked Incompatible:
 - None yet!
 
***

### Required Mods:
*Duh.*
- Fabric Loader: 0.10.8 or greater

*Required for the custom particles this mod adds as indicators.*
- Fabric API: 0.29.3 or greater

*Required as part of the config screen this mod generates.*
- Cloth Config API (Fabric): 4.8.3 or greater

### Suggested Mods:
*Suggested for many reasons, but that includes the mods screen, and configuring the mod in-game.*
- Mod Menu: 1.15.0 or greater

*Suggested for the guidebook, which is currently incomplete, but not necessary.*
- Patchouli: 1.16.2-44-FABRIC or greater

title: Casino Rocket Additions - Unofficial Addon
description: More games for Casino Rocket mod
body:
**Casino Rocket - Additions** is an unofficial add-on developed to complement the **Casino Rocket** mod, expanding the Minecraft gameplay experience by adding new minigames, betting systems, and reward mechanics. Its main goal is to enrich the casino atmosphere within the game, offering more varied, interactive, and entertaining activities for players.

This add-on introduces an **American Roulette table**, a minigame based on the classic casino game. At this table, players can deposit chips or bills as a form of bet, select different types of bets, and adjust the amount they wish to wager before starting the round. Once the bet is placed, the player can spin the roulette wheel and wait for the result. Depending on the number, color, or combination selected, the system delivers rewards proportional to the type of bet placed, making each game an element of risk, strategy, and chance.

In addition to roulette, the add-on also includes a **bingo machine**, designed to offer a different and more relaxed gameplay experience. In this minigame, each player uses individual cards with assigned numbers. The machine draws random numbers without repetition, allowing the game to progress through rounds. Players must manually mark the numbers on their cards and pay attention to fulfilling the game's objectives. When a player completes the necessary combination, they can claim bingo and receive their respective reward.

Overall, **Casino Rocket - Additions** enhances the variety of activities available within the original mod, adding new forms of entertainment based on chance and player interaction. Thanks to its betting, reward, and game round systems, this add-on allows for the creation of more complete casino spaces within Minecraft, ideal for servers, themed maps, or multiplayer experiences focused on fun and friendly competition.

title: CS CINEMATIC
description: Advanced Minecraft camera plugin featuring unlimited positions, smooth animations, sound effects, screen shake, zoom, teleportation, and YAML-based editable cinematic files.
body:
# 🎬 CS Cinematic | Advanced Camera System
**Version: 2.0.0 | Minecraft: 1.21+**

Transform your Minecraft server with **CS Cinematic**, the ultimate tool for creating professional, smooth, and immersive camera sequences. Whether you are building a server lobby intro, a story-driven RPG cutscene, or a map trailer, CS Cinematic handles it all without requiring any client-side mods!

---

## ✨ Key Features

**📍 Unlimited Camera Positions**
Create complex camera paths with as many keyframes (positions) as you need. There is no limit to how long or detailed your cinematic can be.

**🎥 Butter-Smooth Movement**
Forget choppy teleportation! CS Cinematic uses advanced math (interpolation) to glide the player's camera smoothly between points.
*   **8 Interpolation Types:** Linear, Ease-In, Ease-Out, Smooth, Bounce, Elastic, and more.

**📝 Fully Editable YAML Files**
Every cinematic you save creates a file in `plugins/CSCinematic/cinematics/`.
*   You can edit coordinates, speed, text, and sounds manually in the file.
*   Easy to share cinematics between servers.

**🎵 Advanced Sound System**
*   **900+ Sounds:** Built-in tab completion for every Minecraft sound.
*   **Custom Sounds:** Support for resource pack sounds.
*   **Timing:** Play sounds at specific positions or global timestamps.

**💥 Immersive Visual Effects**
*   **Screen Shake:** Add intensity to explosions or dramatic moments.
*   **Zoom & FOV:** Dynamically change the Field of View for dramatic close-ups.
*   **Comedy Mode:** One command to enable fast cuts, funny shakes, and zoom effects.

**💬 Titles & Text Overlays**
Display clear titles and subtitles synced perfectly with the camera movement. Customize fade-in, stay, and fade-out times.

**⚡ Smart Player Handling**
*   **Spectator Mode:** Players are automatically switched to Spectator mode.
*   **Input Blocking:** Movement, chat, and interactions are blocked during the show.
*   **State Restoration:** When the cinematic ends, the player is returned to their original location, gamemode, and inventory exactly as they were.

---

## 🛠️ How It Works

CS Cinematic is designed to be intuitive. You don't need complex coding knowledge.

1.  **Create:** `/cs create <name>` to start a recording session.
2.  **Position:** Fly to a spot and type `/cs pos add`.
3.  **Customize:** Add a specific speed or delay: `/cs pos add 3.0 5.0`.
4.  **Spice it up:** Add a sound or text: `/cs text 1 "Welcome!"`.
5.  **Save:** `/cs save` writes everything to a file.
6.  **Play:** `/cs play <name>` to watch your masterpiece.

---

## 🎮 Command List

| Command | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `/cs create <name>` | Create a new cinematic. |
| `/cs edit <name>` | Edit an existing cinematic. |
| `/cs pos add` | Add a camera point at your location. |
| `/cs pos list` | View all positions. |
| `/cs sound <id> <sound>` | Add a sound effect to a position. |
| `/cs text <id> <text>` | Add a title to a position. |
| `/cs shake <id> <amount>` | Add screen shake effect. |
| `/cs play <name>` | Play the cinematic for yourself. |
| `/cs play <name> <player>` | Force a player to watch. |
| `/cs save` | Save your work to YAML. |
| `/cs load <name>` | Load changes made in YAML files. |

---

## 📂 Configuration

The plugin is highly configurable via `config.yml`. You can set default speeds, delays, and message prefixes.

**Data Folder:** `plugins/CSCinematic/cinematics/`
*   Each cinematic gets its own `.yml` file.
*   You can copy/paste these files to back them up or share them.

---

## 🚀 Why Choose CS Cinematic?

*   **Optimized:** Lag-free performance even on 1.21+ servers.
*   **User Friendly:** Tab-completion for all commands and sounds.
*   **Professional:** Creates movie-quality transitions.
*   **Free:** Full features with no paywalls.

# Douse It

A lightweight client-side mod that enhances the visual experience of burning entities. 
**Perfect for immersion and aesthetic focus: removes the intrusive fire overlay and replaces it with neat flame particles and realistic campfire smoke.**

## Features

- 🚫 **No Fire Overlay** - Completely hides the intrusive blocky fire texture overlay on burning entities (including the player).
- 🔥 **Better Particles** - Replaces the overlay with neat flame and smoke particles.
- 🌫️ **Realistic Smoke** - Smoke rises in a column (campfire style) and is distributed naturally across the entity's body.
- ⚙️ **Fully Configurable** - Customize everything:
    - Toggle particles on/off.
    - Adjust spawn chance (density).
    - Configure spread (full body vs centered).
    - Tweak vertical speed.

## Configuration

The configuration file is located at `config/douseit-client.toml`:

- **Particles**:
    - `smoke`: Adjust chance (default 10%), speed, and spread.
    - `flame`: Adjust chance (default 50%), speed, and spread.
- **Fire Texture**:
    - `hideFireTexture`: Set to `false` if you only want the particles but want to keep the vanilla fire overlay (why though?).

## Compatibility

- **Client-Side Only**: You don't need this on the server.
- **Mod Loaders**: Native Forge 1.20.1 support. Easily portable to other loaders.

title: Uncraftable Coins
description: Currency coins that cannot be crafted - perfect for controlled server economies where operators manage the money supply.
body:
# Uncraftable Coins

**Uncraftable Coins** is a fork of [RPG Coins](https://modrinth.com/mod/coins) specifically designed for controlled server economies. This version removes all crafting recipes, making coins obtainable only through creative mode or commands.

## What Makes This Different?

Unlike the original RPG Coins mod, **Uncraftable Coins** has **no crafting recipes**. Players cannot:
- Craft coins from ingots
- Convert between coin types
- Farm resources to create currency

This makes the mod perfect for servers where operators need full control over the money supply.

## Features

- Adds **Gold Coin**, **Iron Coin**, and **Copper Coin** items
- **Zero crafting recipes** - coins can only be added by operators
- Works with economy plugins and shop mods as regular items
- Can be stored, traded, and dropped like any item

## Ideal For

- **RPG Servers** - Distribute coins as quest rewards
- **Economy Servers** - Admins control currency circulation
- **Survival Servers** - Non-farmable currency for player shops
- **Custom Gamemodes** - Any scenario requiring controlled currency

## Compatibility

- **Required:** [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- **Works with shop mods:** [Spud's Shops](https://modrinth.com/mod/spuds-shops), [Universal Shops](https://modrinth.com/mod/universal-shops)
- **Compatible with:** [RPG Series mods](https://modrinth.com/user/ZsoltMolnarrr)

## Installation

1. Drop the `UncraftableCoins.jar` into your `mods` folder (client and/or server)
2. Start Minecraft - the mod works immediately
3. Use creative mode or `/give` commands to distribute coins

## Tags

- `coins:coins`
- `coins:gold_coin`
- `coins:iron_coin`
- `coins:copper_coin`

## Coins

![The three coins added by the mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/26269f0a02adaf1dccc10cb6fa5aa7a928dbc1ae.webp)

## Credits

This mod is a fork of [RPG Coins](https://modrinth.com/mod/coins) by [Riser876](https://modrinth.com/user/Riser876).

Original design inspired by [Jewelry (RPG Series)](https://modrinth.com/mod/jewelry) by [ZsoltMolnarrr](https://modrinth.com/user/ZsoltMolnarrr).

title: Extra Discs
description: Collect all of your favorite songs from the Minecraft Soundtrack using Skeletons!
body:
**ExtraDiscs** is a simple music mod for Minecraft that adds Music Discs for all of the game’s music, allowing the player to listen to it on demand. The songs are divided into separate categories that all have their own methods of being obtained. 

To obtain discs in certain categories, the player must get a Skeleton to kill a certain mob. Each category correlates to a specific mob:

<details>
<summary>Overworld Music Discs</summary>
Zombies will drop Overworld Music Discs
</details>
<details>
<summary>Creative Music Discs</summary>
Iron Golems will drop Creative Music Discs
</details>
<details>
<summary>Underground Music Discs</summary>
Silverfish will drop Underground Music Discs
</details>
<details>
<summary>Underwater Music Discs</summary>
Guardians will drop Underwater Music Discs
</details>
<details>
<summary>Nether Music Discs</summary>
Ghasts will drop Nether Music Discs (C418).

Piglin Brutes will drop post 1.16 Nether Music Discs (Lena Raine).
</details>
<details>
<summary>End Music Discs</summary>
Shulkers will drop End Music Discs
</details>
<details>
<summary>Menu Music Discs</summary>
Endermen will drop Menu Music Discs (figure it out.)
</details>
<details>
<summary>Deep Dark Music Discs</summary>
Wardens will drop Ancestry, the Deep Dark Music Disc.
</details>
<details>
<summary>Creator Remix</summary>
Strike the Creator Music Disc with Lightning to de-oxidize and enchant it.
</details>

Each condition is meant to give the player a unique challenge. The pools with less items will have harder conditions, but will inherently guarantee the player has to do it less times than pools with more items in them, and vice versa. 

**Technical Specifications:**
This mod does not contain any of the music in the game, and instead registers sound entries for the songs already in the game. 

Any and all assets are purely custom and are not in violation of any copyright laws pertaining to the usage of the game’s music. Please support C418, Lena Raine, Kumi Tanioka and Aaron Cherof.

**Additional Credits:**
- [Ocelot5836](https://github.com/Ocelot5836/) for the Mono Audio Wrapper code
- [NoteBlock](https://www.youtube.com/@NoteBlock), [Jonny Atma](https://www.youtube.com/@JonnyAtma) and [Dom Palombi](https://www.youtube.com/@DomPalombiMusic) for the amazing Creator Remix (used with permission, of course).
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
...and Huggbees for... Newman-O's?
</details>

title: Festus Winter Horror
description: A snowy horror apocalypse survival modpack.
body:
Festus Winter Horror is a 1.20.1 Fabric-based modpack that throws you into a harsh, snow-covered post-apocalyptic world teeming with horrors, hostile environments, and immersive survival mechanics. Stranded in an eternal winter, you must scavenge, survive, and uncover the secrets buried beneath the ice — while avoiding the many things lurking in the cold, dark wilderness.

🧟‍♂️ Core Features
❄️ Endless Winter: The world is locked in a permanent blizzard. Snowstorms, freezing temperatures, and whiteout conditions shape your every decision.

🧛 Horrific Encounters: Cursed mobs, paranormal threats, and unknown creatures stalk the snowy biomes. Mods like The Man in the Fog, Graveyard, and Cave Dweller create a constant sense of dread.

🧬 Origins & Abilities: Choose a supernatural origin that gives you unique abilities—and weaknesses—to help or hinder your journey through the apocalypse.

🏚️ Abandoned World: Explore haunting ruins, decaying villages, overrun cities, and frozen wastelands. Mods like Abandoned & Ruined Structures, Hostile Worlds, and Haunted Buildings provide an immersive world full of environmental storytelling.

🔥 Survival Over Comfort: You’ll face harsh hunger mechanics, limited resources, frozen rivers, darkness, and cold exposure. Every campfire, shelter, and decision matters.

🎮 Performance-Optimized: Packed with FPS-boosting mods like Sodium, Starlight, LazyDFU, and EntityCulling for smooth gameplay, even with visual enhancements.

🧊 Immersive Visuals: Snowy shaders, creepy soundscapes, and thematic resource packs create a chilling, cinematic feel.

🛠️ Multiplayer-Ready: Designed for singleplayer survival or server play. Team up or turn on each other in a frozen fight for survival.

🌨️ Why Play Frozen Descent?
If you’ve ever wanted a true survival horror experience in Minecraft, this is it. This modpack blends the challenge of winter survival, the intensity of hostile horror mobs, and exploration into a deeply immersive experience. Every minute you stay alive feels earned. Whether you're hiding from things that move in the snow or scavenging abandoned towns in silence—this is survival, not comfort.

🔧 Recommended Settings
Fabric Loader 1.20.1

6–8GB RAM minimum

Use the included resource pack and shader profile for full immersion

Optional: Play with dynamic lighting off for a more terrifying night

## Biome Descriptions

![The Burnt Forest Title Card](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eac172403b8ba5099649b601ab15e4955ab208c0.png)
![Burnt Forest Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a5c567a0a7798a93e9835cdd7b1b69b9d87ce4a_0.webp)

Burnt forests house enemies aptly named the Burnt in addition to Ashgazes, a passive mob.

Burnts can rarely drop a Radient Ruby which can be smithed together with an unpowered firestarter to create a scolding hot blade.

![The Frosty Forest Title Card](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d5b679d521a5dd7faee714d8830d274b94e1fa63.png)![Frosty Forest Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d96daae51fec25be87e7f9f9d6dfae649cd5cee8.jpeg)

Frosty forests are home to snow foxes and frostbitten skeletons that'll send shivers down your spine. You may also find some shiverlilies while exploring this frozen wasteland.

Frostbitten skeletons rarely drop Subzero Sapphires, which can be smithed together with an empty crown to create the *ahem* "coolest" fashion trend.


![Lush Savannah Title Card](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/179414d243469bf96f2504544e79479817b556a2.png)![Lush Savannah Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf23ce1fd76b50eea238284fc53483d139a02b1e.jpeg)

These petrified plains have been adopted by mossy plants galore, as well as some peculiar statues. They're not weeping and they're definitely not angels, these living statues are quite deadly especially given that they're immune to melee attacks.

There isn't any unique items in this biome yet but there will be.

![Overgrown Desert Title Card](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/79cfc440b7ce2b18994930d1e048743138bee455.png)![Overgrown Desert Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/170edb25ecb2f437c68051aad6be874bfdca6939.jpeg)

This desert has mutated into a little oasis, if you like cacti that is... Vinelifes may look pretty but you'd better be careful because these pack hunters have thorns.

While exploring this deceptively humid jungle you may come along a tree house with an arid emerald inside. Use this gem to smith a powerful multitool able to slice through vines with ease; Ironically it's called the vineslice.

![Rainbow Forest Title Card](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/18b81217e4c0eff7511c72125aa7d5f875b0b467.png)![Rainbow Forest Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8ac8ff2779310a8f36887ae7e1ff16d420bb99b.jpeg)

These spectral woods are home to some vaporous enemies: clouds. You may also find some rainbow crystals around that are excellent for decoration.

Clouds can rarely drop a lightning bolt that requires lightning charges to be used. Once you have this ammunition it makes an excellent ranged weapon, striking fear into the hearts of your enemies.

![Nuclear Forest Title Card](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/123c880fbf3ce6eef0dab0347c520f37e38079a5.png)![Nuclear Forest Biome](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d36056d7618094cc6dfa4277f809907f5fb89306.jpeg)

This atomic wasteland is home to the hardiest of creatures, cockroaches. They've infested everything; the trees, that abandoned house, that nuclear bunker...

If you manage to stumble across a uranium crystal you can create a sabre made of light! That's right your very own beam-sword. Holding this weapon will give you speed and right clicking will give you a temporary jump boost.

title: Local Difficulty Utilities
description: Fixes local difficulty display on the client and syncs inhabited time from the server. Includes configs and commands to easily edit a chunks local difficulty.
body:
# Local Difficulty Utilities **Local Difficulty Utilities** is a lightweight utility mod that: - Fixes the client-side display of local difficulty. - Syncs each chunk's inhabited time value from the server, so the client sees the real difficulty. - Adds commands to view and edit the inhabited time of chunks. - Provides configurable options for debugging, syncing, and modifying local difficulty values. ---
Commands ### `/ldu inhabited chunk get ` Displays the `inhabitedTime` value of the target chunk. --- ### `/ldu inhabited chunk set ` Sets the targets `inhabitedTime` value. --- ### `/ldu inhabited region ` Sets all loaded chunks `inhabitedTime` values in-between the two coordinates at once. --- ### `/ldu inhabited cancel` Cancels any ongoing region commands.
---
Config Options ### `restoreLocalDifficultly: true` If `true`, the Local Difficulty entry in the F3 debug menu will be re-enabled so you can see the local difficulty and the day values. If the server doesn't also have this mod with inhabitedTime syncing enabled, then the local difficulty value will be wrong due. The day value will always be correct. --- ### `syncInhabitedOnF3: true` If `true`, the server will respond to chunk sync requests when the client has the F3 debug menu open. --- ### `syncInhabitedOnNewChunk: true` If `true`, the server will respond to chunk sync requests when the client enters a new chunk. --- ### `regionMaxChunks: 250001` This is the maximum amount of chunks that can be edited at once with the region command. --- ### `regionBatchSize: 100` This limits how many chunks the region command will try to edit per tick.
--- ### Other Information - The `region` command will only select and edit chunks that are loaded into the game's memory. - This mod can be used on servers without this mod, but the client won't be able to get display the correct local difficulty because it doesn't have access to the needed information. --- ### Requirements - [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) - [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) - [(Optional) ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)

![Banner!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d30861d4550769f7300bafd28031110c19bb767d.png) # Where'd I Wake Up – A Respawn System for Map Mods Where'd I Wake Up is an addon for Minecraft map mods that allows players to choose their respawn location directly through the interface of supported map mods. ## Performance and Requirements

4GB of RAM should be more than enough to run this modpack.
Distant Horizons is installed and that may affect your performance depending on your system requirements. Play with the mod's LOD Distance Render Distance or disable entirely.

## Who is this for?

If you are new to modded minecraft or an experienced player looking to slow down and enjoy the finer things in life, this would be an excellent modpack for you. Otherwise, if you are looking for a complex and highly customized modpack, you may want to look elsewhere.

## Looking to move your Vanilla world to Modded?

This pack was built to be installed on top of an existing vanilla server. Therefore, mods added had limited world generation additions. Create and Farmer's Delight are the only significant mods that add new items/blocks to world generation, if you're playing on a previously-vanilla world you'll need to travel to new chunks to access these blocks.

## Underpunks Server

As mentioned above, this modpack was designed for players of the Underpunks Discord Game Server. Access to the official minecraft server is only open to verified and trusted members of the Underpunks Discord Game community. More details about the game can be found [here](https://underpunks.com/).

title: Recalls
description: Adds recall potions from Terraria along with two additional potions! A replacement for /home and /back!
body:
# **Recalls**
**Recalls** is a Data Pack that adds the Recall Potion and Return Potion from the game Terraria.
There is also a third potion called the "Potion of Death Recall" which isn't from Terraria but rather an idea I had while making the original Potion of Recall.

Here are the potions and what they do:
- Potion of Recall
  - Teleports you to your spawnpoint.
- Potion of Death Return
  - Teleports you to your last death location.
- Potion of Return
  - Teleports you to your spawnpoint and creates a portal back to the original location. (Careful using this in multiplayer, other people can, and probably will, steal your portal back, leaving you at your spawnpoint.)

In order to make one of the potions easier to make, the Wither's loot table was modified to drop 3-5 wither roses upon death.

You will unlock the recipes in the recipe book when you either obtain the special ingredient for the specific potion, or you obtain nether wart which will unlock all of them.
#
 There are two version of the datapack, stackable and unstackable. Stackable is the normal, base version that allows for the three potions to be stacked up to 16. Unstackable is a slightly modified version that only changes one thing, the three potions cannot be stacked. This is to accomodate for people who may think stacking them is too overpowered, so I created a version where they aren't stackable.

title: Don't Grow NOW!
description: Prevent crops from growing by doctoring farmland
body:
# Don't Grow NOW!

Prevent crops from growing by doctoring farmland

---

Tired of those pesky players trampling on your farms? Want to stop crop growth for aesthetic purposes? Then Don't Grow NOW! is just the right mod for you! Just apply some fermented:tm: bone meal to farmland and you're good to go!

## Gameplay

*Fermented Bone Meal* can be crafted using 8 bone meals and 1 fermented spider eye. It can be applied on farmland by right clicking or by dispensing it into farmland, turning it into *Doctored Farmland*. It prevents:

* Farmland blocks from dehydrating and turning into dirt
* Crops from growing
* Players and mobs from trampling on farmland blocks

Doctored farmland can also be picked up when broken with a shovel enchanted with Silk Touch, to be moved somewhere else.

Doctored farmland can be converted back into normal farmland by right clicking with a water bottle or using a dispenser to do so and crops will be able to grow again.

title: Grand Teleport (GTP)
description: Adds a GTA-style cinematic transition when using teleport.
body:
# Grand Teleport (GTP)

<iframe width="512" height="288" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/VU99CEmt75U" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Grand Teleport adds a GTA-style cinematic camera transition to Minecraft teleports.

When a teleport starts, the camera leaves the player, pulls up through several zoom stages, moves across the world when possible, and then returns to the player near the destination. The original teleport is still handled by Minecraft, the server, or the other mod that started it. GTP adds the cinematic transition around it.

## Important multiplayer note

Before using Grand Teleport on a multiplayer server, please make sure the server owner or staff allow it.

GTP is intended as a visual presentation mod, not as a way to bypass server rules. It does not grant teleport permissions, and it does not let you use commands that the server would normally deny. Some server-assisted transitions also require Grand Teleport to be installed on the server so the client can be told when a server-side teleport is happening.

## Main features

- GTA-style pull-out, overhead travel, and pull-in camera transition.
- Configurable zoom-stage camera heights.
- Separate zoom-stage settings for the Overworld, the Nether, and the End.
- Optional player input blocking during the transition.
- Optional cross-dimension camera travel.
- Minecraft sound mode and Grand Teleport custom sound mode.
- ModMenu configuration screen.
- Client commands using both `/gtp` and `/grandtp`.

## Supported teleport sources

GTP can react to common teleport commands such as:

- `/tp`
- `/teleport`
- `/minecraft:tp`
- `/minecraft:teleport`
- `/execute ... run tp ...`
- `/execute ... run teleport ...`

Depending on the Minecraft version and installed mods, GTP also supports several mod or server-assisted teleport flows, including JourneyMap teleports, Waystones teleports, Warp Plate teleports, command blocks, and other player-targeted teleports.

For multiplayer server-side teleport sources, Grand Teleport may also need to be installed on the server.

## Commands

- `/gtp on` or `/grandtp on` - enable the transition.
- `/gtp off` or `/grandtp off` - disable the transition.
- `/gtp status` or `/grandtp status` - show the current status.
- `/gtp player_freeze on` or `/grandtp player_freeze on` - block movement and camera input during the transition.
- `/gtp player_freeze off` or `/grandtp player_freeze off` - allow movement during the transition.
- `/gtp player_freeze status` or `/grandtp player_freeze status` - show the player-freeze status.

Settings are also available from the ModMenu configuration screen.

## Recommended companion mods

Grand Teleport feels best when the camera can see distant terrain during the transition. Voxy and Distant Horizons are recommended if your PC can run them comfortably.

These mods are optional. GTP works without them, but the transition is more impressive when long-distance terrain is visible.

## Sodium compatibility notes

Sodium compatibility is version-sensitive because Sodium's internal renderer changes between Minecraft versions.

The following versions have been the most stable in testing:

- Minecraft 1.21.11: Sodium `0.8.0` to `0.8.12`
- Minecraft 26.1.x: Sodium `0.8.9` to `0.8.12`
- Minecraft 26.2: Sodium `0.9.0`

These are tested recommendations, not a guarantee that other versions cannot work. If the transition flickers or chunks appear abruptly, try changing Sodium versions or checking Sodium's chunk fade settings.

## Sound credits

Grand Teleport includes an optional custom sound mode. These GTP sound effects were created by editing and processing audio assets acquired under a paid Zapsplat plan.

The default Minecraft sound mode is also available if you prefer vanilla-style effects.

## Notes

- GTP is mostly client-side for player-started teleports.
- Server-assisted teleports may require the mod on both the client and server.
- The mod only changes the camera transition and related visuals. It does not grant teleport permission.
- Distant terrain mods are optional, but Voxy or Distant Horizons are recommended for the intended cinematic look.

## License

Grand Teleport source code is licensed under the MIT License.

Bundled Grand Teleport custom sound effects are not licensed under MIT.
They are edited audio assets created from sounds licensed from ZapSplat under a paid Premium plan, and are included only for use as part of Grand Teleport.

Do not extract, redistribute, sell, sublicense, or reuse the bundled custom sound files separately.

https://www.zapsplat.com/license-type/standard-license/

title: DialogueUtils
description: A Pixelmon side mod that allows you to easily create helpful menus using Pixelmon's Dialogue, Choice Dialogue, and Input Dialogue screens
body:
# DIALOGUEUTILS 1.2.1
This mod does not modify Pixelmon or its behavior.
# For Support, contact `@infidelrick` on Discord

Dialogue Utils is a server-side mod using the PixelmonAPI for generating dialogues, choice menus, input screens, and notice overlays in-game.

## FEATURES
* **Simple Dialogues**: Display basic text-based dialogues
* **Choice Dialogues**: Provide players with multiple options to choose from
* **Input Dialogues**: Allow players to input custom text with commands
* **Notice System**: Display various types of overlays including text, Pokémon, and items
* **PlaceholderAPI Integration**: Support for PlaceholderAPI in all dialogue and notice text

## COMMANDS
### SIMPLE DIALOGUE: `/dutil simple <player> <title> <message>`
**Description**: Display a simple dialogue box to the player.  
**Permissions Required**: `dialogueutil.simple`  
**Example**:
```
/dutil simple PlayerName "&eSafari Zone" &eGood Luck {player} &aCatch what you can before your timer runs out. Add more time with &e/safari buy #
```
### CHOICE DIALOGUE: `/dutil choice <player> <configId>`
**Description**: Send a choice menu to a player using a pre-configured dialogue in `dialogues.yml`. Choices can be configured to run commands, have pokedollar costs, and/or permission requirements.  
**Permissions Required**: `dialogueutil.choice`  
**Example**:
```
/dutil choice PlayerName shop
```
![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1188003/description_3bd3afe8-c6cd-4c17-b00f-6c294a7b0915.png)
### INPUT DIALOGUE: `/dutil input player|console escape|stay <targetPlayer> <title> <message> <command>`
**Description**: Create an input dialogue for the target player, allowing them to input text.  
**Options**:
* `player|console`: Execute the command as the player or the console
* `escape|stay`: Determine whether the menu closes when "Escape" is pressed
* `title & message`: Put in quotes if more than 1 word
* `command`: Can use {player} and {input} for placeholders  
**Permissions Required**: `dialogueutil.input.player` or `dialogueutil.input.console`  
**Example**:
```
/dutil input player escape Player123 "&9What's your favorite color?" "Please provide feedback:" msg {player} {input} is a good choice!
```
![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1188003/description_8ed1e467-5689-4735-bac3-f362c1571960.png)
### NOTICE COMMANDS
The notice system allows you to display overlays with various types of content.
#### TEXT NOTICE: `/dnotice direct text <player> <duration> <lines>`
**Description**: Display a text-based notice overlay  
**Permissions Required**: `dialogueutil.notice.text`  
**Example**:
```
/dnotice direct text PlayerName 10 "&6Welcome!\n&eEnjoy your stay"
```
#### POKEMON NOTICE: `/dnotice direct pokemon <player> <layout> <duration> <pokemon> <use3d> <lines>`
**Description**: Display a notice with a Pokémon sprite or 3D model  
**Permissions Required**: `dialogueutil.notice.pokemon`  
**Example**:
```
/dnotice direct pokemon PlayerName LEFT_AND_RIGHT 10 "pikachu growth:ginormous" true "&6Special Pikachu!\n&eCheck it out"
```
#### ITEM NOTICE: `/dnotice direct item <player> <layout> <duration> <lines> <itemWithNbt>`
**Description**: Display a notice with an item  
**Permissions Required**: `dialogueutil.notice.item`  
**Example**:
```
/dnotice direct item PlayerName LEFT_AND_RIGHT 10 "&6Master Ball\n&eUltimate catching power" "pixelmon:poke_ball{PokeBallID:\"master_ball\"}"
```
#### NOTICE FROM CONFIG: `/dnotice config <player> <configId>`
**Description**: Display a pre-configured notice from notices.yml  
**Permissions Required**: `dialogueutil.notice.config`  
**Example**:
```
/dnotice config PlayerName welcome
```
#### OTHER NOTICE COMMANDS:
* `/dnotice hide` - Hide the current notice
* `/dnotice list` - List available notice configurations
* `/dnotice reload` - Reload notice configurations
* `/dnotice help` - Show notice command help
### RELOAD COMMANDS
* `/dutil reload` - Reload dialogue configurations
* `/dnotice reload` - Reload notice configurations
## CONFIGURATION FILES
### `config.yml`
Controls general settings and default messages.
```yaml
# Enable/Disable Debug messages
debug: false
messages:
  noMoney:
    title: "§cNot Enough Money"
    message: "§cYou need {price} to select this option!"
  noPermission:
    title: "§cPermission Error" 
    message: "§cYou don't have permission: {permission}"
```
### `dialogues.yml`
Define configurations for choice menus.
```yaml
dialogues:
  shop:
    title: "&6Shop Menu" 
    message: "&eWhat would you like to buy? &7Use &6/money &7to check your balance"
    choices:
      - text: "&aRare Candy &7($1000)"
        commands:
          - "[console]broadcast {player} got some candy"
          - "[console]give {player} pixelmon:rare_candy 1"
        price: 1000
        permission: "shop.rare_candy"
        failureTitle: "&cNo Permission"
        failureMessage: "&cYou need the &6shop.rare_candy &cpermission!"
```
### `notices.yml`
Configure different types of notices.
```yaml
notices:
  welcome:
    type: text
    duration: 10
    lines:
      - "&6&lWelcome to the server!"
      - "&eThank you for joining us"
      - "&aEnjoy your stay"
  
  professor_pikachu:
    type: pokemon
    layout: LEFT_AND_RIGHT
    duration: 12
    pokemon: "pikachu growth:ginormous form:phd"
    use3d: true
    lines:
      - "&6&lBalance:"
      - "&e%vault_eco_balance%"
  
  master_ball:
    type: item
    layout: LEFT_AND_RIGHT
    duration: 8
    item: "pixelmon:poke_ball"
    nbt: "{PokeBallID:\"master_ball\"}"
    name: "&dMaster Ball"
    lines:
      - "&6&lMaster Ball"
      - "&eThe ultimate Pokeball"
```

## PERMISSIONS
### Dialogue Permissions
* `dialogueutil.simple` - Use simple dialogues
* `dialogueutil.choice` - Use choice dialogues
* `dialogueutil.input.player` - Use input dialogues as player
* `dialogueutil.input.console` - Use input dialogues as console
* `dialogueutil.admin` - Access administrative commands
### Notice Permissions
* `dialogueutil.notice.text` - Use text notices
* `dialogueutil.notice.pokemon` - Use Pokémon notices
* `dialogueutil.notice.item` - Use item notices
* `dialogueutil.notice.config` - Use configured notices
* `dialogueutil.notice.admin` - Access notice admin commands
## DEPENDENCIES
*   NeoForge: 21.1.172 or later
*   Minecraft: 1.21.1
*   [Pixelmon](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/pixelmon): 9.3.16 or later
*   PlaceholderAPI (Optional) - For placeholder support
*   LuckPerms (Optional) - Give command access to non-op players
## FEATURES & NOTES
* Color codes with & are supported in all text
* PlaceholderAPI placeholders are supported in all text (%placeholder%)
* Multiple notice layouts available: LEFT_AND_RIGHT, LEFT, RIGHT
* NBT data support for item notices
* Command execution after notice display
* Configurable duration for all notices
* 3D model support for Pokémon notices

title: OptCraft
description: OptCraft provides ultimate control over your Minecraft performance!
body:
# OptiCraft Description

OptiCraft is a **client-side Fabric performance mod** focused on improving FPS stability, lowering stutter, and reducing unnecessary CPU/memory overhead in common gameplay scenarios.

It uses a **modular optimization system** so each performance feature can be toggled independently. You can run it in safe mode, tune individual modules, or enable aggressive presets for higher performance.

## Core Focus Areas

- **Rendering:** skips duplicate chunk rebuild scheduling where safe.
- **Client Tick:** reduces repeated allocations in hot per-tick logic.
- **Entity Handling:** caches repeated client entity lookups to reduce redundant work.
- **Memory:** canonicalizes repeated `Identifier` objects with an LRU cache.
- **IO:** uses async handling for non-critical tasks (like debounced config saves/resource sampling).
- **Networking:** reduces packet-path allocations with identifier canonicalization.

## Advanced Modes

- **Compatibility Mode:** disables high/extreme risk patches for maximum mod compatibility.
- **Maximum Performance Mode:** enables and tunes all major optimizations automatically.
- **Ultra Aggressive Mode:** pushes cache and dedupe settings further.
- **Unsafe Extreme Mode:** enables invasive FPS-first patches (particle budget limiting and short-window sound dedupe).

## Configuration + UX

- Full in-game config UI via **Cloth Config** (when installed).
- **Mod Menu** integration for one-click config access.
- Fallback config screen if Cloth Config is missing.
- Built-in debug overlay with module state + optimization counters.

## Compatibility

- Fabric client mod.
- Java 17+.
- Universal best-effort jar targeting **Minecraft 1.20.1+** with runtime-gated mixins.

title: Cobblemon Recrafted
description: The cobblemon mod to jump right in to choose your starter instead of the best mods.
body:
## About modpack
Do you just want to play minecraft and don't want to choose mods this is for you. Every mod you'll need for your cobblemon journey is in this modpack so you can start catching em all! This modpack doesn't only add cobblemon, but also addons to the mod to have even more things to do.

## About cobblemon
- Capture Pokémon to expand your team, battle wild Pokémon to gain experience, level up to unlock new moves, and evolve your Pokémon. There are over 700 Pokémon to catch!
- Battles using the Pokémon Showdown! engine for accurate competitive battle mechanics.
- Some Legends Arceus-style mechanics, such as move relearning, physically running from battle, and evolving your Pokémon when you decide.
- Toggle free-movement during battles. You can build, mine, or fight mobs while in Pokémon battles!
- Record the Pokémon you see and catch with a Pokédex. They come with a scanning feature to analyze wild Pokémon!
- You can trade and battle with your friends in multiplayer.
- Let your Pokémon roam free wherever you want using pastures!
- Berries which can be found in the wild, grown on farmland, mulched for bonuses, and cross-bred to mutate new berries.
- Medicine items can be made by putting crops and berries into a brewing stand. Brewed potions heal more!
- Ancient structures in the world to discover. Some of these structures have gilded chests, which may contain valuable loot or other surprises!
- Fossils can be found by excavating suspicious gravel or sand at certain locations, which can then be revived using a resurrection machine.
- All Pokémon from generations 1 to 9 can be spawned and battled with, but if they don't have a model yet then they will display as a substitute doll.

title: Space Update
description: dannytaylor's April Fools' 2025 "Update"
body:
# ![Space Update](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/VJngGiES/images/bbe5ae1f318ef91bb4a9e8584e20d806eccee541.png)

Introducing... space! (what a stellar idea!) This update adds not one, but TWO new dimensions! The Space Station, and The Moon!  

The Space Station is a void dimension above the overworld, that contains just one thing... the space station! If you keep going up, your gravity will soon switch as you approach the moon.  

The Moon is a dimension made of Moon Stone and is covered in craters, and contains Crystals! Moon Stone can be used to craft Moon Bricks. Not only can you craft Crystal Blocks that are difficult to break, but you can also use Crystals to craft Crystal Wings and The Pulser Block.  

The overworld gets an upgrade too with Lead (don't taste it, it's poisonous!), and a new structure "The Facility", which unless you have a way to fly beyond the height limit, and breathe without oxygen, you might just want to find... which you can do by crafting a Lead Compass!  

## Requirements  
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net)  
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)  
- [Luminance](https://modrinth.com/mod/luminance) 1.0.0-alpha.5 (Embedded, servers require the luminance jar included in this release)  
- [Minecraft](https://minecraft.net/) 1.21.4  

## 
![Caution: Flashing Lights. This mod contains flashing lights and may not be suitable for players with photosensitive medical conditions. If you experience lightheadedness, altered vision, twitching, involuntary movements, disorientation, confusion, or temporary loss of awareness, please stop playing immediately and seek medical advice.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/VJngGiES/images/58d11be49e3e2c25493c9b0d0822167063faa826.png)

## Changes  
- Updated Menu  
- Added Bloom  
- Added Lead  
- Added Lead Lamp  
- Added Space Station Dimension  
- Added Moon Dimension  
- Added Breath of the Cosmos, and Heavy Footed enchantments  
- Added Moon Stone  
- Added Moon Brick, Moon Bricks, Cracked Moon Bricks, Moon Brick Stairs, Moon Brick Slab, Moon Brick Wall, and Chiseled Moon Bricks  
- Added Crystal Ore, Crystal, Crystal Block, Crystal Stairs, Crystal Slab, Crystal Wall, Crystal Glass, Crystal Glass Pane, and Crystal Wings  
- Added Pulser Block  
- Added Steve Co. Supply Crate  
- Added Moon Slime, Moon Slime Spawn Egg, and Moon Slime Ball  
- Added Bright Day Music Disc  
- Added Moon, and Sun Painting
- Added Space Air  
- Removed Herobrine  

### Menu  
- Updated button textures to be space themed  
- Updated the title screen panorama with several space themed panoramas  
- Updated the title screen music with the following:  
  - `dtaf2025:music/devoid`  
  - `dtaf2025:music/cosmic`  
  - `dtaf2025:music/light`  
  - `dtaf2025:music/aware`  
  - `dtaf2025:music/dark`  
- Replaced box blur shader with gaussian blur shader  

### Post Effects  
#### Gaussian Menu Blur  
- This post effect replaces the menu blur shader  
- The post effect is located at: `assets/dtaf2025/post_effect/gaussian.json`  
#### Bloom  
- This post effect will always render  
- The post effect is located at: `assets/dtaf2025/post_effect/bloom.json`  
- The strength can be adjusted in the Space Station Settings...

### Dimensions  
#### Overworld  
- Lead Ores generate in the same way as Iron Ores  
- Facility Structure that generates in the `minecraft:plains` biome  
#### Space Station  
- Entities that are 96 blocks above the overworld height limit will be teleported to the bottom of the space station dimension  
- Entities that are 16 blocks below the space station height limit will be teleported to 48 blocks above overworld height limit  
  - If the entity doesn't have slow falling, they will be set on fire for 32 seconds (or until they are in water).  
- Generates a space station at `0, 64, 0` on first world generation.  
- You can't breathe here without the `Breath of the Cosmos` enchantment  
- The only biome that generates here is `dtaf2025:space`  
- Gravity is 0.16x that of the overworld, unless wearing boots with the Heavy Footed enchantment  
#### The Moon  
- Entities that are 96 blocks above the space station height limit will be teleported to 48 blocks above the moon height limit  
- Entities that are 96 blocks above the moon height limit will be teleported to 48 blocks above the space station height limit  
- The only biome that generates here is `dtaf2025:the_moon`  
- Gravity is 0.16x that of the overworld, unless wearing boots with the Heavy Footed enchantment  
### Biomes  
#### Space  
- Nothing generates here, it's a void biome.   
- You can't breathe here without the `Breath of the Cosmos` enchantment  
- The following music is played in this biome:
  - `dtaf2025:music/devoid`  
  - `dtaf2025:music/cosmic`  
  - `dtaf2025:music/light`  
  - `dtaf2025:music/aware`  
  - `dtaf2025:music/dark`  
#### The Moon  
- This dimension is made of Moon Stone, with Crystal Ore, Craters, Moon Rovers, and spawns Spiders, and Moon Slime.  
- You can't breathe here without the `Breath of the Cosmos` enchantment  
- The following music is played in this biome:  
  - `dtaf2025:music/devoid`  
  - `dtaf2025:music/cosmic`  
  - `dtaf2025:music/light`  
  - `dtaf2025:music/aware`  
  - `dtaf2025:music/dark`  

### Enchantments  
#### Breath of the Cosmos  
- When worn on head, the entity can breathe in `#dtaf2025:no_oxygen` biomes, without space air
- Found in Facility Structure  
#### Heavy Footed  
- When worn on feet, gravity returns to normal in space dimensions  
- If worn in a dimension that has normal gravity, gravity becomes 1.94x that of normal  
- Found in Facility Structure  

### Moon Stone  
- Generates in `dtaf2025:the_moon` biome, as the moon equivalent of stone  
- It can be smelted into Moon Brick, which can be crafted into its block variants  

### Crystal  
- Can be found in ore form in `dtaf2025:the_moon` biome  
- Can be used to craft Crystal Blocks, Crystal Stairs, Crystal Slab, Crystal Wall, Crystal Glass, Crystal Glass Pane, Crystal Wings, Pulser, and Steve Co. Supply Crates  
#### Crystal Wings  
- This can be crafted using 1 crystal, and 4 phantom membranes  
#### Pulser
#### Steve Co. Supply Crate  
- This can be crafted using a crystal, and a chest  
- Opens a screen that tells the player to get a Supply Crate Key from the Minecraft Store  
  - When the player presses that button, the official [Minecraft Shop](https://shop.minecraft.net/) is opened in their browser, this feature is meant as a joke  
##### Developer's Note  
We took the "Steve Co. Supply Crates" (also known as "Locked Chests") from Minecraft Beta 1.4,  
and made them link to the actual minecraft shop. See [here](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Locked_chest) for more info on the original!  
This mod contains a reference to "Supply Crates" (a.k.a. "Loot Boxes", "Crates", "Gambling"), which we do not support, nor do we endorse the use of these for exchange of real-world currency. These are predatory practices designed to cause harm, and we encourage you to avoid them.  
This reference was intended to make fun of companies that use these predatory practices.  

### Moon Slime  
#### Mob  
- Moon Slimes look similar to their overworld counterparts, but are blue instead of green  
- Moon Slimes have twice the health, movement speed, and attack damage compared to their overworld counterparts  
- Moon Slimes will attack and convert overworld slimes if they are to ever be near each other  
#### Moon Slime Ball
- Unlike overworld and nether slimes, Moon Slimes drop Moon Slime Balls which can be consumed quickly  

### Bright Day Music Disc  
- Found in Space Station and Moon loot chests  
- Plays [dannytaylor - Bright Day](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lsb9qSkNLVE) when inserted into a jukebox  
- Has a comparator output of 10  

### Paintings  
#### The Moon  
- 1x1 painting of the moon  
#### The Sun  
- 2x2 painting of the sun from the moon  
#### Facility Poster  
- 2x2 painting of a minecraft player silhouette  

### Space Air  
- Entities that are in `#dtaf2025:no_oxygen` biomes can breathe when in or next to space air  


## Attributions  
- [Emafire003/StructurePlacerAPI](https://github.com/Emafire003/StructurePlacerAPI)  
  - We forked StructurePlacerAPI for use of structure generation (specifically for the space station).  
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net)  
- [FabricAPI](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)  
- [Minecraft](https://minecraft.net/)  

##  
This mod was created for April Fools' 2025, and is likely to contain bugs. Use at your own risk.  

Licensed under LGPL-3.0-or-later.  

**This mod is not affiliated with/endorsed by Mojang Studios, Microsoft, Snow Commerce, or The Official Minecraft Shop.**  
The Minecraft Logo, name, and some game assets are property of Mojang Studios and fall under Minecraft EULA.

A small client-side mod which turns Lodestone Compasses into Markers in your world for you to see!
body:
# W.I.T.L (Where Is That Lodestone)
A simple client-side Vanilla+ mod which lets you save Waypoint Markers by using a lodestone and a compass. 

Once a marker has been made, renaming the compass will change the display name of the marker.

## Compatibility
So far this mod only works directly with [Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap), not World Map. I may possibly increase this list of compatibility in the future.

So far I have not found any conflicts, but please if you do, send them as an issue [here](https://github.com/saturn-volv/WITL/issues)!

## Disclaimer!
This mod is still a **WORK IN PROGRESS** and in such, all displays of the markers is not final and subject to change. The plan for markers is to have them change icon dependent on what the item's name is, so changing the name changes the marker icon.

# Egg Hunt
Egg Hunt is a simple and fun way to introduce a festive Easter egg hunt to your Fabric server. Players can find eggs placed all around the world, with easily customizable textures and rewards.

title: STR OreGen
description: Bukkit plugin that randomly adds extra ores to a Minecraft server world as new chunks are generated.
body:
This Bukkit plugin will randomly add extra ores to new chunks as they are generated.  At this time, only the default Minecraft ores are supported.  Currently, the ore generation only works in the Over World.  Even though the generation only takes place in the Over World, ores from any dimension may be used.


The ores are generated in spherical blobs based on a configuration file.  The default configuration file will be created after the plugin's first run.  For best use, this plugin should be used with brand new worlds.  A reproducible seed value is generated for each ore in the configuration and per each individual chunk.  If the world is deleted and regenerated and no changes have been made to the world seed or configuration, the ores will generate in the exact same locations.  Changing the world seed will change the locations where the ores generate.  Making any changes to the configuration for an ore will change the locations where the ore generates.


Here is a quick explanation of the configuration file:

```
oreGenSettings:
  - ==: OreGenSettings
    percentChancePerTry: 40.0
    maxPerChunk: 2
    ore: CLAY
    triesPerChunk: 4
    percentChancePerBlock: 80.0
    radius: 5.5
    logAttempts: 'true'
    replacedBlocks: SAND,DIRT,COARSE_DIRT,GRASS_BLOCK,GRAVEL
```

* __ore__: This is ore that will be added to the chunk.
* __radius__: The radius of the sphere to be generated.  Minimum is 0.5 and the maximum will typically be 16 but is computed on the fly and if the configuration value is larger than the computed max then the computed max will be used.
* __triesPerChunk__: This controls how many times the plugin will attempt to add the ore to the chunk.  There are several reasons why adding the ore will fail.  Minimum is 1, maximum is 50.
* __maxPerChunk__:  This is the maximum number of successful attempts to add the ore to the chunk.  Even if only one block is converted to the ore, this is considered a success.    Minimum is 1, maximum is 50.
* __percentChancePerTry__:  This is a percent value (i.e. 40 is 40%.)  If this check fails, the attempt is not successful.  This is a double sized value and can be very small so as to make some ores very rare.  Minimum is 0, maximum is 100.
* __percentChancePerBlock__:  This is a percent value (i.e. 80 is 80%.)  If this check fails, the block will not be converted to the ore.  Minimum is 0, maximum is 100.
* __replacedBlocks__:  *Optional*.  If not specified, the default list of replaced blocks will be:  GRANITE, STONE, ANDESITE, DIORITE, CALCITE, DEEPSLATE, TUFF
* __logAttempts__:  *Optional*.  If specified as 'true', both failed and successful attempts to generate the ore will be added to the server's logs.

### **Warning!** [Vault](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/) and a Permissions plugin is **required!** I recommend [LuckPerms](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/luckperms.28140/). ## Commands and Syntax ### Syntax of the `/buy` Command All subcommands explained below require the `itemshop.buy` permission node.
command syntax description permission node
help Show help for buy

multipliers See active multipliers itemshop.multipliers
### Syntax of the `/cost` Command All subcommands explained below require the `itemshop.buy.cost` permission node.
command syntax description permission node
help Show help for cost
[Material material (*)] [Integer amount (1)] See the buy cost of a material itemshop.buy.cost
set <Material material> <double cost> or /setcost ... Set the bare buy cost of a material itemshop.buy.cost.set
\*: If omitted and the command issuer is a player, `material` will be the type of the item the player is currently holding. ### Syntax of the `/sell` Command All subcommands explained below require the `itemshop.sell` permission node.

title: Osmium Sans
description: A condensed 4x8 font for high information density
body:
An 8px font created on a 4x8 grid, making it at most twice as dense as Minecraft's default font. Tries not to sacrifice readability, but it *is* a condensed font.

I don't suggest using this as a global font, but I offer it here anyway because some people like it.

This may be useful in mods that need to fit more information on screen where Minecraft's font is too wide. The font is CC0 licensed; feel free to use it for whatever you see fit.

![](https://blob.jortage.com/blobs/a/16e/a16edf482151a4286c845e587927a429fd8260e745e5d075d9222dfb7d79d299ab35237b9e815caadd399ac92dad9058826dfef2ba7830f31454cebf3fa06dba)

Currently has no accented character support.

Note that this font, when installed globally, allows you to write books and signs that contain text others with wider fonts can't see. Be careful when using it in multiplayer, as such.

It's called osmium because it's dense.

title: Advanced Fake Player
description: Spawn real players and directly possess them to control their actions without running multiple game instances.
body:
# Advanced Fake Players (Beta)

Ever wanted to test a multiplayer feature but had nobody available to join your world? Or maybe you're simply looking for new ways to have fun with your friends?

No more launching multiple Minecraft clients just to test multiplayer mechanics, mods, datapacks, command block creations, or server features.

Most fake player mods rely on chat commands, scripted actions, or limited NPC behavior. Advanced Fake Players takes a completely different approach by creating highly integrated synthetic players and introducing a Direct Possession System, allowing you to seamlessly take control of alternative players from a single Minecraft instance.

Create, possess, and interact with fully integrated fake players as if they were real accounts connected to the server.

**To spawn the player, just type: /fakeplayer spawn <name>**

## **Direct Possession System**

This is not just another AI-controlled NPC.

You can instantly transfer your camera, movement, inventory, and interactions into any spawned fake player.

### Features

*   **Full Input Redirection** – Place blocks, break blocks, attack entities, interact with GUIs, and manage inventories exactly as if you were using another account.
*   **Zero Client Overhead** – Perform multiplayer testing while running only one Minecraft client.
*   **Instant Switching** – Jump between your real player and any controlled fake player at any time.

**To control the player, just type: /fakeplayer control <name>**

## **Deep Server Integration**

Unlike traditional NPCs, fake players are integrated directly into Minecraft's player systems.

### **Authentic Behavior**

*   Trigger chunk loading.
*   Affect local difficulty calculations.
*   Participate in mob spawning mechanics.
*   Activate pressure plates and tripwires.
*   Interact with entity collisions naturally.
*   Can be targeted by hostile mobs.
*   Can appear in player selectors such as `@a`.

## **Multiplayer Support**

Fully compatible with multiplayer and LAN worlds.

It can also be used to create hilarious situations and troll your friends in multiplayer servers.

### **Multi-Control Mode (Beta)**

One of the most unique features of the mod is the ability for **multiple real players to control the same fake player simultaneously**.

This feature is currently in **beta** and may contain bugs or unexpected behavior, but it already provides a surprisingly fun and chaotic experience for testing, challenges, and cooperative gameplay.

Enable it with:

`/fakeplayer config multi_control true`

## **Requirements**

Because the Possession System the mod **must be installed on both the client and the server**.

### Supported Platforms

*   Fabric
*   Forge

**Perfect for:**

*   Mod development
*   Multiplayer testing
*   Technical Minecraft projects
*   Command block creations
*   Datapack development
*   LAN worlds
*   Dedicated servers
*   Troll your friends

## **Commands**

### **`/fakeplayer config`**

Configure mod settings.

### **`/fakeplayer spawn <name>`**

Spawn a new fake player.

### **`/fakeplayer control <name>`**

Take control of a fake player.

### **`/fakeplayer unpossess`**

Return control to your original player.

You can also use the keybind defined in the mod configuration (default: O).

# Fast & Better Vanilla

## Overview

**Fast & Better Vanilla** is a **lightweight client-side modpack** designed to enhance the raw Vanilla Minecraft experience. It focuses on **performance optimization**, **improved usability**, **UI clarity**, and **practical in-game tweaks**. This pack aims to make Vanilla Minecraft **faster, cleaner, and more enjoyable**, without altering core gameplay mechanics or server interactions.

Unlike feature-heavy modpacks or aggressive optimization packs, Fast & Better Vanilla takes a **balanced approach**: every included mod is carefully selected to improve the Vanilla experience, from performance enhancements and chat tools to optional visual improvements and quality-of-life tweaks.

---

## Important Notice

**This modpack is intended for private use only.**

Use on public servers may result in bans. The modpack creator assumes **no responsibility** for damages, data loss, or issues caused by usage. Use at your own risk.

---

![In-Game view](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6b5d5cf066c9f5611ac7134b7ebc77af06254b69.png)

## Design Goals

* Enhance overall performance and game responsiveness
* Improve user interface (UI) and chat readability
* Provide practical in-game enhancements, e.g., zoom, durability tools, chat animations
* Include optional visual enhancements such as shaders and item/tooltip improvements
* Preserve Vanilla gameplay without interfering with server rules or game balance

> The goal is to make Vanilla Minecraft **better, smoother, and more refined** while retaining its authentic feel.

* Optional visual improvements including shader support

title: Better Piglin Trades
description: Data-driven piglin bartering! Define custom trade items and loot tables via datapacks. Includes tiered trades for gold nuggets, ingots, and blocks with JEI support.
body:
## Features

**Better Piglin Trades** transforms piglin bartering into a fully data-driven system that modpack makers can customize without writing any code.

### Tiered Trading System

The mod includes three default trade tiers:

| Trade Item | Reward Quality |
|------------|----------------|
| **Gold Nugget** | Basic rewards - iron nuggets, soul sand, fire charges |
| **Gold Ingot** | Standard rewards - ender pearls, potions, obsidian (vanilla-like) |
| **Gold Block** | Premium rewards - netherite scrap, diamonds, enchanted books |

### Fully Customizable

Create your own trades by adding JSON files to your datapack:

**Trade Definition** (`data/mypack/piglin_trades/emerald.json`):
```json
{
  "item": "minecraft:emerald",
  "loot_table": "mypack:gameplay/piglin_bartering/emerald",
  "priority": 0
}
```

Then create a matching loot table with your desired rewards!

### JEI Integration

When JEI is installed, press "U" on any trade item to see all possible barter rewards. The display shows:
- The input item required
- All possible output items with average quantities

## For Modpack Makers

- **Add new trades**: Create trade definitions for any item
- **Override existing trades**: Use the `priority` field (higher wins)
- **Remove trades**: Point to an empty loot table
- **Balance rewards**: Full control over loot table weights and quantities

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge 21.1+

## Optional

- JEI (Just Enough Items) - For viewing possible barter outputs

title: EntityBatch
description: Entity Render Batching — sorts entities by type before drawing them so the GPU can render all cows together, all pigs together, etc. instead of switching between types randomly. Fewer GPU state switches = better performance in crowded scenes.
body:
EntityBatch is a lightweight client-side performance mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that boosts FPS by optimizing how entities are rendered each frame.
Features:

Entity Render Batching — groups entities of the same type together during  rendering, reducing GPU state switches and draw call overhead

Distance LOD Culling — skips rendering small entities that are too far away to see, eliminating unnecessary draw calls

Best used in: mob farms, crowded multiplayer servers, villages, and any scene with large numbers of entities
Safe to use on servers — purely client-side, no gameplay changes

title: PlasmoVoice - Mute @a | Unmute @a
description: Mute or Unmute all player at once and with custom condition
body:
## RECAP

While using the mod PlasmoVoice you can’t mute or unmute every player with the argument `@a`, and even less so with a custom condition like `@a[team=.....]` or something else.

This datapack allows you to use /vmute or /vunmute on multiple players at once instead of doing it manually one by one.

This datapack requires PlasmoVoice (obviously).

---

## HOW TO INSTALL?

Download the correct version of the datapack and place it in the datapacks folder of your world.\
Then reload the datapack by running `/reload`.

## ABILITIES :

To mute every player, use:

`/function plasmovoice_at_all:mute/run {"condition":""}`


To unmute every player, use:

`/function plasmovoice_at_all:unmute/run {"condition":""}`


> NOTE: When you mute every player, it will mute all players except you.

### If you want to be more precise in your mute/unmute you can add a condition

To add a condition, you need to modify the empty field: `{"condition":"HERE"}` with a “Minecraft-style” condition.
For example, to mute every player in the red team:
```
/function plasmovoice_at_all:mute/run {"condition":"team=red"}
```

_Also uninstall the datapack using `/function plasmovoice_at_all:uninstall`._

title: HardcoreNecromancy
description: A Minecraft Java Plugin that adds the feature to revive people in hardcore mode.
body:
## For a hardcore server.

If a player holding a totem in both hands writes the command 

```
/necro [nickname of the dead player]
```

, then both totems are used, after which the dead player is resurrected right in front of the resurrector, totem effects are applied to both players, and hunger for 5 minutes, nausea for 10 seconds, weakness and fatigue for 30 seconds are also imposed on the resurrected one.

After using the command, both players (both the resurrector and the resurrected) permanently lose 3 health hearts, the team cannot be used with 4 health hearts, while in observer mode, and on live players.

## config.yml

```
# HardcoreNecromancy Configuration
# Amount of hearts to remove from players during revival (2 hearts = 1 health unit)
hearts-to-remove: 6

# Whether to remove hearts from the reviver (person performing the revival)
# If false, hearts will only be removed from the revived player
remove-hearts-from-reviver: true
```

## messages.yml

```
# HardcoreNecromancy Messages
# Use '&' for color codes and %variable% for placeholders

console-cannot-revive: "&cYou have to be a Player to revive someone."
cannot-revive-while-dead: "&cYou can't revive people when you're dead."
player-not-found: "&cCouldn't find the player %player%"
cannot-revive-self: "&cYou can't revive yourself."
player-not-dead: "&cThis player isn't dead."
need-totems-in-both-hands: "&cYou must hold totems in both hands"
need-more-health: "&cYou need to have 4 health units."
revive-success: "&aYou've revived %player%"
revived-by: "&aYou've been revived by %reviver%"
```

## Required
[ProtocolLib](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/protocollib.1997/)

title: Crafter's Combat Logs
description: Direct info via Discord on PvP events containing inventory data, totem usage and damage exchanged!
body:
![https://i.imgur.com/fctxkl8.png](https://i.imgur.com/fctxkl8.png)

Crafter's Combat Logs is a powerful PvP logging software that I developed based on the addon billy's logs on Garry's Mod.

The server I run doesn't allow PvP without both parties agreeing and in the case of a false report, I never knew who to believe. I created this plugin since I couldn't find anything else like it online. It's been super useful and so I want to share it with others who might need a similar plugin.

You'll need to run the plugin using a discord bot, which can be set in the config. If you need any support please stop by the discord at <https://discord.gg/CraftersOne> or emailing me at <Plexiate@crafters.one>.

I've been using this plugin now with a small/medium sized server for a month or two now and it feels like I've gotten rid of all the hiccups. I do plan to make some changes to the way info is displayed in the method of collapsing each PvP event into one card. Showing the damage exchange for the actively PvPing players rather than sending new cards it would be set to one message for a very organized look. A few more changes and am absolutely open to suggestions.

## Damage Cards:

![https://i.imgur.com/aieM90z.png](https://i.imgur.com/aieM90z.png)

Damage cards are sent when a player hits, or deals damage, to another player in some direct form. The information is:

- The world's name / dimension of event.

- Coords to the location of PvP.

- The weapon used.

- Weapon's nickname if set.

- Weapon's enchants, if enchanted.

- Exact time of the event.

## Totem Cards:

![https://i.imgur.com/hgFSgHd.png](https://i.imgur.com/hgFSgHd.png)

Totem cards will send when the player uses them, regardless of if it's a PvP situation, to discord with the exact date of the event.

## Death Cards:

![https://i.imgur.com/nT6WFYk.png](https://i.imgur.com/nT6WFYk.png)

Death cards will list a lot of information, similar to the damage cards. This card is sent on the event of a player's death, regardless of PvP. You can see who/what killed the player as well as the world, location, exact time and the contents of the player's inventory at the time of death. **This will also include the contents of all shulker boxes carried.**

## Config

```
settings:

  discord_token: "YOUR_DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN"

  discord-channel: "YOUR_CHANNEL_ID"

messages:

  in-game:

    plugin-prefix: '&8[&aCraftersCombatLogs&8]'

  discord-messages: #You can use discord formatting with these.

    player-combat-message: "Player **{ATTACKER}** attacked **{VICTIM}** and dealt **{DAMAGE} damage**."
```


### Planned:

- More customization.

- Show the enchants on items in Death Cards.

- In-game data display
