title: ExtraGreetings
description: A feature-rich greeting plugin for Minecraft servers with customizable particles, titles, subtitles, action bars, boss bars, chat messages, and more.
body:
# 🎉 ExtraGreetings

A feature-rich greeting plugin for Minecraft servers with **Folia support**, **Adventure API**, **MiniMessage**, and optimized for **Minecraft 1.20.1+**.

## ✨ Features

- **🎭 Customizable Join Greetings** - Welcome players with titles, subtitles, action bars, boss bars, particles, sounds, and chat messages
- **🎪 First-Time Join Detection** - Different greetings for new players vs returning players
- **👑 VIP Support** - Special greetings for VIP players with permissions (now includes quit messages!)
- **🚪 Permission-Based Quit Messages** - VIP and regular quit messages with different effects
- **⚡ Folia Compatibility** - Full support for Folia's scheduler
- **🎨 MiniMessage Support** - Rich text formatting with gradients, colors, and effects
- **🔧 PlaceholderAPI Integration** - Support for custom placeholders
- **⏰ Cooldown System** - Prevent spam with configurable cooldowns
- **🎯 Command Execution** - Run commands on join/quit events
- **📊 Built-in Statistics** - Track player joins and active features
- **🔄 Live Reload** - Reload configuration without restarting
- **🛠️ Config Updater** - Automatic configuration updates with backup system
- **🧪 Enhanced Test Command** - Actually test greetings instead of just logging

## 📋 Requirements

- **Minecraft 1.20.1+**
- **Folia** or **Paper** server
- **Java 17+**
- **Optional**: PlaceholderAPI for additional placeholders

## ⚙️ Configuration

The plugin generates a default configuration file at `plugins/ExtraGreetings/config.yml`. Here's an example:

```yaml
# ExtraGreetings Configuration
settings:
  enableJoin: true
  enableQuit: true
  cooldownSeconds: 60
  debug: false
  joinDelay: 1

join:
  firstTime:
    title: "<gradient:#FF55FF:#55FFFF>Welcome</gradient>"
    subtitle: "<italic>%player% has joined for the first time!</italic>"
    actionbar: "<rainbow>Enjoy your stay!</rainbow>"
    bossbar:
      enable: true
      text: "Welcome, %player%!"
      color: BLUE
      style: SOLID
      duration: 10
    particles:
      enable: true
      effect: "HEART"
      count: 50
      offset: {x: 0.5, y: 1.0, z: 0.5}
      speed: 0.1
    sound:
      enable: true
      effect: "ENTITY_PLAYER_LEVELUP"
      volume: 1.0
      pitch: 1.0
    message: "<bold><gold>[+]</bold> <white>%player%</white> joined for the first time!"
    commands:
      - "give %player% diamond 1"
      - "broadcast &aWelcome new player %player%!"

  recurring:
    title: "<yellow>Welcome back!</yellow>"
    subtitle: "<gray>Enjoy your stay!</gray>"
    message: "<gray>[+]</gray> <white>%player%</white> returned!"

  vip:
    enable: true
    title: "<gradient:#FFD700:#FFA500>VIP</gradient> <gold>Welcome!</gold>"
    subtitle: "<yellow>%player% the VIP has joined!</yellow>"
    # ... more VIP settings

quit:
  # VIP quit greeting (for players with extragreetings.vip permission)
  vip:
    message: "<bold><gold>[VIP]</gold></bold> <yellow>%player%</yellow> has left the server!"
    particles:
      enable: true
      effect: "DRAGON_BREATH"
      count: 30
      offset: {x: 0.5, y: 1.0, z: 0.5}
      speed: 0.15
    sound:
      enable: true
      effect: "ENTITY_ENDER_DRAGON_FLAP"
      volume: 1.0
      pitch: 1.2
    commands:
      - "say VIP %player% has left the server!"
  
  # Regular quit greeting
  regular:
    message: "<gray>[-]</gray> <white>%player%</white> left the server."
    particles:
      enable: true
      effect: "SMOKE_NORMAL"
      count: 20
      offset: {x: 0.0, y: 0.5, z: 0.0}
      speed: 0.1
    sound:
      enable: true
      effect: "ENTITY_HORSE_SADDLE"
      volume: 0.8
      pitch: 1.0
    commands: []
```

## 🎮 Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/extragreetings` | Show help menu | `extragreetings.admin` |
| `/extragreetings reload` | Reload configuration | `extragreetings.admin` |
| `/extragreetings info` | Show plugin information | `extragreetings.admin` |
| `/extragreetings stats` | Show plugin statistics | `extragreetings.admin` |
| `/extragreetings debug [on/off]` | Toggle debug mode | `extragreetings.admin` |
| `/extragreetings reset [data/cooldowns]` | Reset plugin data | `extragreetings.admin` |
| `/extragreetings test [join/quit]` | Test greetings (actually triggers them!) | `extragreetings.admin` |
| `/extragreetings update` | Update configuration to latest version | `extragreetings.admin` |

**Aliases**: `/eg`

## 🔐 Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `extragreetings.admin` | Access to admin commands | `op` |
| `extragreetings.vip` | Receive VIP greetings (join AND quit) | `false` |
| `extragreetings.bypass.cooldown` | Bypass greeting cooldown | `op` |

## 🛠️ Configuration Updater

### ✨ Features:
- **Automatic Updates**: Updates configuration on plugin startup
- **Comment Preservation**: Maintains all your configuration comments
- **Backup System**: Creates timestamped backups before changes
- **Manual Updates**: Use `/extragreetings update` to force updates
- **Validation**: Checks for invalid sound/particle effects

### 📁 Backup Location:
Backups are stored in `/plugins/ExtraGreetings/backups/config.yml.timestamp.bak`

### 🔄 How It Works:
1. **Startup**: Plugin automatically checks for missing config options
2. **Updates**: Adds new options with default values
3. **Cleanup**: Removes obsolete configuration options
4. **Preservation**: Keeps all your custom settings and comments

### 📝 Console Messages:
```
[ExtraGreetings] Added missing config option: quit.vip.message
[ExtraGreetings] Configuration updated successfully!
[ExtraGreetings] Config backed up to: config.yml.1234567890.bak
```

## 🎨 MiniMessage Formatting

ExtraGreetings supports full MiniMessage formatting:

```yaml
title: "<gradient:#FF55FF:#55FFFF>Welcome</gradient>"
subtitle: "<italic><yellow>%player%</yellow> has joined!</italic>"
actionbar: "<rainbow>Enjoy your stay!</rainbow>"
message: "<bold><gold>[+]</gold></bold> <white>%player%</white> joined!"
```

**Available Tags:**
- `<bold>`, `<italic>`, `<underlined>`, `<strikethrough>`
- `<color:#hex>`, `<red>`, `<green>`, `<blue>`, etc.
- `<gradient:#start:#end>`, `<rainbow>`
- `<click:run_command:/command>`, `<hover:show_text:text>`

## 🏷️ Placeholders

### Built-in Placeholders
- `%player%` - Player name
- `%player_displayname%` - Player display name
- `%player_uuid%` - Player UUID
- `%online_players%` - Online player count
- `%max_players%` - Maximum players
- `%server_name%` - Server name
- `%current_time%` - Current time
- `%server_uptime%` - Server uptime
- `%plugin_version%` - Plugin version

### PlaceholderAPI Support
When PlaceholderAPI is installed, you can use any available placeholder:
- `%player_level%` - Player level
- `%vault_eco_balance%` - Player balance
- `%luckperms_prefix%` - Player prefix
- And many more!

## 🎆 Particle Effects

Supported particle effects include:
- `HEART`, `VILLAGER_HAPPY`, `FLAME`, `SMOKE_NORMAL`
- `EXPLOSION_LARGE`, `FIREWORKS_SPARK`, `ENCHANTMENT_TABLE`
- `SNOWFLAKE`, `WATER_BUBBLE`, `REDSTONE`
- **NEW**: `DRAGON_BREATH` (used in VIP quit greetings)
- And all other Bukkit particle types

## 🔊 Sound Effects

Supported sound effects include:
- `ENTITY_PLAYER_LEVELUP`, `ENTITY_EXPERIENCE_ORB_PICKUP`
- `ENTITY_ENDER_DRAGON_GROWL`, `ENTITY_HORSE_SADDLE`
- `BLOCK_ANVIL_USE`, `ENTITY_FIREWORK_ROCKET_LAUNCH`
- **NEW**: `ENTITY_ENDER_DRAGON_FLAP` (used in VIP quit greetings)
- And all other Bukkit sound types

## 🎯 Boss Bar Configuration

```yaml
bossbar:
  enable: true
  text: "Welcome, %player%!"
  color: BLUE    # BLUE, RED, GREEN, YELLOW, PURPLE, PINK, WHITE
  style: SOLID   # SOLID, SEGMENTED_6, SEGMENTED_10, SEGMENTED_12, SEGMENTED_20
  duration: 10   # Duration in seconds
```

## 🔧 Advanced Configuration

### Custom Commands
Execute commands when players join or quit:
```yaml
commands:
  - "give %player% diamond 1"
  - "broadcast &aWelcome %player%!"
  - "tp %player% spawn"
```

### VIP Configuration
Special greetings for VIP players (both join AND quit):
```yaml
vip:
  enable: true
  title: "<gradient:#FFD700:#FFA500>VIP</gradient> <gold>Welcome!</gold>"
  # Players need extragreetings.vip permission
```

### Permission-Based Quit Messages
Different quit messages based on permissions:
- **VIP Players** (`extragreetings.vip`): Special quit effects with dragon particles
- **Regular Players**: Standard quit messages

### Cooldown System
Prevent greeting spam:
```yaml
settings:
  cooldownSeconds: 60  # Cooldown in seconds
  joinDelay: 1         # Delay before showing greeting
```

## 📊 Statistics

Use `/extragreetings stats` to view:
- Total players who have joined
- Active cooldowns
- Active boss bars
- Plugin status

## 🧪 Testing System

### Usage:
- `/extragreetings test join` - Tests join greetings (shows actual effects!)
- `/extragreetings test quit` - Tests quit greetings (shows actual effects!)

### Features:
- **Actual Triggering**: Shows real greetings instead of just logging
- **Permission Detection**: Automatically detects VIP status
- **Feedback**: Shows which type of greeting is being triggered
- **Error Handling**: Provides clear error messages if something fails

## 🐛 Troubleshooting

### Common Issues

1. **Greetings not showing**: Check if join/quit events are enabled in config
2. **Particles not spawning**: Verify particle effect names are correct
3. **Sounds not playing**: Check sound effect names and volume settings
4. **PlaceholderAPI not working**: Make sure PlaceholderAPI is installed and loaded
5. **Config not updating**: Use `/extragreetings update` to manually update

### Debug Mode

Enable debug mode to see detailed logging:
```yaml
settings:
  debug: true
```

Or use the command: `/extragreetings debug on`

## 🔄 Migration

### From Other Greeting Plugins

1. **Stop your server**
2. **Remove the old plugin** and its data files
3. **Install ExtraGreetings**
4. **Configure** the new plugin using this guide
5. **Start your server**

## 🤝 Support

- **Discord**: [Join our Discord](https://discord.gg/WPYVPGbKZc)

title: Echoes Of Time
description: Adds TIME TRAVEL... back a few seconds (plus other stuff)
body:
# 🌀 Echoes of Time
Echoes of Time is a lore-rich, exploration-focused mod that expands the deep mysteries of the Ancient City and the Warden with powerful new relics, forgotten technology, and time-bending artifacts.

## 📜 Overview
Long ago, the ancients of the Deep Dark uncovered secrets not meant for mortals—fragments of time itself. With their downfall, their creations were buried in silence. Now, deep beneath bedrock and through the darkness of the Warden’s domain, you can reclaim these lost Echoes.

## 🧭 Features
### 🔮 Totem of Echoes
A powerful artifact that rewinds your position and state after death. Crafted with Warden Ribs and a Totem of Undying.
- How to Use:
The Totem of Echoes activates automatically when you die, just like a normal Totem of Undying. Instead of just saving your life, it rewinds you back in time — including your location, health, hunger, potion effects, and inventory. You’ll reappear in the exact spot and state you were in seconds before death, as if nothing ever happened.

### ⚡ Scepter of Echoes
A staff fueled by a Temporal Core, looted from the Warden. Allows you to manipulate time to evade death or strike with devastating force. 
- How to Use:
Hold right-click (or your active item button) to charge the Scepter. The longer you charge (up to 10 seconds), the further back in time you can rewind. Release the button to instantly rewind your state and location, undoing damage or escaping danger.

### ⏳ Fractured Hourglass
Ancient relics found in Ancient City loot. Used for crafting powerful items.

### 🦴 Warden Ribs
Rare drops from the Warden, used in powerful crafting recipes tied to the forgotten technologies of the Deep Dark.

## 📦 Installation
Minecraft Version: 1.20+

Modloader: Forge

## 🏁 In Progress
Performance upgrades (which will enable longer rewinds) and more time-themed items are coming soon!

## _Reclaim the past. Bend time. Awaken the Echoes._

title: Pathfinder Navigation
description: Present the route in a beautiful way
body:
What should I do if I get lost in mc? What should I do if I can't understand the map? What should I do if I have no permission to transmit? You can give this mod a try. This is a mod that helps players find the route. It is different from map mods and stone tablets. It will only show the roads to players by indicating the routes.

The existing types of wayfinding compasses are:

Stellar Compass · Navigator: An arrow is generated under the player's feet and always points towards the destination.

Stellar Compass · Foundation: It can quickly trace the route and show players the nearest route to the target point with particles.

​Stellar Compass · Pathfinder: In addition to the abilities of the previous compass, it will stop and wait for the player when they are far away. When blocked, it will find the nearest excavation route and display shovels, pickaxes, and axes to prompt the player to create a path by destruction.

​Stellar Compass · Guardian: It will slowly fly towards the target point and be able to expand the barrier. The barrier can: 1. Illuminate the surrounding blocks. 2. Stop the monster's advance. 3. Clear the approaching arrows.

Recipe:

Use items such as Soul sand to synthesize soul stone slabs, then synthesize compass cores, and further synthesize various compasses.

This is a very simple mod to make elytra flight just a little bit for flexible. Currently, it has the following features:
- Automatic swapping to elytra when you try to glide.
  - Enchanted elytra's are preferred (though specific enchantments are not checked), and if there are multiple in your inventory the one with the least remaining durability is selected. Don't ask me why I implemented it like that.
- Automatic swapping to armor when you land.
  - Armor with the best armor value is preferred, and if there are multiple with the same armor value any enchanted armor is selected (though specific enchantments are not checked).
- Hotkey to stop flying at any moment. (`V` by default)
- When you fly into water, you can immediately start swimming without needing to stop gliding first.

Please note that if you play on a server, this mod might be considered cheating. Always check if you're allowed to use this mod before doing so, or you might risk getting banned! (For which I take no responsibility)

# Create but Better

**Create but Better** is a Minecraft modpack designed to put the **Create mod** at the center of the gameplay experience. This modpack enhances the **mechanical and automation aspects** of Minecraft, allowing players to construct **intricate contraptions, efficient factories, and steampunk-inspired machinery**. But that's not all—this modpack also introduces **tons of new structures, powerful bosses, and exciting exploration opportunities**, making it a **perfect blend of creativity, automation, and adventure**.

## Features

### 🔧 Core Focus on the Create Mod  
This modpack ensures that **Create** remains the central feature, refining the vanilla experience while adding **enhanced automation possibilities**. From **mechanical power to kinetic energy systems**, everything revolves around the creativity and engineering that Create offers.

### ⚙️ Expanded Automation & Machinery  
Build **massive contraptions, transport networks, and fully automated factories** using **belts, cogs, windmills, and steam engines**. With improved mechanics and additional tweaks, automation feels **smoother and more intuitive** than ever.

### 🏰 Tons of New Structures  
The world is filled with **unique dungeons, ancient ruins, hidden laboratories, and steampunk-inspired cities**. These new locations are not just for show—many hold **valuable loot, puzzles, and challenges** for players to uncover.

### 🔄 Quality-of-Life Enhancements  
To make gameplay more enjoyable, the modpack includes **interface improvements, inventory management tweaks, and performance optimizations** that help keep large-scale builds running efficiently.

### 🤝 Compatibility & Integration  
The modpack ensures **seamless integration** between Create and other mods that complement its mechanics. Everything is carefully selected to **enhance the experience without overshadowing Create’s core mechanics**.

### 🎨 Steampunk Aesthetic  
With its focus on **gears, kinetic motion, and mechanical power**, Create but Better embraces a **steampunk-industrial style** that brings a unique and visually appealing atmosphere to Minecraft.

## Who is this Modpack for?  
If you love **engineering, automation, and creative problem-solving**, this modpack is perfect for you! Whether you’re a **veteran redstone engineer looking for new challenges**, an **adventurer eager to explore dangerous ruins**, or a **builder wanting to add movement and functionality to your creations**, Create but Better provides an **expansive toolset** to bring your mechanical and exploratory dreams to life. 🚀⚙️

title: Soulpiercing
description: Adds a new weapon inspired by the Master Sword from BOTW!
body:
Crafted using 2 Diamonds, 1 Netherite Ingot, 1 Nether Star, and 1 Stick, the Soulpiercer is a new weapon with the same stats, (attack damage, attack speed, durability, and fire-resistance), of a Netherite Sword, but with a _twist_.

When you are at full health while holding the sword, its blade will glow blue, and right-clicking it will shoot out glowing, blue beams that fly straight and deal 10 points, (or 5 hearts), of damage on contact.

The exact recipe can be found in the **Gallery**.

title: Economy API
description: Provides an API for a virtual currency in-game.
body:
# Economy API
Economy API adds a virtual currency to the game with direct and easy to use methods for managing player's money.

## Developer Wiki
A developer guide is being created at the moment and will be available in the next few days. You can join the Discord to keep updated on the progress.

## Features
Economy API has a few features to make life easier for both the developer and the player. These include (excluded the code methods that are found in the Developer Wiki):
- Player balance visible in-game and can be turned ON / OFF.
- Command to turn off the balance GUI: `/economy:showoverlay`
- More coming soon.


## Why Choose Economy API?
Economy API is your pick if you're planning to make a Forge mod like a shop, auction house, selling / jobs or just to use a currency.

### Pros:
- Easy to use and understand
- No complex methods
- Actively updated
- Can be used anywhere
### Cons:
- Doesn't support currency formatting (yet)

``` YAML
lootBonus: true
ignoreClickCancel: false
awardAdvancement: true
sound:
  enabled: true
  name: "block.crop.break"
hand:
  - &hoes
  - AIR
```

lootBonus - will the luck enchantment count\
ignoreClickCancel - will canceling a click by other plugins be ignored\

title: ChatLink
description: A simple mod to link your server and discord chat
body:
# ChatLink

A simple mod to link your server and discord chat

## Versions

| Mod Version | Supported Mod Loaders | Supported Minecraft Versions  |
|-------------|-----------------------|-------------------------------|
| 1.0.0       | Spigot, Paper, Purpur | 1.19.x, 1.20.x                |
| 1.0.1       | Spigot, Paper, Purpur | 1.19.x, 1.20.x                |

## Download

The latest version of ChatLink can be downloaded via [this link](https://modrinth.com/plugin/chatlink/versions)...

...or download the latest development built of ChatLink via [this link](https://nightly.link/sidgames5/chatlink/workflows/maven/bukkit/chatlink-latest+bukkit.jar.zip).

## Installation

1. Download a version
2. Place it in the `plugins` folder of your server
3. Run your server to generate config files
4. Make a bot for the integration in the discord developer portal
5. Make a webhook in the channel you would like to use the integration in
6. Open the config file in `plugins/chatlink/config.yml`
7. Get the channel ID for the channel you created the webhook in
8. Place all of the required information inside the config file
9. Restart your server
10. Done!

description: Weighted is a small mod that adds weighted armor and weapons to your game! With its own buffs towards combat.
body:
Weighted adds weighted weaponry and armor. Each item has a set of buffs and debuffs. For example, If you wear the Ankle Weights. You will take significant knockback reduction! (Even better than Netherite!) and you will no longer be effected by Shulkers! But to combat this new found ability. You are significantly slower and you sink in water! But do not worry! You can enchant these boots with Light Footed to remove all of these debuffs and even get a little speed boost!

You can craft these weights with one Netherite Scrap.

Add the weights to sticks in a smiting table to make a Weighted Stick (which can help you craft the weighted sword and axe)

And to make the Ankle Weights you just add one weight to a set of Iron Boots.

This mod is very small and was made in less than a day. There may be bugs and tweaks later on with the updates but I just thought this was a cool small idea to implement.

title: TC Destinations
description: TrainCarts-Addon which allows you to manage destinations in a more advanced way.
body:
# TC-Destinations
#### Requires: [TrainCarts](https://modrinth.com/plugin/traincarts), [CTCommons](https://modrinth.com/plugin/ctcommons) and a MySQL-Database
**Java-Version:** 17 or above  
**Minecraft-Version:** 1.17.1 or above  
  
TC-Destinations is a plugin for Minecraft servers using [SpigotMC](https://www.spigotmc.org), [PaperMC](https://papermc.io) or forks of these projects.   
It serves as an add-on for the [TrainCarts](https://modrinth.com/plugin/traincarts) plugin and comes along with a bunch of features to manage destinations in a more advanced way.  
It is very lightweight as database queries and network connections run completely asynchronously.
   
This plugin was developed for the [CraftTogetherMC](https://github.com/CraftTogetherMC) Minecraft server, see also: [TC-Portals](https://modrinth.com/plugin/tc-portals)!  
   
### A big thank you and lots of love go out to [TeamBergerhealer](https://github.com/bergerhealer)  
Also, a lot of appreciation goes to the people behind [Cloud](https://github.com/Incendo/cloud) and [Adventure](https://github.com/KyoriPowered/adventure)!  
  
#### Dev-Builds: [See here](https://ci.craft-together-mc.de/job/TC%20Destinations/)  
  
## Features:
- Fancy paginated list of destinations (Works cross-server in a BungeeCord network)
- Manage your destinations in a more advanced way
- Teleport to your destinations
- Set up multiple enter-messages with clickable texts using [MiniMessage](https://docs.adventure.kyori.net/minimessage)
- Dynmap integration *(A marker is created on the map for each destination)*
- Commands to get mobs on/off train(s).
- All root-commands renameable
- All texts can be customized

#### Choose your destination with `/destination`
![](https://i.imgur.com/vSkjgU3.png)

#### Clickable paginated list of all your saved destinations `/destinations`
![](https://i.imgur.com/a6VdIq0.png)
![](https://i.imgur.com/mUETMfv.png)

#### Set up multiple customized enter-messages *(enterMessages.yml)*
![](https://i.imgur.com/8qRGMM4.png)

## Commands & Permissions:

#### Select a Destination
| Command                         | Permission                            | Description                                                                       |
|:--------------------------------|:--------------------------------------|:----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `/destination`                  | craftbahn.command.destination         | Shows basic information about using the command                                   |
| `/destination <name>`           | craftbahn.command.destination         | Sets the specified destination to the currently selected train                    |
| `/destinations [type]`          | craftbahn.command.destinations        | Shows a list of all destinations                                                  |
| `/destinations [type] [filter]` | craftbahn.command.destinations.filter | Shows a filtered list of all destinations **Filter flags:** `--server` `--player` |  

#### Manage your destinations
| Command                                                  | Permissions                             | Description                                                                                                                |
|:---------------------------------------------------------|:----------------------------------------|:---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `/destedit info <destination> [server]`                  | craftbahn.command.destedit.info         | Displays detailed information about the specified destination                                                              |
| `/destedit tp <destination> [server]`                    | craftbahn.command.destedit.teleport     | Teleports the player to the specified destination                                                                          |
| `/destedit add <destination> <type> `                    | craftbahn.command.destedit.add          | Adds a new destination with the specified station type                                                                     |
| `/destedit remove <destination> [server] `               | craftbahn.command.destedit.remove       | Removes an existing destination                                                                                            |
| `/destedit addmember <destination> <player> [server]`    | craftbahn.command.destedit.addmember    | Adds a secondary owner to the specified destination                                                                        |
| `/destedit removemember <destination> <player> [server]` | craftbahn.command.destedit.removemember | Removes a secondary owner of the specified destination                                                                     |
| `/destedit settype <destination> <player> [server]`      | craftbahn.command.destedit.settype      | Specifies the type of specified destination                                                                                |
| `/destedit setowner <destination> <player> [server]`     | craftbahn.command.destedit.setowner     | Sets the owner of a destination                                                                                            |
| `/destedit setprivate <destination> <player> [server]`   | craftbahn.command.destedit.setprivate   | Specifies that this target is private. Only players with permission `craftbahn.destination.see.private` can use and see it |
| `/destedit setpublic <destination> <player> [server]`    | craftbahn.command.destedit.setpublic    | Sets this game to be viewable by all players. (This is the default setting for newly created destinations)                 |                                                
| `/destedit setwarp <destination> <player> [server]`      | craftbahn.command.destedit.setwarp      | Sets the teleport point of this target for players                                                                         |
| `/destedit setlocation <destination> <player> [server]`  | craftbahn.command.destedit.setlocation  | Specifies the position of the destination (Mainly used to locate dynmap markers)                                           |
| `/destedit updatemarker <destination> <player> [server]` | craftbahn.command.destedit.updatemarker | Renews all markers to be displayed on the dynmap                                                                           |

#### Additional commands
| Command               | Permission                 | Description                                                 |
|:----------------------|:---------------------------|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| `/mobenter [radius]`  | craftbahn.command.mobenter | Allows animals around the selected train to board the train |
| `/mobeject`           | craftbahn.command.mobeject | Ejects all animals from the selected train                  |

## Pathfinding across servers (BungeeCord)
If you're using [TC-Portals](https://modrinth.com/plugin/tc-portals) to create cross-server portals, with a little extra work,  
it is possible to reach destinations on another server.  
  
For example, if you want to drive from server1 to a destination on server2,  
you need to create a [destination](https://wiki.traincarts.net/p/TrainCarts/Signs/Destination) on server1 that leads to the portal, which leads to server2.  
Let's name it server2 as well.  
  
If you now run `/destination` to set a destination, for your train and the destination is  
on another server, TC-Destinations will create a [route](https://wiki.traincarts.net/p/TrainCarts/PathFinding#Route_Manager) for the train.  
The route then firstly contain the destination: `server2` and then afterwards,  
the destination you want to reach.   
  
Thats it!  

## F.A.Q
<details>
    <summary>Can I use this plugin without Bungeecord?</summary>
    Yes you can.
</details>

<details>
    <summary>I don't want other servers' destinations to be listed. What can I do?</summary>
    Just use separate databases or table-prefixes for each server
</details>
  
## Libraries used
- [CTCommons](https://modrinth.com/plugin/ctcommons) (CraftTogether's plugin library)
- [BKCommonLib](https://modrinth.com/plugin/bkcommonlib) (Extensive plugin library)
- [Adventure](https://docs.adventure.kyori.net) (Very neat UI-Framework for Bukkit/Bungeecord and more)
- [MiniMessage](https://docs.adventure.kyori.net/minimessage) (Text format to represent chat components)
- [Cloud](https://github.com/Incendo/cloud) (Command Framework)
- [HikariCP](https://github.com/brettwooldridge/HikariCP) (High-performance, JDBC connection pool)
- [MariaDB Connector/J](https://mariadb.com/kb/en/about-mariadb-connector-j/) (JDBC-Driver)

title: GuardStone
description: GuardStone lets you create fully protected areas in your world using special “GuardStone” blocks that can be evolved through several tiers. The owner can control who can build, what is protected, and see the zone borders in‑game.
body:
![GuardStone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5baf480692f89ba17f0ac9c850feb68d1fed8b12_0.webp)

# GuardStone – Protected Area Stones for Forge 1.20.1
GuardStone lets you create fully protected areas in your world using special “GuardStone” blocks that can be evolved through several tiers. The owner can control who can build, what is protected, and see the zone borders in‑game.

![documentation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/159ee43e17ef068f4a893d4044a0404f5135afd7_0.webp)

**Complete protection, configured by the player, base 16x16, which evolves to 24x24, 32x32, 40x40, and 64x64 (height programmable on the server). The maximum block size can be configured in the server settings, as can the ability to create the base stone. Right-click on the block to configure permissions and add or remove allied players. You can enable the visibility of the stone boundaries; two protections cannot overlap.**

## Key Features
Place a GuardStone block to create a protected zone around it.
Evolve the stone through several tiers (Iron → Gold → Diamond → Netherite) for stronger / larger protection.

Interactive GUI to:
Invite / remove trusted players.
Toggle protection flags (build, break, explosions, pistons, containers, crops, entities / item frames).

![visual border](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d5590c5deaa8c0fe47b9b6afcb766c838b7424d7_0.webp)
## Toggle a visual border preview of the zone.

Strong entity protection so players cannot loot armor stands or similar entities inside protected zones without permission.

Advancements for each evolution level in a dedicated GuardStone tab.
Server‑side configuration for vertical protection range (height & depth) so zones can cover from deep underground to build limit if desired.

![Obtaining a GuardStone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3dda5ed7eadc8e8f0bd7226f2be17e26bb35fd36_0.webp)
## Getting Started
1. Obtaining a GuardStone
Craft or otherwise obtain a GuardStone block (check the in‑game recipe book or recipe viewer mods like JEI/REI for exact recipes configured in your pack).
Place the GuardStone in the world like a normal block. As soon as it is placed:
A protection zone is created around it.
The player who placed it becomes the owner of that GuardStone.

2. Opening the GuardStone GUI
Right‑click the placed GuardStone block to open its Zone GUI.
This screen is divided into two main panels:

Left panel – Player management (owner name, invited players).
Right panel – Protection flags and border controls.
Managing Players
On the left panel you will see:

Player Name text box
Invite button
Untrust / Expel button
A list of invited players

Usage:
Type a player’s exact name into the Player Name box.
Click Invite to give them permissions inside this GuardStone zone.
To remove permissions, type their name again and click Expel.
Invited players are allowed to interact inside the zone according to the protection flags you have enabled.

![Protection Flags](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a418fece311ce0a45bfac887536a7c56fb637948_0.webp)
## Protection Flags
On the right panel you will see several toggle buttons:
Build (Construir)
Break (Romper)
Explosions
Pistons
Containers
Crops
Entities / Item Frames (Entidades/Marcos)
Each button shows a state:

BLOQUEADO – action is protected (blocked for non‑trusted players).
PERMITIDO – action is allowed.
Typical behavior:

With Build and Break set to BLOQUEADO, only the owner, trusted players, and server operators can place or break blocks inside the zone.
Explosions set to BLOQUEADO protects against TNT/creeper damage in the area.
Containers protects chests, barrels, shulker boxes, etc.
Crops protects farmland and crops from grief.
Entities/Item Frames protects things like armor stands and item frames, preventing other players from taking items or rotating/removing them.
You can adjust these flags at any time; changes take effect immediately.

Showing the Zone Borders
At the bottom of the right panel there is a button:

Show Limits: ON/OFF (Mostrar límites)
OFF – border preview is hidden.
ON – renders a yellow wireframe box around the protected area, similar to Minecraft’s F3+G chunk borders:
Full outline around the zone.
An extra horizontal slice at the camera height to make the volume easier to understand.
Multiple GuardStones can have their borders shown at once, so you can visualize overlapping or neighboring zones.

Evolving the GuardStone
GuardStones can be evolved through multiple tiers, such as:

**Iron
Gold
Diamond
Netherite**
Each evolution level:

Increases the strength / size of the protection zone (exact values depend on the mod’s configuration).
Grants a GuardStone advancement in a dedicated advancement tab.
Evolution is triggered server‑side, and when a GuardStone reaches a new tier, the owner receives the corresponding advancement (e.g., evolving to Diamond or Netherite).

Check your advancement screen to track your progress through the GuardStone evolution path.

Server Configuration
The mod provides server configuration options for:

Radius of the protection zone.
Vertical height above the stone.
Vertical depth below the stone.
Notes for server owners:

Large height/depth values can effectively protect from bedrock to build limit around the GuardStone.
Choose values that make sense for your server’s gameplay and performance.
Config comments explain the trade‑offs of very large vertical ranges (wide protection vs. performance and overlap with other stones).
After changing config values, restart the server to apply them.

Permissions and Operators
The owner of each GuardStone always has full control over its GUI and flags.
Invited players obey whatever flags are enabled.

title: Minecart Chain
description: Minecart Chain lets you connect minecarts together using iron chains and build simple vanilla-style trains. A furnace minecart can act as the engine, while an automatic brake lever appears on top of it when it is linked to another cart.
body:
# Minecart Chain Train 
Turn ordinary Minecraft minecarts into fully controllable steam trains.
Minecart Chain lets you connect carts into real train formations, convert furnace minecarts into controllable steam locomotives, and manage your train with simple lever-based controls.
Build freight trains, passenger trains, industrial railways, station yards, and steam-powered transport systems using familiar Minecraft mechanics expanded with more realistic train behavior.


## Features
Connect Minecarts with Iron Chains
Use Iron Chains to link minecarts together.
Connected minecarts move as one train, allowing you to create longer and more useful rail formations.
Steam Locomotive Conversion
Place a furnace minecart at the front of your connected train to turn it into a controllable steam locomotive.
The locomotive can pull connected wagons and reacts to throttle, brake, direction, fuel, water, and signal controls.


## Fuel and Water System
**Locomotives now require both fuel and water to drive.**


Supported fuel includes all vanilla furnace fuels, such as:
- Coal
- Charcoal
- Logs
- Planks
- Sticks
- Wooden tools
- Lava buckets
- Other standard furnace fuels
- Water can be added using water buckets.


Fuel is consumed only while the locomotive is driving.
Fuel and water usage scale with the number of connected minecarts in the train, so larger trains require more resources.
Locomotive Screen
Furnace minecart locomotives now have a locomotive screen inspired by the vanilla furnace minecart.
The screen shows:
Current fuel reserves
Current water reserves
This makes it easier to manage long-distance railway travel.

## Train Controls
- Red Lever - Brake
Control the train’s braking force.
Use it to slow down, stop safely at stations, or manage movement near junctions.
- Navy Lever - Direction
Choose the direction of travel.
Available modes:
Forward
Reverse
This is useful for switching yards, backing trains into position, and managing compact railway systems.
- Black Lever - Throttle
Control locomotive power.
Available modes:
1/3 Throttle
Full Throttle
Use lower throttle for slow movement and precise control.
Use full throttle when you need more speed or pulling power.

## Signal Rail
Signal Rail is a powered-rail-looking track that sends a redstone-driven control signal to a connected train.
Right-clicking Signal Rail cycles its mode between:
Throttle
Brake
Reverse

When powered by redstone, Signal Rail toggles the selected locomotive lever once when any cart in the connected train passes over it.
Signal Rail works through the whole chained train.
This means a passenger cart or cargo cart can trigger the locomotive controls, not only the locomotive itself.


### Signal Rail can be used for:
- Automatic braking zones
- Direction switching
- Station control systems
- Yard automation
- Redstone-based railway logic

### Signal Rail Recipe
Signal Rail uses a shapeless recipe:
Powered Rail
Redstone Torch
Lever


## Lean Out of the Wagon
Improve visibility while riding inside a minecart.
Controls:
Press A to lean left
Press D to lean right
Use this to look around corners, watch your train, check nearby wagons, and enjoy a more immersive railway experience.


### What You Can Build
With Minecart Chain, you can create:
Steam-powered freight trains
Passenger services
Industrial minecart systems
Automated redstone railways
Switching yards
Station control systems
Long-distance railway routes
More realistic Minecraft train networks

body:
![A minecraft modpack Title in the style of Minecraft base game title.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf030efe1fe488fdc5eb0780786ef7227146194f.png)
# Henkō's Creation - Vanilla Flavor

> **Important:** To ensure the best performance and compatibility, make sure you're running **Java 17** for Minecraft 1.20.1. You can download the correct version of Java from [here](https://adoptium.net/temurin/releases/?os=windows&arch=x64&package=jre&version=17).


## A Beautifully Enhanced Minecraft Adventure

Welcome to a carefully crafted Vanilla+ modpack, designed to give you the **ultimate Minecraft experience**! This pack is all about refining the game we already know and love, by enhancing performance, ironing out bugs, and polishing visuals, while still staying faithful to that classic Minecraft feel. Whether you're an explorer, a builder, or a technical player, this modpack will breathe new life into your game.

### Key Features:
- **A Seamless World Expansion:** The world generation has been completely re-imagined to offer you breathtaking landscapes and biomes, all while keeping the aesthetic style of Minecraft that we hold dear. Using mods like **Terralith** and **Tectonic**, the overworld now boasts a wide variety of new biomes, stunning caves, mountains, and forests that feel like a natural extension of the game. You’ll stumble upon vast deserts, towering cliffs, and lush valleys as if they were always meant to be part of Minecraft.

  ![An image of a landscape with rocky formations in a turquoise sea.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/120f11e50aa661d500e94470107c12d4e6a082ce_0.webp)

- **Overhauled Nether and End Dimensions:** Your adventures won’t stop at the overworld! Prepare for a completely new challenge in a **revamped Nether** thanks to **Incendium**, filled with eerie biomes, strange creatures, and structures that make survival even more intense. As for the **End dimension**, it has been vastly expanded with projects such as **Nullscape**, offering not just a final boss fight but an entire world to explore, full of floating islands, lush alien forests, and ancient ruins. Both dimensions have been re-imagined while staying true to the hauntingly beautiful tones of the base game.

- **Create Mod Integration:** While the modpack preserves much of the vanilla experience, one major gameplay addition takes center stage—**the Create Mod**. This mod allows players to build complex mechanical systems, from simple automation setups to entire factories that will blow your mind. Add-ons to the Create Mod ensure that there’s always something new to discover in your engineering and automation adventures, without overwhelming you if you're more familiar with traditional Minecraft gameplay.

### Visual and Sound Enhancements:
This pack goes beyond just gameplay improvements. It’s all about making Minecraft look and feel better, without deviating from its charm. Expect to see:
- **Enhanced lighting effects** for a more immersive atmosphere
- **Improved textures** that sharpen the world’s details without breaking the signature pixel art
- **Ambient sounds** that create a richer soundscape, helping to immerse you fully in your environment

### Multiplayer Features:
For those diving into multiplayer, the modpack introduces a few key features to enhance the cooperative (and competitive) experience! **Land claiming** allows you to protect your builds, ensuring that no one can tamper with your hard work. You can also team up with friends using the **Teams and Friends system**, making collaboration easier and more fun. Plus, with **proximity-based voice chat**, communication becomes crucial—just be mindful when exploring dangerous areas like the Deep Dark, as talking too loudly near a **Warden** could spell disaster!


### OptiFine Parity:
If you’re an avid user of **OptiFine**, you’ll be pleased to know that this modpack supports most of the features you’re familiar with:
- **Shaders** for more realistic lighting and reflections
- **Connected textures** that allow blocks like glass and bookshelves to look seamless
- The famous **zoom function** that lets you see distant details
- **OptiFine-required resource packs**, so you can bring in all your favorite visual enhancements with ease

### Built for Everyone: From High-End PCs to Low-End Machines
We understand that not everyone is running on a high-end gaming PC, and this modpack is designed to offer **maximum flexibility**:
- For high-performance machines, the inclusion of mods like **Distant Horizons** gives you insane render distances, offering breathtaking views that stretch as far as the eye can see.
- For those with lower-end PCs, simply disabling shaders and a few demanding options (such as Distant Horizon) will allow you to achieve **smooth gameplay comparable to competitive gaming clients**. So, no matter your setup, you’ll be able to enjoy everything this modpack has to offer!

### Perfect for Long-Term Play
This modpack was created with a **long-term multiplayer server** in mind for friends to enjoy together, but it’s equally well-suited for solo adventures or your own server. We’ve built this pack to grow and evolve over time, with **frequent updates** ensuring you always have something new to explore, fix, or optimize.

Feel free to dive into this Vanilla+ modpack, whether you’re looking to explore new biomes, perfect your engineering skills, or just enjoy the beauty of Minecraft with a fresh twist. We’ve balanced everything to make sure the game feels like a **natural extension** of the base experience, perfect for long-term play without losing that familiar Minecraft magic.

Happy crafting and exploring!

- **Vein of Unity**: Instantly mines all connected ore blocks.
- **Ore for all**: 50% chance nearby comrades also receive your ore drops.

Stalinium Shovel: 8.5 Attack Damage
- **Path of Progress**: Digs a 3x3 area.
- **To each according to their labor**: Mining grants Haste II to you, and Haste I to nearby comrades.

Stalinium Hoe: 8 Attack Damage
- **Rain Dividend**: Rain doubles your harvest yields.
- **Shared Bounty**: 50% chance your comrades get the same crop drops as you.

#

**Stalinium Armor**
![Stalinium Armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9b4f2886f825100cdfe76b86ac24a1f1b34dd2d.png)

Stalinium Helmet: 6 Armor
- **Watchful Comrade**: Hitting an enemy marks them for everyone to see.

Stalinium Boots: 6 Armor
- **March of Progress**: Sprinting for 5 consecutive seconds gives you and all allies within 5 blocks Speed I for 5 seconds.

Stalinium Chestplate & Leggings: 10/8 Armor
- **Iron Will of the Collective**: When wearing the chestplate alongside the leggings, gain Resistance I.

Full Armor Set Bonus: 
- **Power of the Many**: Gain more hearts the more allies are nearby.

#

**Stalinium Press**

![Stalinium Press](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8a4118a2ff494c888a36ecc27a97e9178ad80d97.png)

Turns 9 Stalinium nuggets, 1 redstone block and one lava bucket into 1 Stalinium ingot. Takes 30 seconds to do so.

#
**Potions**

Using 3 awkward potions and a potato, you can craft Vodka:

![Vodka](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/QfGbkvp6/images/0fc6ed5456f0eaad515ef86ba06c3a59993a7f51.png)

It gives you Nausea for 1 minute.

Using 3 bottles of vodka and a Stalinium ingot, you can craft Weapons Grade Vodka:

It gives you knockback immunity, +3 attack damage, +22.5% attack speed and +30% movement speed for 1 minute.
#

**Party system**

Use
```
/comrade party create
```
 to create a party
 #
 Use
```
/comrade party invite <player_name>
```
 to invite a player. If you are not in a party already, it automatically creates a party. 
 #
 Use
```
/comrade party accept <leader_name>
```
 to join a party you've been invited to.
 #
 Use
```
/comrade party remove <player_name>
```
 to remove a member from your party. Only usable by the party owner. 
 #
 Use
```
/comrade party list
```
 to list all members in your party.
 #
 Use
 ```
/comrade party leave
```
to leave a party (only works if you're not the leader).
#
Use
```
/comrade party disband
```
to disband the party (only works if you're the leader)
#
You cannot hurt members of your party and they cannot hurt you. Also makes Stalinium Effects apply to these members.
</details>

title: Crafter Spells
description: CrafterSpells introduces a collection of utility spells to enhance your Minecraft experience, inspired by the Summoner Spells from League of Legends.
body:
![Crafter Spells](https://i.imgur.com/sn0FMPD.png)

# CrafterSpells

CrafterSpells introduces a collection of utility spells to enhance your Minecraft experience, inspired by the Summoner
Spells from League of Legends. This magic system is designed to complement vanilla gameplay while adding new strategic options for players.

![Spells Menu](https://i.imgur.com/sOnIOIB.png)

## How to Use

All Crafter Spells are given to players by default and can be viewed and selected by accessing the Craft Spells screen by pressing the `M` key (Default).
At any one time, only two Crafter Spells can be assigned from the menu in two dedicated spell slots that appear next to your hotbar. Press the assigned keys (default: `V` and `B`) to cast the spell in each slot. Some spells have immediate effects, while others have cooldowns or special mechanics.

## Spells List
<details>
### Barrier

Creates a magical barrier around you that increases your armor rating and renders a translucent shield effect. The barrier absorbs incoming damage, protecting you from harm.

**Effect:** Increases armor rating
**Duration:** 10 seconds
**Cooldown:** 20 seconds

---

### Bore

Creates a tunnel through solid blocks in the direction you're looking. Perfect for mining or creating quick pathways through mountains.

**Effect:** Bores a cylindrical tunnel (radius 1, length 12 blocks)
**Cooldown:** 40 seconds
**Note:** Doesn't affect bedrock or liquids

---

### Ghost

Transforms you into a ghostly form, allowing you to move 20% faster and pass through solid blocks. Perfect for exploration and escaping tight situations.

**Effect:** 20% increased speed, no-clip through blocks, partial invisibility
**Duration:** 10 seconds
**Cooldown:** 40 seconds

---

### Growth

Enriches the soil in a radius around you, causing crops to instantly grow. A helpful spell for rapid farming and food production.

**Effect:** Instantly grows crops in a 6-block radius
**Cooldown:** 120 seconds
**Note:** Similar to bone meal but affects multiple plants simultaneously

---

### Heal

Restores a portion of your missing health and can also heal a nearby ally you're looking at. A vital spell for survival and team play.

**Effect:** Heals 40% of missing health (minimum 2 health points) for you and a targeted ally
**Range:** 16 blocks for ally targeting
**Cooldown:** 40 seconds

---

### Nourish

Quickly restores hunger and saturation for you and an ally you're looking at. Never worry about food during long expeditions again!

**Effect:** Restores 60% of missing hunger and 40% of missing saturation
**Range:** 16 blocks for ally targeting
**Cooldown:** 120 seconds

---

### Saturate

A combat spell that drains the hunger of opponents, preventing them from sprinting. Gives you a strategic advantage in PvP encounters.

**Effect:** Reduces target's hunger by 8 points, sets saturation to 0, and applies Hunger effect
**Range:** 20 blocks
**Cooldown:** 120 seconds

---

### Snowball

A two-phase spell. First cast throws a magical snowball that marks the first entity it hits. Second cast teleports you directly to the marked entity.

**Phase 1:** Throws a snowball projectile that marks the first entity hit
**Phase 2:** Teleports to the marked entity
**Range:** 20 blocks (projectile), 50 blocks (teleport range)
**Cooldown:** Only applied after teleportation or if the snowball misses - 40 seconds
</details>

## Planned Features

- Additional spells with unique effects
- Configuration
- Multi-Language Support

title: Death note
description: Adds a death note that kills a random player on the server.
body:
Adds a fun tool for pranks on servers!

# 📜 Features
## Death Note

- Single-use item: Disappears after activation.
  
- Random target: Selects any online player (except yourself) when used.
  
- Delayed effect: The chosen player dies after 30 seconds.

## Visual effects:

- Soul particles around both players.
  
- soul_escape sound effects on activation.
  
- Death cannot be prevented (ignores armor and potions).
  
- How to Obtain

Drops from Evokers with a 5% chance (in addition to standard drops).

# 🎯 Usage
## Activation:

- Hold the Death Note → Right-click (RMB).
  
- Soul particles and sound effects will appear.

## Mechanics:

- Once used, the particles swirl around the target.
  
- At 30 seconds → instant death.
  
- If the target leaves the game before the timer ends → effect is canceled.

title: BetterLinks
description: A packet based server links plugin.
body:
# BetterLinks

BetterLinks adds support for the new server links feature in 1.21+. This adds a new button to the game menu, which when
pressed will bring you to a new menu with buttons showing customizable text heading to customizable URLs.

This project and its collaborators use the following regularly and are thankful for their maintenance:
- [PacketEvents](https://github.com/retrooper/packetevents)
- [sharkbyte-configuration](https://github.com/amnoah/sharkbyte-configuration)

## Photos

![game menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e352b1187eb17cc12b0b7ccd168af3635dc8a904_0.webp)

![links example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cea2b51b1b0b09fb3b3f1a095770b179bbc608a5_0.webp)

## Requirements

This plugin only supports 1.21+ on platforms with an existing BetterLinks implementation. This includes Spigot,
Paper (and its forks), Folia, Sponge, and (soon) Fabric.

## Quick Feature Breakdown
- Platform independent design.
- Fully packet-based.
- Color code support.
- Weight-based, allowing for sorting.

For individual platform features, please check each module.

# Documentation

Please check the [BetterLinks wiki](https://github.com/amnoah/BetterLinks/wiki).

Necessary documentation will either be included in the config file or in the wiki.

For general support, please join my [Discord server](https://discord.gg/ey9uTg3hcy).

For issues with the project, please open an issue in the issues tab.

Our main currency this season aren't diamonds, instead we have Sevayic Shards, Sevayic

Every week missions will be given out randomly, you need to right click a "Mission Log Block" to get your missions granted to you, which then you can use ``/missions`` command to see this weeks missions.

Missions have 5 difficulties:
Easy missions can be completed without much preparation, and they can be completed by yourself
Medium and Hard Missions are harder, and require witnesses to complete.

Assigned missions are created by admins and require the person who made them to grant them to you. These missions will be given out my the people in our server working on big projects! For example if someone is working on a Zoo, they can make an assigned mission for the delivery of a Warden, we promote projects so the payment for these missions come out of the server, not the project owner.

Eternal missions are missions that you have to keep going for the rest of the server, they are generally for opening and maintaining a shop. After being paid for them if you can't maintain a shop you will lose the mission and have to pay the 1.5x the reward as a penalty.
</details>


<details>
<summary>The Sevayic Trader</summary>
The wandering trader has gotten quite the upgrade, and now it trades using sevayic materials, and all of it's trades are active at all times, it's trades upgrade as more milestones are complete and it will help you get the grindier items much easier. And who knows, it might help you get some special items as well.
</details>


<details>
<summary>Side Milestones</summary>
Aside from unlocking dimensions, the Milestones will also let you unlock the following mods:

- [Patbox's Brewery](https://modrinth.com/mod/brewery)
- [More Tools](https://modrinth.com/mod/more-tools)
- [Glide Away](https://modrinth.com/mod/glide-away)
  
</details>

<details>
<summary>Lenient Death</summary>
When you die your tools/weapons/armor will no longer drop. You still will need to go back and pickup everything else.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Changes to Villagers</summary>
Villagers have once again been majorly nerfed, 
  
- You no longer get XP out of trading
- High Quality Foods (Cooked Porkchops, Chickens, Golden Carrots) are badly prepared. Meaning that they have a 10% chance to give you Hunger when eaten.
- Diamond Items Sold by the Villagers are shoddily made, they are tiered between Iron and Regular Diamond tools.
- The Librarian villagers no longer sell enchanted books, instead they sell soul lanterns, chiseled bookshelves and tinted glass.

To balance this out, villagers no longer need to restock any of their trades!

</details>

<details>
<summary>Changes to Enchanting</summary>
  
Not only is there [revamps to the existing enchantments](https://modrinth.com/datapack/seva-ya-new-enchants) the modpack also has [new enchants](https://modrinth.com/datapack/seva-ya-new-enchants). All of these enchants but Sculk Thrive can be obtained from the enchanting table, including curses.

With the enchanting table "weakened" and the villager trades gone, there needs to be a new way to get enchantments repetably. This is where the Enchanting Trims come to play. With the enchantment trims, a book and some sevayic currency on a smithing table you can get any Max Level Book you want given you have it's trim, just like other Trim Templates these can also be duplicated. 

To see how to obtain each enchantment there's a tab on the advancements screen.
</details>


<details>
<summary>New Food and Fishes?</summary>
We are planning to add more Fishes and Food to the game, sadly these features are not ready yet.

For now the only one we have is that Hoglins now drop Chewy Porkchops, a porkchop that takes longer to eat and gives slightly less saturation/hunger. 
</details>


<details>
<summary>Changes to Farming</summary>

Thanks to [Harvest with ease](https://modrinth.com/mod/W4Ajthd2), while holding a hoe you can right click crops to auto harvest them and even get some XP out of it. Better hoes have a bigger range but do keep in mind that this takes durability away from your hoe.

[Hoes also have bigger ranges based on their size when tilling](https://modrinth.com/mod/9vlChzlU).
</details>

<details>
<summary>Changes to Recipes</summary>
Alongside some recipes to make the game easier, we also have some nerfs to some recipes.

- Flight Rockets now require fire charges to craft, alongside that fire charges now also can't be crafted with charcoal.
- Tuff can be crafted with cobblestone and gravel 
- Calcite can be crafted with diorite and bonemeal
- Soul Sand can be blasted to Tinted Glass
- Tuff and Calcite can be used to craft concrete with 3 times the yield
- Powered Rails can be crafted with copper (Vanilla Tweaks)
- Most items can be redyed (Vanilla Tweaks)
- All stone can be used for stone tools ([Stone is Stone](https://modrinth.com/mod/P4chhBIh))
</details>


<details>
<summary>Changes to World Generation</summary>
Just like every other Seva ya Season, the world generation is made to be more exciting.
This time we will have: 
  
- [Terralith](https://modrinth.com/datapack/terralith)

- [Amplified Nether](https://modrinth.com/datapack/amplified-nether)
 
- [Nullscape](https://modrinth.com/datapack/nullscape)
  
- [Structory](https://modrinth.com/datapack/structory)
  
- [Repurposed Structures](https://modrinth.com/mod/repurposed-structures-fabric)
  
- [Underground Rivers](https://modrinth.com/mod/Y7J94SaP)
  
</details>



<details>
<summary>Vanilla Tweaks</summary>
We have the following Vanilla Tweaks Datapacks enabled:
  
- Armor Statues: You can use ```/trigger as_help``` to get the armor stand book, this book can be used to edit armor stands. An item frame with this book can also be powered to animate armor stands
- Custom Nether Portals: Nether Portals can be in any shape and can include crying obsidian
- Mini Blocks: Mini blocks can be crafted using a stone cutter for most blocks in thge game
- Silence Mobs: You can disable the sounds of any mob by naming it "silence_me"
- Storm Channeling: You can throw a channeling trident directly upwards at world height, this will use 60% of your trident's durability
- Anti Enderman Grief: Endermen no longer pickup/drop blocks
- AFK Display: AFK players will have their names turned into gray
- Coords HUD: By using ```/trigger display_hud``` you can view your coords and time
- Nether Portal Coords: By using ```/trigger nether_portals:nether``` or ```/trigger nether_portals:overworld``` you can calculate the coordinates where a nether portal should be.
- Workstation Highlights: By using ```/trigger villager_workstation:show``` while looking at a villager you can see where it's workstation is.
</details>


<details>
<summary>Carpet</summary>
We have the following Carpet Patches active:

- persistentParrots: Parrots will not fall from your shoulders when you take really small damage
- renewableDeepslate: Deepslate will generate instead of cobblestone under Y=0 when flowing lava touches water.
- lagFreeSpawning: Optimized mob spawning
- missingTools: Glass can be broken fast with a pickaxe.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Some other features</summary>
  
- [Bundle as Quiver](https://modrinth.com/mod/IN9qauZM): Your bow can pull items from your bundles
- [Camera Obscura](https://modrinth.com/mod/camera-obscura): Allows you to take images from inside the server and turn them into maps
- [CopperGratesBubbleThru](https://modrinth.com/mod/NJiz0kE3): Copper Grates don't block bubble elevators
- [Ice Prevents Crop Growth](https://modrinth.com/mod/6rPhicfw): Ice under farmland freezes the crops on that farmland in place
- [IndyPets](https://modrinth.com/mod/indypets): Animals can be put into wander mode, so you don't need to make them sit at all times, they can later be called with goat horns 
- [Just Mob Heads](https://modrinth.com/mod/jzTUm9hE) and [Just Player Heads](https://modrinth.com/mod/YdVBZMNR): Mobs and players drop their heads when they die
- [Lil Guy](https://modrinth.com/mod/9srQd7ap): Named baby mobs don't grow up

- [Seeking Hearts](https://modrinth.com/mod/4ATKNIA0): Creaking Hearts give redstone comparator energy equal to how close to the center they are to someones screen

- [Where Is It](https://modrinth.com/mod/FCTyEqkn): use ```/whereis``` to see where an item is in containers around you

title: Expensive Boats
description: Makes boats a late-game item: crafting requires a netherite ingot, implied to be the keel (some imagination required)
body:
Boats have been in Minecraft since the early days, and they let you travel vast distances across water from day one with minimal resource investment. These are one of the few features of the game that I actively dislike, and here's why.

A basic boat requires just five planks. That's it. You can craft one immediately after punching your first tree and suddenly cross entire oceans at high speed. Water goes from being a major obstacle to a highway you can access instantly.

This fundamentally changes how you approach the world. Instead of water creating natural boundaries that shape your exploration, you can sail off into the sunset whenever you want. Distance becomes meaningless when you can cross thousands of blocks in minutes with almost no preparation.

### Early game exploration

Think about your typical early game progression. You spawn, gather basic resources, and then you can craft a boat and sail to any biome you want. You can reach structures, villages, and resources that *should* feel like major discoveries, all without any real investment or journey.

Water also becomes a safety net. If you're cheap like me, you've probably spent at least one early-game night on a boat just to get away from hostile mobs on land. Instead of engaging with the gameplay loop (building proper shelter or dealing with the night cycle) you just explore islands and shipwrecks until dawn. It's an easy escape that removes the pressure of early survival.

When boats are cheap, water exploration has no significance or stakes.

## Expensive Boats

This data pack changes the boat crafting recipe to require a bottom layer of wood, a netherite ingot, and wood (underneath the normal recipe). This is implied to be the boat's ballast and keel - you'll just have to pretend it's not a dinghy.

With netherite required, boats become an investment. You need to progress through the game, explore the Nether, and commit valuable resources before you can sail vast distances. Water travel becomes something you earn rather than something you get for free.

When boats are expensive, crossing water feels meaningful again. You plan your journeys, you consider whether the trip is worth the resource cost, and reaching distant shores feels like an accomplishment.

I think this is more fun when used in combination with [No Sprinting](https://modrinth.com/datapack/no-sprinting) and [No Sprint-Swimming](https://modrinth.com/datapack/no-sprint-swimming), to make movement more intentional and distance more meaningful.

body:
![Thumbnail](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4be6d77f4db89ef930db85f4ef0206fba46bd602.png)

# **Welcome to Minecraft Overhauled!**  

Minecraft Overhauled is a carefully curated collection of mods, resource packs, and shaders designed to take your Minecraft experience to the next level. This pack transforms the game with enhanced world generation, countless new structures, and endless opportunities for exploration.  

Perhaps you'll find yourself trading in **ChoiceTheorem’s Overhauled Villages** or venturing deep into one of the many scattered dungeons. Every corner of your world holds something new to discover!  

If you love building, **Chipped** adds an incredible variety of blocks, letting you customize every detail of your world. Want to turn that dream base into a cozy home? **Handcrafted** brings stylish furniture and decorations to make your builds feel truly lived-in. **Supplementaries** expands your building options even further with interactive and functional decorations, making every corner of your world more immersive.  

Exploration has never been more exciting—**Moog’s many structure mods** and **Structory** fill your world with new dungeons, ruins, and settlements, ensuring there's always something fresh to stumble upon. **Regions Unexplored** breathes life into the Overworld with stunning new biomes, from lush forests to treacherous wastelands. And the adventure doesn’t stop there—**BetterNether** turns the Nether into a fiery realm of dense forests and eerie ruins, while **BetterEnd** transforms the End into a mystical dimension with glowing plants, unique biomes, and towering spires.  

To make your travels easier, the **Waystones mod** lets you set up teleportation points, making long journeys a breeze. And as you explore, keep an eye out for **Artifacts**, powerful gear hidden in chests and dungeons that grant unique abilities to aid you on your adventure.  

Of course, visuals and immersion matter just as much. The **Fresh Animations** resource pack brings Minecraft’s mobs to life with fluid, expressive movements. **LambDynamicLights** ensures that torches and lanterns glow dynamically, casting realistic light as you carry them.  

Worried about performance? Don't be! While this pack enhances visuals and gameplay, it also includes optimization mods working behind the scenes to **keep everything running smoothly**. Whether you're exploring breathtaking landscapes or battling through dungeons, you'll get the best performance possible.  

I hope you enjoy this modpack and all the adventures that await!

title: Downpour
description: Expand upon the rain with ritual magic!
body:
![https://i.imgur.com/BX5VfrG.png](https://i.imgur.com/BX5VfrG.png)
## **Summary**
<center>Downpour is a mod that adds new and exciting content revolving around the rain, featuring several biomes, useful tools, and structures, including one you can build yourself.


**From redstone to the Nether to hidden secrets, no place is safe from the influence of the power of rain.**</center>

## Note
Downpour adds a new recipe for gunpower; keep this in mind. It can be crafted with 2 sand blocks and 2 coal pieces.

![https://i.imgur.com/2Ot7pZP.png](https://i.imgur.com/2Ot7pZP.png)

There are two ways of obtaining one of the primary building blocks of Downpour:
- 
- Crafting with 2 deepslate and gunpowder
  
- Finding a ruined altar and mining it

These are sigil bits. With iron nuggets and gold nuggets, you can upgrade them into slate, which can be used to for the most important early-game aspects of the mod, such as building your first functional altar.

## Building your first altar

Once having obtained Sigil Slate, it's time to acquire the blocks needed to create the rain altar. 



With 4 slate and 1 stone (it has to be regular stone), you can create a Blank Sigil. You will need 17 of these to proceed.



Aqua Slate is the next thing required to move on. You can craft these with a Sigil Slate, three Lapis Lazuli, and a diamond. You will get them in bundles of four.

These alongside regular Sigil Slate and some torches can make Rain Candles. You will use these as part of the Altar.

A Rain Sigil Block can be crafted by surrounding a Blank Sigil with four Aqua Slate.



2 Aqua Slate, 3 Blank Sigils, 1 Rain Sigil Block and 1 Rain Candle is what you will need to build the most important block in the mod, the Aquaifier. You can use it to construct the altar automatically by feeding it necessary materials.



Feed them to your Aquaifier and you will have created your Rain Altar.

---

### But there is so much more to do in this mod! Check out these cool biomes:

title: CivPak
description: A relatively minimal modpack made to enhance the experience on 'civ' type servers. This pack is specifically formulated around CivMC and its rules, so if you use this pack on another server, do your own research to make sure everything here is compliant!
body:
# CivPak
Unofficial modpack aimed for use on multiplayer servers with Civ plugins

## What is this for?
CivPak is a fairly lightweight modpack built on Fabric intended to enhance 'Civ' style minecraft servers—that is, servers usable on a vanilla client featuring the block reinforcement plugin Citadel, and the block-based in-game action-tracking plugin JukeAlert. This pack was built specifically with the server CivMC in mind, and has been formulated around its rules.

## Mod Selection
Includes:
* Journeymap with a custom config designed to be as compliant as possible with CivMC's rules. (if you have performance issues, I recommend turning the entity radar off)
* GammaUtils for a more customizable fullbright experience compared to the server's freely available in-game /gamma command (which simply provides the Night Vision effect).
* The Snitch Mod to provide better management, placement, and visualization of owned snitches on a Civ server.
* LambDynamicLights for a generally more immersive experience using torches and other light-emitting blocks/items. **I recommend setting this mod to *fast* in its settings/config for a good balance between performance and quality on the vanilla client.**
* Various performance optimization mods including Sodium.

## Disclaimers

### About Server Rules
If you play on any server with this modpack, please review that server's rules and/or verify with that server's admin(s) to ensure everything on here is allowed. I've done my best to make sure all the mods here are above board, but some servers may have particularly strict rules and I'd always recommend due diligence to avoid any bans.

### Modpack Non-Officiality (unless specified otherwise by authorized parties)
**This modpack shall not be acknowledged to be official in any capacity for play on CivMC or other minecraft server, and shall not be construed as such, unless stated in a publicly available capacity by such server's owners or authorized persons to make that decision.**

### Licensing
This curated collection of mods does not carry a preset license due to differing and potentially incompatible licenses of constituent mods. **The license, or lack thereof, on this collection shall not be construed to provide rights to the end user that may or may not conflict with those outlined by the licenses of any mods contained witin, and use of said mods is still subject to their individual terms on an individually-considered basis.** Due to this individually-considered relationship between end-users and mods, users should carefully consider potential consequences for redistribution of this pack outside of the Modrinth platform. Due to the unique nature of the agreement Modrinth requires from Authors for content hosted on the Modrinth Platform under its [Terms of Use](https://modrinth.com/legal/terms), privileges implicitly granted here by said Terms may not apply elsewhere.

Any unique assets created by the pack author (CrazyGrape) provided by this modpack are to be considered under an All Rights Reserved basis unless otherwise specified.

title: World Balance
description:
An attempt at nerfing unbalanced features.
Structures are rarer, villages always spawn abandoned, no Trader Llamas, convert Wandering Trader to a Villager & more!
body:
Minecraft is currently pretty poorly balanced, I made these changes to try improve it somewhat. There's many more changes I want to make, but here's an early version of the pack!

# Features:

## 💎Wandering Trader tweaks
- added trade to convert them to a villager
- will not spawn with trader llamas anymore

_Now killing him truly does not give you anything, and he is happy to convert to a villager for some cake!_

![Wandering Trader has a cake trade to convert him to a Villager](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/YX5Oloic/images/80e8af085476f6025a24102891f9b426fe6f692a.png)

I suggest also using a datapack to change the Wandering Trader's trades to be more useful.

## 🏘️Village tweaks
- all generated villages are abandoned, only spawning zombie villagers
- villages are way rarer, ~2k blocks between them
- removed hay bales, animals and crops from villages
- adjusted village chest loot, removing tools, armor, obsidian, diamonds, changing ingots to nuggets and reducing amounts of other items

_Villages give players way too much free stuff for being a peaceful structure. My solution is to make them abandoned, rarer and removing most of the loot. This way if you do find one its special and you have to use other ways to get villagers (curing or wandering trader)._

I also suggest using these two datapacks to balance villagers:
- [Villager Restock Balance](https://modrinth.com/datapack/villager-restock-balance)
- [Librarian's Balance](https://modrinth.com/datapack/librarians-balance)

## 🐪Other tweaks
- camels will now spawn naturally in deserts
- cave spiders spawn in deserts at night instead of normal spiders (due to them being similar to scorpions)
- made ruined portals generate more rarely
- made rabbit jump height a bit higher so they dont get stuck on edges of blocks as often

title: RainControl
description: A serverside Fabric mod to allow full customization of rain & thunder
body:
# Description
RainControl is a simple server side Fabric mod which allows the user to configure the time between rain, the duration of rain, the duration of thunder and also the chance of a thunderstorm.

# Config
The config file is found at /config/RainControl/config.acfg with a default configuration of:
```
# The minimum and maximum amount of time you want clear weather to last, in ticks. Defaults are set to vanilla
min_clear_weather=84000
max_clear_weather=180000
# The minimum and maximum amount of time you want rainy weather to last, in ticks. Defaults are set to vanilla
min_rainy_weather=6000
max_rainy_weather=24000
# The minimum and maximum amount of time you want thunder to go on for, in ticks. Defaults are set to vanilla
min_thunder_weather=3600
max_thunder_weather=15600
# The minimum and maximum amount of time you want between thunder storms, in ticks. Defaults are set to vanilla
# Note: The maximum you pick will not necessarily be the in-game maximum, as thunder and rain have to coincide for the game to allow thunder
# This means that the chance of a thunderstorm also relies on rain, so if you set the time between rain to be a high value, you might want to lower these values
min_clear_thunder=10000
max_clear_thunder=160000
```

As you can see everything is commented, and should be fairly self explanatory - but if you do need any help don't hesitate to ask me in the GitHub issue tracker. Since values are in ticks it is important to remember that 20 ticks typically is 1 second in real time, and that an in-game day has 24000 ticks.

# Other

The mod is open source, so you can checkout the repo [here](https://github.com/LordNoisy/RainControl) should it be of use to you :)

Hopefully this mod can provide some use to you :)

title: Simplified Backpacks
description: Simple Backpacks with nifty addons!
body:
# <center>Simplified Backpacks!</center>
<center>

[![Support](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9d2c289db211cf86af07adb3d181b4ea5624296.png)](https://discord.gg/V3DTUtgGeG)

</center>

_This mod needs [Trinkets Updated](https://modrinth.com/mod/trinkets-updated) to work!_
_For 1.21.8, use [Trinkets Canary](https://modrinth.com/mod/trinkets-canary)._

Simplified Backpacks adds a simple Backpack, which can be upgraded to various tiers, with each one increasing the amount of rows in the backpack!

![A Backpack resembling a tiny Chest sitting on some Oak Planks.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9d5d199ed1cef1a4bfb9ae60c4f477f21206c25e.png)

Backpacks are placeable by sneaking and right-clicking on a block. You can pick them back up by either sneaking and right-clicking, or by breaking the Backpack block.

### Translation Credits
English, German, Pirate Speak and LOLCAT by flingus

English (Upside Down), Shakespearean English, Anglish by skyrpy

Russian by HafniuMark

## <center>Addons</center>
Backpacks can have Addons, which give a new function to each Backpack that has one.
Backpacks can only contain one Addon at a time, without commands.

### Sorting
The Sorting Backpack Addon adds two buttons.

- One of the buttons sorts the inventory by either Alphabetical order, or by item count.
- The other button transfers matching items from your inventory into the backpack.

### Magnetic
The Magnetic Backpack Addon also adds two buttons.

- One of the buttons toggles the Magnetic item pickup.
- The other button toggles, whether or not to filter picked up items.

The filter filters picked up items into the Backpack if the Backpack contains atleast one of the item you picked up.

Both of these Addons are sold by Leatherworker Villagers.

To apply these, place them inside of a Smithing Table along with the Addon's desired smithing item.

![Examples for applying an Addon to a Backpack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/28d3075a6ed1bbe01e610285f582e0caadf7a866.png)

Applying an Addon will get rid of any other Addons on the Backpack!

## <center>Upgrades</center>

Each Backpack has a Tier they can upgrade to. To upgrade, you need an Upgrade Template of the Tier and its corresponding item.
