title: Herobrine011840's Cave Biomes
description: This mod adds new biomes and resources to overworld caves.
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/tpj8gGsJC0I" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>


![Logo](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/213/herobrine011840s-cave-biomes.png)


Curseforge page is [Here](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/herobrine011840s-cave-biomes)

**_THIS MOD REQUIRES GECKOLIB_**

Herobrine011840's Cave Biomes adds new cave biomes to the overworld. These are semi-rare and occur in all regions of the Overworld.



New Additions:

# Blocks

Grimslate:

-This stone type is found in the Grimslate Caves biome. It can be crafted into chiseled and brick variants.

Climbing Moss:

-A common plant found in the Grimslate Caves that can be used for food.

Gloom Tubes:

-These plant blocks are found in Grimslate Caves. They are a purely decorative block.

Forbodum Vines:

-These are a common vine block found on the ceiling of the Grimslate Caves. They behave similarly to Weeping Vines.

Abyssum:

-This block is a small tree-like plant found in the Grimslate Caves. They can be used as a source of planks.

Old Speleothic Stone:

-This is a stone block found in the Archaic Caves. It does not have many uses.

Ancient Leaves:

-This block can be found occasionally in Archaic Caves. It is a decor block.

Grotto Daisy:

-A common flower found in the Archaic Caves that can be crafted into Light Gray Dye.

Redstonial Bloom:

-This uncommon flower that is found in Archaic Caves emits a redstone power of 13 and can be crafted into Redstone Dust.

Archaica Marigold:

-A rare flower found in Archaic Caves that can be crafted into Solar Dust, which is used for a Framed Lamp.

Framed Lamp:

-This decorative block is crafted from Solar Dust, Iron, and Glass. Any undead mob that walks on it will be set on fire.

Concave Syenite:

-This stone makes up the majority of the Hollow Fracture biome. It has many decorative variants, as well as a Hollow variant.

Hollow Flesh:

-These blocks are found growing on the floor of the Hollow Fracture biome. The Hollow Flesh blocks make the player unable to jump over them.

Anchor Chains:

 -A functional block crafted with Chains and Shrapnel. Placing this block or powering it with Redstone will create a long line of chains extending downward from the block.

Ancient Lootbox:

-This block can be found within Broken Fortresses in the Hollow Fracture. Clicking on them with a Hollonite Pearl will make it drop some loot. They have a chance of breaking when you do this.

Dacite:

-This block can be found in the Dacite Caves, in Dacite Ruins, or crafted with Andesite and Nether Quartz. It has a very large amount of decorative variants.

Dacite Sand:

-This block is found in Dacite Caves and Dacite Ruins. It can be smelted into Dacite Glass.

Dacite Glass:

-This is a frameless version of Glass made by smelting Dacite Sand.

Clearwater:

-This block is a variant of Water found in the Dacite Caves.

Limestone:

-This stone is found in Limestone Caves. it has a lot of decorative variants, and it can be used to craft Stone items.

Cave Frond:

-A tall flower found in the Limestone Caves. it can be made into Orange Dye.

Lumenshroom Soil:

-A variant of dirt found in the Lumenshroom Caves. It can be smelted into a smooth variant.

Lumenshrooms:

-These block are a light blue version of Mushrooms found in the Lumenshroom Caves.

Glimmershale:

-This decorative stone is found in the Glittering Caves. It has a few decorative brick variants.

Glittering Crystals:

-These crystals are found in the Glittering Caves. They are purely decorative.

Glittergrass:

-This plant is found in the Glittering Caves. It drops Glittering Dust when broken without shears.

Glittering Lamp:

-This light block can be crafted with Glittering Dust and Iron Nuggets. It has no functional use, other than looking good.

Gemslate:

-This is a rare stone found in Woodland Mansions and the Diamond Mines.

# Items

Moss Loaf:

-This item is a decent food source crafted from Wheat and Climbing Moss. it can be found in Mining Shacks and Broken Fortresses.

Hollonite Shield:

-This gear item is a stronger version of a Shield. It has 2048 durability and gives the holder 2 seconds of Strength I when an attack is blocked.

Spirit Essence:

-This rare item is dropped by the Lumenshroom Spirit. It is a vital crafting ingredient for the Ban Hammer.

Ban Hammer:

-This weapon is crafted from Spirit Essence, Shrapnel Scraps, and Sticks. It has extremely high attack damage, but is incredibly slow.

Glittering Dust:

-This item can be obtained from Glittergrass and can be used to make Glittering Crystal Blocks or Glittering Lamps.

Copper Tools:

-This tool set is in between stone and Iron. The tools have 187 durability.

Magentrosite:

-This rare resource can be used to upgrade either Netherite or Irisite Tools. It is crafted with A Netherite Scrap, A Malevolium Ingot, and an Irisite Gemstone on a Smithing Table.

Spelunker's Pickaxe:

-This super rare item can only be obtained once in your world, as it is a reward for completing every Herobrine011840's Cave Biomes advancement. it can be combined with existing Netherite or Magentrosite Pickaxes in order to transfer their enchantments. The pickaxe is purely cosmetic and does not provide any additional benefits.

Smithing Templates:

 -There is a new Armor Trim in this mod, and it is called the Caverns Armor Trim. It is found occasionally in Mining Shacks.

 -3 new upgrade templates are also a part of this mod:

  -The Malevolium Upgrade can be obtained in Mining shacks or by killing Evokers

  -The Irisite Upgrade can be found in Mining Shacks or in Dacite Fountains

 -The Magentrosite Upgrade can be found in Mining Shacks or from killing a Wither

 -One last Smithing Template found in this mod is the Hollonite Shield template found in Broken Fortresses. It is used to craft a Hollonite Shield.

Music Discs:

 -There are 3 new discs in this mod:

  -Descension is found in Mining Shacks

 -Deepest is found in Ancient Cities

 -Hollowing is found in Broken Fortresses

# Ores

Malevolium:

![Malevolium Ore](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/254/2025-01-22_17.png)

This ore can be found in Grimslate Caves. it can be used to make Malevolium Gear, which is about as strong as Diamond. There is a decorative bar variant as well.

Hollonite:

![Hollonite Ore](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/255/2025-01-22_17.png)

This is a semi-common ore found in the Hollow Fracture. It is used to craft Hollonite Shields and to obtain loot from Ancient Lootboxes.

Shrapnel:

![Shrapnel Ore](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/256/2025-01-22_17.png)

This uncommon ore can be found in the Hollow Fracture. It is used to make the Ban Hammer.

Irisite:

![Irisite Ore](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/257/2025-01-22_17.png)

This is an uncommon ore found in the Dacite Caves. It can be used to make Irisite gear, which is between Diamond and Netherite.

Amazonite:

![Amazonite Ore](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/258/2025-01-22_17.png)

This is a very common ore found in the Limestone Caves. It is used for decoration.

# Mobs

Hollowed:

![Hollowed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4b5d478e91f0df62755158231109d7a373b21a6.png)

This mob will spawn rarely in the Hollow Fracture. It will watch the player from a distance, but if you get too close to it, then it will burrow and start to approach the player. You can tell when a borrowing Hollowed is near due to them giving players the Darkness Effect. When it gets close enough, it will emerge from the ground and begin chasing the player.

Stats:

Hp: 1000

Atk: 15

Def: 5



Lumencap:

![Lumencap](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/261/lumencap.png)

This mob is a relatively peaceful creature residing in the Lumenshroom Forest biome. It will approach a player when it spots them, as they are very curious creatures. Killing one has a chance to inflict the Fungal Curse effect for 5 minutes.

Stats:

Hp: 5

Atk: 0

Def: 0



Lumenshroom Spirit:

![Lumenshroom Spirit](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e818c6c1a923b9c6b5aeebac628e124c19a5a74b.png)

This large and intimidating creature will only spawn if a player with the Fungal Curse effect has said effect wear off. They are very strong and will be a difficult foe.

Stats:

Hp: 260

Atk: 13

Def: 0

Drops:

 -1 Spirit Essence

# Enchantments

Blinding Light:

-An enchantment similar to Thorns, this will light any undead that attack on fire. It can be found in any structure with randomly enchanted books, Mining Shacks, or by enchanting. Maximum level is three.

Double Ban:

-This rare enchantment can only be found in Mining shacks. It will give the wielder Strength III for 12.5 seconds when they smash something. Maximum level is one.

Elytra Veil:

-This uncommon enchantment can be found in Mining Shacks, enchanting, or anywhere that randomly enchanted books are found. The enchantment is basically an Elytra's version of protection. Maximum level is three.

Experience Gain:

-This uncommon enchantment can be found in Mining Shacks, enchanting, or anywhere that randomly enchanted books are found. Each level makes your pickaxe drop +1 experience per block mined. maximum level is three.

Hammer:

-This rare enchantment can only be found in Mining Shacks. It allows the pickaxe to mine a 3x3x3 area. Maximum level is one.

Recoil:

-This rare enchantment can be found in Broken Fortresses. It give the holder's Shield a chance to inflict damage upon the attacker. Maximum level is two.

Reinforced:

-This very rare enchantment can be found in Dacite Ruins or Mining Shacks. It is pretty much just Unbreaking X for tools. Maximum level is one.

# Biomes

Grimslate Caves:

![Grimslate Caves](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/266/2025-01-22_17.png)

This is a semi-common cave biome that is usually found near Forests, but it can be found in many different places.



Archaic Caves:

![Archaic Caves](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/267/2025-01-22_17.png)

This rare cave biome can most often be found under Jungles and Warm Oceans.



Hollow Fracture:

![Hollow Fracture](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/268/2025-01-22_17.png)

This rare cave biome is most often found beneath Swamps and Windswept Hills.



Dacite Caves:

![Dacite Caves](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/269/2025-01-22_17.png)

This small and rare cave biome is most often found beneath Mangrove Swamps and Jungles. Dacite Ruins on the surface can indicate that a Dacite Caves may be nearby.



Limestone Caves:

![Limestone Caves](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/270/2025-01-22_17.png)

This very common cave biome is most often found beneath Deserts and Badlands.



Lumenshroom Forest:

![Lumenshroom Forest](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/272/2025-01-22_17.png)

This very rare cave biome can be found under Mushroom Islands and in oceans near where a Mushroom Island might generate.



Glittering Caves:

![Glittering Caves](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/271/2025-01-22_17.png)

This semi-common cave biome is most often found beneath Badlands.



Diamond Mines:

![Diamond Mines](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1275/239/2025-08-02_18-31-32-png.png)

This is an extremely rare biome found in semi-mountainous tropical areas. This biome contains a huge amount of Diamond Ore at any vertical hieght. Woodland Mansion storage rooms may have a map to this location, but expect it to be tens of thousands of blocks away.

# Structures

Dacite Ruins:

![Dacite Ruins](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/279/2025-01-22_18.png)

These are uncommon structures found in Jungles, Sparse Jungles, and Mangrove Swamps. They are very small, containing only one barrel of loot.



Dacite Fountain:

![Dacite Fountain](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/280/2025-01-22_18.png)

This rare structure can be found in the Dacite Caves. It contains a single chest with a small amount of loot.



Ancient Village:

![Ancient Village](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/281/2025-01-22_18.png)

This common structure can be found in Limestone Caves. It consists of a few houses with early game loot in them.



Broken Fortress:

![Broken Fortress](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/282/2025-01-22_18.png)

This common structure is found in the Hollow Fracture. It contains some rare loot. They are usually quite destroyed because of the biome they are in.



Report bugs [Here](https://discord.gg/65Y5pn2TAW)



Go to my [Youtube channel](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCuvzUmcTrqXztT7R1oJGQeg) for more updates and info.

title: Coord Mod
description: See your coords without F3. Made for my friend.
body:
# Coords mod
# Requires Fabric API

## Overview

This mod adds the command /coords to see your coordinates. Useful if the F3 key doesn't work on your keyboard or if you don't like the F3 screen where you have to search for your coordinates.

## Usage

| Command       | Description                    |
|---------------|---------------------------|
| /coords       | Gets your coordinates         |
| /coordsexact  | Gets your precise coordinates       |
| /togglehud   | Toggles the coordinates HUD (top-left)                |

## Why?
This mod was made for my friend. And I like making random mods.

## Where is 26.1?
I am currently updating the mod to support 26.1. Keep in mind that I am a single developer working on this in my free time. Follow the project to be notified when 26.1 support releases.

## Why are you taking so long?
Previous versions of Minecraft were obfuscated, so that instead of meaningful names in the code, it had things like class_3457. We got around this using Yarn Mappings, which turned them back into meaningful names. 26.1 removed this obfuscation, but the names are different from Yarn. For example, in Yarn, the player is `PlayerEntity` but in the unobfuscated code, the player is `Player`. This means that I have to change every method to match the unobfuscated code.

title: Adjustable Sound Limit
description: Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge用・音源の同時再生数の上限を自由に変更できるModです。Adjust the maximum number of simultaneous in-game sounds in Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge.
body:
# Adjustable Sound Limit

## 🇺🇸 English

### Description
**Adjustable Sound Limit** is a simple yet essential mod that expands the maximum number of simultaneous sound channels in Minecraft.
By default, Minecraft limits sound channels to around 250. In heavily modded environments with many machines, farms, or entities, this limit is easily reached, causing sounds to cut out abruptly.

This mod increases the default limit to **1024** (configurable up to **4096**), ensuring a rich and uninterrupted audio experience.

### Features
*   **Expanded Sound Limit**: Default 1024 channels (Vanilla is ~250).
*   **Configurable**: Adjust the limit between 64 and 4096 to suit your hardware.
*   **In-Game Config GUI**:
    *   Works standalone (Native simple GUI included).
    *   *Note: A game restart is required after changing settings.*

### Verified Versions
*   **Minecraft**: 1.20.1 (Forge)
*   *If you confirm this mod works on other versions (e.g., 1.20.2, 1.20.4), please report it!*

### Requirements
*   **Minecraft**: 1.20.1
*   **Loader**: Forge
*   **Side**: Client Side Only (Installation on server is not required)

### License & Modpacks
*   **All Rights Reserved.**
*   **Modpacks**: You **ARE** permitted to include this mod in any modpack.
*   **Redistribution**: You are **NOT** permitted to redistribute this mod on other websites. Please link to this page instead.

### ⚠️ Notes & Troubleshooting
*   **Server Incompatibility**: Do **NOT** install this mod on a dedicated server. It is a client-side mod and may cause crashes or unexpected behavior if installed on a server.
*   **Hardware Limitations**: If the sound limit increase is not reflected in the F3 debug screen (still shows ~247), your hardware or sound driver (OpenAL) may be limiting the channels. Please try **lowering** the `maxSounds` value in the config file.
*   **Mod Conflicts**: This mod modifies the sound engine core. It may conflict with other mods that also modify the sound engine.

---

## 🇯🇵 Japanese

### 概要
**Adjustable Sound Limit** は、Minecraftの同時再生可能なサウンドチャンネル数の上限を拡張するModです。
バニラのMinecraftでは、同時に再生できる音の数が約250に制限されています。工業Modの機械音や大規模なトラップタワー、大量のMobがいる環境では、この上限に達してしまい、重要な音が聞こえなくなる（音が途切れる）ことがよくあります。

このModを導入することで、デフォルトの上限を **1024** （最大 **4096**）まで引き上げ、音が途切れる問題を解消します。

### 特徴
*   **サウンド上限の拡張**: デフォルトで1024チャンネル（バニラは約250チャンネル）確保します。
*   **設定可能**: PCのスペックに合わせて、64〜4096の範囲で調整可能です。
*   **ゲーム内設定画面 (GUI)**:
    *   Mod単体で簡易的な設定画面が利用可能です（Mod一覧の設定ボタンからアクセスできます）
    *   *注意: 設定を変更した後は、Minecraftの再起動が必要です。*

### ⚠️ 注意事項・トラブルシューティング
*   **サーバーへの導入について**: このModはクライアントサイド専用です。**サーバーには導入しないでください。** 不具合やクラッシュの原因になる可能性があります。
*   **設定が反映されない場合**: Modを導入してもF3画面の「Sounds」の分母（最大数）が増えていない場合、お使いのPC（サウンドカード/ドライバ）がその数値をサポートしていない可能性があります。設定ファイルの `maxSounds` の値を **少し下げて** （例: 512など）試してみてください。
*   **競合について**: サウンドエンジンの根幹を変更するため、同じ箇所を変更する他のサウンド系Modと競合する可能性があります。

### 動作確認済みバージョン
*   **Minecraft**: 1.20.1 (Forge)
*   *もし他のバージョン（1.20.2, 1.20.4など）での動作を確認できた場合は、報告していただけると助かります！*

### 動作環境
*   **Minecraft**: 1.20.1

title: Custom Fast Hardcore
description: An Extensible, Highly Customizable Minecraft Fast-Paced Competitive Framework
body:
# Custom Fast Hardcore

Eliminate downtime for a "Fast-Paced Hardcore Survival Arena" experience.

- Initialize came: `/cbr game init`
- Change map center: `/cbr game offset [x] 0 [z]`
- Join team: `/cbr team join [teamId]`
- Start game: `/cbr game start`

## Core Features

- Ultra-Lightweight: The modpack has less than 30 mods; pre-generating an 8000x8000 map with Chunky only takes 2 hours.
- Looting + Vanilla Progression: Scavenge for supplies in the abundant villages or quickly head underground for mining.
- Everything is Fast: Starting gear + a "Godspeed Pickaxe" + dense villages eliminate most "downtime," making the total game duration 25 minutes.
- Safe Start: Spawn points distributed in a Golden Spiral pattern + a 30-second invincibility period for all players at the start, preventing "spawn-killing".

### Key Advantages

- Zone Mechanism: Native client-side support for non-vanilla boundary shapes like circular and spherical zone detection and rendering.
- Fast-Paced: 25-minute rounds, initial acceleration, very low system requirements, compatible with short play sessions.
- Framework Extensibility: The modpack includes highly customizable configuration files, allowing it to be quickly converted to other PvP forms like gunplay or magic by adding extra mods.
- Backward Compatibility: Can be reverted to UHC by using regular polygon rendering, extending the shrink time, reducing structure density, and cancelling loot generations.

## Game Flow

The game area is a circle with a radius of 500. The zone shrinks in 5 stages, each lasting 5 minutes:
- Initial Phase: Players spawn within a radius of 400. The boundary radius shrinks from 500 to 400.
- Phase 2/3/4: At the start of the stage, a Bombing Zone + Supply Drop Zone are generated. The center of these zones is attracted by the collective center point of all remaining living players.
- Phase 5: The safe zone changes from a circle to a sphere and gradually shrinks its radius, bringing underground players back to the surface.

### Detailed Explanation

- Starting Gear (9 slots): Efficiency X Unbreaking III Wooden Axe, Efficiency X Unbreaking III Iron Pickaxe, Cherry Wood Planks x64, Basalt x64, Ender Pearl, Crafting Table, Furnace, Torch x16, Campfire x3.
- The Bombing Zone continuously expands its radius for 30 seconds, generating 10 random TNT explosions per second, followed by 60 seconds of random supply drops.
- Spawned loot has low durability, while items crafted from mined resources have full durability.
- All containers are subject to loot refresh, covering Nether and End items.
- The Phase 5 Sphere starts at the collective center of all remaining living players, constantly shrinking and moving towards (0, 64, 0).

## Modpack Contents

Sorted by name

### Battle Royale Mechanism

- CBR addon by XiaoColorful
- Custom BattleRoyale by XiaoColorful

- Better Villages by jtl_elisa, jtl_tom

### Gameplay Extension

title: Chisel The Stone!
description: This mod aims to make building with blocks that have chiseled and brick variants with the help of a new tool - The Chisel
body:
🛠️ Chisel The Stone!

Sculpt your world, one block at a time.

Turn plain old blocks into something extraordinary with just a right-click! Chisel The Stone! brings a smooth and immersive way to transform your building materials directly in-game using a custom chisel tool. No crafting menus. No fuss. Just click, chisel, and create.

🔨 Features:

Right-click any supported block with the chisel to cycle between:

Base Block → Chiseled → Brick Variant

(Supports blocks like Stone, Tuff, Quartz, Deepslate, and more!)

Works seamlessly in Survival and Creative modes

     Balanced tool durability and smooth animation


Note : The Chisel Tool only works on blocks that are placed by the player, and not naturally generated ones.
           This prevents players from farming stone bricks/chiseled stone bricks from naturally generated stone.

Contact : MrMisc29 on Discord. MrMisc29 on YouTube

title: Loot Bundle Bags
description: Adds Loot Bags to Vanilla Minecraft
body:
This datapack adds loot bags to minecraft, without the need of any client side additions, including resource packs.

This uses the new bundle item to do so.

By default, whenever a player kills a mob, there is a 2% chance for a bag to drop, and when this occures there is a 75% chance it will be a common one, a 20% chance of uncommon, and a 5% chance of a rare bag.

There are also 3 variations of the bags. There is an overworld, nether, and end variations for each tier.

When the bag is aquired, all one need do to open it, is "use" the item, as if you were going to throw its contents on the ground.

title: Iconic
description: Upload your own icons to chat, fully client side!
body:
## Iconic **Upload your own icons to chat, fully client side!** *The following document is relevant for Iconic `2.0.0`.*
### Using the Mod To insert an icon into chat, begin by typing `:`. Autocomplete suggestions will pop up. Upon sending a message with icons, the icons will be sent to other clients, which will then show it on screen.
**The mod works by hiding an icon id in the chat. If the actual chat message sent exceeds the maximum length of 256 characters, a warning will be shown.** Don't icon spam too much. These commands also support including icons: `/me`, `/msg`, `/teammsg`, `/tell`, `/tellraw`, `/tm`, `/w`, `/reply`, `/r`, `/last`, `/l` (last 4 are common reply commands on servers). ### Adding Your Own Icons Add icons by clicking the star button at the bottom left of the chat bar. A directory will be opened where you can add icons. Alternatively, navigate to your dotminecraft and open the `icons` directory.
**Icons over 1 megabyte will be rejected. Only images in the `.png` format are accepted.**
**If an image is wider than taller (width > height), or the image is wider than `256`, it will automatically be corrected to a `256px` width square image.** Alternatively, you can use one of the provided icon generators:
Icon Generators ### URL Downloads an icon from the internet by URL, and saves it to the icon directory as a PNG.
**Usage**: `/iconic url [icon name] [url of image]` ### Player Skin Generates a 3D render of a player skin.
**Usage**: `/iconic player [player name or UUID]` ### PetPet Animation Adds the petpet animation to any other icon.
**Usage**: `/iconic petpet [other icon name]`
### Built-in Icons The mod comes with some built-in icons. Here's a list:
Built-in Icons List - `axolotl` - `bananaspin` (A spinning banana) - `birdspin` (A dancing bird) - `boatjeb` (Jeb in a boat) - `bruh` - `catbop` (Bopping cat) - `cathello` (Cat waving hello) - `concern` - `confusion` - `creeper` - `egg` - `emotionaldamage` (EMOTIONAL DAMAGE!!!) - `explosion` (Planet annihilation) - `eyes` - `fabric` (FabricMC logo) - `fire` - `heart` - `hellothere` (Obi-Wan Kenobi hello there) - `iapprove` - `minecraft` (Minecraft logo) - `missing` (Missing texture cube) - `modrinth` (Modrinth logo) - `neverdie` (Tribute) - `partypopper` - `pog` - `potato` - `prideflag` - `rage` (Angry seagull) - `rainbow` - `rickroll` (Rick Astley) - `shut` (Shut seagull) - `skull` - `snail` - `sob` - `sus` (Among Us character) - `tater` (FabricMC mascot?) - `thanossnap` (Fading away) - `thumbsdown` - `thumbsup` - `wheeze`
### Animated Icons Icons can be animated too! Here's how:
Adding Animated Icons To add an animated icon, create an image with a height greater than the width. For example, a `64x256` image would have 4 frames, each `64x64` pixels.
Each frame is rendered for approximately 37.5 milliseconds (0.0375 seconds), and loops after reaching the last frame. Here's a tool you can use to convert a gif into an icon that can be used.
**Make sure to set *Tile Alignment* to *Vertical* and *Tile Size* to *256x256* (or a smaller square).**

title: SignLink
description: The plugin will allow you to insert links into the sign
body:
## **The plugin was only tested on version 1.20, but it is likely that it will work on earlier versions.**

**SignLink** is a Minecraft plugin that allows players to create clickable signs with URL links. With this plugin, you can write a URL in a book, then click on a sign to open that URL. The book with the URL is removed from the player’s inventory after creating the clickable sign.

**Features:**
- Simple configuration through a config file.
- Support for various types of signs that can have URLs (e.g., OAK_SIGN, OAK_WALL_SIGN, BAMBOO_SIGN, and others).
- Automatic saving of the URL and creator information to a database file.
- Command /signlink reload to reload the plugin configuration.

**Usage:**
1. Write a URL in a book in Minecraft.
2. Place the book in your hand and click on a sign to make it clickable.
3. The book will be removed from your inventory, and players will be able to click on the sign to open the specified URL.

**Commands:**
- /signlink reload (sign.sign) - reloads the plugin configuration.

title: Magical Programming
description: A mod that allows you to type in custom spells to do a wide variety of things.
body:
This mod adds in the magic wand item, where you can put in your spells in a custom programming language (SpellScript), and it'll run them! This allows you to do a lot of things.

To get the magic wand, craft with a nether star on top of two sticks. This may seem expensive, but it is definitely worth it. To use the wand, sneak right click to edit the spell, and right click to cast the spell.

Contains an in game guide (crafted with magenta dye and a book), but here are some sample commands:
- `print("Hello, World!")`
- `add force(self, multiply vector(look direction(self), 3))`
- `add force(summon arrow(position:eye position(self), critical:true, power:5, punch:2, pierce:10), multiply vector(look direction(self), 10)))`

title: Assisted Progression
description: A simple mod to help you along the way
body:
# Mod Requirements
- NeoForge only, version 20.4.72-beta or above

# Assisted Progression
Over the years and across various mods, there are ideas for blocks and items that don't fit some overall theme, but are still nice to have. This mod is a repository of sorts for those ideas. While every idea may not be completly novel, there are plenty of simple to use items and blocks that assist along the way in modded minecraft.


## Credits
----------
pauljoda - Developer

powerchug - Textures


## Permissions
----------
You are free to use this mod in any pack on whatever platform as long as proper credit is listed.

# Items

## Spawner Relocator
![Spawner Relocator Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/spawner_relocator_recipe.png)

The spawner relocator allows you to pick up, and place a vanilla spawner. Hold right click, and release when looking at a spawner to pick it up, and reverse to place. This is a one use item.


## Magnets
### Magnet
![Magnet Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/magnet_recipe.png)

The magnet allows you to attract things towards the player. Shift right click to toggle activation. The base magnet does not require power, however there may be some things you would not want brought to you while active. Use with caution.

### Electric Magnet
![Electric Magnet Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/electric_magnet_recipe.png)

The electric magnet is similar to the base magnet, but does require power to operate. The advantage being that this will only pull items and xp orbs towards the player.


## Trash Bags
### Trash Bag
![Trash Bag Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/trash_bag_recipe.png)
![Trash Bag Menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/trash_bag_menu.png)

The trash bag allows you to set filters that will automatically void items on pickup. The base trash bag supports one item. If you have JEI installed, you can click and drag items from JEI to the filter slots to set the filter without the need of the item. The bags will match tags and damage of the item in the filter.

### Hefty Bag
![Hefty Bag Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/hefty_bag_recipe.png)
![Hefty Bag Menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/hefty_bag_menu.png)

The hefty bag allows you to do the same thing as the trash bag, but with more filter slots,


## Pipette
![Pipette Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/pipette_recipe.png)

The pipette can be crafted with any type of glass and two panes. It can hold up to a full bucket of fluid, and will drain and fill fluid handling blocks with right click. Particularly useful for small fluid amounts that need moved around in mods like Tinker's Construct.


## Parashoes
![Parashoes Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/parashoes_recipe.png)

The parashoes are proof that a pun can become a good idea. This pair of shoes, has a parachute that will slow your decent. Wear these to glide from heights safely.

## Climbing Gloves
![Climbing Gloves Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/climbing_gloves_recipe.png)

Climbing gloves allow you to scale vertical surfaces while they are in your inventory. Combined with the parashoes, they are an excellent way to traverse large caves, ravines, and mountains.

 
## Mob Net and Mob Net Launcher
![Net Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/net_recipe.png)
![Net Launcher Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/net_launcher_recipe.png)

The mob net and mob net launcher are items used to capture and move mobs. Use the launcher to launch a net at a mob, once hit the mob will be trapped in the net. Right click the ground to respawn the exact mob, or right click a spawner frame (see [spawner frame](https://github.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/wiki/Blocks#spawner-frame)), to create a vanilla spawner of that type. The launcher does require power to operate.

# Blocks

## Ender Pad
![Ender Pad Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/ender_pad_recipe.png)

The ender pad is a way to warp on the horizontal axis. The arrow will face away from the player when placed, and if you sneak while standing on top it will send you to another ender pad in the direction the arrow points, up to 20 blocks. It will send you through walls so it is a great way to move in and out of an area that may not have a normal access. 

## Player Plate
![Player Plate Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/player_plate_recipe.png)

The player plate is a pressure plate that will only activate when players are on top.

## Spawner Frame
![Spawner Frame](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/spawner_frame_recipe.png)

On its own, the spawner frame is a simple block; however, when a mob net with a captured mob is right clicked onto the frame it will transform into a vanilla spawner of that type of mob. This is a one way process and the spawner will not revert back to a frame.

title: Craftomatic
description: Automatically craft items by using a template item to tell the crafter how to make what you want.
body: # Craftomatic Automatically crafts new items based on a template. NOTE: This is beta and we are experimenting with two types of crafters: a passive one which you can simply put a hopper under to collect items, and an active one which behaves like a dropper, like the vanilla Crafter in Minecraft 1.21. It's unclear whether we'll keep both. This block allows you to automatically craft items. You place an item into the left slot, and the grid will update to show you the items it needs to craft it. If multiple items could be used (as in the case of dyes), arrows will appear above and below the template item to allow you to choose the specific recipe you want. You can also use the scroll wheel while hovering over the template item to switch between recipes. ## How is this different than the Vanilla Crafter in 1.21? This block uses a template to tell the crafter what you want to make. With that knowledge, it can pull in the appropriate items from hoppers place around it. This means you can make each hopper only hold one item type and the crafter knows what to do. Drop an item in the left well and it will show the ghost items for what it expects. If Instead you have an item that can be crafted in several ways, it will provide arrows to select the input ingredients you want to provide. ## Hopper (Passive) Variant In this setup, you only need to place a hopper underneath the crafter to receive the results. In this variant, you can up up to 5 input hoppers around the crafter, so it can pull in up to 5 items in once cycle. For items that leave items behind, e.g. honey bottles -> honey blocks will leave empty honey bottles, those items will also flow out the bottom. No item will craft until remaining items are all gone. ## Dropper Variant This one behaves more like the upcoming Vanilla crafter in that it works like a dropper and requires a Redstone signal to make it work in the same way. It even has a mouth! Due to the fact that it requires power, you can only put up to 4 hoppers around it, so it can't input quite as fast. However, when crafting items that leave items behind, the dropper variant will attempt to spit all of them out with the result item at the same time, while the hopper variant has to wait for enough cycles for the grid to clear before it starts crafting new items. ## Pros and Cons There are pros and cons to both variants. Personally, while originally gravitating towards the dropper variant, I have found myself using the passive variant because it's just simpler (no Redstone clock involved). The passive variant also is easily tileable for use in a sorter, etc. while the dropper variant requires power which might affect a nearby component. It might be workable, but it's harder. The dropper variant can be faster, as it can run on a redstone clock whereas the passive variant can operate only at hopper speed. The hopper variant can only output from the bottom, whereas the dropper variant is directional. ## Stateful Crafting If you don't put a template item in, the table behaves as a stateful crafter. What that means is if you start to craft something and forgot something, when you close the UI, the items are still in the table. It should otherwise behave like a normal crafting table. ## Crafting Recipes There are two recipes for the two variants. The key difference is the item at the bottom. For the passive variant, a Redstone block is used (to represent that it is self-powered). For the dropper variant, a dropper is used instead. ![Crafting Screenshots](https://i.imgur.com/DQ0Bn25.png)

title: Immersive Skyblock
description: A datapack which creates a Skyblock overworld, nether and end dimension, complete with biomes, empty structure bounding boxes and integrated immersive portals compatibility.
body:
# Immersive Skyblock
This Datapack adds a set of Skyblock dimensions and configurations for Immersive Portals, allowing you to seamlessly walk from your survival world to a minimalist skyblock let's play with seperate inventories.


### Dependencies
[Immersive Portals](https://github.com/iPortalTeam/ImmersivePortalsMod) and [Dimensional Inventories](https://modrinth.com/mod/dimensional-inventories) are the core mods required to add full functionality to the pack.

I recommend my custom-made [Multiversal Vanilla](https://modrinth.com/modpack/multiversalvanilla) modpack for the best experience. It's been thoroughly tested and contains as many performance-enhancing mods as possible without conflicting with immersive portals, as well as some QOL mods and some extra visual and audio enhancement goodies.

### Installation
1) Install your preference of the optional dependencies above.
2) Back up your Minecraft world.
3) Drop the datapack into your world folder.
4) Drop the preset from the [github repo](https://github.com/SlyAquaGuy/immersive-gamemodes/tree/main/dimensionalinventories) into the dimensionalinventories folder or configure Dimensional Inventories using `/diminv`.

# Features 

### Vanilla First
The datapack minimally works on a vanilla installation *(you can use `/tp` to swap dimensions)*, the recommended mods only enabling immersive travel between gamemodes using portals and seamless inventory swapping.

This implementation using Mojang's inbuilt dimension system means that your vanilla Minecraft world stays vanilla; if there's a version change or datapack update that renders the pack unusable, you're left with a vanilla world free from any modifications and some empty portals.

### Balanced Dimensions
Care was taken to ensure the datapack doesn't enable any major exploits in a world.
- Achievements and statistics don't progress in skyblock. *(configurable)*
- Items and mobs can't be transported across different gamemodes. 
- No player interaction across gamemodes. *(can't mine blocks on other side of portal)*

**Skyblock Features**
- Classic skyblock void with island.
- Skyblock portal requires a fully oxidised copper frame and is lit using flint & steel.
- Nether Island with basic blocks included.
- All biomes and important structure bounding boxes are generated.
- End portals, spires, the exit portal and the dragon are all generated. Good luck! 
- End Ships generate, making elytra and shulker boxes obtainable.

## Credits
Special thanks to Qouteall for [Immersive Portals](https://github.com/iPortalTeam/ImmersivePortalsMod) and Thomilist for [Dimensional Inventories](https://modrinth.com/mod/dimensional-inventories).

Huge shoutout to BluePsychoRanger for their [Skyblock Datapacks](https://github.com/BluePsychoRanger/SkyBlock_Collection) I adapted for the worldgen. Skyblock wouldn't have been possible without it.

title: Aeronautics Scoped Links
description: Removes the ability for sable levels to crosstalk between other sable sublevels and the world.
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3722d583499a799059ce16603dfdc85c9fd71ae1.png)
# Sable Scoped Links

Sable Scoped Links adds Sable-aware scoping to Create redstone links.

By default, Create redstone links can communicate globally within their normal range rules, which can cause links inside Sable sub-levels to interact with links in the ordinary world or in other sub-levels. This mod changes that behavior so redstone links can be limited by their Sable sub-level context.

## Features

- Prevents Create redstone links inside one Sable sub-level from leaking into another.
- Supports configurable scoping behavior:
  - Vanilla Create behavior
  - Same sub-level only
  - Sub-level and ordinary world bridging
- Supports Ordinary links, Mobile linked controllers, and typewriters.


## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge
- Create
- Sable

## Purpose

This mod is intended for Create + Sable worlds where redstone link networks should respect moving or isolated Sable spaces instead of behaving as one shared global network.

## Credit
- The mod icon was made by [Vercte](https://modrinth.com/user/Vercte).

# LaunchBlocks: Bounce Your Way to Adventure

## Overview

Transform your Minecraft world with special slime blocks that propel players through the air! This lightweight plugin adds custom launcher blocks that send players soaring in their facing direction when stepped on, opening up exciting possibilities for parkour courses, adventure maps, and creative gameplay experiences.

## Features

- **Custom Launch Blocks**: Special slime blocks that propel players in their facing direction
- **Configurable Physics**: Fine-tune launch power and height to create the perfect trajectory
- **Simple Commands**: Easily obtain launch blocks with `/launchblock` or just place a slime block
- **Permission System**: Control who can create and use launchers
- **Server-Friendly**: Lightweight implementation with minimal resource usage
- **Customizable Effects**: Configure sound and particle effects for an enhanced experience
- **Full Documentation**: Comprehensive setup guide included

## Perfect For

- **Parkour Maps**: Create challenging jumping puzzles with precise landing targets
- **Adventure Maps**: Add exciting movement mechanics to your story-driven experiences
- **Mini-Games**: Design unique race courses and obstacle challenges
- **Transportation Systems**: Build fun and creative ways to travel across your builds
- **PvP Arenas**: Add vertical elements to combat with strategic launch points

## How It Works

Players can place special slime blocks that function as launchers. When stepping on these blocks, they'll be propelled forward in their facing direction with a slight upward boost. The physics are fully configurable, allowing server owners to create the perfect feel for their specific needs.

## Installation

2. Place it in your server's plugins folder
3. Restart your server
4. Configure settings in the config.yml file (optional)

## Future Plans

title: NAT-Whitelist
description: Whitelist management plugin independent of the Minecraft base plugin (Support Discord Webhooks, MySQL)
body:
![NAT WHITELIST BANNER](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3668fef1486fe33343bcbdc792bddd742bec2787_0.webp)
## What is
NAT-Whitelist is a powerful and flexible whitelist management plugin for Minecraft servers. It allows server administrators to easily control who can join the server, with support for both MySQL and SQLite databases.

## Features

- Add or remove players from the whitelist using commands
- Supports both MySQL and SQLite for storing whitelist data
- Automatically fetches correct usernames from Mojang API
- Option to kick non-whitelisted players automatically
- Option to remove offline players from the whitelist
- Customizable messages using MiniMessage format
- Easy integration with Bukkit/Spigot servers
- Log with Discord webhooks (on, off, add, remove, join but no whitelited)

## Commands

| Command                | Description                                 |
|------------------------|---------------------------------------------|
| `/whitelist add <name> <another name>`    | Adds a player to the whitelist            |
| `/whitelist remove <name><another name>` | Removes a player from the whitelist        |
| `/whitelist list`          | Lists all whitelisted players              |
| `/whitelist reload`        | Reloads the plugin configuration           |
| `/whitelist enable`        | Enables the whitelist                      |
| `/whitelist disable`       | Disables the whitelist                     |
| `/whitelist removeoffline` | Remove offlines players                    |

## Permissions

| Permission                   | Description                                      |
|------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| natwhitelist.reload          | Allows you to reload the configuration             |
| natwhitelist.add             | Allows you to add a player to the whitelist        | 
| natwhitelist.remove          | Allows you to remove a player from the whitelist      | 
| natwhitelist.on              | Enables the whitelist                    | 
| natwhitelist.off             | Allows you to disable the whitelist                | 
| natwhitelist.removeoffline   | Allows offline players to be removed         | 
| natwhitelist.bypass          | Allows joining even without being whitelisted    |
| natwhitelist.list            | Allows you to list whitelisted players         |
| natwhitelist.admin           | Grants all NAT-Whitelist rights (inherits all of the above permissions) |

# My Battle Mod

**Three wands, endless battles.**

My Battle Mod adds three simple yet powerful items to Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge).  
No dependencies – works with **any** Forge mod's mobs.

---

## Features

### Battle Wand – Make mobs from different mods fight each other

- Right-click any mob to create a team for its mod (team name = mod ID).
- Right-click the same leader mob again to disband that mod's team.
- Sneak + right-click to disband all teams.
- Right-click air to change modes.
- When a team is created, all existing mobs of that mod are automatically added to the team.
- Newly spawned mobs automatically join their mod's team.
- Mobs from different teams become hostile to each other (no range limit).
- Leader mobs receive a glowing effect while their team is active.

### Boss Wand – Add a real-time health bar to any mob

- Right-click a mob to display a BossBar above the screen, showing its health.
- The bar updates automatically as the mob takes damage or heals.
- Right-click the same mob again to remove the BossBar.
- Right-click air to change the bossbar's color.
- Works on any living entity (including modded bosses).
- The BossBar is visible to all nearby players.

### Move Wand – Move the mob

- Right-click mobs to select/deselect them (multiple selection allowed).
- Right-click the ground to move all selected mobs to that location.
- Right-click air to toggle between Teleport and Walk mode.
- Sneak + right-click air to clear all selections.

### Multi-language support

All in-game messages are fully translatable via language files (English and Chinese included).

---

## How to get the items

In Creative mode, find them under the **Tools & Utilities** tab.

Example commands:
- /give @p mybattlemod:battle_wand
- /give @p mybattlemod:boss_wand
- /give @p mybattlemod:move_wand

---

## Commands (`/mybattlemod`)

- `/mybattlemod team` – Manage teams (add, remove, list, members, join, leave, friendly fire)
- `/mybattlemod move` – Move mobs (teleport, walk, manage selection)
- `/mybattlemod ally` – Manage alliances (add, remove, list, delete alliance)
- `/mybattlemod information` – Control mob head display (mod ID, alliance icon, both, clear all)
- `/mybattlemod targetmode` – Switch target selector mode (replace vanilla or merge)
- `/mybattlemod sightrange` – Set or get mob detection range

---

## Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Forge 47.x
- Works with **any** Forge mod – no extra libraries needed.

body:
# **Happy Creeper**
Short summary:

Turn creepers into survival companions by weakening, taming, healing, recoloring, and fighting alongside them.

# **Overview**
Happy Creeper is a NeoForge mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that gives creepers a full companion gameplay loop.

Instead of only running from them, you can approach them safely with a creeper head, weaken them with a special biscuit, tame them, and keep them with you as a combat companion.

This mod is built around survival-friendly mechanics rather than creative-only gimmicks.

# **How It Works**
- Wear a Creeper Head to get close safely.
- Feed the creeper an Anti-Blast Biscuit to weaken it.
- Feed the weakened creeper a Sweet Gunpowder Biscuit to tame it.
- Right-click your tamed creeper with an empty hand to switch between follow and stay.
- Heal it with Gunpowder or another Sweet Gunpowder Biscuit.
- Tamed Creeper Features
- Follows its owner and can be told to stay
- Teleports back if it gets left behind
- Changes dimension with its owner
- Resyncs after the owner respawns
- Defends the owner from hostile mobs
- Attacks mobs the owner is fighting
- Uses a small contact blast attack instead of normal self-destruction
- Dies with a larger non-destructive final explosion
- Has increased health compared to a normal creeper
- Visual Features
- Weakened creepers show a continuous visual effect
- Tamed creepers use a custom happy green texture by default
- Tamed creepers can be recolored with dyes
- Rainbow Biscuit unlocks a smooth rainbow mode that cycles through colored creeper textures

# Items
- Biscuit
- Anti-Blast Biscuit
- Sweet Gunpowder Biscuit
- Rainbow Biscuit

# Current Release Notes
This release is intended as an alpha playtest build.

The full taming loop is implemented and playable, but balance and polish are still in progress.

# License summary
- You may use this mod freely.
- You may include the original unmodified jar in modpacks, launchers, mirrors, and server packs.
- You may not publish modified versions without my written permission.
- Approved derivatives must include credit and a link to the official project page.

# Requirements
NeoForge mod for the Minecraft versions listed on this page.
Requires Java 21.

A Client-Side mod for Hypixel Skyblock that highlights the area where a Trapper Animal could be, based on the height and angle the Theodolite tells us. **DISCLAIMER:**
The accuracy of the mod varies. This is because in the message you get from the Theodolite, **_all values are rounded_** to a multiple of 5. You could be one block below an Animal and it would tell you that the mob is 5 blocks above.
You _can_ counteract this by setting the angle and height margins to 2.5, but it would highlight a much larger area as a result. # Features - Highlights a circular area when using the Theodolite, red circle for center, green circles for margin of error - Circles get removed when the Animal is killed (or when you leave the lobby/server) - Config - currently only changeable in the JSON file... (within the standard MC config folder) - That's it for now... ## Planned - Config Menu - Fancy Shapes ## Issues - There is an Issue while using Shaders using the Iris mod which prevents the rendering of... anything, really. From what I can read on the Iris Docs, this is unfixable. - You can use Shaders perfectly fine, but you will need to turn them off to see anything drawn by this mod

title: mc-js
description: Create Minecraft plugins in JavaScript instead of Java! Full Bukkit/Spigot/Paper API, Hot-Reload, Events, Commands, Databases, GUIs and more.
body:
# 🚀 MC-JS - JavaScript Plugin System for Minecraft

**Write Minecraft Server Plugins in JavaScript - No Java Required!**

MC-JS is a powerful plugin system that allows you to develop server plugins using modern JavaScript (ES6+) instead of Java. Perfect for developers who already know JavaScript or want to quickly create plugins without having to learn Java.

## ✨ Key Features

### 🎯 Core Capabilities

- **📝 Full JavaScript Support** - Develop plugins in modern JavaScript using the Rhino Engine
- **⚡ Hot Reload** - Reload plugins without server restart (`/jsreload`)
- **🔧 Complete API Access** - Access to virtually all Bukkit/Spigot/Paper API functions
- **🎮 Event System** - Register listeners for any Minecraft event with priority support
- **💬 Command System** - Create custom commands with full tab completion support
- **⏰ Task Scheduling** - Synchronous and asynchronous task scheduling
- **📦 Inventory Management** - Create and manage custom GUI menus using standard Bukkit inventories (9-54 slots) with click handlers
- **🗄️ Database Support** - Built-in SQLite database operations (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, SELECT)
- **🌐 HTTP Requests** - Make HTTP GET/POST requests asynchronously
- **🔐 Encryption** - MD5, SHA256, Base64 encoding/decoding
- **📁 File I/O** - YAML, JSON, and text file support
- **🎨 BossBar Support** - Create and manage boss bars with progress tracking
- **⏱️ Cooldown System** - Built-in cooldown management per player
- **⚙️ Config System** - Per-plugin configuration files (YAML)
- **🌍 World Management** - Control weather, time, world border, explosions
- **🎯 Entity Management** - Spawn, control, and customize entities
- **🔒 Player Management** - Ban, kick, teleport, health, food, gamemode

### 🛠️ Advanced Features

- **🎨 Particle Effects** - Spawn particles with string or enum support
- **🔊 Sound System** - Play sounds at locations or for players
- **📊 Scoreboard System** - Create and manage scoreboards, teams, objectives
- **📝 Item Manipulation** - Create, modify, and manage items with custom names and lore
- **🔒 Permission System** - Check and manage player permissions
- **🎨 Color Support** - Minecraft color codes and formatting utilities
- **🌐 HTTP Integration** - Make external API calls and web requests
- **📊 Economy Integration** - Vault economy support for server economies

## 📦 Installation

### Requirements

- **Minecraft Server**: Paper/Spigot 1.20+ (recommended: Paper)
- **Java**: Version 21 or higher
- **Minecraft Version**: 1.20+

### Steps

1. **Download the latest release** from the [Releases](https://github.com/LootingVI/MC-JS/releases) page
2. **Place the JAR file** in your server's `plugins/` folder
3. **Start or restart** your server
4. **Create JS plugins** in `plugins/MC-JS/js-plugins/` directory

The plugin will automatically create the `js-plugins` directory and copy an example plugin on first run.

## 🚀 Quick Start

### Creating Your First Plugin

1. **Navigate to** `plugins/MC-JS/js-plugins/` directory
2. **Create a new file** with `.js` extension (e.g., `myplugin.js`)
3. **Add the following code**:

```javascript
var pluginInfo = {
    name: "My First Plugin",
    version: "1.0.0",
    author: "YourName",
    description: "My awesome plugin!"
};

function onEnable() {
    logger.info("My plugin is enabled!");
    
    // Register a command
    api.registerCommand("hello", "Say hello", "/hello", function(sender, args) {
        api.sendMessage(sender, "&aHello from JavaScript!");
        return true;
    });
    
    // Register an event
    api.registerEvent("player.PlayerJoinEvent", function(event) {
        var player = event.getPlayer();
        api.sendMessage(player, "&6Welcome to the server!");
    });
}

function onDisable() {
    logger.info("My plugin is disabled!");
}

this.onEnable = onEnable;
this.onDisable = onDisable;
this.pluginInfo = pluginInfo;
```

4. **Save the file** - The plugin will auto-load on server start, or use `/jsreload` to reload
5. **Test your command** - Type `/hello` in-game or in console
6. **Check console** - Look for "My plugin is enabled!" message

> 💡 **Tip**: Use `/jslist` to see all loaded JavaScript plugins and `/jsreload <plugin>` to reload a specific plugin.

## 📚 Available Objects

These objects are automatically available in all JavaScript plugins:

| Object | Description | Usage |
|--------|-------------|-------|
| `api` | Complete JS API wrapper - main interface for all operations | `api.registerCommand(...)` |
| `server` | Minecraft server instance | `server.getOnlinePlayers()` |
| `plugin` | Main plugin instance | `plugin.getName()` |
| `logger` | Plugin logger | `logger.info("Message")` |
| `scheduler` | Server scheduler | `scheduler.runTask(...)` |
| `Bukkit` | Direct Bukkit API access | `Bukkit.getServer()` |

## 🎮 Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/jsreload` | Reload all JS plugins | `mcjs.admin` |
| `/jsreload <plugin>` | Reload specific plugin | `mcjs.admin` |
| `/jslist` | List all loaded JS plugins | `mcjs.admin` |
| `/jsconfig` | View or reload plugin configuration | `mcjs.admin` |

## 📖 Documentation

> **📖 Full Documentation**: Visit our [complete documentation website](https://lootingvi.github.io/MC-JS/) for detailed API reference, examples, and guides.

## 💡 Example Applications

- **Welcome Plugins** - Greet players with messages, titles, and sounds
- **Statistics Systems** - Track player statistics with SQLite databases
- **Custom GUI Menus** - Create interactive menus using standard Bukkit inventories with custom layouts and click handlers
- **Mini-Games** - Develop simple games with event handling
- **Utility Plugins** - Create helpful tools and commands
- **Integration Plugins** - Connect your server with external APIs

## 🛠️ Technical Details

- **JavaScript Engine**: Rhino (Mozilla)
- **API Version**: 1.21
- **Compatibility**: Paper, Spigot, Bukkit
- **License**: MIT

## 🤝 Support

- **GitHub**: [LootingVI/MC-JS](https://github.com/LootingVI/MC-JS)
- **Issues**: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/LootingVI/MC-JS/issues)
- **Documentation**: [lootingvi.github.io/MC-JS](https://lootingvi.github.io/MC-JS/)

## 📝 License

This project is licensed under the MIT License - see the [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for details.

---

**Made with ❤️ for the Minecraft Community**

# 🥛 reMilked

[![fabric](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/supported/fabric_64h.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/remilked/versions?l=fabric)
[![neoforge](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/supported/neoforge_64h.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/remilked/versions?l=neoforge)

**reMilked** is an unofficial cross-platform continuation of the original **Milked** mod. Built with the **Architectury API**, it brings the unique "milking" mechanics to the modern versions of Minecraft.

---

## 🐄 About the Mod
Have you ever felt that players are... underutilized resources? **reMilked** allows players to be milked just like cows. Every player has a milk storage (10 levels max).

### Key Gameplay Mechanics:
* **Milking Players:** Use an empty bucket on another player to get a Milk Bucket.
* **The Risk:** Each milking action reduces the target's milk level. If a player's milk level reaches zero, they **die immediately**.
* **Self-Sustainability:** You can milk yourself! Just hold `Shift`, look down, and `Right-Click` with an empty bucket.
* **Regeneration:** Milk levels naturally restore over time (1 level every 30 seconds), so manage your "resources" wisely.

## ✨ Improvements in reMilked
This fork focuses on modernizing the experience and fixing long-standing issues:

* **Multi-platform Support:** Native support for both **Fabric** and **NeoForge**.
* **Refined Logic:** Immortal players (Creative mode or Invulnerability) can no longer be milked to death.
* **Creative Freedom:** Removed milking cooldowns for players in Creative mode.
* **Fixes:** Resolved a bug where armor could prevent death even after the player's milk supply was completely exhausted.
* **Localization:** Now includes full **Russian (ru_ru)** support.

## 👥 Credits
**reMilked** is a fork of the original [Milked](https://modrinth.com/mod/milked-koil) mod created by the **Koil** organization.
* **SpiritXIV** — Original Owner

title: Falling Blocks
description: Every once in a while, blocks around you fall down!
body:
# Falling Blocks

**Falling Blocks** turns your world into a collapsing danger zone! At random intervals, blocks around every player lose stability and fall as physics-affected entities. Build quickly, stay alert - the ground might not be there for long. **Yes, you can still beat the game!**

## Features

- **Random Collapse Events**: Every 30-120 seconds, a sphere around each player triggers falling blocks.
- **Countdown Warning**: A global boss bar appears 5 seconds before the collapse begins.
- **Smart Physics**: Most solid blocks can fall - exceptions include bedrock, portal blocks, fluids, etc.
- **Vanilla-Friendly**: Works seamlessly with vanilla Minecraft and most other mods.
- **Server-Side**: Only the server (or the player hosting the world) needs the mod installed-perfect for multiplayer chaos!

## Why Play?

This mod adds tension and unpredictability to your survival experience. Whether you're seeking a unique challenge or want to spice up multiplayer worlds, **Falling Blocks** keeps you constantly moving and adapting. Can you survive when the world keeps falling apart?

title: Flower Bonemealing
description: A simple mod that allows you to spread small flowers by right-clicking them with bone meal.
body: # **ABOUT** The "Flower Bonemealing" mod is intended to solve one simple issue: Flower farming. When playing survival, I found myself to be annoyed by the fact only tall flowers can be bonemealed to drop a copy of themselves. When playing on Bedrock, however, I learnt that it is a feature to be able to right click a small flower with bonemeal to spread more of it. This is my attempt of replicating this feature in a more Minecraft Java Edition like way. ## **USAGE** Like the about section describes, simply right-click a flower with some bone meal to spread more of it. The main purpose is to farm dyes. ## **CONFIGURATION** This mod is highly configurable. It contains a block tag called `flower_bonemealing:blacklist` to which you can add flowers that should not be spread. Additionally, the mod contains config options that let you set the spread range of flowers on all three axes individually, as well as a decimal number to control how successful spreading is. ## **COMPATIBILITY** This mod works with flowers from all mods by default if they tag their flowers as `minecraft:small_flowers`. The way it works is that it checks whether the interacted block is of this block tag and then does a series of checks to ensure it only spreads to positions the block would survive, meaning all base blocks like dirt are also compatible by default and don't need to be tagged. ## **PRESENTATION**

title: SimpleRules
description: A simple /rules plugin for servers.
body:
# 📜 SimpleRules

![simplerules](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9a7ff975bc069a002072a52e016754af3be19849.png)

A lightweight and elegant solution for displaying your server rules directly in Minecraft chat! Perfect for server owners who want a clean, professional way to share their community guidelines.

## ✨ What makes this special?

- 🎨 **Beautiful Formatting** - Eye-catching colors and borders that make your rules stand out
- 🔧 **Easy Management** - Edit rules in a simple config file and reload without restarting
- ⚡ **Lightning Fast** - Minimal resource usage, won't slow down your server
- 🎯 **User-Friendly** - Just one simple command

## 🚀 Quick Start

1. Drop the plugin into your `plugins/` folder
2. Start your server
3. Edit the rules in `plugins/SimpleRulesPlugin/config.yml`
4. Run `/rules reload` to apply changes
5. Players can now use `/rules` to see your server guidelines!

## 💡 Commands Overview

- `/rules` - Show the server rules
- `/rules help` - Display available commands  
- `/rules reload` - Reload configuration (admin only)


## ⚙️ Easy Configuration

Simply edit your `config.yml`:

```yaml
rules:
  - "Be respectful to all players"
  - "No griefing or stealing"
  - "Have fun and follow server guidelines!"
```

No complex setup, no database required - just simple YAML configuration!

title: Project: Mayhem
description: A chaotic modpack with over 160 mods, inspired by CrazyCraft.
body:
![The Project: Mayhem logo.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/46539c60c59688a7c08a9b3ee306967898648701.png)

# 📖 About 📖
**Project: Mayhem** is a massive Forge modpack for Minecraft **1.20.1**, loaded with over **160 mods** that transform the game into the ultimate sandbox of destruction, creativity, and absolute randomness.

Want to build the base of your dreams with thousands of block variants? Go for it. Want to blow it all up seconds later with dozens of insanely destructive TNTs? You can. Arm yourself with a ridiculous arsenal of guns and weapons, explore beautifully overhauled biomes and dimensions, tame dragons, survive against mobs from every corner of the modding universe, or just vibe with some nostalgic shaders and classic Faithful textures. You can even scale your player, paint your own paintings, or visit the Aether.

With massive worldgen changes, chaotic combat options, new mobs, new mechanics, and full controller support, **Project: Mayhem** throws structure out the window and hands you pure, unpredictable fun.

This isn’t just modded Minecraft — this is a playground of mayhem.
There are no limits here. Only madness.

# 🛠️ Features 🛠️
## 🎨 Visuals & Immersion 🎨
- **Faithful 32x (Classic)** is enabled by default for that nostalgic look we all grew up with
- **Complementary Unbound Shader** enhances the atmosphere with beautiful lighting and shadows, also tying into that nostalgia
- **AmbientSounds** and the aptly named **"Sounds"** mod make the world feel more alive with enhanced audio
- **Particular** and **Visuality** add extra particle effects, making combat, movement, and the environment feel richer
- **Concentration** adds proper borderless fullscreen support for a smoother experience

## 🕹️ Utilities 🕹️
- Full **controller support** via the Controller Support Mod (you may need to configure it for your controller)
- **Essential Mod** improves multiplayer and adds various handy utilities
- **Resourcify** lets you install shaders and resource packs in-game without leaving Minecraft
- **GraveStone Mod** keeps your items safe when you die — no more painful loot losses
- **Sophisticated Backpacks** offers customizable backpacks to help you carry way more stuff
- **Pehkui** lets you scale your player model however you like
- **Customizable Player Models** lets you design your character exactly how you want — arms, legs, everything
- **Cake's Cosmetics**, **CosmeticArmors**, and **CosmeticWeapons** add loads of visual flair without affecting gameplay
- **Quark** and **Vanilla Refresh** overhaul and expand vanilla systems with quality-of-life tweaks and new mechanics

## 🗺️ Exploration 🗺️
- Terrain is completely overhauled with **Tectonic**, **Biomes O’ Plenty**, and **Dynamic Trees**
- Trees now fall realistically thanks to **FallingTree**
- The **Aether Dimension** brings a nostalgic dream world to life
- **Infinite Dimensions** adds an absurd number of randomized, wild dimensions — inspired by the April Fools update
- The End and Nether have been fully revamped with **Incendium** and **Endless Biomes**
- **YUNG’s mods** and **Towns & Towers** massively improve vanilla structures
- **Limitless** removes the build height cap — go as high as you want

## 🔫 Combat & Creatures 🔫
- Guns galore from **TaCZ** and **Point Blank** — if it shoots, it’s probably here
- **Expanded Combat** and **Better Combat** introduce deeper melee mechanics and tons of new weapons
- Minecraft Dungeons content is added for a bit of RPG spice
- **Lucky TNT Mod** adds dozens of wild and unpredictable TNT variants
- **Burnt** brings realistic fire spread and liquid magma
- **Alex’s Mobs** and **Ice and Fire** fill the world with creatures, both majestic and terrifying
- **All The Trims** lets you apply any armor trim to any armor

## 🏗️ Building 🏗️
- **FramedBlocks** gives you ultimate control over shapes and materials for your builds
- **Rechiseled** adds hundreds of block variants for detailed builds
- **Exline’s Furniture**, **Furniture Beetle**, **Another Furniture**, and **Furniture Expanded** add stylish decor options
- **Joy of Painting** lets you paint your own in-game artwork
- **Create** (with several addons) provides complex machines, automation, and mechanical creativity

title: Toxic Storm
description: Toxic Storm is a deadly survival mod that transforms Minecraft into a fight for your life against a massive toxic storm.
body:
🌪️ Toxic Storm – Survive the Poison
Toxic Storm is a deadly survival mod that transforms Minecraft into a fight for your life against a massive toxic storm. After three days in a new world, the storm awakens — and from that point on, survival becomes a desperate race against time, poison, and chaos.

⏳ You Have 3 Days
When you enter a new world, you have three in-game days to gather supplies, craft gear, and prepare. After that, the toxic storm begins — and only one place is safe: your original spawn point.

🛑 The Safe Zone
A small protected area around your spawn is the only place where the storm can't reach you.

Stepping outside it means instant death from the poisonous clouds.

Even hostile mobs like zombies and creepers spawn inside the safe zone, making it your only refuge and your greatest threat.

🧪 Toxic Resistance Potion
You’re not entirely helpless — using apples, you can craft a special potion that grants temporary immunity (2 minutes) to the toxic storm.
Use it wisely to explore, relocate, or escape when the storm shifts to another location.

💀 What Happens in the Storm?
☠️ Instant death outside the safe zone without protection

💣 Random TNT bombardments

🧟 Mob spawns inside the safe zone

⚡ Sudden teleportation events to random locations

🔧 Features
Global toxic storm starts after 3 days

Potion system that adds risk-reward choices

Perfect for chaos survival, hardcore maps, or content creators

⚠️ Early Development Notice
Toxic Storm is still under active development. Expect bugs and experimental mechanics. Feedback is welcome to help shape the final experience.

title: Expanded Entity Armor Model
description: This is a Resource pack that turns on parts that vanilla hides without breaking other resource packs!
body:
# Expanded Entity Armor Model
## What does the Resource Pack does?

Vanilla uses 2 models for armor models:

**[entity]_outer_armor.JEM** for the helmet, chestplate and boots, these models show all the parts/cubes in it: right/left legs, right/left arms, body, head, and headwear.

**[entity]_inner_armor.JEM** for the leggings, this only shows the right/left legs and the body, but for some reason it vanilla hides the rest: right/left arms, head, and the headwear.

This Resource Pack turns on these parts, and adjusts the heads to not interfere with the player skin, however this isn't the only thing it does, it also adjusts the armor model to fit better with the slim player and all other entities that can wear armor in vanilla (anyone can suggest me an entity from a mod in the [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/SanguardMC/Expanded-Entity-Armor-Model/issues)

The entity changes are made so they don't break other resource packs that add other armor textures, you can use the models in the pack. However, I'd highly appreciate it if you included a link to this pack, as it required a lot of effort to re-model the entity armor manually with the correct UV without breaking everything.

## How can it be used?

The Pack allows you to create things like gloves or something like the Maid armor for my [Resource Pack,](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/spectrumcraft-pack) which also includes these models

The Resource Pack also includes a Template armor that can be used with [CIT Resewn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn)

You can use the Armor Template [Blockbench model](https://github.com/SanguardMC/Expanded-Entity-Armor-Model/releases/tag/BB-Model) on the GitHub Repository, or you have the armor template armor that's inside the pack and the model:

|Template Armor|Armor Template Model|
|-|-|
|![Template Armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Rc79ILyk/images/555ca0f72f915200ccbf70071e7a610c731d1ba3.png)|![Armor Template Model](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Rc79ILyk/images/97e9600b6436b711af246b0805e03d9bd65190f5.png)|

Red/Green is the outer layer, while the Blue/Yellow is the inner layer

## Dependencies

You'll only require [Entity Model Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) in order to work, but I'd recommend CIT Resewn if you want to add armor to your resource pack and use the template armor

As far as I'm concerned, Optifine doesn't support entity armor CEM models, so I'm not sure if it works

## Credits
- [Traben](https://modrinth.com/user/Traben) & Infinity-lily
  - For helping me know how to show these hidden parts in Traben's discord server
- [Shizotoaster's Ultimate Armor Patch](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ultimate-armor-patch/gallery)
  - For the inspiration of adapt all models to fit the entities but without destroying other Resource Packs

However, you now exhaust yourself much faster. 🍖 > - Your body can no longer support armor heavier than Iron. 🔩 > - When you get hit, you have a 20% chance to inflict damage onto your attacker, and heal some of the health you lost back. ‼️ > **Down To A Seed ❤️** > - As a result of your excess of knowledge on plants and flowers alike, you know how to create some of them, down to an atom. 🧠 > **I Think I'm Gonna Be Sick... ❤️** > - You have found a way to eat flowers / plants and gain some of their abilities through eating them. 🪷 > - However, you also found out that some of them give side effects. 🥀 > - You must sneak to eat flowers / plants, if you want to remove the effect of a flower / plant, spit it out by sneaking and using your Primary Power button. 😵‍💫 > - Only 1 plant ability can be equipped at a time. ☝️
🪷 Each Flower & The Abilities They Grant 🌷
![Dandelion, applies Saturation & Health Boost, Poppy, applies Haste & Speed 2, Kelp, gives unlimited air, Chorus Fruit, primary, teleport, teleports you 8 blocks in any direction you're looking at, has a 30% chance to fall and teleport you to a random place within your area, wither rose, primary, wither everyone, everyone within an 8 block radius of you gets the wither effect, you take 2 and a half hearts of damage almost every 2 seconds, Oxeye Daisy, primary, regenerate self, applies regeneration for almost 3 seconds, secondary, regenerate others, regenerates people you've "tagged" within an 8 block radius, to tag people right click on them, to untag people sneak then right click on them, to clear all tags you've made, sneak then use secondary, Torchflower, primary, burn others, burn anything and everything within an 8 block radius, secondary, Hot Hand, after activation your next hit will burn your target, Water hurts you, Sculk Vein, primary, smash, after activation your next hit will knock your target back further, secondary, roar, you roar, sending every entity within an 8 block radius back and dealing an extra 2 and a half hearts of damage, applies blindness & slowness 2, you grow to 1.5 times your size](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d9d08547102bebf4c0f8c1b0d337bc896d35833a.png)

title: MuffinHunt Datapack
description: A Manhunt-style datapack with a few twists.
body:
# muffinhunt-datapack

This is the MuffinHunt datapack! You'll find features packed for MuffinHunts!

## What is a MuffinHunt?

A MuffinHunt, in short, is a variation of Manhunt, with extra rules. Among those rules are other changes like having starting kits (which are mostly for balancing), automatically increasing kits, and more. You can find a full list of rules and explanations about the series [here](https://osfanbuff63.github.io/muffinhunt-datapack-docs/WhatIsAMuffinHunt).

## How To Use

Place the zip file that you downloaded in your Minecraft world (.minecraft/saves/[worldname]/datapacks by default) folder and you are good to go! You can trigger the functions manually, but you will not need to run any commands beyond `/trigger StartMuffinHunt` to work. You'll find them under namespace `muffinhunt:`. You will have to manually assign tags, however while a MuffinHunt is running, you can do `/function muffinhunt:dev/assign_permanent_tags`. This will assign tags that will not be removed on the end of the MuffinHunt.
