title: MacCraft
description: A performance-optimized Minecraft modpack tailored for macOS.
body:
MacCraft provides a solid foundation of the best optimization mods available, carefully configured for maximum performance on macOS. Backed by extensive testing and research, MacCraft runs smoothly on both Apple Silicon and Intel-based Macs. 

Built with simplicity and maintainability in mind, it includes only essential quality-of-life and visual enhancements—keeping things lightweight, fast, and focused on performance. This also means it's quick to recieve Minecraft version updates.

The modpack includes the Iris Shaders Mod and supports shaders, though you'll have to check for MacOS/ Metal compatibility on the shaderpack that you want to use. (This limitation is because Apple discontinued support for OpenGL on MacOS with OpenGL 4.1 in 2011.) This modpack includes Mellow Shaders by TheCMK which runs well on MacOS and provides a nice balance between visuals and performance.

title: BetterMS
description: Adds a configurable numerical ping display to the player list.
body:
**BetterMS** is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod that improves the player list by replacing the default ping bar indicators with the actual ping value displayed in milliseconds. Instead of guessing your connection quality from a set of bars, you get a precise numerical readout that updates in real time.

The mod color-codes each ping value based on latency thresholds, making it easy to identify connection quality at a glance. Low latency values appear in green, moderate values in yellow, and high latency values in red, following a consistent and intuitive color scale.

BetterMS is designed to be completely unobtrusive. It has no configuration screen by default on most versions, requires no setup beyond installation, and adds no overhead to your game. It runs entirely on the client side, meaning it works on any server without requiring the mod to be installed server-side.

**Requirements**

- Fabric Loader
- No additional dependencies required for most versions

**Installation**

Download the release matching your Minecraft version and place the .jar file into your mods folder. Launch the game using the Fabric profile and the mod will load automatically. No additional configuration is needed.

**Author**

Developed and maintained by sjgamer92og. For issues or feedback, visit the project page on Modrinth.

title: The Grass Requiem
description: The Grass Requiem is a mod that overhauls how grass and wheat farming works.
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4a92d1cbd816ee581f4b03e9c5c4a23913cdda94.png)

## About The Grass Requiem

The Grass Requiem is a mod that overhauls how grass works as well as add a lot of features related to grass and wheat in a way that makes Wheat and Grass more interesting and less static, ~~while also letting you touch grass.~~

This mod is made as a submission to the MCreative Discord Server's Nature-themed mod jam.

![separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95d21aa4393cf17acf2cb3df73ca45013a3cc63e.png)

## Quick Summary of Features

- Dirt will turn into Grassy Dirt before turning into Grass Block.
- Tall Grass grows over time.
- Scythes (Harvesting tool that can also be used in combat)
- Wheat Seeds replaced with edible Wheat Grains.
- Tall Grass is now farmable and can be used as a cheap food source for Animals.
- Straws, the Byproduct of extracting Wheat Grains can be used as a compact fuel and used to make building blocks.

![separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95d21aa4393cf17acf2cb3df73ca45013a3cc63e.png)

## Grass Growth & Grassy Dirt Block

Dirt blocks adjacent to Grass blocks will first turn into "Grassy Dirt" block. The Grassy Dirt block then would act like a grass block, where it would convert adjacent dirt blocks into Grassy Dirt too. Leave Grassy Dirt for long enough, and it would turn into a full grass block.

The grass foliage you see in the world will now spawn in randomized ages, where some are short and some are half, and some fully grown. Cutting it with your bare hand will not drop anything, but using a Hoe or a Scythe (tool that is going to be explained later) will drop "Cut Grass" and will leave a small grass that will slowly grow back later. 

The Cut Grass is an item that can be used as a cheap, low quality drop for breeding animals. Cut Grass does not tempt animals, and the Grass you obtain it from grows twice as slow as normal crops.

![Grass Growing into dirt](https://i.imgur.com/OiWITIZ.png)

![separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95d21aa4393cf17acf2cb3df73ca45013a3cc63e.png)

## Wheat Farming Overhaul

You can no longer get Wheat Seeds from grass. Instead, you will need to find Wild Wheat, which is found in the Plains, Sunflower Plains, Savanna, and Meadow biomes. Harvesting them, will most of the time will give you Plain-old Wheat, but sometimes give you Straw and Wheat Grains. 

![Wild Wheat](https://i.imgur.com/7w9HGBW.png)

Wheat is no longer used to craft food items, and instead you have to extract the Wheat Grains from it by holding the wheat in your main hand, a hoe or scythe in your off-hand, then right-clicking, which would use up the Wheat and give you Straw and Wheat Grains. 

Wheat Grains (Formerly known as Wheat Seeds in Vanilla Minecraft) is a low nutrition food source on their own, but you can craft bread, cake, cookies, as well as Cereal from them (which is a good food source).

![Cereal Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a04e328700bb7c518281b60f2b76fe844a5e9034.png)

![separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95d21aa4393cf17acf2cb3df73ca45013a3cc63e.png)

## Scythes

The Scythe is a Tool set that can be made from ranging between wooden all the way to Netherite, which is a Harvesting Farm tool used to quickly clear out foliage and crops within an area. Grass, Tall Grass, Fern, and Large Fern now take time to remove, having a Hoe and Scythe is important to have in order to clear them out. All Scythes below Diamond tier would clear out 3x3 area of foliage and crops, while diamond tier or above would clear out 5x5 area.

![Scythe Tiers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/311042c7e9c4f6b0567f7c778081bcae3f75650e.png)

The Scythes can also be used in combat as it gives an extra 1.5 Block and Entity Reach as well as give you an attack speed of 2.6, which would elevate combat by having high-speed attacks. (Using it with Strength II potion will make it incredibly powerful due to high attack speed)

![Netherite Scythe being used to clear out grass](https://i.imgur.com/pgEOL6Y.png)

![separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95d21aa4393cf17acf2cb3df73ca45013a3cc63e.png)

## Straw and its uses

Straw is a quite useful byproduct of extracting Wheat Grains from Wheat. First, you could use it to make a Straw Hat you can wear, cus why not? You can also use it as a highly compact furnace fuel source. 

On its own, it can only smelt 1.25 items per Straw, which is not that much. But you could convert 9 of them into 1 Straw Bale, in which the Straw Bale would last 9x as long as plain straw so it would smelt 11.25 items per Straw Bale. We are not done compacting the fuel source! You can Compact 4 Straw Bales into 2 Straw Blocks, which would allow you to smelt 22.5 items per Straw Block.

A Straw Block as described earlier is a high density furnace fuel source. That's not its only use though. Straw blocks double as a decorative block in which you can craft them into blocks like slabs and stairs and use them to build whatever you like.

Lastly Packed Mud used to require Wheat, and now would require Straw instead so it makes sense.

![Straw Blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1f818bba825429b5225d74cfbf6791e5cf49ed11.png)
![Straw Bale and Grass Bale](https://i.imgur.com/ReEJHiR.png)

![separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95d21aa4393cf17acf2cb3df73ca45013a3cc63e.png)

## Other small Additions and Features
- Added bunch of villager trades involving all the new added content.
- JEI compatibility, where you could see information on how to extract Wheat Grains from Wheat.
- Advancements has been added to help guide the player.
- Grass Bales exist as a way to store a lot of cut grass.
- You can use Cut Grass and Grass Bales as a fuel source instead of a cheap breeding food; though they're weaker than straw.

title: ZzaiClear
description: This mod provides entity cleaning function
body:
**Zzclear** is a lightweight, highly intelligent entity clearing and server optimization mod for Minecraft Fabric.
It silently operates in the background to automatically sweep up dropped items, abandoned entities, and lag-inducing objects based on a highly configurable frequency timer. With a powerful in-game command system and hot-reloadable configuration logic, it eliminates server lag from its absolute source!

---

## ✨ Core Features

- 🕐 **Automated Scheduled Clearing:** Customize the sweeping cycles (down to the exact minute); when the timer strikes, lingering entities are flawlessly eradicated.
- 🛡️ **Smart Whitelists & Filters:** Say goodbye to "one-size-fits-all" wipes! Whether it's dropped items, specific monsters, or individual entity types, Zzclear supports precise bypassing and explicit targeting via its blacklist/whitelist arrays.
- 🐴 **Rider Protection:** Entities currently being ridden by players (horses, boats, minecarts, etc.) are automatically protected from clearing.
- ⏱️ **Item Drop Immunity:** Newly dropped items can be given a grace period to prevent them from being immediately swept up.
- 🌍 **Dimension Filtering:** Exclude specific dimensions (e.g., The End) from the sweep cycle entirely.
- 📊 **Sweep Threshold:** Skip the clearing cycle when the number of target entities is below a configurable minimum, avoiding unnecessary empty runs.
- 🌐 **Bilingual Config:** Config file comments support Chinese and English, controlled by the `language` field. Takes effect after `/zzclear reload`.
- 🪓 **Total Entity Management:**
  - **Standard Clearing:** Dropped Items, Experience Orbs
  - **Mob Clearing:** Hostile/Neutral Monsters, Passive Animals
  - **Vehicles/Decorations:** Boats, Paintings, Item Frames
  - **Physics/Projectiles:** Fired Arrows, Thrown Tridents, Falling Blocks, Primed TNT, Shulker Bullets, Firework Rockets, and more.
- 🔄 **Hot-Reload Commands:** Changing the configuration data file? No need to restart the server! A single built-in command applies the new rules instantly.

---

## ⌨️ In-Game Commands

The primary root command is `/zzclear`:

### 1. Configuration Reload (Admin)
` /zzclear reload `
- **Function:** Re-reads the `config/config.json` file from disk and immediately applies all new clearing filters, timer periods, and refreshes config comment language.

### 2. Check Clear Countdown (All Players)
` /zzclear status `
- **Function:** Shows the remaining time (minutes and seconds) until the next automatic sweep.

### 3. Manual Immediate Sweeping (Admin)
If you do not want to wait for the background timer intervals, use these commands to instantly wipe specific entity categories:
- `/zzclear items` — Instantly clears all dropped items on the ground.
- `/zzclear monsters` — Instantly clears all hostile and neutral monsters.
- `/zzclear animals` — Instantly clears all friendly, passive animals.
- `/zzclear xps` — Instantly clears all floating experience orbs.
- `/zzclear others` — Instantly clears miscellaneous entities (e.g., Paintings, Boats, Falling Blocks, Projectiles).

### 4. Item Whitelists (Admin)
Hold an item in your main hand and instantly register it into the whitelist filters to prevent the sweeper from ever consuming it:
- `/zzclear white item add`  — Adds the **currently held item** into the global whitelist.
- `/zzclear white item del`  — Removes the **currently held item** from the global whitelist.

### 5. Entity ID Whitelists (Admin)
If you need to meticulously protect or exclude a specific living organism or object (e.g., `minecraft:zombie`), utilize these endpoints:
- `/zzclear white entity add <Entity ID>` — Adds a specific entity registry ID into the whitelist.
- `/zzclear white entity del <Entity ID>` — Un-registers a specific entity registry ID from the whitelist.
  > *Note: These commands fully support in-game Tab autocompletion suggestions!*

---

## 🔑 Permission Nodes

Without LuckPerms, admin commands require OP level 4. With LuckPerms installed, use these permission nodes for fine-grained control:

| Permission | Description | Default |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `zzclear.command.admin` | Reload, whitelist management | OP only |
| `zzclear.command.items` | Manual item clearing | OP only |
| `zzclear.command.monsters` | Manual monster clearing | OP only |
| `zzclear.command.animals` | Manual animal clearing | OP only |
| `zzclear.command.xps` | Manual XP orb clearing | OP only |
| `zzclear.command.others` | Manual other entity clearing | OP only |
| `zzclear.command.status` | View clear countdown | All players |

---

## ⚙️ Configuration Setup

After launching the game once, the mod automatically generates the config file at:

```
<game root>/Zzclear/config/config.json
```

The config file includes comments in Chinese or English (controlled by the `language` field).

### Common Settings

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `language` | `"zh"` | Config comment language, `zh`=Chinese, `en`=English. Takes effect after reload |
| `sweepIntervalMinutes` | `4` | Sweep interval in minutes |
| `warningTimeSeconds` | `20` | Warning time before sweep (seconds) |
| `finalCountdownSeconds` | `5` | Final countdown duration (seconds) |
| `countdownMessage` | Chinese text | Countdown warning message template, supports `{0}` placeholder |
| `sweepCompleteMessage` | Chinese text | Sweep complete summary template, supports `{0}`~`{3}` placeholders |
| `statusMessage` | Chinese text | `/zzclear status` message template |
| `ignoreNamedEntities` | `true` | Ignore entities with custom names |
| `ignoreRiddenEntities` | `true` | Protect entities being ridden by players |
| `newItemImmunitySeconds` | `0` | Item drop immunity (seconds after drop), `0`=disabled |
| `minEntityCountToSweep` | `0` | Minimum entity count to trigger sweep, `0`=no limit |
| `dimensionBlacklist` | `[]` | Dimensions excluded from sweep, e.g. `["minecraft:the_end"]` |

### Item Settings

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `sweepItems` | `true` | Enable item entity sweeping |
| `useItemWhitelist` | `false` | Whitelist mode (protect listed items) |
| `useItemBlacklist` | `false` | Blacklist mode (only sweep listed items) |
| `itemWhitelist` | `[]` | Item whitelist |
| `itemBlacklist` | `["minecraft:diamond"]` | Item blacklist |

### Mob Settings

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `sweepLivingEntities` | `true` | Enable living entity sweeping |
| `dropExp` | `false` | Drop experience when killing mobs |
| `sweepPassiveAnimals` | `false` | Sweep passive animals |
| `sweepHostileMonsters` | `true` | Sweep hostile monsters |
| `useMobWhitelist` | `true` | Enable mob whitelist mode |
| `useMobBlacklist` | `false` | Enable mob blacklist mode |
| `mobWhitelist` | Villagers, Iron Golems, etc. | Mob whitelist |
| `mobBlacklist` | Villagers, Iron Golems | Mob blacklist |

### Other Entity Settings

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `sweepExperienceOrbs` | `false` | Sweep experience orbs |
| `sweepFallingBlocks` | `false` | Sweep falling blocks (e.g. sand) |
| `sweepArrows` | `false` | Sweep arrows |
| `sweepTridents` | `false` | Sweep tridents |
| `sweepProjectiles` | `false` | Sweep projectiles |
| `sweepShulkerBullets` | `false` | Sweep shulker bullets |
| `sweepFireworks` | `false` | Sweep firework rockets |
| `sweepItemFrames` | `false` | Sweep item frames |
| `sweepPaintings` | `false` | Sweep paintings |
| `sweepBoats` | `false` | Sweep boats |
| `sweepPrimedTNT` | `false` | Sweep primed TNT |

> **Tip:** After tweaking the JSON config, jump right back into the game and fire `/zzclear reload`. Done instantly, with absolutely zero delays!

# Refined Schematics

- **Carbon**  
  Tough dark metal with full gear and smelting progression.

  A stronger high-tier Overworld metal used in advanced progression.

  Blue gem ore with full tools, armor, trims, and blocks.

## Extended Ores: Nether

  Green Nether metal with full tools, armor, trims, and blocks.

### Nether Gems

### Special Nether Progression

  Blazite uses a smithing upgrade path instead of normal crafting.
  Full Blazite armor grants **Resistance** and **Fire Resistance**.

## Extended Ores: End

### End Gems

  Black End gem with full tools, armor, trims, and blocks.

- **Chorite**  
  Light-purple End gem with full tools, armor, trims, and blocks.

### Special End Armor Effect

  levite back onto the end island

## Extra Features

- Custom trim colors using the new ingots and gems
- Separate creative tabs for:
  - **Extended Ores: Overworld**
  - **Extended Ores: Nether**
  - **Extended Ores: End**

## Alloy Metals

- **Bronze**

title: Attack Range Attribute
description: A small API that adds an attack range entity attribute.
body:
# Attack Range Attribute

A small API that adds the "attackrangeattribute:generic.attack_range" entity attribute.

> On its own this mod does NOT change gameplay. It does NOT change the attack range when used on its own.

Other mods like [Better Combat Extension](https://modrinth.com/mod/bettercombat-extension) and [Spell Engine Extension](https://modrinth.com/mod/spell-engine-extension) can optionally use this mod.

## Vanilla Minecraft has the "entity_interaction_range" attribute. Why is an "attack_range" attribute necessary?

The entity_interaction_range attribute controls both the range of attacks and the range of right-click interactions (e.g. trading with villagers). This works fine in vanilla, since the entity_interaction_range doesn't change in normal gameplay.

However, in scenarios where different weapons are designed to have different attack ranges, the right-click interactions with entities get inconsistent and in extreme cases, when the attack range is 0, impossible.

## API

Casting a "LivingEntity" to the "AttackRangeUsingEntity" interface gives access to all relevant methods.

title: Create SkyBlock+
description: A minimalist Skyblock experience focused on the Create mod—build, automate, and expand your island using mechanical engineering and kinetic power.
body:
A unique take on the classic Skyblock experience, this modpack revolves entirely around the Create mod and its ecosystem of addons. Starting from almost nothing, you are challenged to build up your world using creativity, engineering, and clever automation instead of traditional progression paths.

Rather than relying on magic or overpowered tools, your journey is driven by mechanical power. Generate rotation, transfer energy through shafts and belts, and design increasingly complex contraptions to process resources. What begins as simple hand-cranked machines quickly evolves into fully automated production lines, where efficiency and design become key to your success.

Every resource must be earned through thoughtful setups and smart engineering. Expand your floating island, optimize your systems, and experiment with different Create addons that introduce new mechanics, machines, and possibilities. Whether it's precision crafting, bulk processing, or large-scale automation, the modpack encourages you to think like an engineer.

With a strong focus on progression, creativity, and satisfying automation, this Skyblock experience offers a rewarding challenge for players who enjoy building, optimizing, and watching their machines come to life high above the void.

title: LegendaryMC
description: A dark fantasy medieval modpack combining exploration, RPG combat, roles, and immersive world generation.
body:
LegendaryMC is a large medieval fantasy modpack built for exploration, atmosphere, and long-term survival. The idea for this pack came from playing with friends and constantly searching for a medieval or dark fantasy modpack that felt right, but never quite finding one that fit what we were looking for. So instead of waiting, this pack slowly grew out of testing, combining, and tweaking many existing mods until it felt cohesive enough to actually play long-term.

The world is expanded through a combination of terrain, structure, and dungeon mods that add large landscapes, villages, castles, ruins, and underground content. Exploration plays a big role, and many locations are intentionally dangerous early on, encouraging preparation, cooperation, and smart decision-making rather than rushing progression.

Combat and gameplay are shaped by a mix of medieval weapons, armor, magic systems, and combat overhaul mods. Together they create a heavier, more grounded combat feel without turning the game into something overly complex or punishing. Progression is meant to feel steady and rewarding over time, whether you play solo or with others.

At the start, players can choose a role using class and origin-style mods, giving early direction and small starting advantages without forcing strict classes. Villages are enhanced by several mods that add guards, named villagers, improved layouts, and more variety, helping the world feel more alive. Beyond safer areas, dangerous dungeons, ancient ruins, powerful enemies, and world bosses offer long-term challenges.

This modpack is actively played and tested in a small group setting and is shared in that same spirit. While not everything is perfect, it has already been used for several weeks of survival gameplay, which is why the project is now being shared publicly.

**For smooth gameplay, it is recommended to allocate at least 8 GB of RAM.**

LegendaryMC is free to use and play. All included mods belong to their respective authors <3

title: Happy Ghast Tiers
description: Are your Happy Ghasts getting you down? Well wipe those tears away with Happy Ghast Tiers! This datapack adds five new tiers of harnesses each providing a small but noticeable speed boost. And as an added bonus we've added Ghast Treats!
body:
TL:DR - [Gallery](./happy-ghast-tiers/gallery)
### Happy Ghast Tiers
Expands Minecraft’s Happy Ghasts with a fully upgradeable harness system, allowing players to give their Happy Ghasts a much-needed speed boost in a way that feels natural to vanilla gameplay.

Harnesses can be upgraded through multiple tiers(~~Vanilla~~Leather, Copper, Iron, Gold, Diamond, and Netherite), with each tier providing a small but noticeable increase to flying speed.

Upgrades can be applied sequentially, or players may craft Reinforced Upgrades to skip directly to a desired tier. Players craft the initial harness just like in vanilla. Players can even still dye vanilla harnesses like normal, but once a vanilla harness is upgraded, its color becomes locked to prevent Minecraft from accidentally overriding the custom NBT data of upgraded harnesses. Every future upgrade automatically preserves harness color.

Netherite-tier harnesses & upgrades are fireproof, behaving like vanilla Netherite items when dropped into lava or fire.

-------------------
### **Other features:**
- Happy Ghasts with no rider will be slowed automatically to default speeds
- Happy Ghast Treats can be crafted with snowballs and blaze powder
  - Treats provide a temporary boost just like rockets do for the elytra

-------------------
### **Planned Update:**
- Custom Enchantment granting a 5% flying speed bonus per level (I–III)

_This enchantment is planned for a future release. It has been intentionally delayed while the core Minecraft mechanics remain experimental and subject to refinement. Once added to the base game, I'll be adding a custom enchantment for the harnesses_

-------------------
### **Stretch Goals:**
- Add the ability to dye upgraded tiers from one color to another
- Add an in-game Admin config to toggle if Harnesses are chest loot instead of craftable
- Add an in-game Admin config that allows for custom tier speeds
- Add more variants and 3D model harnesses (a texture pack rework. I'm not an artist)

title: Farting
description: Occasionally, players fart when they crouch.
body:
# Farting
That's it. That's the mod.

This mod requires three mods:
- [Polymer](https://modrinth.com/mod/polymer)
- [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin)
- [Fzzy Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/fzzy-config)

With Polymer, this mod is entirely server-side.

## Features
- Occasionally, when crouching, players will fart.
- Fully data-driven farts, allowing you to configure their weights, particles, sounds, velocity, and (soon) effects.
  - There are two default farts, normal fart and big fart.
    - Normal fart is a short burst with a small particle cloud that pushes you forward slightly.
    - Big fart is a larger burst with a bigger, darker particle cloud that launches you up in the air a bit. This one is rare.
- The chance of a fart happening can be configured (between 0 - 1, 0 being not at all and 1 being 100% of the time).
- Farts trigger sculk sensors; this can be disabled, but it is enabled by default.
- Editing the fart sounds can be done via resource pack.

I question my life decisions every day.

## Issues
If you have any questions, suggestions, or bugs, please [make an issue here](https://github.com/justanoval/farting/issues).

## Download
- [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/farting)

## Disclaimer
This mod will not be ported to Forge or any other mod loaders.

description: A TPA project, you can tpa to people.
body:
#

Copis TPA

# Features ## Send Teleport Requests - Players can send a teleport request to another player using `/tpa `. - Requests are sent as clickable messages with `[Accept]` and `[Deny]` buttons. ## Accept or Deny Requests - `/tpaccept ` accepts a teleport request and teleports the sender after a 5-second countdown. - `/tpdeny ` denies a request, notifying both players. ## Countdown Teleportation - Teleports include a 5-second countdown with messages and portal particle effects. - Enderman teleport sound is played for both players. ## Request Expiry - TPA requests expire after 30 seconds if not accepted. - Prevents sending requests to yourself or to offline players. Works on Fabric and compatible plugin servers.

**The popcorn rocket launcher is a literal rocket launcher, that can shoot popcorn fireworks.**
  - **(Yes, this is the cinema experience, stay with me!!)**

  - **The rocket projectile travels in a straight line, and will explode throwing popcorn everywhere upon collision.**

title: Resurrections
description: This is a Minecraft mod I made for my hardcore multiplayer server. After a player dies, they drop their soul which can be placed in the reviving station and revived.
body:
# Resurrections

The mod was originally made for a hardcore server that I was running. It currently adds a way to revive players after they die, with config on the way for almost everything.

## Blocks

This mod currently adds 1 block to the game; the  **Resurrecting Station**. Which is crafted with the recipe below.  
![The crafting recipe for the Resurrecting  station](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1515234ea0467b01da5feea7a8fc82246e40721a.png)

## Items

This mod currently adds 3* items to the game. **Soul**, which is dropped upon player death. Whenever the soul is in either the world, inventory or any other container it will slowly decay until it deletes itself. **Soul Essence** is obtained by shift-right-clicking a held soul and destroying it. It also adds **Soul Tomes**, which vary in power, with the first tier (lesser) having a chance for restoring half a **Soul Heart**. The second tier (greater) guarantees half a **Soul Heart** and a chance for another half. The final tier (pure) guarantees a whole **Soul Heart** and a chance to obtain an extra 2.

## Resurrection

The process of reviving a dead player is really simple, after crafting the  **Resurrecting Station**, use a player's  **Soul**  on the  **Resurrection Station**  and the reviving process will begin.

> Player  **Soul**s will decay even while in the  **Resurrecting Station**  but you can see the remaining percentage of the time remaining.

> The **Resurrecting Station** will emit a comparator signal relative to the amount of time remaining.

While the player is in the  **Resurrecting Station**, you can use items (in the config  **soon^TM^**) to repair the player's soul. Different items repair their soul a different amount, with hard caps for the amount of each item usable to repair the  **Soul**. After the souls is fully repaired, the player is brought back into the Resurrecting station and the occupied  **Soul**  item is destroyed.

## Planned features

Currently the mod is  _**not**_  feature complete. I am planning to add:

-   Config for near everything
    
-   More features related to resurrection, with 2 currently in planned for v1.3
    
-   More features to do with souls, including a whole new dimension!  (name drop at 100 downloads)
    
-   And a few more things that are secret right now :)
    

# WARNINGS

This is my  **first public mod!!!!!**  It probably has  **many bugs!**  Please report any bugs to me on discord (@x_explotion) and I'll try to fix them but still: beware! The player data for a soul is stored in a component of the item, called (something or other). This can be used to spawn them in with commands if anything happens. Please be patient with me as I try to fix them. Have fun!

This mod is going on the back burner for a little bit, a content update is planned in the future but I am unsure of it.

description: This will add coins to trade with other people on a server!
body:
Adds Copper, Gold and Diamond Coins to use with other players as a global currency. These can be obtained by smelting down copper ingots, gold ingots or diamonds. A diamond coin is equal to 8 gold sacks, which is equal to 64 gold coins, wich are 512 copper sacks or 4096 copper coins. This can be customized via a datapack. All Items can be found in a new Creative-Inventory-Tab. I am currently working on loot-tables, so you will be able to find coins in buried treasures, desert and jungle pyramids. 


**I downloaded the mod, now what do I do with it?**

First make sure you have the fabric mod loader Version 0.16.9 for Minecraft 1.20.1 installed and Java version 21. On older Versions of Windows you can run into issues, which can be fixed by installing the software "jarfix". 
If you are using the default minecraft launcher go to one of these directories depending on your OS: 
~/Library/Application Support/minecraft/mods -> macOS
%appdata%\.minecraft\mods -> Windows
~/.minecraft/mods -> Linux
Now drag in the .jar file that you downloaded.

Other lauchers (like modrinth app) probably have a built-in system to help install mods. On modrinth app create a new istance with the plus icon (or use an existing one) select Fabric Version 0.16.9 for Minecraft 1.20.1. After some time you should be able to select your instance, go to "add content" and search for "Coins and Stuff". Just click install and you are ready to go.

# AerodynamicMinecarts

Removes the `minecartMaxSpeed` gamerule limit, removes minecart air resistance, and significantly reduces rail friction.

body:
Better Warden

Description

This data pack aims to fix the issue of Shriekers being almost completely useless after being picked up by the player while allowing for a balanced and customizable experience.

By default when the pack is added to a world or server it allows for shriekers placed by players in Deep Dark biomes to summon the warden when set off. The pack can be configured to work in other ways (modes) or disabled outright all from in-game (see below).

This data pack works on both single-player worlds and multiplayer servers.

To configure from in-game:

/function better_warden/admin/config

Replace with one of the modes listed below.

Available Modes:

biomebased - Only shriekers placed in deep dark biomes can summon wardens(DEFAULT)

ylevelbased - Only shriekers placed below y-level 0 can summon wardens

norestrictions - All shriekers can summon wardens

disabled - Only naturally generated shriekers can summon wardens

Known Issues:

  • Changing the config mode does not affect already placed shriekers (they will still work unless broken and replaced)

Feedback:

If you have any suggestions or feedback goto the feedback page, I am always open to new ideas.

This mod makes you able to beat minecraft in a super flat world by adding a new villager profession, that can trade obsidian for a nether portal and end portal frames for an end portal. But it also adds a new block, called the stone compressor, which is used as the working station of the new villager profession and crafted using three gold blocks at the top, one oak wood in the middle, one iron ingot left and right and three pieces of mud at the bottom.

Apart from that because of you needing ender eyes to beat minecraft the mod makes blazes spawn natural in nether wastes on top of magma cubes, which can be turned of using one of five new gamerules of the mod.

Another feature is, that the nether is entirely flat with this mod, highly increasing the mob spawning there, making it even more difficult.

The mod also makes lava convert into blackstone, when placed in the end or the overworld, which can also be turned off using the extinguishLavaInOverworld gamerule.

Two other features are, firstly that pillagers have a random chance to spawn with, more or less powerful firework rockets depending on the difficulty, during a raid, which can be turned off using the enablePillagerFireworkRockets gamerule and secondly that witches can drink four new potions, being the slow falling potion when she is falling, the turtle master potion when she has only half of her health, the regeneration potion when she has the poison or wither effect and the luck potion when she is traped in a cobweb, which can also be turned off using the enableCustomWitchPotions gamerule.

And last but not least you can throw different materials like blackstone, mud bricks, quartz, sandstone and red sandstone on top of the stone compressor, that is turned on using right click, converting them into their stair variant with 4/3 times the original item count if it is divideable by 3 or else converting them into their slab variant with double the original  item count. But of course this can also be turned off using the enableStoneCompressorRecipes gamerule.

title: be_lod-compat
description: This mod make some modded blocks rendered better in DistantHorizon.
body:
# _Current status: Please use 0.6a for DH-2.3.5~DH-2.4.5, 0.7.2a for DH-3.0.2~DH-3.0.3, 0.7.3a for DH-3.1.0 and above_

# BeLodCompat

This mod improves how Distant Horizons renders blocks from certain mods. Without it, those blocks may look wrong or disappear entirely in the distance.

## Features

Without this mod, LittleTiles blocks are treated as avoided blocks by Distant Horizons (similar to flowers), making them mostly invisible or appearing as gray when visible. Immersive Railroading rails appear as pure white.

- **LittleTiles** – Extracts one tile's block state and color from LittleTiles blocks. Color blending requires database caching to be enabled and the Distant Horizons config option `common.lodBuilding.worldCompression` set to `"MERGE_SAME_BLOCKS"` for stable rendering.
- **Immersive Railroading** – Reads the rail bed fill material ID from the parent block's NBT. If the fixed block override is not enabled, database caching must be active to ensure reliable long‑distance display.
- **Database support** – Each dimension maintains its own SQLite database, stored in separate locations:
  - Singleplayer: `<save_folder>/belodcompat/<dimension>.db`
  - Multiplayer client: `.minecraft/belodcompat_servers/<server_ip>/<dimension>.db`
  - Dedicated server: `<world_root>/belodcompat/<dimension>.db`
  This per‑dimension isolation prevents data mixing and ensures correct LOD rendering across all dimensions.

## Requirements

- Minecraft: 1.20.1 (Forge) or 1.21.1 (NeoForge)
- Distant Horizons 2.3.5/3.0.2 or later
- LittleTiles (optional)
- Immersive Railroading (optional)

## Configuration

A config file is generated at `config/belodcompat.cfg`. The file is automatically reloaded when changed (except for `enableDatabase`, which requires a restart). The following options are available:

| Option | Description | Default |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `debugLogging` | Enable debug logging (some debug messages may not be written to the log in certain situations) | `false` |
| `overrideIrRailBlock` | Force all IR rails to use a custom block instead of their bed fill material | `false` |
| `overrideIrRailBlockId` | Block ID used when override is enabled (falls back to `minecraft:soul_sand` if invalid) | `minecraft:soul_sand` |
| `getIrDataFromParentDirectly` | Retrieve bed fill color directly from parent rail (faster but may slow down slightly) | `false` |
| `replaceIrIfAir` | Replace the bed fill color with a fallback if the original is air | `false` |
| `enableDatabase` | Enable SQLite database caching (requires restart) | `true` |
| `useAsyncDbWrite` | Use asynchronous database writes (better performance but may lose data on crash) | `true` |

## Commands

The mod adds the `/belodcompat` command with the following subcommands:

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/belodcompat dumpIR [dimension]` | Dump all cached IR block states for the specified dimension (or current dimension if omitted) |
| `/belodcompat dumpLT [dimension]` | Dump all cached LT block states with colors |
| `/belodcompat showConfig` | Display current configuration values |
| `/belodcompat getLtColor <x> <y> <z> [dimension]` | Show the cached LT color at the given position |
| `/belodcompat getBlockStateOfLT <x> <y> <z> [dimension]` | Show the cached LT block state |
| `/belodcompat getBlockStateOfIR <x> <y> <z> [dimension]` | Show the cached IR block state |

## License

LGPL 3.0

## Project Links

GitHub: [https://github.com/Deepseasaltyfish/BE_DH-compat](https://github.com/Deepseasaltyfish/BE_DH-compat)

  ---
**A datapack that locks all vanilla recipes behind series of advancement-based questlines.**

- Everything can be completed in Hardcore mode.
  
There are six questlines you can complete:  

| Questline      | Number of Advancements | Completion Reward          |
|----------------|----------------------|------------------------------|
| Tutorial       | 6                    | Wooden Equipment             |
| Questline 1    | 14                   | Stone Equipment              |
| Questline 2    | 26                   | Copper Equipment             |
| Questline 3    | 36                   | Iron Equipment, Nether Access|
| Questline 4    | 37                   | Diamond Equipment            |
| Questline 5    | 19                    | Eye of Ender                 |
| Questline 6    | 11                   | Crafter                      |

title: Return By Death Fabric
description: A Re:Zero-inspired Fabric 26.1.x mod adding Return by Death, rare checkpoints, a Shadow Witch shrine, world rewind mechanics, RBD progression, and the Unseen Hand ability.
body:
# Return By Death Fabric

**Return By Death Fabric** is a Re:Zero-inspired Fabric mod that adds a curse-like death rewind system to Minecraft.

Players do not start with Return by Death by default. To unlock it, you must find a rare **Shadow Witch Shrine** and make contact with the **Shadow Witch**. Once cursed, death no longer works normally. Instead, you return to rare automatic checkpoints while your inventory, position, health, hunger, XP, entities, time, and nearby world changes are restored.

This mod is still a **work in progress**. More features, polish, balance changes, and bug fixes are planned for future updates. Suggestions are welcome, so feel free to comment ideas, feedback, or bugs you find.

## Multiplayer Support

Return By Death works in multiplayer. When a player returns by death, the timeline can rewind for affected nearby players as well, depending on the server/host configuration.

Server/host-controlled settings decide things like checkpoint timing, player rewind behavior, Unseen Hand player targeting, and whether checkpoint messages are shown. Random players cannot override these settings for the whole server.

Recommended for singleplayer, LAN, Essential-hosted worlds, or trusted multiplayer servers.

## Features

* Return by Death death rewind system
* Rare automatic checkpoints
* Shadow Witch Shrine structure
* Custom Shadow Witch NPC
* Witch dialogue UI
* RBD level progression
* Inventory, health, hunger, XP, and position restoration
* World time rewind
* Block, entity, and explosion rewind support
* Villager profession, trades, reputation, XP, and trade cooldown rewind support
* Multiplayer player rewind support
* Forbidden Unseen Hand ability at RBD V
* Mod Menu config support
* Admin/testing commands

## How to Unlock Return by Death

Find a rare **Shadow Witch Shrine** and interact with the **Shadow Witch**. After making contact with her, you unlock Return by Death.

By default, players must find the Shadow Witch to unlock Return by Death. If you want players to start with Return by Death automatically instead, this can be changed in the Mod Menu config settings.

Meeting the Witch again can deepen your curse and increase your RBD level. The final upgrade requires an offering by default.

## RBD Progression

### RBD I - Return by Death

Unlocked by meeting the Shadow Witch for the first time.

This gives you the basic Return by Death curse. When you die, you return to your latest checkpoint instead of dying normally. Your position, inventory, XP, health, hunger, effects, nearby blocks, entities, explosions, and time are restored as much as possible.

### RBD II - Lingering Memory

Unlocked by meeting the Shadow Witch again after RBD I.

This level gives the player vague memories of the failed timeline after returning. These hints can help you understand what killed you without fully revealing everything.

### RBD III - Mercy Return

Unlocked by deepening the curse again.

This level allows rare Mercy Return effects during repeated death loops. If you keep dying in a short time window, there is a small chance for a stronger return effect to help you escape the loop.

### RBD IV - Deeper Rewind

Unlocked by deepening the curse again.

This is mostly a filler/progression level for the player. Internally, it can improve parts of the rewind system, but it is mainly a step before reaching the final authority.

### RBD V - Forbidden Authority

Unlocked by reaching the final curse level through the Shadow Witch.

By default, the final upgrade requires a tribute. Once unlocked, RBD V grants the forbidden **Unseen Hand** ability.

Unseen Hand lets you pull and damage targets with an invisible force. In multiplayer, whether it can affect other players depends on the host/server settings.

## Finding the Shrine

The **Shadow Witch Shrine** is a rare worldgen structure that can generate in forest and taiga-type biomes in the Overworld.

For testing or admin use:

```mcfunction
/locate structure returnbydeath:witch_shrine
```

## Notes

Return by Death is a complicated rewind system, so some edge cases may still need testing. Large explosions, modded inventories, complex multiplayer item transfers, and unusual entity behavior may not always rewind perfectly.

Please report bugs or leave suggestions in the comments. Future updates may add more Witch content, progression, abilities, multiplayer polish, balancing, and more Re:Zero-inspired mechanics.

title: Quick Harvest
description: It’s a lightweight QoL mod that makes farming faster without auto-replanting or changing vanilla mechanics.
body:
A simple, dependable right-click harvesting mod designed for real modpacks—not just vanilla testing. A lot of “right-click harvest” options are either overcomplicated, inconsistent, or only support a handful of crops unless you hand-tune configs. Ion Quick Harvest focuses on doing one thing well: right-click fully grown crops to harvest them, drop the normal loot, and reset the plant back to its starting growth stage so it stays planted and keeps growing.

  Ion Quick Harvest supports vanilla crops and most modded crops out of the box by detecting common growth/age properties used by crop blocks. If you’re using another mod that also changes right-click harvesting, you may see conflicts—please report them so I can improve compatibility. For the smoothest experience, disable duplicate harvesting features in other mods so only one system controls harvesting.

**Configuration Options (planned/optional)**

- Harvest with empty hand (or require a hoe)
- Durability cost when harvesting with a hoe
- Auto-detect modded crops using common growth/age properties
- Manual allowlist/denylist for harvestable crops/blocks
- Optional XP from harvesting (chance + amount)
- Optional harvest range settings (by hoe tier) + Efficiency scaling

**Compatibility / Supported Content**
- Vanilla crops (wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots, etc.)
- Most modded crops that use standard growth/age properties
- Farming/food mods that follow common crop block patterns

title: Water World
description: A data pack version of the classic Survival Island adventure map genre.
body:
## __SUMMARY__ **A data pack version of the classic Survival Island adventure map genre.** You spawn on a small bamboo jungle island in a world of only oceans. Rather than a small custom-made area that you cannot exit, this pack changes world generation to only include ocean and cave biomes. The Nether also recieves a similar treatment, consisting of lava ocean and small islands. Some otherwise unobtainable items can be found around the world. ## __CHANGES__ * World Generation is limited to Ocean and Cave biomes, besides a Bamboo Jungle island at spawn * The Nether generates as an infinite lava ocean with small islands throughout * Saplings are distributed as loot across many structures * Otherwise unobtainable items can be found in chests, suspicious blocks, and trial vaults * Sniffers dig up flowers that are unobtainable in an Ocean world * Wandering Traders sell various animals * Husks spawn in Warm Oceans and drop Sand (or Red Sand when killed by fire) * Trail Ruins generate in Deep Oceans and Deep Cold Oceans * Sugar Cane and other plant blocks can be fished as junk * Buried Treasure does not generate * Removed Herobrine ### __World Generation__ * Only the following biomes can generate: * Deep Frozen Ocean * Frozen Ocean * Deep Cold Ocean * Cold Ocean * Deep Ocean * Ocean * Deep Lukewarm Ocean * Lukewarm Ocean * Warm Ocean * Lush Cave * Dripstone Cave * No longer needs tall land biomes above to generate * Deep Dark

* A single Bamboo Jungle island is at the World Spawn. This is the only generated island of its kind on the map. * Nether terrain generation is limited to small islands on an infinite lava ocean. Structures spawn as normal. * Trail Ruins can be found in Deep Oceans and Deep Cold Oceans poking out of the sea floor. * Buried Treasure does not spawn. As such, Buried Treasure Maps can not be found in Shipwrecks or Ocean Ruins. * Minimum distance between Ocean Monuments is increased. ### __Loot__ * Wandering Traders are completely overhauled. They now sell 'animal vouchers'. When purchased, the associated animal will pop out of the ground. - __Common (3 per trader)__ * Chicken * Cow * Pig * Sheep - __Uncommon (2 per trader)__ * Armadillo * Donkey * Goat * Horse * Rabbit - __Rare (2 per trader)__ * Allay * Camel * Fox * Mooshroom * Wolf * Saplings can be found as loot in a variety of structures: - __Common__ * Oak - Mineshaft & Dungeon Chests * Birch - Mineshaft & Dungeon Chests * Spruce - Mineshaft & Dungeon Chests - __Uncommon__ * Jungle - Warm Ocean Ruins (Suspicious Sand) * Acacia - Warm Ocean Ruins (Suspicious Sand) * Dark Oak - Cold Ocean Ruins (Suspicious Gravel) - __Rare__ * Pale Oak - Trial Chamber Vaults * Mangrove - Stronghold Chests * Cherry - Ancient City Chests

* More plant blocks, including Sugar Cane, Firefly Bushes, and Dry Grass can be fished as junk. * Nautilus Armor is found in Dungeon chests rather than Horse Armor. * Other unobtainable items such as Pottery Sherds, Goat Horns, and Hearts of the Sea are found in a variety of structures. The full list of loot table modifications can be found at the bottom of this page. ### __Sniffers__ * Sniffers dig up the following flowers, which otherwise cannot be found in the world: * Allium * Blue Orchid * Lily of the Valley * Orange Tulip * Pink Tulip * Red Tulip * White Tulip * Lilac * Peony * Rose Bush * Sunflower * *(Note: Poppies, Dandelions, Cornflowers, Oxeye Daisies, and Azure Bluet are not included as they can be grown in Dripstone Caves and Deep Dark biomes)* ### __Frogs & Turtles__ * While Frogs and Turtles do not spawn naturally, Turtle Eggs and Frogspawn can be found in the world: * Turtle Eggs - Warm Ocean Ruins (Suspicious Sand) * Frogspawn - Cold Ocean Ruins (Suspicious Gravel) ### __More Underwater Music__ * A separate resource pack that adds remixes of Minecraft's soundtrack that only play underwater. * Download at [More Underwater Music](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/more-underwater-music).
LOOT TABLES ## LOOT TABLE CHANGES ### Fishing - Added: * Sugar Cane * Short Dry Grass * Fern * Firefly Bush * Wildflowers * Pink Petals * *(Note: These items are fished when the player rolls a “junk” pull)* ### Shipwrecks - Removed: * Buried Treasure Map - Added: * Lily Pad * Dead Bush * Cactus * Arms Up Pottery Sherd ### Ocean Monuments - Added: * Heart of the Sea (Elder Guardian) ### Warm Ocean Ruins - Removed: * Buried Treasure Map (Chest) - Added: * Turtle Egg (Sand) * Acacia Sapling (Sand) * Jungle Sapling (Sand) * Cocoa Beans (Sand) ### Cold Ocean Ruins - Removed: * Buried Treasure Map (Chest) - Added: * Frog Spawn (Gravel) * Dark Oak Sapling (Gravel) ### Trail Ruins - Added: * Sweet Berries * Bush ### Mineshaft - Added: * Spruce Sapling * Birch Sapling * Oak Sapling * Miner Pottery Sherd * Prize Pottery Sherd ### Dungeon (Monster Room) - Removed: * All Horse Armor - Added: * Spruce Sapling * Birch Sapling * Oak Sapling * Heart of the Sea * Regular Goat Horn * Skull Pottery Sherd * All Nautilus Armor (excluding Netherite) ### Ruined Portal - Added: * Golden Nautilus Armor ### Trial Chamber - Added: * Archer Pottery Sherd (Chests) * Pale Moss (Chests) * Hanging Moss (Chests) * Closed Eye Blossom (Decorated Pots) ### Trial Vault - Added: * Pale Oak Sapling (3 to 6) * Screaming Goat Horns ### Ominous Vault - Added: * Creaking Heart ### Stronghold - Added: * Mangrove Propagule * Heart of the Sea * Brewer Pottery Sherd ### Ancient City - Added: * Cherry Sapling
HOW TO INSTALL 1. Download 'Water World Pack v1.1.zip' 2. Extract the file 3. In Minecraft, click 'Create New World' 4. Under 'More', click 'Data Packs' 5. Click 'Open Pack Folder' 6. Move 'Water World Pack v1.1' to that folder 7. Back in Minecraft, click the arrow symbol over the pack icon to select it 8. Click 'Done' 9. If Minecraft warns you that you are using Experimental Features, click 'Proceed' 10. You can now configure your world settings 11. When you're ready, click 'Create New World' 12. Your spawn island may generate in an odd location. If that is the case, you may want to try again and create a new world with the data pack.

title: Hex Shadowing
description: A Hex Casting addon that enables 1.17-style item shadowing.
body:
# Hex Shadowing

> **Deprecation Notice**
> This interation of the mod is no longer maintained and will not be getting item blacklists. A replacement mod with similar functionality is in progress and should remove most currently-known duplication glitches.

![Screenshot of linking two stacks of amethyst shards. A scroll displaying the spell is in the background.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5105c5137dd23a28f4d7d2bab8f7b4f460a35c62.png)

A Hex Casting addon that enables item shadowing.

Adds a single Great Spell to shadow link two dropped items. Two linked stacks behave like they are one -
items added to one sync to the other, and items removed also vanish from the other stack. (In fact,
they *are* the same ItemStack internally.) Managing linked items without disconnecting them requires
some care, but also enables a number of unique applications, such as remote item restocking,
item storage, wireless hoppers, wireless redstone, etc.

This brings back the same item shadowing exploit that Mojang patched in 1.19, without the need to
perform update suppression. Behavior regarding what actions are safe (preserve the link) and what is
not is largely the same. This addon modifies a block entity's behavior to make it possible to
get linked item entities back into an inventory safely. (The original 1.17 exploit did not need this
as initial linking was done in-inventory.)

1.17/1.18 item shadowing behavior is documented in two excellent videos
by [PR0CESS](https://youtube.com/watch?v=i8_FPyn20ns)
and [Fallen_Breath](https://youtube.com/watch?v=mTeYwq7HaEA).

## Balancing Note (Server Owners Please Read)

1.17 item shadowing was inherently a general item dupe exploit that came with additional, more
interesting applications. This mod seeks to re-enable the latter applications without significantly
impacting balance. To link items, two full stacks of the same item are required - this should be the
maximum number of items that a player can get back after unlinking. Thus, there is no known general
item duplication glitch with just the vanilla game, Hex Casting, and this addon. (Smaller tricks, like
mending two broken tools with the xp cost of one, are possible and will not be patched.) However,
it may be possible to duplicate items by using this addon in combination with some other mod.

A configurable blacklist of linkable items is planned for a future release of this addon. Blacklisting
by item type, tag, damageability, enchantments, and other properties is planned.

title: JATiCA
description: Add JAOPCA materials to Tinker's Construct
body:
# JATiCA
JATiCA (**J**ust **A** **Ti**nkers' **C**onstruct/**C**ompatibility **A**ttempt) is a mod that adds materials registered in JAOPCA as Tinkers' Construct materials.  
Since this is an addon mod developed by a third party, please direct any questions or bug reports about this mod to me, not to the developers of JAOPCA or Tinkers' Construct.

🌐[日本語](https://github.com/BlueSheep2804/JATiCA/blob/master/README_ja.md)

## Setup
1. Install JAOPCA, Tinkers' Construct, and JATiCA.
2. Launch Minecraft.
3. Open `config/jaopca/modules/jatica_materials.toml` and add the names of the JAOPCA materials you want to add as Tinkers' Construct materials to `passiveMaterialWhitelist = []`.  
    Setting it to `["*"]` will add all materials registered in JAOPCA as Tinkers' Construct materials.
4. Restart Minecraft.
5. Open `<material_name>.toml` in `config/jaopca/materials/` and configure the material properties in the `[jatica]` section.  
    By default, no parts are generated, so set the required parts to `true`.
6. Restart Minecraft, and the Tinkers' Construct materials will be added.

## Changing Material Names
If you want to change the material names displayed in Tinkers' Construct, add a key like `material.jatica.<material_name>`.  
> <material_name> Small Blade, <material_name> Mattock, etc.
```json
{
    "material.jatica.amethyst": "Cool Amethyst"
}
```
If you want to change the material names displayed in JAOPCA, add a key like `jaopca.material.<material_name>`.  
> Molten <material_name>, Block of <material_name>, etc.
```json
{
    "jaopca.material.amethyst": "Cool Amethyst"
}
```

## Acknowledgments
Thanks to the developers of JAOPCA and Tinkers' Construct.
- [JAOPCA](https://github.com/TheLMiffy1111/JAOPCA)
- [Tinkers' Construct](https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct)

title: Uncapped Armor
description: Allows for armor values above 20 to be factored into protection
body:
This is a very simple mod that replaces values in Minecraft's default `DamageUtil` class to allow for protection values over `20` to be calculated.

The way it works is by calculating the damage based on however much armor the player has PLUS a predefined 'padding' (set in config). The higher the armor value, the higher the protection, however you wil experience diminishing returns at higher values.

title: move on!
description: rebalances movement options to create a more well-rounded experience! [currently only does so by adding a new type of rail and making rails faster]
body:
> **please leave any feedback, including bug reports and suggestions, on the [issues page](https://github.com/gamemode-3/move-on-1.21.5/issues)!**
# DESCRIPTION
Rebalances movement options to create a more well-rounded experience! There's much more planned, but right now it only improves rails to be faster and cheaper.
# FEATURES
## improved powered rails
#### copper powered rails
powered rails just got cheaper! combine a rail, redstone and a copper ingot to get a powered rail. it's also a tad faster than before.
regular rails have a slightly modified recipe, now requiring three sticks per craft.
#### booster rails
with the same recipe but a gold ingot, you can craft booster rails. they'll be even faster
than the new powered rails. you can also build a mixed track of some powered and some booster rails to get speeds in between.
#### derailing
though they take a while to accelerate, going at full speed with with booster rails is really, _really_ fast. if you're going faster than a powered (copper) rail, you'll derail in any curve. luckily, activator rails will slow you just enough to not derail. one's enough if you're just going a bit quick, but you'll need two if you're really pushin' the pedal to the metal! 

derailing can be configured to your liking or turned off :)

## configs
you can configure everything in `.minecraft/config/move-on-config.properties`.
> [how to find `.minecraft`?](https://minecraft.wiki/w/.minecraft)

## credits
credits to [simple config](https://github.com/magistermaks/fabric-simplelibs/tree/master/simple-config) and [kaupenjoe](https://github.com/Tutorials-By-Kaupenjoe/Fabric-Tutorial-1.17.1/tree/28-simpleConfigs) for the config framework!

i have the rail idea from JetStarfish's video on YouTube, who in turn had it from a YouTube comment by [Sporkaganza](https://www.youtube.com/@einootspork) on [this video]([https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O2qCIvXALiw&list=PLGwH3ofslfrTDK0SEVLHzTrRJgqtcTigv&index=2](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O2qCIvXALiw&list=PLGwH3ofslfrTDK0SEVLHzTrRJgqtcTigv&index=2)).
specifically Sporkaganza had the idea for the concept of copper and gold rails where gold is faster. 
most of the details differ from their conceptions.
all textures are my own edits of Minecraft vanilla textures.

title: MaintiainMe
description: Seamlessly manage server maintenance with ease.
body:
# MaintainMe by SamVolvo
MaintainMe is a versatile Minecraft plugin designed for server administrators seeking an easy and effective way to manage maintenance modes. Compatible with Minecraft version 1.18 and higher, MaintainMe offers a range of powerful features to ensure smooth and seamless server maintenance.

### Key Features:
**Maintenance Mode:** Easily put your server into maintenance mode with _/maintenance on_. Players without the proper permissions are automatically kicked with a customizable message. You turn it off with _/maintenance off_.

**Schedule Maintenance:** Plan maintenance with _/maintenance schedule <time in minutes>_. The server will automatically switch to maintenance mode when the timer runs out. You can stop a scheduled maintenance with _/maintenance stop_.

**Reload Functions:** Reload the configuration or the plugin itself with _/maintenance reload config_ and _/maintenance reload plugin_.

**Customizable Messages:** Adjust the MOTD for normal and maintenance modes.

**Permissions:** Various permissions for access to maintenance commands and bypassing maintenance mode.

**Update Checker:** Automatically checks for new versions of the plugin and notifies server administrators.

**Custom Logger:** Provides extensive logging options, including debug, loading, info, warning, and error messages.

MaintainMe simplifies server management and provides administrators with the tools they need to keep their servers running smoothly.

**For any problems or info join our [Discord](https://www.samvolvo.com/discord).**

# CloudCore

Minecraft paper/velocity library plugin which most new plugins of CloudCraft depend on.

## Content

- Configurate based configuration loading with some default serializers
- Simple adventure translation loader

### Bukkit specific

- Block bounding box (with a defined world)
- EntityPosition, extends Paper's new (experimental) Position API with yaw and pitch
- Useful custom arguments when working with Paper's brigadier api

## API Usage

Add the following to your `build.gradle.kts`:

```kotlin
repositories {
    maven("https://repo.cloudcraftmc.de/releases/")
}

dependencies {
    // bukkit dependency
    compileOnly("dev.booky:cloudcore:{VERSION}")
    // velocity dependency
    compileOnly("dev.booky:cloudcore-velocity:{VERSION}")
}
```

title: Theou: Quest for Olympia
description: Explore unique biomes based on Ancient Greek mythology, and complete tasks given by the gods, in order to gain their blessings.
body:
# Theou
## A DataPack made for DataPack Jam #2

Theou adds the dimension of Olympia, the realm of the Ancient Greek Gods.  
Explore the unique biomes based on Ancient Greek mythology, and complete tasks given by the gods, in order to gain their blessings.  

Minecraft 1.19+ is required.

It is recommended that you use the Resource Pack.

## Guide
To get started on your journey with Theou, you will need to find an Oracle.

Oracles will generate around your world, and will always emit a mysterious glow...
![Oracle](https://i.imgur.com/q5j75pa.jpg)

Throwing a Diamond Block, as a sacrifice, to the Oracle, will grant you a Task from the Gods.  
Right click on the task to accept it.  
![Task](https://i.imgur.com/Wty9Lcg.jpg)

When you complete a task, you will be granted a favour.  
Sacrificing three favours to the Oracle will open a portal to Olympia.  
Make sure you get in fast! It only stays open for a minute and a half!
![Portal](https://i.imgur.com/VtfuUba.jpg)

You will arrive high in the sky, in Olympia!  
Make sure you guide yourself safely to land!  
Once you have arrived, you will then be able to explore to your hearts content!  
Can you discover all five of the unique biomes?
![Olympia](https://i.imgur.com/PMwibTp.jpg)

### Blessings of the Gods
In Olympia, you will be able to find Temples, dedicated to the many different Gods of Olympia.  
![Temple](https://i.imgur.com/sRhkmJM.jpg)

Offering a God's favour to the flames in their Temple will grant you a Blessing.  
You can tell which Temple belongs to which God, by the coloured concrete on it's roof.  
The name of the Favour is coloured the same as it's God.

Around Olympia, there are many more structures to explore, and great treasures to be found!  
![Altar](https://i.imgur.com/fRwrMeK.jpg)

When you are ready to leave Olympia, simply jump into the void! Don't worry, it's safe!

## Spoilers
It is recommended that you explore and experiment around with Theou, to discover how it all works!  
However, if you are stuck, or don't have the time to fully explore the world, useful details will be listed below.  

### Table of Gods
| God | Task | Blessing | Colour |
| --- | ---- | -------- | ------ |
| Aphrodite | Breed 10 Animals | Regeneration (to self) + Slowness (to others) | Pink |
| Apollo | Sacrifice Cat music disc | Infinite Spectral Arrows | Blue |
| Ares | Kill 25 Zombies | Strength + Resistance | Red |
| Artemis | Sacrifice Artemis' Bow from Wandering Trader | Infinite Harming Arrows | Brown |
| Athena | Sacrifice Golden Apple and Shield | Night Vision | Purple |
| Hades | Kill 20 Zombie Piglins | Fire Resistance, Regeneration and Speed in the Nether | Dark Red |
| Hepheastus | Craft 5 iron swords | Fire Resistance | Black |
| Hermes | Sacrifice each Overworld log type | Jump Boost and Speed | Orange |
| Poseidon | Kill 20 Drowned | Water Breathing and Dolphin's Grace | Cyan |
| Zeus | Sacrifice a block of gold | Absorption | Yellow |

Sacrifices are made by throwing the required items one at a time into the Oracle's pool.

Blessings will randomly degrade with use. However, the degradation is global for all blessings.  
The degradation goes down over time, if not using blessings.  
To use a blessing, hold it in either your main or off hand.

Enhanced particles, weather effects, and atmospheric ambience from additional mods and resource packs - Dynamic lighting, visual effects, and immersive improvements ### 🔊 **Immersive Audio** - **Atmosfera** - Dynamic ambient sounds that enhance atmosphere - **Presence Footsteps** - Realistic footstep sounds that vary by block - **Sound Physics Remastered** - Realistic sound propagation and reverb ### 🗺️ **Navigation & Information** - **Veinminer** - Mine connected ores quickly (with enchantment support) - **Anvil Restoration** - Repair anvils with iron ingots - **Inventory Sorter** - Keep your chests organized - **Pet Protection** - Your pets are safe from harm - **Mine Spawners** - Pick up and relocate mob spawners using silk touch ### 🎤 **Voice Chat Built-In** - **Simple Voice Chat** - Proximity-based voice communication - Talk to nearby players naturally in-game - Customizable settings and push-to-talk ### 🎯 **Quality of Life** - **Essential Commands** - Teleportation, homes, warps, and essential server utilities - **LambDynamicLights** - Hold torches to light your way - **Controller Support** via Controlify - **Mod Menu** for easy configuration - All keybinds customizable --- ## 📦 What's Included? ### Mods **A carefully selected mod stack** including: - Core performance mods centered around Sodium + Voxy - Visual enhancements (Voxy LOD terrain, dynamic lighting, particle effects) - Audio improvements (Ambient sounds, realistic footsteps, sound physics) - Expanded world gen (Biomes O' Plenty, Dungeons and Taverns, Moogs structure packs, Towns and Towers, Underground Worlds, synced seasons) - Immersive environmental sounds and audio enhancements - All pre-configured and optimized for performance --- ## ⚙️ Optimization Guide ### Default Settings The modpack uses **performance-first defaults** tuned around Sodium + Voxy: - **Voxy LOD stream radius:** `512` - **Normal render distance:** `12` - **Simulation distance:** conservative by default for stability ### 🎨 Want Better Visuals? 1. **Increase Voxy LOD distance / quality** in Voxy settings - Raise gradually if your system can handle it 2. **Increase normal render distance** in Video Settings for sharper nearby terrain 3. **If you have a beast PC, increase simulation distance** - Raise in steps and test for stability 4. **Optional:** add **Iris** and a shader pack you like — nothing in FugCraft stops you, and it can look great > **On shaders:** We don't ship shader mods — Sodium + Voxy + resource packs are the default look. You're free to install **Iris** and your preferred shader pack on top; just expect a FPS hit and consider lowering Voxy if needed. ### ⚡ Need Better Performance? 1. **Lower Voxy LOD stream radius first** — try `256` or lower if `512` is heavy 2. **Disable Voxy rendering** temporarily if needed (keep Sodium enabled) 3. **Lower normal render distance** 4. **Lower simulation distance** 5. **Tune Sodium Extra** options for more headroom --- ## ⌨️ Essential Keybinds > **Note:** All keybinds can be rebound in settings - **`J`** - Open full map - **`M`** - Toggle minimap - **`B`** - Add waypoint - **`N`** - Manage waypoints - **`G`** - Toggle fullbright - **`'`** (apostrophe) - Open claims settings - **On full map (`J`): hold `U` + drag** - Claim an area - **On full map (`J`): hold `I` + drag** - Unclaim an area - **`V`** - Voice chat settings - **`R`** - Push to talk (voice chat) --- ## 🎮 Server Commands Essential commands for the FugCraft server: | Command | Description | |---------|-------------| | `/book` | Get the in-game FugCraft guide book | | `/home set ` | Set a personal home location | | `/home tp ` | Teleport to your home | | `/tpa ` | Request to teleport to a player | | `/tpaccept` | Accept teleport request | | `/warp tp ` | Teleport to server warps | | `/spawn` | Teleport to spawn | | `/rtp` | Random teleport far from spawn | | `/openpac-claims` | Manage your claims | | `/openpac-parties` | Manage parties | > **📚 Full command list:** [Essential Commands Wiki](https://github.com/John-Paul-R/Essential-Commands/wiki/List-of-Commands-&-Permissions) --- ## 🔗 Links & Resources - **🌐 GitHub Repository:** [FugCraft-Server](https://github.com/FugLong/FugCraft-Server) - **🖥️ Host Your Own Server:** Complete open-source server setup available in the repository - ready to host locally or remotely! - **📥 Manual Downloads:** Available in the GitHub repo if you prefer manual installation - **📋 Full Mod List:** Check the repository for detailed mod information --- ## 💡 Pro Tips - Right-click an anvil while holding iron ingots to repair it automatically - Open the pause menu **Server Links...** button for the repo, client guide, modpack, and wiki links - Voice chat has proximity - walk closer to hear players better - Use the claims system to protect your builds — open the map (`J`), hold **`U`** + drag to claim, **`I`** + drag to unclaim - Notice the enhanced particles and ambience - look for improved rain, fire, and environmental effects! - Voxy generates LOD chunks gradually - be patient for best results on first load! - Check out the [Traveler's Backpack Wiki](https://github.com/Tiviacz1337/Travelers-Backpack/wiki) to learn how to use all the backpack features! --- ## 🎯 Target Version **Fabric 26.1.2** --- ## 📝 Credits Created and maintained for the FugCraft community. Special thanks to all the mod developers whose incredible work makes this modpack possible! ---

explore vast worlds and use new items and attack new monsters and build with new blocks and some other stuff im forgetting

mr knight has quite the scary enemy, as he has 1000 health. To put that in perspective, netherite swords only do 8 damage. He can notice you from quite far away, and will sprint quickly at you, so just try to avoid him.

title: ChatTranslator
description: This Fabric mod enables real-time chat translation in Minecraft using the DeepL API. It is designed to facilitate smooth communication on international servers, with specialized features for high-traffic environments.
body:
# ChatTranslator
A Fabric mod that translates Minecraft chat in real-time using the DeepL API. Perfect for international servers like Hypixel.

---

## 🌍 Supported UI Languages / ローカライズ対応
The settings menu and interface are available in:
Modの設定画面等は以下の言語で表示可能です：
- **English** 🇺🇸 / **日本語** 🇯🇵 / **简体中文** 🇨🇳 / **한국어** 🇰🇷
- **Deutsch** 🇩🇪 / **Español** 🇪🇸 / **Français** 🇫🇷 / **Português (Brasil)** 🇧🇷
- **Tiếng Việt** 🇻🇳 / **ไทย** 🇹🇭

---

## 🔑 DeepL API Key / APIキーの取得方法

This mod requires a **DeepL API key** to function.  
このMODを使用するには **DeepL APIキー** が必要です。

### What is the DeepL API? / DeepL APIとは？

[DeepL](https://www.deepl.com/) is a high-quality machine translation service known for its natural and accurate translations. The API allows applications like this mod to use DeepL's translation engine directly.  
DeepLは自然で高精度な翻訳で知られる機械翻訳サービスです。APIを使うことで、このMODのようなアプリケーションから直接DeepLの翻訳エンジンを利用できます。

### How to get your API Key / APIキーの取得手順

1. **Go to the DeepL API page / DeepL APIページにアクセス**  
   👉 https://www.deepl.com/pro-api

2. **Sign up for a free account / 無料アカウントを作成**  
   Click **"Sign Up Free"** and create an account. No credit card required for the Free tier.  
   「**無料で登録**」をクリックしてアカウントを作成します。無料プランはクレジットカード不要です。

3. **Copy your API key / APIキーをコピー**  
   After logging in, go to your [Account Settings](https://www.deepl.com/account/summary) and find your **Authentication Key**.  
   ログイン後、[アカウント設定](https://www.deepl.com/account/summary)から**認証キー**を確認・コピーします。

4. **Enter it in the mod / MODに入力**  
   Press **J** in-game → Enter your API key in the settings screen.  
   ゲーム内で **Jキー** を押し、設定画面にAPIキーを入力します。

### Free vs Pro / 無料プランとProプランの違い

| | Free / 無料 | Pro |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Monthly characters / 月間文字数 | 500,000 | Unlimited / 無制限 |
| Cost / 料金 | Free / 無料 | Paid / 有料 |
| API endpoint | `api-free.deepl.com` | `api.deepl.com` |
| Credit card required / カード登録 | ❌ Not required / 不要 | ✅ Required / 必要 |

> **Note / 注意:** The Free plan supports 500,000 characters per month, which is more than enough for casual use on a Minecraft server.  
> 無料プランの月500,000文字は、Minecraftサーバーでの通常利用には十分な量です。

---

## 🇺🇸 English Guide
- **Universal Translation:** Supports all languages available in the DeepL API!
- **Setup:** Press **J** in-game -> Enter API Key -> Add Rule (e.g., `AUTO` -> `EN-US`).
- **Commands:** `/tr <text>` to translate your message, `/translate on/off` to toggle.

---

## 🇯🇵 日本語ガイド
- **万能な翻訳機能:** DeepL APIが対応している**すべての言語**間で相互に翻訳可能です！
- **設定方法:** ゲーム内で **Jキー** を押し、APIキーを入力。「翻訳ルール」で `AUTO` -> `JA` 等を設定。
- **コマンド:** `/tr <本文>` で自分の発言を翻訳、`/translate on/off` で機能のオンオフ。

---

## 🌐 DeepL Language Codes / 翻訳対応言語
You can translate to any of these languages (and more!):  
以下の言語コードを使用して、あらゆる言語へ翻訳できます。

| Language | Code | Language | Code |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Japanese** | `JA` | **English (US/UK)** | `EN-US` / `EN-GB` |
| **Chinese (Simp)** | `ZH` | **Korean** | `KO` |
| **French** | `FR` | **German** | `DE` |
| **Spanish** | `ES` | **Portuguese (BR)** | `PT-BR` |
| **Italian** | `IT` | **Russian** | `RU` |
| **Vietnamese** | `VI` | **Turkish** | `TR` |

<details>
<summary>Click to view more languages / その他すべての対応言語を表示</summary>

Arabic (`AR`), Bulgarian (`BG`), Czech (`CS`), Danish (`DA`), Dutch (`NL`), Estonian (`ET`), Finnish (`FI`), Greek (`EL`), Hungarian (`HU`), Indonesian (`ID`), Latvian (`LV`), Lithuanian (`LT`), Norwegian (`NB`), Polish (`PL`), Romanian (`RO`), Slovak (`SK`), Slovenian (`SL`), Swedish (`SV`), Ukrainian (`UK`)
</details>

---

## Disclaimer / 注意事項
- Requires DeepL API Key (Free or Pro). / DeepL APIキー（無料・Pro問わず）が必要です。
- This is an unofficial mod. Use at your own risk. / 本MODは非公式プロジェクトです。利用は自己責任でお使いください。

title: zy optimised pack
description: A modpack with a focus on optimisation and quality of life features. Designed for use with vanilla servers.
body:
zy optimised pack is modpack with a focus on optimisation and quality of life features. The performance of the game is improved with mods such as [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) and [Lithum](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium), with QoL mods such as [Bobby](https://modrinth.com/mod/bobby), [WI Zoom](https://modrinth.com/mod/wi-zoom), [Shulker Box Tooltip](https://modrinth.com/mod/shulkerboxtooltip) and [WI Zoom](https://modrinth.com/mod/wi-zoom) being included. 

Various resource packs and shaders are included, making configuration easily accessible upon startup. This modpack aims to enable good performance across various devices and keep the experience as close to vanilla as possible, whilst improving the game in unobtrusive ways.

[PrismLauncher](https://prismlauncher.org/) is recommended to manage different Minecraft versions.

![Ghast with shaders](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/p4MSuVei/images/a15429a91806c1b78609f3b639db75ad3be43b49.jpeg)

## How to Install
[PrismLauncher](https://prismlauncher.org/download/) is recommended to manage instances and download mods. With PrismLauncher open, click the `Add Instance` button, select the `Modrinth` tab and search for this modpack (either by name or by using the link).

Alternatively, you can use the `Import` tab to select the `.mrpack` that can be downloaded to import the pack into PrismLauncher.

You will need Java (version 21) installed on your device. PrismLauncher can download Java for you when you open it for the first time.

Additionally, you can also download Java here: [adoptium.net](https://adoptium.net/en-GB/temurin/releases/?version=21&os=any&arch=any).
> **Note: On Macs with Intel processors, you need to install the x64 version of Java, on Macs with Arm 64 (Apple silicon) processors, you need to install the Arm 64 (aarch64) version of Java.**

## When Updating
To keep your settings, make sure to copy over `options.txt` to the new instance's folder, from your old folder. Also, if you want, copy over `servers.dat` (your server list), `hotbar.nbt` (your saved creative hotbars), `saves/` (your worlds) and `screenshots/`, along with `.bobby/` (only made if you have the bobby mod).

title: Infinity Fireworks
description: Fabric mod that allows you to use firework rockets without consuming them.
body:
# Languages

[EN/English](https://lyuwenhan.github.io/extensions/minecraft-java/data/assets/infinity-fireworks/README/README.html) | [ZH-CN/简体中文](https://lyuwenhan.github.io/extensions/minecraft-java/data/assets/infinity-fireworks/README/README_ZH-CN.html)

# Infinity Fireworks

Fabric mod for Minecraft that lets firework rockets be used without consuming the item stack.

## Features

- Firework rockets are not consumed when launched from a block
- Firework rockets are not consumed when used for elytra boosting
- Works in singleplayer through the integrated server
- Works on Fabric servers when installed server-side
- Keeps vanilla firework behavior, including flight data and explosions
- No commands or configuration required

## Usage Example

```text
Use a firework rocket -> rocket launches -> item count stays the same
```

Field description:

- `Use a firework rocket` - Right-click a block or boost while gliding
- `rocket launches` - Vanilla firework behavior still happens
- `item count stays the same` - The stack is not decremented

## Behavior

- Applies to all firework rockets, including customized rockets
- Does not create new items or change crafting recipes
- Does not affect dispenser behavior
- Creative mode behavior remains unchanged

## Multiplayer Safety

- Client-only installation does not change item consumption on remote servers
- Multiplayer servers must install the mod server-side for the effect to apply
- When installed on a server, the non-consumption behavior applies to players using that server
- The mod does not register commands or send custom gameplay packets

## Supported Versions

- Minecraft 26.1.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.2+
- Fabric API 0.150.0+
- Java 25

## License

MIT
