body:
# BetterTPLogin  
A secure Minecraft authentication plugin with advanced features and user-friendly design.

---

## Key Features

### Authentication
- Secure registration with SHA-256 password hashing  
- Login verification system  
- IP-based auto-login for returning players  
- Password reset functionality  

### Security
- Random spawn point generation (4-block radius)  
- Movement restriction for non-authenticated users  
- Block interaction prevention  
- Anti-grief protection  

### Data Management
- YAML-based persistent storage  
- Location tracking and restoration  
- IP address management  
- Session handling  

---

## Commands
- `/register <password>` - Create new account  
- `/login <password>` - Authenticate existing account  
- `/resetpassword <current> <new>` - Change password  
- `/setspawn` - Set spawn point (Admin only)  

---

## User Experience
- Colored message formatting  
- Automatic spawn point randomization  
- Last location restoration  
- Clear login/register prompts  

---

## Technical Details

### Storage Format
```yaml
UUID:
  location:
    world: world_name
    x: 0.0
    y: 64.0
    z: 0.0
    yaw: 0.0
    pitch: 0.0

# Chimera

An Origins add-on that adds a chimera background to the game.

"_Born pretty weak, Chimeras survive and adapt by changing their body parts and mimicking other creatures._"

You have 2 fewer hearts than others, and can only eat meat. **But** you have 5 new body modification slots in which you can install other mob's body parts, extending your abilities.

## Modifications
### Core
- **Chimera Prime core**: Removes penalty from switching modifications. Reduces the cooldown before a modification can be used after equipping.
- **Blaze core**: Grants fire resistance, lava vision, faster movement in lava, and makes you always on fire. Water will hurt.
- **Dragon heart**: Grants 6 extra hearts and better health regeneration.
- **Prismarine core**: Grants water breathing, better water vision, faster movement in water, and removes block breaking slowdown in water.

- **Ravager horns**: Charge at the target, dealing damage and knocking them back.

- **Creeper skin**: Slowly become invisible when standing still.
- **Dragon scales**: Damage resistance.

- **Ocelot paws**: Less fall damage.

body:
## What is MiniZone?
**MiniZone** is a modpack designed to keep the vanilla feel of Minecraft while adding new features and improving the overall experience. It’s perfect for SMP servers, offering subtle changes without altering core mechanics.

## What does it add?
It adds a lot of things, and here are some examples:

- ✔️ Ad Astra (Space mod)
- ✔️ BetterX (BetterEnd and BetterNether)
- ✔️ Create and its addons
- ✔️ Sodium and optimization mods
- ✔️ EMI and its addons
- ✔️ Quality of Life mods
- ✔️ Yung's mods for improved exploration
- ✔️ 200+ mods enhancing the vanilla experience

## FAQ
### Why did you make a modpack?
I wanted a modpack that keeps vanilla gameplay intact while adding fresh features. The goal was to create a balanced and optimized experience for SMP servers, with no unfair advantages for players. Keep it fair, keep it fun!

### Can I use it on my server?
Yes! MiniZone is designed for both PvP and PvE servers, with a focus on multiplayer balance and performance. Get your friends together and dive in!

### Does it change Minecraft too much?
No, MiniZone stays true to the core vanilla gameplay. It only adds features and optimizations without drastically altering the way Minecraft is played.

### How does it perform?
MiniZone includes mods like Sodium and FerriteCore to ensure performance is optimized, even on large servers. It’s lightweight enough to run smoothly on most systems.

### Is it beginner-friendly?
Absolutely! The modpack includes quality-of-life improvements and intuitive features, making it easy for both new and experienced players to enjoy.

### Can I disable any Items, and is Custom tools, armor, and swords are disabled?
Yes! Custom tools, armor, and swords are disabled by default, keeping the vanilla balance intact. But if you want to try them, you can easily enable these features in the config. Enjoy the flexibility to play the way you like!

title: Ender Dream
description: Your bed is no place of safety and sleep is no respite. Not while she watches.
body:
Since its introduction, the bed has fundamentally opposed the existing structure and meaning of Minecraft. There have been many steps along the road from Beta's true survival experience to the modern 'the only way I can die is if I do something incredibly stupid'. The bed was one of those steps. Skipping the night takes away interesting decisions and risk from the player. Beds should not be the most powerful option for self-defence.

However, having control over the day-night cycle is greatly useful to the player, and the intensity of early nights will - and should - fade away. So instead of removing this advantageous mechanic from the game, this mod simply withholds it in a lore/thematically vanilla+ manner. You may still craft a bed. You may still get in it. You may still fall asleep. But something awaits you there now. She awaits you. Do not fall into her palm, as all others have. Should she be felled, your dreams will be safe to you once again.


<details>
<summary>Actual Functionality</summary>
The mod is aware of whether or not an ender dragon has died, once it has, it is functionless. Before then, players attempting to sleep in a bed will be met with a series of warning signs, followed by their execution (which won't damage armor and ignores totems), just before they are able to sleep through the night.
</details>

This mod competes with other sleep-nerfing mods, most commonly ones that disable it entirely, and directly opposes mods that increase their potency.

WARNING: This mod is currently untested with other sleep-altering mods. It is possible (or even likely) that there exists compatibility issues. You can report issues [here](https://github.com/Hxrlio/EnderDream/issues). I should cite these incompatibilities here and resolve them, but as a casual developer I make no guarantees.

title: Infection
description: Infection is a datapack which adds an infection to the game, a new challenge that makes harder to survive.
body:
Infection is a datapack which adds an infection to the game, a new challenge that makes harder to survive.

Effect

This new effect can affect you at any time if you are not wearing a face mask. It reduces the movement speed, the attack damage, the attack speed and deals constant damage (the armor protects it). The only way to heal it is by eating a honey stew or dying, that is, milk does not work with this effect. It has its own behavior depending on the dimension and how long the player has been infected.

Overworld:
  • 1 min = -20% movement speed & -20% attack damage.
  • 2.5 min = 1 point of damage (3 sec).
  • 7 min = -50% attack speed, -40% movement speed & 2 points of damage (2 sec).
  • 12 min = -40% attack damage & 4 points of damage (1.5 sec).
The Nether:
  • 1.5 min = -30% attack damage, -30% movement speed, -50% attack speed & 4 points of damage (2 sec).
  • 5 min = -50% attack speed, -50% movement speed & 9 points of damage (1.5 sec).
The End:
  • 1 min = -30% movement speed, -30% attack damage & 6 points of damage (2 sec).
  • 6 min = -40% movement speed, -50% attack speed, blindness & 10 points of damage (1.5 sec).
  • 12 min = -60% movement speed, -60% attack damage & 14 points of damage (1.5 sec).
Other dimensions: Same as the overworld.

Grace Period

Is a period of time during which you can't be infected. There is both global and individual grace pediod.

  • Global: 25 minutes from the creation of the world or the installation of the datapack.
  • Individual: 5 minutes per player, resets on death.

Face Mask

This new item is necessary wear to avoid getting infected. It has no armor points, it can't be re-dyed and the armor trims aren't seen on them. It has 80 durability, but loses 1 every 2.5 minutes. It can be crafted with any wool and two strings. If you try to dye a face mask or apply a trim on them, you will simply lose material. DON'T DO IT.

The zombies, husks, drowneds, skeletons, strays, piglins and zombified piglins have a chance to spawn with a random color face mask.

Honey Stew

It is a new stew based on medieval medicines, which were made with flowers and honey. It is crafted with a suspicious stew and 4 honey bottles. The only way to remove the infection from the player without dying, is by eating the honey stew, with a 40% chance of effectiveness. Also by eating it, you will lose all the negative effects you have, like an intermediate between the milk bucket and the honey bottle.

Advancements

  • Adventure → Safety Over Style: Obtain a Face Mask
  • Husbandry → Bee Our Guest → The Sweetest Stew: Eat a Honey Stew

Warning

Optifine is recomended for a better experience with the datapack, but it's not totally necesary. However, the resource-pack is totally necesary.

Credits

  • Ándogo_Myler for creating the texture of the effect.
  • Torrezx for helping to create the gallery images.
  • Minho for beta-testing.

title: Aniko's Roleplay Mod
description:
Aniko's Roleplay Mod is a lightweight mod majorly focused on Roleplay. The mod contains 100+ new commands with a variety of functions. They're split into 8 different categories.

Chat, Misc, Character, Relation, Item, Writing, Dice, Operator.
body:
Aniko here. This mod was made as a passion project, so updates will be infrequent; however, I have finished porting it to multiple Forge and Fabric versions, so I'm pretty happy with the state it's in. Oftentimes, the 1.20.1 Forge version will be the most recently updated and the least buggy. If you find any bugs or have suggestions for the mod, you can contact me through Discord. @asioko

(Note: future forge 1.20.2 versions & forge 1.21.1 versions are being discontinued. Many features that are on 1.20.2 & 1.21.1 have optional mod dependencies in which the mods don't exist for normal Forge.)

Certain features only work with Aniko's Nameplate Addon mod; they are optional features. The only reason these features are separated into another mod is that they're client-side. [Aniko's Nameplate Addon](https://modrinth.com/mod/anikos-nameplate-addon)

Here is what the mod adds in eight different categories, assuming you are the most updated version of the mod;

# [Chat]

/chatmode <global | local | whisper | shout | roleplay> - change your active chat mode

/chatcolor <hex> - set your chat color

/chatcolor gradient <hex1> <hex2> - set a gradient chat color

/chatcolor reset - reset your chat color


# [Character]

/characters - open the character management GUI

/character create <name> - create and switch to a character

/character switch <character> - switch active character

/character delete <character> - delete one of your characters

/character list - list saved characters

/character namemask <name> - temporarily mask your character name

/character namemask clear - clear your active name mask

/character set Name <value> - set your character name

/character set Age <value> - set your character age

/character set Race <value> - set your character race

/character set Gender <value> - set your character gender

/character set Pronouns <value> - set your character pronouns

/character set Residence <value> - set a residence

/character set Pronunciation <value> - set your character's pronuncation

/character set Height <value> set your character height (scale your character if you have Pehkui, optional.)

/character set scale <0.75-1.25> 

/character set Appearance - type appearance text in chat after the prompt; supports appending and manual formatting

/character set Artlink <url> - set a clickable art link

/character view <character> - view a character card

/characteruser <RP name> - find the Minecraft username behind an RP name

/character lastseen <character> - finds last time a character was used

/character compare <character>,<character> - compares 2 characters

/character search <option> <text> - search specific things about characters

/character color <hex> <hex> - sets your own character color, only viewable for yourself

/character color <character> <hex> <hex> - sets other people's character colors, only viewable for yourself

/status <text> - set your active character status for hover cards

/status clear - clear your active character status

# [Relations]

/relations - open the relations GUI

/relation set <character> - type the relation in chat after the prompt

/relation change <character> - type the new relation in chat after the prompt

/relation remove <character> - remove your relation to a character

/relation view <character> - view a character's relations

/relation color <character> - type one or two hex colors after the prompt to color that relation

/note set <character> - type a private note in chat; supports appending with --

/note view <character> - view your private notes

/note remove <character> - remove all private notes for that character

/note list - list characters you have notes for

# [Writing]

/documents - open the documents GUI

/mail - open your mail GUI

/mail <character> - send the held letter, document, or journal to another character's mailbox

/document create <title> - create a document

/document title <title> - rename the held document

/document body - type document text in chat after the prompt; supports appending with -- and manual formatting

/document sign - sign the held document with your active character name

/letter create <title> <recipient> - create a letter

/letter body - type letter text in chat after the prompt; supports appending with -- and manual formatting

/letter seal - seal the held letter

/journal create <title> - receive a writable journal book

/journal save - save the held written journal into your journal storage

/journals - open the journals GUI

# [Misc]

/format <bold | italics | strikethrough | underline | smalltext | bigtext | obfuscate | upsidedown> - toggle chat formatting

/format reset - clear your active formatting

/font <normal | smalltext | bigtext | upsidedown> - set your font variant

/togglepunc - toggle automatic punctuation

/clearappend - clear appended text

/headset - set your active character menu head to your current skin head

/kit create <name> - creates a kit based on your current inventory (Operator command)

/kit <name> - allows a player to claim a single kit (can no longer claim kits after, this is for roleplay purposes upon making a character)

/kit <username> reset - allows a player to choose another kit 

/playtime - gives playtime for your current character

/playtimeall - gives playtime across all your characters

/prompt cancel - allows you to cancel certain prompts

/prompt preview - allows you to preview certain prompts

/IC - sets your tag to IC (In character) in Nameplate & Tab (only works with Aniko's Nameplate Addon Installed.)

/CIC - sets your tag to CIC (Can be in character) in Nameplate & Tab (only works with Aniko's Nameplate Addon Installed.)

/afk - sets your tag to AFK (Away from keyboard) in Nameplate & Tab (only works with Aniko's Nameplate Addon Installed.)

/ooc - sets your tag to OOC (Out of character) in Nameplate & Tab (only works with Aniko's Nameplate Addon Installed.)


Manual Formatting (symbols go on both sides of a text) * italics ** bold  __ underline ~~ strikethrough || obsfucate ^^ upsidedown " Dialogue


Ending a message with -- appends it to your next message.

# [Item]

/change item lore - type item lore in chat after the prompt; supports appending with -- and manual formatting

/change item name <name> - change the held item's name

/change item color <hex> <hex2> - set held item name color or gradient

/change item lorecolor <hex> <hex2> - set held item lore color or gradient

/change item command add <command> - attach a command to a held item

/change item command list - list attached commands on the held item

/change item command clear - clear attached commands from the held item

/itemmeta set <key> <value> - set RP metadata on the held item

/itemmeta get <key> - view RP metadata from the held item

/itemmeta remove <key> - remove RP metadata from the held item

/itemmeta clear - clear all RP metadata from the held item

/inspectitem - inspect the held item's name, lore, metadata, and item ID

/signitem - sign the held item with your active character name

# [Dice]

/roll <dice> - roll publicly, like /roll d20, /roll 2d6, or /roll d20+5

/roll advantage <dice> - roll twice and keep the higher result

/roll disadvantage <dice> - roll twice and keep the lower result

/roll hidden <dice> - show the roll only to yourself and operators

/roll private <dice> - show the roll only to yourself

/coinflip - flip a public coin

# [Operator]

/chatstaff - enter staff chat

/chatevent - enter event chat mode

/chatevent <message> - send one event message

/colortoggle - toggle color and gradient support for global and local chat

# Optional Mod Support
No mods are required here, but optionally add more functionality to the mod.

Works with [Origins Forge] Saves Origins between characters (Currently only 1.20.1 mainline forge version, broken on other versions, will fix later!)

Works with [Pehkui] makes /character  set height actually scale your character, makes /character set scale <0.75-1.25> function 

Works with any mod using [Curios API] for trinket slots, so they save properly between characters

title: CraftyAI
description: A free, intelligent AI companion for Minecraft. Talk naturally, scan blocks, and more in chat!
body:
# CraftyAI ### AI companion for Minecraft Talk to an AI in Minecraft chat. It answers questions, scans blocks, controls time and weather, gives items, and runs commands. Free to use.
[Docs](https://craftyai.pages.dev) · [Download](#quick-setup) · [Features](#features) · [Discord](https://discord.gg/zCkE44hsBR)
> CraftyAI is in beta. You may hit bugs or slow responses during peak hours. Report issues on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/zCkE44hsBR). --- ## v1.2.0-beta ("Orion") - **RAG Memory**: The AI recalls past conversations across sessions using vector search. - **Block Scanning**: Ask the AI to scan nearby blocks and entities (up to 32 blocks out). - **Scheduled & Delayed Tasks**: Set recurring or one-shot actions. *"Remind me to sleep in 5 minutes"* or *"Set weather to clear every hour"*. - **Auto-Mint API Keys**: Install the plugin. An API key generates automatically. No Discord required. - **Custom Prompts (Pro)**: Change the AI's personality and behavior per server. - **Server Linking**: Connect your Minecraft server to your Discord account. --- ## Features
### In-Game AI Chat - Talk to AI in Minecraft chat - Configurable names and aliases - Typo-tolerant matching - Conversation memory across sessions - Per-player cooldowns and rate limits ![CraftyAI Natural Chat](https://craftyai.pages.dev/assets/chat-feature.png?v=3) ### Vision Scanner - Scan blocks and entities around you - AI analyzes what you see - Reports biome, time, coordinates - Works with all entity and block types ![CraftyAI Vision Scanner](https://craftyai.pages.dev/assets/vision-feature.png?v=3)
### AI Game Actions - Control time and weather - Heal and feed players - Change gamemodes - Give specific items - Run scheduled or delayed automations ### Edge Infrastructure - Runs on Cloudflare edge servers worldwide - BYOK: bring your own Gemini API keys - Background vector memory pruning
--- ## Subscription Tiers CraftyAI is free. Higher tiers add more capacity for large networks. | Tier | RPM | Requests/Day | Tokens/Day | Custom Prompts | |------|-----|-------------|-----------|---------------| | **Free** | 30 | 100 | 50K | No | | **Starter** | 100 | 1,000 | 500K | No | | **Pro** | 200 | 5,000 | 2.5M | 1 change/24h | | **Enterprise**| 500 | 100,000 | 10M | Yes | --- ## Platform Support ### Plugin (Server-Side) | Platform | Versions | Status | |----------|----------|--------| | **Spigot** | 1.8 → 1.21+ | Full Support | | **Paper** | 1.8 → 1.21+ | Full Support | | **Folia** | 1.19+ | Async Scheduling | | **Purpur** | 1.16+ | Full Support | ### Mod (Client/Server) | Platform | Versions | Status | |----------|----------|--------| | **Fabric** | `1.20.4` – `1.21.1` & `26.x` | Full Support | | **Quilt** | `1.20.4` – `1.20.6` | Fabric-Compatible | | **Forge** | `1.20.4` – `1.20.6` | Full Support | *(Fabric requires `craftyai-fabric` for 1.20.x–1.21.1, `craftyai-fabric-26` for MC 26.x)* --- ## Quick Setup ### Plugin (Spigot/Paper/Folia/Purpur) 1. Download `craftyai-spigot-1.2.0-beta.jar` from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/craftyai) 2. Drop it in `plugins/` and start the server 3. and start chatting. ### Mod (Fabric/Forge) 1. Download from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/craftyai) and place in `mods/` 2. **Fabric users:** Install [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) 3. Launch Minecraft 4. chat. --- ## Commands & Permissions | Command | Description | Permission | |---------|-------------|------------| | `/crafty` | Plugin info and status | `crafty.chat` | | `/crafty status` | Connection diagnostics | `crafty.chat` | | `/crafty reload` | Reload configuration | `crafty.admin` | | `/crafty learn Q \| A` | Teach the AI new knowledge | `crafty.admin` | | `/crafty test` | Test AI connection | `crafty.chat` | | `/crafty apikey` | Generate a new API key | `crafty.admin` | | `/crafty pro status` | Show current tier and expiry | `crafty.chat` | | `/crafty pro redeem ` | Redeem a Pro key from Discord | `crafty.chat` | | `/crafty pro help` | How to get a Pro key | `crafty.chat` | | `/crafty link` | Link server to Discord | `crafty.chat` | | `/crafty prompt view` | View custom prompt | `crafty.chat` | | `/crafty prompt set ` | Set custom prompt (Pro) | `crafty.admin` | | `/crafty prompt reset` | Reset prompt (Pro) | `crafty.admin` | *Grant `crafty.actions` to let the AI run in-game commands and actions.* --- ## Transparency & Privacy - **Edge Network**: Chat is processed on our Cloudflare edge servers. We don't sell chat history. - **BYOK**: Bring your own Gemini API keys for full data isolation. - **Closed Source Backend**: The server-side code is closed source. Plugins communicate over HTTPS. **Remote Connections**: - **AI Endpoint**: Connects to `craftyai-gateway.craftyauth.workers.dev` when a player chats. Sends game context, API key, and Session ID. - **Telemetry**: Sends anonymous heartbeats with request counts. Disable with `enable_metrics: false` (Plugin) or `telemetry_enabled: false` (Mod). ---

title: ResourcePack to Mod Lib (RPtMLib)
description: this is a library mod for Resource Pack to Mod. which is a mod that allows you to turn your resource packs to a mod.
body: # 📦 ResourcePack to Mod Library (RPtMLib) RPtM is a lightweight Fabric utility that lets you bundle multiple resource packs directly into a single mod JAR. It uses the `registerBuiltinResourcePack` API to register assets as "Built-in" packs. You can use [RPtM Converter](https://rptm.pages.dev/) to turn your resource packs to mods. All generated mods will be needing this library mod. In Modrinth people tend to download mods over datapacks and resource packs. So i build that mod for people who suffer from that. --- ### 🛠️ Why use this? * **Internal Loading:** Packaged assets stay inside the JAR—no more messy folders. * **Automatic Detection:** If any RPtM mod is installed it will work without hustle. * **Version Agnostic:** Built to work on **1.20+**. * **Zero Bloat:** No heavy dependencies or performance hits. * **Mod Compatibility:** Works with **[Respackopts](https://modrinth.com/mod/respackopts)** natively. * **Open Source:** Both [RPtMLib](https://github.com/Runteryaa/RPtM) and [RPtM Converter](https://github.com/Runteryaa/RPtM-Converter) source code available on [GitHub](https://github.com/Runteryaa/RPtM). --- ### 🗺️ TODO * ... --- ### 🚀 Quick-Start 1. Go to [RPtM Converter](https://rptm.pages.dev/) website. 2. Upload your resource pack. 3. Fill in the blanks about your mod. 4. Click "Convert to Mod". 5. Drag-n-drop to your mods folder. (make sure you have RPtMLib installed) 6. DONE!

title: Repair Your Portal!
description: This mod limits the lighting of nether portals to only ruined portals in order to encourage players to form relationships with structures!
body:
# Functionality

This mod limits the lighting of nether portals to only repaired ruined portals! All methods of lighting portals is included, such as:

- Flint & Steel
- Fire Charge
- Fireball 
- Dispenser

### Why do this?

Removing the ability to build nether portals encourages the player to form a relationship with the structure, potentially developing infrastructure or building around the ruined portal.

# Config

Inside the config file for this mod, you can:
- Enable/disable a client-side message for attempting to light your own portal
- Customize the message for lighting your own portal
- Toggle whether portals inside of the nether need to be repaired ruined portals to activate

These features are helpful for modpack designers and server owners particularly.

Feel free to use this mod in a modpack!

title: Durability warning mod
description:
Durability Warning

A lightweight client-side mod that alerts you when your tools are about to break.

Never accidentally destroy your favourite pickaxe again — get a clear warning when an item drops below 2.5% durability.
body:
🛠️ Durability Warning

Never break your tools by accident again.

Durability Warning is a lightweight client-side mod that alerts you when your tools are about to break — right when they drop below 2.5% durability.

Simple, clean, and designed to feel like vanilla.

⚡ Features
⚠️ Low durability alert
Get a clear warning when your tool is about to break
🔊 Subtle sound cue
Plays a quick alert sound so you don’t miss it
💬 Action bar message
No chat spam — clean and unobtrusive
🔁 Smart re-triggering
Repair your tool → it will warn you again next time
🧩 Client-side only
Works on any server (including vanilla)
🎮 Why use this?

Breaking a max-enchanted tool is one of the most frustrating things in survival.

This mod gives you just enough warning to react — without adding clutter, UI spam, or unfair advantages.

It fits seamlessly into vanilla gameplay.

⚙️ Requirements
Fabric Loader
Fabric API
Minecraft 1.21.1
🧠 How it works

The mod monitors the durability of items in your hands and triggers a warning when they drop below 2.5%.

It only alerts once per low-durability event to avoid spam, and resets automatically if the item is repaired.

💡 Design Philosophy
Vanilla-friendly
No gameplay advantage
No unnecessary features
Just solves a real problem
🚀 Future Plans (optional)
Armor durability warnings
Configurable threshold
Custom sounds / visual alerts
📦 Lightweight & Efficient

Minimal performance impact, no background overhead — just a simple check each tick.

❤️ Made for Survival Players

Whether you're mining, building, or exploring — this mod has your back when your gear is about to give out.

title: Random Drops From Blocks (RDFB)
description: This mod making if you break blocks, you gonna get random stuffs, like blocks,tools,mobs
body:
# Random Block Drops

**Made this for fun lol**

Ever got bored of mining and wanted some chaos in your life? This mod gives you random rewards every time you break a block. Could be a diamond, could be a chicken, could be 64 dirt blocks. Who knows? 

## What It Does

Break any block → Get a random surprise:
- **Random Items/Tools** (swords, food, random junk)
- **Random Blocks** (could be useful, probably not)
- **Random Entities** (hope you like surprise creepers!)

## Commands (OP lvl 2+)

| Command | What It Does |
|---------|-------------|
| `/randomdrops status` | See current settings |
| `/randomdrops toggle` | Enable/disable the randomdrops |
| `/randomdrops creative` | Enable/disable creative support |
| `/randomdrops reload` | Reload config file |
| `/randomdrops set item <0-100>` | Chance for item drops |
| `/randomdrops set block <0-100>` | Chance for block drops |
| `/randomdrops set entity <0-100>` | Chance for mob spawns |
| `/randomdrops amount item min <1-64>` | Min items per drop |
| `/randomdrops amount item max <1-64>` | Max items per drop |
| `/randomdrops amount block min <1-64>` | Min blocks per drop |
| `/randomdrops amount block max <1-64>` | Max blocks per drop |

## Config

Edit `config/random-block-drops.json` to customize everything:
```json
{
  "itemChance": 33,
  "blockChance": 33,
  "entityChance": 34,
  "enabled": true,
  "workInCreative": false,
  "itemMinAmount": 1,
  "itemMaxAmount": 16,
  "blockMinAmount": 1,
  "blockMaxAmount": 64
}
```

## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

## Warning

**I hope you like it)**

(but also don't blame me if you get a wither from breaking dirt)

---

*Made with chaos in mind*

title: Arcanmira
description: A new realm full of dangers and riches...
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/HREQMQ34EZA" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

![Logo](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/992/386/arcanmira.png)

Arcanmira adds a new dimension with a huge amount of content.

Curseforge page is [Here](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/arcanmira)



In order to get to this dimension, you will have to find the Realm Ruins. It spawns in any Overworld biome on the surface, and you will have to craft the Ancient Ingot into an Ancient Igniter to light the portal in the ruins.



Another way to get to the Dimension is to enable the Start in Arcanmira gamerule when creating a new world.



If you want to go into this mod blind, then DO NOT read any further. Advancements within the mod are a good way to try and figure out mechanics without looking them up.



New Additions:

# Blocks

Chert:

 -This is a common stone that makes up the underground of Arcanmira. It can be used as Stone Tools and decoration. Some Overworld ore can be found in this stone.

Rocky Chert:

 -This is a variant of Chert that spawns on the surface of the Stone Gardens biome.

Shadowy Chert:

 -This is a variant of Chert that spawns on the floor and ceiling of the Shadowed Caves biome.

Mossy Chert:

 -This is a decorative variant of chert that can be found naturally in Mining Stations. It can be crafted with Small Cavity Overgrowth and the respective chert block.

Cavitite:

 -A common decorative stone found in the Mossy Cavity.
 
Hydestone:

 -A common stone found in mountains in Arcanmira. It is used to duplicate Armor Trims and for decor. Emeralds may generate in this stone. There is six different types of Hydestone: Normal, Elder, Gray Dungeon, Dark Gray Dungeon, and Black Dungeon Hydestone, and Ghostly Hydestone. All Hydestone types can be dropped from their respective Hydes.

Hyde Totem:

 -This block is placed by the Overlord. It spawns a Hyde when a player gets too close.

Hyde Statue:

 -This functional block can always be found at the center of Hyde Villages. It can be used to check your standing with the Serene Hydes. If you reputation is bad, then you can offer Fractured Shards to the statue to make amends.

Quarry Rock:

 -Uncommon stone found exclusively in Mining Stations. It is a decorative block, and ores may be found in it.

Rhyolite:

 -A common stone found in patches in any biome that can be used for decoration. It is used in crafting some of the important blocks.

Gypsum:

 -White stone found commonly in the Crystalline Grotto biome that is used for decoration.

Volcanic Rock:

 -A common stone found in the Volcanic Flow biome.

Yellow Calcite:

 -A stone type that spawns as small boulders in the Magnolia Forest biome.
 
Crystal Flesh:

 -A brittle red stone found only in the Peering Caverns.

Eyebulb:

 -Hanging crystal eyeball blocks found in the Peering Caverns. Breaking these without Silk Touch will spawn an Eyeling.

Peering Crystallizer:

 -A rare block found in the Peering Caverns. Killing a living mob near this block will cause an Eyebulb to sprout.

Laventurf:

 -A grass block that generates in most biomes in Arcanmira.
 
Sunsta Laventurf:

 -An orange variant of Laventurf that generates in the Sunsta Forest.

Lavenpodzol:

 -This is a variant of Lavendirt that spawns in patches in the Ringlet Forest and Archlit Slopes biomes.

Mossy Lavendirt:

 -This is a variant of Lavendirt that spawns in the Mushroom Highlands biome. Arcanmira mushrooms can survive on this block at any light level.

Lavendirt:

 -A common dirt that is found in most Arcanmira biomes.

Ashy Sand:

 -Black colored sand found in the water of most Arcanmira biomes. It can be smelted into Ashy Glass.

Mira Lily:

 -A common flower found in most Arcanmira biomes that can be grown from Laventurf and crafted into dye.

Archlight Bloom:

 -Another common flower found only in the Archlit Slopes biome. It can be grown from Laventurf, but only if the Laventurf is in the Archlit Slopes biome.

Whirlyflowers:

 -These flowers are similar to Pink Petals. They can be found in some Arcanmira biomes and come in four colors: Green, White, Purple, and Red.

Sualgae:

 -A very common water plant found in Arcanmira. It can be brewed into potions of Blinding Light or cooked into food.

Splash Berries:

 -A bush plant found in the Wetlands and Volcanic Flow biome that has berries that can be picked and eaten.

Sogweed:

 -A common water plant found in the Wetlands biome that can be made into Soggy Satchels.

Cave Mold:

 -A common plant found in caves that has no use.

Lichenfungus:

 -This weird plant can be found deep underground, specifically in the Fungal Caves biome. It is a decorative block, with the Small Lichenfungus being used in Shrungcap Stew.

Midnight's Veil:

 -This moss-like plant can be found growing on trees in the Veilgrove.

Shadecoral:

 -A purple coral found in the waters around Veilgroves.

Crushing Coral:

 -A gray two-block tall coral found in the waters around Veilgroves.

Bubbly Arcoral:

 -A magenta coral found in Veilgroves that occasionally produces Bubbles. These can regenerate your breath and will pop if you stand on them.

Oceanic Bulb:

 -A glowing plant found in Veilgroves.

Tree Grass:

 -This is a green grass plant found mostly on trees in the Stone Gardens biome.

Arcane Amaranth:

 -This is a flower found in the Stone Gardens biome.

Candyfluff:

 -This is a flower found in the Stone Gardens biome.

Puklik Flower:

 -This is a two-block tall flower found in the Stone Gardens biome.

Shadowmoss:

 -This hanging plant can be found in the Shadowed Caves biome and crafted into the Ominous Cloak and Ominous Hood.

Shelf Fungus:

 -A common mushroom found in the Archlit Slopes and Mushroom Highlands biomes.

Shrungcap:

 -A yellow mushroom found in the Mushroom Highlands biome. The Tall shrungcaps can get very large.

Rare Mushrooms:

 -These three blocks (Hydden Gem, Ink Cap, and Archmorel) can be found in the Mushroom Highlands biome (These can also be found rarely in Archlit Slopes, Shadowed Caves, and Hytes). They are made into Shrungcap stew.

Cavity Overgrowth:

 -A common red cave moss, found primarily in the Mossy Cavity.

Cave Algae:

 -An uncommon plant found growing on Chert in the Deeplume Caves.

Lumen Berries:

 -Vines that grow fruit found in Deeplume Caves.

Deeplume:

 -A hearty glowing stalk found in the Deeplume Caves.

Lumeworm Silk:

 -A bioluminescent block found in the Deeplume Caves.

Grumbleroot:

 -This is a vegetable found often in Wetlands and Hyde Villages. It is very similar to carrots. They can only be planted on Lavendirt blocks near water.

Archlit Wood:

 -A new white wood set found in the Archlit Slopes biome. Blue Apples can drop from the leaves.

Magnolia Wood:

 -A new wood set found in the Magnolia Forest biome, with small bushes also in the Stone Gardens. The trees have Magnolia Flowers on the ground near them.

Veiled Wood:

 -A new dark purple wood set found in the Veilgrove biome.

Petronck Wood:

 -This rocky wood set can be found in the Stone Gardens biome. Mining the canopy blocks can rarely yield a Geode, which can be cracked and displayed or crushed into raw materials with a Geode Cracker.

Ringlet Wood:

 -This blue wood set can be obtained from the thin Ringlet Trees in the Ringlet Forest.
 
Sunsta Wood:

 -This orange wood type is found in the Sunsta Forest biome.

Arcane Bricks:

 -This uncommon resource can be obtained from Locked Chests within Arcane Ruins. It can be used in a Repair Forge to fix tools, along with decorative blocks such as Flower Pots and Brick Blocks.

Locked Chest:

 -This is a block found in Arcanmira Structures, mainly Arcane Ruins. They can be oped to drop some loot, and can be reset with a Curious Key. Opening these near Serene Hydes will anger them and reduce your reputation.

Tool Smithing Forge:

 -This block can be used to trim Altorite Tools with a Tool Trim. They work like a Smithing Table.

Framed Glass Panes:

 -These are decorative versions of Glass Panes made with Eldbrass. You can make them in every color and as an Ashy or colorless one.

Eldbrass Forge:

 -This is a useful crafting block that is used to make Hardened Plating.

How to forge Hardened Plating:

![Forging Hardened Plating](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/992/389/recycle-bin-file-explorer-10_16_2024-2_40_32-pm.png)

Geode Cracker:

 -This utility block can be used to crack Petronck Geodes.

Malachite:

 -This common green stone is purely decorative and can be obtained from Hyde Dungeon loot, higher tier Hydes, or from the Overlord.

Orange Crystals:

 -These are uncommon crystals found in the Crystalline Grotto biome. The crystal shards can be used in quite a few recipes.

Salt:

 -A pink decorative block found in the Salt Mines. Salt Chunks are used to make Salt Lamps and food items.

Salt Lamp:

 -A small decorative light block.

Plated Debris:

 -This is an ore version of Hardened Plating. It can be smelted into scraps.

Lost Supplies:

 -This block can be found in Arcane Ruins and Mining Stations. When opened, they can give Gear, Ores, Food, Wood, and more.

Plated Core:

 -A rare block found in Abandoned Cities used to craft the Chargeblade.

Key Repair Station:

 -This block is used to fix Broken Keys.

How to fix a key:

![Key Repairing](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/992/388/screenshot-10_16_2024-2_37_11-pm.png)

Safe Doors:

 -This block is found in Sanctums and can be unlocked by using a Safe Key.

Spawner Obelisk:

 -This block is found in some Arcanmira structures. It will spawn mobs based on the block beneath it when a player activates it by getting too close. They will recharge after an hour.

Treasure Rubble:

 -This rare block is found in the Ashy Sand pile in Safe Rooms. When mined, it will drop valuable loot, such as Broken Safe Keys and Ores. 8-12 of these blocks generate in each Safe Room.

Shadow Treasure Rubble:

 -This is a variant of Treasure Rubble that spawns in Sanctum Safe Rooms during a Shadow Event. The loot contained within it is different compared to Treasure Rubble.

Glaring Safe:

 -This block is found in a few structures in Arcanmira. They are unlocked with Tattered Keys and will drop some loot.

Altorite Alloy Press:

 -This crafting station is the only way to craft Altorite Ingots. It can be crafted with Ancient Ashes.

How to press an Altorite Ingot:

![Pressing Altorite](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1011/348/2024-11-09_19.png)

Respawn Ritual Altar:

 -This is a rare block that is crafted with Altorite Ingots. By placing an Orange Crystal Shard and then Ancient Ashes into the block, you will be able to set your spawn point in any dimension.

Arcane Radar:

 -Crafted with Altorite, this rare block can be used to highlight nearby entities by placing either an Orange Crystal Shard or Eldbrass Ingot into the block and then right-clicking it.

Repair Forge:

 -This block can be crafted by Upgrading an Eldbrass Forge with Altorite in a Smithing Table. It can use Arcane Brick to repair tools without costing experience or raw materials.

Arcane Altar:

 -This block is found in Safe Rooms and will contain a rare item upon opening.

Spike Traps:

 -Crafted with Crusher Teeth, this block will, when powered, hurt entities standing on it.

Shadow Wall:

 -This block can be crafted with Shadow Flesh. It is only visible and collideable when there is no light nearby.

Daylight Altar:

 -This block can be crafted from a Fractured Shard. It is used to skip 4 in game hours after every ritual.

Haunted Brazier:

 -Crafted with a Fractured Shard and Eldbrass, this block will spawn mobs when it is lit. Killing all of these mobs will net a reward. During Shadow Events, this block will only spawn Embersouls.

Embiric Bricks:

 -This is a decorative block made with Embiric Powder and Arcane Brick.

Embiric Lanterns:

 -These is crafted with Embiric Powder and either a Saltpewter Lantern or Eldbrass Lantern. It will despawn Shadowhydes and Apparitions near it.

Tablet Binder:

 -A utility block used to put spells into a Spell Tablet.

Gilded Crate:

 -This is a rare block found in Hyde Dungeons (See Hyde Dungeon below for chances) that will drop a Tool Trim and experience when broken.

# Items

Deeplume Stew:

 -A filling food item crafted with Deeplumes.

Grumbling Stew:

 -Soup made from Grumbleroot and Salt.

Blue Apple:

 -This common item can be obtained from Archlit Leaves. It is slightly better than a normal apple.

Enchanted Blue Apple:

 -This is a very rare item found in Safe Rooms. It is much stronger than an Enchanted Golden Apple.

Fruit Salad:

 -A food item made with every Arcanmira fruit.

Hardened Plating:

 -This alloy resource can be forged with an Eldbrass Forge. It is used for gear that is about as strong as Netherite, and is used to make Altorite.

Safe Keys:

 -These items are used to open Safe Doors. They are found in most loot chests in Arcanmira and can drop from Elder Hydes.

Tattered Keys:

 -This key can be dropped from Glarewraiths and Glarecadavers, along with being found in most Arcanmira Structures. They are used to unlock Glaring Safes.

Curious Keys:

 -These can be obtained from Goblits by trading them a Curious Pearl. They are used to reset Locked Chests.

Soggy Satchel:

 -A common item crafted with Sogweed and Eldbrass that can hold up to 9 slots of 32 items each.

Ancient Ashes:

 -This is a very rare item found in Safe Rooms used to craft Ancient Ingots and Altorite Alloy Presses.

Altorite:

 -This valuable alloy can be used to craft Altorite Gear, which is much stronger than Netherite. The full armor set has a special ability that can be activated with a keybind. (Default is V)

Tattered Cloth:

 -This is an uncommon item dropped by Glarewraiths. It can be crafted into an Ominous Cloak and Ominous Hood, which, when both are worn, will give the player some benefits, like going invisible when sneaking.

Eyestone:

 -This is an uncommon item dropped by Eyespirits that is used to craft Safe Keys.

Hauntfish:

 -A near invisible fish that can only be caught by fishing in Arcanmira. It is a food item.

Invisible Sushi:

 -A food item made with Hauntfish.

Crusher Meat:

 -This item is dropped from Crushers and can be cooked for a very good food source.

Crusher Tooth:

 -A common item dropped from Crushers that can be crafted into Spike Traps.

Hydebone:

 -This item has a 1/14 chance of dropping from Cloaked. It is used to craft the Chargeblade and Chargehammer.

Fractured Shard:

 -This rare item drops from the Shattered when they despawn in the daytime. It is used to make Daylight Altars and Potions of Guarding, along with repairing your Serene Hyde reputation.

Protective Wax:

 -This item can be obtained from trading with Serene Hydes. It can be used to make common mobs (such as the Hyde and Glarewraith) from despawning when a Shattered spawns.

The Shatterer:

 -This is a large sword made from Protective Wax and Fractured Shards. It can be used to hurt the Shattered, which will cause it to despawn.

Embiric Powder:

 -A rare dust that drops from Haunted Braziers and Embersouls. It has a few uses.

Ember Idol:

 -This item functions like a Totem of Undying. It will save you from death and make you immune to all damage, but you will instantly die after 10 seconds.

Armornite Gear:

 -This gear is between Netherite and Altorite. It can be made with an Armornite Plate and Plated gear, plus an upgrade template. The gear is stronger during Shadow Events or if you are in dark areas.

Overlord Ingots:

 -These are rare items crafted from Netherite Ingots and an Overlord Scrap dropped by the Overlord. It is used to make Altorite.

Quarry Pickaxe:

 -A rare item that can be obtained by trading Diamonds with Goblits. It mines in a 1x2 area, so it is very good for strip mining.

Chargeblade:

 -This weapon is crafted from a Plated Core, Tattered Cloth, and a Hydebone. It does relatively little damage but can be charged up to deal a lot of damage.

Chargehammer:

 -This is a souped-up version of the Chargeblade. It gains charges from killing mobs with it in your offhand, with there being no limit to the charges it can hold. It will deal 20% of the total hit damage back to the person using it.

Spell Tablet:

 -A utility item that can be found in Sanctums. Spells can be bound to it using a Tablet Binder.

Spell Parchment:

 -Scrolls found in most Arcanmira structures. These are used to add a spell to a Spell Tablet.

Potions of Blinding:

 -This item can be brewed with Sualgae and Awkward potions. It will blind any attacker by reducing their mob follow range by 75% and instantly kill Eyespirits.

Potions of Guarding:

 -This item is brewed from a Fractured Shard and Awkward potions. It gives the user extra Armor and Armor Toughness. There are 2 levels for this potion.

Potions of Death's Touch:

 -This special potion can be found exclusively in Abandoned Cities and Burial Chambers. It inflicts Wither of 30 seconds.

Curious Pearl:

 -This uncommon item can be found in some Arcanmira structures. Trading this item with a Goblit will get you a rare item.

Smithing Templates:

 -There are 5 new Armor Trims in this mod:

  -Concealed can be found in Sanctum chests

  -Plated can be found in Safe Rooms

  -Underhalls can be found in Black Hyde Dungeons

  -Mourner can be found in Burial Chambers

  -Arcane can be found in Arcane Ruins

 -2 New Tool Trims used for Altorite Tools:

  -Both Chargeline and Malevolent can be found in Gilded Crates within Hyde Dungeons

 -And 3 new upgrade templates:

  -The Plating Upgrade is found by looting Lost Supples, Sanctum Chests, Hyde Dungeons, Trading with Goblits, and by killing Overlords.

 -The Armorite Upgrade can be found in Safe Rooms' Treaure Rubble during Shadow Events

  -The Altorite Upgrade can be found in Safe Rooms

Music Discs:

 -There are 6 new discs in this mod:

  -Hydden is found in Safe Rooms

  -Overlord of Arcanmira can be obtained from defeating the Overlord

  -Wondrous can be obtained by trading Diamonds with Goblits

  -Dungeon Crawling can be found in Dark Gray and Black Hyde Dungeons

  -Awakened can be found in Burial Chambers

  -Shadow Events can be found in Safe Rooms' Treaure Rubble during a Shadow Event

# New Enchantments

Cooldown Reduction:

 -This enchantment can be found in a few structures in Arcanmira. It will reduce the cooldown on the Altorite Armor's special ability by 10 seconds. Maximum level is one.

Overcharge:

 -This enchantment can be found in a few structures in Arcanmira and can be put on a Chargeblade to allow you to overcharge the item by one per level. Maximum level is three.

Renewability:

 -This enchantment can be found in a few structures in Arcanmira. It will give the Chargeblade 1-2 charges back when killing a mob. Maximum level is one.

Deeplume Caves:

![Deeplume Caves](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1625/469/deeplume-png.png)

A small and rare biome found deeper underground. The cave is covered in Algae and Lumen Berry Vines.



Flowering Shrublands:

![Flowering Shrublands](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1625/491/flowering-shrublands-png.png)

This is a rare sub-biome of the Shrublands. Magnolia Trees generate very sparsely here, and the surface is covered with Whirlyflowers, with the Green Whirlyflowers being exclusive to this biome.



Fungal Caves:

![Fungal Caves](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1625/492/fungal-png.png)

This cave biome is found deep under mountains, mainly Archlit Slopes. It is the only place where the Fongre spawns.



Hytes:

![Hytes](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/992/606/minecraft-forge_-1.png)

This is an uncommon mountain biome. it is the only place in Arcanmira that is always snow-covered and it is one of three biomes that Hydestone generates naturally in.



Magnolia Forest:

![Magnolia Forest](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1625/493/magnolia-png.png)

A very common biome that consists of Magnolia Trees with Magnolia Flowers and Yellow Calcite generating on the forest floor.



Mossy Cavity:

![Mossy Cavity](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1625/470/mossy-cavity-png.png)

A common cave biome with a lot of Cavity Overgrowth growing on the floor and Cavitite in the walls.



Mushroom Highlands:

![Mushroom Highlands](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1216/821/minecraft-forge_-1-20-1-singleplayer-6_10_2025.png)

This is a rare mountainous biome filled with Shrungcaps. There are three rare mushrooms found here, and it is one of three biomes that Hydestone generates in.



Peering Caverns:

![Peering Caverns](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1625/471/peering-png.png)

An uncommon biome usually found under mountains. Many Eyebulbs grow from the floor and ceiling, and Eyespirits are the only mob that spawn naturally here.



Ringlet Forest:

![Ringlet forest](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1288/42/ringlet-forest-png.png)

This is an uncommon surface biome found near Shrublands and Archlit Slopes. The Ringlet Trees in this biome are very thin, only being an eighth of a block thick. The leaves can be cut off of the trees with Shears or regrown with Bone Meal.



Salt Mines:

![Salt Mines](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1625/481/salt-png.png)

An uncommon cave biome filled with Salt speleothems. Saltpewter Ore generates exclusively in this biome.



Sea:

![Sea](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1288/45/sea-png.png)

This is a very common biome that can have Splash Berries on islands. It generates in areas with low continentialness.



Shadowed Caves:

![Shadowed Caves](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1625/494/shadowed-png.png)

This is a cave biome found inland. The floor and ceiling are covered with Shadowy Chert, with Shadowmoss growing on the ceiling. The Shadowborn will only spawn within this biome.



Shrublands:

![Shrublands](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1288/47/shrublands-png.png)

This is another very common biome. It contains a lot more Lavengrass than any other biome.



Stone Gardens:

![Stone Gardens](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1625/495/stone-gardens-png.png)

This is a rare biome found in more continential areas of Arcanmira. the ground here is made of Laventurf and Rocky Chert, with new flowers and Tree Grass dotting the landscape. Most of the foliage in this biome grows on top of the Petronck Trees, as they are rich in minerals and provide shelter for the plants. You can get Geodes from mining the canopies of the Petronck Trees. This is the only biome that the Crumblehyde and Rockwraith spawn in.


Sunsta Forest:
![Sunsta Forest](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1359/319/2025-10-16_12-34-16-png.png)
This is an uncommon forested biome that generates near coasts. Sunsta Laventurf covers the floor of this biome, with Sunsta Grass and Red Whirlyflowers on the forest floor.


Veilgrove:

![Veilgrove](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1288/51/veilgrove-png.png)

A rare biome found out in the sea. There are special trees here, along with Purple Whirlyflowers on the ground and special corals in the water. Glarewraiths don't burn here and they are the only mob that spawns.



Volcanic Flow:

![Volcanic Flow](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/992/605/minecraft-forge_-1.png)

This is an uncommon biome that is usually found near the sea. Jagged Crags of Volcanic Rock generate here, along with Splash Berries.



Wetlands:

![Wetlands](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1288/55/wetlands-png.png)

This is a semi-rare biome that is similar to the Shrublands but has much less Lavengrass and the surface is covered with pools of Water. Splash Berries, Grumbleroots, and Sogweed are found here.

# Structures

Realm Ruins:

![Realm Ruins](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/992/633/minecraft-forge_-1.png)

This is an uncommon Overworld structure that you have to find in order to enter Arcanmira. You can find Enchanted Diamond and Iron Gear here, along with some supply items.



Arcane Ruins:

![Arcane Ruins](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1216/824/minecraft-forge_-1-20-1-singleplayer-6_10_2025.png)

These are small ruin structures found on the surface of Arcanmira. They consist of a group of ruined buildings with Locked Chests in them. A new Armor Trim can be found here, along with Arcane Brick, which is exclusive to this structure.



Hyde Village:

![Hyde Village](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1288/59/hyde-village-png.png)

This is a common, usually small town found in most forests and plains of Arcanmira. There are generally few houses with chests, but opening these will anger the Serene Hydes living here.



Wayfinder's Tower:

![Wayfinder's Tower](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1288/53/wayfinders-tower-png.png)

This is a semi-common structure found on the surface of Arcanmira. A chest that usually contains a map can be found here, with a Glaring Safe containing the maps to rarer structures.



Burial Chamber:

![Burial Chamber](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1181/822/minecraft-forge_-1-20-1-singleplayer-5_8_2025.png)

This is a very small dungeon found everywhere in Arcanmira. The Glarecadaver will spawn in this structure and there are Glarewraith Spawners in some. The loot here is contained within Glaring Safes, and the layout of each one depends on the biome it spawned in.



Mining Station:

![Mining Station Entrance](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/25f1de0ff289578cb5f8f55585a825b984f90377_0.webp)![Small Mining Station](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/271eb9ecaed8bba3d8f94bd4e082ba69791efd8c.png)![Medium Mining Station](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1b0b42e1e4f50596cc03961b74efcffb6ed0067f_0.webp)![Large Mining Station](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b53e1ee453aefde77d5844dfec3ad9f3c6b47b3b_0.webp)

This is an uncommon structure found in most forested and mountainous inland biomes. There will always be an entrance to this structure on the surface with a ladder and staircase leading down into the main complex. This complex has three variants: Small, Medium, and Large. The lower complex contains mined deposits of Quarry Rock, some Lost Supples, and Goblits wandering around, with Cavity Overgrowth found often in the chambers. Plated Debris can be found rarely in the mines.



Hyde Dungeon:

![Gray Hyde Dungeon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1fd92cc6cdc9291960177e6421225cd4106845cc_0.webp)![Dark Gray Hyde Dungeon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d5a7fbb3c1ead92d7725576b865131720543f7d_0.webp)![Black Hyde Dungeon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a330115796c5961f560e771537848a79caf0e9a0.png)

This structure can be found from Y=-30 to Y=30 in mountainous biomes. The structure consists of a certain type of Dungeon Hydestone, and the color depends on which variant it is. The Gray Hyde Dungeon is the easiest to conquer, while the Black Hyde Dungeon is the most difficult and contains the most loot. These structures can be found with a map that you can obtain from the Wayfinder's Tower.



Abandoned City:

![Abandoned City](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1181/825/minecraft-forge_-1-20-1-singleplayer-5_8_2025.png)

This is a very rare structure found on the surface of non-coastal Arcanmira biomes. Many Cloaked patrol the streets, with each house having a Glaring Safe in it. The Plated Core, which is used to craft the Chargeblade, can be found here.



Sanctum:

![Sanctum](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/992/632/minecraft-forge_-1.png)

By far the most valuable structure in this mod, it is a semi-rare structure found in mountainous inland areas and cave biomes. The Overlord Boss can be found here, along with Safe Rooms that contain a bunch of loot, and a portal to leave the dimension. The second floor may contain extra Spawner Obelisks and Chests. If you come here during a Shadow Event, the mobs spawned here will be much harder, including the Overlord. The loot in Safe Rooms and from the mobs is much better during this time.

description: Why does Nutella not exist in Minecraft? Why is such a delight not in the game? This mod will add the best food into the game!
body:
**Ferrero nor Nutella do not endorse this project! This is NOT in any way official!**

**This mod is only in it's earlier release. It is 1.0 but doesn't have a whole ton of content. Stay tuned for updates!**
## Context
About a year ago (as of writing this), the Nutella mod was created. However, it was buggy, the textures were funky, and in general not the best. This is a recreation of that mod with a more ambitious (and less buggy) vision.

## Overview

Why does Nutella not exist in Minecraft? Why is such a delight not in the game? This mod will add the best food into the game!

This mod also adds a new dimension, Dreamscape. Find how to get there below.

Go exploring! Find nutella! Eat nutella! Make nutella! Find a chocolate cow! Make choclite armor! Have fun!

## Getting Started
First and foremost, I highly suggest for you to get JEI (Just Enough Items). Most people already have it, or at least know what it is, but I'd like to remind you that you'll likely struggle and be confused without it!

Start by crafting Nutella. You can upgrade it to gold, diamond, and netherite, but don't do that if you're specifically trying to go to Dreamscape. Instead, use four to make a Nutella block. Then use four of those to make four Nutella bricks. Then make a portal with the bricks in the same shape of the nether portal. To light it, you'll need Transdimensional Nutella, obtained by combining Nutella and an eye of ender. Light the portal and bam! You have access to Dreamscape.

title: Wither Storm, With Herobrine!
description: Lost cities mod, wither storm, and herobrine!
body:
## **City Under Siege**

The world is dead, and the survivors are being hunted. This modpack drops you into an infinite, decaying metropolis where the environment is just as lethal as the monsters.

---

### **The Nightmare Trinity**

* **The Ruins:** You spawn in **The Lost Cities**. Survival means scavenging through abandoned skyscrapers and subways. There are no safe forests—only concrete jungles.
* **The Stalker:** **Herobrine** is real. He isn't just a boss; he’s a haunting presence that stalks you through the ruins, messing with your head and building shrines in the shadows.
* **The End:** **Cracker’s Wither Storm** is active and evolving. It’s a massive, block-eating titan that forces you to stay mobile. If you stay in one penthouse for too long, the Storm will eventually find you and level the entire block.

---

### **Survival Rules**

1. **Don't Settle:** Your base is temporary. The Wither Storm is always moving, and it *will* find you.
2. **Scavenge Everything:** Iron, coal, and food are rare. Strip the buildings for every scrap of copper and glass you can find.
3. **Watch the Fog:** If you see eyes in the distance, it’s already too late.

**How long can you survive the collapse?**

---

Would you like a list of essential performance mods to make sure the Wither Storm doesn't lag out your game?

title: Time Changer Express
description: A Client-side Fabric Mod that allows changing Minecraft in-game time, full configuration via commands
body:
TimeChanger lets you change the time and weather on your client without affecting the server or other players. Simple as that.

Want it to always be noon while you build? Use /ctime 6000. Tired of rain ruining your screenshots? Type /cweather clear and you're done. The server keeps running normally, but you see what you want to see.

It's client-side only, so it works on any server (unless they kick you for other reasons lol). The mod saves your settings in a config file, so you don't have to set it up every time you play.

Commands:

/ctime <number> - Change time (0-24000, or -1 to turn it off)
/cweather <clear/rain/thunder/unset> - Change weather
Works on Minecraft 1.21.8 with Fabric. No weird dependencies, just Fabric API. That's it.

title: TheLostMenu
description: An eerie horror cosmetic mod that transforms your menu with forced window sizing, glitch effects, and atmospheric soundscapes. Perfect for modpacks!
body:
**Project Description**

The Lost Menu is a client-side cosmetic mod designed to overhaul the standard Minecraft main menu into a psychological horror experience for modpack developers. Inspired by Graveyard Shift at Freddy's and the aesthetic of The Broken Script, it aims to create an unsettling "system hijack" atmosphere before the player even enters a world.

**Main Features**

Forced Window Perspective: Automatically scales the game to a restricted 800x600 window in the main menu to create a sense of claustrophobia.

OS Window Manipulation: The actual game window can shake and vibrate on your desktop for high immersion.

Dynamic Visual Glitches: Subtle internal shaking effects simulate a corrupted game state.

Thematic UI: Changes the window title to cryptic messages like choose and decide.

Eerie Soundscape: Replaces standard menu music with unsettling mechanical noise fully compatible with the in game volume slider.

**Customization**

Every feature including the window shaking can be individually toggled in the configuration file titled the the_lost_menu-client.toml .This allows players to adjust the mod of the experience to their preference.

Credits

Sound effects (Music) provided by whalesofjupiter via Pixabay this [Music](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/tape-emission-3-17891/)

title: Origins: Arachnium
description: An arachnid of a steampunk era. Boost across the sky and unleash chaos on them all.
body:
# 🪝 Arachnium
### (Impact 2)
"I tell you, truly, sir, that artificer has gone mad. He first took over the aerodrome and has now created a dreadful contraption of pistons and engines from parts of aircraft. They have eight limbs that move on their own accord, eight eyes fixated with bright brimstones. It was designed in the case of war breaking out, but all it knows of is war."

Introducing the **Arachnium** origin! An Impact 2 origin themed around a steampunk, mechanical spider **thirsting for blood**! With lore, advancements, movement, and combat, the only thing stopping you from taking over a server is you!

## Powerlist

<details>
<summary>Constraint</summary>

Copper wires that weave around your victims' body, slowing them down and occasionally piercing them. These are ejected following Prowess.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Pressure Prowess</summary>

Fit with long copper legs with pipes scattered throughout, you can let the steam come out at any force you desire. While sprinting on a block, you charge up a resource that, once full, allows you to jump high into the air. This puts you into the state of Prowess. During this period, you can pause your movement and dash three times; this stage ends when you hit the ground.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Chest of Cogs</summary>

A heart made of cogs that is constantly turning, beside it is empty space. You can use this space to store items, some items even give certain buffs.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Oxidation</summary>

Because the copper that makes up your body has not been waxed, it will oxidise over time. As your body oxidises, you begin to move more slowly until you are unable to sprint, and then you find yourself exhausting. You can scrape this with an axe, and so can other players.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Mechanical Nature</summary>

Unfit for extreme moisture or heat, your mechanical body deteriorates in either situation. When on fire, you slow down dramatically and take more damage when wet.

</details>

## Dependencies
This datapack does require the [Origins Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins).

## Additional
This origin was created with a friend, their origin will be released soon. The origins were loosely inspired by ULTRAKILL and the advancements will prove that.

A lightweight Minecraft mod that Change arrow retrieval mechanics, ensuring no more lost arrows.

Vanilla Minecraft often makes normal arrows disappear after firing. This mod fixes that completely - every shot becomes retrievable, saving resources and perfect for survival mode gameplay.  

Simple installation, instant effect. Make every arrow count!

title: ChatTools
description: A cross-server chat management plugin designed for Minecraft Velocity servers. It supports global message synchronization, custom server display names, and cross-server private messaging, enhancing player communication in multi-server environments.
body:
# ChatTools - Velocity Cross-Server Chat Plugin
![Velocity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Velocity-3.4.x-blue) ![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-17-green) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-GPLv3-green.svg)

**ChatTools** is a cross-server chat management plugin designed for Minecraft Velocity servers. It supports **global message synchronization**, **custom server display names**, and **cross-server private messaging**, enhancing player communication in multi-server environments.

> **Note**: This plugin is AI-developed to simplify cross-server chat management.

---

## Features
- **Cross-Server Message Sync**:
  - Messages sent by players on any sub-server are broadcast to all online players in real-time.
  - Message format includes **server alias** and **player name**.
- **Custom Server Names**:
  - Define server display names via configuration files (e.g., `lobby` → `Main Lobby`).
- **Cross-Server Private Messaging**:
  - Use `/tell` or `/msg` to privately message players across servers.
  - Messages are visible only to the **sender**, **receiver**, and **console**.
  - Supports tab-completion for online player names.
- **Dynamic Configuration**:
  - Use `/chattools reload` to reload configurations without restarting the server.
- **Compatibility**:
  - Supports Velocity 3.4+ and Minecraft 1.16+.

---

## Installation
### 1. Download the Plugin
Download the latest `ChatTools.jar` from [GitHub](https://github.com/NSrank/ChatTools) or other distribution channels.

### 2. Install the Plugin
Place the downloaded `ChatTools.jar` into the `plugins/` directory of your Velocity server.

### 3. Start the Server
Start the Velocity server. The plugin will automatically generate the default configuration file at `plugins/ChatTools/config.yml`.

---

## Usage
### Commands
| Command                    | Permission             | Description                                                         |  
|----------------------------|------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|  
| `/chattools reload`        | `chattools.reload`     | Reload the plugin configuration file to apply changes immediately.  |  
| `/tell <player> <message>` | `chattools.command.tell` | Send a private message to a player across servers.                 |  
| `/msg <player> <message>`  | `chattools.command.tell` | Alias for `/tell`.                                                |  

### Examples
1. **Cross-Server Chat**  

A player in the `Lobby` server sends:

```
  [Main Lobby] Steve: Hello everyone!
```  

  A player in the `Survive` server replies:

```   
  [Survival World] Alex: Welcome to Survival!
```

2. **Cross-Server Private Message**:
```
  [Main Lobby] Steve → [Survival World] Alex: How's it going?
```

---

## Configuration
The configuration file is located at `plugins/ChatTools/config.yml`:
```yaml  
servers:
  lobby:
    name: "Main Lobby"
    color: "AQUA"
  survive:
    name: "Survival World"
    color: "GREEN"
  minigame:
    name: "MiniGame Zone"
    color: "YELLOW"
```
- **Keys** (e.g., lobby) are **Velocity server IDs**.
- **Values** (e.g., Main Lobby) are **display names** used in chat.

---

## Support and Feedback
If you encounter any issues or have suggestions for improvements, please contact us through the following channels:

-  **GitHub Issues**: [Submit an issue](https://github.com/NSrank/ChatTools/issues)

---

## License & Disclaimer  
- **Development Statement**: This plugin is AI-developed to provide efficient chat management for the Minecraft Velocity community.

- **License**: Licensed under GNU General Public License v3.0. You are free to use, modify, and distribute it under the license terms.

- **Disclaimer**: The developer is not responsible for any issues arising from the use of this plugin.

---

## Acknowledgements
Special thanks to the following technologies and tools:

- [Velocity API](https://papermc.io/software/velocity)
- [SnakeYAML](https://github.com/snakeyaml/snakeyaml)
- [Adventure API](https://github.com/KyoriPowered/adventure?spm=a2ty_o01.29997173.0.0.7c5733f51H3mj8)

---

title: FeverDream Frenzy (Discontinued)
description: Explore a world filled with weird and wacky mobs, biomes, blocks, and more
body:
# **The mod got corrupted, find more about it here https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC2uM7rgDxFqWndH0-lIOXVw/community?lb=Ugkx3BaNxJSsJ_BLL6kazrcfVzBhM_O8etzb**

**NOTE: THIS MOD IS ONLY BEING PORTED TO MODRINTH AND WILL NOT HAVE OLDER VERISONS OF THE MOD. HOWEVER, NEWER VERSIONS CAN AND WILL BE HERE.**

Welcome to FeverDream Frenzy. A mod here to do what other mods have done, be weird. Inspired by mods such as Creeps and Weirdos, trying to just be a goofy little experience. But unlike Creeps and Weirdos, this mod has more progression and unification among features, with everything being intwined, from as simple as two species fighting, to the god-like entity that created all of the weirdness. This mod includes 30+ advancements as of now, as well as many bosses for you to face. Along with a new WACKY biome to explore.

 

Please do remember this mod is still in development, and may not be completely stable due to bugs.

The mod itself is based around unpredictability, to not know what you'll find while playing. It isn't meant for a serious or immersive experience, but simply for a fun one. If you are someone who is a fan of weird and wacky adventures, this mod is the perfect thing for you! Along with advancements, there is a good bit of progression in this mod, being able to use the same item for different things. This mod has a bit of everything, from food, to armor, to dungeons.

So, what all does this mod include? Well, let's start with the mobs.

 

Juanathan:

Juanathans are short little guys, spawning in dark places especially in the Wacky Woods biome. These guys are very fast, and attack players, Wacky Warriors, and Wacky Guards. Upon death, Juanathans drop fries, which can be used to make a very fast shovel, and or eaten.

 

Wacky Warrior:

Wacky Warriors are only found in the Wacky Woods, and are neutral towards the player. They wield a Wacky Blade, which does low damage, yet never breaks. As mentioned before, Wacky Warriors fight Juanathans (and usually win).

 

Wacky Guard:

Wacky Guards, unlike their fellow Wacky Warriors, attack the player on sight. Covered in Wacky Armor, these are the Piglin Brutes of the Wacky Warriors. Only found within The Great Wack Tree, these wacky people guard their treasure. 

 

Wider:

Widers, are strange flying spiders found within the Wacky Woods. They are passive, and merely fly about without a thought. Killing them (although I don't know why you would) will make them drop their meat. Uncooked, it's pretty bad, but when cooked, they are quite good to satisfy your hunger.

 

Cheese Monkey:

Oh boy, the Cheese Monkey. This ain't just your everyday mob, for the Cheese Monkey is a boss. Found in a Cheese Temple, you'll have to break the Cheese Altar in order to summon it. The monkey is quite slow, but will have the help of Molten Cheese Cubes. Getting too close to the Cheese Monkey, may cause it to regurgitate out more of those cheesy little cubes, if you aren't careful you will be overwhelmed. Upon death, the Cheese Monkey will drop Hyper Cheese, of which can either be eaten, or used to craft Cheddar Grenades.

 

Molten Cheese Cube:

Summoned by the Cheese Monkey, these guys are easy to avoid alone, but not so much in groups.

 

The Ent of The Great Wack Tree:

Yet another boss, this bad boy is found at the top of The Great Wack Tree. Unlike the Wacky Guards protecting their loot, the Ent is here to protect the tree. You cannot damage the Ent by normal means, but the trap wood scattered across the arena and throughout the tree, sure can damage the Ent. Upon taking damage however, the Ent will call upon swarms of Wack Seeds, to aid it in battle. On it's death, it will drop the Wacky Acorn, either used to craft trap wood, or to plant a Great Wack Tree in your own back yard! (If your backyard is big enough that is)

 

Wack Seed:

Summoned by The Ent of The Great Wack Tree, these little seeds are quite fast, and are not affected by trap wood.

And more

 

Now of course there are quite a few items and blocks in here, such as The Dirt Cleaver, or Wack Stone. But I think it'll be better for you yourself to see them. If this mod peaks your interest, please do download to support it, and maybe one day, the greatness of a weird Minecraft mod may strike the Earth again.

title: No Spoiler Recipe Book
description: A Minecraft datapack that makes the recipe book give you the recipe only after you craft the item for the first time.
body:
Do you think that Minecraft is better experienced by discovering every crafting recipe by yourself and that the Recipe Book ruins the experience by giving away all the recipes in the world when you collect an item from the ground? Worry not, with this datapack you won't have to worry about getting spoilers!

This datapack changes the recipe book to only show a recipe when you craft the corresponding item, if you smelt your first iron, for example, you won't unlock the flint and steel recipe, but you'll also have to find flint and craft it, only then you will be able to see the recipe in the book.

If you already have started a world and you want to use the datapack, open your world to LAN enabling cheats (if you don't have them already enabled) and use the command ```/recipe take your_username *``` to delete all your unlocked recipes, this way you will start fresh!

I created this pack because of a Twitch streamer that started playing the game blind, and he refused to use the book in order to have the most immersive experience. I thought "Wait, there are no mods that make the recipe book show only what you already crafted?" and to my disbelief no one made something similar! So I learnt how to create datapacks and here we are.

This datapack is fully open source, on GitHub you can find the script I created to automate the process and the instructions to port the datapack to your desired version. You are freely allowed to make your own version of the datapack for every version of the game that you wish for and upload them online (you don't have to give me credit, but if you do I will appreciate it :)

Note: this is for the vanilla game, if you want to use it with another datapack you'll have to convert the datapack's recipes with the script on GitHub.

title: Dangerworks
description: Dangerworks is a medium-sized 1.20.1 modpack that focuses on adding more to the features that are already in Minecraft as well as adding more challenge as well as a sense of wonder to the game again through wacky magic and simple technology.
body:
Journey through danger, construct crazy contraptions with create, travel to distant worlds, tinker with the wackiest enchantments and magic in: Dangerworks! a modpack built from the ground up to make the world a bit more interesting and challenging featuring more diverse terrain with several biome mods, cave mods, dungeons and difficulty that increases as you journey through the nether and the end.

### Diverse Simple Biomes ###
a heavy focus on mods that improve existing biomes as opposed to traditional large scale modpacks. With mods such as cascades that adds the incredibly varied small scale moutains from early beta to william wythers overhauled overworld and geophilic that add tweaks of their own to existing biomes.


### Rejuvenated Structures and Dungeons ###
A heavy focus on mods that improve existing structures such as YUNG's better mineshafts and YUNG's better desert temples as well as Epic dungeons which add incredibly fun and thrilling dungeon adventures that will never be the same each time you explore them.

### Adventure And Combat ###
To compliment the newly added and remastered structures Daedelus's entire RPG series suite has been included which features elemental magic such as Fire, Ice, Thunder and Healing magic through classes that are built to encompany them. Revisited enchanting and alchemy is a focus too with new potion effects that can spice up how you play through Extra Alchemy, Extra Enchantments and Curses and reconfigured enchanting through the Easy Magic mod that fixes many of the issues that Minecraft has had (since forever) with features such as moving enchantments from pre-enchanted items to books and easy rerolls to allow you a more indepth customisable experience with your weapons and equipment.

### Tougher Foes ###
With mods like Majrusz's Progressive Difficulty the game is structured more similarly to games like Terraria through the difficulty increasing as you enter the nether, and as you beat the ender dragon to keep you on your toes at all times. Complimenting this change additionally, several mob mods are included such as Special mobs and Ender Zoology. Which feature challenging mobs that have unique attack patterns that will put your skills to the test, no matter at what point you're at during your adventures.
