# Cluckifer (Quilt/Fabric/NeoForge)  
Cluckifer is a fork of [Fleecifer](https://modrinth.com/mod/fleecifer), but it makes chickens hostile instead of sheep.  

## Mod Requirements

## FAQ
- **I've got another mod that changes chicken behavior, is this compatible?**
    - Cluckifer has not been tested with other mods that change chicken behavior, you may experience issues under this circumstance.
- **Can I use this in a modpack or video?**
    - Yes, you can use this mod in modpacks or videos.
- **Will you backport this mod?**
    - I am unlikely to port to specific versions, as this mod was made for fun. However, other developers are free to port this mod, as long as they adhere to the conditions of the LGPL-3.0-or-later license.
- **Can I remove the re-texturing of the chicken?**
    - The eyes are separate textures located at `cluckifer:textures/entity/chicken/chicken_eyes.png`, and `cluckifer:textures/entity/chicken/chicken_eyes_emissive.png`, which you could replace with blank textures using a resource pack.

title: Kars Optimized Multiplayer
description: Modpack for Minecraft 1.20.4 with staple performance mods and QoL utility mods suitable for multiplayer use
body:
This modpack will provide staple performance mods (and extras) to help maximizing your fps output.

Disclaimer: maximizing your fps output doesn't mean it will not fluctuate or be very stable. The game settings will affect performance a lot, and some mod may not work well when paired with other mods, making some fps spikes inavoidable.

# Another optimization pack?
Yes.

Although, this one is equipped with various QoL tools and enhancements for playing in multiplayer servers.

You may or may not like the QoL mods included in this pack.

## Notable features:
- Chest Tracker: This mod will greatly help you finding specific item between your monster chest storage, just open each of them once to allow the mod to cache its contents as NBT file, then you can press **CTRL+F** to search your item. It will then return relevant results to you that if clicked on, will show you glowing boxes in which your item is stored in.
- Amecs: This mod allows you to combine keybinds with **CTRL**, **ALT**, and **SHIFT**, so you will have a lot more flexibility for keybinds.
- EMI: EMI is a relatively new NEI-like mod that is fast, requires zero dependencies, and will not hog up your computer resources. It also has plenty of features, similar to its competitors. If you need more features, there are various external mods that can be added to complement its functionality. Press **ENTER** while opening inventory/container gui to focus to search bar. Press **BACKSPACE** to return to the previous recipe. Press **LMB/R** while hovering over an item to view the recipe for that item. Press **RMB/U** while hovering over an item to view its usage. Press **A** to favourite any item, it will be shown on the bottom-left section.
- Chat Calc, Chat Patches, ChatUtils: These three will help you solve chat games, finding particular keyword in chats, keeping the chat history stays after server switches or game restarts. Open chat and **press and hold LCTRL while clicking with LMB** to copy the raw text from a line. Use **RMB** to copy raw/formatted/json text or its unix timestamp.
- ClientHarvest: Farming in multiplayer servers are often tedious due to how your player will sometimes chew up raw plantable plants, making you take longer time to replant your harvested items. This mod simply fixes that by replanting your plants using your active mainhand plant as source.
- Extended Hotbar, HotbarReplace: Allows you to have one extra hotbar slot that is swappable and will refresh your used items for you to allow swift structure building process. Press **R** to swap your hotbar.
- Inventory Binds: You have three extra buttons that can be customized to your liking. By default, this modpack will give you a `/home Home` button, a `/back` button, and a `/spawn` button. You can read [how to configure the buttons here](https://modrinth.com/mod/inventory-binds).
- Freecam (Modrinth Version): Allows you to roam around the loaded area centered in your player entity without the clipping feature to comply with "no x-ray or cave finder" rules. Press **F9** to activate or deactivate this mod.
- Xaero's Minimap (Fair-Play): This nerfed version disables entity tracking and cave tracking to prevent you from gaining unfair advantages in PVP and mining.
- Press **C** to zoom, scroll wheel to adjust. Press **CTRL+N** to toggle Night Vision mode. Press and hold **CTRL+C** while clicking a slot in your inventory to lock/unlock a slot. Locking a slot prevent items contained within it from being dropped.
- Everything else is adjustable from the keybind option. Remember that you can use **CTRL ALT SHIFT** to rebind the keys.

The rest of the mods can be considered as "gaining technical advantage" in some servers, so please check out the server rules and/or reach out the server staff before using them. However, alternatives such as Freecam (Modrinth Edition) and Xaero's Minimap (Fair-Play) has been used to help complying with most server rules.

title: ForeverFantasy
description: Explore, level up, and immerse yourself in our modpack. Adventure awaits in a world filled with mystery and skill progression.
body:
# **Early Alpha Version!**
- This Modpack is still being play-tested.
# Why this modpack?
In my quest for the perfect Minecraft experience, I've been on the lookout for a modpack that just gets it—something that captures the heart and soul of what I've always wanted this game to be.

Most of what I stumbled upon, though? Well, it was either a hot mess of half-baked ideas with mods that left me scratching my head, or it was so jam-packed with stuff that it lost that simple, pure Minecraft essence.

But hey, here’s the modpack I've put together. It’s not trying to be all fancy with crazy tech stuff; it's just about good ol' adventure, gathering what you need, some decent fights, and exploring like it's a laid-back RPG MMO.

Imagine wandering through this chill Minecraft world, where every day is a new little adventure. No crazy machines, just you and the blocks. The mobs? They're there, but not in a way that makes you want to tear your hair out. It’s more like a gentle nudge to keep you on your toes.

This modpack is like your favorite comfy sweater—simple, reliable, and perfect for those lazy afternoons of mining and exploring. No need for overthinking; just dive in, swing your sword, grab some resources, and see where the day takes you.

So, if you're tired of the modding madness and just want to kick back with Minecraft the way it was meant to be, this one's for you. It might not be the flashiest modpack out there, but it’s got that cozy, familiar feeling that I've been craving for a long, long time..

title: The Sploog SMP Modpack
description: The official Sploog SMP Modpack, by Vexipoo, gabefletch, and ETH.
body: ## The Sploog SMP Modpack Welcome to the official Modrinth page for The Sploog SMP Modpack (or TSSMPMP). While this is modpack is intended for use on the upcoming Sploog SMP server, we feel like we've created a very nice multiplayer Minecraft experience so it's available here on Modrinth for anyone to use. - Please note that his modpack has been archived and is not being actively maintained anymore. The ONLY version of Minecraft supported is 1.19.2. ## Mod List When TSSMPMP was still being worked on, a Moddermore link would be available for viewing here. You can still view mods for a specific version of TSSMPMP by selecting "View All" at the top of the version list and then scrolling to "Dependencies." ## Supported Modloaders ### Fabric (Recommended) Fabric is the modloader of choice for actively compiling TSSMPMP, testing mod inter-compatability, and etc. If unsure on what modloader to use, then Fabric is the best choice for running TSSMPMP. - With Fabric, TSSMPMP can be ran right out of the box with what's included in the download. ### Quilt (Requires Extra Setup) Those who wish to use Quilt instead of Fabric may do so since Quilt is fully backwards-compatible with Fabric mods using the [Quilted Fabric API.](https://modrinth.com/mod/qsl) - Running TSSMPMP with Quilt requires the use of [Quilted Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/qsl) and may require other dependency and/or compatibility layer mods than if you were to simply use Fabric. - The TSSMPMP team has not tested Quilt support and therefore cannot give accurate information on what extra mods would be required. - Quilt support will be fully implemented in the future since some mod developers of mods included in TSSMPMP are deciding to stop releasing versions for Fabric and fully transition to Quilt. - We fully support any reason behind switching from Fabric to Quilt, but using Fabric is currently the easiest way to play with TSSMPMP. ### Forge (Not Supported) We have no plans to ever support the Forge modloader. - Fabric mods have an entirely different architecture than Forge mods and cannot easily be ported. - Even if Fabric mods worked in Forge, we would not officially support Forge as we believe it is both a technologically and ideologically inferior software than Fabric or Quilt. ## Created by ### Vivibee - Project Head - Server Owner ### GabeFletch - File Maintainer - Modrinth Listing - GitHub Repository - Issue Tracking ### ETH - Play Tester

title: Custom Cartesians
description: View and Customise Critical Ingame Information!
body:
# Custom Cartesians



## About The Custom Cartesians Mod is a client-side only Minecraft Mod that allows you to view and customise critical in-game information. It adds an additional Coordinate Display HUD which can be customised to only display a specific coordinate axis. This can be useful in protecting ingame locations that are being shared publicly.  This HUD is non invasive to the vanilla F3 Debug screen and will hide itself when the vanilla GUI is used. The HUD can also be toggled off.  ## Features - Customisable and Toggleable Coordinate HUD - Customise Coordinate display - Config file - Compatibility with Cloth Config and ModMenu  - Keybindings for easy toggling of features. Keybinding actions will also sync to the Config file   ## Installation This mod is client-side only. Do not install this on dedicated servers. ## Dependencies - Fabric API (Required) - Cloth Config API (Required, Preinstalled in this mod) - Mod Menu API (Optional, install if you like an Ingame Config GUI) ## Usage ### Using the Config options 1. Open the Configuration File. This can be done via minecraft/config/customcartesians/client.toml or the Mods -> Custom Cartesians -> Configure Button if you have Mod Menu Installed. 2. Set the configuration option "toggleOverlay" to True. 3. Click "Save" in the File Editor program if you have opened the client.toml file. If you are using Mod Menu, click the "Save and Quit" button.  ### Using the Keybinds There are a number of keybinds provided by the mod which allow you to configure the mod easily. To toggle specific Coordinate displays, hold down the "Mod Base Setting" Keybind then press on the corresponding Keybind for the Coordinate. For example, to toggle the Y Coordinate, use "Left ALT + H" (By default)   ## Screenshots The Config GUI that is generated when Mod Menu is installed alongside this mod.

The HUD with only the Y coordinate shown

## Terms of Use General/distribution/mod packs: You are free to use this mod for personal use. You may use it for non-commercial public use as well, as long as you link back to this thread or CurseForge page and use official download links. If you wish to put this mod in a modpack that is redistributed commercially, please contact the owner about it so we can discuss this further. ### Modpacks You can use this mod in your modpack. You don’t have to ask for permission as long as you credit the author. You may not reupload this mod on other platforms. ### Licensing This project is licensed under GNU Public v3. More information about this license can be found in the License.MD file within the Github repository. You may NOT redistribute this mod by itself in a way that allows you to earn money off of it. These terms can be subject to change.   ## Issues Please report any issues to the issue tracker linked at the top of this page. ## Compatibility This mod will be available for Forge in the future as well. ## Planned Features - Ability to move the HUD to different screen positions - Provide more information on the HUD if needed. ## Credits Treblero, for the original idea

title: ShowerCore
description: The official extension for Hot-bath Mod! Adds functional shower heads with customizable cores, reskinable bathtubs, AOE conduit buffs, and floating rubber ducks.
body:
# ShowerCore

Welcome to **ShowerCore**! Tired of smelling like a zombie after a long mining trip? Want to gain superpowers just by standing under some water? This mod turns your boring hygiene routine into a magical, buff-granting experience.

> ⚠️ **Dependency:** This mod **requires** [HotBath](https://modrinth.com) to work properly. HotBath provides the basic bath fluids used in this mod.

---

## Features

### Showers
The heart of your bathroom. It's not just for looks; it's for power.
* **Install Core:** Right-click a Shower Head with a Shower Core (Item).
* **Swap Core:** Right-click with a different core. The old one pops out.
* **Remove Core:** Sneak + Right-click with an empty hand to remove the core.
* **Toggle:** Right-click to turn it on or off.
* **Effect:** Stand under the running water to get continuous buffs. Effects stack up over time when standing continuously.

| Core Type | Effects (10s refresh) | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hot Water** | Speed II | Basic speed boost |
| **Milk** | Regeneration II + Removes negative effects | Cleanses all negative status effects + Saturation every 15s |
| **Herbal** | Regeneration II + Resistance II + Removes negative effects | Damages undead entities (1 HP every 2s) |
| **Peony** | Regeneration II + Luck II + Haste II + Removes Bad Omen/Debuffs | Triple buff combo |
| **Honey** | Regeneration II + Absorption IV | Saturation every 4s, provides extra golden hearts |
| **Rose** | Regeneration II + Strength II + Removes Bad Omen/Debuffs | Combat-focused buffs |

### Cores
Placing a Shower Core down as a block acts like a **Conduit** with area-of-effect (AOE) buffs.
* **Activation:** Requires specific frame blocks placed around them to activate.

| Core Block | Buffs Granted (13s duration) | Activation Frame Blocks |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hot Water** | Speed II | Prismarine, Prismarine Bricks |
| **Milk** | Saturation II | Quartz Blocks (All types) |
| **Herbal** | Regeneration II | Moss, Vines, Leaves |
| **Peony** | Luck II | Pink Wool / Concrete / Terracotta |
| **Honey** | Absorption II | Honeycomb Block, Honey Block |
| **Rose** | Strength II | Red Wool / Concrete / Terracotta |

### Bathtubs
For when standing is just too much effort.
* **Fill up:** Right-click with a water/lava bucket, or HotBath fluids for magical effects! Hot fluids produce visible steam particles.
* **Faucet:** Sneak + Right-click the faucet part for a fun visual *whoosh* water effect.
* **Sit down:** Right-click the head or foot of the tub to relax.
* **Shared Bath:** Right-click an occupied tub to request to join. The player inside clicks `[Accept]` or `[Reject]` in chat (or use `/showercore accept_bath/deny_bath`). Players must be within 5 blocks.
* **Reskinning:** Hold **6x identical blocks** in your main hand and right-click the tub to change its texture. Survival consumes 6 blocks (only if changed), Creative is free. Works with most vanilla and modded blocks seamlessly.

### Ducks
The true boss of this mod: The **Rubber Duck**.
* **Physics:** Floats and bobs in water!
* **Interact:** Right-click to make it spin.
* **Pickup:** Sneak + Right-click to take your buddy back into your inventory.
* **Warning:** Do NOT throw it in lava. It will scream. You will feel bad.

---

## Technical

### Configuration
Tweak the mod via configuration files:
* **Activation Blocks:** Change which blocks activate the Core Blocks.
* **Steam Fluids:** Define which extra modded fluids or lava make the tub steam.
* **Duck Destroyers:** Choose which fluids are lethal to your rubber duck.
* **Visuals:** Toggle translucent particles for a mistier look.

### Incompatibilities
* **Chunk Animator:** Messes with block rendering. Causes limitations:
  * Custom fluids from *other* mods cannot be poured into the bathtub (HotBath fluids still work fine).
  * The "Duck Destroyers" config breaks, making ducks immortal in dangerous fluids.

---

## Crafting

### Items
| Result | Center | Sides (Cross Shape) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Herbal Bath Core** | Conduit | `hotbath:bath_herb` |
| **Honey Bath Core** | Conduit | Honeycomb |
| **Hot Water Core** | Conduit | Magma Cream |
| **Milk Bath Core** | Conduit | Milk Bucket |
| **Peony Bath Core** | Conduit | Peony |
| **Rose Bath Core** | Conduit | Rose Bush |

### Blocks
* **Bathtub:** U-shape layout using any wood Planks (e.g., Jungle Planks) or Stone + 1x Iron Nugget in the top right slot.
* **Shower Head:** Bucket (Top-Middle) + Stick (Middle-Left) + Planks (Middle-Right).
* **Rubber Duck:** Yellow Dye (Top & Bottom rows) + Red Dye (Middle-Left) + Slime Ball (Center) + Yellow Dye (Middle-Right).

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RHX0R3/RHSignItem/refs/heads/main/rhsignitem_paper.png)
With RHSignItem you are able to add a signature to an item of your choice.

![https://img.shields.io/bstats/servers/11372?color=green?label=Servers](https://img.shields.io/bstats/servers/11372?color=green?label=Servers) ![https://img.shields.io/bstats/players/11372?color=green?label=Players](https://img.shields.io/bstats/players/11372?color=green?label=Players) [![https://img.shields.io/discord/422802721280622594?color=%237289da%20&label=Discord&logo=Discord&logoColor=white](https://img.shields.io/discord/422802721280622594?color=%237289da%20&label=Discord&logo=Discord&logoColor=white)](https://raidersheaven.eu/discord) Made with love in Germany 🇩🇪
# Features ## Commands ### /sign With this command you can sign an item instantly. The lore will be determined by the content under `SHORT` inside of the `config.yml`.

Here is a list of all arguments for `/sign`: * `/sign help` → will show you a list of all commands. * `/sign ` → creates a signature with a custom text, depending on the `DEFAULT` content * `/sign delete` → removes an applied signature * `/sign lock` → will lock an item to prevent adding a signature with `/sign` or `/sign ` * `/sign unlock` → will free an item from it's locked state and allows signatures again * `/sign version` → shows you some version information **Example:** ``` /sign That item is so awesome and rare,
that every player wants to own. ``` ### /rename With the command `/rename ` you can change an items displayname. It uses color formats and placeholders here too!

**Example:** ``` /rename This is a cool item name! ``` ## Formatting All messages within the configuration and language files support **MiniMessage**. To learn how to use it, please visit the [Adventure](https://docs.advntr.dev/minimessage/format.html) website.

I highly recommend using the **MiniMessage** format, as it is also the current best practice for all users of Paper and it's derivatives. Legacy formats such as `&` or `&#rrggbb` will *kinda work* too, but are **not** recommended!

You can also use all placeholders from the **PlaceholderAPI** and it's expansions! ## Language Files **RHSignItem** ships with some default language files: German, English and Russian. You can change these as you desire. But you can also create a new file and integrate it. In this case, make sure to properly set the `locale` to the files name in the config. ## Auto-Locking In order to make the signing process as easy as possible, you can enable the `auto-lock` setting. After that, every new signature will automatically set the locked state onto the item.

If you want to specify that feature, while only allowing players with the correct permission to do that, activate it through the `permission-based` setting. Players will need the `rhsignitem.command.sign.lock.auto` permission. ## Optional Offhand Requirements With the `offhand-item-mode` setting you can choose, if the player needs to hold an item in his offhand in order to create a signature with `/sign` or `/sign `.

`type` determines the item that is needed.

Also you can choose, if the item should be used. * durability -1 * amount -1 ## Item Blacklist As a server owner or administrator, you probably don't want all items to be allowed for signatures. **RHSignItem** comes with a blacklist feature, that can easily be configured and extented. ## Vault integration If you want to make the commands only usable through a payment, just toggle it's setting inside the `config.yml` file! You can set a fixed price for executing any command, toggle each command and choose, which ones should be set behind a paywall. Also you can toggle messages when using the payment system. # What does it look like in-game? [![https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RHX0R3/RHSignItem/refs/heads/main/rhsignitem_paper_preview.jpg](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RHX0R3/RHSignItem/refs/heads/main/rhsignitem_paper_preview.jpg)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RHX0R3/RHSignItem/refs/heads/main/rhsignitem_paper_preview.jpg) # Permissions The plugin requires a player to have the respective permissions listed below: * `rhsignitem.*` → grants access to **all** plugin commands * `rhsignitem.admin` → grants an override status to *delete* and *unlock* (for administrative purposes) * `rhsignitem.command.sign` → `/sign` and `/sign help` * `rhsignitem.command.sign.sign` → `/sign ` * `rhsignitem.command.sign.delete` → `/sign delete` * `rhsignitem.command.sign.lock` → `/sign lock` * `rhsignitem.command.sign.lock.auto` → for **auto-lock** with permission based command handling * `rhsignitem.command.sign.unlock` → `/sign unlock` * `rhsignitem.command.sign.version` → `/sign version` * `rhsignitem.command.rename` → `/rename ` # Support If you need help with **RHSignItem**, you can join the [RaidersHeaven server](https://raidersheaven.eu/discord/) on Discord. Just post inside the [#rhsignitem-paper-plugin](https://discord.com/channels/422802721280622594/931212109293977640) channel.

Since support is provided exclusively by me, there may be delays and longer response times as I cannot read all messages immediately or only at certain times of the day. Thank you for your understanding! # Metrics collection **RHSignItem** collects anonymous server statistics through [bStats](https://bstats.org/plugin/bukkit/RHSignItem/11372), an open-source statistics service for Minecraft software. You can opt out in ` plugins/bStats/config.yml ` at anytime. ![](https://bstats.org/signatures/bukkit/RHSignItem.svg)

title: Excavate
description: Area mining enchantment for all tools | 3x3 | 5x5
body:
# Excavate

Area mining enchantment for NeoForge 1.21.1.

![Mod preview, Excavation II](https://github.com/TophC7/Excavate/raw/main/public/preview.webp)

**Excavation I** affects a 3x3 area.
**Excavation II** affects a 5x5 area.
Crouch to use single-block interactions.

## How it works

- Enchant any pickaxe, axe, shovel, or hoe
- Mine a block and the surrounding area breaks as well
- Hoe tilling, shovel pathing, and axe stripping also affect the surrounding area
- Each block drops its own correct loot
- Only blocks your tool can actually mine are affected
- Tool takes durability per block broken and stops if it breaks
- Unbreakable blocks (bedrock, etc.) are never affected

### Crop harvesting

Hoes with Excavation harvest mature crops in an area. Auto-replant is
enabled by default and one seed is consumed from each crop's drops to replant it.
If no seed drops, that crop is left empty. You can toggle auto-replant in the config screen.

## Configuration

Open the config screen from the Mods menu. Settings:

| Setting              | Scope  | Default | Description                                                  |
| -------------------- | ------ | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Show Highlight       | Client | On      | Show the area outline preview                                |
| Auto-Replant         | Common | On      | Replant crops automatically when area-harvesting             |
| Area Hoe Tilling     | Common | On      | Let hoes till dirtlike blocks in an area                     |
| Area Shovel Pathing  | Common | On      | Let shovels create dirt paths in an area                     |
| Area Axe Actions     | Common | On      | Let axes strip logs and apply other right-click axe actions in an area |

## Getting the enchantment

- **Enchanting table** - rare (same weight as Fortune)
- **Villager trades** - available from librarians
- **Commands** - `/enchant @s excavate:excavation 2`

## Compatibility

- Works with any modded tool that uses vanilla tool tags
- Supports [Enchantment Descriptions](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/enchantment-descriptions) for in-game tooltip text
- Requires NeoForge 21.1.219+

## License

GPL-3.0-or-later

title: Item Coating
description: A mod that allows applying potion effects to weapons, tools, and armor. Effects trigger on attack, block break, or when taking damage.
body:
# Item Coating

A mod that allows applying potion effects to weapons, tools, and armor. Effects trigger on attack, block break, or when taking damage.

## Key Features

- **Apply Coatings**: Craft item + potion OR grab potion and right-click item in inventory
- **Remove Coatings**: Grab milk bucket and right-click item to remove all coatings
- **Three Item Types**: Weapons (apply on attack), Tools (apply on block break with Inversion), Armor (apply when taking damage)
- **Two Effect Types**: Time-based (expire by timer) or Hit-based (expire after N hits for instant effects ≤1s)
- **Extend Effects**: Reapply same effect to extend (time-based: full/1/4 duration, hit-based: +1 hit)
- **Loot Coatings**: 8% chance for items in loot chests to spawn with coatings (1% chance for Coating Curse instead)
- **[Better Combat](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-combat) Support**: Works with dual wield and offhand attacks

## Enchantments

| Enchantment | Max Level | Effect |
|-------------|-----------|--------|
| **Coating Capacity** | III | +1 coating slot per level (base 1, max 4) |
| **Coating Preservation** | V | Extends duration: +5s + 20% × 2 × level (time) or +1 + 2 × level hits |
| **Coating Potency** | III | +1 effect level per enchantment level |
| **Coating Curse** | I | Prevents applying coatings (curse) |
| **Curse of Inversion** | I | Inverts effect application (extremely rare treasure) |
| **Curse of Permanence** | I | Makes coatings infinite and unremovable (extremely rare treasure) |

## Item Types

### Weapons
- **Trigger**: On attack
- **Target**: Enemy receives effect
- **With Inversion**: Wielder receives effect

### Tools
- **Trigger**: On block break (requires Inversion curse)
- **Target**: Player receives effect (only with Inversion)
- **Without Inversion**: No effect (blocks can't receive effects)
- **Note**: Axes are treated as weapons, not tools

### Armor
- **Trigger**: When taking damage
- **Target**: Attacker receives effect
- **With Inversion**: Wearer receives effect
- **Full Set Mode**: Optional config to require all 4 pieces with same effect

## Curses

### Curse of Inversion
- **Effect**: Inverts who receives the coating effect
  - Weapons: Effects apply to wielder instead of target
  - Tools: Effects apply to player when breaking blocks
  - Armor: Effects apply to wearer instead of attacker
- **Rarity**: Extremely rare (1% of normal curse chance)

### Curse of Permanence
- **Effect**: Coatings become infinite and cannot be removed
  - Coatings never expire (no duration/hit countdown)
  - Milk bucket cannot remove coatings
  - Can still add new coatings if capacity allows
- **Rarity**: Extremely rare (1% of normal curse chance)

## Visual Effects

- **Particles**: Colored particles around coated items (configurable)
- **Tooltip**: Real-time timer/hit counter, effect icons, Shift for descriptions

## How It Works

### Applying Coatings

1. **Crafting**: Item + potion(s) → coated item + empty bottles
2. **Quick Apply**: Grab potion → right-click item → instant coating
3. **Works in any inventory**: Player, chest, shulker box, etc.

### Mechanics

- **Time-based** (>1s potions): Shows "Poison II (1:23)", expires by timer
- **Hit-based** (≤1s potions): Shows "Strength II (3 hits)", expires per use
- **On Trigger**: 
  - Weapons: Applies effect for 3s (time) or 1s (hit) on attack
  - Tools: Applies effect for 1s (time) or 1s (hit) on block break (with Inversion)
  - Armor: Applies effect for 3s (time) or 1s (hit) when taking damage
- **Extension**: 
  - Time-based: Same level = full duration, different level = 1/4 duration
  - Hit-based: +1 hit per potion (regardless of level)

### Armor Full Set Mode

Optional config setting `armorCoating.requireFullSet`:
- **Disabled (default)**: Each armor piece works independently
- **Enabled**: Effects only apply if all 4 pieces have the same effect

## Configuration

Fully customizable via `config/itemcoating/itemcoating.toml`:

<details>
<summary>Loot Settings</summary>

```toml
[loot]
coatingChance = 0.08  # 8% chance for coating/curse
curseChance = 0.01    # 1% chance for curse instead of coating
minAmplifier = 0
maxAmplifier = 1
effectBlacklist = ["minecraft:bad_omen"]
```
</details>

<details>
<summary>Weapon Coating Settings</summary>

```toml
[coating]
effectBlacklist = ["minecraft:bad_omen"]
weaponBlacklist = []
appliedEffectDurationHitBased = 1.0  # seconds
appliedEffectDurationTimeBased = 3.0  # seconds
```
</details>

<details>
<summary>Tool Coating Settings</summary>

```toml
[toolCoating]
enabled = true
applyOnBlockBreak = true
effectBlacklist = ["minecraft:bad_omen"]
toolBlacklist = []
appliedEffectDurationHitBased = 1.0  # seconds
appliedEffectDurationTimeBased = 3.0  # seconds
```
</details>

<details>
<summary>Armor Coating Settings</summary>

```toml
[armorCoating]
requireFullSet = false
effectBlacklist = ["minecraft:bad_omen"]
armorBlacklist = []
appliedEffectDurationHitBased = 1.0  # seconds
appliedEffectDurationTimeBased = 3.0  # seconds
```
</details>

<details>
<summary>Particle Settings</summary>

```toml
[particles]
enable = true
interval = 8  # ticks between particles
spread = 0.2
velocity = 0.01
showInOffhand = true
cycleColors = true
```
</details>

<details>
<summary>Enchantment Settings</summary>

```toml
[enchantments.capacity]
enabled = true
maxLevel = 3
slotsFormula = "1 + {level}"
minPower = 1
maxPower = 51
availableInBooks = true
availableInTable = true

[enchantments.inversion]
enabled = true
minPower = 80
maxPower = 100
availableInBooks = false
availableInTable = false
lootChanceMultiplier = 0.01  # 100x rarer

[enchantments.permanence]
enabled = true
minPower = 80
maxPower = 100
availableInBooks = false
availableInTable = false
lootChanceMultiplier = 0.01  # 100x rarer
effectBlacklist = ["minecraft:instant_health", "minecraft:instant_damage"]
```
</details>

## In-Game Configuration

- **Fabric**: Access via Mod Menu
- **Forge**: Access via mod configuration menu
- Edit all settings without restarting the game
- Requires [Fzzy Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/fzzy-config) (included as dependency)

## Compatibility

- **Minecraft**: 1.20.1
- **Architectury**: Cross-platform (Fabric & Forge)
- **Better Combat**: Full dual wield and offhand support
- **Works with**: Any mod using standard Minecraft potion effects

## Related Mods

- **[Effectification](https://modrinth.com/mod/effectification)** – Unifies similar status effects from different mods

## Alternative Implementations

If you're looking for similar functionality, check out:
- **[Coated Blades](https://modrinth.com/datapack/coated-blades)** – A datapack/mod for Minecraft 1.21+ with comparable coating mechanics~~~~

## License

This mod is licensed under MIT License.

- New herbs
- Decorative blocks
- Storage blocks
- Brewing system
- New alchemy system

- Add latice block.
- Improve ironwood, olive and apple trees.
- Improve compatibily with other mods.
- World generation options.

title: Cobblemon: Glimmering Sculk
description: Obtain Sculk from Glimmet and Glimmora
body:
# Sculk Drops for Cobbleverse

## Summary
Datapack designed for **Cobbleverse** (Peaceful Mode). Assigns the **Sculk** drop to **Glimmora**, a Pokémon whose mineral biology and alien floral appearance visually resemble Sculk Catalysts and Sensors.

## Changes
- **Pokémon**:
  - `Glimmet` (Pre-evolution): Drops **1-3** blocks.
  - `Glimmora` (Evolution): Drops **4-8** blocks.
  - *Visual Reason*: Glimmora looks like a crystalline mineral flower, which fits perfectly with the "organic/mineral growth" aesthetic of Sculk (Catalysts and Shriekers). Its dark and poisonous colors resonate with the Deep Dark theme.
- **Item**: `minecraft:sculk`.

## Balancing and Farm (Pasture Loot)
- **Rarity**: Glimmora/Glimmet are rare spawns in caves, maintaining the block's prestige.
- **Progression**: Evolution is rewarded by significantly increasing the farm's yield (more than double).
- **Production**:
  - In a Pasture Loot farm with **16 Glimmoras**, approximately 96 blocks (1.5 stacks) are generated per cycle.
  - This allows building with Sculk in peaceful mode without breaking the economy.

## Installation
1. Place in the `datapacks` folder (`.minecraft/saves/<World>/datapacks/`).
2. Restart the world (Do not use `/reload`).

title: Mellow
description: This mod is for QuestCraft, it automatically reduces the initial render distance - then slowly ramps back up again over a short period of time.
body:
Mellow is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod that smoothly lowers render distance during loading and gradually increases it after joining a world. By starting at 2 chunks and ramping up to 6 chunks over time, Mellow reduces initial lag and stuttering while keeping exploration smooth and responsive.

It's designed to reduce the initial memory and performance demand on QuestCraft as the client loads into a server.

**Automatic role management**: Assign roles when accounts are linked - **Online status roles**: Grant roles to players currently connected to the server - **Slash commands**: Modern Discord slash command interface - **Full customization**: Configure all bot behaviors in the config file ![Link](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2RbnHQFK/images/3e82a79f56f8b736397e63e01eaa083cec4368f7.png) ![ExampleBot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2RbnHQFK/images/99c4568b4671cbbabd81b8db0b0caf324e8bd6c1.png) ### Advanced Logging - **Connection logs**: Track player joins with IP, UUID, username, and timestamp - **Disconnection logs**: Monitor when players leave the server - **Link events**: Log all account linking activities - **Unlink events**: Track account unlinking operations - **Custom embeds**: Fully customizable Discord embed colors and formatting ![Logs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2RbnHQFK/images/1337cd53a6fd0b333833376f44cb76f7db1a735b_350.webp) ### Player Management - **In-game commands**: `/link`, `/unlink`, `/linkinfo` for players - **Admin commands**: `/forceunlink`, `/discordlink reload` for administrators - **Database storage**: SQLite database for reliable data persistence - **Auto-cleanup**: Expired codes are automatically removed --- ## Commands & Permissions ### Player Commands | Command | Description | Permission | |---------|-------------|------------| | `/link` | Generate a linking code | Default | | `/unlink` | Unlink your Discord account | `discordlink.unlink` | | `/linkinfo [player]` | View linking information | `discordlink.info` | ### Admin Commands | Command | Description | Permission | |---------|-------------|------------| | `/forceunlink ` | Force unlink a player's account | `discordlink.admin` | | `/discordlink reload` | Reload plugin configuration | `discordlink.admin` | ### Aliases - `/dl` → `/discordlink` --- ## How It Works ### For New Players 1. Player attempts to connect to the server 2. If not linked, they are kicked with a unique code displayed 3. Player joins your Discord server 4. Player uses `/link code:XXXXXX` on Discord 5. Account is linked and player can now join the server 6. Configured roles are automatically assigned ### For Linked Players 1. Player connects to the server normally 2. "Online" role is automatically added on Discord 3. "Online" role is removed when player disconnects 4. Player keeps their "Linked" role permanently ### Role System - **Linked Role**: Given when account is successfully linked (permanent) - **Online Role**: Given when player is connected to the server (temporary) - **Automatic management**: All roles are handled automatically by the bot --- ## Configuration The plugin is fully configurable through `config.yml`: ### Discord Settings - Bot token configuration - Guild (server) ID - Enable/disable bot features ### Role Management - Configure linked account role ID - Configure online player role ID - Toggle automatic role assignment - Control role removal on disconnect ### Logging System - Enable/disable specific log types - Configure log channel ID - Customize embed colors (join, quit, link, unlink) - Toggle individual log events ### Link Requirements - Enable/disable mandatory linking - Customize kick message with code display - Configure bypass list (players/UUIDs) - Bypass permission support ### Link Command Settings - Code expiration time (default: 5 minutes) - Code length (default: 6 characters) - Custom messages and formatting ### Messages - Fully customizable plugin messages - Color code support - Configurable prefix - Multi-language friendly --- ## Setup Guide ### Prerequisites - A Discord bot (create one at https://discord.com/developers/applications) - Bot token - Server (Guild) ID - Role IDs for linked/online roles - Channel ID for logs ### Discord Bot Setup 1. Create a bot on Discord Developer Portal 2. Enable these **Privileged Gateway Intents**: - Server Members Intent - Message Content Intent 3. Invite the bot to your Discord server with these permissions: - Manage Roles - Send Messages - Embed Links 4. Copy your bot token ### Plugin Installation 1. Download DiscordLink and place it in your `plugins/` folder 2. Start your server to generate the config file 3. Stop your server and edit `plugins/DiscordLink/config.yml` 4. Fill in your Discord bot token, guild ID, role IDs, and channel ID 5. Configure your desired settings 6. Start your server ### Getting IDs - **Guild ID**: Enable Developer Mode in Discord, right-click your server → Copy Server ID - **Role IDs**: Right-click a role → Copy Role ID - **Channel ID**: Right-click a channel → Copy Channel ID --- ## Database DiscordLink uses **SQLite** for data storage: - No external database server required - Automatic database creation and management - Stores player UUIDs, usernames, Discord IDs, and link timestamps - File location: `plugins/DiscordLink/links.db` --- ## Use Cases ### Community Servers - Verify players are part of your Discord community - Easy player identification between platforms - Enhanced moderation capabilities ### Whitelisted Servers - Replace traditional whitelist with Discord linking - Automatic access control - Easy member management ### Network Servers - Unified account system across multiple servers - Share linked accounts via shared database (future feature) - Centralized player management ### Event Servers - Require Discord linking for special events - Track attendance via Discord roles - Enhanced communication with participants --- ## Requirements - **Minecraft**: 1.21.4+ (Paper/Purpur) - **Java**: 21+ - **Dependencies**: None (JDA included) --- ## Support Found a bug? Have a suggestion? - Open an issue on GitHub - Join our Discord community - Star the project if you find it useful ---
**Made for the Minecraft community** *Connecting players across platforms*

title: PVPMode
description: Allow players to manage their pvp mode
body:
# Introduction  
Simple plugin to manage your pvp mode(peace,default,insane).  
**Peace mode**: You can't attack and no one will damage you.  
**Default mode**: Default. You can attack and will take damage.  
**Insane mode**: More damage to self and other player.  
You can set the price and timer when change to insane mode  
In-game menu supports! (From v1.7)  
Optional dependent plugins:  
1. Vault  
2. PlaceholderAPI  
PlaceholderAPI: %pvpmode_mode% Show your mode  

# Image
![cmd](https://s2.loli.net/2022/05/28/Mid8V1P2ZzWNHqv.png)  
![message](https://s2.loli.net/2022/05/28/ZRkJ3Mniob2TPA1.png)  

# Commands
aliase: pvp  
/PVPMode Open the menu.  
/PVPMode help View help.  
/PVPMode info <player> Check your or player's mode.  
/PVPMode <0/1/2/peace/default/insane> switch mode.  
/PVPMode <0/1/2/peace/default/insane> <player> switch player's mode.  
/PVPMode create <world> <mode> Create a world to lock the mode.  
/PVPMode remove <world> Remove the world.  
/PVPMode mode <world> <mode> Set the world's mode.  
/PVPMode reload Reload the config.  
0 = peace, 1 = default, 2 = insane  

# Permissions
pvpmode.admin Admin commands  
pvpmode.insane To use /pvp 2 or /pvp insane  

# Usage
Put PVPMode.jar into your server's plugins folder.  
If you want to use Vault and PlaceholderAPI functions. Also put them inside. (Optional)

title: RealPermissions
description: GUI Permission Management made easy.
body:
# RealPermissions Plugin

Welcome to the **RealPermissions** plugin page!  
RealPermissions is a brand-new GUI-based permissions management plugin.

## Statistics  
[Plugin Statistics on bStats](https://bstats.org/plugin/bukkit/RealPermissions/19519)

## Found an Issue?  
Report it [here](https://github.com/joserodpt/RealPermissions/issues) or message me on Discord.  

**Discord:** [Join the Discord Server](https://discord.gg/SK7M7f2Yk)

## Features  
- **Integration with RealScoreboard, RealMines, RealRegions, and RealSkywars!**  
- **Integration with Plugin Permissions** installed on the server.  
- **YAML Configuration** for easy setup and customization.  
- **Simple and Performant GUI Interface** for intuitive management.  
- **Powerful Command Syntax** for advanced control.  
- **Timed Rank Support** for temporary rank assignments.  
- **Permission Inheritance Support** for streamlined management.  
- **Tab and Chat Customization** per rank.  
- **Rankup Command** for smooth rank progression.  
- **Plugin Settings via GUI** for easy configuration.

## Commands & Permissions  

All main plugin commands require the `realpermissions.admin` permission.  

### Command List

1. **Default Command**
   - **Command:** `/realpermissions` or `/rp`  
   - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
   - **Description:** Opens the RealPermissions GUI for managing permissions and ranks. If used by the console, displays plugin information.

2. **Reload Command**
   - **Command:** `/realpermissions reload` or `/rp rl`  
   - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
   - **Description:** Reloads configuration files, including language settings, ranks, and player data.

3. **Rank Command**
   - **Command:** `/realpermissions rank <rank>` or `/rp r <rank>`  
   - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
   - **Description:** Opens the Rank GUI for the specified rank to manage permissions and members.

4. **Players Command**
   - **Command:** `/realpermissions players` or `/rp p`  
   - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
   - **Description:** Opens the Players GUI to manage player-specific permissions and ranks.

5. **Ranks Command**
   - **Command:** `/realpermissions ranks`  
   - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
   - **Description:** Lists all available ranks with their prefixes or opens the RankViewer GUI for players.

6. **Set Superuser Command**
   - **Command:** `/realpermissions setsuper <player>` or `/rp setsu <player>`  
   - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
   - **Description:** Toggles superuser status for the specified player.

7. **Set Rank Command**
   - **Command:** `/realpermissions set <player> <rank>` or `/rp s <player> <rank>`  
   - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
   - **Description:** Assigns the specified rank to a player.

8. **Set Timed Rank Command**
   - **Command:** `/realpermissions settimedrank <player> <rank> <duration>` or `/rp str`  
   - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
   - **Description:** Assigns a timed rank to a player for the specified duration in seconds.

9. **Clear Timed Rank Command**
   - **Command:** `/realpermissions cleartimedrank <player>` or `/rp ctr`  
   - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
   - **Description:** Clears the timed rank for the specified player.

10. **Rename Rank Command**
    - **Command:** `/realpermissions rename <rank> <new name>` or `/rp ren`  
    - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
    - **Description:** Renames the specified rank to a new name.

11. **Delete Rank Command**
    - **Command:** `/realpermissions delete <rank>` or `/rp del <rank>`  
    - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
    - **Description:** Deletes the specified rank, except for the default rank.

12. **Manage Rank Permissions Command**
    - **Command:** `/realpermissions permission <add/remove> <rank> <permission>` or `/rp perm`  
    - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
    - **Description:** Adds or removes a permission node from a rank.

13. **Manage Player Permissions Command**
    - **Command:** `/realpermissions playerperm <add/remove> <player> <permission>` or `/rp pperm`  
    - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
    - **Description:** Adds or removes a permission node for a specific player.

## PlaceholderAPI Placeholders  

- **%realpermissions_rank_name%** – Returns the player's rank name.  
- **%realpermissions_rank_prefix%** – Returns the player's rank prefix.  
- **%realpermissions_rank_permission_count%** – Returns the number of permissions assigned to the rank.  
- **%realpermissions_timed_rank_time_left%** – Returns the remaining time for the player's timed rank.  
- **%realpermissions_player_permission_count%** – Returns the total permissions count for the player.

## Support  
If you encounter any issues, contact me via DM on Here or join the Discord server.

## Like the Plugin?  
Don't forget to give it a **heart**!

title: BlockRevive
description: A LightPaper weight plugin to regenerate any blocks in any region you make.
body:
# **BlockRevive** - Advanced Block Regeneration Plugin

BlockRevive is a powerful and feature-rich Minecraft plugin for Paper servers that enables automatic block regeneration in designated regions. Perfect for mining servers, resource worlds, and custom game modes where you want blocks to respawn after being mined.

**Supported Versions:**
The recommended versions are currently 1.21 to 1.21.10,
Other Minecraft versions may work, but they haven't been tested.

## 🌟 Key Features
- **Region-Based Regeneration System** - Define custom 3D regions where blocks automatically regenerate after being broken
- **Full Nexo Integration** - Complete support for Nexo custom blocks with proper ID detection and regeneration
- **WorldEdit Schematic Support** - Paste schematics and automatically create regeneration regions
- **Visual Selection Tool** - Easy-to-use enchanted blaze rod wand for selecting regions (left/right click to set positions)
- **Particle Boundaries** - Visualize region boundaries with orange particle outlines
- **Customizable Regeneration Times** - Set different regeneration times per block type, per region, or globally
- **Centralized Holograms** - Display all regenerating blocks in a single paginated hologram per region
- **Individual Block Holograms** - Optional countdown timers above each regenerating block (toggleable)
- **Look-Based Hologram Display** - Holograms appear only when looking at regenerating blocks (reduces clutter)
- **Flexible Drop Control** - Configure whether blocks drop items and experience
- **Particle Effects** - Customizable particles for breaking, regenerating, and bedrock states
- **Sound Effects** - Optional sound notifications when blocks regenerate
- **Permission System** - Control who can bypass regeneration mechanics
- **Region Groups** - Organize multiple regions into groups for easier management
- **Per-Region Configuration** - Each region gets its own config file for granular control
- **Auto-Save System** - Automatic data saving to prevent loss on server crashes
- **Block Placement Prevention** - Optionally prevent players from placing blocks in regeneration regions
- **Full Tab Completion** - Complete command and argument auto-completion
- **Debug Mode** - Built-in toggleable debug logging for troubleshooting
- **WorldGuard Compatibility** - Works alongside WorldGuard for region protection


## 📋 Requirements
- Minecraft: 1.21+ (Paper recommended)
- Java: 21+
- Optional: Nexo (for custom block support)
- Optional: WorldEdit or FastAsyncWorldEdit (for schematic features)
- Optional: WorldGuard (for region protection compatibility)

## 🎮 Use Cases
- **Mining Servers** - Create renewable ore farms and mining worlds
- **Resource Worlds** - Allow infinite resource gathering without world regeneration
- **Custom RPG Worlds** - Renewable resource nodes for progression systems
- **Prison Servers** - Automated mine resets without manual intervention

## ⚡ Performance & Technical
- Efficient region management with optimized block tracking
- Async block regeneration to prevent server lag
- Smart caching system for block types and regeneration data
- Auto-save intervals to preserve data during crashes
- Supports unlimited regions and regenerating blocks

## 🔧 Easy Setup
- Drop the JAR into your plugins folder
- Restart the server
- Use /blockrevive wand to get the selection tool
- Select your region and use /blockrevive create <name>
- Configure block times in the region's config file
- Done! Blocks will now regenerate automatically

## 📦 Commands Overview
- Region creation and management
- Block-specific regeneration time configuration
- Schematic pasting with auto-region creation
- Region visualization and inspection
- Hologram positioning and management
- Region grouping for batch operations
- Manual save and reload functions

## 🛡️ Permissions
- blockrevive.admin - Full access to all commands and features
- blockrevive.bypass - Break blocks normally without regeneration
- blockrevive.region.<region> - Allow Player to mine in certain regions

## 📝 Version Information
- Plugin Name: BlockRevive
- Author: Turretedash7

title: EasyBuild(oceanstudio)
description: EasyBuild is a commission-driven building plugin for Minecraft servers. Create regions, contract builders, track progress, and pay rewards via Vault. Permission-protected building, admin reviews, and multilingual messages.
body:
#                          EasyBuild  (委托插件)
##                         由OceanStudio开发


## 插件简介(中文)

EasyBuild 是一个“委托建筑”管理插件，让管理员发布建筑任务，玩家在指定区域承包、施工、提交验收，并自动发放经济奖励。
支持进入/建造权限控制、合作伙伴、工期与奖励、可点击消息与GUI、可视化列表、传送与详情查看。
安装要求


依赖插件：必须安装 Vault；可选安装 XConomy（若安装则优先通过命令结算）。
经济插件：任意与 Vault 兼容的经济实现（例如 EssentialsX Economy、CMIEconomy 等），或直接使用 XConomy。
放置插件：将 easybuild-<platform>-<mcversion>.jar 放到 plugins/，重启服务。

### 快速开始

确认控制台出现“已连接到Vault经济系统”或“检测到XConomy插件”提示。
管理员用命令创建委托区域与参数。
玩家进入委托区域用命令承包并开始施工。
完工后玩家提交验收，管理员在区域内执行验收决定，系统自动发放奖励并通知相关玩家。
主要命令（玩家）

cbwt 承包委托：站在委托区域内执行，承包后状态变为“建设中”。
wtwg 提交完工：将状态设为“已完工”，等待管理员验收。
fcwt 放弃委托：释放当前承包，使其回到“未承包”。
wt 查看委托列表：可点击打开详情。
wtinfo <委托ID> 查看委托详情：显示状态、坐标、工期、奖励等，并提供传送按钮。
wttp <委托ID> 传送到委托位置：传送到区域中心的安全位置。
wtadd <玩家名> 添加合作伙伴：承包人可添加1名合作伙伴共同施工。
wtqx 权限管理菜单：在区域内打开GUI，设置进入/建造权限为“关闭/开启/自定义白名单”。
主要命令（管理员/OP，需 easybuild.admin）

wtcj <x1,y1,z1> <x2,y2,z2> <名称> <工期天数> <报酬> <描述> 创建委托区域与任务。
示例：/wtcj 100,64,200 150,100,250 小店建设 7 1000 请建造一个小商店
坐标格式为数字三元组 x,y,z，世界取执行者当前世界。
yswt <y/n> 在委托区域内验收“已完工”委托：
y 通过：弹出可点击按钮进行“确认发放奖励/修改奖金金额/设置验收成功语句”。
n 未通过：弹出可点击按钮进行“结束建设并发送原因/延期建设/设置未通过语句”。
wtset <委托名称> 管理菜单：交互式设置状态或延长工期。
wtdel <委托名字> 删除委托：直接移除指定委托。
内部按钮命令（仅通过可点击按钮触发）：confirm_review、modify_reward、terminate_commission、extend_commission、set_approval_message、set_rejection_message。
权限与区域保护

进入与建造限制仅在“建设中”状态生效；“未承包”和“已完工”不限制。
权限模式：
进入权限：OPEN 所有人；CLOSED 仅建设者（承包人+合作伙伴）；CUSTOM 建设者 + 指定白名单。
建造权限：同上模式，单独设置。
在区域内执行 wtqx 打开权限GUI，选择关闭/开启或输入白名单玩家名（支持多个，空格分隔）。
经济与验收

奖励发放采用“承包人与合作伙伴平分”（总额 ÷ 人数）。
经济结算优先使用 XConomy 命令；失败则使用 Vault API；格式化金额采用经济插件格式。
验收通过后会自动向承包人和合作伙伴发送消息；玩家上线会收到未读消息提醒。
管理员可在验收界面修改发放金额或设置验收成功/未通过的自定义语句。
数据与配置

数据目录：plugins/EasyBuild/
commissions.yml 委托数据（区域、状态、工期、奖励、权限白名单、验收消息等）。
messages.yml 玩家通知消息（加入时推送未读）。
config.yml 基础配置，包含 language。
多语言：内置 zh_CN, en_US, ru_RU, ja_JP, ko_KR，从 JAR 的 lang/messages_<lang>.yml 读取；缺失时回退 zh_CN。
修改语言：在 config.yml 设置 language: en_US 等，重启服务器生效。
常见问题

“不在任何委托区域内”：需要站在管理员创建的坐标范围内。
“已承包无法承接其他委托”：同一玩家同时仅能承包一个“建设中”委托。
“经济功能不可用”：安装并启用 Vault + 经济插件或 XConomy，检查控制台初始化日志。
“坐标格式错误”：请严格使用 x,y,z 三段数字，勿含空格与其他字符。
兼容性说明


——

## Overview

EasyBuild is a “commissioned building” plugin: admins define a build area and task, players contract it on-site, build, submit for review, and receive automatic payouts.
Includes entry/build permission control, partners, duration and rewards, clickable chat/UI, list view, teleport, and detailed info.
Requirements


Dependencies: Vault is required; XConomy is optional (used first if present).
Economy: Any Vault-compatible economy (EssentialsX Economy, CMIEconomy, etc), or XConomy.
Install: Drop easybuild-<platform>-<mcversion>.jar into plugins/, then restart.

### Quick Start

Check console for “Connected to Vault” or “Detected XConomy”.
Admin creates a commission with region and parameters.
Player enters the area, contracts, and starts building.
When done, player submits completion; admin reviews inside the region; system pays out and notifies.
Player Commands

cbwt Contract commission: run inside the area; sets status to “In Progress”.
wtwg Submit completion: moves to “Completed”, awaiting admin review.
fcwt Abandon commission: releases current contract back to “Uncontracted”.
wt List commissions: clickable entries to open details.
wtinfo <commissionId> Show details: status, coords, duration, reward; includes teleport button.
wttp <commissionId> Teleport to the commission area center safely.
wtadd <playerName> Add a partner: contractor can add up to one partner.
wtqx Permission GUI: open in-area to set entry/build modes “Closed/Open/Custom whitelist”.
Admin Commands (easybuild.admin)

wtcj <x1,y1,z1> <x2,y2,z2> <name> <days> <reward> <description>
Example: /wtcj 100,64,200 150,100,250 ShopBuild 7 1000 Build a small store
yswt <y/n> Review inside the area:
y approve: clickable actions for “confirm payout/modify reward/set approval message”.
n reject: clickable actions for “terminate with reason/extend duration/set rejection message”.
wtset <name> Management menu: interactive status change or duration extension.
wtdel <name> Delete a commission immediately.
Internal button commands: confirm_review, modify_reward, terminate_commission, extend_commission, set_approval_message, set_rejection_message.
Permissions & Protection

Entry/build restrictions apply only in “In Progress”; “Uncontracted/Completed” are unrestricted.
Modes:
Entry: OPEN everyone; CLOSED builders only; CUSTOM builders + whitelist.
Build: same modes independently.
Use wtqx inside the area to open GUI and set modes or input whitelist player names.
Economy & Review

Rewards split evenly among contractor and partner(s).
Settlement first tries XConomy commands; falls back to Vault API; amounts formatted via the economy plugin.
Approved reviews send messages to contractor/partners; unread messages display on player join.
Admin can modify payout or set custom approval/rejection messages.
Data & Configuration

Directory: plugins/EasyBuild/
commissions.yml commission data (region, status, duration, reward, permission lists, messages).
messages.yml player notifications (pushed on join).
config.yml contains language.
Languages: zh_CN, en_US, ru_RU, ja_JP, ko_KR via lang/messages_<lang>.yml inside JAR; fallback to zh_CN.
Change language in config.yml with language: en_US and restart.
FAQ

“Not in any commission area”: stand within an admin-defined region.
“Already contracted another commission”: one active “In Progress” commission per player.
“Economy not available”: install and enable Vault + economy or XConomy; check console init logs.
“Coordinate format error”: strictly use x,y,z triplets without spaces.
Compatibility

Designed for Bukkit/Spigot API platforms (Spigot/Paper/Purpur/Folia/Bukkit).
Proxy (Velocity/BungeeCord/Waterfall) and mod platforms (Forge/NeoForge/Fabric/Quilt) require separate adaptation; provided JARs there are archival builds and not fully functional today.

title: Label My Items
description: Adds item labels, which can label items
body:
# Label My Items

A basic mod that adds the Item Label and the Eraser, which are used together to manage item labels.

Item labels appear in the tooltip of an item:

![A cake item in the inventory gui, with "Labels: for joe" in the tooltip.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ddafe6c3ddbaa729eb58b5da4dd2df2081c6ed20.png)

Lukasino's Artillery (LA) adds a large long-range cannon with immersive controls.

Instead of just opening a single GUI or clicking on a block to mark it as a target, this mod uses in-world interactive blocks for aiming, loading, and firing the cannon.

So now you can destroy your friend's base while being thousands of blocks away!

## Usage
There is a detailed in-game guidebook. Please read it first, and then you can ask for additional help on Discord.

## Features
- Modular cannon
- Interactive cannon controls
- In-game guidebook
- Destroying friendships (friends required)

## Coming soon...
- Improved targeting system
- Console upgrades
- Different ammunition types
- Rocket defenses
- And much more!

## Requires Geckolib!

### Reporting bugs
LA is still in an early phase of development. Bugs are to be expected. Please try to determine how to reproduce the issue, and then report it on Discord.

### Thanks to
- Pixabay and its community for providing sound effects used in this mod.
- Bippinbits for developing PVKK. This mod is in no way connected to official Bippinbits developers or to the PVKK game. It is a fan project heavily inspired by PVKK promotional videos.

title: Durtleminer
description: A custom mod for use on the Durtle Empire SMP. Contains various features requested by SMP members.
body:
## Notes
This mod makes some fundamental changes to Minecraft, and it's recommended you at least read the section headers to get an idea of what it does.

## Credits
- RatseerOfRattesse (Main Programmer, Builder and Texture Artist)
- Jarnu47 (Texture Artist)
- leoleokthelioon (Builder)
- Suuuuuuuuuuuuuuuune (Builder)
- Smileydude23 (Musician and Texture Artist)

## Special Thanks
- ModdingByKaupenjoe - could not have created this without your tutorials
- The Durtle Empire SMP members - thank you for supporting this project :D
- Songs of War - a lot of inspiration from this film :)
- Liam Vickers - I used some of your music (project isn't monetized though so it's fine)

## Features
### The Lesser Firmament Set
- Added Lesser Firmament Pickaxe
  - Obtain by combining a Lesser Firmament Amalgam, Lesser Firmament Template, and Netherite Pickaxe in a smithing table.
  - Can instamine most pickaxe-mineable blocks
  - Has a cool tooltip that shows function on pressing shift
  - Can accept all pickaxe-acceptable enchantments
- Added Lesser Firmament Amalgam
  - Obtain from smelting Lesser Firmament Template **[or from End City loot] <REMOVED FEATURE**
- Added Lesser Firmament Template
  - Obtain from **[from End City loot] <REMOVED FEATURE**
- Made Lesser Firmament Pickaxes fire resistant
### Enchantment Changes
- Made feather falling exclusive to End Cities
- Made mending exclusive to Ancient Cities
### Trial Changes
- Evokers now drop trial keys
- Replaced the elytra item frame in End Ships with an Ominous Vault containing an elytra and some other end items. It requires a Mysterious Key of the End variant to open.
- Added Mysterious Key - end variant. Currently unobtainable. Future plan is to have more variants for more vaults containing useful items across the world.
- Added Ender Trial Key and Ominous Ender Trial Key for an upcoming end-themed trial chamber
- Added loot tables for Trial Spawners and Vaults in the same structure
- Command for normal vaults in the structure
/give @s minecraft:vault[block_entity_data={id:"minecraft:vault",config:{loot_table:"durtleminer:vaults/end_ports/normal/end_port",key_item:{id:"durtleminer:ender_trial_key"}},}]
- Command for ominous vaults in the structure
/give @s minecraft:vault[block_state={ominous:"true"},block_entity_data={id:"minecraft:vault",config:{loot_table:"durtleminer:vaults/end_ports/ominous/end_port_ominous",key_item:{id:"durtleminer:ominous_ender_trial_key"}},}]
- Following commands require a command block
- Command for shulker trial spawners in the structure
/give @p trial_spawner[block_entity_data={id:"minecraft:trial_spawner",spawn_data:{entity:{id:"minecraft:shulker"}},normal_config:{total_mobs:6,simultaneous_mobs:2,simultaneous_mobs_added_per_player:0.5,ticks_between_spawn:20,spawn_potentials:[{data:{entity:{id:"minecraft:shulker"}},"weight":1}],loot_tables_to_eject:[{data:"durtleminer:trial_spawners/end_ports/normal/end_port",weight:1}]},ominous_config:{total_mobs:6,simultaneous_mobs:3,simultaneous_mobs_added_per_player:1,ticks_between_spawn:20,spawn_potentials:[{data:{entity:{id:"minecraft:shulker"}},weight:1}],loot_tables_to_eject:[{data:"durtleminer:trial_spawners/end_ports/ominous/end_port_ominous",weight:1}]},}]
- Command for phantom trial spawners in the structure
/give @p trial_spawner[block_entity_data={id:"minecraft:trial_spawner",spawn_data:{entity:{id:"minecraft:phantom",Color:10b}},normal_config:{total_mobs:6,simultaneous_mobs:2,simultaneous_mobs_added_per_player:0.5,ticks_between_spawn:20,spawn_potentials:[{data:{entity:{id:"minecraft:phantom"}},"weight":1}],loot_tables_to_eject:[{data:"durtleminer:trial_spawners/end_ports/normal/end_port",weight:1}]},ominous_config:{total_mobs:6,simultaneous_mobs:3,simultaneous_mobs_added_per_player:1,ticks_between_spawn:20,spawn_potentials:[{data:{entity:{id:"minecraft:phantom"}},weight:1}],loot_tables_to_eject:[{data:"durtleminer:trial_spawners/end_ports/ominous/end_port_ominous",weight:1}]},}]
- Command for endermite trial spawners in the structure
/give @p trial_spawner[block_entity_data={id:"minecraft:trial_spawner",spawn_data:{entity:{id:"minecraft:endermite",Color:10b}},normal_config:{total_mobs:12,simultaneous_mobs:4,simultaneous_mobs_added_per_player:0.5,ticks_between_spawn:20,spawn_potentials:[{data:{entity:{id:"minecraft:endermite"}},"weight":1}],loot_tables_to_eject:[{data:"durtleminer:trial_spawners/end_ports/normal/end_port",weight:1}]},ominous_config:{total_mobs:18,simultaneous_mobs:6,simultaneous_mobs_added_per_player:1,ticks_between_spawn:20,spawn_potentials:[{data:{entity:{id:"minecraft:endermite"}},weight:1}],loot_tables_to_eject:[{data:"durtleminer:trial_spawners/end_ports/ominous/end_port_ominous",weight:1}]},}]
### Blocks
- Added Dark Purpur blockset
- Added chorus woodset (except for signs, boats, and chestboats) and recipe support
- Added recipes for Dark Purpur, including stonecutter recipes. A Dark Purpur block can be obtained by putting two popped chorus fruit diagonally and two black dye/ink sacs also diagonally in a square formation
- Dark Purpur textures by Jarnu47)
### Daggers
- Added daggers from wood to netherite. All daggers have two less damage than their respective sword and no attack cooldown. Crafted by putting the material above a stick.
### Paintings
- Added the paintings 'Durtle Realistic,' 'Durtle Cartoon,' 'Durtle Sunset', and 'Campfire Cuddles.'
### Sounds
- Added the music disc 'Hez Happy Music.'Obtainable by crafting a ring of turtle scutes aroudn a diamond.
- Added the Arjun is Sus goat horn. Obtainable alongside other goat horns.
- Added the I Am Steve goat horn. Obtainable alongside other goat horns.
### Structures
- Added in the End Grave structure. It's a small building spawning in the outer end, with a double chest of End City loot. Built by oelthelion.
- Added underground room structures. Built by Suuuuuuuuuuuuuuuune.
  - They spawn a single block of either cherry fence, magma block, or stripped birch wood
  - Dig straight down underneath one of these to find either a diamond deposit or a structure with chest loot surrounded by a diamond deposit.
- Added the Tombs of the Builder Structure, Built by oelthelion
  - Spawns undergound in any biome a Trial Chamber spawns in
  - Spawns a central room ('ruins of battle') in which there is a trial spawner and a chest full of mineral loot (entire blocks of it)
  - All other structures branch off of it
  - Blacksmith room: village blacksmith loot, but all the ingots are blocks and there's a special axe on the ground
  - Colosseum room: a massive room with two levels. The lower level is full of posed armour stands, set in battle. The walls are surrounded by a bunch of ominous vaults containing lots of rare loot (including wither skulls, heavy cores, and totems) The top level is empty, but lined with trial spawners. Don't fight them on normal mode - they'll just drop regular trial keys and nothing else. Fight them on ominous however, and you'll get ominous keys, plus some stupid challenging mobs (you will die in iron and likely diamond).
  - Elbow hallway: just a small hallway. There's soom special iron gear on the ground, plus some blacksmith loot. And a trial spawner!
  - Home-like room: a bed and a barrel full of food
  - Icy hallway: a trial spawner. No loot
  - Maze room: a big maze with multiple trial spawners and some nice mineral loot
  - Overgrown room: literally just decoration. Absolutely nothing of value
  - Staircase of doom: big parkour staircase. Might have more rooms at the top, might not
  - Wooden hallway: a trial spawner and barrels full of logs and occasionally god apples
  - Tombs are about as rare as the maximum rarity of a village. They're kinda overpowered, but most of the good loot is in vaults so you most likely only need to find one for a whole server
### Item Frames
- Added in recipes for invisible item and glow item frames. Can be crafted by placing the respective frame with a block of glass. Unfortunately they don't retain invisibility after being placed and broken.
### Songs of War References
- Added seven new armour trims based on Ardoni markings from Songs of War (If you don't know what that is, SHAME ON YOU)
  - Foresight (Based on Hubris Nestoris). Found in buried treasure chests, duplicated with Hearts of the Sea
  - Confluence (Based on Ingressus Voltaris). Found in End cities, duplicated with Purpur blocks
  - Unity (Based on Achillean Nestoris). Found in Trial Chambers, duplicated with Breeze Rods
  - Extremism (Based on Tygren Voltaris). Found in Stronghold libraries, duplicated with End Stone
  - Rebellion (Based on Senn Voltaris). Found in Igloos, duplicated with blue ice
  - Naivety (Based on Ria Sendaris). Found in plains villages, duplicated with slime balls
  - Internecion (Thalleous Sendaris). Found in ancient cities, duplicated with cobbled Deepslate
- Added Mr. Finch's hoe (From Songs of War)
  - Bonemeals crops and trees only, does not consume durability, tills normally
  - Found in Mr. Finch's farm
- Added Mr. Finch's farm structure, spawns in dark oak forests, contains a few chests worth of woodland mansion loot
  - About as rare as a woodland mansion
  - Contains an ominous vault containing Mr. Finch's hoe
  - Vault can be opened with a Mysterious Key, farm variant
  - Added Mysterious Key, farm variant
  - Found in ominous vaults in Trial Chambers
### Diamond and Netherite Changes
- Changed up netherite gear
  - Upgrading diamond to netherite produces shattered gear
  - Shattered gear has to be put in a smithing table with a netherite upgrade template and a nether star to turn into netherite gear.
  - As this mod is primarily for the SMP, this was made to stop a _certain player_ from getting everything on the first day.
- Made diamonds and netherite renewable
  - Diamond gear can be smelted down into one diamond
  - Trade one netherite upgrade template to weaponsmith, armoursmith, or toolsmith for four netherite scraps.
### Wither Debuff
- Debuffed the Wither
  - It now only has 150 health and does not regen.
  - This was done to counter the lack of protection and sharpness enchantments on the server.

title: Default Potion Tweaks
description: Changes the behavior of certain vanilla potion effects, as well as allowing greater control over their specific values
body:
## Default Potion Tweaks

###### Changes the behavior of certain vanilla potion effects, as well as allowing greater control over their specific values

[![Requires MixinBooter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Requires-MixinBooter-ffab00.svg?labelColor=212121&style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/mod/mixinbooter)
[![Requires ConfigAnytime](https://img.shields.io/badge/Requires-ConfigAnytime-ffab00.svg?labelColor=212121&style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/mod/configanytime)

![Inventory status effect]([effect_inv.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ACGaming/DefaultPotionTweaks/refs/heads/main/effect_inv.png))

* A new effect **Mastery** is added, which increases attack speed by a configurable amount
* Haste can be tweaked to only affect mining speed, the specific percent increase is configurable
* Strength moved from a flat damage increase to a percent damage increase, the specific percent increase is configurable
* Instant Health moved from exponential scaling to linear scaling, the healing amount per level is configurable
* Instant Damage moved from exponential scaling to linear scaling, the amount of damage per level is configurable
* The speed increase per level offered by Swiftness is configurable
* The speed decrease per level offered by Slowness is configurable

This mod was commissioned for Minecraft 1.12.2 to be used in the [**Rebirth of the Night**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/rebirth-of-the-night) modpack.

### Cobblemon Stars Mod Pack

Welcome to **Cobblemon Stars**, the ultimate mod pack designed to take your Cobblemon Minecraft experience to new heights! Dive into an enriched world filled with exciting features and community-driven gameplay. Here's what you can look forward to:

#### **Key Features:**

1. **Raids:**
   - Team up with friends or other players to tackle challenging raid bosses. Defeat powerful Pokémon to earn exclusive rewards and prove your strength as a trainer.

2. **Tournaments:**
   - Test your skills in our competitive tournaments. Battle against the best trainers on the server for glory, bragging rights, and fantastic prizes. Regularly scheduled tournaments keep the competition fresh and exciting.

3. **Events:**
   - Participate in special events hosted regularly, offering unique challenges and rewards. From holiday-themed events to special one-time-only occurrences, there's always something new happening in Cobblemon Stars.

4. **Global Trading System:**

title: Pink Garnet Blocks
description: This mod adds stairs, slabs, buttons, pressure plates, fences, fence gates, doors, and trapdoors for both custom and vanilla blocks.
body:
## Mod: **Pink Garnet Blocks**

**Description:**  
This mod enhances your building experience by adding stairs, slabs, buttons, pressure plates, fences, fence gates, doors, and trapdoors for both custom and vanilla blocks.

### Currently Included:
- **Pink Garnet Ore**: Variants of all listed blocks.
- **Lime Wool**: Stairs, slab, fence, wall.
- **Emerald**: Stairs, slab, fence, wall.

### Future Updates:
Expect more items to be added in future updates! For now, these additions expand your building palette with unique materials.

### Version Compatibility:
- **Current Version**: 1.20.1
- **Future Updates**: Release dates for versions beyond 1.20.1 are not currently supported.

**Enjoy the mod and happy building!**

title: Breedable Indicator
description: Mobs that are willing to be bred will give off heart particles when you hold their favorite food.
body: Mobs that are willing to breed will have hearts appear above them if you hold one of their valid breeding items. This is to help tell them apart from mobs who have bred already. This pack reads from the vanilla item tags that determine what items mobs breed with, so if another data pack modifies these tags, this data pack will still work.
